entries.summary: I; me; I (with completive aspect)

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka seini iyan ka ingngaran te etew te kandin ne pegkeetew ke egguhuran din ka duma meyitenged te pegkeetew rin. Iyan degma karumaan te seini ne lalag ka sikeddì/sikeddiey.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenà a eg-ulì diyè te kanami su eg-eatangan a te kunterè ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I won't go to our place because my enemy waits to grab me.

fields.label: Grammar note
fields.text: 1st person singular focus pronoun (Set I, brief form)

fields.label: Grammar note
fields.text: 1st person singular focus pronoun (Set I, brief form) with completive aspect

entries.summary: ah
the hemp plant

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: Used to make rope; major export product; banana family

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka abaka iyan ka pinamula ne egkeeg-ut wey egkaseleppian. Ka abaka ne diyè te katalunan iyan igngaran ka leew, wey ka impamula iyan igngaran ka leing. Ka egkeeg-ut ligkat kayi egngaranan e te lanut ne iyan eggimuwen ne me hinabel. Malebud seini ne pinamula wey warè sugpang ne mahaan egkahepù ka tikeg te dewun kayi wey mahaan degma egkahisi ka me dewun minsan te kalamag dè. Ne emun ke warè nahisi-gisi ka dewun te niyug, nekeg-iling iya perem se dewun dan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Impamula a te me abaka su eyew egtulin eggeg-uten kud ne igbelegyè kud diyè te Kelinan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I planted abakas in order to strip it to fiber when it grows and sell it there in Calinan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mareet ne abaka ka epun su maagkap ka lanut.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Epun abaka is not good because its fibre is lightweight.

entries.summary: the alphabet

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka seini ne lalag migpasabut te ngaran te me litera. Egkaayun ne minsan nekey ne litera ka igpasabut kayi.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Daruwa pad ne tuig si Daday piru egkateu e ne egbasa te abakadda.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Daday knows how to read the alphabet even though she is only two years old.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ka abakada ka alpabitu te Filipino.

entries.summary: measles

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka abas dalu egginguma te me batè. Egpanlepew diyè te laplap ne mallintek piru malalab. Ne meyi kenè egkabawian ka batè egpatey.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Neyid-u a te hari ku su due abas ne migpanlepew diyè te kandin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I felt sorry for my younger brother because he broke out in a measles rash.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Hapit migpatey si Tetuk te abas su neempet e ka lawa rin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Tetuk almost die of the measeles because it's scattered on his body.

entries.summary: to break off something, e.g., corn (aheley), sugarcane (tirè), a raft pole (tarek); and remove the outer skin or leaves

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to break off something, e.g., corn (aheley), sugarcane (tirè), a raft pole (tarek)

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: and remove the outer skin or leaves

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka eg-abat iyan sika se eggaaniyen ne aheley.Kenè egkaayun seini te paley su aheley rè iya.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: When corn (aheley) is picked, the skin (luwit) is then removed at the same time. If the corn is only picked, but not husked, then this is not called eg-abat but egsagpì. With sugarcane (tirè), the outer leaves are usually pulled off before the sugar cane is broken off at the base. With a raft pole (tarek), the nodes (buku) are usually smoothed off.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eg-abat a te aheley su eggaseen ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I am going to pick corn because I'm going to grate it.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eg-abaten niyud e ka aheley ni Nanit?

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Are you going to pick Nanit's corn?

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Did you plow the harvested corn field yesterday?

entries.summary: to pierce something; to go through something, and reach something else

fields.label: Meaning context
fields.text: for a person, animal or thing (esp. a pointed object)

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka kaluwasan te lalag ne abbas iyan ka pegduritsu diyè te limang. Emun ke egseled ka te pilimiru ne gumawan egligwang ka diyè te lein ne gumawan wey ke lungag naa. Seini warè migpasabut ne ke egseled ka diyè te baley diyè ke red egligwè te imbayaan nu ke kenè diyad e te lein ne gumawan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: (Eg-abbas ka uran ke due lungag te atep.)Wà pad mig-abbas.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: It's not drilled through yet (when using a hand-drill on a piece of wood).

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè eg-abbasan te uran ka atep ne warè lungag.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The rain is not pass_through on the roof that there's no hole.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mig-abbasan te weyig ka sakeru ku su napanè bes ni Utù te eggelebek eg-ubal te piet.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The water goes_out from my water container because it is shot by Utu that use to play bow.

fields.label: Meaning context
fields.text: for something, e.g., a sharp utensil or blood on a mat

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to go through something, and reach something else

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eg-ay-ayaran ta te egsubung ka weyig su eyew kenè egkaabbasan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We are going to block the water very carefully so that it won't go through.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Naabbasan ka lekeb ney te ugpit ne intiyuk ni Mama.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The sword that Mama pierce is goes through on our door.

entries.summary: strong (of something such as wind, or someone throwing) or loud (of a sound)

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: strong (of something such as wind, or someone throwing) or loud (of a sound)

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka abbet ne lalag iyan igpasabut ka malantus, meiyal wey manekal. Egkasabut seini ke eggamiten e diyè te peglalag.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Maabbet sikandin ne egdegpak su neumaan din pad te egdegpak ka bayaku seeyè te ulepung te kayu.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: He is strong in throwing because his throw reached the bird at the top of the tree.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Maabbet ne egpallahuy si Buelan su layun egdaug.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Buelan run+fast because he is always won the race.

entries.summary: to go abroad; for some reason

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eg-abbrud a diyè te Amirika ke egpekeimpus ad te kursu ku su amana egdawaten seini ne kateunan diyè.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: After I graduated my course I will abroad to United States of America because this course is demmand their.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mateles ne eg-abbruran ka Amirika ne inged te keddì ne puhawang.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: It is good to abroad in America according to my opinion.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Sika ka ig-abbrud ku su warè seleppì ku para te pegbebaley ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I dont have money to finance for my house that is why i'm going abroad.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Iyan nu abruri ka inged ne Hawaii.

entries.summary: a slender, short, white variety of rice

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a slender, short, white variety of rice

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Abbut ne paley ka ig-erek ney kuntee ne leg-un.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We are going to plant the abbut rice variety this year.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mananam buwa ka abbut ne paley su duen ded taman kuntee?

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Seems abbut rice is yummy because it's exist until now?

entries.summary: to weave something; with something

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eg-abel e pad te eghamiten ku te egparid te pista.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I am going to weave a skirt for my participation of parade this coming fiesta.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eg-abelen ku pad ka eghamiten ku te parid eyew te pista.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will be weaving my skirt for my participation of parade this coming fiesta.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Malised ka ig-abel ku ne me gamit su daan e, keilangan ne eg-ilisan e te bag-u.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My weaving materials are old and it makes difficult for me to work, It is need to change.

entries.summary: to swallow something; throat; to keep on swallowing something

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka eg-abeleng iyan ka pegpaseled te minsan nekey puun te be-bè pabayè te abelangan peendiyè te getek. Egkeyimu sika te minsan nekey ne malenggew wey se kenè.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè ka eg-abeleng te behas te santul su egkabekeg ka.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Don't swallow santol seeds because you will choke.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Nabekeg a dengan te santul su in-abeleng ku ka behas.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I was choke of santol seed because I swallow it.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mania te eglehes ka abelengan te batè?

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Why is the throat of the child noisy?

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Iyan an-anayan ne egbayaan te keenen ka abelengan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The first way to food is throat.

entries.summary: to carry someone or something; on their side; fragrant herbs covered with cloth, tucked into the waist of a woman's skirt

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: In-aben din layun ka anak din ne deisek pad.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: She always carries her little baby on her side.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Abena nu ka anak nu layun.

fields.label: Grammar note
fields.text: If you are carrying a person, their legs straddle your stomach, so that the legs are at your sides.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: fragrant herbs covered with cloth, tucked into the waist of a woman's skirt

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka kaluwasan te abenan iyan ka an-anayan ne tahuanan te ingkeen te manuk. Egkakita seini diyè te leeg te manuk.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kahiyen ku ne egbetu e ka abenan te manuk su amana nabulung-bulung.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I thought that the crop of the chicken was going to burst because it was very full.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Chicken+crop is a first of food.

entries.summary: the clothe used to wrap to the child; sling clothe; to wrap; wrapping

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: the clothe used to wrap to the child; sling clothe

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka abet ne lalag iyan igpasabut ka pegbukus wey ke pegsaput naa te bate. Manggad ne egngaranan te lampin ka ighabet te bate. Egpegbaggkesen ka pulpul kayi eyew igtahu ka bate.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Habeta nu ka bate su egligkat kid.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Wrap the child because we will leave now.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Hugasi nu pa ka platu su eghabet a.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Please wash the plate because I will wrap.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mighabet a te bate sikan naa ka wara a nakatabak te tawag nu.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I was wrapping a child when you call that is why I was not answer you.

entries.summary: to do again something; for a reason; to be repeated

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka eg-abey iyan ka peggimu te minsan nekey ne innimu nud e te an-anayan naa wey ke naluhey e, meupiya naa wey se kenè, dakel na wey se kenè, maheteng naa wey se kein-inuwan naa ne ne egliberan te eggimu.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Engkeri niyu ka salè niyu su pekeetew kew eg-abey.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Leave behind your sins to become born again.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eg-abayan ku pad te eggilamun ka ahelayan ku su eyew kenè egkeenen te ambew.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will still weed again our corn field so that it cannot be eaten by rat.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mig-abayan ku pa te eg-ebunu ka tebesalan ku su eyew egmasalig amana ka behas.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I applied again a fertilizer to my squash field so that it will bear many fruits.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Iyan ku ig-abayi te egpamula te minsan nekey su eyew egmatubung key.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The reason I planted again of any kind of root crops so that we will be abundant of food.

entries.summary: to copulate with a female; for a reason; to always want intercourse with someone else

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Kaluwasan kayi iyan ka eggimuwen te alunggun ne pegpaseled te lebut te lukes diyè te lebut te malitan ne iyan egpuunan ne egkaberes ka malitan ne taman eg-anak e, seini egkaayun degma diyè te me mananap, me manuk-manuk. Ka abid iyan egpuunan ne eglabuhal ka langun ne due umul.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Amana ne mahelhel ka asu ne eg-abid.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The dog is very agressive in mating.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Iyan din kenè ig-abira te asawa rin su eglangeseen.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The reason that he didn't have sex with his wife is that she had her period.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè ka abid keddì su keepes e pad.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Don't have sex with me now because I don't want to.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Abiren ku pad ka asawa ku su naalimengawan ad kandin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will have sex with my wife because I really missed her.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: This is regarded as a vulgar term if it is used in open speech to talk about people

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to always want intercourse with someone else

entries.summary: the part of an edible animal that a particular person always gets; to request or claim a share or part of something; for themselves

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: the part of an edible animal that a particular person always gets

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka abin iyan ka in-angken te etew ne amana rin iya igkeibeg. Iyan dè egkaayunan kayi ka langun ne egkakeen.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ka ulù ka keddì ne abin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The head is always my share.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Naanad a ne duè abin su sika nahud ka eggimuwen te apu ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I use to have portion of fish, and meat because that always my grandmother did.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to request or claim a share or part of something

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Emun ke duè egpekeutel te babuy, usa, kasili ne dakel, egkuwa a te sabeka ne gupal ne eg-abinen ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: When someone is able to slaughter pig, deer, or big eel, I am going to take one large share for myself.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: In-abin ni Rani ka ulu te babuy sikan naa ka warè egpakaahew.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Rani took pig head that's why no one can take it.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to strongly request or claim a share or part of something

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka eg-abinen iyan ka eg-alam te baad te ngalap ne amana igkateltelesi te egkeen te sabeka ne etew.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I gave a share to my father-in-law.

entries.summary: to open something (such as a book (diblu) or a can of fish (tinapa))

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to open something (such as a book (diblu) or a can of fish (tinapa))

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka eg-abliyan iyan ka peglulukat te minsan nekey iling te baley, bintana, kehun, kaban, wey ke kabil naa. Egkaayun degma ne ka peg-awè te supè te minsan nekey.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Abliyan ku pad ka gumawan wey bintana te baley.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will still open the door and window of the house.

entries.summary: abraham banana
April

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka Abril iyan ka igkeep-at ne bulan te kalindaryu. Sabeka seini te sapulù wey daruwa ne bulan te kalindaryu.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpanumbaley a te anggam ku te pitsa singku te Abril su eyew egpakasalengan a pista ran.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will visit my uncle on the fifth of April so that I can arrive during their fiesta celebration.

entries.summary: the greyish white ash from a fire; an (open) fireplace for cooking, or the room containing the fireplace; to build or make a fireplace

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: the greyish white ash from a fire

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka abu iyan ka igmuk ne egkalimud ne egpuun te kayu ne igtemeg wey ke ig-undul. Egpekeiling seini te abug piru ka batek din meebul ne egkataman egkeyimu e seini ne tanè.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Usig ne egbuluku ka miyew diyè te abu.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The cat fond curls up on the ash.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpakabawi te dalehes ka abu su masakit ne igtahu.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Ash will cure skin diseases because it's a pain.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: an (open) fireplace for cooking, or the room containing the fireplace

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka seini ne lalag iyan sika se eggilutuan te minsan nekey ne keilangan ne egsubbeen kayi degma egkakita ka hapuy wey seini ugpu rè te baley.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Hendiyè ka te abuwan ne keen ka.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Go to the cooking place and eat.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Usig ne egkumu-kumu ka buyag diyè te abuwan tagsè maselem.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Old people squat down every morning with their arms around their legs next to the fireplace.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to build or make a fireplace

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka igpasabut te lalag ne eg-aabu iyan ka peggimu te temehanan, subaanan hilutuanan naa. Egtahuan seini te tane eyew due egkatahuan te sig-ang. Ka duma ne eg-aabu iyan eggamiten ka simintu wey putew naa. Piru te matigsalug, iyan de eggamiten ka tane ne malamiket.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eg-aabu a kuntee diye te baley ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will make_a_fireplace in my house.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Migkuwa ka iney ku te malamiket ne tane su eg-aabu sikandin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My mother get clay soil because she is going to make_a_fireplace.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: grey, e.g., as if covered in ash

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mig-atelug ka manuk ku ne abuwen diyè te sapiling.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My grey chicken laid an egg in the back yard.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Abuwen ka igngaran te manuk ne iling te abu ka bulbul.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The chicken that has grey feather called grey_chicken.

entries.summary: black chinned fruit dove

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Migsaharan te abuen ne bayaku ka ka bitaya ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My trap caught a black chinned fruit dove.

entries.summary: to round up animals

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eggendiyà a te kamet su eg-abug a te me babuy ne mahintalunan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I am going to the farm because I am going to round up the wild pigs.

entries.summary: dust (usually dust which is found on the road)

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: dust (usually dust which is found on the road)

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Nabuleg a te abug te terak.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I got a particle in my eye from the dust from the truck.

entries.summary: a type of fruit tree with green, non-sweet fruit with a creamy texture

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a type of fruit tree with green, non-sweet fruit with a creamy texture

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka abukadu sabeka seini ne kalasi te me prutas ne ka nanam kayi kenè ne meemis piru malambu seini. Bayew malibusen seini.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kahiyen ku dengan ne meemis ka abukadu, kunaleg te kenè bes.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I thought before that avocado was sweet, but it's not.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: The fruit is often dipped in sugar before eating

entries.summary: bald; to cut or shave the hair; completely off someone

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka seini ne lalag iyan sika se warè bulbul wey ke impeupew pinaahi te pegpatempug te bulbul. Ka seini ne lalag nekeg-iling de te upew. Piru seini ka bayew maralem te lalag ne upew.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Abulug e ka amey te amey rin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: His grandfather (lit. father's father) is bald already.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Meupiya ne egpitawen ka ulu ni Jayham ke egpaabulug su malibusen.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Jayham's skull is nice to look at when it's bald because it's round.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to cut or shave the hair

entries.summary: pink mold; to become mouldy for a reason

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to become mouldy for a reason

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eg-abungawen ad e mulè ka egtetahad te hari ku ne egbebeli te niyug.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I am mouldy of waiting of my younger brother to buy a coconut.

entries.summary: to plant cassava (binggala) or sugar cane (tirè); somewhere; by poking a stick in the ground on a slight angle. This will then shoot and grow upward from several nodes

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to plant cassava (binggala) or sugar cane (tirè)

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: by poking a stick in the ground on a slight angle. This will then shoot and grow upward from several nodes

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka ad-ad iyan ka pegtiyuk, pegluglug, pegpes-ek te tirè diyè te tanè. Seini ka pamaahi te pegpamula te tirè wey iling degma kayi ka pamaahi te pegpamula te binggala.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kaaselem warè pad duma ne eggimuwen ku su egpangad-ad e pad te tirè.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Tomorrow I won't do anything else because I will be planting sugar-cane.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to crawl along under something low to escape detection

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Duen kun apù te apù ni amè dengan naaldek te etew ne egpangimatey. Tenged te naaldek sikandin, mig-ad-ad e te tibehew ne newugmì.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: They say there was a grandparent of the grandparent of father long ago that was afraid of people that were killing. Because she was afraid, she crawled along under the tibehew that had fallen over. NK 16/Feb/09: They say there was an ancestor long ago that was afraid of people that were killing. Because ...

entries.summary: to give respect to someone; with something (reasons); respectful

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eg-addat a te me suled ku su eyew igkehid-u a ni kandan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will give respect to my brothers so that they pitied on me.

fields.label: Matigsalug example

entries.summary: stilts

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka akew iyan ka eggimuwen ne unturanan te daruwa ne paa ne innimu ligkat te kayu wey ke bagul te niyug. Ke kayu ka eggimuwen ne akew, egsapsapan ka kayu wey egsasangan ka diyè te diralem ne iyan ka egpataluwan te timbebakal wey tinuru te paa. Ke eglansangan ka kayu, egbantalan ka kayu te daruwa ne kayu ne ka kalayatan iling kalayat te paa wey egtukehan ka imbantal ne me kayu wey eglansangan degma eyew egkeehet. Minsan ka damuluwan ke eggimuwen, iling ded degma ka pamaahi te peggimu te akew ne imbantalan wey intukehan wey inggehet pinaahi te lansang. Minsan mamenu kalayat te akew ka eggimuwen sumalè te igkeupii te eggimu. Ne emun ke bagul te niyug ka eggimuwen ne akew, eglungahan dè ka limang ne bagul ne warè nalungahi wey egtiyukan dè te lubid ne iyan eggen-genan te eg-eakew.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Usig a dengan ne eggimu te akew te deisek e pad.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I used to make a stilts when I was a child.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: This is a tree oil which is rubbed all over the patient's body and can also be drunk. If the person gets a rash from this medicine, it is a sign that he has been poisoned or cursed (imbarang). If the person is not cured, no payment is expected. If the person is cured, a large payment is expected, such as a horse (worth 5,000 pesos in 1990) or even more. This remedy is known only by a few people.

entries.summary: to tell a slightly untrue story about something so that can be able to do something

fields.text: Don't overcook rice because it will be shattered when it is pounded.

entries.summary: to raise one or both hands; above their heads, e.g., as in school when indicating that you have the answer to a question

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to raise one or both hands

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: above their heads, e.g., as in school when indicating that you have the answer to a question

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Put up your hand. (Command of teacher at school.)

entries.summary: to tap something to vibrate or wobble it; somewhere; to be vibrated by movements

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to tap something to vibrate or wobble it

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Masakit ka peka ku su naantag a ka mig-untud te terak.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My back is aching because I was shaken around when I rode in the truck.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Amana ka tanè ne egkaantag ke egbibinayu ensi Elisa te hemey.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The ground vibrates when Ilisa and others pound rice.

entries.summary: to play a game of dice; i a plain stone

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to play a game of dice

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Hendini kew e su eg-antak ki eyew egkahalè ki.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Come here let's play a dice so that we can be happy.

entries.summary: to watch or to witness a place; to be seen clearly; to be able someone to see something around

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to watch or to witness a place

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka seini ne lalag iling te migpaneyik ka te bubungan ne egpanlangulangu ka te inged.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpamaneyik a te Sumalili su eg-antayapen ku ka keupiya te dalepè ta ne inaranan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will climbing up to the top of mount Sumalili te witness the beauty of our mother land.

fields.label: Meaning context
fields.text: for a venue or a place

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be able someone to see something around

entries.summary: to float on water; to float well

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Masalig ka me isda ne mig-antew te weyig su inggilu.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: There were dead fishes floating in the river because they were poisoned.

fields.label: Meaning context
fields.text: for something, especially a type of wood

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Amanan maantew ka laheng ni Eddi te egpangukuy diyè te bubungan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Eddi's voice is floating well when he is yelling in the mountain.

entries.summary: to cast lots; to decide something by chance
two days before the fiesta

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Anti kid e eggendiyè te Simud ka egpamista.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We will go to Sinuda two days before the fiesta to attend the festival.

entries.summary: a tiny brownish type of water frog; and poisonous

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a tiny brownish type of water frog; and poisonous

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mesi eglalag ka antig, eg-uran naa te kenè egkaluhey.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: When a small type of water frog talk then it will rain sooner.

entries.summary: spectacles; diving goggles

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Migbehayan a ni Nida te antipara su eyew egpakabasa a te dereisek ne litra.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Nida gives me a spectacles so that I will be able to read small letters.

entries.summary: a preparation for coloring the eyebrows

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a preparation for coloring the eyebrows

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Amana ka antis ni Elisa ne migdakupal.

entries.summary: spectacles

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka antiyuhus iyan ka igsaluub te mata ne egpekeiling te linti. Nakalkalasi ka batek wey ka karakel kayi. Innimu seini ligkat te alungan wey putew, plastik wey ke kayu naa.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Amana ne mahal ka antiyuhus ne igkeupii ku su diyè nahud himuwa te Amirika.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The glasses that I wanted is very expensive because it was made in America.

entries.summary: to gently throw something underhand; to something or someone; to be thrown away accidentally

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka eg-antug iyan ka egdegpak/egsawilè te minsan nekey. Piru egpasaselib ka paahi te pegdegpak wey kenè ne igparibabew te pamanayen su buntug/degpak e ka ngaran due.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eg-antug a perem te bula piru intampuk e ma ni Rikrik.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I am about to thow a ball but Rikrik beat it.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Bantey ka su ig-antug ku diyè te keykew seini se paan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Watch out because I'm going to throw this bread to you.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Hentew-a David ka eg-antuhan nu te sahing?

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Who will you throw this banana at David?

entries.summary: hidden; unknown; to be able to guess, or answer a knowledge question

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka antuken iyan ka tagneen wey ke lalag/guhuren ne neeles se kaluwasan ne keilangan egtulagseben wey egnengnengan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Seini ka antuken ku ne egpaantukan ku kaniyu: Egpaal-alungetey ne neelin nguwehen.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: This is my riddle that I want you to answer: The ones with runny noses approach each other.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be able to guess, or answer a knowledge question

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Hentew-a ka egpakaantuk ke hendei itahù ka kumbalè ni Madu?

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Who can guess where Madu's shirt is?

entries.summary: to suffer or bear something difficult; e.g., the hot sun when working

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to suffer or bear something difficult

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: e.g., the hot sun when working

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka eg-antus iyan ka egtiis te me kayirapan, kasakitan wey langun ne kenè ne meupiya ne egsum-sumanen wey eggeramen. Piru kenè dè me keyirapan wey kasakitan ka eg-antusen, ke kenè, minsan degma egpekeupul ne me pegsulay.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Keilangan ne eg-antusen ta ka langun ne me keyirapan ne egbayaan ta su diyè te kewun-aan, due kahalaan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We need to suffer all the sufferings lie in our way because at the distance, happiness lies.

entries.summary: to rock or seesaw, e.g., on a log across another log

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan seini ka anluwahan ne minsan nekey, kayu, putew. Sabeka ka kayu kayi wey ke putew naa ne egbantalan diyè te taliwarè. Ne ka tagsè pulipusan kayi iyan eg-unturan te daruwa ne etew/grupu eyew egpekegsubal egkaanluwag.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to rock or seesaw, e.g., on a log across another log

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka eg-aantuwal iyan ka eg-aanluwag eyew egkeenew wey egpakabahed ka kayu ne mig-unturan. Emun ke daruwa ka eg-aantuwal, ka tagsè etew egpinnuu diyè te pulipusan te kayu ne mig-unturan dan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Amana a nakiyang su kahiyen ku te egpanlentey te batang ke kenè egkaantuwal.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I was scared crossing through the log because I thought won't tipped up.

entries.summary: the term of reference for a parent-in-law; a prospective parent-in-law; to work for his father-in-law after the wedding as a part of the bride price

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: the term of reference for a parent-in-law

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: The commonly used term of address is enug.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka anuhang iyan ka ngaran te iney wey amey te egpangasawa. Ne minsan degma ka me anggam wey aye te minsan hendei ne kalapihan, te lukes naa wey te malitan, seini red degma ka igngaran te alunggun.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Piding ka ngaran te anuhang ni Andi.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Piding is the name of Andi's father-in-law.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to work for his father-in-law after the wedding as a part of the bride price

entries.summary: to make a "hoy" noise when someone is leaving

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to make a "hoy" noise when someone is leaving

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Migpasabut seini te egkalulunu wey egkaalimengawan, egkatuen wey egkana-naayan ne egkarumaan te laheng ne "himmm dè".

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Nakaanun-anun a te peggipanew enni suled.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I made lots of +"hoy" noises when my friend and company left.

entries.summary: a wild big dirty white skin tree that grows anywhere, and it has small leaves; to be corpse; the dead body move around

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a wild big dirty white skin tree that grows anywhere, and it has small leaves

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka anunang iyan ka kayu ne egmeebul se batek te luwit wey bayew dereisek ka dewun. Minsan hendei seini egtubu wey meupiya degma ne klasi ne pinamula.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: This supposedly happens because the family has been using anunang wood for fires and it causes a person to die slowly. However, the younger generation think that maybe it happens because the person wasn't completely dead.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka eg-anunangen iyan ka mananey egpatey wey minsan migpatey e duen pad geyinawa diyè te abelengan din.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mananey migpatey ka malitan su eg-anunangen.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The woman died slowly because she was a corpse moving.

entries.summary: a hairy type of rice (paley) that is not so well liked by the wild pigs (babuy) and the rice birds (maya)

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a hairy type of rice (paley) that is not so well liked by the wild pigs (babuy) and the rice birds (maya)

entries.summary: a small type a wild tree which is usually used as a roud timber for a house

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a small type a wild tree which is usually used as a roud timber for a house

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka seini ne lalag iyan sika se kalasiyan te kayu diyè te katalunan ne egkaayun ne eggeeren para te baley.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Etuwey! Anupul bes ne kayu ka intempug nu!

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Wow! Surprisingly that you cut off the anupul tree!

entries.summary: fern

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka anutung iyan ka leew ne kayu ne malapung ka dewun ne egpekeiling te dewun te pulà. Meitem ka lawa kayi ne mahalanglang wey duhiyen ka pakew te dewun kayi. Kaayun ne eggimuwen ne seini ne unturanan te me bulak wey egpatubuan te me leew ne bulak.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpameled e pad te anutung su igbelegyè ku te iney ni Punges ne egpameli te anutung.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will cut down anutung trees and sell those to Punges’ mother who is a buyer of anutung.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Due migsesaleg ne limuken dutu te anutung ne eggumgumen ku angkuwa.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: There is fruit dove lying its egg in anutung tree and I will put a trap on it afterwards.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpanguwe e pad te dewun te anutung su iyan ku iglulubung.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will take some anutung leaves because I will make a hunting hut out of it.

entries.summary: to swim down-river with the current

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to swim down-river with the current

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka eg-anuy iyan ka eglumbuk piru egparuma-ruma te weyig ne iyan dè egkakita ka ulu. Ka duma eg-anuy ne eg-eampuan eyew kenè egkaleplep. Ka duen dè geyinawa ka egkaayunan te seini ne lalag wey ka warè lein e degma ka eggamiten.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Emun ke egduù ka weyig ne warè mig-uran, duen naa uled ne mig-anuy.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: If the water cascades in absence of rain, there is a snake swimming down the river.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè ki rè eg-anuy su dakel ka weyig ne kema ke egkalened ki.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We will not swim down the river because it flooded and we might be carried away.

entries.summary: cabinet

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Diyè nu ipanahù ka me kumbalè ta te aparadur su eyew kenè egketketen te ipes.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Put our clothes in the cabinet so that cockroach won't bite them.

entries.summary: to follow; with something

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eg-apas a kaaselem kuna diyè te Basak.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will be following you tomorrow their in Basak.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ig-apas ku rè kuna ka keenen kaaselem te maselem diyè te kamet.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will take your food tomorrow at your field.

entries.summary: the area beside the cheek on the side of the face or jaw.; no good manners; fool

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: the area beside the cheek on the side of the face or jaw.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: Some say it is the area above the cheek, others say the area below.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka apengag iyan ka beneng. Minsan nekey ne due ulaula, egkaayunan te seini ne lalag. Piru ka seini ne lalag kenè amana egkahamit te malehet din ne kaluwasan su layun egkahamit te panunggilingan ne iyan egpasabut ka kenè egtulik.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Neelin naan dè iya ne museng ka apengag ku su migpangendiru a nahud.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My cheek was just [covered] with soot because I ate the rice out of the bottom of the pot.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Warè apengag te seini ne batè su diyè egdiek te irung ta te nakalipereng.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: This child is fool for he stept on my nose when I asleep. (Lit. This child has no cheek...)

entries.summary: bile; gallbladder; the seat of the emotions

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: The phrase, "warè aperu", is used to refer to a person, usually a child, who is not responsible for their actions.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: Figure of speech: The phrase, "napigse e ka aperu rin", is used to refer to a person who was mistreated as a child and no longer obeys anyone or feels remorse over wrongdoing.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka aperu iyan ka baad te lawa te manuk ne diyè egpakakepkep te atey. Bayew seini egmeitem wey egpekeiling te ube se batek. Mapeit seini ke egpigsè wey egkaawè te intiru ne manuk ne sinuba.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mapeit ka aperu te manuk ke egkapigsè.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The gallbladder of the chicken is bitter if burst open.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egmapeit ka sinuba ne manuk ke egkapigsè ka aperu.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The gallbladder will make the cooked chicken bitter.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I'm in a bad mood. (Lit. My gallbladder is bad.)

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Nekey buwa ne batè sika se warè aperu.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: What kind of child is that, being foolish. (Lit. What kind of child is that, no gallbladder)

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Warè aperu te seini ne batè su diyè egdiek te irung ta te nakalipereng.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: This child is fool for he stept on my nose when I asleep. (Lit. This child has no gallbladder...)

entries.summary: including; to include something; to participate in some activity

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka kaluwasan te lalag ne apil iyan ka pegtipul diyè te duma ne due inggimu wey ke migkekelag naa. Minsan nekey ne egpakatimul wey egpakalagkes, sikan en iya ka igpasabut kayi.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egkeupian a ne eg-apil kayi te egbubula su eyew egkateu a degma.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I want to join to the basketball game so that I can learn also.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè ka eg-apilen te egbubula su amana kad e egkateu ne egbubula.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: You won't be included in playing basketball because you'rè very skillful at playing basketball.

entries.summary: to give five to someone

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: The action of 'giving five' involves one person hitting the raised palm of the other.This may be done, for example, to congratulate someone, or when someone tells a joke, or to show that you like someone's actions.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eg-apiran ku si Bora su nakadaug sikandin te papitawey te katuenan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I gave five to Bora because he won a prize during talent night.

entries.summary: hail; to fall together; The name of a lake somewhere in Bukidnon

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka apiyew iyan ka iling te batu ne egmaangkag wey egmeebul ne egpakasewug te dakel ne uran. Egpekeiling seini karakel te sulu ne egkeulug duma te uran wey egkaleney red seini ne iyan egpakatimul te laneg.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mig-uran gabii wey naaldek a te me apiyew diyè te lama.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: It rained yesterday and I was afraid of hail in our front yard.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè kew silengleng kuntee te uran su egkengeuluhan kew te derakel ne apiyew.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Don't walk in the rain now because you might be hit by large hail.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: The small pieces of ice break open egkapigsè when they strike the ground and release a fluid which is like water.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: If the rain and hail will go together it means that there is a person who made something wrong (esp.laughing of animal).

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: The name of a lake somewhere in Bukidnon

entries.summary: surname; family name

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka apilidu iyan ka ngaran te kaap-apuan wey seini ka ilaan te langun ne me etew te me karumaan dan. Ka langun due me apilidu minsan nekey ne kalasi te etew. Iyan dè dengan eggimuwen ne apilidu te me etew ka ngaran te amey ran piru kenad kuntee.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ka apilidu ni Mimi su Man-umbuk.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Man-omboc is the family name of Memie.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Man-umbuk pad dengan ka apilidu ni Mimi piru Adyung e kuntee su nakaasawa rin e ki Birni Adyung.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Man-imbuk was Mimi's surname before but now it is Adyung for she got married with Birni Adyung.

entries.summary: approved

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mig-aprubaan e te me meisturu ka me impalanuwan ney ne project para te iskuylaan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Our proposed project for school has been approved by the teachers.

entries.summary: grandchild; grandparent; descendant

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Miggendini ka apù ku ne anak te anak ku su naalimengawan kanami.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My grandchild who is the daughter/son of my daughter came here because s/he misses us.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eggendiyè key te apù ney ne iney te iney ney su naluhey e ne warè ney nakita sikandin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We are going to our grandparent the mother of our mother because it was already a long time that we haven't seen her.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka kaap-apuan iyan ka kabuybuyahan te sabeka rè ne pamilya. sikandan ka egpuunan te sabeka ne kalayunan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Warè key e nakakita te me kaap-apuan ney su nammatey e sikandan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We haven't seen our ancestor because they were already dead.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Me matigtalumu bes ka kaap-apuan enni Eteng, kahiyen ta ne me matigsalug.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Eteng’s ancestors were talumus, we are thinking that they’re matigsalugs.

fields.label: Comment
fields.text: great great grandchild; great great grandparent

fields.label: Comment
fields.text: great great great grandchild; great great great grandparent

fields.text: a bacteria culture used to start the rice fermentation process used to created tinapey

fields.text: Migtubuan dengan te apù ka peka ni Nuwil.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a bacteria culture used to start the rice fermentation process used to created tinapey

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a bird used for trap in order to catch others

entries.summary: last name

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Agdahan ka apù ku su iyan apù te apù ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My last name is Agdahan because that is my grandfathers last name.

entries.summary: a wild chicken that has been tamed

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a wild chicken that has been tamed

entries.summary: lime; to offer bettle nut; a bettle nut which is ready to chew

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: Made by burning snail shells buyukung covered by ember untill it become soft.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Migpamurut ka iney ku te buyukung su eggimuwen din ne apug eyew egpakamamè sikandin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My mother collects shells because she is going to make a lime out of it so that she can make a chew betel.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: They are offering bettle nut to each other.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a bettle nut which is ready to chew

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Duen e inapuhan sika te lamisa.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: There is a prepared bettle nut at the table.

entries.summary: to verbally refuse something or someone; debator; has an ability to debate

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to verbally refuse something or someone

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: In the parable of the two sons who were asked by their father to go work in the fields, the one who at first refused but then went and did it was the one who mig-apul his father. The one who agreed at first but then didn't do it didn't mig-apul his father.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mareet ne batè si Irik su layun eg-apul te iney ke egsuhuen.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Eric is bad because he always refuses when his mother commanding him (to do) something.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to debate or discuss with each other

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpaap-apuley si David wey si Binhamin su egmekeg-ahew te kasilè.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: David and Benjamin are arguing because they are snatching sweet potato.

entries.summary: a vegetable which grows along the river bank

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a vegetable which grows along the river bank

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka seini ne gulay egpekeg-iling te dewen te suli wey iling en iya seini te suli piru kenè egdehes wey amana ne meilem ka dewen wey bayew maangkag ka me lawwa kayi ne diyè dè egkakita seini te katalunan su egkeenen te palees ka behas kayi ne egngaranan te butù te apesew wey meupiya degma ne egkeenen ka butù kayi.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Migpamupu key te apusew diyè te sampew su eggulayen ney.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We picked vegetable variety at water falls because we are going to cook them.

entries.summary: apostle
to flee somewhere (e.g.,a place or relatives); because of something (e.g., famine or someone)

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to flee somewhere (e.g.,a place or relatives)

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: because of something (e.g., famine or someone)

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka eg-aput iyan ka egpallahuy ne egdupak wey egpepangabang te duma. Egkaayunan kayi ka minsan minsan nekey ne egkaaputan iling te kayu, baley, bubungan, sulung, batu, etew wey duma pad ne egpakapangabang wey egpakabulig te timpu te kalasayan wey keyirapan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eg-aput e pad diyè te me karumaan ku su amana ne bitil kayi te kanami ne inged.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will evacuate to my relatives because of the famine here in our place.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Emun eggingume e ka kumunista ne seeyè key eg-aput te katalunan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: When time comes that communist will arrive we will flee to the forest.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Diyè key eg-aput te anggam ney tagsè egbubunlis ka amey ney.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We will flee to my uncle every time our father get angry.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Diyad e mig-aput ensi Mayit te kanami gabii su newubug ka amey ran.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Mayit and others evacuated to our place yesterday because their father was drunk.

entries.summary: great grandchild

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka apù te buel iyan ka anak te apù te apù. Minsan hentew ne anak te apù te apù din minsan mekaamung dè wey ambey rè, egkaayun ded degma. Iling kayi ka apù te buel: ka iney eg-anak wey eg-anak e degma ka anak din ne ka anak din eg-anak e degma, ne seeyè se apù eg-anak ne sikan en iya ka apù te buel.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Si Diyunatan Linggan ka apù te buel te apù ney ne iney te iney ney.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Diyunatan Linggan is the great grandchild of our grandmother that is a mother of our mother.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ka apù ney ne iney te iney ney, ka eg-eapù te buel ki Diyunatan Linggan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Our grandmother which is the mother of our mother, Diyunatan Linggan is her great grandchild.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: It is called apù_te_buel because their great grandfather and grandmother still alive and still giving care of the child just like hugging and carrying them.

entries.summary: great, great grandchild; great, great grandparent

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka apù te mata iyan ka anak apù te buel te apù. Malayat seini ne peg-iitul su iling kayi: ka iney eg-anak ne ka anak din eg-anak e degma ne seeyad en iya ka apù, ne ka apù eg-anak e degma ne seeyad en iya ka apù te buel ne eg-anak e degma ka apù te buel ne seeyad en iya ka egngaranan te apù te mata. Egngaranan seini te apù te mata su kenè mem pad egpatey ka apù wey egkakita rin pad anak te apù din te buel.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Nekey buwa ka ngaran te apù ku ne apù te mata te apù ku?

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: What is the name of my grandchild which is the great great grandchild of my grandmother?

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: It is called apù_te_mata because their great, great grandfather and grandmother still alive and see them.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan e man-e seini ka apù ne buyag wey kenè ne ka apù te mata ne batè.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Nakakita kun pad keddì ka apù ku te mata te warè pad sikandin migpatey.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My great great grandparent was able to saw me before she died.

entries.summary: great, great, great grandchild; great, great, great grandparent

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka apù te talinga iyan ka anak te apù te mata. Iling man-e kayi ka peg-iitul kayi: ka iney eg-anak wey eg-anak e degma ka sikandin ne seeyad en iya ka apù, ne ka apù eg-anak e degma ne seeyad en iya ka apù te buel, ne ka anak te apù te buel seeyad en iya ka apù te mata, ne ka anak te apù e te mata seeyad en iya ka apù te talinga. Egngaranan seini te apù te talinga su amane e ne mariyù ka peg-anak-anak te kabuhalan din ne egkarineg naan dè ka ngaran te apù din su migpatey man-e ka buyag ne apù.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: It is called apù_te_talinga because the child didn't see their great, great, great grandfather and grandmother, only story they heard from their parents about them.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan seini ka buyag ne apù te talinga wey kenè ne iyan ka batè.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Warè kun nanengnengi ka ngaran te me apù ku te talinga su dengan dè sikandan nammatey.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I don't know the name of my great great great grandparents because they died long time ago.

entries.summary: bad omen in the weather; to show an ill omen, such as rain, lightning and thunder, wind or a rainbow; to be bad because of a particular action

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to show an ill omen, such as rain, lightning and thunder, wind or a rainbow

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka ayew iyan ka palinneu ne egkakita diyè te aw-awangan iling te egpaddusilem, egpamalawag, egmalalab ka langit, wey egsalahapun minsan kenè ne lengleng. Sika ka me palinneu ne egkakita diyè te aw-awangan te due mareet ne egkeyitabu. Minsan degma diyè te me etew wey me ayam wey minsan nekey egkakita degma ka me palinneu te due egkeyitabu/neyitabu ne kenè ne meupiya.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kema ke ayew e seini te egbubunu su sahuhune dè ne migpaddusilem wey duma rè iya ka kulihi ne mig-ulingit.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: This might be a bad omen of a murder because the sky suddenly darkened and the buzzard bird is also calling out loudly.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: The bad omen usually indicates a forthcoming murder, enemy raid, or a similar happening. The weather is also believed to become bad in response to certain actions by people (e.g., laughing at animals). The bad weather is also seen as a sign that something bad will happen to the people who did the action.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be bad because of a particular action

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpakaayew-ayew ka timpu ke egmangngingisin ki te me mananap.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The weather will be bad if we laugh at animals.

entries.summary: pig; to keep or raised domestic pigs

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka babuy sabeka ne mananap iling te usa piru warè dè sungey wey usig ne egpanuwal seini. Daruwa se kalasi te batek kayi due maangkag wey meitem, mahintalunan wey ayam. Mapupul se irung kayi piru egpakasudsud te tanè minsan makehal. Warè nenekeg-iling ka karakelan kayi due ka amana dakel, due ka eleg-eleg dè wey due dereisek ne kalasi. Amana ne malambu ka ngalap kayi piru ka duma ne etew kenè egkeen kayi su malindit kun wey egpakabehey degma te dalu.

entries.summary: to revenge at someone else; to answer the letter or email to someone else

fields.text: Ka egbales iyan ka egsulì te minsan nekey ne neyimu diyè kandin minsan mareet wey ke meupiya. Senge kakuwa ne kenè egpekeg-iling ka sulì din te innimu diyè te kandin, egkaayun ne egsulian din te meupiya ka mareet wey ke mareet naa ka igsulì din te meupiya. Kaayun degma ne egpeg-elinen, ke nekey ka innimu diyè te kandin sikan ded degma ka eggimuwen din diyè te miggimu kandin te iling dutu. Ne emun ke mareet, ne mareet ded wey emun ke meupiya, ne meupiya red degma.

entries.summary: a large, high type of a tree which usually dwelling place of anykind birds (strangler fig); a tree in traditional Matigsalug belief; evil spirits (busew) that dwell in balitì trees

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a large, high type of a tree which usually dwelling place of anykind birds (strangler fig)

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: These start as epiphytes and strangle their host, assuming tree form. There are at least five known species: 1. F. benjamina: straggling, smooth tree with drooping branches, planted as graceful shade tree, the bast of which is source for rope material. 2. F. indica: (Tag) baliting-baging, baliting-ibon, (Ceb) nunúk, erect smooth tree, the bark of which is used by Negritos and Mangyans in their g-strings. 3. F. payapa, (Ilk) puspus, basakla, the powdered roots are used as vulnerary when applied to wounds. 4. F. retusa: (Tag) marabutan, large with slender roots, smooth brown bark and male and female flowers, leaves and bark applied as poultice for rheumatism. 5. F. stipulosa: (Ilk) sanglaw, deciduous, 10 m. high, the fresh roots are used as poultice on wounds. They are much feared as being haunts of various supernatural beings like (Tag) tianak. The panuvaran, prayer house is built under such a tree for offering sacrifice to appease the spirits.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: There are a number of foods which are not recommended for a feeding mother to eat in the first week after giving birth. These are: cold water, salt asin, deer usa, egg-plant sehutung, balanak and subbuk (types of fish), red corn, cassava binggala, red-skinned sweet potato, wild pork, dried fish bulad, and taro leaves tubed. Basically anything which is associated with a red color is prohibited. Other foods (especially those associated with white) are acceptable and these include: chicken manuk, string beans sitaw, white rice ballas, white-skinned sweet potato, white corn, carp, small fish peit, domestic pork, linala, sardines and bananas sahing.

entries.summary: to command someone else

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka igpasabut te buut iyan ka peg-awè te katenged te sabeka ne etew. Egpekeiling seini te uripen ne minsan hendei rè egsuhu-a. Meupiya ne egbatasanen ka iling kayi su migpeila te pegpariralem. Biniseyè seini ne lalag ne layun e eggamita te me Matigsalug.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Duè katenged din ne egbuut su sikandin ka pangulu.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: He has the authority to rule because he is the president.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Si Bura ka migbuut ke nekey ka eggimuwen te me Hari rin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Bura make_decision for his younger brothers/sisters.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè ne meupiya ne egbuutan te me ginikanan ka anak te kursu ne igkeupii su kenè egpekeimpus.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: It's not good to parents to+decide of the course for their children because they will not succed.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Meupiya ne egbuutan ka etew ne buutan su mahaan egtuman.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: It's good to+control the person who is kind because he/she easy to follow.

entries.summary: fixed married;

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka igpasabut te buutan iyan ka egpeg-asaween ne iyan egbuut ka me ginikanan. Minsan nekey ka eggimuwen te lukes wey malitan ne egpeg-asaween, warè iya egkeyimu.

fields.text: Egbuutan a perem te iney ku piru wara migsugut ne eg-asawa su warè ku igkeupii ka malitan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My mother had arrange_married for me but I disagree to marry because I don't like the woman.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Migbuutan te apu ku ka iney ku sikan naa ka nekeg-asawa sikandan te amey ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My grandfather force_to_marry my mother that is why they married with my father.

fields.text: a rash in the groin or under the neck of a baby

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to get a chill after swimming too long

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè kew sesalual te makames su egdahumayen kew.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Do not wear wet pants because you will be chilled.

entries.summary: pull down

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka igpasabut te dahupì ne lalag ka pegkeulug puun te ampew ne marahing-dahing. Kenè bayew egkahamit ka seini ne lalag diyè te kasangkapan ne egkeulug, diyè dè te etew. Ka seini ne lalag mabehat amana su emun egkahi ka senge-etew te dahupì, igpasabut naa ne natamtamanan neulug ka sabeka ne etew.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Migdahupì dè iya si Tetuk ka neulug te baley ney dengan diyè te Luwey.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Tetuk dropped from the roof of our house heavily.

entries.summary: a piece of wood or plastic for chopping meat and vegetable

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a piece of wood or plastic for chopping meat and vegetable

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Seini ka egpanadtaran te me ngalap wey me gulayen ne minsan nekey.

fields.label: Grammar note
fields.text: Seems that this does NOT come from a verb root like dakat.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Tadtara nu pa sika se ngalap sika te dakatan eyew egkasubbe e.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Kindly chop the meat into small pieces using that chopping board so that it will be ready for cooking.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Amana ne meupiya ka dakatan niyu ra!

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Your chopping board is really nice!

entries.summary: to tap something; on the ground or stone

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè nu idakdak sika se saku ku su due egbetu.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Do not tap my sack because there is something in it that will explode.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: E.g. removing lead sinkers from the wooden mold.

entries.summary: big; large; to grow bigger in size; many; much

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Dakel ne babuy ka migbayè te ahelayan ney su maluag ka kemes.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The pig that passed through our cornfield is big because the step is wide.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Wey kud e igdaddu ka kalabew ku ke egdakel e sikandin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will only plow my carabao when he grow up already.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egparakelen iyan ka eggimuwen ne dakel ka kabaluan wey ke kaayun pad ne egpatulinen.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egparakelen ku pad ka me itù ku ne wey ku igbehey keykew.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I just letting my puppies to grow bigger then I'll give you.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egparakelen ku pad ka behas te peliyà human ku egpupuwa.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will make the fruit of bitter melon grow big before picking it.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Indakelan ku te egbaad si Nanit.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I put big portion on Nanit's share.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Igkarakdakeli e te egkenga-ayu-ayu ke due ubag seleppì dan ne sabeka ne gatus.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Poor people grieve if they have one hundred peso.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka karakelan iyan ka katikang, kalayat, wey mamenu kasulug ka tahu te minsan nekey wey minsan hentew.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpekeiling te karakelan te baley te buyag ka baley te apù ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The size of my grandpa’s house is like the house of the old.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mamenu a ka+ karakelen te kasili ne neutel nu gabii?

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: What is the size of the eel that you were caught yesterday?

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to get bigger by giving a lot amount of food

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egdakel e ka anak ni Etug ki Ining.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Etug's son with Ining is already growing.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egdakelen ku ka igpakeen ku te asu ku eyew mahaan egtulin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will give more food for my dog so that it will grow faster.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egdakelan ku te sunggud ka itù ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will feed my puppy a big amount of food.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ke egdakel-dakel e ka me manuk ney, egkengalaag e.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: When our chicken get bigger, then they will be lost.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egkarakdakelan a te geyinawa diyè te uyab ku su amana sikandin ne telegandang.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My love towards my girlfriend is increasing for she is very beautiful.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: may be a metaphor for being in love with a person?

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to give love, value ( beloved ) at someone else or something for a reason

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Indakelan si Hisus te geyinawa te Amey rin su migsabsabeka sikandin ne Anak.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Jesus is loved by his Father because he is the only Son.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Iyan igdakeli si Hisus te amey rin su sabsabbeka nahud sikandin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The reason that Jesus loved much by his father because he was the only son ( child ).

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Iyan din igdakeli te geyinawa ka asawa rin su mabasuk nahu.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The reason that he loved much his wife because of being industrious.

entries.summary: expensive

fields.text: Amana ne dakel se bali te nabeli ku ne kumbalè.

fields.label: English translation

entries.summary: to hold and push down something; on the ground or in a stiff area; (so that it would not move)

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to hold and push down something

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: on the ground or in a stiff area

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egdakesel iyan ka egpahen wey egdasek te minsan nekey pariralem eyew egkatenes wey egpakadalapi. Eggamitan seini te keseg wey kanekal iling te pegpahen te babuy ne eggimatayan diyè te impeyibatan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Migpabulihey sikandan ka egdakesel te bubu ne igteen dan su eyew egkatanled.

fields.text: Igdakesel ku ka babuy ne eggilangen su eyew kenè egpakaweil.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will press down the pig to be slaughter so that it can't move.

fields.text: to used to pressed down with something

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Narakeselan a te me saku ne intiang ney ki Dadut gabii.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I was pressed down by the sacks that Dadot and I were carried yesterday.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Si Adan ka indakeselan te duma rin ne iyan kun migpanakew.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Adan was being blamed by his companion who steal something.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: or to force them into a difficult situation

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Indakeselan a nikandin te salè ne warè ku neyimu.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpakarakesel ki iya te dalu ke kenè ki egpabawi wey egbuyù te tabang te Manama.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We will become extremely sick when we are not going to a doctor and ask a guidance of the Lord.

fields.label: Matigsalug example

fields.label: English translation

entries.summary: pile up; to become thick

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egdakupal iyan ka egmakepal wey ke eg-utu-utu wey ke eg-um-umambu. Egkaayunan kayi ka langun ne egmemekeg-ampew wey ke egmemekeg-utun ne minsan derakel wey me mallintek, mannipis wey ke makepal.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Migdakupal dè iya ka bilu te egbusawen diyè te Dabaw. Nekeiling din e te tued ne natutung.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The grime on the crazy man in Davao is very thick. He looks like a burned stump.

entries.summary: a particular kind of stone of which certain cliffs are made; a cliff made of a particular type of stone; having a lot of cliffs of dalama rock (of an area)

fields.label: English translation

entries.summary: path; to make a path or trail; somewhere

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka igpasabut te lalag ne dalan iyan ka bayaan. Iyan duma ne igpasabut te dalan ka sabeka ne lugar ne layun egbayei. Kaayun ne terak ka ebaye, etew wey me ayam naa. Egmaawang seini wey egmarampal.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Hendei ka dalan te eggendue te engki Mirian?

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Where is the way going to Mirian?

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Dalan buwa te ambew seini su marampal e?

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: This might be a way of a rat because it is cleared?

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to make a path or trail

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: It is difficult to make a trail because we'll be pierced.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Seini ka meupiya ne egdalanen su makehal ka tanè.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: This area is a good place to make a trail because the soil is solid.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egdalanan te me etew ka sika ne bubungan peendiyè te limang.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: People will make path over that mountain going to the other side.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be on the road or path

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Paayun-ayun ke rè patiralan kayi ne dutun dè iya te kewun-aan ka belun.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Just go straight on this road and you can find the well ahead of you.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Diyè kid e egpamewu te deralanen.

fields.label: English translation
