fields.text: Two thousand (pesos) is the purchase price of my of my carabao.

entries.summary: twenty

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Amana a nahalè su daruwampulu ne saku ka nahaani ku te keddì ne kamet.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I'm very happy because I harvested twenty sackfuls from my field.

entries.summary: twenty

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka daruwa ne pulù iyan seini ka lalag meyitenged te numiru ne migsinundulan te sapulu wey siyew, wey nakasinundul man-e kayi ka numiru ne daruwa ne pulù wey sabeka.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Te daruwampulù pad ka idad ku amana a ne maagsik-agsik.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I'm very smart when I was twenty years old.

entries.summary: a field

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka seini iyan sika se egpamulaan ne imbungkiyal pinaahi te daru wey ke taraktul ne nabukiyal e ka tanè wey egkaayun e ne egpamulaan te minsan nekey.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Maluag ka daruwan diyè te salalayan ne egpamulaan te paley.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Salalayan's field is so wide for rice plantation.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka daruwa ne pulù iyan ka numiru ne egpakasinundul te sapulù wey siyam wey egkasinundulan man-e seini te daruwa ne pulù wey sabeka.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Buyag e bes en iya su daruwa ne pulù ad ne leg-un kayi te Simud.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I am old enough because I stayed in Simud for twenty years already.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kahiyen te apù ku ne daruwa ne pulu din kun pad, kunaleg te nabuybuyahan bes e.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My grandfather/mother think that he/she is still twenty years old, but_on_the_other_hand he/she is very old.

entries.summary: twenty-two
twenty-one

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan igpasabut kayi ka numiru ne egpakasinundul te daruwa ne pulù wey egkasinunudulan degma seini te daruwa ne pulù wey daruwa.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kahiyen ku ne egpekeimpus ad te peg-iskuyla ku te miggingume e te daruwa ne pulù wey sabeka ka idad ku, kunaleg te kenè e bes pad.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I thought I can be finished with my studies when my age turn to twenty one, on_the_other_hand I cannot yet.

entries.summary: a gift or payment; to give a gift or reward; to someone else

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Amana nahalè ka me anuhang ku, su imbehayan ku sikandan te dasag.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My parent-in-law was very happy because I gave them a gift.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to give a gift or reward

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Na prublimaan a ke nekey ka igdasag ku te uyab ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: It's a problem for me if what kind of gift that I will give to my girlfriend.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egdasahan ku te salual ka amey ku.

entries.summary: to use all the vegetables all at once

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to use all the vegetables all at once

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan igpasabut te seini ne lalag ka eg-aminen te eggamit ka minsan nekey ne butang te sikandè ne timpu wey ke uras.

entries.summary: to give bribe

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Seini red ka igdasè ku, ne himatayi nu ka asawa ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Here is my bribe, and then kill my spouse.

entries.summary: dense; thick; to press down on something; and keep adding more until it becomes compacted

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: and keep adding more until it becomes compacted

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan igpasabut te seini ne lalag ka egtamien ka minsan nekey ne intahu te minsan nekey.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Indasek ni Nuwil ka pitsay rin eyew dakel ka igpakatahu te saku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Nuwil press_down his pechay in the sack so that it will contain more.

fields.label: Meaning context
fields.text: for something, e.g., rice or corn in a sack, soil in a basket

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mabehat ka aheley minsan senge saku dè ke egkaay-ayaran egkarasek.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Corn is heavy even if it's only one sack if it is compacted carefully.

entries.summary: add to much

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: For example, adding more food to one's plate

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Egkahamit ka seini ne lalag ke egpamehayan te senge etew te egkakeen ke senge etew wey egkahamit man-e ka seini ne lalag ke diyè dè egsahensek te senge ledleran ka masulug ne etew.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ka langun ne prublima kayi te Simud indasen te Mayur.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: All the problems here in Sinuda get given to the Mayor.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Indasen keddì ka egkakeen sikan naa ka nabulung-bulung a.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: They give me so much food to me and so Im so full.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Nakiling ka bangka su narasen key ma diyè te limang.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Raft is inverting because we are compacted on one side.

entries.summary: to encourage others (e.g. church members); to ak someone; for encouragement

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egdasig a te me duma ku su kenad e egpanimba.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I'll encourage my companions because they don't go to church anymore.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egdasihen ta ka tagsè sabeka kanta su eyew kenè ki egkapeled te kanta ne pegpamakey.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We encourage to everyone of us so that we can't fall over to serve the lord.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be encouraged by someone or something (e.g. a good situation)

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ingkadasig din ka iyam ne himu rin su meupiya.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: He is encouraged by his new work because it's good.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to encourage someone, or to be the thing

entries.summary: to arrived in the bride's residence; to marry; to give a gift

fields.label: Meaning context
fields.text: for the relatives of the groom

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to arrived in the bride's residence

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan igpasabut te seini ne lalag ka pegdulung te lukes diye te baley te malitan. Sabeka seini ne kultura te Matigsalug.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Indateng e si Nuwil te amey ku gabii.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The father bring Noel to the woman's house yesterday.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mahirap ka neumaan ney te pegdateng ney te baley te eg-asaween ni Jacky.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We have bad experienced when we arrived at Jacky's bride house.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: usually as a forerunner to making a bigger request from them

entries.summary: to have a fever

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Warà a nakaleug-leug gabii su egdatengen a.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I can't able to strolled yesterday because I has a fever.

entries.summary: to arrive; to stay inn

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka dateng egpekeg-iling te egginguma, ke hendei ka egpuun ka baley ne eggingumaan nu sika ka egdatengan nu.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Duen e pad egdateng te baley ni Peggak te me daruwan karusileman.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: There are still arrive at Peggak's house within two nights.

entries.summary: impassive

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè ka egpalintutu due su egparatu-datu dè sika.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Do not believe that because he/she is just impassive.

entries.summary: chieftain; dominant; leader

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka datù ne egkahiyen iyan sika se mateu te kukuman wey gantangan ne egkateu ne egsulbad te me samuk iling te ahawey, patey, libug wey duma pad.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ka datù ka tighusey ke due egpakalibug, egpakapatey wey te duma pad ne me prublima.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The chieftain was a resolver when theres somebody commit adultery, murder and other problem.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Meupiya ne etew ka igdatù ney diyè te kanami ne inged.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The leader in our place was a good man.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be a spokesman of other side

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Masalig ka me terak te datù wey maluag ka tanè.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Rich people are usually have many vehicles and heve a wide area of land.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to become a leader; to be wealthy

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Masalig ne me etew ka egkeupian ne egkaratù, ne langun ne himu eggimuwen dan, mareet ma wey meupiya.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Many people desire to became a rich, then they do everything even each good or bad.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Minsan dakel ka karatuan ta kayi te inged, piru warè pulus su kenè te ma egkeuyan diyè te langit.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Eventhough we have much wealth here in our world but it's useless because we can't bring it to heaven.

entries.summary: to bounce; to bounce something

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egdatul ka bula su malibusen ma.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The ball will bounce because it is round.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egkeupian a ne egparatul te bula tagsè maselem.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I like to bounce the ball every morning.

entries.summary: to win a competation; to have won

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Taheinep ku ne indaug a te pegpamakey ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I was dreamed that I won to serve the lord.

entries.summary: sesame

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka dawa iyan ka pinamula ne egpekeiling te paley se dewun wey minsan iya ka lawa piru dereisek ubag ka behas. Egpekeiling dè karakel te lelanek ka behas kayi. Mahaan dè degma seini eg-uma iling te paley. Amana ne tetelesi ne egkeenen ka behas kayi ke egkabinayu e su malamiket wey mananam ke egkalutu e. Bayew rè dereisek seini te lenga. Nasabeka rè iya ka ngaran te behas wey lawa.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Amana bes ne masalig ka dawa ne migtubù diyè te tampuwaran te baley su neulaan te batè ka dawa ne nanubù e.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: There are many sesame grow in the back yard of the house because the child spilled out the seed and it grew.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Masalig ka dawwa diyè te lama ney.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: There's a lot of barley in our front yard.

entries.summary: to receive something

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Amana ne mahale-galè ne indawat te amey ku ka mahaliyug.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My father warmly and happily welcomes the visitor.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Nekey-a diyè te kaniyu ne suman-suman, egdawaten ku buwa ka igbehey ni Maning keddì?

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: What do you think, should I take the thing given by Maning?

entries.summary: to pounce and seize its smaller prey (e.g., a chicken, a mouse); to be able to catch a prey

fields.label: Meaning context
fields.text: for an animal (e.g., a snake, a cat, a crocodile, an underwater monster)

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to pounce and seize its smaller prey (e.g., a chicken, a mouse)

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egkaamin e ka me piyak ku su egpandawiyen te banug.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My check will almost gone seized by eagle.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be able to catch a prey

entries.summary: to mention someone's name, i.e., to associate someone's name with an action; to be mentioned in connection with some action, e.g., when the children misbehave then others remember that the father never disciplined the children

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to mention someone's name, i.e., to associate someone's name with an action

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egdawit ki te Manama te tagsè aldew su eyew kenè ki iya egbalaharen nikandin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We call God every day so that we are never ignored by him..

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè ka dawit te egkakeen ke eggendiyè ka te mabbenes su kema ke egkahaten ka te uled.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Do not mention food when you go to into the bush because you might get bitten by a snake.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Layun din dè egdawita ka amey rin te timpu te me keyirapan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: In difficult times he always talks about his father.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be mentioned in connection with some action, e.g., when the children misbehave then others remember that the father never disciplined the children

entries.summary: to transfer

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka lalag ne dawunlud iyan igpasabut ka peggalin te minsan nekey puun te sabeka ne kumpyutir peendiyè te sabeka ne kumpyutir wey ke silpun naa. Ka seini ne lalag egpuun te Inglis ne linalahan piru eggamiten e seini te me Matigsalug ne me etew.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Migpadawunlud si Anamarie te me kanteen diye te silpun din eyew due iyam ne me kanta rin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Anamarie puts songs into her cellphone so that she have a new songs.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egdawunlud ka United Matigsalug Christian Association, Inc te me ulahingen ne me Matigsalug.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: United Matigsalug Christian Association Inc downloading Matigsalug songs.

entries.summary: an upstream location

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka diraya iyan ka uluwan te weyig. Egkaayun ne degma ne iyan en iya ka migpuunan/mig-uluwan kayi wey ke sika naan e iya se lawa piru kenè pad ne marani te tetemuwan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Diya a egbunsud te diraya ka egseseg-ew su masalig ka ngalap diyè.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will start poisoning fish upriver because there are a lot there.

entries.summary: to praise someone or something; with words or actions; to pretend to have or be something

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka pegdayan iyan ka pegsayè te minsan hentew wey te minsan nekey.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egdayanen ku ka alukuy ku tenged te keupiya rin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I praise my friend because of his kindness.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: This term is not used in the Southern Matigsalug areas such as Gumitan. They prefer deyrey or sayè.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to pretend to have or be something

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: so that they will be praised

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egparayan-dayan iyan ka peggimu te minsan nekey eyew igpakita te duma eyew egsayeen sikandin.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egkeepes a te etew ne huwey rè eggimu ke due agalen din su egparayan-dayan ma ubag.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I don't like the man pretending to be hard-working in the presence of his master so that he will be praised.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to ignore correction or instruction because the style of correction

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: doesn't fit, or is not strong enough for, the situation

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè nu lalahi ka batè te egbinateen su igkarayan din dè sika.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Don't speak to a child in childish way, because it will encourage him to ignore your correction.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to encourage a person or animal to ignore the correction, or to be the thing

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: which encourages a person or animal to ignore the correction

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be outspoken and boastful about something

entries.summary: if

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka dayi iyan ka lalag ne igsalambag wey ke igpewun-a eyew te pegbalibad wey pegtambag naa tenged te pegduwa-ruwa. Layun egkakita seini diyè te kewun-aan te nabaley ne lalag.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Dayi perem ke keddì sika su egbehayan ku iya sikeykew.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: If it is mine then I will really give you some.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Dayi ke sikeykew ka mig-ulahing su egkabennalan ad iya.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will be entertained if it is you who did the singing.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenà ad egduma kaniyu su marusilem e, dayi perem ke maaldew.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will no longer come with you because it is dark already, if it is daytime it's alright.

entries.summary: for someone or something to be better

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: for someone or something to be better

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka dayirayi iyan ka bayew red me-meupiya wey ke kenè amana ne mareet/masumpit. Egkaayunan kayi ka keugpè, timpu, wey himu.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Dayirayi red gabii su warè ded amana mig-uran, piru kuntee su miggapune.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Yesterday was better than today for it didn't rain whole day but it does today.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Dayirayi e red ka me menubù ne warè nekeiskuyla su meupiya red se batasan du te me biseye ne warad iya gulehud.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Natives who have not gone to school are better than visayan people who don’t have good manners.

entries.summary: foreigner; to go to another place

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka dayu iyan igpasabut ka etew ne miggendiyè te sabeka ne inged. Kaayun ne diyè sikandin eg-ugpè te malepet dè ne timpu wey egkaayun degma ne eg-angey rè sikandin te egkakeen.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Due etew ne dayu diyè te inged ney ne meupiya se batasan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: There's someone who is foreign that has good attitude.

entries.summary: a place inhabited by evil spirits (busew). Usually this is a rock face (dalama) or a large tree especially the balitì tree

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a place inhabited by evil spirits (busew). Usually this is a rock face (dalama) or a large tree especially the balitì tree

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka dayuwan iyan ka inged ne wey ke pinamula, wey minsan nekey ne hinimu ne due mig-ugpè ne kenè ne iling kanta. Ka me buyag migkahi ne iyan kun mig-ugpè dutu ka migbelig wey migbantey te sika ne inged wey ke pinamula, wey ke hinimu.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè kew dani-rani te sika ne baliti su dayuwan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Don't draw near to that baliti tree for that is sacred.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè kew pamanihus dutu te sampew su dayuhan seeyè.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Don't bathe at the waterfall because it is/was honored.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Dayuwan ka baliti diyè te Sita su due eglalag ke marusilem.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: There's evil_spirit in Baliti tree in Sita for there's crying of women during night.

entries.summary: just; only

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kayi e rè egtaman te Panganan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I'm only going this far, to Panganan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Sikeykew rè ka palanggè ku ne anak ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: You are only my beloved child.

entries.summary: for security

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka seini ne lalag iyan sika se me tapik naan dè te me guhuren.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Iyan ded meupiya ka eg-addat ki te kultura eyew kenè ki egkalueran.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: It is better that we respect the culture so that we wont be cursed.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Sikan ded ka impammitew nu ne simat.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: There it is the needle you are searching for.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ne mig-insaan dan si Abraham[gl], “Hendei ka asawa nu ne si Sara?” Ne migtabak sikandin, “Duen ded te seled te balungbalung.”

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: And they asked Abraham,[gl] “Where is your(sg) spouse Sara?” He answered, “Just there inside the tent.”

entries.summary: also

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: 1. Te naluhey-luhey, neetew e degma si Hisu Kristu ne kabuhalan ded ni Rut.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: After a long time, Hisu Kristu was also born that was a descendant of Rut as well.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: 2. Ne iling te keupiya niyu kayi te keddiey wey diyè te me asawa niyu ne nammatey e, iling ded degma ka keupiya ne igpapitew te Magbebayè ne Manama due te kaniyu.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: And like your(pl) goodness to me and to your(pl) deceased husbands, (may it) will be like also the goodness that will_be_shown to you(pl) by the Lord God.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: 3. Ne eyew man-e egkabuhal ded ka pamilya rin wey kenè egkalingawan te me karumaan dan, wey te me etew te seini ne inged.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: And so that his family also will grow and won't be forgotten by their relatives, and by the people in this place. Now_then, you(pl) are all the witnesses of this today.”

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: 4. su eyew egpakaruma red ka ngaran ni Malun diyè te karatuan din.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: so that Malun's name will be able_to_accompany his wealth.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: 5. si Hakub[gl] (ne egngaranan ded degma ki Israil)

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: 6. Te nakaliplipereng e sikandin, in-angey e te Manama[gl] ka gusuk din wey impakimut din ded ka pali.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: When he was deeply-asleep, God took his rib and he caused the wound to close_up.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Te seeye ne timpu, warè ded nalingawi te Manama[gl] ensi Nuwi[gl] wey ka langun ne me mananap ne duma rin diyè te arka.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: God did not forget Nuwi[gl] at that time or all the animals that accompanied him in the ark.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Piru migpabulus si Lut[gl] ka egginggat kandan. Nataman, nabennalan ded iya sikandan ne miggendiyad e te baley rin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: But Lut[gl] invited them strongly, so they consented and went to his house.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ka Makpila sakup te Kanaan,[gl] wey marani seini te Mamri ne iyan ded ka Hibrun.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Makpila was under_the_jurisdiction or Kanaan,[gl] and this was near Mamri which is also the Hebron.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ne minsan eg-apul sikandan ne egdumeen nu ka malitan, egpakaawe ke red iya man-e te impasaad ku keykew.’

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: And even if they refuse to let the woman come with you(sg), you(sg) will still be free from what_ you(sg) _were_caused_to_promise by me.’

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ne migkekali e man-e ka me suluhuanen ni Isaak[gl] te lein ne belun. Piru migpaap-apuley red man-e sikandan meyitenged te belun.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Now/Then the servants of Isaak[gl] dug another well. But they were again harassed by the locals.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: God has had pity on me

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Nakasuman-suman ke red te karumaan ta ne si Buas ne naruma nu se me suluhuanen ne me malitan?

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Do you(sg) remember our(incl) relative Buas whose female servants became_ your(sg) _companion?

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egdereetan nu naan ded ka intiru ne siyudad minsan nasalinan e te lalimma ne etew ne matareng?

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: will you(sg) destroy the entire city although five righteous people are lacking?”

entries.summary: then also

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Nalaag ku ka sugkad ku wey nalaag ku red maa ka gunting ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I've lost my comb and then also I've lost my scissor.

entries.summary: to strike the ground; to hit by someone

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egdeeg iyan ka peglatabi/pegkeulug te minsan nekey diyè te tanè wey ke minsan hendei. Egkaayunan kayi ka minsan nekey ne diyè egpuun te dibabew peendiyè te diralem ne egdeehan iya. Egkaayunan degma ka kayu wey minsan nekey pad ne pinamula ne egkapeled.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egdeeg ka kayu diyè te tanè.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The tree strike on the ground.

entries.summary: to show contempt for or oppress someone; to keep on oppressing someone else

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to show contempt for or oppress someone

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan seini ka pegtayu-tayu/pegleigleig te duma rin Egkaayun seini te minsan nekey ne due geyinawa iling te me ayam, me manuk-manuk, me etew, wey duma pad.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Masalig ka me dumahat ne egdeeg-deeg te me Matigsalug su deisek ma katuenan dan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Many dumagat oppressed the Matigsalug people for they have only little knowledge.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: e.g. a mother hen who sits on her eggs but none hatch.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to keep on oppressing someone else

entries.summary: to win a competition or a game; to be able to win or be victorious; to be defeated

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to win a competition or a game

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be able to win or be victorious

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan seini ka egpanalu te minsan nekey ne apisanan wey te papitawey te katuenan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Amana egkahalè ka me Pilipinu ke egpakareeg si Mani Pakyaw te buksing su manuk-manuk dan sikandin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Filipino people will be very happy when Manny Paquiao will be victorious in boxing competition for he was their idol/man.

fields.label: Meaning context
fields.text: for a person or animal, or group or people or animals

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egkareeg iyan ka pegkatalu te minsan nekey ne kelag wey te apisanan wey te pegpapitawey te katuenan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Layun egkareeg te me matig-Israil ka me kunterè dan te kandan ne pegbubunu su duma ran ma Manama.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The Israelites always defeated their enemies in every battle because God was with them.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè nu gen-geni ka iyam pad migpigsè ne bayaku su egdeehen te kulis nu.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Don't touch the chick of bird so that it would not defeated with your fortune.

entries.summary: certain strings of salurey
to eat raw meat from a carcass

fields.label: Meaning context
fields.text: for something (especially an animal such as a dog)

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to eat raw meat from a carcass

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egderees iyan ka pegpanamantaman pegkeen te minsan nekey. Egpekeiling seini te etew ne eggutasan ne amana egpameedpeed egkeen. Himu seini te etew ne bel-is.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egderees ka me etew te babuy ne neutel dan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Indeesan e ka impanued ne babuy.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The pig that was hunted was already eaten (by the dogs).

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ware contribution ney su talagdees key re.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We had no contribution (at the party) because we were just consumers.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: Usually this term is used for animals.

entries.summary: damage; ugly; bad (unfavorable)

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Migpasabut seini ne lalag te kenè ne meupiya se peglalawa, ulaula wey ke pegkeetew naa.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mareet a mulè ku su neelin a ne bateg.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I am ugly for I am covered with scars.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan seini ka lalag ne kenè ne meupiya. Egkaayunan kayi ka minsan nekey ne kenè ne meupiya ne egtengtengan, egsumsumanen, wey eggedgeramen iling te timpu, ulaula, himu wey duma pad.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mareet ne aldew kuntee su migsalahapun.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The weather is bad because it's cloudy today.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mareet se geyinawa ku su warè e pad nakalem-ag.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I am in a bad mood because i haven't yet had my breakfast.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Migmareet-deet ka geyinawa ku gabii su kahiyen ku ne egpatey e ka kuddè ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I really depressed yesterday because I thought that my horse will died.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mareet ka eggimu te kenè ne eleg diyè te duma.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: It is immoral to do improper things to others.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Seini ne lalag migpasabut te kenè ne meupiya ne himu, suman-suman wey lalag te minsan hentew wey minsan nekey.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mareet ka uyang ku su takawen.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My brother-in-law was wicked for he was a robber.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Seini ne lalag migpasabut te sabeka ne hinimu ne egkahuhus wey egkabalbalanangan naa. Egkaayunan degma kayi ka minsan nekey ne egkapesè wey ke egkabuang naa.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Keilangan ne egliwan ad egbeli te iyam ne kendiru su mahaan e egkareetan ka kundiru ney.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I need to buy a new kettle because the old one going ruined now.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be able to destroy or run down something, or to be a thing

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan seini ka egpakahuhus wey ke egpakabalangabalang te minsan nekey ne me meupiya. Egkaayunan degma te seini ne lalag ka langun ne me suman-suman wey ke lalag naa ne kenè ne meupiya.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè kew ubal te radyu ne kenè ne kaniyu su kema ke egpakarereet kew.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Don't play with the radio which is not yours for you might damage it.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to waste something (e.g money or food)

entries.summary: cabbage
unfortunate

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan seini ka kenè ne meupiya wey ke masumpit ne egkeulaula te etew. Warè meupiya ne egkatamanan din su layun naan dè iya ne mahirap wey masumpit, iling te layun dè egpakakita te samuk, kenè egkaaminan te prublima wey amana egkeyirapan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mareet se kulis ku su layun e naan dè iya egpakasubbuk te kasamuk.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I am unfortunate for I am always in trouble.

entries.summary: bad tasting

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan seini ka kenè ne mananam se nanam te keenen. Iling te kenè amana ne meupiya ne eggedgeramen iling te malagsem, subla ne mapeit, maalas, wey malagnaw, maperes wey subla ne meemis, malamismis.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mareet se nanam te inggilutù ku ne gulay su warè asin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The desert that I had cooked was distasteful for it has no salt.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: In Matigsalug only sweet is a good taste while the rest are consider as bad taste.

entries.summary: also; too

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan sika ka lalag ne migpasabut te eg-iling te duma rin wey ke nekey ka innimu rin. Egkaayun degma ne iyan igpasabut kayi ka himu wey ke etew, suman-suman, batasan wey lalag ne nekeg-iling.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Keddì ma ka migsusubba gabii sikan naa ka keykew e degma susubba kuntee.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I was the one who cooked yesterday that is why it is likewise your turn today.

entries.summary: to throw something overhand; at something or someone

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan seini ka pegsabulak wey peg-antug te minsan nekey diyè te minsan hendei. Egkaayun ne diyè ig-antug ka minsan nekey ne inggen-genan te aw-awangan, tanè, etew, kayu wey weyig, wey minsan nekey pad. Egkaayun ne due eggisuhaten wey se warè su ka impurtante kayi ne egkalekaan ke miggen-genan ne ig-antug wey ke igsabulak naa.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egdegpaken ku sikeykew te batu su miggun-aan e ma nikeykew te egdegpak.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will stone you because you stoned me first.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Neinu-inu si Pastur Paundag te duèn e migdahing diyè te atep din kunaleg te indegpakan bes e sikandin te teì.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Pastur Paundag surprised that there is sound on his roof knowingly that he throwing a dung.

entries.summary: to wince with pain at something

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to wince with pain at something

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka igpasabut te lalag ne egdeg-uy ka pegdehengdeheng tenged te kasakit ne eggeramen te etew. Migpalinneu seini te masumpit e ka dalu wey ke eggeramen te sabeka ne etew. Egpakapanlagkuy naan dè sikandin tenged te masakit wey masumpit ne eggeramen din. Ka egdeg-uy iyan ka laheng te etew ne egdehengdeheng wey egpanlagkuy tenged te masakit ne miggeram din.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Malasi egdeg-uy te marusilem ka anaken ku su egkasakitan sikandin te ulu rin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My niece always groaned at night for he suffers headche.

entries.summary: to refuse to do something again because of the bad experience at first time; to refuse; to turn down; to not want

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to refuse to do something again because of the bad experience at first time

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka kaluwasan te sika ne lalag iyan ka kenad e eg-abey man-e eggimu ke mareet ka impangkusan te an-anayan ne innimu rin, wey kenad e sikandin egkeupiian ne egkeyitabu pad man-e ka iling due.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egkareha ad e keykew su warè ka migbayad te insambayan nu ne seleppì.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will not allow you to borrow my money again for you didn't repay me.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè ad egpasambey keykew su nareha ad e.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I never allow you to barrow something for you failed to return it.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to refuse; to turn down; to not want

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Migderehe e ka batè su in-ahawan te amey te paan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The child turn down his food because his father take away his bread.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: e.g. a child to turn down his food e.g., not contented of something given to him as their share

entries.summary: to pant

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: e.g. when feverish or during sexual intercourse

fields.label: Matigsalug example

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Why are you puffing last night?

entries.summary: to itch

fields.text: for something (such as a sore or mosquito bite)

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egdehes amana ka pahis wey ka egkahaten ki te higtek su due kahew.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Small white sores and mosquito bites itch a lot because of the presence of germs.

entries.summary: burn log which were not consumed by the fire; to be eaten by fire

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: burn log which were not consumed by the fire

fields.text: Ka deig ne egkahiyen sika se natutung ne kayu ne warè naamin te egkeen te hapuy ne kaayun pad ne igtemeg.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Due deig diyè te kamet ney meupiya seeye su malegleg.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: There is burn_log in our field it is good becuase it is strong flame

entries.summary: little (in size); to decrease or decline; to divide into small pieces

fields.label: English translation

fields.label: English translation

fields.label: Matigsalug example

fields.label: English translation

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Igdereisek ki rè te beyin su deisek ka impamehey ne behas.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We have only a little share of rice because of scarsity.

fields.text: Naalatan a ganna su natempug ka tindeisek te alukuy ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I am very terrified earlier because the last finger of my friend was cut off.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Sikeddiey ka kinadeisekan te langun ne me suled ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I am the least in all of us.(brothers)

fields.label: Meaning context
fields.text: for a person, animal or thing

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to make smaller i.e to shorten

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpariisek e pad te lawwa ku su amana ad e malambeg.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I'll make my body slim because i'm very fat.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpariiseken ku pad ka bali te beligyè din ne wey ad e egkuwa.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I'll wait that the price of his sales reduced before i order.

fields.label: English translation

fields.label: English translation

entries.summary: cheap

fields.text: Ka deisek se bali ne lalag iyan igpasabut ka belegyè ne beratu.

fields.label: Matigsalug example

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Just buy the rice which is cheap in price.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The sharpener is nice because inexpensive.

entries.summary: small; little

fields.text: Deisey naan dè ka asukal ney su malehed key nasì ne eg-inum te kepi.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We only have small amount of sugar left because we always drink coffee.

entries.summary: to accompany each other

fields.text: Napelaan ad e ka egtetahad ki Amè ka egdekat keddì su amana ne mananey.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I was tired waiting my father who will accompany me for he comes so late.

entries.summary: to pound something (e.g. baluhu used for fishing); using hard materials

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to pound something (e.g. baluhu used for fishing)

fields.label: English translation

fields.label: Matigsalug example

fields.label: English translation

entries.summary: to light a lamp or fire; from another source of fire by using something; to carry fire to the thing to be ignited

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: from another source of fire by using something

fields.label: English translation

entries.summary: a loud sound that someone makes; to yell to express bad emotion

fields.text: to yell to express bad emotion

entries.summary: rarely; far apart (in distance); far apart; infrequent

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Marelag a rè egkakita nikeykew su diyà ad e mig-ugpè te mariyù ne inged.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: You can rarely see me for I'm now living in a far away place.

fields.label: English translation

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Maddelahen te rè te egpamula ka aheley su eyew kenè egpekegselungey.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We will plant the corn infrequently in order not to stunt it.

entries.summary: wilderness; field; farm

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka seini sabeka ne parti te katalunan ne meupiya ne eg-ubpaan wey egpangametan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Due meupiya ne delag diyè te Simud.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: There's a good wilderness there in Sinuda.

entries.summary: to flee in fear

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan igpasabut te delas ka peg-awe te sabeka ne inged.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpandelas key man-e su masamuk ka kanami ne inged.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We will flee to another place in the reason that our place is always in trouble.

entries.summary: a part of a kuglung instrument.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a part of a kuglung instrument.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka seini iyan sika se baad te lawa te kuglung ne lenged e te kelengan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mabatek ka deldeg te kuglung din.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The deldeg part of his kuglung guitar is colorful.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ew meupiya ne egpitawen ka deldeg te kuglung nu ra!

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Oh the deldeg of your kuglung guitar is good to see!

entries.summary: a barbless spear; to spear someone or something

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Seini ka panganiban te me kaap-apuan ne maliddus se pupul wey putew ka pupul ne egkaayun degma ne igpanganup dan degma eyew te pegkeen dan. Malayat seini wey malibusen ka eggen-genan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Naaldek a te apù ku ne nabelù gabii su egpilaken ad e perem nikandin te deldeg din.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I was scared of my angry grandpa yesterday because he was about to spear me with his spear.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: made from a file and a wooden handle

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egdeldeg iyan ka egpilak te minsan nekey wey ke minsan hentew naa pinaahi te degdeg.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Amana ne tummawan kun ka amey ni Ayit ne egdeldeg te mahintalunan ne babuy.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Ayit’s father is a marksman when spearing a wild pig.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Nabelù dengan ka apù ku wey egdeldehen din e perem ka anggam ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My grandfather was angry long ago he was about to spear my uncle.

entries.summary: to drive away someone else

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka igpasabut te seini ne lalag iyan ka pegpaawè te minsan nekey; Egkaayun degma ne ka peg-abug te mananap puun te sabeka ne inged peendiyè te lein ne inged.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Malasi ku egdeldela ka babuy te sumbaley ney su egpanuwalen din ka me pinamula ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I frequently drive away the our neighor's pig because it roots up our plants.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Indeldel kud e diyè te ugpaan ney ka anaken ku su amana en iya ne pehulen.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I drove off my nephew from our house because he is really very lazy.

entries.summary: dark gloom

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka seini iyan sika se egkahiyen te me buyag marusilem e su warad bulan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ew, delem bes kuntee ne timpu.

entries.summary: a traditional herbal medicine; to fetch herbal medicines

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Sikanami se me Matigsalug, masalig ka me delemetan ney ne derewunen.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We, Matigsalug people, we have a lot of herbal plant.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Neulian ad te dalu ku su due dalemetan ne pig-inum ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I was healed because I took liquid medicine.

fields.text: Egpakirelemetan e pad diyè te engki Meyra su nakanengneng a ne masalig ka me delemetan dan diyè.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I'm going to fetch herbal medicines at Meyra's (place) because I know that they had a lot of herbal medicines.

fields.label: English translation

fields.label: English translation

fields.label: English translation

fields.text: Nadisgrasya a te mutur ku sika ka due pali ku.

fields.label: English translation

entries.summary: December

fields.label: English translation

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka disiplina ne lalag iyan igpasabut ka peggimu te etew ne matareng. Meupiya ne eg-ikul te balaud wey egtuman.

fields.text: The true discipline is when someone who is bad character made right.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ka disiplina kenè ne igdereet ke kenè eyew igtul-id.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Discipline is not about destroying someone but to make him/her straight.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egdisiplineen ku ka anaken ku su eyew egtulik sikandan.

fields.text: Ka seini ne inged pantaren wey kenè amana eg-uran wey warè me pinamula wey ke me hilamunen naa. Warè etew ne egpekeugpè su warè weyig wey meinit seini ne inged.

entries.summary: the day before a fiesta; prelude

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Dispiras ki rè eggendiyè te simud ka egpamista su egmanumbaley ki pad diyè te me karumaan ta.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We will be going to Sinuda to meet our relatives a day before the fiesta.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: Like Christmas which seems to start in November now in many countries, the fiesta usually begins with special meals even before the official day.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka igpasabut te egdispiras iyan ka egkeyitabu te kenè pad ka malehet ne silibrasyun.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egdispiras pad keilangan ne kayi kew e.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: You must be here before the main event happen.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Migdispiras pad human nekeuma ensi Suled Robert.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Brother Robert came after tha final+date.

entries.summary: district

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan igpasabut te distritu ka sakup te sabeka ne lungsud wey ke prubinsya naa. Intahuan te distritu ka tagse sabeka ne lungsud wey ke prubinsya eyew egkabaad ka pegdumala.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Daruwa ne distritu ka iskuylaan te Kitewtew.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: There are two districts of Kitaotao School.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Duè tatelu ne pulu ne distritu ka simbaan te Hiniral Baptis.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: There are thirteen districts of General Baptist Church.

entries.summary: to burn a person or animal; to be given to somebody

entries.summary: goes out;; to come out

fields.label: English translation

entries.summary: a spirit (associated with certain places esp trees)

fields.text: a spirit (associated with certain places esp trees)

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: Among Ceb., a ceremony of offering food cooked without salt is made to insure harvest, give thanks, safety before house construction, and diagnose illness. The ceremony is performed by a medium.

entries.summary: savage

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka makariyab-diyab iyan ka amana ne makaalat-halat wey amana ne dakel, malayat, matikang, maluag. Seini iya ka egkahiyen ne kenè ne maheteng ne ulaula iling te layun ta egkakita; panalimbeka rè seini.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Amana ne makariyab-diyab ne etew si Guliyat su amana ne bundahul wey bubuluti.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Gulayat is really terrible person because he is big and bully.

entries.summary: jacket

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka diyakit ne lalag iyan igpasabut ka igsaluub ne malayat se belad. Duè klasiyan te diyakit, duè diyakit ne makepal, wey duè manipis. Egkahamit ka diyakit ke tingmaagsil wey ting-uran. Egkahamit degma ka diyakit diyè te me inged ne maagsil.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Migsaluub si Tano te diyakit din su maagsil ka inged ne Lorega.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Tano wore his jacket because Lorega place is cold.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eggamiten ku ka diyakit ke diya a te Simud eyew egmeinit a.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I use to wear my jacket when I am in Simud so that I may feel heat.

entries.summary: a diamond

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Makehal ka diyamanti, masil-ew wey mahal. Ware batek kayi. Eggamiten seini te pegperi te makehal ne me kasangkapan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Emun ke egpakakita a te diyamanti egkaratu e buwad iya.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: When I see a diamond no doubt I wll be rich.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Hendue te diyamanti seeye su masil-ew.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Seems those are diamonds because they are bright.

fields.text: Diyesnen ne subla si Ginilyn su kene egkalit sikandin ka egsimba.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Genelyn is devout because she can't be late in attending church.

fields.label: Matigsalug example

fields.label: English translation

fields.text: Amana ne lelayati ka duhayas diyè te Matigul.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The small waterfall there at Maitgul is very high.

entries.summary: a large fish trap anchored in the river; to fish in a river; using a fish trap

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a large fish trap anchored in the river

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Nahale-galè a su masalig ka migsahad te duheng ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I was very happy because my fish trap was full of fish.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: These are made of bamboo and thorns. They are built in the dry season so as to catch fish when the rains come. They are placed in a waterfall or downward-sloping part of a river.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Iyan ta igduheng ka kawayan su meupiya.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Our fish trap will be bamboo for it is good.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egduruheng ki kaaselem su igpaserè ta te egkamet ke due egsahad.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We will fish (with duheng) tomorrow because that will be the viand for our slash-burning if we catch any fish.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Seini ka egduhengan ta ne beuhan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: This river is the place where we will put the fish trap.

entries.summary: thorn; thorny ground

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Duhi bes te sapinit ka nakatued te paa ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Oh, it was a sapinit thorn that went into my foot.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mahirap ne eggilamunan ka kamet ney su duhiyen ka me hilamunen.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: It's hard to weed our field because the weeds are thorny.

entries.summary: to disappoint somebody who already has a problem; who already has a problem to be disappointed by something

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to disappoint somebody who already has a problem

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: You disappointed me, who was worried already.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: who already has a problem to be disappointed by something

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egkaduruhù e si ayè ka egdaralu pad ne warè pad egkakeen.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Aunt is disappointed - she is still sick and still has no food.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Iyan din igkaduruhù se peggawas din puun te purisuwan impatey e ka amey wey iney rin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: He is disappointed that when he came out of prison, his parents were already dead.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: I, naruruhu ad e seini su nalimbungan a te tindira ne desek pad ka seleppì ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Oh, I feel cheated because I was deceived by the shop assistant (and I already had little money).

entries.summary: to stoop in order to walk in a low place; for a reason (because the place is low or in respect to elders)

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to stoop in order to walk in a low place

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: for a reason (because the place is low or in respect to elders)

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egduhung-duhung e rè ne eghipanew su malig-et ka igbayè ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will just stoop to walk because the way that i've passed is quite narrow.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Napalian a diyè te migduhung-duhungan ku ne sulung.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I've got wounded there at the cave when I bent over my body to walked through the narrow passage.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Iyan ku igduhung-duhung su malig-et dè ka lungag te sulung.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I stooped to walk because the passage of the cave was narrow.

entries.summary: to call a dog; for a reason

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egduhuy-ruhuy sikandin te asu rin ne nalaag.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: He is calling his lost dog to come.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Nekey a ka egduhuy-duhuyen din, ka itu wey ke ka inayan ne asu?

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: What she call to come, the puppy or the mother bitch?

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Iyan din igduhuy-ruhuy te asu rin su nalaag.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The reason that she call her dog to come because it was lost.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Duhuy-duhuya nu ka itù su egakeenen ta.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Call the puppy for we going to fed it.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: The call may be extended further by further repetition. i.e. duhuy-ruhuy-ruhuy-ruhuy

entries.summary: to thump or bash (someone); with the bottom of a closed fist; to (engage in) boxing (with somebody)

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egdukduk sikandin te batè ne kenè egetulik te panulu.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: He will thump those children who are not listening to advice.

fields.label: Matigsalug example

fields.label: English translation

fields.text: Iyan igdukduk keddì te amey ku ka gibang ne kemù din.

fields.label: English translation

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egbuyù e pad te bawì te egbuween diyè te duktur.

fields.label: English translation

fields.label: English translation

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I shouted when I was scared by a cobra.

entries.summary: to unjustifiably treat others; as guilty by association (e.g., to be angry at a whole family for the misdeeds of one); to request something from others

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: as guilty by association (e.g., to be angry at a whole family for the misdeeds of one)

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Migdulihis din pangeheti ka me batè diyè te tangkaan din minsan warè labet te ehetanan dan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: He got unjustifiably angry at the children in front of him even though they were not part of the ones they were angry at.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egdulihisen ku buwad iya te egkamet seini se langun ne me pinamula?

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Maybe I will cut down all these plants grown.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Iyan din igdulihis te me batè te eg-ehet su egkewubug nahud sikandin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The reason that he includes the children to treat it's because he was drunk.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: even if there's no chance of getting it

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egdulihis iya egbuyu ka anak ku te pisu te warè.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My son is forcing me by asking for one piso even when there's none.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egdulihisen ad iya te asawa ku te egharek ne kenè e ma iya.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My husband harrasses me to kiss but I don't.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Iyan din igdulihis keddì su neiyam e kun e.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: He forced me because I seems new looked for him.

fields.label: English translation

fields.label: English translation

entries.summary: to ignite

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka dullit ne lalag iyan igpasabut se egpasihaan te sabeka ne etew ka minsan nekey su eyew egkalegleg, egkatutung, egpakatetemeg wey ke egkasilaban naa.

entries.summary: to go along with; to be worth of descrimination

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egparulundulun iyan ka egparuma-ruma naan dè te keugpè din ne warè keupianan. Iling te egkengaayu-ayu ne egparuma-ruma naan dè iya te peg-ugpè din. Ka ikarangeb ne igpasabut kayi ne eglalag te minsan nekey diyè te duma sumalè te nakita rin diyè te kandan. Emun ke nakita rin ne due seyyup te senge etew ne nasì eggimuwi te mareet wey kenè egbulihan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Nasì dè iya parulunduluni te duma ne menubu ka keugpè dan te egpakannekal la perem ne eggimu.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Some natives just go along with their living instead of striving hard.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè nu parulunduluni te eg-apul sika su egbusawen ma sika.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Don't continue (lit. push yourself) to argue with that because he/she is crazy.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè nu parulunduluni te eglalag ka sika ne etew ne impanamantamanan te eg-ehet te amey rin su egpakatimul ka te prublima.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Don't say bad things to that person that is has been scolded by his father because you will make the problem worst (lit. you can add to the problem).
