fields.text: Go and see to the dog that's barking (i.e., at wild game)

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan seini ka peggendiyè te duma eyew te pegbulig ke nekey ka eggimuwen din. Seini warè bayad, ke kenè egpakenen dè ka etew isip bayad te pegbulig.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè e bu pad egpakarupak kaaselem keykew te egkamet su duen pad impurtanti ne eggimuwen ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I think that I just can't able you to help clearing area tomorrow because I still have something important to do.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to assist someone in their work such as egkamet clearing a field, eg-eeti and eg-erek etc.

entries.summary: to appeal a case; to another authority

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egduput iyan ka egparani diyè te duma ne etew eyew egpepangabang wey egpabulig. Egkaayun ne egpatabang meyitenged te keuyahan, prublima, wey dalu wey me kalasayan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egduput e pad diyè te karumaan ku su dakel ka prublima ku kuntee.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will appeal to my relatives because I have a big problem today.

entries.summary: a common term used for fruit trees

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a common term used for fruit trees

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka durabli iyan ka nalein-lein ne me prutas, iling te mangga, durian, tebuwe wey te langun dè iya ne me prutas. Pinamula seini wey keilangan ne egtangguwen wey layun dè egkametan eyew kenè egbenesan wey eyew egpamehas degma te masalig. Minsan degma ka me kayu ne kenè egpamehas ne igpamula egkaayunan te seini ne lalag.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egdakelen ku te egpamula te durabli ne me kayu su eyew due egkasalsalihan ku ke egkabuyag ad e.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will plant more fruit trees so that I have something to rely on if I'm getting old.

entries.summary: Check GU dictionary??; to be prompt

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egdurisuwan iyan ka due-rue ne peggimu/pegpakita te minsan nekey diyè te minsan hentew. Ka seini ne lalag migpasabut te degma te warè peglamu-lamu te minsan nekey ne egkasuman-suman ne eggimuwen te warad pegsuman-suman ke nekey ka eggingumaan te eggimuwen din.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mareet ke egdurisuwan nu te eg-inse ka etew ne nabeley pad.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: It's not good to ask somebody promptly who is tired.

entries.summary: a type of cultivated fruit tree; spiny fruit; has a unique odor

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a type of cultivated fruit tree; spiny fruit; has a unique odor

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Sabeka seini ne kalasi te prutas ne amana ne mananam ne egkeenen. Egpekeiling seini te balangas piru dakel wey mahalang se duhi wey bayew egmeebul-ebul se batek. Ka duma egkangarehan wey ka duma egkeemutan kayi. Emun ke egperiyen e seini, egkakita ne nabaad-baad se behas kayi iling te beungun wey due degma behas kayi ne egkabukusan te maangkag iling te kapuk ne behas din, ne iyan iya seeyè ka egkakeen. Sabeka seini ne prutas ne malasi egkakita diyè te Dabaw su seini ka igkeupii ran te langun ne me prutas.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Derakel e perem ka me durian ne impamula ku piru nasì ma ibelegyè te amey ku ka tanè ney.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The durian fruits that I planted are almost grow bigger but my father sold our land.

entries.summary: two

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka igpasabut te dus, daruwa. Seini ne lalag numiru ne egpakasinundul te sabeka wey ke an-anayan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Daruwa ne libu ka kentidad te kuddè ne nabeli ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The horse that I bought cost two thousand pesos.

fields.label: Grammar note
fields.text: Borrowed from Spanish via Cebuano, but in very common use, e.g., in domains such as money and telling the time.

entries.summary: to punish or to judge someone else; a curse; to curse someone else

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to punish or to judge someone else

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egparusa iyan ka peglegpad te sabeka ne etew tenged te neyimu rin ne supak te balaud wey te impalintutuuwan te sabeka ne grupu te etew wey ke inged. Egkaayun ne mabehat wey maagkap ka legpad, ne egkaayun ne me kasangkapan, me ayam wey tanè, wey minsan nekey ne diyè te kandin ka igbayad isip legpad te neyimu rin, wey egkaayun degma ne umul rin ka igbayad din te neyimu rin ke amane e ne mabehat ka salè din.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egparusa ka Manama te seeyè se kenè egpalintutuu kandin su eyew egpakapamalehet ka langun ne maresen sikandin ne Manama.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: God will punish those who do not believe in him so that everybody may know/testify/prove that he is mighty God.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egdusaan te me datù ka lukes wey malitan ne egpalibuhey pinaahi te peg-unung kandan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Tribal elders will punish man and woman committing adultery by killing them both.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Duen kun dengan indusaan ne migpalibuhey ne neumaan te asawa te malitan wey indugsuan din ka daruwa ne nekegkepkep pad.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: There was man and woman condemned to death because they committed adultery and the woman’s husband and found them stabbed them both while cuddling each other.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Duen pad man-e igdusa dengan te egpalibuhey ne egpaniyuken te simat ka lawa te daruwa taman te egpatey.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: There was another punishment long ago for man and woman committing adultery which is fiercing their bodies with a needle until they die.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egparusaan te Manama ka minsan hentew ne kenè eg-inniyug te me salè dan su sika ka ingkahi rin diyè te Kasulatan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: God will judge anybody who will not repent for that is what He said in the Scripture.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka indusa iyan ka lalag ne mareet wey ke dilus te sabeka ne etew tenged te innimu rin ne kenè ne meupiya diyè te duma. Kenè dè degma egkarusa ka etew tenged te mareet ne hinimuwan din, ke kenè, egkaayun degma ne egkarusa sikandin minsan meupiya ka innimu rin wey nasekel ka etew kandin.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Nekeyimu a te mareet diyè te dayuwan sikan naa ka due dusa ku kuntee.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I made mistake to the sacred things/place/immortal that is why I have a curse now.

entries.summary: twelve

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: Among the younger generation, Matigsalug numbers are rarely used for numbers over ten.

entries.summary: night or evening; to get dark, (because night or a storm is approaching); to go dark, e.g., a dark overcast day with heavy black clouds

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka marusilem iya ka pegginguma te timpu ne egkeepus e ka maaldew. Ka lalag ne marusilem migligkat te dusilem ne iyan igpasabut ka delem wey ke warè malayag. Ka maaldew due aldew ne egsiha piru ka marusilem iyan ka timpu ne kenad e egkakita ka aldew wey iyan e egkakita ka bulan wey me bituen naa wey duma pad ne eglayag diyè te langit. Egkaayun degma ne warè bituen wey bituen ne egkakita te timpu te marusilem.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Marusilem key e nekeuma diyè te Dabaw su maapun key e nahud migligkat puun te Simud.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: It was already evening when we arrived in Davao because we left Sinuda in the afternoon.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to get dark, (because night or a storm is approaching)

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egmarusilem iyan ka kenè ne malayag ka egkakita iling te egkasagkup e wey ke egkeebukan ka sulu talewarè te delem. Iyan man-e kaluwasan kayi ka pegkaawè te layag te minsan nekey ne nakabehey te siha wey layag ne iyan egpuunan ne migdelem e.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mesi eglineb e ka aldew su egmarusilem e.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: When the sun has already set it will get dark soon.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to go dark, e.g., a dark overcast day with heavy black clouds

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egpaddusilem iyan ka kenè pegsiha te aldew tenged te salahapun wey ke ayew te mareet ne egkeyitabu wey ke neyitabu en iya. Iyan man-e kaluwasan kayi ka pegdakupal te gapun ne due kibel wey warè nakasilè ka aldew tenged su nabunbunan te gapun.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ayew buwa seini te nabunu ne etew su mania te sahuhune ne migpandusilem te meupiya ma perem ka timpu kuntee.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Maybe this is a bad omen that a person has been killed because it's going dark despite the good weather today (Maybe the sun shone in the morning and it is going dark at noon).

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to wait for it to be dark before doing something

entries.summary: to stab someone else

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka induslak iyan ka manekal ne pegtiyuk wey ke pegsundang te minsan nekey wey minsan hentew pinaahi te minsan nekey ne kasangkapan ne nahen-genan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Induslak ku te kayu ka peka rin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I pierced his back with wood.

entries.summary: to push (someone)?

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka dusu iyan ka lalag ne pegtuu/pegtuku te minsan nekey parasek wey ke pabulus. Egkaayunan te seini ne lalag ka minsan nekey ne egkahen-genan iling te pupud ne igpansul, wey minsan nekey pad ne igpansul iya.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egkadsilan e pad perem ka egpamanihus piru indusu ad ma te duma ku diyè te weyig.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I feel cold bathing but my companion push into the river.

entries.summary: to pluck out something; such as hairs from the head or beard, or weeds from the ground; to fall out

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: such as hairs from the head or beard, or weeds from the ground

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egpandutdut iyan ka pegbarut te minsan nekey ne nakatalu wey ke migtubu naa ne keilangan ne eg-aween iling te benget, sumpe, bulbul te ilek wey ulu, wey ke uban naa. Egkaayun degma ne egdutduten/egpabaruten ka me hilamunen.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpandutdut a te me bulbul te manuk-manuk.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I pluck out the feathers of birds.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egkarutdut iyan ka pegkabarut wey pegkaawè te minsan nekey diyè te intubuan wey ke natahuan din naa iling te bulbul te minsan nekey wey ke hilamunen naa. Karumaan degma seini te lalag ne lulu iling te bulbul ne egkalulu.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè nu gen-geni ka manuk ne nasubid su egkarutdut ka me bulbul.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Don't hold the wet chicken because its feathers might fall out.

entries.summary: there (beyond reach but within sight)

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan seini ka lalag ne migtinurù meyitenged te sabeka ne inged wey ke hendei lenged. Egkaayunan degma te seini ne lalag ka natahuan te sabeka ne himu wey ke hinimu iling te baley, iskuylaan, eglengeren ne kayu, weyig, wey minsan nekey pad.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Hentew buwa ka egmanlelalag dutu te ampew?

entries.summary: that over there

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka seini ne lalag iyan karumaan te lalag ne dutu ne migtinuru te sabeka ne inged wey ke eglengeren naa ne inged. (Pitawa niyu ka lalag ne dutu)

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Dutun buwa te dibabew ka masalig se abaka ne le-ew.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Maybe there is lot of wild abaca over there.

entries.summary: to rise rapidly, as from a cascade of water from a heavy rainfall further upstream

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to rise rapidly, as from a cascade of water from a heavy rainfall further upstream

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egduu iyan ka lalag meyitenged te pegbagiyu te weyig ne amana ne dakel tenged te dakel ne uran wey ke due subung ne naluwangan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè kid e eglapas su migduu e ka weyig.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We will not cross the river because it rose already.

entries.summary: two (counting); two (adjective); second or next

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: This is the common counting form (saa, duwa, telu, ...), and is often used with young children.

fields.label: Grammar note
fields.text: sometimes used as the counting form, although duwa is more common

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Seini iyan sika se egkagamit te pegseel te me butang ne keilangan ta ne egkatuenan ke pila a ne buuk.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Daruwa ne simana ka peggimeley ne imbehey kanami te iskuylaan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We are given two weeks' semestral break by the school.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka seini ne lalag iyan ka igkarangeb ne numiru puun te an-anayan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ka igkaruwa ne selida kangkuwa su busew.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The next showing later will be a horror movie.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Igkararuwe e rè te in-alam te talagpanulu ney su warè ku nakumplitu ka me himu ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I am only second placer among the top students because my projects are incomplete.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: in groups of two or two each

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka tigdaruwa iyan ka lalag meyitenged te senge sukub[/nekey ka seenge sukub?] wey ke senge parisan naa, wey egkaayunan degma ka sabeka ne grupu/punduk ne migmasugsuwayey ne tigsenge sukub sikandan. Egkaayunan degma te seini ne lalag ka egpababaarey te minsan nekey ne tigsenge parisan naa wey ke tigsenge sukub naa sikandan ka eg-angken te sabeka ne timman wey ke punduk naa.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ka igkeupiì tigdaruwa kew rè te anak.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: What I want is that each of you must have only two children.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I divided and give two in each group

fields.label: Grammar note
fields.text: This affix indicates an excess of what is required

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ikaruwa key pad egligkat ki Aliks su warè pad seleppì ney ne igpliti te unturanan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We will leave on the day after tomorrow because we don't have money yet for our fare.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ikaruwa bu pad ka kasal ni Riki su warè mem pad migginguma ka eg-asaween din.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Ricky's wedding will be the day after tomorrow perhaps because the bridesmaid has not yet arrived.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka seini ne lalag iyan ka aldew ne migsinundulan te gabii ne aldew. Iyan man-e seini ka igkatelu ne aldew ne miglihad ligkat kuntee.

fields.label: Grammar note
fields.text: not nararuwa:n. This appears not to be a predictable morphophonemic change

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Seeyè pad te nararuan migginguma si Bibi ka migleuy keddì puun te Balinsiya.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Bibi arrived here two days ago to visit me.

fields.label: Grammar note
fields.text: this is not relative to today

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: two nights (and intervening days) in the future

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will be there for only two nights

fields.label: Grammar note
fields.text: used only with reference to travelling or staying in a place

fields.label: Grammar note
fields.text: not kararuwa:n. This appears not to be a predictable morphophonemic change

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: two nights (and intervening days) in the past

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I was there for only two nights

fields.label: Grammar note
fields.text: used only with reference to travelling or staying in a place

fields.label: Grammar note
fields.text: not nararuwa:n. This appears not to be a predictable morphophonemic change

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kararuween ka lawa rin kunterè te keddì.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: His body will be twice as big compared my body.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egkararuween ku ka karakel te bayad nu.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will double the amount of your payment.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to multiply a number or quantity

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan seini ka kenè[keneg kasabeka se geynawa] egkaamin se suman-suman wey geyinawa meyitenged te eggimuwen din iling te eggipanew, eglipereng, egkeen wey minsan nekey pad ne eggimuwen. Egkeyitabu ka iling due tenged te eggeramen din ne kenè egpekeiling te maheteng ne peggeramgeram[suman-suman] din iling te egkasasew sikandin, tigkew rè due ne migmasakit ka geyinawa rin, wey ke due ne ingkapanseb tenged te me palinneu ne narineg wey ke naheram din naa iling te egkutel ne limuken.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egkaruwa-ruwa a ne egduma kaniyu su migmasakit ka geyinawa ku ganna.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I'm not sure to come with you because I was troubled earlier.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be unsure of doing something

entries.summary: to dispose of something (e.g. to sell a horse); to give a gift to make amends for a misdeed; to sell or dispose of something

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to dispose of something (e.g. to sell a horse)

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egduwaren iyan ka himu ne egbehey/belegyè/dasag diyè te duma te minsan nekey ne diyè te kandin.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egduwaren kud e ka kuddè ku su warè igpaliling ku te anuhang ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will dispose my horse for I don't have departing gift for my father-in-law.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to give a gift to make amends for a misdeed

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan seini ka lalag ne peglaag/behey/dasag te minsan nekey ne diyè te kandin diyè te duma ne etew.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egduruwad si Dyuni te kuddè diyè te anuhang din.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Johnny will give a gift to his father-in-law.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to sell or dispose of something

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan seini ka lalag ne migpataha meyitenged te minsan nekey ne igbehey wey igdasag naa diyè te duma.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egkaruwad ku buwa iya ka sapul ne kalabew ku su warè man en iya igkabehey ku te hari ku ne egtetamuk keddiey.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I might dispose my one and only carabao for I do not have something that I can give to my brother seeking help from me.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Migpasabut seini ne lalag meyitenged te me etew ne migpabegbehayey te minsan nekey ne diyè te kandan. Te kultura te Matigsalug, egpatamtamukey sikandan eyew te pegsulbad te minsan nekey ne prublima ne egkaayun ne egduwaran dè. Piru emun ke due egpabulig ne etew meyitenged te prublima rin diyè te sabeka ne etew, sika ka egpuunan ne egpakatetamuk ka etew ke egbulihan din ka etew ne due prublima.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egparuduwarey ki pad ubag suled su eyew egkasulbad e ka prublima ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We will exchange (something worthy or expensive) so that my problem will be solved.

entries.summary: two-faced

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Panunggilingan ka seini ne lalag ne iyan kaluwasan ka kenè egkasalihan ne etew wey warè malehet ne hukum wey ke lalag naa. Ke kanakan pa iya, ke daruwa ka ulaula rin, migpasabut sika te subla te sabeka ka tratu rin, wey kenè egkasalihan te tratu rin.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenà a egkeupian ne eg-alukuy te daruwa ka ulaula su kenè sikandin egkasalihan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I don't like to befriend with two-faced person because he is not trustworthy.

entries.summary: to take another wife; the secondary wife or wives; the wives of a single husband

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egduruwey iyan ka peg-asawa man-e. Minsan masulug e ka asawa te sabeka ne etew, egkaayun ded ne eg-asawa pad man-e sikandin te mengebay naa wey ke manggiasawè e ne ingkeupii rin. Egkaayun ne egkaasawa rin ka malitan pinaahi te peg-ahew kayi te lein ne lukes wey ke minsan nekey pad ne paahi ne egkaasawa rin ka malitan batè ma wey ke buyag e, mangiasawa naan e wey ke balu e.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My uncle will take another wife.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: the wives of a single husband

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka talaruwey iyan ka daruwa ne malitan ne sabeka rè se iglukes/asawa. Inggamit ka sika ne lalag eyew ig-umew te daruwa ne igmalitan ne warè kalabetan ke tapey naa ka sabeka wey ke duwey naa ka dangeb, su iyan impasabut te sika ne lalag ka keugpè te daruwa ne malitan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Layun dè egpekeg-ehet ka talaruwey su kenè sikandan egpekeg-uyun.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The wives (of a single husband) always quarrel because they don't agree with each other.

entries.summary: hammock

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka duyanan iyan ka uwaan ne innimu ligkat te kayu wey ke balahen naa, plastik wey ke putew naa ne indaydayanan te kutsun wey me hinabel. Ka duyanan egkaayun ne eggamiten te buyag wey batè piru ka uwaan batè dè ka egpakahamit. Igbitin seini diyè te kayu pinaahi te hiket din, wey egkaayun degma ne igbanggut seini diyè te sungkaleg wey ke diyè naa te me ges-ew emun ke diyè te seled te baley igbitin.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egkateu ne eggimu te duyanan ka amey ku su matulik nahud sikandin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My father knows how to make hammocks because he's a fast learner.

entries.summary: to curse another person

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egduyè iyan ka pegdilus wey ke peglalag te amana ne mareet wey ke masakit ne lalag ne egdumaan te mabehat ne legpad wey ke dusa diyè te sabeka ne etew. Migpalintutuu ka duma ne duen kun geem te lalag ne iglalag te etew.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè ka egduyè te kunterè nu, ke kenè, keilangan ne eggeyinawaan nu sikandin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Do not curse your enemy but rather you must love him.

entries.summary: to be in tune

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: It's not in tune because it's too low.

entries.summary: to make a discrimination for his own (e.g.) abiding his old style and let the personality being discriminable; to let someone to be discriminated against

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to make a discrimination for his own (e.g.) abiding his old style and let the personality being discriminable

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka seini ne lalag iyan sika se egpabilin ka te ulaula te menubu ne egsawayen te duma wey iling te egbalaharen nud e ka warè nud e sumsumana ka duma ke nekey ka igkalalag dan kuna.

fields.label: Matigsalug example

fields.text: to plant rice (paley) or sometimes corn (aheley) in a field

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: by making a hole with a (dibble) stick

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eg-erek a te paley diyè te kamet ni Amè diyè te Buha.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will plant rice to the father's failed in Buha.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eg-erekan ney te dinuradu ka kamet ney seeyè te liwaraan te bubungan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We will plant dinuradu rice to my kaingin field at the middle of the mountain.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Nekey ka paley ne ig-erek niyu seeyè te kamet niyu?

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: What kind of rice seeds that you are going to plant on your field.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: this type of planting requires the use of a long stick, as apposed to the short one used to egtuwil. Although it takes longer, and divides labor between the one who digs the hole and the one who drops the seed, it is still preferred by some because the long stick makes a sound each time it is used to pierce the ground. Perhaps this has superstitious or religious significance.

entries.summary: person; a human being (in contrast to non-human animals); what kind of people is talking about; to become a person; to be born

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: person; a human being (in contrast to non-human animals)

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: In the MS worldview, there is no word for living things. The things in the world include me etew humans, me mananap animals (not including humans), me kayu trees, and me hilamunen grasses.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka etew iyan ka minsan hentew ne due geyinawa, neuyag wey ke napatey, kumplitu se baad se lawa wey se kenè naa, wey kayi mig-ugpè te kalibutan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: What relation is this person to you?

fields.text: What kind of people are you?

fields.text: Engkeri niyu ka salè niyu su pekeetew kew eg-abey.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Leave aside your sins to become born again.

fields.text: Kenè niyu amana iparibabew ka pegkeetew niyu su kenè ne meupiya sika.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Don't put your reputatin in high because that is nat good.

fields.text: Amane e ne mareet ka keet-etawan kayi te inged te seini ne timpu.

fields.label: English translation

Ne minsan nekey degma ka egpuunan te egkeetawan ka nalepu, egkaayun ne tenged te imbusbusan te weyig, neetawan dè due te kandin, wey ke due delemetan ne inggamit.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kahiyen ku ne kenad e egkeetawen ka malitan ne nalepu su neepuk te migtakereg te bubungan ne Lantawan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I thought that the woman wouldn't back to consciousness painted upon climbing mount Lantawan.

entries.summary: to become dried up (e.g., in a lake or in a pot of boiling rice); easily dried up (e.g., of a body of water, or of a rice variety that uses a lot of water when cooked); to fish by removing water

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egkeetiyan iyan ka egkaaminan te weyig wey warad e egkasamè su egmammare e. Egkaayun te seini ne lalag ka sinuba wey ka me weyig, beuhan, lanew wey minsan nekey pad ne due weyig.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to become dried up (e.g., in a lake or in a pot of boiling rice)

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Pitawa niyu ka sinuba su kema ke egkeetiyan e.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Take a look at the cooking rice for it might be dried up.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mesi eggulabung su egkeetiyan iya ka weyig ne Man-ulasen.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: When drought comes, the Man-ulasen river will really dry up.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: easily dried up (e.g., of a body of water, or of a rice variety that uses a lot of water when cooked)

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: from a small dam with a basin

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Meupiya ka eg-eeti te timpu te gulabung su deisek ka weyig.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: It is better to go fishing (by removing water from a dam) during drought time because rivers are low.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eg-etiyen ney kaaselem ka beuhan su masalig kun ka me peit.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We will go fishing tomorrow by taking out the water from a creek for its many fish peit.

fields.label: Grammar note
fields.text: The reduplicated form has the same meaning as the basic form.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: This is a fishing practice. A part of the river is sectioned off, and water is removed with a basin. As the water level in the section drops, the fish and crabs become visible and can be caught easily.

fields.label: English meaning

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I almost died of hunger while walking earlier today, but I am thankful because there was food there at the house on my arrival.

entries.summary: glossy swiftlet

fields.text: Ka etil ngaran te bayaku wey deisek ubag ka sika ne bayaku. Sumale te guhuren te me buyag batè kun seini ne neengkeran te due imbatun, migsahukul[nekey ka migsahukul?] seini ke nekey kun e ka egbaba te hari rin. Nataman migbaluy e sikandin ne etil ne miglayang e.

fields.text: Ka etuten iyan ka etew wey ke ayam naa ne layun dè egpalihawang te mangareg ne kalamag diyè te lebut din. Masulug ka puunan mania te egpalihawang dè due sikandin te mangareg ne kalamag. Kema ke nakakeen sikandin te meyilew ne keenen, wey ke imbuturan naa sikandin, wey nakaarek sikandin te mangareg wey napenù e te kalamag ka getek din, wey kema ke inlebusan sikandin. entries.summary: breath; life; to breathe; to be able to breathe

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: Everything that lives has geyinawa. This includes trees, plants and, surprisingly, water. The geyinawa is passed from the mother to her offspring. Likewise, the ground is the source of geyinawa in crops and other plantlife. When a person or plant dies, his/its geyinawa no longer exists. The same is true of water that boils off.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Nangenen ku ne warè pad migpatey ka itù, piru te pegsamsam ku kandin, warad bes e geyinawa.

fields.text: I was already a teenager when I was circumcised because I was afraid when I was a child.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: A small ilab knife is used. A flattened piece of bamboo is placed under the foreskin and then there is only one quick straight cut with the knife. No skin is actually removed. The ceremony is done in hiding with several boys around 12-15 yrs old being circumcised at one time by one of the elders. It is said that if one is not circumcised, he becomes weak and yellow and is unable to father children.

fields.label: Grammar note
fields.text: Because gunting is now commonly used to refer to scissors, the Cebuano term for circumcision (tulì) is often used instead of this. If gunting is used, the body part (lasu) may need to be specified to make the meaning clear.

fields.text: Ka igpasabut te seini ne lalag iyan sika se pegpanampey te minsan nekey diyè te sampayanan iling te: kumbalè, lanut. Egkaayun degma ne ka pegpandampil te minsan nekey.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpanggabel a te me kumbalè ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I have been weaving my clothes.

entries.summary: fence

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka habeng iyan ka alad ne kenè amana ne malig-en wey matikang iling te ig-alad te babuy wey te baley. Seini ne klasi te para rè te me baled wey ig-atang te kenè amana ne derakel ne me mananap.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Keilangan ne due habeng te baled su eyew kenè egpakaalihu ka ambew.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: There should be fence of a trap so that mouse cannot by-pass.

entries.summary: a circular tube of material (used by women to carry children); to wrap a blanket; to wrap a blanket around a child

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a circular tube of material (used by women to carry children)

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to wrap a blanket around a child

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: so as to lift him up or carry him in it

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka igpasabut te seini ne lalag iyan sika se pegbaba te batè ne due manggad ne igbaba. Batè ne egbukusan te minsan nekey ne hinabel eyew egkabedberan wey egkalamberan wey egkaayun degma ne minsan nekey ne egkaayunan te seini ne lalag.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè ka egdalusung su eggabet e pad te batè.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Beheyi e pa te manggad su iggabet ku te batè.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Iggabet ku pad ka tuwalya ku kayi te batè su maagsil amana.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will wrap the child with my towel for it is so cold.

entries.summary: an uninhabited place

fields.text: Ka hagpè ka igkeupii te uled te eg-ubpè su mabbenes ma.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Uninhabited places are the places where snakes want to live because they are overgrown with weeds.

entries.summary: something placed under something else that protects what is underneath. For example, a thick blanket used to cover a horse's back so that heavy loads don't scrape off the skin; or a coaster placed under a cup.; to cover something; with something (especially a cloth or blanket)

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: something placed under something else that protects what is underneath. For example, a thick blanket used to cover a horse's back so that heavy loads don't scrape off the skin; or a coaster placed under a cup.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: with something (especially a cloth or blanket)

fields.label: English meaning

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka hagpi iyan sika se igbelat diyè te minsan hendei ne keilangan ne eggagpiyan. Ka igpaampew te minsan nekey wey egkaayun degma ne bunbun.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eggehagpi a te egtahuan ku te aheley.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I wll cover my maize storage bin.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eggagpiyan ku te saku ka egpabulukuan ku te miyew.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Beheyi e kun te pepil su iggagpi ku te egpinnuuwan ku ne nasubid.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Give me a piece of paper so that I could cover my wet chair.

entries.summary: cold or cool; coldness; to feel cold

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Egselem-selem ki egpamanihus diyè te weyig. Te kenè ki pad egseneb daan e ne egpangenew ka bulbul te lawa ta su maagsil ka weyig te maselem.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Maagsil ne aldew kuntee su bayew egpangpangalamag.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: This day is cold for it is quite windy.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Maagsil ka Simud su keilangan ne egdiyakit.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Simud is cold because must wear jackit.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka hagsil iyan ka kenè ne meinit. Egkaheram seini diyè te kalamag, weyig ne warè neiniti, ayis wey ke migkehal ne weyig, wey minsan nekey ne bayew nasubid wey warè narampil te aldew.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Amana ka hagsil te eg-inumen ne intahuan te ayis (impakehal ne weyig) ne iling te egkengapupu e ka ngipen ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The coldness of the drink in which ice (hardened water) has been put is very great, and it felt like my teeth fell out.

fields.label: Grammar note
fields.text: The hagsil form is more common close to the highway, while the agsil form is preferred in certain, more remote areas. This distinction between /h/ and the glottal is made for many words.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to cause someone to feel cold, or to be the thing

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: which causes someone to feel cold

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to air by putting it somewhere

entries.summary: stairway; ladder; to build a stairway

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Neulug si Tiri te haheran su kenè ma sikandin egpitew te egdiekan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Tiri fell from the ladder because he didn't watch the step.

entries.summary: to be selfish about something; selfish

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Amana iya eggakam-hakam si Eniyew te serè ne kenè din man ded iya man-e egkaamin.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eggakhakamen ku ka pan ne imbeli te amey ku wey kenà a egpamehey.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka igpasabut te seini ne lalag iyan sika se leheren, ka kenè egpanalad te minsan nekey ne diyè te kandin.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Maakam-hakamen ne etew si Welu te minsan nekey ne kandin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Welu is a selfish person, he will not share other what he had.

entries.summary: to be shaken by movements

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egkahakgak iyan ka egkataltal wey egkaantag te minsan nekey ne egkaweil.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mahaan e rè gutasi su nahakgak te terak ka ingkeen ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I starve right away because what I had eaten was shook by the truck.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Diyè nu te ulu te terak ipeuntud ka terak su egkahakgak ke diyè te lebut.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Let the pregnant ride at the front seat because it will be shaken if at the back.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenad egkahi ka radyu ne imbeli te iney ku su nahakgak te peg-untud terak.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The radio bought by my mother was broken (lit. won't speak) because it was shaken in the truck.

entries.summary: the belt (for a knife sheath)

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ay-ayari nu te eggakus ka dulan nu su eyew kenè egkeulug.

entries.summary: sacrifice

entries.summary: to guzzle something down

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: (He) is like a dog because he is greedy.

entries.summary: majestic; noble; reverent

entries.summary: to use just a little water in the bottom of a pot; light going out (down to a flicker)

fields.text: to use just a little water in the bottom of a pot

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egmangalap-halap iyan ka deisek naan dè iya ka samè ne warad/egkaamin e iling te weyig diyè te sakeru, ka layag te sulu ne mahaan e egkeebukan, ka mata te buyag ne kenad amana egkita wey ke egkabigtawan wey nalepu naa.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpanakeru e pad su eggalap-halap naan dè ka weyig ney diyè te gelun.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will fetch water for only moist was left in the water container..

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: light going out (down to a flicker)

entries.summary: to use up something quickly; to be quickly used up

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè kew eggalas-halas te seleppì niyu su igtagana ta ke warad egkeenen ta.

fields.label: Matigsalug example

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: If you cook a lot of vegetables, the salt will be quickly used up.

entries.summary: spaced apart

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenà a egpakalipereng te marusilem su mahalat ka alabat ney wey maagsil amana.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I can't sleep at night because our wall(boards) are spaced apart and it's very cold.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mahalat ka atep ney ne kalan, sikan naa eg-uranan key.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Our cogon grass roof is widely spaced, that's why we get rained on.

entries.summary: to scare someone; with words or something else; to be afraid of something

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Miggaldek din ka anak din ne egsinehew.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: She scared her child who's crying.

fields.label: Cebuano translation
fields.text: Tinakot niya ang anak niyang umiyak.

fields.label: Tagalog translation
fields.text: Gihadlok niya ang iyang anak nga naghilak.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eggaldeken ku pad ka anak ku ne egsinehew.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will scare my son who is always crying.

fields.label: Cebuano translation
fields.text: Tatakuten ko ang anak ko na umiiyak.

fields.label: Tagalog translation
fields.text: Hadlukon nako ang akong anak nga naghilak.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Busew ka iggaldek ku te anak ku eyew egsanggel ka egsinehew.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will scare my son with witch to be stopped crying.

fields.label: Cebuano translation
fields.text: Tatakuten ko ang anak ko ng asawang upang tumigil siya sa pag-iyak.

fields.label: Tagalog translation
fields.text: Hadlukon nako ang akong anak sa asawang aron mag-undang sa paghilak.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egkaaldek a te meitem ne miyew.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I am afraid of a black cat.

fields.label: Cebuano translation
fields.text: Ako ay matatakot ng itim ne pusa.

fields.label: Tagalog translation
fields.text: Mahadlok ko sa itom nga iring.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Igkaaldek ku ka meitem ne miyew su egkabaluy kun ne busew.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I am afraid of a black cat because it will be entered by an evil spirit.

fields.label: Cebuano translation
fields.text: Ako ay matatakot sa pusang maitim kayi sinipian nga di magandang ispireto.

fields.label: Tagalog translation
fields.text: Mahadlok ko sa itom nga iring kay sudlan ug dili maayo nga ispiritu.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be scary to someone else

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpakaaldek te busew ka tul-an ne ulu te ubal.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Evil spirit can be afraid a skull of a monkey.

fields.label: Tagalog translation
fields.text: Matakot ang aswang sa buto ng unggoy.

fields.label: Cebuano translation
fields.text: Mahadlok ang abal sa bukog sa unggoy.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Igpakaaldek te busew ka tul-an te ulu te ubal ke igtahù seini diyè te gemawan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Evil spirit can be afraid a skull of a monkey if you put it of the door.

fields.label: Tagalog translation
fields.text: Matakot ang aswang sa bungo ng unggoy kong ito ay nasa pintoan.

fields.label: Cebuano translation
fields.text: Mahadlok ang abal sa bukog sa ulo sa unggoy kong ibutang kini sa pultahan.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to ask somebody to scare someone else

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpaaldek kun pad sikandin te anak din.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: She asked me to scare her child.

fields.label: Cebuano translation
fields.text: Gipahadlok niya nako ang iyang anak.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Sikandin ka egpaaldeken ku te anak ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: She will be the one that I request to scare my child.

fields.label: Tagalog translation
fields.text: Siya ang inuutusan kong takuten ang anak ko.

fields.label: Cebuano translation
fields.text: Siya ang akong gisugo aron hadlokon ang akong anak.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Igpaaldek ku pad pad ka anak ku su kenè egkapanulù.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I request anybody to scare my child because she/he will not take my advice.

fields.label: Tagalog translation
fields.text: Ipatakot ko muna ang anak ko kasi hindi siya maturuan.

fields.label: Cebuano translation
fields.text: Ipahadlok sa nako ang akong anak kay dili magpatudlo.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kaaldekan dengan ne etew si Ulmu su eggimatey ke egpakaayad-ayad.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Ulmu was fearsome person before for he murder if he will.

fields.label: Tagalog translation
fields.text: Katakotan na tao noon si Ulmu kasi pumapatay ng tao.

fields.label: Cebuano translation
fields.text: Kahadlokan nga tawo si Ulmu sa una kay mopatay gayod siya ug tawo.

entries.summary: to play or joke with someone; somewhere; for some occassion, program or reason

fields.label: English meaning

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: A long time ago there was a guy from Cotabato who came here to Sinuda to Datu Gusasa the leader of the community to request repayment of a debt. But then an unexpected tragedy happened -- there was strong rain accompanied with wind. The place was covered with water and all the people turned into eels. Only two remained -- the guy holding a lady who was the lovely daughter of Datu Gusasa. The guy decided that the lady would be the payment of Gusasa's debt. But suddently a voice came from somewhere and said, "Leave the woman if you want to be saved and not included inthe wrath." But the guy shouted, "No! I can't. I love this woman!" and then the water rushed towards to them and and the guy used his shield to block the water and it become a mountain.

Ka igpasabut te seini ne lalag ka peg-ulahing, peg-uuranda, peg-eggung te minsan nekey ne ulahingen. Egkaayun ne egbalesan ka peg-ulahing te minsan nekey ne me egdahing iling te kuglung, salurey, kubing, pulendag wey duma pad wey egkaayun degma ne kenè.

entries.summary: papaya

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka kapayas iyan ka pinamula ne egbebehas te egpekeiling te sayuti piru eggihitè te iling te gatas ka behas. Egkaayun ne egkeenen minsan meyilew wey neyinug, wey bayew malayat ka lawa kayi ne egpekeiling te kayu piru warè pused su due lungag te lawa rin. Egkahelgeleran ka dewun din wey mallayat se pakew ne duen ded degma lungag. Meilem ka behas din ke meyilew pad wey egmakalawag ke egkeyinuhan e wey igkeupii ne egkeenen te me manuk-manuk wey me mananap.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Patey ad perem te gutas ka miggendiyè te Panganan piru meupiya su due kapayas diyè te dalan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I'm almost dying of hunger going to Panganan but fortunately there is papaya along the way.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: A large native yam which grows wild. The tubers contain a poisonous alkaloid, dioscorine, which must be washed out before they can be eaten. The tubers are sliced and placed in running water for several days. It is locally an important famine food and is preferred to other tuberous plants. The stalk is called (WBM) tuveg. An old, shrivelled inedible tuber is called (WBM) ku-es.

entries.summary: co-father

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: A Spanish eclessiastical legacy, now used to extend the family alliance. A co-father is one other than one's spouse who has one of the following relations to oneself: he is either the father, godfather, or father-in-law of children to whom one also is a parent or godparent. The term is also used as a term of address to a person with whom one has this relation or to a close family of one's age group.
