fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eglayap e ka me impanampey ku ne me pinipian.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My hanging washed clothes are being carried away by the wind.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be mixed with something that is carried by the wind (e.g cut hair, dust)

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: by putting a large basket of grain on the head and slowly pouring it onto a mat, allowing the wind to carry away some of the empty rice hulls

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: This is a preliminary type of winnowing done during the drying process to help the rice dry completely.

entries.summary: to do something very often

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mania te eglayas-layas egpamanihus si Elisa te mahal ka siyampu?

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Why does Elisa always bathe when shampoo is (so) expensive?

entries.summary: to be long or tall (of a person, a tree, a nose, a piece of string, etc.); standard measurement (of how long); superior

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be long or tall (of a person, a tree, a nose, a piece of string, etc.)

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Malised ka malibutut ke ne talagbubula su egkalugsek ki rè te me matangkawal.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: It is hard to be a short player for we will be only rejected by the tall ones.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: proud; overbearing???; to cause to become long?

entries.summary: a long time

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Malayat e ne timpu ka miglihad su egkabuyag ad e.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: It's been long time had passed away because I'm old enough.

entries.summary: a variety of thornless bamboo that doesn't grow to a very big diameter

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a variety of thornless bamboo that doesn't grow to a very big diameter

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè kew kekahis te laye su mangingilu.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Don't scrape a bamboo for my teeth is sensitive.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: Used for making woven bamboo walling (selehiya)

entries.summary: always

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka seini ne lalag iyan sika se eg-abey-abey, tabid dè, eglibed-libed wey malasi.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Layun dè eg-uran kayi te kanami.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Here in our place it's always raining.

entries.summary: to swell; a swelling or tumor; to wants intercourse

fields.label: Meaning context
fields.text: for something, especially a part of the body

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka igpasabut te eglebag iyan ka egmalibusen diyè te lawa te etew, wey me ayam. Masulug ka egpuunan mania te eglebag ka lawa te etew wey me ayam. Sabeka kayi ne egpuunan sika se ingkahat te manunungkul, hidtek, wey ke miglebag dè duè. Masakit ne subla ka eglebag su duè nanè diyè te diralem, egkataman egbetu e. Duè duma ne eglebag ne egpakapatey te etew, iling te eglebag ne susu, atelug, wey eglebag se atey.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè nu ieled te weyig ka palì nu su eglebag.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Don't soak your wound in water because it will swell.

fields.label: Tagalog translation
fields.text: Wag mong ilagay sa tubig ang sugat mo dahil ito ay lumalaki.

fields.label: Tagalog translation
fields.text: Ayaw ihumol sa tubig ang imong samad kay maghubag.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Iyan impatayan te iney ni Alisya ka miglebag sè susu.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The cause of Alisya's mother death is swelling of the breast.

fields.label: Tagalog translation
fields.text: Ang ikinamatay ng mama ni Alisya ay ang pamamaga ng susu niya.

fields.label: Cebuano translation
fields.text: Ang gikamatyan sa mama ni Alisya ang paghubag sa iyang susu.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka igpasabut te egpalebag sika se asu ne egkeupian ne egpaahad. Kaayun ded degma ne eggamiten seini diyè te etew. Ka egpalebag ne asu, kenè egpekegteil su igkeupii rin iya ne duè egpakaahad kandin. Sikan naa eglewuk-lewuk sikandin eyew egpapitew-pitew te lukes ne asu.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eg-anak e ka asu ku su egpalebag e.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My dog is going to have puppy because it want to have sex.

fields.label: Tagalog translation
fields.text: Magka-puppy na ang aso ko dahil gusto na niyang magpatalik.

fields.label: Cebuano translation
fields.text: Manganak na ang akong iro kay gusto nang magpaiyot.

entries.summary: a (small type of) basket; a small basket, the bottom of which is tightly woven rattan and the top is bamboo

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: The Tagalog pángnan is used by fishermen and by fruit or flower vendors.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a small basket, the bottom of which is tightly woven rattan and the top is bamboo

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Himuwi a ine te leban su eglebanen ku te egpangali.

entries.summary: to go naked

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Migpaayad-ayad miglelebas ka alukuy ku ne egpamanihus.

entries.summary: a pool of greenish colored water

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a pool of greenish colored water

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka due lebubuk ne weyig iyan seeyè se weyig ne nasubung wey ke natalibubu ne weyig. Ka lebubuk iyan ka egpakamareet te weyig ne egkataman egkalebeg e ka weyig ne egmangareg e.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mareet ka weyig ne due lebubuk su mangareg.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Water that has greenish particles has not good odor.

entries.summary: to muddy or stir up water; to become murky or cloudy (by being stirred up); a name of a cloudy creek in traditional Matigsalug belief

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to muddy or stir up water

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Me batè ne egmanikep ka eglelebeg te beuhan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The children catching fish are the ones who stirred up the creek.

fields.label: Meaning context
fields.text: for a river or other water

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to become murky or cloudy (by being stirred up)

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Nalebeg e seini, kenè egpakaabbas se mata ta.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: This has become murky, we cannot see through it.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a name of a cloudy creek in traditional Matigsalug belief

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: This creek is the one passed by the soul before it reaches the Meibulan place (the place for souls)

entries.summary: a name of a place
grave; cemetery; to inter or bury

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Migbenesan e ka lebeng te apù ku ne malitan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My grandmother's grave is grassy already.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka lelebengan iyan sika se inged te me minatey, ka eglebengan te me etew ne namatey te minsan nekey ne dalu, ugpaan te busew, makahaldek-haldek ne inged wey ke igkahaldek te me etew.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egkahaldek a ne egbayè diyè te lelebenganan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I afraid to go past in cementery.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a placenta or dead person or animal

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The (people) passed who burried the dead.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to sink into something, e.g., being stuck in mud

entries.summary: depression in land; to form a ravine (e.g., through the action of water on the land); valley

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to form a ravine (e.g., through the action of water on the land)

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mateles ne egkameten ka migleb-eng su kenè ne mahirap ka egpamula, eggilamun, wey eggaani.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: It is good to make a cleared field (kaingin) in a valley because planting, weeding, and harvesting are not difficult

entries.summary: to submerse something

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka lebleb ne lalag nekeg-iling te lenep ne lalag. Iyan dè lein su kenè egkaayun ne eggamiten seini ke warè sabeka ne etew ne egpalenep te minsan nekey wey ke hentew naa.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè nu ilebleb sika se hari nu su ke ma ke egpatey.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Do not submerse your youngest because he might die.

entries.summary: easy to break (e.g. a rope); flabby as in flabby muscles; the people living in this world

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan kaluwasan te malebud ka mewumelwumel ne minsan nekey iling te kayu, lubid wey duma pad ne mahaan egkatepù, egkahepù wey egkasagpì.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Alinguweg tree is easy to break.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: the people living in this world

entries.summary: summit

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan kaluwasan te seini ne lalag ke migketul ne tanè wey ke pulu naa te bubungan. Egkaayun ne migketul ka tanè tenged su impaketul te me etew wey ke tapey naan e iya ne migketul.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mani buwa te kenè diyè egmambebaley ka me menubu te lebuntud su diyè iya te kalandihan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I don't know why the natives won't built their houses at the summit, but in slope.

entries.summary: to have diarrhea

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka eglebusan iyan ka peg-iindes tenged te nakeen ne kenè meupiya diyè te lawa. Iyan egpuunan ne eg-iindes ka sabeka etew tenged te nakakeen sikandin te meyilew wey nareetan e ne egkakeen.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mania te layun kew eggehaling te aheley ne eglebus.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Why are you always grinding corn that caused diarrhea.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Hilhilutua niyu ka giniling su eglebusan ki.

entries.summary: base of a tree; the stem end of a fruit; the buttocks of a person or animal

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka lebut iyan ka igtubu te minsan nekey ne egtubu wey egtulin. Egkaayun degma ne iyan igpasabut kayi ka igtubu/pupul te behas te me prutas wey ke ka balitang naa te ayam wey ke etew.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eggimeley ki pad sika te lebut te kayu.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We will rest at the base of that tree for a while.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: the stem end of a fruit

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: the buttocks of a person or animal

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Amana ne bubuyahen ka piyus ni Aye iling te lebut te patuk.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Aunt's buttocks are very big as of duck.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a polite term for the genitals of someone of the opposite sex

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: an obligation of male sides to be given at female sides especially at grandmother and granfather either it is money, things, or animal.

entries.summary: for a cluster of luwey cane to be dense when clearing a field with a bolo; a idiomatic phrase referring to hard work

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: for a cluster of luwey cane to be dense when clearing a field with a bolo; a idiomatic phrase referring to hard work

entries.summary: frayed cloth or woven mat; to become frayed

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka leddak iyan ka igngaran te minsan nekey ne egkareetan e wey mahaan e egkamewù iling te hinabel, kumbalè, ikam, wey duma pad ne kasangkapan ne egkamewù.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Iyan ku red iglibed igsaluub ka salual ku ne leddak su warè pad nahangu ka iyam ne salual ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The reason why I'll wear my old frayed pants again is because my new pants aren't dry yet.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egkaleddak iyan ka egkareetan e wey egkamewù e su amane e ne naluhey wey ke buyag e. Piru iyan dè egkaayunan kayi ka me hinabel, kumbalè, salual wey duma pad ne me kasangkapan ne kenè ne putew wey plastik.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egkaleddak e ka kumbalè ne iglibed-libed ku igsaluub su warad iya duma ne igsaluub ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My clothes which I wear over and over again are getting frayed because I don’t have any others to wear.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè niyud isaluub ka sepatus ku rue su egkaleddak e ne warè mem pa igbeli ku te iyam.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Don't wear my shoes because they're falling apart and I don’t have anything to buy new ones.

entries.summary: to move out of the way, e.g., into a corner; to put something; into a corner

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to move out of the way, e.g., into a corner

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egledled iyan pegdapig diyè te sungguk wey ke pegpeilis naa eyew kenè egkariekan wey egkasikeung naa. Iyan man-e lein ne kaluwasan kayi ka pegtahù te minsan nekey diyè te ilis wey ke sungguk.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ledled ka suled su egkaridiekan ka te me batè.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Move to the corner brother because you'll get trampled on by the children.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka ledled iyan ka ilis/sungguk te baley wey ke sinabeng naa. Egkaayun degma ne iyan igpasabut ka ilis diyè te innelesan wey ke natahuan naa te minsan nekey.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Diyè ku rè igpabuluku te ledled ka asu kema ke egkaagsilan diyè te selib.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will let the dog lie at the edge of our house because it might be cold under the house.

entries.summary: a small shelter; to build a small shelter, e.g., for a shelter for pigs

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka leeb iyan ka deisek ne baley ne innimu eyew egtagtaheeran te eg-ugpè. Egkaayun ne diyè seini igpes-ek te minsan hendei iling te kamet, te bariyu, te eglenaan wey minsan hendei pad. Innimu seini ligkat te kayu, damuluwan, luwey, minsan nekey pad ne eg-atepan te kalan, dewun te abaka wey minsan nekey pad ne egkaayunan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Due leeb te migpangeg-ut diyè te bangalug.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to build a small shelter, e.g., for a shelter for pigs

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egleleeb ka me bakuwitir eyew due egtaheeran te eg-ugpè.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The evacuated will build a small house to have a temporary shelter.

entries.summary: to cook something; by roasting it inside a tube of bamboo

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: by roasting it inside a tube of bamboo

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egleleeb iyan ka peglablab te damuluwan wey ke bagtek naa ne intahuan te egkakeen wey ngalap eyew eggilutuen. Kenè dè amana egtutungen ka damuluwan su eyew kenè egkatutungan ka inlablab.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egleeben ka peit ne neutel ku te migpanikep.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: Thin-walled maahul bamboo damuluwan is cut into one section baney. It is then filled with the food and the top is blocked with leaves. It is placed into the blazing fire but turned so that it does not burn through in any one place. When almost burnt through, it is removed from the fire with tongs and the contents are ready to eat. Dragonflies are usually cooked this way.

entries.summary: to take off clothes

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpaleen ku pad ka kumbalè ku su meinit.

entries.summary: a wild animal or plant, e.g., leew ne sinkamas; to return to the wild; leew abaka

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a wild animal or plant, e.g., leew ne sinkamas

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka leew iyan ka me ayam ne diyè te kabenesan. Egkaayun ne tapey iya ne leew ka ayam wey ke miglunus dè iya miggipanew ligkat te kamuney kandin wey ke ugpaan din iling te miyew, me manuk-manuk ne narakep ne migmaamuk e.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Migdawi te leew ne miyew ka piyak ne in-itit ku.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egleew e man-e ka ayam ney ne ekang ne nalekaan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Our owl pet was return again to the wild.

entries.summary: incompact

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Mewumel, kenè ne makehal, amana nabitey.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Legbit e ka butù te kuddè.

entries.summary: any vegetable used for flavoring a major dish including onions: sibuyas, lemon grass: tanglad, tomatoes: kalamantis, garlic: ahes ginger, luya, and tehiyà

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: any vegetable used for flavoring a major dish including onions: sibuyas, lemon grass: tanglad, tomatoes: kalamantis, garlic: ahes ginger, luya, and tehiyà

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka leggù iyan ka minsan nekey ne igsewug diyè te gulay eyew egmananam iling te: sibuyas, luya, lehiya, kalamantis, tanglad, bumbay, ahus wey masalig pad ka duma.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Amuti nu te leggù ka gulay nu su eyew egmananam.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Mix the cooked vegetable with flavoring to make it delicious.

entries.summary: to arch the part of the body esp. back; to bend something (e.g.,bolo or bow)

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to arch the part of the body esp. back

entries.summary: to make the fire flame; to smoulder or to blaze; to cause fire to smoulder, or to be a thing

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egkalegleg iyan ka hapuy ne egkanlabkanlab wey ke egkeuyag naan e ne hapuy.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mahaan egkalegleg ka pepil ke egsilaban su manipis wey nahangu nahud.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The paper flames quickly when burned because it's thin and dry.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to cause fire to smoulder, or to be a thing

entries.summary: to punish; to be punished; punishment

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka eglegparan iyan ka pegparusa te sabeka ne due neyimu ne mareet/sayep. Egkaayun ne egparusaan sikandin te maagkap dè wey ke mabehat naa sumalè te neyimu rin.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè ku sikeykew egpakeenen su eglegparan ku sikeykew te neyimu nu ne mareet.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I won't let you eat for I will punish you for the evil thing you has done.(Free. I won't let you eat as a punishment for the evil thing you has done.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Legparan iya ka meiyal ne egpapallahuy te mutur.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The guy going fast on his motorcycle will get his +(just) reward indeed.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kamatayen ka iglegpad te etew ne makasesalè.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Death is the punishment of a sinner person.

entries.summary: to close a door

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka eglegpengan iyan sika se egsengsengan, egsagpengan. Egkaayun ne minsan nekey ka eglegpengan iling te lungag, gumawan, wey butbut. Ka tuyu te eglegpengan su eyew kenè egpakalebas ka minsan nekey ne diyè te ligwang wey ke diyè naa te seled.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eglegpengan ku ka gumawan su makeseg ka kalamag.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will close the door for the wind is heavy.

entries.summary: the downward direction; to get off (a vehicle)

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka eglegsad iyan ka pegpamaneug ligkat te minsan nekey ne unturanan wey te me ayam degma ne egkeunturan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eglegsad ki te bus diyè te Puntian ke eggendiyè ki te Santul.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We will get off in Puntian when we go to Santol.

entries.summary: to happen simultaneously

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka kaluwasan te seini ne lalag iyan ka pegdengan peggimu te minsan nekey ne himu.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kahiyen ku ne egpekeglegsè ne eglesut ka egpegsepingey.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I was thinking that the twin will be given birth simultaneously.

entries.summary: to sever something (such as a piece of string or cane or rope)

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to sever something (such as a piece of string or cane or rope)

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka eglegtas iyan ka pegtamped te minsan nekey ne nakabanggut wey ke nakabalabag naa. Iyan man-e seini ka pegtempug te minsan nekey ne kenè amana ne dakel iling te gawed.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eglegtas e pad te abaka su eggiket ku te manuk.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I'll chop off a piece of hemp fibre because I'll use it to tie up the chicken.

entries.summary: to walk stomach out and bent back; to become bent back

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to walk stomach out and bent back

entries.summary: spicy

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka legu iyan ka minsan nekey ne igsewug diyè te gulay eyew egmananam iling te: sibuyas, luya, lehiya, kalamantis, tanglad, bumbay, ahus wey masalig pad ka duma.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Amana ne meemut ka legu ne in-amut nu te gulay.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The spicy that you mix in the vegetable is very fragrant.

entries.summary: a year

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan kaluwasan te seini ne lalag ka tuig wey ke sapulù wey daruwa ne bulan ka eglihad, wey ka tatelu ne gatus hen-em ne pulu wey lalimma (365) ne aldew.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Tagse leg-un ne egsahekeen key te pegkeetawi ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Every year we celebrate my birthday.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: The oldest Matigsalug term for measuring years appears to be kamet, lit. clearing a field which was done once annually. Only some of the older people use kamet. Many people use leg-un, although many nearer the highway use the Cebuano tuig or the variant tuid.

entries.summary: chives; basil

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka lehadda iyan ka pinamula ne kenè amana ne malayat wey malapung. Meilem seini wey due bulak ne meilem ded piru maangkag e ke egmanlesut e. Bayew meemut ka ngareg din wey egkaayun ne igbawi te buwe. Mallilintek ubag ka dewun din wey bayew malapung.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Amuti nu te lehadda ka innilutù nu ne serè su eyew egmeemut wey eyew egmananam.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Mix with chives your viand so that it will be smelling nice and be delicious.

entries.summary: to have the husks removed; grit as might be found in milled rice; to be sore because something is stuck in it

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egkalehas iyan ka pegkaawè te luwit/ukaba te paley ne imbinayu. Piru minsan nekey ne egbinayuwen egkaayunan te seini ne lalag iling te aheley, binggala ne imbeug wey masalig pad ka duma.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egkalehas e ka paley ne imbinayu ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The rice which I pounded were almost remove its husks.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: grit as might be found in milled rice

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: This is the term used for left pounded rice after separating the husks by the used of winnowing tray nihu. It's still mixed with unhusked rice and need to pound again in order to be ready to cooked.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be sore because something is stuck in it

entries.summary: to distribute something or spread it around

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to distribute something or spread it around

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egleheb iyan ka peg-atul-atul pegbehey te minsan nekey diyè te duma ne me etew. Kenè ne iyan dè egkaayun ig-atul-atul igbehey ka me kasangkapan wey ka egkahen-genan wey egkakita, egkaayun degma ka guhuren ne eg-atul-atul diyè te minsan nekey.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egleheben ku te kumbalè ka me hari su eyew warè egkaal-alangan diyè te kandan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will give clothe each my younger brothers and sisters so that all should be given.

entries.summary: stingy; selfish; to be a big eater; to feel like eating, e.g., after being sick

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka leheren iyan ka kenè egpamehey ke nekey ka kandin ne igkeupii te duma rin minsan egbuyù wey se kenè. Sabeka seini ne batasan te etew ne kenè ne matumpis diyè te duma su iyan dè iya egsumsumanen ka kandin ne keupianan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè egpasambey si Punges te minsan nekey ne kandin su amana sikandin ne leheren.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Punges doesn't let his things to be borrowed by others because he is very selfish.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka malehed iyan ka amana ne egkeen piru kenè dè iya man-e ne balbalen. Kabaluan dè seini te egkahaalamlam su meupiya rè iya se peggeram-geram te pegkeen.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè ne malehed ne egkeen ka apù ku, sikan naa ka miggasè amana sikandin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My grandma lost her appetite, that's why she is very thin.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to feel like eating, e.g., after being sick

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egkeutul e ka hari ku ne migderalu sikan naa ka egmalehed e sikandin ne egkeen.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My brother feel now like eating from being sick that's why he have now an appetite.

entries.summary: difficult; to find something difficult; problem

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan kaluwasan te seini ne lalag ka masumpit wey ke meyirap ne egkeulaula wey ke egkatamanan. Egkaayunan degma ne iyan meyirap ka eggimuwen wey ka timpu.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Malehen ke warè egkatuenan ta su egkalupihan ki te duma.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: It's difficult if we don't have a knowlegde for we will be decieved by others.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egkalehenan iyan ka egkeyirapan te timpu, te eggimuwen wey te egkeulaula.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egkalehenan a ne egdaru su warè a nalayam.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: It's difficult for me to plow because I am not used to it.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Igkaleheni ku ka eg-uubat su warè e rè due nekeuubat bunsud pad dengan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I have difficulty on lying because I never lied even before.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: This is deep Matigsalug and rarely used.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to cause extended labor in childbirth for its mother

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eglehenan naa mulè si Lita su amana dakel ka gettek din.

entries.summary: to hug someone else; to be continuously embracing someone or something else; to wrestle with someone

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be continuously embracing someone or something else

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egleheng iyan ka pegkepkep te duma ne etew te minsan nekey ne tuyù.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mania te egleheng ka te hari nu?

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Why are you wrestled your (younger) brother?

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Malasi egpaleglehengey ka me anak ku ne lukes.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My sons always wrestling with each other.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eglehengen e ka aye ku te uyab din.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The boyfriend of my auntie is going to rape her.

entries.summary: the sound of wind, water, rain or breathing; to produce a loud sound; noisy (of wind, water, rain or breathing)

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: the sound of wind, water, rain or breathing

fields.label: Meaning context
fields.text: for the wind, water, rain or someone breathing

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The water will produce a loud sound if there is a flood

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: noisy (of wind, water, rain or breathing)

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka malehes iyan ka mahulub ne dahing te minsan nekey iling te weyig, kalamag, geyinawa wey duma pad.

entries.summary: true (to fact, logic or known truth); real; to become true or real; truly; really

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: true (to fact, logic or known truth); real

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka malehet iyan ka lalag ne kenè ne ubat. Egkaayun ne seini ne egkakita wey se kenè, dakel wey ke deisek, egkahen-genan wey se kenè.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Malehet ne iglangeti kud iya ka etew ne hambuhen.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I really hated the boastful man.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan sika ka lalag ne karumaan te eleg wey ke maheteng. Egkaayun sika te himu wey te lalag wey te suman-suman.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Malehet bu red ka intabak nu?

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egmemalehet iyan ka pegpehetpehet egpangguhud te guhuren ne warè nanengnengi wey ke eggubabeen wey ke guhuren ne warè amana naay-ayari te egpammineg. Egkaayun degma ne kenè egpehetpehet eg-insè ke eleg naa ka narineg din ne warè amana namulmulii.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Keilangan ne egmemalehet ka ke egpangguhud su eyew egpalintutuuwen ka iya te duma.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: You need to prove if you are going to tell history so that somebody will believe.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Keilangan ne egmemalehet ki ne Manama si Hisus.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We should prove that Jesus is Lord.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Legleheti nu te egkahi si Mimi te kenà a egpakaruma kandin te eggendiyè te Panganan su kema ke egpaketetahad sikandin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Make sure to tell Mimie that I can't go with her to Panganan, for her to didn't wait for me anymore.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be sure to do something

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eglehet-lehet ki ne egpamula te aheley kuntee ne bulan su egpakasalemak kun te mahal.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We will make sure that we can plant a corn because it will be harvested with a high price.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Keilangan ne egdawaten ta ka kamalehetan ne me makasesalè ki.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We should accept the truth that we are sinners.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Nekey-a ka nakita nu ki Milin ne egmamalehet ne sikandin iya ka migtakew te kumbalè ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: What have you observe to Melin that bears an evidence that she really stole my clothes.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Sikeddì ka egpamalehet ne kenè iya ne si Pipu ka migtuleng te miyew te kepitan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I am going to testify that Pipo isn't the one who striked the captain's cat.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Malehet bes iya ne dakel se geyinawa ni Uked ki Lidilin su kenad e sikandin egkeibeg ne egkeen ka egsuman-suman kandin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: It's really true that Uked loves Ladylyn because he loses his appetite just thinking about her.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egkalelehet a ne egkebeng te batè.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I am forcefully to pinch of a child.

entries.summary: eager; to eager or to be encouraged to do something; to cause someone to be eager, or to be the thing

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka seini ne lalag iyan sika se egkarayan ne egkalangetan, wey egkabulù amana ka sabeka ne etew puun dutu egpanamtamanan din e te egpanumbag ka kalaban din wey ke immenu rin.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to eager or to be encouraged to do something

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Nalelehet a ka insumbag su intampelè e ma ni kandin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I was eager to punch him cause he teased me.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to cause someone to be eager, or to be the thing

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: which causes someone to be eager

entries.summary: the husband of a woman who is the first cousin of a male

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: the husband of a woman who is the first cousin of a male

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka lehuy iyan ka duma ne lalag te uyang. Eggamiten seini te taleuyang te minsan hendei ne tapid. Piru iyan dè egkaayunan ne eggamitan te seini ne lalag ka me lukes wey kenè egkaayun ka me malitan su ipag ka eggamiten ke lukes wey malitan ka egpegngaraney, wey andey ke neelin ne malitan.

fields.text: Amana ne maaliali si lehuy su minsan marusilem pad ne egpatinugpu e ka eggendiyè te kamet.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My cousin-in-law is very industrious because he woke up early at dawn and went to the farm.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be mocked or insulted by someone else

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Iskuwilya kew kuntee me anak su eyew kenè kew egkaleig-leig te duma keuremè.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Go to school today children so that others cannot take advantage of you in the future.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Neyid-u a te buyag ne egle-leihen te me anak din.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I feel sorry for the old man who is mocked by his children.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to mock or insult someone else

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egleig-leig en iya ka me Biseye diyè te siyudad te me Matigsalug.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Visayans in the cities really mock the Matigsalug.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè niyu leig-leiha sikandin su due egkatuenan due.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Don't discriminate against him because he has common sense.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egle-leihen ad en iya te anak ku su buyag ad e.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My son took advantage(insult) to me for I'm now aged.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egkaleig-leig naan dè iya ne etew si Mukù su amana ne mapariralemen.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Muku is really taken advantage by others because he is so humble.

entries.summary: to be undercooked (usually on the fire)

fields.text: to be undercooked (usually on the fire)

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: by lifting off whatever was covering it

entries.summary: to eat breakfast

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan seini ka pegkeen te maselem, ka an-anayan ne pegkeen. Panunggilingan katatelu egkeen ka etew te sabeka ne aldew ne iyan seini ka an-anayan ne eggimuwen te etew su maselem seini eggimuwa, ne ka ikarangeb iyan paniudtu, ka ikatelu iyan ka peglabung.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eglem-ag e pad perem piru egkeengkeran e man-e te me duma ku sikan naa ka warà ad e migkeen.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I plan to have breakfast but I'm running out of time (my companions are now leaving) that's why I haven't.

entries.summary: to be silent; to rest; to stay at home; quiet; solemn; still; formal

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to rest; to stay at home

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mateles ne eglemanan ka baley ran su maluag.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: It's good to rest on their house because it's wide.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan seini ka pegbabatasan te sabeka ne etew ne kenè ne malalag-lalag, kenè ne lewuk, kenè ne liheen, ka peg-uugpè diyè te baley. Kenè ne samukan ne etew wey ke malinawun.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Iyan ku igkeupii ka malitan ne maleman su sabeka sika ne batasan te beyi ne egkasalihan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I want still girl for it is one of the behavior of the woman who can be trusted.

entries.summary: to be completely covered or completely finished; to completely cover or finish something; e.g., clearing a field

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be completely covered or completely finished

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mahaan kud e egkalembas te eg-atep ka baley ku.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to completely cover or finish something

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eglembasen ney pad ki Papang ka ingkametan ney su eyew warad e egliberan ney.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We will clear the area completely which we are clearing so that there's no more to be worked.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Emun ke egpekeglembas e ka ingkametan henduen te pad egkakita ke mamenu kaluag ka ingkametan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: If the area will be completely cover then we can find out how wide is the area.

entries.summary: to fall apart

fields.label: Meaning context
fields.text: for something (e.g., a woven mat, a grass-roofed house)

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka pegkamareet te sabeka ne ikam wey ke ka pegkahisi naa kayi. Kenè dè ne ikam dè ka egkaayun ne egkahisi wey egkalembis naa ke kenè egkaayun degma ka kumable, atep te baley iling te kalan, dewun te abaka wey duma pad ne me atep ne dewun dè.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egkalembis e ka ikam ney su malasi nahud egkaihian te anaken ku ne malitan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Our mat is to be fall apart because it is always be urinated by my nephew.

entries.summary: to stop bleeding; to stop throbbing; to wait the pain to stop

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka eglemè iyan ka egsanggel ne palì ka eglangesa.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpekeyipanew ad e su miglemè e ka langesa te palì ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I can walk now because my wound stop bleeding.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka eglemè iyan sika se egsanggel ka egmasakit iling te egmasakit ka ngipen ta.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpekeyipanew ad e su miglemè e ka masakit ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I can walk now because the pain stop throbbing.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to wait the pain to stop

entries.summary: to jeer at someone else (to their face); sarcastic; ridiculous

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to jeer at someone else (to their face)

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: This is not as emotively bad as eg-iran-iran.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka eglemet iyan ka egdew-ey wey eglalag te mareet diyè te tangkaan te etew ne eglemetan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Suman-suman te me buyag ne Matigsalug eglemetan dan ke layun egtengtengan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The Matigslug elder think that they were mocked by someone when he stared at them.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Insalè ni Tilit ka biseyè ne miglemet te me menubu diyè te Tulay.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Tilit offended the visayan man who mocked natives in Tulay.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè bes iya egkaayun ne eglemetan ka me menubu su egsalè.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: It is not possible to mock natives because (they) will take offense.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Tampele iya se naneem-neem ni Alma.

entries.summary: to become weak with fear

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: Matigsalug believe that when a baby exposed outside during nighttime, the baby will become weak and sick because the baby seen and touched by the evil spirits.

entries.summary: to become bent

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egkalemid e perem ka paa ku ne nakaalik te batang.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My feet will almost bent for it lever out of the log.

entries.summary: lamp
easy; simple; to make something easily; easiness

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Malemu rè ne eggastuwen ka seleppì piru mahirap ne egpamitawen.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: It's easy to waste money but hard to find.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ka kalemuwan te seini himu su kenè ne mabehat.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The easiness of this work is not heavy.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpanhinlemu rè ne egpangayu si Bibuy te kayu ne inlimud ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Bibuy is to be lazy for just getting my collected fire wood instead of collecting for his own.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: e.g. by taking something close belonging to someone else instead of going the full distance to get another

entries.summary: green-winged ground dove

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: Slate-blue head and neck with white stripe above eye, 10 in. long, eats fruits and grain, fast adept flier (Common Emerald-Dove)

entries.summary: to dwell with someone else; on a temporary, yet extended, basis; to sleep together

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: on a temporary, yet extended, basis

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan ka sabeka ne pamilya ne due mig-amut mig-ugpè ne lein ne pamilya. Seini sabeka ne batasan te me Matigsalug wey seini egkeyitabu ke due sabeka ne pamilya ne iyam pad migginguma puun te lein ne inged ne warè pad egke-ugpaan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eglemung a eg-ugpè diyè te baley te anggam ku.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eglemung key pad kayi te kaniyu anggam su warè mam pad baley ney.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We'rè going to stay here with you uncle for we have no house yet.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Palemlemungey ki rè ka eg-ugpè su eyew egmekegbulig ki te me himu ta.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We will dwell together so that we can helped each other.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Impalemlemungey e sikandan ne eggibat te sabeka ne sinabeng.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: They sleep together in one room.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpalemungey e man-e ka talaasawa ne iyam nekeg-engked.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The newly divorced couple again dwell together.

entries.summary: side of the mountain; slope

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka lendig ne lalag iyan igpasabut ka masandig ne igtubù te bubungan wey ke te masandig naa. Ka seini ne lalag ngaran e kuntee te inged ne mig-ugpaan te me etew. Ka apù ku ne lukes diyè mig-ugpè te Lendig.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Masalig ne me baley diyè te Lendig.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: There's a lot of houses on that place.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka seini ne lalag iyan sika se mabenes ne diyè te me masandig.

entries.summary: the eaves of a house

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka lending iyan ka minsan nekey ne igtagtaheed ig-alabat te leeb wey baley naa. Egkaayun ne me dewun te me pinamula wey ke me hinabel naa wey ke me saku wey me linas we. Ka igtagtaheed ig-alabat egkaayun ne: dewun te me pinamula, linas/islab te me kayu, me hinabel, me saku, me pepil wey masalig pad ka duma.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Liyas ku naan dè iya te peggirehe ney diyè te kamet su iyan dè lending te bakalag ney ka dewun te bagyang.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I was very frightened when we stayed overnight at the field because the eaves of our guard house is only a leaves of bagyang plant.

entries.summary: to get off a nest or egg; to get off or out of a vehicle; to land somewhere

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to get off a nest or egg

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eglenè e ka manuk te in-elenan din su miggutasan e sikandin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The hen will get off its eggs now for she is hungry.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to get off or out of a vehicle

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka eglenè iyan ke egpamaneug ligkat te ampew peendiyè te tanè, wey eglegsad naa ligkat te mig-unturan ne minsan nekey iling te terak, kuddè, kalabew wey duma pad.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Pitawa niyu, eglenè e ka eriplanu!

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Look(pl), the airplane is landing now!

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to cause their (eaten) food, breathing or stressful emotions

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to settle down (or to experience their emotions settling down) by doing something

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egpalenè-lenè iyan ka egpabunsud te geyinawa wey suman-suman wey egdawaten ka minsan nekey ne egkeyitabu puun te eg-im-imanen ne egkatahaan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpalene-leneen ku pad ka ingkeen ku human a eggipanew su kema ke egmasakitan a te getek ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will rest after eating before I leave because I might have stomachache. (Lit. I will let the food go down before I leave because I might have stomach ache.)

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpalenè-leneen kud ka geyinawa ku su kenè iya ne sikeddì ka egpanalu.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will calm down (lit. lower my expectation) because it is really not me who will win.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Nekal-nekal ka wey palenè-lenè ka su duen ded egtanud kanta.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Be strong and relax because there is Someone who watches over us.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Palenè-lenaa niyu ka geyinawa su warè ded iya mareet ne egkeyitabu kanta te eglawang.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Calm down because nothing bad will happen to us while rafting.

entries.summary: to be absorbed by something, e.g., a sponge or a pillow; to cause an evil spirit (busew) to enter someone else

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be absorbed by something, e.g., a sponge or a pillow

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egleneb iyan ka egserep ne weyig diyè te tanè wey diyad e egbayè te diralem te tanè. Egkaayun degma ne egleneb ka langun ne kalasi te weyig ne diyè te kayu, behas te me kayu wey pinamula, me teneb te patiyuken, ka egkeinum, ka me gite wey masalig pad ka duma.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Due beuhan ne egleneb wey due degma kenè egleneb.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Some water will soak to the ground and others do not.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to cause an evil spirit (busew) to enter someone else

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Usig ne egpaleneb ka apù ku te me busew diyè te me apù din.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My grandfather loved to cause evil spirits enter to his grandchildren.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Isip te apù ni Tutu ne egpaleneban din si Tutu su eyew due egbantey diyè te kandin ne panisingan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Toto's grandmother thought that it is better for Toto to possess evil spirit for his security.

entries.summary: to drown (or sink if inanimate); to drown something; into the water

fields.label: Meaning context
fields.text: for someone or something such as an animal or a ship

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egkalened iyan ka egkaanlas te weyig wey ke dahat naa. Egkaayun ne egkaanlas ka minsan nekey tenged te me ayatanan iling te mabeheng ka weyig, migduu ka weyig, mahuye ka etew tenged te newubug, kenè egkateu ne eglumbuk ka etew, wey masalig pad ka duma.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egkalened ad e su kenà a egketeu ne eglumbuk.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I'll drown because I don't know how to swim.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to come suddenly and then leave again suddenly

entries.summary: goosebumps; to have the hairs on their arms stand on end

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka lenem iyan ka egmanlepew diyè te laplap ne dereisek iling te pamenus piru kenè ne masakit. Egpanlepew seini emun ke maagsil wey wey ke egkaliyasan ka etew. Egkaayun degma ne egpanlepawan kayi ka me ayam. Egkaayun degma ne egduma te lenem ka bulbul te tengel ne egmanasindeg ke egkaliyasan ka etew.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpanlepawan ad te lenem su eglihad kid e te lebenganan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I've got goosebumps for we almost reach the cemetery.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to have the hairs on their arms stand on end

entries.summary: to dive into the water; to submerse themselves in the water; to be pulled in towards the centre of the body

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka eglenep iyan ka egseneb te weyig, lanew, dahat wey ke linsebuk naa. Iyan man-e igpasabut kayi ka eggeles iling te beuu.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eglenep-lenep ka me batè ne egpamanihus diyè te weyig.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The children keep diving into the river.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to submerse themselves in the water

fields.label: Meaning context
fields.text: for part of the body (e.g. one's tongue, penis, or testicles)

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be pulled in towards the centre of the body

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: This may happen as the result of a curse.??

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to test the innocence of two men by holding their heads under water - the first one to surface is the guilty one

entries.summary: to be afraid of something dangerous (such as falling out of a tree), often the stomach will tighten in fear; that someone feel fear ( esp. height )

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be afraid of something dangerous (such as falling out of a tree), often the stomach will tighten in fear

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egkalenew iyan ka egkaaldek tenged te matikang ne neugpaan iling te migpamaneyik te kayu wey mig-untud te kuddè wey duma pad, wey egbayè te due lunew wey egpantew te amana deralemi ne lungag wey bitu, wey masalig pad ka duma.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egkalenew a ne eg-untud te kalabew su kema ke egkeulug a.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I'm scared to ride a carabao for I might be fallen.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: that someone feel fear ( esp. height )

entries.summary: to dissolve or melt something; in something (e.g., pot or frying pan); using something

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: in something (e.g., pot or frying pan)

fields.label: Meaning context
fields.text: for something (e.g. sugar, salt, ice, plastic)

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egkaleney iyan ka egkabalbalawan se ulaula puun te makehal peendiyè te mewumel-wumel iling te apiyew, sukal, asin, lana ne migkehal/newulep wey masalig pad ka duma.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egleney ka sukal emun ke egkaweyihan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The sugar dissolves if water is put on it.

entries.summary: sesame

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka lenga iyan ka dereisek ne benì ne egpekeiling te pantad wey bayew makalawag se batek. Igsawed seini ke igpamula wey egpekeiling te lawa te paley emun ke egtubu. Nasabeka rè iya ka igngaran te lawa wey te behas din su lenga rè iya piru iyan dè egkakeen ka behas kayi. Egbinayuwen pad wey egkataman egsubbeen e wey egkeenen e. Amana ne mananam ka lenga ke egsukalan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Amana ne mapampamula ka iney ku lenga su egkeempet dè iya ka kamet ney te lenga ne insawed din.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My mother is very fond of planting a sesame seed because our farm is mostly full of sesame plants she had spread.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: the seed is used for food. The oil of the seed is extracted and used for a cosmetics and for cooking. The leaves are used for cleansing the hair

entries.summary: to look up or to raise one's eyes; to be in a high level or a top; heavenly

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to look up or to raise one's eyes

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egleng-ag iyan ka eglengak eyew egpitew diyè te ampew wey ke diyè naa iya te langit.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè ka leng-ag ke eggipanew ka su egpakarugsu ka.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Don't raise your eyes when you are walking for you will slip over.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be in a high level or a top

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egleng-ahen iyan ka diyè te langit.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ka egleng-ahen ne Manama ka eleg ne egsimbeen su maresen sikandin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The heavenly God is worthy to be praised for He is powerful.

entries.summary: to raise one's head; to become raise up

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka eglengak iyan ka egleng-ag diyè te ampew wey ke diyè naa te aw-awangan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eglengak iya ka manuk ke egpekeimpus ne eg-inum te weyig.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The chicken will raise its head after drinking.

entries.summary: direction; to place alongside; to be a guarantee of a debt

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka lenged migpasabut te neugpaan/natahuan te minsan nekey. Migpanengneng seini te nasasindehan te sabeka ne baley, inged, me limlimuan, me tuus/palinneu, wey te langun ne egkakita kayi te ampew te tanè.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to place alongside; to be a guarantee of a debt

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Igpalenged ku rè ka seini ne kuddè te nasambayan ku keykew ne babuy.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I'll guarantee my horse for the pig that I borrowed from you.

entries.summary: to pause for a few minutes; to wait for the rain to pause before doing something; the name of a creek

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to pause for a few minutes

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to wait for the rain to pause before doing something

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: slow in decision making but really good (of a person)

entries.summary: a small fly which is attracted to the eyes

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a small fly which is attracted to the eyes

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka lengew-lengew iyan ka dereisek ne me mananap ne eglayang ne usig eggulun te kalabew. Egliblibulung sikandan wey diyè egmangugpè te makames wey kenè amana egkaaldawan. Usig sikandan ne eggulun te mata te me ayam ded wey te mata te etew.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Miggulunan a te lengew-lengew ka migpanasi dutu te mabbenes su migpaddusilem nahud.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I was attracted by small flies when I splited hemps in the jungle because the sun go dark.

entries.summary: to shake the head; from side to side

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka eglengey-lengey iyan ka egkeleng-keleng te ulu. Migpalinneu seini te pegkene-kenè wey ke warè nabenalan. Egkaayun degma ne egkeleng-keleng/eglengey-lengey ka etew ka egpallubey te bulbul wey ke duma naa iya te kalasiyan te sayew.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eglengey-lengey sikandin ke egkenè su warè sikandin natelesi minsan egmenuwen.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: He shakes his head as he refused for he don't like it in any way.

entries.summary: a simple tool fashioned from bamboo and a tin can for picking rice

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a simple tool fashioned from bamboo and a tin can for picking rice

entries.summary: to be well after being sick; conscious; still alive

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be well after being sick

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka malenggew iyan ka manekal wey ke neuyag pad/ded. Migpasabut seini te langun ne due geyinawa wey kenè dè ne iyan igpasabut kayi ka migderalu.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kahiyen ku te egsamsam te uled ne migketeng diyè te dalan ke napatey e, kunaleg te malenggew bes ded.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I think that the snake lie down on my way is dead but I'm wrong, it was still alive.

entries.summary: to be in the process of dying

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be in the process of dying

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè naan dè egkaluhey ne egpatey e ka buyag su egkalenggu-lenggu e sikandin.

entries.summary: to snore; to snore pretending

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eglengguken a iya ne eglipereng ke egkabeley te maaldew.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: If I tired of a daytime I will be snored when I sleep.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpalelengguk ubag ka hari ku eyew kahiyen ne nakalipereng.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My younger brother pretend to snored so that somebody will say he is asleep.

entries.summary: an unpleasant smell like that of urine or rotting fish; rancid odor

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: an unpleasant smell like that of urine or rotting fish; rancid odor

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan ka kenè ne meupiya ne ngareg te ngalap. Kenè egpasabut ne egngareg ka sika ne ngalap ke kenè egpekeiling ka ngareg te ihi.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenaa egkeibeg ne egkeen te ketipa su maleng-ig.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I don't want to eat a catfish for it's odorous.

entries.summary: to feel uninterested and uninvolved in what is happening around them; to be uninterested and uninvolved in what is happening around them; to always feel uninterested and uninvolved in what is happening around them

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to feel uninterested and uninvolved in what is happening around them

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egkalengkay rè due mulè si Ayit.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be uninterested and uninvolved in what is happening around them

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka eglengkay iyan ka kenè egteil wey kenè egkasasew wey egbantey te eggimuwen. Egleug-leug dè due wey kenè egkabantalan te minsan nekey ne egkewengetè te duma su hendue te warè dè diyè te kandin ka neyitabu wey ka igkasasew te duma.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eglengkay rè due mulè si Ayit te egkahulikid kid e ka iney rin diyè te baley.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Ayit is uninterested (in helping) while her mother is busy in the house.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to always feel uninterested and uninvolved in what is happening around them

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mania te eglengkay-lengkay ke rè due te migsahap man-e si Kawanan?

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Why are you uninterested that Kawanan was in danger?

entries.summary: rainy season; to rain for a long time

fields.label: Matigsalug definition

entries.summary: mortar

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: The mortar is carved out of a single piece of hardwood. It stands about two feet high and the middle is hollowed out. Rice (paley), corn (aheley), peanuts (meni), etc. can be pounded by one or two people using wooden poles (andu).

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka lesung iyan ka binayuan ne kayu ne innimu ligkat te mabasag wey makehal ne kayu ne daruwa peendiyè te hep-at ne dangew se kalayat wey warè minsan mamenu karakel. Iglungahan ka taliwarè te kayu pinaahi te hapuy wey egkuliteken te ugpit/puruk su eyew diyè igtahù ka minsan nekey ne egbinayuwen. Seini ka galingan te me menubu wey ka tagsè talaanak due iya kayi.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ka lesung iyan ka egbinayuwan te paley te Matisalug su warè galingan dan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The mortar is the material used by Matigsalug people to pound grains/palay for they don't have a grinder.

Iyan seini ka peglihawang te batè wey timpu te pegkeetew rin. Piru kenè dè ne etew, mananap ka egkalengeran kayi su minsan degma ka me pinamula wey me kayu.

Seini ne himu iyan ke pegsalampew te minsan nekey wey ke peggenat te me paa peendiyè te aw-awangan eyew kenè egpakariek te kenè egdiekan wey egkakayew ka daruwa ne paa te bayew egkaluhey.

entries.summary: pervert; to have an erection; to cause an erection

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka let-ug iyan sika ka egbehey te ibeg te minsan hentew ne egkeupian eg-abid. Due kayi ka langun ne due lebut ne iyan egpuunan ne egpakaanak emun ke egpekeg-uma ka benì te lukes wey te atelug te malitan. Ka let-ug iyan egpakeyinalig te minsan hentew ne eg-abid wey egpaabid. Diyè seini egpuun te suman-suman wey diralem te etew wey mananap naa. Seini ka igngaran te eggeramen ne egdumaan te baliyut, eyam, ibeg wey imma wey egkataman egkalet-uhan e. Egpakabehey seini te mareet ne batasan te etew emun ke kenè egpakatigkel wey egpeimma-imma rè due wey egpalihè-lihè.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Pegnela nu ka let-ug nu su egkareetan ki.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Control your pervert because we will be ruined.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mareet ne egdumaan si Ulnu su iyan dè egsumsumanen se let-ug din.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Ulnu is not good to accompany with because he thinks only of his pervert

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egkalet-uhan iyan ka egkehalan te lasù para te me lukes su egkeupian ne eggilabet te igkeupii ran ne eggilabetan. Ne ka me malitan degma egpallebag buwa degma ke egkeemisan/egkalet-uhan. Ka me etew wey ka me mananap egkaayunan te seini ne lalag wey ka minsan nekey ne due betì, lasù, susu wey geyinawa wey ibeg.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Batè pad si Segana ne egkalet-uhan e.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Segana erected his penis even he's still young.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egkalet-uhan e ka daruwa ne kuddè ne egpabutengey su egpekeg-ahew te beyan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The two horses are erecting their penis because they are fighting for female horse.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kahi te iney ku ne emun ke egpakegdani ka malitan wey lukes su egkalet-uhan kun e ka lukes.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My mother said that when man and woman will close to each other the penis of man will erect.
