fields.text: Ka nakaleus iyan ka nakapalasung wey ka nakabuntug naa tenged te amana ne iiyali ne pegpallahuy/peggipanew/pegpapallahuy te minsan nekey. Egkaayunan degma te seini ne lalag ka minsan hentew ne miggipanew wey warè nataleen/nabanggew/nabalabahan te hipanew rin.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Amana ne iiyali ka kuddè ku piru mahaan egsuwey te dalan ke egpallahuy, sikan naa ka malasi a degma egpakaleus diyè te kewun-aan ke egsuwey e ka kuddè.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My horse is very fast runner but gets off the road easily, that's why I often thrown off from the horse when the it gets off the road.

entries.summary: to go and see something; e.g., used of Otto coming to look at the timber; to survey and clear a small clearing before the main time of clearing fields, in order to see if the land is ready for clearing yet

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: e.g., used of Otto coming to look at the timber

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan ka pegpitew te minsan nekey ne keilangan ne egpitawen iling te sahing, baled, pinamula, kamet. Egkaayun degma ne ka pegpanumbaley diyè te lein ne inged.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egleuy a te kamet ku su kema ke imbenesan e.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will visit my field because it might be grassy now.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to survey and clear a small clearing before the main time of clearing fields, in order to see if the land is ready for clearing yet

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egpanleuy iyan ka egpamitew te egkametan wey meupiya ne egpamulaan. Mesi egpakakite e te egkametan, egbunsud e egkamet te deisek ne emun ke egkutel ka limuken wey egkalenged ne kenè ne meupiya ka egkametan, egpamitew e man-e te lein taman te egpakakite e te meupiya pinaahi te kutel te limuken.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: The limuken dove will give the signal whether or not to proceed in earnest with clearing a field.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: Also used of a chicken which is full grown but not yet laying eggs.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to survey its nest for laying eggs

entries.summary: undressed; naked

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egpalewad-lewad iyan ka egpalawas wey ke warè gumgumuten. Ka minsan nekey ne due insaluub egkaayunan te seini ne lalag emun ke egluluung sikandan. Minsan degma ka me batè ne sikan pad iya miglesut, egkaayunan degma te seini ne lalag.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Layun dè egpalewad-lewad si Ipi dengan te deisek pad sikandin piru kuntee kenè nud iya egkiteen ne egpalawas.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Ipi was always undressed when she was a little child but now you could never see her naked.

entries.summary: the fat which rises to the top and sets after meat has been boiled in a pot; to come out of boiling meat and rise to the top of the water; to produce more fat and float on top of the water

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: the fat which rises to the top and sets after meat has been boiled in a pot

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to come out of boiling meat and rise to the top of the water

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to produce more fat and float on top of the water

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eglew-ag ka kalambuan te ngalap diyè te weyig.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The fat of the meat is floating on the surface of the water

entries.summary: to fast from eating so that their body will become thin, causing the skin to wrinkle, and thus allowing room for the person to grow taller inside their skin

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to fast from eating so that their body will become thin, causing the skin to wrinkle, and thus allowing room for the person to grow taller inside their skin

entries.summary: to move from place to place

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to move from place to place

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka lewuk iyan ka leug wey kenè egtelen diyè te ugpaanan din su eggelebek egleug-leug te minsan hendei. Egkaayunan te seini ne lalag ka langun ne due geyinawa, eglayang wey se eggipanew wey se egpananap, wey ke eglumbuk. Ka langun ne manekal wey egpakaawè ligkat te sabeka ne inged peendiyè te duma ne inged.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eglewuk-lewuk e ka babuy ney su egpamitew te egkakeen din.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Our pig is wandering around because he is looking for what he can eat.

entries.summary: naked

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka seini iyan sika se warè migkukumbalè wey warè bunbun te lawwa wey egkahiyen te duma ne migpalawwas.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Migpalewwad-lewwad sikandin te migligwang te baley.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: She's burlesk when she out of her house.

entries.summary: to lie on one's back; to fall backwards

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egley-ang iyan ka eggibat ne iyan igparagket te innibatan ka peka wey ka ulaula wey ka getek nakatangkè/egkakita. Su emun ke iyan egkakita ka peka te etew ne miggibat, miglangkeb naa sikandin.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egley-ang a iya ke eglipereng a wey kenà a egkilid.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will lie down when I sleep and I won't lie on one side.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpakaley-ang ad e kuntee su malurek ka dalan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I might fall down because the road is slippery.

entries.summary: to lie a body down facing upwards

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to lie a body down facing upwards

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka igpaley-as iyan ka igpeyibat ne nakaley-ang wey naayun ka paa. Minsan ka eggibat ne eggulep dè due ne egkaayunan te seini ne lalag wey ka igpaketang ne minatey eyew egdamahen wey wey egbehayan te katamanan ne limlimuan wey eyew degma ig-andam eyew iglebeng. Eggimuwen seini eyew igpaayad-ayad igpeyibat eyew egpakabunsud.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè ka ka paleley-as ka eggibat su egdupaken ki te busew!

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Do not lie down facing up because the evil spirits will come to us!

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Hendei ipaley-as ka sumabaley niyu ne napatey?

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Where is the dead body of your neighbor lie?

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Impaley-as e ka batè ne nalened gabii diyè te Simud.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The child was laid down??? which was drowned yesterday in Simud river.

entries.summary: a custom or tradition
to waste time instead of getting ready to go somewhere

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to waste time instead of getting ready to go somewhere

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan ka kenè peglangan-langan, peglamu-lamu ke nekey ka eggimuwen. Panunggilingan peggilamun, pegkamet, pegpamipi wey ke peggipanew.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè kew liba-liba te peggipanew niyu su eyew mahaan kew rè egpekeuma diyè te eggingumaan niyu.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Dont waste your time along the road so that you can get home early.

entries.summary: to be envious or jealous of someone else

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be envious or jealous of someone else

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka eglibak iyan ka egkeimma te duma wey egsagsahukul wey eglalag te mareet diyè te neimmaan. Iyan egpuunan kayi ka imma te kasangkapan, himu, pinamula wey katelesan, wey masalig pad ka duma.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eglibak si Diding ki Bilin su warè sikandin nabehayi te imbehey diyè te ki Bilin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Diding is envious of Bilin because she doesn't have what is given to Bilin.

entries.summary: to help someone
to pretend or trick someone else; to backtrack; make a mistake in speaking

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to pretend or trick someone else

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka eglilibat iyan ka eg-uubat ne kenè egkeila te innimu rin eyew kenè egkanengnengan te duma ke nekey ka innimu rin pinaahi te pegpangguhud te kenè ne malehet ne innimu rin wey peggimu te minsan nekey ne egpakabunbun te innimu rin ne eggeles din. Egkeyitabu seini emun ke egkasapenan wey ke eggimu naan e minsan hentew ne eggelesan te malehet, mareet ma wey ke meupiya.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Malasi eglilibat ka me anak ku emun ke egginguma ad e.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My children often pretend (by doing something) when I arrive.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to backtrack; make a mistake in speaking

entries.summary: a lead anchor or sinker; to anchor a boat or weigh down a fishing line; with something (e.g., lead, a stone)

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka seini ne lalag iyan sika se tingga ne eggamiten te talimbehat te barku wey diyè te bunuwit.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to anchor a boat or weigh down a fishing line

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kaayun ded ne buhayi a te minsan deisek dè ne tepik te tingga ne igpalibatu ku te galawan ku?

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Can you give me a little piece of a lead to be the anchor for my toy (boat)?

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to attach something as an anchor or sinker

entries.summary: a mushroom

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Masalig ka me libbes ne nanubu diyè te kamet ney sikan naa iyan ney serè te tagsè maselem ka libbes.

entries.summary: to return; to be not expected to return somewhere; to do something

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka eglibed iyan ka egbaliyung eggipanew peendiyè te migpuunan wey ke innendiyaan. Iyan man-e igpasabut kayi ka egbalew-balew eggimu te minsan nekey ne neyimu rin e iling te egkamet, eggilamun, egkeen wey masalig pad ka duma.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eglibed a kaaselem diyè te Dabaw.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will return tommorow to the Davao.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be not expected to return somewhere

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Keilangan ne eglibliberen te meistra te eglalag ka malised ne guhuren su eyew mahaan egkasabut.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The teacher should say again and again the difficult story so that it will be easily understood.

entries.summary: a material waistband tied in a knot (especially that which is part of the traditional Matigsalug dress for a woman); to wear a material waistband

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a material waistband tied in a knot (especially that which is part of the traditional Matigsalug dress for a woman)

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka libed iyan ka ngaran te igbagkes kayi te liwaraan te salual. Innimu ligkat te manggad ka para te malitan wey innimu ligkat te hinabel wey in-ampawan teyii te me balieg eyew igdayan-dayan kayi. Malalab ka batek te ka libed te me malitan piru nabatek-batek ka libed te me lukes. Piru kuntee ne timpu, kenad amana eggamit ka iyam pad nanulin ne me Matigsalug ne me batè su iyan dan e eggamiten ka iyam ne libed ne innimu ligkat te hinabel ne makepal wey ka duma innimu ligkat te me kayu wey putew wey me plastik. Ne iyan naan dè eggamit kayi ka me buyag ne tapey e ne miggamit en iya wey ka egpakabeli kayi su sabeka ne kuddè ka bali te sabeka ne libed.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Hendei nu beliya ka libed nu?

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Where did you buy your waistband?

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eglilibed a su maluag ka salual ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will wear a belt because my pants are too big.

entries.summary: the delivery of a baby
to become confused or delirious for doing something; to cause confusing; to cause someone troubled

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to become confused or delirious for doing something

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egkalibeg iyan ka egkahuhus se meupiya ne suman-suman wey kenè egpekeyimu te meupiya ne eggimuwen, wey kenè egpakasuman-suman te meupiya wey eleg. Iyan man-e igpasabut kayi ka egkakulitek se utek tenged te masulug se egsum-sumanen.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egkalibeg ad e su masalig nahud ka egsum-sumanen ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I'm confused because of many things I'm thinking of.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: e.g. an apostrophe when a learner is reading

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Masulug ka immanulu ne igpakalibeg te me etew.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: There are many teaching that cause people to confuse.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Elegasi ka nakalibeg te me Matigsalug dengan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Inumen ne egpekewubug ka nakalibeg ki Jaime.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Drinking alcoholic drinks caused Jaime to be crazy.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Smoking with Mariwana caused someone to be crazy.

entries.summary: to circle around a fixed area

fields.label: Meaning context
fields.text: for something (e.g. untethered horse or carabbao, aeroplane)

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to circle around a fixed area

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka eglibeng-libeng iyan ka eglingut-lingut eggipanew te sabeka ne inged wey ke minsan hendei ne nalingeran te eggipanew wey egweil-weil naa ne diyè egbayè te aw-awangan, weyig wey tanè. Egkaayunan te seini ne lalag ka minsan nekey ne egweil-weil wey egpekeyipanew ligkat te sabeka ne inged peendiyè te lein ne inged, mariyù ma wey se marani, matikang ma wey se mababew, maralem ma wey se mababew, maluag ma wey se malig-et naa.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Iyan ku naan dè pulunganan diyè te baley ka eglibeng-libeng ka egpamitew simat ne natarin su igteyi ku perem te kumbalè ku ne nahisì.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I'm just roaming around the house looking for the lost needle which I will sew of my torn clothe.

entries.summary: a place

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka seini ne lalag iyan sika se ngaran te inged wey egkaayun degma ne ngaran te etew seini.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ka seini ne inged ka egngaranan te Libi.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: This place is what we called Libi.

entries.summary: Levite

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Kabuhalan seini ni Libi ne sabeka te anak ni Hakub. Iyan dan katungdanan ka egbulig te eggimuwen te talagpanubad diyè te timplu.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Libita ka ngaran te etew ne talagbulig te talagpanubad.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The helper of the sacrificers called Levites.

entries.summary: free

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Libri te paniudtu ka siminar ney.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Our seminar is free for lunch.

entries.summary: book

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: It's rare to hear the older pronounciation diblu now.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Amana egkeupian ne egbasa te libru si Badid.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Badid is very interested in reading books.

entries.summary: thousand

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Seini ka igngaran te seleppì ne subla pad te pila ne gatus ne migsinundul te pila degma ne pulu. Iyan igpasabut kayi ka seleppì ne eggingume e te sapulù ne gatus wey ke egsubla pad iya kayi ne kenè degma egginguma te milyun.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ka idad te dengan ne me etew su egginguma pad te sabeka ne libu.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Ancient people could reach the age of up to a thousand years.

entries.summary: to commit adultery with a married woman; to commit adultery together

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to commit adultery with a married woman

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egpakalibug iyan ka egpekeyilabet te kenè ne asawa rin. Migpasabut seini te minsan te himu ne mareet pinaahi te peglablabetey te daruwa ne etew ne manggiasawè e.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Nakalibug ka anggam ku te asawa te sumbaley rin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My uncle commit an adultery to his neighbor's wife.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpekeglibuhey en iya mulè kangkuwa ka tahasumbaley ne egparumdumeey te tagsè egbelegyè te lanut.

entries.summary: to meet somewhere; for some reason; to gather together somewhere

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eglibulung ka me etew diyè te dakel ne baley su egtemu te kepitan ne diyè egpuun te Menila.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The people will be gathered at the big house for meeting of the arrival of the captain from Manila.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Nekey buwa ka eglibulungan te me etew seeyè kewun-an.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Miglibulungan te me etew ka kalabew neehet.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The people gathered over the dead body of a carabao.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eggilutua te dakel su eyew iglibulung ku te me etew, ke egkalibulung e sikandan egpangguhuran kud te lalag te Manama.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will cook more so that the people will be assembled, and then when they become assembled, I will tell them the words of God.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egkalibulung ka me etew ke egpeumew ka kepitan te miting.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The people gathered when the captain call a meeting.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Miglibulungan te me etew ka kalabew neehet.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The people gathered over the dead body of a carabao.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Iyan igkalibulung te me etew su due migpasuntukey ne egkengewubug.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The reason that the people gathered because there were drunkard fighting.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Masalig ne me etew te kalibulungan te simbaan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Many people to the party at the church.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to gather together; to meet together

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Deisek dè ne me etew te pegliblibulung te FEMATRICS te miglihad ne Sebadu.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Only a few people attended the gathering at FEMMATRICS office last saturday.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Due kalibulungan kaaselem diyè te palingki.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: There's a meeting tomorrow at the market.

entries.summary: an air-rifle (with one trigger, fires lead)

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: an air-rifle (with one trigger, fires lead)

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Masinaw pad ka libumba ne iyam ku pad nabeli.

fields.text: used for shooting birds. e.g. limuken, kaykayasi, tukmu, saliyangsiyang, uwak. It is charged by pumping up the air container with a plunger, and thus can only fire one shot without being recharged.

entries.summary: to sharpen the point of something (e.g., a spear); using an instrument; to become sharp

fields.label: English translation

to continue

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Malig-et ka dalan pehendiyè te langit.

fields.label: English translation

entries.summary: a wheel, tire

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka liggid iyan ka ngaran te malibusen ne eggimuwen ne paa te terak, mutur, bangkalew wey keritun. Innimu ligkat te putew wey egpakaplian te guma eyew kenè egkareetan ka putew. Due lungag kayi te elat-elat ne egtiyukan te igbantal eyew kenè egpakalekè diyè te lawa. Kaayun ne kayu ka eggimuwen ne ligid wey kaayun ne guma. Amana ne impurtanti seini su emun ke warè ligid te terak, mutur wey ke bayk kenè egpekeyipanew.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Migbetu ka liggid te terak su natiyuk te lansang.

fields.text: The wheel of a truck burst because it was pierced with a nail.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Rubber tree is expensive because it is making as tire.

entries.summary: wheel

fields.label: Matigsalug example

fields.label: English translation

entries.summary: white-eared brown fruit dove; an omen bird; to call to someone; to give an omen

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: white-eared brown fruit dove; an omen bird

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: It has white ears and light brown feathers speckled with black. It is approximately 9 inches long, and eats berries and fruit. It does not fly in flocks and is very tame. Its call is a mournful whistling set of notes: Coo-coo, Coo, Coo, Coo, coo, coo, coo, coo, coo, coo, coo, the pitch going down gradually. To the Matigsalug people, if it calls from the right of the path when one sets out on a journey, it is a good omen. When it calls from the left, it is bad and one should not continue because misfortune or death is awaiting ahead. The most common pigeon kept as a cage bird by lowlanders.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eglimuken ma ka limuken ke due gipanawan ta su egbehey ma te katagaan ta.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: A fruit dove will give a call when we have a trip because it will give us an information about something.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka mammegkit iyan ka uled ne meilem se batek wey amana ne malayat. Egpandawi seini te me mananap ne egkeelehan din te eg-abeleng wey minsan pad ka etew wey ka derakel ne me ayam egdawiyen degma. Emun ke egdakel e seini egpekeiling e te kambing ka ulu wey egsumpeen e wey makariyabdiyab ne egtengtengan. Diyè seini eg-ugpè te uud te derakel ne kayu wey hendue te egbayaan te dakel ne kalamag ka me kayu ne eggipanawan kayi su kenè egkamelmelehan ka uled su nekeiling ka batek din te derewunen te me kayu. Ne emun ke amane e ne dakel seini diyad e eg-ugpè te weyig. Ne hendue te egbaggiyu ka weyig emun ke eg-anuy e seini ne weyig. Amana degma ne dakel ka lalas te seini ne uled su minsan ka me deruwunen ne egkatihisan te langesa rin egkengematey.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kahiyen ku ke nekey ka igpakapaddus-paddus ni Amè, kunaleg te inlupug bes sikandin te mammegkit.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I wondered what makes Dad run so fast, it is because he is after by a green snake.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè kew leleug dutu te bagteken su duen kun mig-anak dutu ne mammegkit.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Don't(pl) wander there where bamboo are lots because there is a long green snake that gave birth.

fields.text: Isanggat niyu ka nihu eyew kenè egkareetan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Hang up the winnowing tray so that it won't get ruined.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: There are two styles of winnowing tray in common use: the traditional Matigsalug one is a rectangular shape and the turned-up edges are made of the same soft woven material as the bottom. The Cebuano winnowing tray is usually a larger oval shape and has a strong rigid edge all around it. Nihu can be used to refer either to the traditional Matisalug tray, or as a generic term for winnowing trays.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: This simple shed is built, for instance, in a field where rice planting is about to commence. The roof is not water tight, built only from cane luwey. The floor is only five or so small logs laid on the ground. A basket is set on the logs and filled with the rice seed. When the sun is hot, the workers may also seek shade in the shed. After the rice is planted, the shed is often dismantled.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: This person calls the people together to a meeting and then begins to prophesy (egpahehanè). They feast and then clear a field together. He displays power by causing money to appear (egpamulingen te seleppì) and causing his hands to sweat blood. He gathers the people back and they live and eat communally. Adultery is not uncommon. In the end, promising no more problems, the leader gives the people poison to drink, claiming it is water from God which will cause no more hunger. He then commits suicide. This was done by Manggoyanan in approx. 1986 near Patag. By time all the bodies were discovered, the military were unable to bury them, so they were sprayed with gasoline and incinerated.

fields.text: Ka salibut iyan ka egsapihu te sabeka ne etew wey ke eglingkus naa. Piru ka seini ne lalag egkahamit diyè te egmalup-lupuhey wey egmaan-antukey. Minsan degma ka maheteng ne eggiphipanew egkaayunan te seini ne lalag emun ke egsapihu ka duma wey emun ke kenè egkeumaan ka dangeb ne eggendiyaan su nekeyipanew e degma.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egsalibuten ku perem ka manuk ne egdakepen ney piru nakabantey ma wey miglayang e.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I tried to crossed behind the chicken that we are seizing to but it was alarmed and flew away.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Nasalibut ney si Birtu diyè te kandan su miggendiyè kun degma te baley ney.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We missed Birtu in thier house because he went to our house also.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Nekegsalibut key ki Tetuk su miggediyè din te Dabaw ka egpangikul keddì te peg-ulì kud e degma kayi te Simud.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Tetuk and I crossed our paths because he went to Davao when I returned home here in Sinuda.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition

fields.label: Matigsalug example

fields.label: English translation

fields.label: English translation

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: A ritualistic requirement to avoid tungkè. A person who can not, or does not want to eat food that is offered him, or who forgets to eat something that he had been craving must do one of the following, perhaps in order of effectiveness. 1) Rub a pinch of the food into his foot, his forehead, and his lips. 2) Touch the food with his finger. 3) If the person is already too far away from the food when he remembers, he may simply utter "eg-sebat-sebat-sebat".

entries.summary: a command; to command someone else; assistant; worker; laborer; servant; messenger

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka lalag ne suhù iyan igpasabut ka pegpeyimu te minsan nekey te sabeka ne etew. Kaayun ne ka tuyù te pegsuhù mareet, egkaayun degma ne meupiya. Duè duma ne etew ne egbayaran ka egsuhuen, due duma ne kenè.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Suhù ka ki Bura diyè te tindaan eyew egpalit te paan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Command Bura into the store to buy a bread.

fields.label: Tagalog translation
fields.text: Utosan mo si Bura duon sa tindahan upang magbili ng tinapay.

fields.label: Cebuano translation
fields.text: Sugò kang Bura didto sa tindahan aron mopalit ug pan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Meupiya ka suhù te me ginikanan su egpakabehey te keupianan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The instruction of the parents is good because it gives goodness.

fields.label: Tagalog translation
fields.text: Mabuti ang tagubilin ng mga magulang dahil makapagbigay ne kabutihan.

fields.label: Cebuano translation
fields.text: Maayo ang tudlò sa mga ginikanan kay makahatag ug kaayohan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kaayun ne ggsuhù e pad keykew Butsukuy te pegpalit te egkeenen ney?

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Can I do a favor to you Butsukuy to buy food for us?

fields.label: Tagalog translation
fields.text: Maari po bang mautosan kita Butsukuy upang magbili ng pagkain para sa amin?

fields.label: Cebuano translation
fields.text: Pwedi ba nga masugò ta ka Butsukuy aron pagpalit ug pagkaon para sa amò?

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka igpasabut te egsuhuen iyan ka pegbehey te igpeyimu diyè te sabeka ne etew.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kaayun ne egsuhuen ku sikeykew diyè te Malaybalay?

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Can I request you to go to Malaybalay?

fields.label: Tagalog translation
fields.text: Maari po bang utosan kita upang pumunta sa Malaybalay?

fields.label: Cebuano translation
fields.text: Pwedi ba nga suguon ta ka didto sa Malaybalay?

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egsuhuen ku ka langun ne Matigsalug ne eggendiyè te Kitaotao kuntee!

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will+command all Matigsalug people to go to Kitaotao now!

fields.label: Tagalog translation
fields.text: Utosan ko ang lahat na Matigsalug na pumunta sa Kitaotao ngayon!

fields.label: Cebuano translation
fields.text: Suguon nakò ang tanang Matigsalug nga mag-adto sa Kitaotao karon!

fields.label: Grammar note
fields.text: A suhù must be a positive command, not a negative one. For instance, "Don't go to the fields today" would not be considered a suhù. (Linda Tanug, 2/17/98)

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka igpasabut te igsuhù iyan ka pegbehey te suhù diyè te sabeka ne etew eyew eggimuwen din.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Seini ka igsuhù ku eyew eggimuwen niyu.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: This is what I'm going to+order you so that you can do it.

fields.label: Tagalog translation
fields.text: Ito ang aking iuutos upang iyong gagawin.

fields.label: Cebuano translation
fields.text: Kini ang akong isugò aron inyong buhaton.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka suluhuanen iyan igpasabut ka etew ne layun egsug-suhua.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Meupiya ka suluhuanen ku su egtuman minsan marusilem.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My servant is good because he/she will obey even night time.

fields.label: Tagalog translation
fields.text: Mabuti ang aking lingkod dahil mautosan siya kahit gabi.

fields.label: Cebuano translation
fields.text: Maayo ang akong trabahante kay masugo siya bisag gabii.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Duè suluhuanen te apu ku dengan ne meiyal-iyal.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: There was a servant of my grandfather before who is energetic.

fields.label: Tagalog translation
fields.text: May katulong ang aking lolo nuon na masipag.

fields.label: Cebuano translation
fields.text: Dunay katabang sa akong lolo kaniadto nga kugihan.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka igpagsabut te egsugsuhuen iya ka pegtuman te langun ne ingkahi te etew ne migbehey te suhù.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egsugsuhuen si Irine ne bate su kenè eg-apul.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Irine can be given+orders because she will not disagree.

fields.label: Tagalog translation
fields.text: Mautus-utusan na bata si Irine dahil hindi siya marunong sumasang-ayon.

fields.label: Cebuano translation
fields.text: Masugo-sugo nga bata si Irine kay dili siya kabalo mobalibad.

entries.summary: common taro

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: A large herb (30-150 cm. high) of the arum family with arrow-shaped leaves. The leaf stalk inserts into the middle of the leaf.The tuberous root stock is eaten in sweet stews. It is an insurance crop which is eaten boiled or baked in times of famine. The leaves and shoots are also used as a vegetable and are called (WBM) tuved.

entries.summary: servant

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka suluhuanen iyan ka igngaran te etew ne due ahalen wey egsuulan. Bayew egpekeiling seini te uripen piru ka uripen hendue mulè te pinirisu ne egkalasayan ne kenè egsuulan te ahalen din, piru ka suluhuanen egsuulan te minsan nekey ne eggimuwen din. Ka etew ne egkaayu-ayu wey ka due bayew egkeyimu piru due ahalen dan ne meyaman ne egpatrabahu kandan, iyan iya sika ka egngaranan te suluhuanen. Ka suluhuanen, kaayun ne eglemung diyè te ahalen din wey egsuwey naa eg-ugpè.

fields.text: Masumpit amana ka egkeula-ula te suluhuanen su minsan nekey ne igsuhu te ahalen ne keilangan ne egtumanen iya.

entries.summary: rice cake

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka suman iyan ka egbunguhan ne hemey ne egsewuhan te sukal, wey iyan igweyig ka ingkeles ne weyig te niyug ne ingkudkud. Egbunguhan naan e seini te dewun wey egsubbeen e taman te egkalutu. Malambu seini ne egkeenen su insewuhan te weyig te niyug ne nakeles e wey mananam amana. Emun ke egkalutu e, egluwiten ped ka dewun ne imbungug human egkakeen. Iyan e mateu ka eggilutù ke mamenu karakel ke suman ne eggimuwen din. Piru ka senge kakuwa, senge dangew rè iya ka kalayat wey hendue karakel te timbebakal.

entries.summary: a type of forest liana

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: A large woody vine with thick, angled and much twisted stems. The rough dark brown bark is used as a substitute for soap since it produces an effective lather in water. The big curved pods contain large seeds known as (Tag) bayugo, (WBM) kayakaya. (MS) kayakaya. These are often pierced in the center and a stick inserted to make a toy spinning top. The knee cap is also called the same respective name in both Tagalog and WBM.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka tabubuleg egpekeiling te patiyukan piru bayew dakel-dakel wey usig ne eglulungag diyè te nahangu e ne kayu. Meitem se batek kayi wey bayew egmalibusen se lawa wey mahulub ke eglayang wey eglalag. Diyè sikandin eg-ugpè te bengel te kayu wey diyè degma eg-atulug. Meemis ka anak kayi ne egpekeiling te dalit.

entries.summary: to cut the hair of a person or animal

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to cut the hair of a person or animal

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka tabulug ne lalag iyan igpasabut ka peg-awè te bulbul te senge etew wey ke ayam naa. Masulug ka egpuunan ne egtabulug ka etew: an-anayan su eyew egpakaseleppì sikandin wey ke tenged naa su insuhu sikandin eyew egtabulug. Egtabulug ka me dengan ne timpu, eggamit te mahalang ne ugpit wey ke egpesè naa te butilya su ware gunting. Ka karaan ne me etew ware egtabulug su masulug te me karaan ne etew me mallayat se bulbul wey me sumpè. Su emun ke malayat ka bulbul te me etew dengan, labew en iya ka me lukes, igpasabut naa due ne datù sikandin; masulug ka egpabulihan.

fields.text: Miggendiyè si Tiyù te Puruk 7 eyew egtabulug ki Ugut.

fields.text: Ka lalag ne taha iyan igpasabut ka pegpeuyan te lalag diyè te sabeka ne etew. Emun ke egkahi ki te taha duè daruwa ne etew ne migpeglalahey. Ka sabeka eg-uyan te lalag, ka sabeka egpeuyan te lalag. Kenè egkaayun ne eggamiten ka taha eyew egpeuyan te kasangkapan wey ke minsan nekey naa diyè te sabeka ne etew.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Due taha te amey nu Rani ne igpatines ka seleppi din keykew.

fields.label: Cebuano translation

fields.label: Matigsalug definition

fields.label: Cebuano translation

fields.label: Matigsalug example

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will ask you to inform my brother there in Panganan to go home.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: According to the most Matigsalug elders that, long time ago there was two sisters named Tambunawey and Imemelu. They live in a peaceful community with their people. When the slam religion came to their place, Tambunawey married a muslim and converted into slam, while Imemelu decided to left the community with her people and went to the remote areas away from them and lived. entries.summary: to prove one's innocence or guilt; justice; to kill the suspect or the relatives of the suspect

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to prove one's innocence or guilt

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: Titihì is the one process of knowing the truth, as like proving who are the innocence and who are the guilty. By this process no one can deny for their faults because it is very effective process for proving the reality. Before the tihian begin some Datus prepare some important materials for them to heve a ritual and to call Manama the Creator and those incharge spirits of tihian. There are three kinds process of tihian, first is to hold a red hot metal from the fire with ember, second is to eat a chopped stalk of a (normally slightly poisonous) giant taro bagiyang, and the third one is to submerge into the water. When someone holding the red hot metal will be burnt meaning they are guilty, and for the giant_taro when they eat of the chopped stalk then itchy for them, they are guilty, and submerging theirselves in the water, who will be the first to withdraw in the water they are the guilty of the crime.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to kill the suspect or the relatives of the suspect

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: It's a Matigsalug culture that when the suspect doesn't accept that they are guilty of any crime they will make a ritual as prayer that when the suspect or relatives of the accused persons were guilty of that crime they will meet them in a specific time according to the scheduled time after the ritual for killing. And usually if the suspect and relatives were not guilty the killers didn't met them but still proceeding to a tihian justice.

fields.text: Masaligka tulisuk te suli diyè te kamet.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: There are so many tops of Gabi to the field.

entries.summary: to know or find the right way or place; to find out who each other is

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to know or find the right way or place

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Nangenen ku ne kenè kud e egkatulituan ka imbayè ku te newun-a su innalin e nahud ka dalan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I thought I can't find the right way which I passed through at first because the road was already diverted.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to find out who each other is

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Amana ne egkahalè si Peggak su egpekegtulitù e sikandan aselem te hari rin ne naluhey ran e ne nekegtariney.

entries.summary: rufous-capped canegrass warbler; striated grassbird; to dip their head (not their body) in water

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kasè tuliyuk ne bayaku su egpangeen te kutu te kalabew.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The striated grassbird is eating carabao lice.

fields.label: Meaning context
fields.text: for a tuliyuk bird or a person

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to dip their head (not their body) in water

entries.summary: close to the point of touching; to pound alternately

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: close to the point of touching

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Gabii nekegtulu key ki Amè ka egbibinayu

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Meupiya ka egpegtuluwey ke egbibinayu su mahaan dè.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Its better to pound grains alternately for it gets faster.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: e.g. on a drum or pounding grain

entries.summary: a type of tree

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Warè epad ingkita te kayu ne tulu piru kahi ni Amè ne malegleg kun ne igtemeg.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I'm not yet seen a tulu type of tree but according to my father it is flamable ( good for firewood ) for firewood.

entries.summary: to pound rice together

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpatuluwey ki ka egbibinayu te paley su eyew mahaan dè egkeimpusan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Lets pound rice together in order to finish it quickly.(To ease the job).

entries.summary: to push someone in the right direction

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to push someone in the right direction

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egtulud a te me etew pehendiyè te kameupiyaan.

entries.summary: a type of grasshopper which talk during nighttime and it calls "tululung, tululung"

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a type of grasshopper which talk during nighttime and it calls "tululung, tululung"

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka sseini iyan sika se egpanlalag ke marusilem ne amana ne matalè piru meupiya ne egpamminehen.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Emun ke egpanlelalag e ka me tulungtulung mataneb naan e sika ne marusilem.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: If the tulungtulung grasshopper talking, it's a sign that midnight already.

entries.summary: suddenly

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Eggipanew pad, mania te tulus e napatey?

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: He was walking along, why did he suddenly die?

entries.summary: divine; sacred; holy; all-powerful; a good spiritual power; sinless; powerful

fields.label: Grammar note
fields.text: Many people in Panganan do not know this word and assume that it must be a mispelling of mateles.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ka Matulus ne Manama iyan migtekul te langit wey migtumpi te tanè su maresen sikandin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The Holy God was the one who created the heaven and the earth (land) because He is powerful. (Lit. The Holy God was the one who spread out the sky and flattened the earth because he is powerful).

entries.summary: religion

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Imbalahad niyu ka suhù te Manama su iyan niyu in-ikul ka tuluuwen ne innimu te etew.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: You rejected the commandment of God because you followed the beliefs which were created by man.

entries.summary: to be carried away by a flow of water; to carry (a load); to stop somewhere on the way to pick up something or someone

fields.label: Meaning context
fields.text: for something fixed in the ground

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be carried away by a flow of water

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: The patil tripod is placed in the river for fun to see if it will withstand the flow of water.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egtahù ka batu eyew kenè egkatuley te weyig.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: (We) put a rock there so that (the tripod) would not be carried away by the river.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Hun-a kew e su egtuluy e pad egtibbas te bagtek.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Go ahead with me because I will get some bamboo to carry.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to stop somewhere on the way to pick up something or someone

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egtuluy e pad kayi te engki anggam su egdagsel e pad te egkamamè.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will stop in uncle's house in order to ask some betel to chew.

entries.summary: a body louse; to have body lice

fields.label: Scientific name
fields.text: Pediculus humanis var. corporis Phtthirius pubis

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ka tuma ne kutu su diyè te lawa egkahat kenè ne diyè te ulu wey memaangkag se batek.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The body lice is a body biter not in the head, and it has white color.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egtumeen ka etew ne kenè egpampamanihus tenged su egdakupal e ke belu rin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The man will be having body lice cause of the great dirt (in his body) because of not taking a bath daily.

entries.summary: to obey or carry out someone's; wishes; faithful

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to obey or carry out someone's

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka igpasabut te seini ne lalag iyan ka peggimu te minsan nekey ne insuhù diyè te sabeka ne etew. Ka peg-ikul te suhù, pegpalintutuu te suhù wey kenè ne egsupak kayi.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egtumanen ta ka suhù te Manama eyew egtumanen din degma ka insaad din kanta.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We will obey to God's commandment so that he will also fulfill his promise to us.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka igpasabut te seini ne lalag iyan ka pegkeyimu te impalintutuuwan ne egkeyitabu. Ka pegginguma te timpu, pegkeyitabu te nahuhud e ne egkeyitabu.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mahaan e egkatuman ka ingkahi ni apù Gawilan ne egkeyimu ka Simud ne mabantug ne lungsud.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The word of senior Gawilan is about to happen, Sinuda will be a great town.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to insist the rules and regulation to be followed

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ipatuman nu pa ka aldew te peggimeley ne wey ka hipanew.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Let the sabbath day to happened before you go.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè ne meupiya ka iyan ta egtumanen ka tuluuwen te kabuybuyahan ta su innimu rè te etew, ke kenè ka tulumanen ne egpuun te Manama.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Its not advisable for us to follow the teachings of our ancestors for only man created it but rather (we'll follow) the religion given by God.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka seini ne lalag iyan seeyè se egpalintutuuwan e ka igkeupiì te sabeka wey ug-uyun e.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Uya su egtumanan te pad iya sikandin te igkeupiì rin.

entries.summary: a benevolent spirit; the Holy Spirit

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a benevolent spirit; the Holy Spirit

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka Tumanud sabeka sika ne panisingan ne egbantey te etew eyew seeyè se egkengehitabu ne egginguma pad egkatuenan din uya su egpanudtulan ma sikandin te seini ne panisingan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Natuenan din ne eglibed ka Manama te mahaan uya su duen ma Tumanud din.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: He knows that God will come sooner because he has a leading spirit.

entries.summary: spirit of God; a prophet; to request leading spirit

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ka se tumanud su panallimbeka rè ka etew ne egtaputan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Only few people advocated by the leading spirit.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Leading spirit advocates for only a few people.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kasè tumanuren egpakataha te eghinguma ne egkehitabu.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The prophet will able to know the future happenings.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egpatumanud a perem su eyew egpakanengneng a te egkehitabu te mehuri ne timpu.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I wish to have a leading spirit so that may I able to know the happening at the end of time.

entries.summary: copper; bronze

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka seini ne lalag iyan ka egkahiyen te me buyag ne kalasiyan te putew ne egpanayyaben ne eggimuwen ne ugpit.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Puun te tumbaha ne putew ka ugpit te Elegasi ne igtibbas te due ngaran ne batè.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Made of copper iron was the sword of a giant to hit Tulalang.

entries.summary: the breeze of earth

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka seini ne lalag iyan sika se tukeg te tanè su kahiyen pa iya te me buyag ne malibusen ka kalibutan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Manawantawan te mata ku ka intumbangel te tanè ne impakita keddì te Magbebayè te taheinep ku.

entries.summary: a protruded forehead; to put protrude on their forehead; a person with a protruded forehead

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka tumbew iyan ka buked ne migketul amana. Senge kakuwa ne egnaranan te tumbew ka etew ne migketul se buked.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to put protrude on their forehead

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a person with a protruded forehead

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka tumbawen iyan ka etew ne migkumbetul se buked. Senge kakuwa ne iyan ig-immu te etew ke nekey ka diyè te kandin. Purisu ka etew ne migkumbetul se buked, egngaranan iya te tumbawen.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Tumbawen ka ignaran ni Amè te kinaariyan ney su migketul nahud ka buked.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Father named our youngest Protrude because her/his forehead protruded.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Tumbawen ka anak ni Mukù su migsuut kandin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Muku’s child has protruded forehead because it alikes of him.

entries.summary: something equivalent to something

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Iyan igpasabut te tumbuk ka igsaliyu te minsan nekey ne igbehey diyè te senge-etew. Egkahamit degma ka seini ne lalag te pegtinurù te minsan hentew ne iyan miggimu te minsan nekey ne meupiya ke mareet naa.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Si Undon ka intumbuk ni Nante ne iyan migtakew te seleppi din.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Nante accused Undon who stole his money.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ke egkeupian kew ne egpakanengneng te urasyun hendiyè kew re te amey ku piru tumbuka niyu.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: If you want to know magic spell just go to my father but pay it.

entries.summary: a ramp for a tree; to make a ramp

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka tumbul iyan ka egbalayen ne haheran eyew eg-unturan te egpepeled te kayu. Emun ke dakel e amana ka lebut te kayu wey derakel e ka luyung, eggimuwan naan e te tumbul.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenad egkahaha ni anggam Sayisun te egpekpek ka lawaan su bubuyahen e, sikan naa ka innimuwan din e te tumbul.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Uncle Sayisun can't chop from the base of the lawaan tree because it is very huge, that is why he made a ramp.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egtumbulan iyan ka egsumpulan te egbalayen ne kayu eyew eg-unturan te egpeled te kayu. Eggimuwen seini emun ke dakel e amana ka kayu wey dakel e ka luyung. Mananey naan e seini ne egpeleren ke egpaleblebutan, sikan naa ka egtumbulan e taman diyè te egkaayunan e te egpeled.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egtumbulan kud ka dakel ne kayu su mananey egkapeled emun ke egpaleblebutan ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will make a ramp to the tree because it will take long choping from its base.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egtutumbul e pad perem te egpeleren ku ne banuwaley ne miglugsu man-e ka uran.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I am about to make a ramp to the banuwaley tree then the rain approached.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Usi, matigkang sika se egtumbulan nu sikan naa ay-ayari nu su egsahap ka.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Brother, you are making a high ramp so make it good because you are in danger.

entries.summary: to be a symbol, e.g., a red chicken sacrified to the evil deity, Meibulan, is a symbol of blood or fighting; to derived

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be a symbol, e.g., a red chicken sacrified to the evil deity, Meibulan, is a symbol of blood or fighting

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka seini ne lalag iyan sika se ig-iling nu ka ngaran te bulbul, batasan, laplap, wey batek te sabeka ne butang mananap ma, etew, wey ke inged.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Meebul se bulbul te seini ne manuk sika ka igtumi ta seini ne luhem ka ngaran.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: This chicken has a dark feathers therefore Darky is the worth name for it that derive for its color.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka Tumibay iyan ka ngaran te etew ne lukes.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mabulut ne etew si Tumibay su warè iya igkaaldek minsan ka me busew.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Tumibay is a really brave man for he fears no one even the evil spirits.

entries.summary: for a hunter to be an accurate shooter

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: for a hunter to be an accurate shooter

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka tummawan iyan sika se etew ne egpasuhat-suhat ke egpusil, egdegpak, egpanè, egpilak. Egkaayun degma ne egkahamit diyè te pegsiyat te bula.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Tummawan ne egdegpak si Pungus su egkasuhat din iya minsan mariyù ka egdekpaken din.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Pungus is a marksman at throwing because he hits everything even if it's throwing a long distance.

entries.summary: to be gathered in a paticular place

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be gathered in a paticular place

entries.summary: to flatten down something

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egtumpi iyan ka eglupi wey egbelat te minsan ne egkalupi wey egkabelat iling te hinabel wey duma pad ne mewumel-humel.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ka Manama ka migtekul te langit wey migtumpì te tanè.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: God is the one who spread out the sky and flattened out the ground.

entries.summary: generous; to keep on (doing something); debt of gratitude

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka seini ne lalag sabeka ne batasan te etew. Ka igpasabut kayi iyan ka hid-u wey mabehey-behey diyè te duma, kenè ne leheren.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Masalig ka alukuy ni Daril su matumpis sikandin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Daril has many friends because he is generous.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Matumpis ne etew ka apu ku su mabehey-behey sikandin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My grandmother is generous because she is giver.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egtumpis-tumpis e pad egkeen keen su egkebuyag ad e mahaan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I will eat alone because I am getting older.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Due pegtumpis ku kandan su dakel ka ingkabulig dan dengan keddì.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I have a debt of gratitude to them because they had helped me a lot.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to be generous with each other

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: You siblings be generous to each other.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: (for two or more people) to be generous to each other

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ka pegpatumpisey iyan ka egpakameupiya te me etew du te pegpeid-iraney.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Generosity contributes harmony to the people than backbiting.

fields.label: Meaning context
fields.text: a spirit that incharge to punish for those people marrying their relatives

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka tumuled sabeka seini ne panisingan ne egsawey te me etew ne egpaggimu te mareet wey sakup sikandin te Anit ne panisingan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Kenè kew eg-asawa te suled niyu su egkakita kew te Tumuled.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Don't marry your cousin because Tumuled spirit will give you punishment.

entries.summary: a purpose

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka tumung ne lalag diyè egpuun te Biseyè. Iyan igpasabut te seini ne lalag ka egkuen diyè te sabeka ne inged wey ke diyè naa te senge baley.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Ka tumung te malitan mania' te migpanumbaley eyew te peg-iipat.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The purpose of the women why they visited is to spy.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Miggendiyè key te Panganan su ka tumung ney iyan ka pegpasalida.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We went to Panganan because our purpose is to show a movie.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Nekey ka tumung nu mania te inggimu nu sika?

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: What is your reason why you do that?

entries.summary: the growth sprouting from the pused (navel) at the node of damuluwan bamboo; to sprout offshoots when planted in the ground

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: the growth sprouting from the pused (navel) at the node of damuluwan bamboo

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka igpasabut kayi iyan ka pegderewun e man-e te kayu wey ke minsan nekey ne naluluwan wey ke napugpuhan te me dewun. Ka pegsubul e man-e te me dewun.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Duen e tunas te ipil-ipil ne impeled ku?

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Is there shoot of an ipil-ipil tree that I cut down?

fields.label: Meaning context
fields.text: for a part of a tree

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to sprout offshoots when planted in the ground

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egtunasan e man-e ka kayu ne sikan ku pad iya pamugpuhi.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Leaves are now sprouting from the tree which I cut off its top not long time ago.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: A branch or part of the trunk of a nara tree will egtunas when used as a post in the ground.

entries.summary: tundan banana

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egtundè iyan ka eg-alam te minsan hentew eyew due igpeyimu wey igpeula-ula iling te sabeka ne etew ne eggimuwen ne pangulu wey ke talewusey naa te sabeka ne punduk te etew.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Intundè si Gawilan ne egkeyimu ne mabantug ne igbuyag te me Matigsalug.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Gawilan was appointed to be a great leader of Matigsalug people.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Intundè te me amey wey iney ne eggimuwen ne pangulu si Tutu diyè te iskuylaan te ilimintarya.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Tutu was chosen by the parents to be the president there in the elementary school.

entries.summary: a narrow lake or trapped pool of water; to wallow in a pool of muddy water; to keep on wallowing in a pool of muddy water

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: a narrow lake or trapped pool of water

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka se tunè sika ka egtammisaken wey eglubuhan te kalabew,babuy,usa wey duma pad.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mig-aangat si Amè te tunè te salareng.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Father watched over (for hunting) the narrow lake.

fields.label: Meaning context
fields.text: for an animal such as a pig or carabao

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to wallow in a pool of muddy water

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egtunè ka kalabew ke egkeinitan su sikan dè iya ka egpakabawi kandin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The carabao will wallow (in a pool of muddy water) when hot because only the pool can cure him.

fields.label: Meaning context
fields.text: for an animal such as a pig or carabao

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to keep on wallowing in a pool of muddy water

entries.summary: to melt something; in something (e.g a tin can or pot); to become melted

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: in something (e.g a tin can or pot)

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egtunawen te Amey ku ka tingga diyè te lata.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My father melted the lead in a tin can.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egkatunew iyan ka pegkaalin te ulaula te minsan nekey ne pegkaleney tenged te egkasewuhan te egpakaleney. Masulug ka me paahi ne egkaalin te an-anayan ne ulaula ka minsan nekey ne egkaleney iling te asin, sukal, kindi, bitsin wey duma pad ne egkaleney emun ke egkeinitan, egkaweyihan, egkakalamahan wey egkewumelan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egkatunew e ka tingga ne intuug ku te hapuy su amana ne iiniti.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The lead that I put on the fire will melt because it's very hot.

entries.summary: half; to split in half; to divide into two equal portions

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka tunga iyan ka lalag ne migpasabut te liwarè dè wey ke nabaad dè.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Tunga dè te kilu te babuy ka imbeli ku su kenè egpekeutel ka seleppì ku.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Only half kilo of pork I've bought for my money is not enough.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to split in half; to divide into two equal portions

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Hendini nu ka katunga te tirè ne in-uus nu.

entries.summary: position; duties; employment; responsibility

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Hentew a ka dakel se katungdanan kayi te Simud su due tuyu ku kandin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Who has a great position here in Sinuda because I has a mission to him.

fields.label: Morphology
fields.text: This word does not fit into the phonology of Matigsalug - Matigsalug pronounciation would be "katundanan".

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka katungdanan iyan ka keilangan ne eggimuwen wey katenged te minsan hentew. Masulug seini ne klasi iling te katenged te amey, talagpanulù, me upisyalis. Minsan degma ka me anak due keilangan ne eggimuwen dan iling te egbulig te amey wey iney. Ka minsan nekey ne keilangan ne eggimuwen te sabeka ne etew tenged su sika iya ka himu rin, sikan naa ka igpasabut kayi ne lalag.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Iyan ku katungdanan diyè te baranggay ka egpanulat te langun ne neneyitabu kayi te inged ta su talagsulat e man iya.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My task in the barangay hall is to write all incidents happened in our place because I am the writer/secretary.

fields.label: Matigsalug example

fields.label: Matigsalug definition

fields.label: Matigsalug example

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Don't leave without eating for you might be bitten by snake along the road.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: If a person refuses to eat food that is offered him, for whatever reason, or if he forgets to eat food that he was craving, it is believed that he will be bitten by a venomous snake and will die. In order to counteract this, the person must say sebatsebat or either touch the food (egsebat-sebat) before daring to walk outside. Secondarily, this word can also refer to a person who is killed by a (mangngayew) as a result of stealing what was meant to be a peace offering.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: The difference between this and eg-erek is that a less pointed stick is used. Evidently, neither way is superior to the other, it just depends on the preference of the field owner. Another difference between the two is that here, the same person that makes the hole also drops in the seed. However, in the case of eg-erek, it is a different person who drops in the seed.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka egtuwil iyan ka paahi te pegpamula ne igbubul dè ka benì diyè te inlungag te puil. Emun masulug ne keilingan ne ka meiyal ne egpamilak ka eglulungag su meiyal ma degma ne egpangulug ka egsinundul eyew kenè sikandin egkalupig. Kayi iya ne paahi egkaangey ka sayew ne palakpak.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Igtuwil te rè ka ka paley su napuilan ma ka kamet ne eyew mahaan dè egkeimpusan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We will just plant the rice by making hole because the field is clear (lit. burned off) to make planting fast.

fields.label: Cultural note
fields.text: When the offering (such as a betel nut, tobacco, some of the first harvested rice) is given, it can then be taken by a spirit (busew). The souls (gimukud) of relatives now deceased can also partake of this offering.

fields.text: to cause someone to have a whooping caugh

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka igpasabut te yekyek iyan sika se egpanaman-taman egbuwa a su malimeran se lieg. Mahirap seini su kenè egpeneng-eneng.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka igpasabut te egyekyeken iyan ka sabeka ne etew ne nasublaan ne buwè.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Neyid-u a te etew gabii ne diyè te uspital ne egyekyeken ka egbuween su hendue te kenad e egpakageheyinawa.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I fell sorry yesterday to the old man in the hospital for he has a wooping cough and he hardly took a breathe.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Cigarette is bad because it cause to+whoop cough.

entries.summary: crisis point of situation; complicated; complex

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka lalag ne yenget iyan igpasabut ka mahirap ka peg-ugpe su ware ka egkeilanganen iling te keenen, ne subla su ware egkakeen, dakel ka prublima wey duma pad. Egkahamit ka seini ne lalag ke igpanengneng te sabeka ne etew diyè te senge etew ne warè egkeyimu rin, warè egkabayaan te isip su egpekeiling te inkeyiket ka suman-suman.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Muyenget key kuntee kayi te Simud su dakel ka prublima ney ne keilangan ne egsulbaren.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: We are in crisis in Simud because we have a big problem need to be solved.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Meupiya ka peg-ugpe ku diyè te Davao, piru muyenget ka kayi.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: My living in Davao is very sounds, but conflicated here.

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka igpasabut te meyenget iyan ka masulug se prublima.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Meyenget iya seini ne aldew su masulug ka prublima.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: This day is so complicated because there are many problems.

entries.summary: to waggle their tongue at someone or something

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to waggle their tongue at someone or something

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka igpasabut te egyewyew iyan ka etew ne egpalihawang te dilè eyew ig-ehet te sabeka ne etew.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Egyewyew re duè si Dì minsan kenè key eg-ehet kandin.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Dì is waggle her tongue even though we don't fight her.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mareet ka dilè ni Din nakita ku su migyewyew dengan sikandin keddi.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Din's tongue is disfigure I was able to see it because she waggle to me before.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Iyan palinneu ne igkabelù te hari ku ka minsan hentew ne batè su egyewyewan din sikandan.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: The sign that my brother is angry with somebody else is he will waggle his tongue towards them.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Inyewyewan ni Rani dengan si Ing-ing sikan naa ka nabelù.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Rani waggle his tongue to Ing-ing so she get angry.

entries.summary: a yoke (for harness); to put a yoke to carabao

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka yuggu ne lalag iyan igpasabut ka kayu ne nabeggkung. Ka tuyù te yuggu iyan ka igsapey te lieg te kalabew wey ke baka naa eyew egkahanuy ka balsaan.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Meupiya ne yuggu ka Nara ne kayu su makehal ne egkahepù.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: A yoke made from Nara tree is the best for it hardly broke.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Mahirap ka kalabew ne warè yuggu su kene egkahamit.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Carabao which is no yoke is not good because it will not usefull.

fields.label: English meaning
fields.text: to put a yoke to carabao

fields.label: Matigsalug definition
fields.text: Ka igpasabut te egyuyugu iyan ka etew ne egtahù te yuggu diyè te kalabew.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Hapit a nasungey te kalabew su egyuyugu a.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: I almost hit of carabao's horn because I put a yoke.

fields.label: Matigsalug example
fields.text: Migyuyugu si Amè te kalabew eyew su egdaru.

fields.label: English translation
fields.text: Amè was putting yoke on his carabo to plow.

entries.summary: ka; Egkahamit ka seini ne litra ke eglalag ka te sabeka ne kasangkapan te an-anayan.; Egkahamit ka seini ne litra te pegpahunsiling te minsan nekey wey egpangguhud ke nekey klasiya te butang ka minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use a before a word which starts with a consonant. You use an before a word which starts with a vowel.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit ka seini ne litra ke eglalag ka te sabeka ne kasangkapan te an-anayan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use a when you talk about one thing the first time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a tree beside my house. The tree is dead. [Note: the second time you say the tree].

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due kayu diyè te kilid te baley ku. Ka kayu migpatey e.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit ka seini ne litra te pegpahunsiling te minsan nekey wey egpangguhud ke nekey klasiya te butang ka minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use a to describe something, or say what kind of thing something is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My sister is a good teacher.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka atebey ku su meupiya iya ne meistra.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The peanuts are 60 pesos a kilo.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka menì su hen-em ne pulu tagsè kilu.

entries.summary: eg-engkeran; peg-engked

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you abandon someone or something, you leave them and do not plan to come back to them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When his wife died, he abandoned his children, so now his children have nobody to care for them.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te pegpatey te asawa rin ne malitan, mig-engkeran din e ka me anak din, su ka me anak din kuntee warad e egtanggu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They abandoned the broken bike by the roadside, and continued on foot.

entries.summary: egpekeyimu; egpakakaya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that you can do something (have_the_ability_to do something).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This truck has the ability to carry 10 drums of water.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini ne terak egpekeeleg te sapulù ne dram ne weyig.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has the ability to win the competition, if he trains hard.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due kaya rin ne egpakareeg te kuntis, ke egpangune-kunè sikandin egbebasbas.

entries.summary: egkaayun ne eggimu; egpekeyimu; mateu; amana egkateu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something is able to do something, they can do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Are you able to help me, or are you too busy?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Someone who is able is good at doing things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a very able student.

entries.summary: meyitenged te; eggiphipanew diyè te nateil ne lugar; nenakatahù wey natalagtag diyè te sabeka ne lugar

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is about a particular subject, that subject is the topic.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We are reading a book about insects.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egbasa ki te libru ne meyitenged te me uled-uled.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggiphipanew diyè te nateil ne lugar

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone moves about a place, they move from point to point inside that place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She walked about the school and visited some of the classes.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggip-hipanew sikandin diyè te iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an] wey migpanleuy te duma ne klasi.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nenakatahù wey natalagtag diyè te sabeka ne lugar

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people or things are about a place, they are in different locations inside that place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There were lots of books lying about the room.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due masalig ne libru ne nenakatahù te sinabeng.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There were about two hundred people at the concert.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due me daruwa ne gatus ne etew diyè te kunsirt.

entries.summary: te dibabew; te ampew; dibdibabew te; subla te

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something moves or is above another thing, it is higher than that other thing, and not touching it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka bayaku miglayang te dibabew ta.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a cloud above us.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a number or level is above another number or level, it is bigger than it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You need to get above 70% in the test.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ne egkuwa ka te dibdibabew te pitu ne pulù ne pursintu te tis.

entries.summary: diyè te lein ne nasud; abrud

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: diyè te lein ne nasud; abrud

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a different country from your home country (e.g., go abroad, live abroad, work abroad).

entries.summary: warè iya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The absence of someone or something from a place is the fact that they are not there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: During my absence, my parents cared for my dog.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te timpu te wara a, iyan egtanggu te asu ku ka amey wey iney ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Many plants cannot grow in the absence of sunlight.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Masalig ne me pinamula ne kenè egtubù ke warè aldew.

entries.summary: warè diyè te nateil ne lugar

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: warè diyè te nateil ne lugar

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something is absent from a place, they are not there in that place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was absent from school last Friday, so he missed the exam.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè sikandin diyè iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an] te miglihad ne Birnis, sika ka warè nekeiksam sikandin.

entries.summary: egkahamit seini ke leleheti ka eglalahen; layun eleg wey malehet ne pegpalintutuu; egkakita ne karakelan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkahamit seini ke leleheti ka eglalahen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is absolute, it is 100% the case.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There must be absolute silence during the exam.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ne warè lalahan te timpu te iksam.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My desk is an absolute mess.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is very lazy and always does the absolute minimum when I ask him to help me.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: layun eleg wey malehet ne pegpalintutuu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which people believe is always true and right.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Absolute truth is true all the time, even if you don't believe it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Layun eleg wey malehet ka kamalehetan te langun ne timpu, minsan ke kenè ta egpalintutuuwen seini.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If society does not have absolutes, then everyone just does whatever they feel like doing.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An absolute amount is an actual amount, not a percentage.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use absolutely to talk about something that is 100% the case.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbalibad en iya sikandin ne egbulig.

entries.summary: egsupsup; egdakep (te dahing); masupsup; marakep-dakep; pegsupsup; pegdakep

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an object absorbs something such as liquid, gas or soundwaves, the liquid, gas or soundwaves move through the surface of the object into the object.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The walls of the recording studio are soft, so they absorb sound.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka alabat te istudyu mewumel-humel, sika ka egdakep seini te dahing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The cloth absorbed the water from the table.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka manggad migsupsup te weyig ne diyè te lamisa.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The dry ground absorbed the rain quickly.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka mammara ne tanè iiyali ne nasupsup ka uran.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Dark colors are hotter to wear, because they absorb heat.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka marusilem ne batek meinit ne igsaluub, su amana egdakep te keinit.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: able to absorb a lot of something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A towel is more absorbent than a shirt.

entries.summary: due kalabetan te pegsuman-suman wey eggeramen, iling te kenè egkasamsam wey egkakita; malepet ne insulat ne egpanengneng te langun

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due kalabetan te pegsuman-suman wey eggeramen, iling te kenè egkasamsam wey egkakita

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something abstract is related to ideas and feelings, not physical things or real events.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has never seen a hammer, so it is an abstract idea for him.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè dè due sikandin nakakita te buntuk, purisu diyè dè seini te suman-suman din.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Happiness is an abstract thing that you can't touch.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: malepet ne insulat ne egpanengneng te langun

fields.label: English explanation
