fields.text: a short piece of writing which gives the main points of a longer piece of writing such as an essay.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have read the abstract of the article, so I know in general what it is about.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nabasa kud ka malepet ne baseen [base͡en], sika ka natahaan [nataha͡an] kud ka intiru ne igpasabut kayi.

entries.summary: eglasey wey ke egpeyilew ne egkaamanaan [egkaamana͡an]; peglasey wey ke pegpeyilew ne egkaamanaan; egdereet; egpasubla

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eglasey wey ke egpeyilew ne egkaamanaan [egkaamana͡an]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you abuse a person or animal, you treat them very badly, and hurt them in some way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This dog was abused by his last owner, so he is afraid of sticks.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini ne asu amana nalasey te newun-a ne kamuney, sika ka egkaaldek [egka͡alldek] e te lampes.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The angry customer abused the shop assistant, saying many rude things to her.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peglasey wey ke pegpeyilew ne egkaamanaan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of hurting a person or animal by treating them very badly.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She suffered physical abuse from her parents.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Sexual abuse of children is a terrible crime.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you abuse something, you use it in a wrong way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She abused her position in the shop by stealing money.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migdereetan din ka katenged din diyè te tindaan [tinda͡an] te migpanakew sikandin te seleppì.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of using something in a wrong way.

entries.summary: due kalabetan te iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an] wey te peg-iskuyla; mapuhawang; talagnengneng wey talagpanulù diyè te iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an] te kulihiyu wey unibirsidad

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due kalabetan te iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an] wey te peg-iskuyla

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something academic is related to schools, colleges and study (e.g., the academic year).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The academic year starts in June.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something academic needs study and thinking more than practical skills.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her course was very academic, as there was a lot of theory.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kursu rin amana ne mapuhawang su masalig ka me suman-suman.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: talagnengneng wey talagpanulù diyè te iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an] te kulihiyu wey unibirsidad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: someone who does research and teaches at a college or university.

entries.summary: iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an] te nateil ne katuenan; maheteng ne punduk ne due kalabetan te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a school for training students in a particular skill (e.g., a military academy).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: maheteng ne punduk ne due kalabetan te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a formal group which is connected to something such as an art or science (e.g., an academy of music).

entries.summary: pamaahi te peglalag-lalag wey pegkalituk; egmanekalen ka lalag wey ka pegparahing; manekal ne peglalag wey pegparahing

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your accent is the way that you say the sounds of your language.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She speaks English with a strong Filipino accent.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eglalag sikandin te Inglis ne Pilipinu ka pegkalituk.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egmanekalen ka lalag wey ka pegparahing

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you accent a word, part of a word, or musical note, you say or play it more loudly and strongly.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You need to accent the important words, don't just say them all the same.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ne egmanekalen nu te eglalag ka impurtanti ne me lalag, kè nu lalaha ne nekeg-iling dè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An accent on a word, part of a word, or musical note, is the fact that you say or play it more loudly and strongly.

entries.summary: egkuen wey ke egdawat te igbehey; egkabennalan; egkarawat; eg-angken

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkuen wey ke egdawat te igbehey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you accept something which a person wants to give you, you agree to take it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I tried to pay her, but she would not accept the money.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you accept something, you agree that it is true or okay.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In some countries, the practice of nose-piercing is accepted by many people.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Diyè te duma ne me nasud, ka himuwen dan ne egsisingan ka irung su egkadawat e te kasuluhan ne etew.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father accepted my decision to study art.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you accept that something bad is true, you say that it is true, even though it is difficult to say.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I accept that I made a mistake when I did that.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eg-angken a ne naseyyup a te peggimu ku due.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egpakasabut ka te minsan nekey ne mareet ne malehet iya seini ne kenè nu egkabalbalawan, wey eggeraman nu iya te eg-ugpè seini.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you accept that something bad is true, you understand that you can't change it, and try to live with it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She finally accepted that she would not see her friend for a long time.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakarawat e sikandin ne kenè din egkakita ka alukuy rin te mananey ne timpu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an organization or group accepts you, they allow you to join them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was accepted by the University of Mindanao to study nursing.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtuhutan sikandin te Unibirsidad te Mindanao ne eg-iskuyla te narsing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The lonely boy wants to be accepted by the others at school.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka lukes ne batè ne egkalangè egkeupian ne eg-apilen te lein ne me batè diyè te me iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an].

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegkuen wey ke pegdawat te igbehey; 2 pegkabennali; pegkarawat 3 peg-angken; 4 pegpakarawat; 5 pegtuhut; peg-apil

entries.summary: eg-angey; pegpekeendiyè [egpeke͡endiyè] wey pegkahamit te minsan nekey; kaayunan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you access something such as information, you get it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Somebody accessed my file and changed something.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due mig-angey te pepilis ku wey migliwanan ka duma.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegpekeendiyè [egpeke͡endiyè] wey pegkahamit te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that you can go to a place or use a thing (have_access_to something).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have access to a computer, so I can check email.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpekeendiyè [egpeke͡endiyè] wey egpakahamit a te kumpyutir, sika ka egpakapitew a te imil ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a place is accessible, you can go there. If a thing is accessible, you can get it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That village is not accessible by truck, only by walking.

entries.summary: warè im-immana ne sitwasyun wey ke pangitabù (layun mareet, wey masakit ka etew); warè im-immana; warè tuyua

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: warè im-immana ne sitwasyun wey ke pangitabù (layun mareet, wey masakit ka etew)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that happens without anybody planning it. It is often something bad, and someone gets hurt.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I didn't mean to drop the cup; it was an accident.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè ku tuyua ne egkeulug ka pakawan; neulug dè due.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was a car accident on the highway.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due aksidinti te terak diyè te kelesadda.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happens accidentally or by_accident, it happens without anyone planning it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I found the letter by accident, while I was cleaning the room.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè ku im-immana te pegkakita ku te sulat, te pegpanlinis ku te sinabeng.

entries.summary: egkeel-elitan; egkatahuan; egkeelehan; egkeugpaan; egkeyirehaan; egteil wey ke egbehey te egpeugpaan wey ke egpeyirehaan; eg-elit-elit; eg-alumama

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a building accommodates people, it has space for them to sleep.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini ne baley egkatahuan te lalimma ne pulu ne etew.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egteil wey ke egbehey te egpeugpaan wey ke egpeyirehaan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you accommodate people, you provide a place for them to sleep.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can accommodate three more visitors in my house.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you accommodate someone, you change your behavior or plans so that the other person will be comfortable.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They had planned to leave on Friday, but they changed to Saturday to accommodate their friends.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migplanu sikandan ne eg-awè te Birnis, piru nabalbalawan te Sabadu su mig-elit-elit pad sikandan te alukuy ran.

entries.summary: eg-el-elitan; eggimelayan; egpeugpaan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a place where people live or stay.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The college provides accommodation for students who live far away.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kulihiyu migbehey te egpeugpaan te me istudyanti ne diyè nangugpè te maddiyù.

entries.summary: egduma; egkarumaan [egkaruma͡an]; egpekegduma; egparumeey [egparume͡ey]; egparumaan [egparuma͡an] te dahing

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you accompany somebody, you go with them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She accompanied us on our trip to Davao.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migduma sikandin kanta te hipanawen ta diyè te Dabaw.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something accompanies something else, it appears together with that thing.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In music, if you accompany someone, you play a part (e.g., on guitar or keyboard) while they play or sing the main part.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She sang and I accompanied her on the piano.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-ulahing sikandin wey migparumaan ku ka ulahingen din te piyanu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the music which you play to support someone who is playing or singing the main part.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This song is a solo with guitar accompaniment

entries.summary: eg-impus; eg-angayen; egkuen ka eg-umeen; eg-uma; peg-impus; peg-angey; pegkuwa; peg-uma; naangey; nakuwa; neuma

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-impus; eg-angayen; egkuen ka eg-umeen; eg-uma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you accomplish a goal or task, you finish it successfully.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She accomplished her goal of becoming a nurse.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: In-angey rin ka igkeupii rin ne egkeyimu ne talagpangabang te duktur.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of accomplishing a goal or task.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The accomplishment of goals can take many years.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Winning that race was an accomplishment which he is proud of.

entries.summary: kalinew wey kasabutan (meyitenged te me etew wey ke grupu); egpekeg-uyun; nekeg-uyun; egpekegduma; kasabutan taliwarè te grupu wey ke nasud (iling te pegpeengked te gubut)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kalinew wey kasabutan (meyitenged te me etew wey ke grupu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: peace and agreement between people or groups.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is accord between all of the committee members.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an idea or action accords_with something else, it agrees or fits with that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father and I often argue, because my ideas do not accord with his ideas.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Layun key egpekeg-apul te amey ku, su ka puhawang ku kenè egpekeg-uyun te kandin ne puhawang.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kasabutan taliwarè te grupu wey ke nasud (iling te pegpeengked te gubut)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a formal agreement between groups or countries (e.g., to stop a war).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people accord someone something (e.g., a certain title), they give the person that thing. (used in formal language).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The group accorded him a warm welcome.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka grupu migbehey te meinit ne peg-elit-elit kandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something does something of_their_own_accord, they do it themselves, and other people don't need to make them do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her son washed the clothes of his own accord, without her telling him to do it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-uney-uney ka se anak din ne lukes migpami-pi te me kumbalè din, ne warè migsuhù kandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This light has a timer, so it turns off of its own accord after one hour.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ne sulù due urasan, sika ka eg-uney-uney seini egkeebuki ke egsabeke e ne uras.

entries.summary: pinabayè te; sumalè te; kahiyen ni; kahiyen te

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you do something according_to customs or instructions, you follow those customs or instructions. If you behave according_to a situation, you behave to fit the situation.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The bridegroom wore the tangkulu at his wedding, according to tradition.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka lukes ne egkasalen migsaluub te tangkulu sumalè te nabatasan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use according_to to say where you got some information.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: According to my friend, there were about 30 people at the house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kahiyen te alukuy ku, due me tatelu ne pulù ne me etew diyè te baley.

entries.summary: aheteng ne kasabutan tali keykew wey te kumpanya ne ka kumpanya egtanggu te seleppì nu wey ke nigusyu; kasabutan te pegsambey wey te pegbayad; tengtenganan (kasulatan, listaan [lista͡an], dukumintu), te me narawat, nabehey wey te keilangan ne egbayaran

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: aheteng ne kasabutan tali keykew wey te kumpanya ne ka kumpanya egtanggu te seleppì nu wey ke nigusyu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a formal arrangement between you and a bank or company, in which the bank or company cares for your money or business.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kasabutan te pegsambey wey te pegbayad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an arrangement between you and a shop, in which you can have things on credit and pay later.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Could you please put those things on my account.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: tengtenganan (kasulatan, listaan [lista͡an], dukumintu), te me narawat, nabehey wey te keilangan ne egbayaran

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a formal document which shows the money that you have received or given, or need to pay.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She checked the account to see how much she needed to pay.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sumpulan diyè te nateil ne nengnenganan te prugrama ne layun ka eggamit te inggamit nu ne ngaran wey paswurd (te kumpyutir)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the 'personal space' which you have on the internet, connected with a particular communication program (e.g. Yahoo or Facebook). You often need a username and password to use it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the story of something that happened (give_an_account_of something).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She gave an interesting account of her trip to Luzon.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you account_for something, you explain the reason for it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can't account for the sudden increase in crime; I have no idea why it's happened.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ku egkahuhud ka sahuhunè ne pegdakel te me kasu; warè puhawang ku ke mania te neyitabù seini.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something accounts_for a certain part of something else, it is that part.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Children account for more than half of our group.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me batè nakatimul te subla te katengè te grupu ney.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Overseas sales account for 70% of our profits.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you account_for people or things, you know where they are.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Don't worry, all of the lost children are now accounted for.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happens on_account_of another thing, it happens because of that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I couldn't see well on account of the rain.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena a amana egpakakita tenged te uran.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He couldn't join the team, on account of his bad eyesight.

entries.summary: egkalibulung; egkalimud; egpamunpun; 1 pegpanlibulung; pegpanlimud; 2 pegpamunpun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something accumulates, an amount or group of it grows.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If I put a little money in this cup every week, my money will slowly accumulate.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke eg-ulug a te deisek ne seleppì te seini ne basu te tagsè simana, ka seleppì hinay-hinay ne egkalimud.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you accumulate something, you collect a lot of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has accumulated a lot of animals, and now has three dogs, two cats and many chickens.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpamunpun sikandin te masalig ne me mananap, ne kuntee due tatelu ne asu, daruwa ne miyew, wey masalig ne me manuk.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The accumulation of books can be expensive.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group or amount of things that have accumulated in a place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was an accumulation of dust on the desk.

entries.summary: amana ne natu-tuenan; naay-ayaran (meyitenged te nasuhat wey ke naangey); 1 amana ne natu-tuenan; 2 pegkaayad-ayad te pegkasuhat wey ke pegkaangey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is accurate, it is true and correct.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His drawing of the horse was very accurate.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka insulat din te pepil ne kuddè amana ne natu-tuenan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Sometimes information on the Internet is not accurate.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: naay-ayaran (meyitenged te nasuhat wey ke naangey)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If throwing or shooting is accurate, the person can hit the thing that they want to hit.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It was a very accurate shot, and the ball went directly into the basket.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana seeyè ne naay-ayaran ne pegdegpak te bula, su ka bula nakatahù duritsu te ring.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 amana ne natu-tuenan; 2 pegkaayad-ayad te pegkasuhat wey ke pegkaangey

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You need to check the accuracy of that information.

entries.summary: egbayung; egpasangil; pegbayung

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you accuse someone of doing something bad, you say that they did it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He accused me of stealing the money.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbayungan a nikandin te iyan a migpanakew te seleppì.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: words which say that someone did something bad (make_an_accusation).

entries.summary: nalayaman; nabatasan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are accustomed to something, or accustomed to doing something, that thing is not strange for you, because you have experienced it or done it many times before.

entries.summary: masakit

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a part of your body aches, it has pain inside that doesn't stop quickly.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a pain inside that doesn't stop quickly.

entries.summary: eg-angayen; egkuen ka eg-umeen; eg-uma; peg-angey; pegkuwa; peg-uma; naangey; nakuwa; neuma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you achieve a goal or result, you complete something good, usually with hard work.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He achieved his goal of building a house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakuwa rin e ka igkeupii rin ne egpakabebaley.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The achievement of his goal will take a long time.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Winning the competition was a great achievement for our team.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegdeeg te pegpapitawey te kateunan su nakuwa te kanta ne grupu.

entries.summary: kimikal seini ne due haydrudin ne mahanadganad ne egtunew te duma ne butang; maperes (meyitenged te egkakeen wey ke egkeinum); due egpakatunew ne kasangkapan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kimikal seini ne due haydrudin ne mahanadganad ne egtunew te duma ne butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a chemical which contains hydrogen, and which can gradually 'eat' other things. If you combine an acid with certain chemicals, it makes a salt.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: maperes (meyitenged te egkakeen wey ke egkeinum)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An acid food or drink has a sour taste (e.g., kalamansi, pineapple).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something acidic has acid in it.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kamenu karakel ka egpakatunew ne butang diyè te sabeka ne butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: how much acid there is in something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We tested the acidity of the soil.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kamenu kaperes ka pegkeen wey ke inumen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: how sour a food or drink is.

entries.summary: eg-angken; eg-alukuy (meyitenged te peg-en-endungè); egpasalamat wey ke egpanengneng te nakuwe e

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you acknowledge that something is true, you agree that it is true (even if it is difficult for you to agree).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I acknowledge that I was wrong.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you acknowledge someone, you show that you know the other person is there (maybe by nodding your head).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I said hello but he didn't acknowledge me.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migkahi a te meupiya piru warè mig-al-alukuy keddì.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpasalamat wey ke egpanengneng te nakuwe e

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you acknowledge a letter or gift, you thank the person or tell them that you have received it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He didn't acknowledge my text message, so I don't know if he got it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè migpanengneng sikandin ke nakuwa rin e ka tiks ku, sika ka warè ku nataheyi ke narawat din e.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you acknowledge someone, you publicly thank them for doing something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: At the end of the Fiesta, the Barangay captain acknowledged the organizers of the fiesta.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te impus te pista, ka kepitan migpasalamatan diyè te katangenan ka miggimu te kalibulungan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 peg-angken; 2 peg-al-alukuy; 3 pegpasalamat wey ke pegpanengneng te nakuwe e; 4 pegpasalamat diyè te katangenan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of acknowledging someone or something.

entries.summary: warè amana neileyi ne etew; natahaan [nataha͡an]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person whom you know a little, but not very well.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you have an acquaintance with a particular subject, you know something about it.

entries.summary: nakataha; nekeila; nakanengneng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are acquainted with someone or something, you already know them.

entries.summary: egbebeli wey ke egkuwa; pegkuwa; peg-angey; pegbebeli; nakuwa; naangey; nabeli

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you acquire something, you buy or get it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbebeli sikandin te iyam ne kumbalè.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is not wise to focus your energy on the acquisition of wealth.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This goat is a new acquisition; I bought it just last week.

entries.summary: egbayè; eglihad; talipag te; deyipag te; nakabantal; nakabalabag; nekeelet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something moves across another thing, it moves from one side of that thing to the other side.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He walked across the room to the blackboard.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miglihad sikandin ka miggipanew te klasiyanan peendiyè te sulatanan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is across something else such as a river, it is on the other side of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her house is across the road from my house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka baley rin talipag te kelesadda puun te baley ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is across something else, it stretches from one side of that thing to the other side.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was writing across the blackboard.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due insulat ne nakabalabag te sulatanan.

entries.summary: eggimu wey egweil; himu; egkeyimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something acts, they do something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We must act now to stop the criminals.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I feel better already, so I think that the medicine is starting to act.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one thing that a person does

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was a good man who did many acts of kindness.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone acts as a job, they do that job. If something acts as a thing, it does the job of that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The fallen tree acted as a bridge across the river.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka napeled ne kayu neyimu ne teytey te pahamayan ne weyig.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is acting as director while the real director is on holiday.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you act like something, or act as if something is the case, you behave in that way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you are an adult, you shouldn't act like a child.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke buyag kad, keilangan ne kenè kad eg-iling te batè.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Don't eat so fast! You're acting as if you haven't eaten for a week.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: kenè ka egkeen ne amana dugdud! iling kew te warad iya ingkeen te sabekan simana.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is acting very strangely. Is he sick?

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggimu te weil te peg-uyan te pangguhuren

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you act, you perform in something such as a movie.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He enjoys drama lessons, because he loves acting.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone's behavior is an act, it does not show how they truly feel.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She cried a lot, but it was just an act to get attention.

entries.summary: himu; weil; iggendiyè te kurti (eggamit te balaud)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that a person or thing does.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His unwise actions caused the accident.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Suddenly, there was a lot of action in the house.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That chemical has a corrosive action.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you take legal action against someone, you use the law courts to make them pay or do something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They took action against the company because of its illegal activities.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Innendiyè dan te kurti ka kumpanya tenged te mareet ne eg-ul-uleen [eg-ul-ule͡en].

entries.summary: maagsik-agsik; maweil; kaayun pad; nahamit pad wey ke egkahamit; ka eglalahen te pangasak iyan ka eggimu te weil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or animal is active, they move a lot or do a lot.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kaayun pad; nahamit pad wey ke egkahamit

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a bank account is active, someone is using it, or is able to use it.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka eglalahen te pangasak iyan ka eggimu te weil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In grammar, in an active sentence, the subject of the sentence is the one who does the action.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The boy ate the cake ['The boy' is the subject of the sentence, and he is the one who does the action].

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka batè ne lukes migkeen te kik ['ka batè ne lukes' iyan ka eglalahen te pangasak, wey sikandin ka miggimu te weil].

entries.summary: himuwen

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There were many interesting activities at the fiesta, including a basketball competition and concert.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was a lot of activity in the next house, with many people arriving and leaving.

entries.summary: etew ne bahani ne eg-uyan te salida wey ke me galawen; aktur

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: etew ne bahani ne eg-uyan te salida wey ke me galawen; aktur

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who performs in dramas such as movies or plays.

entries.summary: malitan ne eg-uyan te me drama iling te salida wey ke galew

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: malitan ne eg-uyan te me drama iling te salida wey ke galew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a female who performs in dramas such as movies or plays. Many people use the word 'actor' to talk about both males and females.

entries.summary: malehet ne egkakita; malehet wey eleg

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use actual to say clearly that something is the real thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That part is the actual centre of the flower.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sika ne baad ka malehet ne taliwarè te bulak.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I've seen models, but not the actual thing.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use actually to say that something is true and correct.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Wow! She actually forgot her own name!

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Tuwey! Malehet ne nalingawan din ka ngaran din!

entries.summary: amana ne sesakiti wey ke dereeti; ka due mateling se pannalinga, wey malayag se panengteng, matagsèb, egpakarineg, egpakakita wey egpakasabut amana; Te matimatiks ka seini ne lalag deisek dè te siyew ne pulù ne egngaranan te tatelu se galang ne minsan nekey; nasiku

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: amana ne sesakiti wey ke dereeti

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a problem is acute, it is very strong and bad.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He suddenly felt an acute pain in his leg.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka due mateling se pannalinga, wey malayag se panengteng, matagsèb, egpakarineg, egpakakita wey egpakasabut amana

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or animal has acute hearing, eyesight or understanding, they can hear, see or understand very well.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Te matimatiks ka seini ne lalag deisek dè te siyew ne pulù ne egngaranan te tatelu se galang ne minsan nekey; nasiku

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In mathematics, an acute angle is less than 90 degrees.

entries.summary: eglayam; egbalbalawan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you adapt to a new situation, you change to fit that situation.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you go to the city, you need to adapt to the new environment.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke eggendiyè ka te siyudad, keilangan ne egpalayam ka te iyam ne palibut.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you adapt something, you change it so that it can be used in a new way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He adapted the house so that his grandmother could stay with them.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbalbalawan din ka baley rin eyew ka apù din ne malitan egpekeugpè diyè te kandan.

entries.summary: pegpalayam; pegbalew-balew; pegpalayam; pegbalew-balew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of changing yourself to become comfortable in a new place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Adaptation to a new place is sometimes difficult.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a change that you make to yourself or something else (make_an_adaptation).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He made some adaptations to the house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggimu sikandin te me pegbalew-balew diyè te baley.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He needed to make some adaptations to his lifestyle when he moved to the city.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: libru wey ke sinulat dengan ne me guhuren wey ke teted-emen ne mig-ilingan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a play or movie which comes from a book or play written at an earlier time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The movie fi:Romeo_and_Juliet is an adaptation of Shakespeare's play.

entries.summary: egtimul; egpegtimul; egtimul te pangasak

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you add something to another thing, you put with or in that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They added some more subjects to the course.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you add two numbers, you join them together to make one larger number.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you add two and five, you get seven.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you add something when you speak, you say something more.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: "I'm tired," she said. "I'm hungry too," she added.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She said that she was tired, and added that she was hungry too.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The addition of a little salt to food helps the taste.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which you add to another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Biku is a nice addition to any meal.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My brother joined us on the trip, and he was a great addition to our group.

entries.summary: ugpaan; egtahuan te egpeendiyaan [egpe͡endiyaan] ka imbilup; nenekegsinsinundul ne me litra ne igpanahù eyew te pegpamitew te wibsayit diyè te Intirnit

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the number, street name and area name of the place where you live.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can't visit them because I don't know their address.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena a egpekeendiyè [egpeke͡ediyè] te kandan su warè ku nataheyi ka ugpaan dan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you address an envelope or parcel, you write the address of the person you are sending it to.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She addressed the envelope, and put a stamp on it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtahuan din te egpeendiyaan [migpe͡endiyaan] ka imbilup, wey mig-istampaan [mig-istampa͡an]

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nenekegsinsinundul ne me litra ne igpanahù eyew te pegpamitew te wibsayit diyè te Intirnit

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The address of a website on the Internet is the sequence of letters which you need to type to find the website on the internet.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you address someone, you speak to them

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She turned and addressed me. 'What do you think?'.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbagkeleng sikandin wey mig-insè keddì. 'Nekey ka suman-suman nu?'.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: maheteng ne pangasak diyè te grupu te me etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a formal speech to a group of people (give_an_address).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The principal gave an address at the public meeting.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka prinsipal migbehey te pangasak eyew te peg-elit-elit diyè te miting.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you address a problem, you try to fix it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We need to address the problem of the lack of water.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ne eggeraman ney eggusaya ka prublima te kakulangen te weyig.

entries.summary: eleg; pegkeeleg

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is adequate, it is what is needed, but is not more or better than that.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The rice is adquate for ten people, but not for fifteen.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eleg te sapulù ne etew ka behas, piru kenad te me sapulù ne etawan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His work is not excellent, but it is adequate.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that something is adequate.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm not sure about the adequacy of this food for so many people.

entries.summary: Ka seini ne lalag egbehey te duma pad ne kanengnengan diyè te ngaran wey ke igsubal te ngaran.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Ka seini ne lalag egbehey te duma pad ne kanengnengan diyè te ngaran wey ke igsubal te ngaran.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a word which gives extra information about a noun or pronoun (e.g. green, bad, broken)

entries.summary: egsanggelen ka miting (wey malasi ne igpabulus impus te deisek ne timpu); eg-epusen wey ke egtamanen ka miting

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egsanggelen ka miting (wey malasi ne igpabulus impus te deisek ne timpu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a meeting or group adjourns, they end their meeting (often they plan to continue at a later time).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-epusen wey ke egtamanen ka miting

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people adjourn a meeting, they end it.

entries.summary: egbalbalawan wey ke egdensihen te deisek; egbalew-balew te nabatasan; 1 pegbalbalawan wey ke pegdensig te deisek; 2 pegbalew-balew te nabatasan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbalbalawan wey ke egdensihen te deisek

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you adjust something, you change or move it a little.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you lose weight, you will need to adjust your clothes so that they will fit you.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke egdeisek ka kabehat nu, keilangan ne egbalbalawan nu ka kaluag te kumbalè nu eyew eg-eleg keykew.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He adjusted the position of the chair so that it was easier to see the TV.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbalbalawan din ka pegkatahù te me bangku eyew malemu rè ne egkakita ka tibi.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The radio was too loud, so they adjusted the volume.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you adjust to a new situation, you change yourself and become accustomed to the new situation.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you go abroad, you will need to adjust to the new culture.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke diyè ka te lein ne inged, keilangan ne egbalew-balew ka te iyam ne pegbebatasan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegbalbalawan wey ke pegdensig te deisek; 2 pegbalew-balew te nabatasan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of adjusting, or a change (make_an_adjustment to something).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He works in a tailoring shop, and most of their work is adjustment of clothes.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Adjustment to a new diet can take some time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He needed to make some adjustments to the machine, because it didn't work properly.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He had to make a lot of adjustments to his lifestyle when he moved to the city.

entries.summary: eg-uyan; egdumalè; egpangulu; egpakeen wey egpeinum te bawì

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you administer something such as an organization or institution, you manage and organize it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka labew te iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an] ney iyan egdumalè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you administer medicine to someone, you cause them to take the medicine.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She administered medicine to the child.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impeinum sikandin te tambal te batè.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The doctor administered oxygen to the unconscious man.

entries.summary: peg-uyan; pegdumalè; pegpangulu; me etew ne due katenged te grupu (iling te me Barangay kagawad); gubirnu te nasud

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of mananging and organizing something such as an organization.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The Barangay Hall is the place for administration of our area.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka Baley ne Barangay iyan eg-ugpaan te me kagawad te pegdumalè te kanami ne inged.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me etew ne due katenged te grupu (iling te me Barangay kagawad)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the group of people who manage and control an organization or institution.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Many things changed during that president's administration.

entries.summary: peg-addat wey ke pegbassa; pegtengteng wey pegsuman-suman ne meupiya ka minsan nekey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegtengteng wey pegsuman-suman ne meupiya ka minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of looking at something and thinking that it is very good.

entries.summary: eg-addat; egbassa; egtengtengan wey egsuman-suman ne meupiya ka minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you admire someone, you respect them because you think they are very good.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I admire him because he is very brave.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eg-addat a kandin su amana ne mabulut sikandin.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egtengtengan wey egsuman-suman ne meupiya ka minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you admire something, you look at it and think that it is very good.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We sat and admired the beautiful view from the hill.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migmaminnuu ki wey migtengteng te keupiya te bubungan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was just admiring your shirt; where did you buy it?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtengteng e rè te kumbalè nu, hendei nu beliya sika?

entries.summary: peg-angken; pegpaseled; pegdawat; bayad eyew te pegseled

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of saying that something bad is true, even though you don't want to say it (make_an_admission).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Everyone was surprised by his admission that he had taken the money.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka tagsè sabeka natekkew te peg-angken din ne sikandin ka migkuwa te seleppì.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of allowing someone to enter a place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We can't enter that place, because the sign says 'No Admission'.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ki egpakaseled te sika ne lugar, su ka palinneu migkahi te 'kenè egpaseled'.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the amount of money which you pay to enter a place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We work at the cinema, so we don't have to pay admission for movies.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtrabahu ki te sinima, sika ka kenè kid keilangan ne egbayad pad te pegseled ta eyew te pegtengteng te salida.

entries.summary: eg-angken; eg-angkenen; egpaseled; egdawaten diyè te uspital eyew egkabawian

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you admit that something bad is true, you say that it is true, even though you don't want to. If you admit to doing something bad, you say that you did it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We admit to stealing the money.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eg-angkenen ney ne intakew ney ka seleppi.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If the people at a place admit someone, they allow them to enter that place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The hotel would not admit me, as I didn't have shoes.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka baley warè migpaseled keddì su warè sepatus ku.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egdawaten diyè te uspital eyew egkabawian

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a hospital admits someone, they accept the person into the hospital to receive treatment.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She was admitted to hospital with a broken leg.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Narawat sikandin diyè te uspital su nahepù ka paa rin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The hospital admitted thirty patients at the weekend.

entries.summary: egtanggu te lein ne anak te etew; eg-adap; eggamit wey ke egdawat (panunggilingan te pamaahi wey duma pad); 1 pegpananggu te anak te lein ne etew; 2 pegdawat wey ke peggamit

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egtanggu te lein ne anak te etew; eg-adap

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you adopt a child who is not your own child, you become the legal parent of that child.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My parents adopted an orphan, so now I have new brother.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ginikanan ku mig-adap te ilu ne batè, su kuntee duen e iyam ne suled ku.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggamit wey ke egdawat (panunggilingan te pamaahi wey duma pad)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you adopt something such as an idea or habit, you start to have that idea or do that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Many people have adopted the new methods of farming.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Masalig ne me etew ne migdawat te iyam ne pamaahi te pegbasuk.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegpananggu te anak te lein ne etew; 2 pegdawat wey ke peggamit

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of adopting someone or something.

entries.summary: kenad e ne batè wey ke egkankanakan; mananap wey ke pinamula ne kenad egtulin wey egdakel

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenad e ne batè wey ke egkankanakan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who is no longer a child or young teenager. In the law, an adult is 18 years or older.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mananap wey ke pinamula ne kenad egtulin wey egdakel

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an animal or plant that has finished growing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There were three adult birds and two babies.

entries.summary: eggendiyè te kewun-aan [kewun-a͡an]; peggendiyè te kewun-aan [kewun-a͡an]; egkeyimu ne amana kad egkateu ne eggimu te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something advances, they move forward.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The men advanced slowly towards the fire.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me etew migpahanad-ganad miggendiyè te due hapuy.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The men used water to stop the advance of the fire.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me etew miggamit te weyig eyew te peg-ebuk te pegbulus te hapuy.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We've built earth banks to stop the advance of the floodwaters.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkeyimu ne amana kad egkateu ne eggimu te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you advance in what you are doing, you become better at doing that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He practices the guitar every day, so he is advancing fast.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Layun egbebasbas sikandin te gitar tagsè aldew, sika ka meiyal nateu sikandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something advances, it becomes better or stronger.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Technology has advanced a lot in the last 20 years.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action of becoming better or stronger (make_an_advance).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There have been many advances in technology in the last 20 years.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you advance a project or idea, you help it and make it more successful.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has worked hard to advance our organization.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miglasey-lasey migtrabahu sikandin te pegpameupiya te grupu ney.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you advance a person some money, you give the money to them earlier than the due date.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ahalen ku migpewun-a keddì te seleppì ne sabekan libu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an amount of money that is given earlier than the due date.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My boss gave me an advance of 1000 pesos.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakarawat a te pewun-a ne sabekan libu puun te ahalen ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you do something in_advance, you do it early, before another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was ready for the visitors, because they told me in advance that they were coming.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Andam ad para te me mahaliyug, su migpewun-a-hun-a sikandan migkahi keddì.

entries.summary: nakameupiya; egpakameupiya; mabulig

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which helps a person or animal do something better than other people or animals.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is very tall, so he is at a big advantage when he plays basketball.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne malangkew sikandin, sika ka nakameupiya te peggahalew rin te baskitbul.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which makes one thing better than another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The advantage of travelling during the day is that you can look at the views.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka egpakameupiya te eggipanew te maaldew sika se egpakapanlangu-langu ka te memeupiya ne egkakita.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: if something is advantageous, it helps you to do something better than other people or animals.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is advantageous for basketball players to be tall.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mabulig te me manggalaway te baskitbul ka matangkawal.

entries.summary: iyam ne nabayaan ne egpakabagget wey iling te dilikadu; amana egkeupian ne etew ne egpakabayè te egmakabagget wey dilikadu ne igsalerep

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: iyam ne nabayaan ne egpakabagget wey iling te dilikadu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an experience which is new and exciting, and maybe dangerous.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Let's climb Mount Apo! It will be a great adventure!

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: amana egkeupian ne etew ne egpakabayè te egmakabagget wey dilikadu ne igsalerep

entries.summary: ka lalag ne egbehey te duma pad ne kanengnengan diyè te pangasak, weil, pahunsiling, wey te kandin degma

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka lalag ne egbehey te duma pad ne kanengnengan diyè te pangasak, weil, pahunsiling, wey te kandin degma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a word which gives extra information about a sentence, verb, adjective or another adverb (e.g., unfortunately, always, very, quickly).

entries.summary: egpataha te minsan nekey eyew egkatahaan [egkataha͡an] te duma pinaahi te radyu, tibi wey duma pad

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpataha te minsan nekey eyew egkatahaan [egkataha͡an] te duma pinaahi te radyu, tibi wey duma pad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or group of people advertise a thing or an event, they use public methods (e.g., the radio) to tell many people about it.

entries.summary: igmataha ne kanengnengan ne eglalahen wey ke egsulaten

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: igmataha ne kanengnengan ne eglalahen wey ke egsulaten

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something spoken, written or recorded to tell many people about a thing or event.

entries.summary: panulù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: words about what you think someone should do (give_advice).

entries.summary: egpanulù te eggimuwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you advise someone to do something, you tell them that they should do it.

entries.summary: peglalag diyè te katangenan te seini ka meupiya ne eggimuwen; pegbulig pinaahi te peglalag; peglalag te talaggukum

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peglalag diyè te katangenan te seini ka meupiya ne eggimuwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of saying publicly that something is a good thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That leader is famous for his advocacy of large families.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sika ne pangulu nabantug te peglalag din te derakel ne pamilya.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of helping a particular group by speaking for them (e.g., speaking to the government or the public).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That NGO [Non-Government Agency] provides advocacy for indigenous groups.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka NGO migbehey te bulig para te me lumad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of an attorney speaking for someone in a court of law.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His attorney's advocacy was very good, and they won the court case.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka peglalag te talaggukum din amana ne meupiya, wey migdeeg sikandan te kasu.

entries.summary: eglalag diyè te katangenan te seini ka meupiya ne eggimuwen; etew ne eglalag diyè te katangenan te meupiya seini ne butang; tigpame-bè

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eglalag diyè te katangenan te seini ka meupiya ne eggimuwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you advocate something, you say publicly that it is a good thing to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That leader advocates the use of tribal languages at elementary school.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: etew ne eglalag diyè te katangenan te meupiya seini ne butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An advocate of something is a person who says publicly that it is a good thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is an advocate of using Manobo languages at school.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sikandin ka miglalag te peggamit te Menubù ne linalahan diyè te iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an].

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An advocate for a particular group is someone who supports them and tries to help them, e.g., by speaking to the government about them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is an advocate for indigenous groups.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sikandin ka tigpame-bè te me lumad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an attorney who speaks for someone in a law court.

entries.summary: minsan nekey ne himu ne egkeyitabù; hinimuwan (meyitenged te pegpangilabet te lein ne malitan); eg-ul-uleen [eg-ul-ule͡en] (meyitenged te pegpangilabet te lein ne lukes)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne himu ne egkeyitabù

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is always talking about other people's affairs.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Layun sikandin eglalag meyitenged te me himuwen te lein ne me etew.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: hinimuwan (meyitenged te pegpangilabet te lein ne malitan); eg-ul-uleen [eg-ul-ule͡en] (meyitenged te pegpangilabet te lein ne lukes)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a sexual relationship with someone who is not your husband or wife (have_an_affair).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The woman was very hurt because her husband had an affair.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana nasakitan ka malitan ne asawa su ka asawa rin due hinimuwan.

entries.summary: egpakabehey te meupiya wey ke mareet ne kapabulusan; egpakaapiktu; egpakasenggil te geyinawa; egkaapiktuwan; eglilibat (te kenè ne malehet ne eggeramen)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakabehey te meupiya wey ke mareet ne kapabulusan; egpakaapiktu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something affects another thing, it produces some result or change in that other thing.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpakaapiktu te himu nu ka pegkabeley.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something affects you, it causes you to feel an emotion, especially sadness.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eglilibat (te kenè ne malehet ne eggeramen)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone affects a particular feeling, they pretend to have that feeling.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She affected interest, but she really didn't care.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eglilibat sikandin te pegkabagget, piru migbalahad din seini.

entries.summary: due marani ne kalabetan; talagduma ne grupu; rilasyun te me etew wey ke grupu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or organzation is_affiliated with another organization, they have a close connection.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That scientist is independent, and is not affiliated with any drug companies.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sika ne sayantis indipindinti, wey kenè ne kuniktadu te minsan hendei ne kumpanya te druga.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an organization that has a close connection with another organization.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That local company is an affiliate of a large multi-national company.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sika ne lukal ne kumpanya talagduma te dakel ne multi-nasyunal ne kumpanya.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: rilasyun te me etew wey ke grupu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a relationship between people or groups.

entries.summary: Seini ka litra wey ke grupu te me litra ne igtimul te lalag eyew egpekeyimu te iyam ne lalag wey ke egbulig te hun-a ne lalag eyew eg-eleg te pangasak.; egsumpul; egpakepkep; egpakapli; pegpakepkep; pegpasumpul; pegpakapli

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Seini ka litra wey ke grupu te me litra ne igtimul te lalag eyew egpekeyimu te iyam ne lalag wey ke egbulig te hun-a ne lalag eyew eg-eleg te pangasak.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a letter or group of letters which are added to a word to make a new word or help the original word to fit in the sentence.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you affix something to another thing, you join it to that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She affixed the letter to the application form with a paper clip.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of affixing something to another thing (e.g., a prefix to a word).

entries.summary: egpakabeli; egpekeutel; egkeyimu su kenè amana ne mabehat, wey kenè ne mareet ka egpangkusan ke eggimuwen nu seini

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you can_afford something, you have enough money to buy it.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkeyimu su kenè amana ne mabehat, wey kenè ne mareet ka egpangkusan ke eggimuwen nu seini

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you can_afford to do something, it means that there will not be serious, bad results if you do it.

entries.summary: egkaaldek [egka͡aldek]; Egkahamit seini ke eglalag te minsan nekey ne iling te mareet.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are afraid of something, you feel fear of that thing.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini ke eglalag te minsan nekey ne iling te mareet.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You say 'I'm afraid' if you are saying something that is bad. The meaning is similar to 'I'm sorry'.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm afraid I can't help you.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Pasaylua a ra kena a egpakabulig keykew.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Tuwey ra kena a egpakabulig keykew.

entries.summary: pegkeimpus te; pegkapenga te; egsinundul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happens after another thing, it happens later than that thing.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpakiglambag a keykew pegkeimpus te klasi.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: After boiling the mixture for 5 minutes, pour it into a bowl.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something moves after someone or something else, they follow that other person or thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I went first, and she walked after me.

entries.summary: maapun [ma͡apun]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the period of time in the day between 12pm and about 5pm.

entries.summary: egkaabey; eg-abey; eglibed; piru (timul ne lalag te newun-a ne inlalag)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happens again, it happens one more time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The clothes fell on the ground, so she had to wash them again.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me pini-pian neneulug te tanè, sika ka keilangan ne pipian din eg-abeyi.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something goes to a place again, they return to that place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She walked to the shop, and then went home again.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggendiyè sikandin te belegyaanan, wey pegkeimpus miglibed sikandin te baley.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I took the book off the table, and then put it back on the table again.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: piru (timul ne lalag te newun-a ne inlalag)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use then_again to add something which is different from what you said before, or which limits what you said.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was surprised at his words, but then again, he always surprised me.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Napetew a te me lalag din, piru layun e rè iya egpetawa nikandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Maybe you will like that food, but then again, maybe you'll hate it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kema ke igkeupii nu ka keenen, piru kema ke kenè nu igkeibeg.

entries.summary: nakaledled; nakasandig; nakaandil; pasinug-ung te; kenè egkeupian; supak

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is against another thing, it is standing beside it and touching it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Put the chairs against the wall, so that we have more space in the room.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ipanledled nu ka me pinnuuwan te alabat, eyew due dakel ne bakanti te sinabeng.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you move against a force (e.g., the wind), you move the opposite way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We walked upstream, against the current.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are against an idea or action, you do not like it or want it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is against the company buying a generator.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè egkeupian sikandin ne egbebeli ka kumpanya te diniritur.

entries.summary: leg-un; tuig; idad; kaluhayan; kabuyahan (meyitenged te pegbunsud te timpu); egkabuyag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The age of a person or thing is the number of months or years that they have existed.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kaluhayan; kabuyahan (meyitenged te pegbunsud te timpu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a long period of time in history.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something ages, they become older.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My grandmother has aged a lot in the past two years, and she is much weaker now.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something ages you, it causes you to feel or look old.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you spend a lot of time in the sun, it will age your skin.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke layun ka egkarampil te aldew, mahaan dè egkabuyag ka lap-lap nu.

entries.summary: me klasiyan te kumpanya ne eggimu te minsan nekey para te etew wey ke lein ne kumpanya; kumpanya ne kuniktadu te gubirnu ne sugpang te dakel ne grupu puun te gubirnu wey ke baad te gubirnu; pegpeyitabù; pegpeyimu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me klasiyan te kumpanya ne eggimu te minsan nekey para te etew wey ke lein ne kumpanya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a company which organizes something for another person or company (e.g., employment agency, travel agency, advertising agency).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kumpanya ne kuniktadu te gubirnu ne sugpang te dakel ne grupu puun te gubirnu wey ke baad te gubirnu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an organization which is connected to the government, or is part of the government (e.g., the PNA—Philippines News Agency).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of causing something to happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This happened independently, without her agency.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Neyitabù seini ne warè pegpangabang din.

entries.summary: etew ne egpangimu te minsan nekey eyew te lein ne etew; minsan nekey ne egpakapeyitabù te minsan nekey; talag-ipat; talagsilib

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: etew ne egpangimu te minsan nekey eyew te lein ne etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who organizes something (e.g., business) for another person.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne egpakapeyitabù te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something (e.g., a chemical) which causes something to happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Salt is the preserving agent in this meat.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a secret agent for his country

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Talag-ipat sikandin diyè te nasud din.

entries.summary: seel te langun puun te pinegtimul; egpegtimul te karakelan; punduk te me etew wey ke kasangkapan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: seel te langun puun te pinegtimul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an amount which is made of smaller amounts added together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The aggregate of the 5 scores was 205.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seel te lalimman intimul su daruwan gatus wey lalimma.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you aggregate amounts, you add them together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They aggregated the scores from the 5 games.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impegtimul ran ka nakuwa puun te lalimma ne galew.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: punduk te me etew wey ke kasangkapan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of people or things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our team is an aggregate of different kinds of people.

entries.summary: ka miglihad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happened a certain time ago, that is how long it before now it happened.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I came here two years ago.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migginguma a kayi me sapulù e ne tuig ka miglihad.

entries.summary: egkabennalan; nekegsinabut; nasabeka se suman-suman; nekeg-uyun; egpekegbennaley; egkasabeka ka suman-suman; egpekegsinabut; egpekeg-uyun; egparuma-ruma; egpalintutuu; eg-uyun; egpekeg-iling

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkabennalan; nekegsinabut; nasabeka se suman-suman; nekeg-uyun; egpekegbennaley; egkasabeka ka suman-suman; egpekegsinabut; egpekeg-uyun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you agree with someone, you both have the same thinking about something.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you agree to do something, you say that you will do it when someone asks you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She asked me for help, and I agreed to help her.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpabulig sikandin keddì, wey migpalintutuu a ne egbulig kandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two things agree with each other, they fit together or are similar.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I believe them, because his story agrees with hers.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I believe them, because their stories agree.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You can't say 'He want', because the pronoun and the verb don't agree.

entries.summary: maparuma-ruma; egparuma-ruma; egpalintutuu; eg-uyun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An agreeable person or thing is nice and easy to like.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are agreeable to something, you are willing to accept or do that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I asked if I could live with them, and they were agreeable to that.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migkahi a te eg-ugpa a diyè te kandan, wey mig-uyun sikandan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: not nice and easy to like.

entries.summary: kasabutan (puun te nekegbennaley wey nekeglalag); pegkasabeka te suman-suman; nekeg-iling

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a particular thing which people or groups have decided about together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We've talked with each other, and so we have an agreement.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekeglalag key kandin, sika ka duen e kasabutan ney.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They talked for a long time until they reached an agreement.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Naluhey sikandan ne impeglalahey taman te nekegbennaley sikandan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If there is agreement between people, or people are in agreement, they have the same thinking about something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My parents are in agreement that I should always get home before dark.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If there is agreement between two things, or two things are in agreement, they fit together or are similar.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I believe them, because their stories of what happened are in agreement.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpalintutuu a kandan, su ka guhuren dan ke nekey ka neyitabù nekeg-iling.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is agreement between their stories, so I believe them.

entries.summary: himu te pegpatubù te pinamula, peg-eayam wey pegkekamet; due kalabetan te pegpamula wey pegkekamet

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: himu te pegpatubù te pinamula, peg-eayam wey pegkekamet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the work of growing crops or raising animals. It is also called farming.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due kalabetan te pegpamula wey pegkekamet

entries.summary: kewun-aan [kewun-a͡an]; seup; egpewun-a-hun-a

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is ahead of another thing, it is in front of that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is pothole in the road ahead, so slow down.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due lungag te kelesadda due te kewun-aan [kewun-a͡an], sika naa pahanad-ganad kew ka egtupang.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an event or time period is ahead, it is in the future from now.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The week ahead will be busy, as I have exams.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Masalig ka eggimuwen ku te seup ne simana, su due iksam ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happens ahead of another thing, it happens before it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Don't forget to practice ahead of the big game.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ka kalingew ne egpewun-a-hun-a egbebasbas para te egginguma ne dakel ne kahalawan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Try to arrive thirty minutes ahead of the starting time, so that you can help prepare the equipment.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is ahead of another person in something, they are doing that thing better or more quickly than the other person.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is ahead of her classmates in her test results.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Labew ka tis ne naangey rin du te me duma rin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something moves ahead, they go in the direction that they are facing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Go straight ahead, and don't turn left or right.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Pabulus-bulus ke rè, wey kenè ka suwey te kawanan wey ke

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something moves ahead, they progress in what they are doing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The project is moving ahead, and it should be finished by July.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Pabulus e ka pruyiktu, wey egkeimpusan e seini te me Hulyu.

entries.summary: egbulig; egpakabulig; bulig; bulig ne seleppì

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something aids you, they help you.

fields.label: English example
