fields.text: The old man walked slowly, aided by his son.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The old man walks with the aid of a stick.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I fell down, but nobody came to my aid.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the money which a group or country gives to help another group or country.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: After the typhoon we received aid from many countries.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impus te bagiyu nakarawat key te bulig ne seleppì puun te lein-lein ne nasud.

entries.summary: egdantey; eggisuhaten; katuenan te pegdegpak te peggisuhat te minsan nekey ne eggisuhaten

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you aim something (e.g., a gun) at an object, you move that thing so that you can shoot or throw it and hit the object.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The soldier aimed the gun at the window.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sundalu migdantey te sinapang diyè te bintanà.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: When you shoot or throw something, if you aim at a particular object, that is the object which you want to hit.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: katuenan te pegdegpak te peggisuhat te minsan nekey ne eggisuhaten

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your aim is your ability to throw or shoot something and hit a target.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The bright sun affected my aim, so I couldn't get the basketball in the hoop.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has very bad aim, and can never get the basketball in the hoop.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you aim to do something, you want and plan to do that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We aim to finish this project by the end of April.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egsumsumanen ney ne eg-impusan seini ne himuwen te me keepusan te Abril.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The aim of a person or group is the thing which they want and plan to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our aim is to win the competition.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka igkeupii ney ne egdeeg key te kuntis.

entries.summary: kalamag; aw-awangan; kalamag; ka egkakita wey egkaheram ta diyè te senge etew (meyitenged te geramen wey batasan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the mixture of gases that make the earth's atmosphere.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: All mammals need air to breathe.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is in the air, it is not on the ground.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The bird is flying in the air.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka egkakita wey egkaheram ta diyè te senge etew (meyitenged te geramen wey batasan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone has an air of something (e.g., sadness), they look like they have that feeling or characteristic.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She always has an air of boredom when she talks to people.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you air something made of cloth, you hang it on a line outside. If you air a room, you open the windows so that the air can come in.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Those blankets smell damp, so we need to air them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Open those windows. This room needs airing.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you air something that you think, you tell it to other people.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He never misses a chance to air his political views.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egparineg wey ke egpakita te prugrama; egpanengneng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a radio or television company airs their programs, they send (broadcast) them for people to listen to or watch.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Last night RADIO UKAY STATION aired an interview with the President.

entries.summary: sistima te pegpaalap te sulat ne pinaahi te eriplanu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sistima te pegpaalap te sulat ne pinaahi te eriplanu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the system of sending letters, parcels etc by plane.

entries.summary: eriplanu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a flying vehicle with non-moving wings and one or more engines.

entries.summary: bayaanan diyè te taliwarè te lingya te me pinnuuwan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: bayaanan diyè te taliwarè te lingya te me pinnuuwan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a path between rows of seats (e.g., in church) or shelves (e.g., in a grocery store).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There were no more empty seats on the bus, so I sat in the aisle.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warad egkapinnuuwan te batsilur, sika ka migpinnuu e naan dè diyè te bayaanan te taliwarè.

entries.summary: sahuhunè ne eggeramen ne liyas tenged su dilikadu; egpataha; egpangilam; egpakahuhud; dahing te pegpanengneng te due mareet

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sahuhunè ne eggeramen ne liyas tenged su dilikadu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a sudden feeling of fear because of danger.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something alarms you, it makes you feel suddenly very afraid or worried.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: dahing te pegpanengneng te due mareet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a sound which tells people that there is danger.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I woke up late because I didn't hear the alarm this morning.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Namewuri a ne miggimata su warè ku narineg ka dahing te pegpanengneng te seini ne maselem.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: parahingen eyew te pegpanengneng te due dilikadu iling te egkasilaban wey ke duma pad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a thing which produces a noise to tell people that there is danger, or to wake someone up.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She was smoking inside the building, and it caused the fire alarm to sound.

entries.summary: warè batek ne weyig ne mahaan egdakep te hapuy. Eggamiten seini ne eg-inumen wey igpanlinis te duma ne kasangkapan wey minsan diyè te lawa.; inumen ne due sewug ne egpakatabeleg

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: warè batek ne weyig ne mahaan egdakep te hapuy. Eggamiten seini ne eg-inumen wey igpanlinis te duma ne kasangkapan wey minsan diyè te lawa.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a colorless liquid which can catch fire easily. It is used in liquids such as drinks and cleaning products, and can also be used on the body.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: inumen ne due sewug ne egpakatabeleg

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: drinks such as beer or rum, which contain the chemical alcohol (sense 1).

entries.summary: egpakatabeleg (meyitenged te inumen); etew ne neuripen e te inumen ne egpakatabeleg

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: etew ne neuripen e te inumen ne egpakatabeleg

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who is addicted to alcohol, so they need to drink it often.

entries.summary: sengekuan; kenè ne mahinged (te nasud); umul ne kenè ne ligkat te kalibutan ta

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is alien, it is strange and different.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The lifestyle of the city is alien to me, as I have always lived in the mountains.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sistima te umul diyè te siyudad sengekuan kayi te keddì, ne layun a eg-ugpè diyè te katalunan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who lives in one country, but is a citizen of another country.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you are an alien in some countries, you are not allowed to buy land.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke kenè ka ne mahinged diyè te lein ne nasud, kenè ka egkaayun ne egbebeli te tanè.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: umul ne kenè ne ligkat te kalibutan ta

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a living thing in the universe which is not from Earth.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Some people believe that there are aliens living on other planets.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka duma ne etew migpalintutuu ne due umul te minsan nekey ne egkekeuyag diyè te lein ne planita.

entries.summary: egkalegleg

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is alight, it is burning, or there is light coming from it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The wall is alight! Bring some water quickly, or the house will burn down.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka alabat egkalegleg! Uyan kew mahaan te weyig, su kema ke egkasilaban ka baley.

entries.summary: egpekegsinsinundul; nenekeglenged; egpegsinundul; egpeglenged; egpanahù te me lalag te tineil ne pegkatahù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two or more things align with each other, they are in a particular position with relation to each other (especially in a straight line).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you stand just here and look at the mountains, all the mountains align with each other to make a straight line.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke egsasindeg ka kayi wey egtengteng te me bubungan, langun ne bubungan nenekegsinsinundul ne nalingya.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you align two things, you cause them to be in a particular position with relation to one another.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpanahù te me lalag te tineil ne pegkatahù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you align words on a page, you put them in a particular position (left, right, centred).

entries.summary: pegpekegsinsinundul; pegpekeglenged-lenged; pegkatapid-tapid; pegkalinya-linya; pegkalenged-lenged (meyitenged te me lalag wey ke litratu ne nakatahù)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The alignment of two or more things is their position in relation to one another.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is difficult to ride this bike, because the two wheels are not in exact alignment.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegkatapid-tapid; pegkalinya-linya; pegkalenged-lenged (meyitenged te me lalag wey ke litratu ne nakatahù)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The alignment of writing or pictures on a printed page is the position on the page (e.g., left, right, centred).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You need to change the alignment of that paragraph, because it is not the same as the other paragraphs.

entries.summary: nekeg-iling

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two or more things are alike, they are similar.

entries.summary: neuyag pad (meyitenged te warè pad napatey wey ke nahangu)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: neuyag pad (meyitenged te warè pad napatey wey ke nahangu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person, animal or plant is alive, it continues to do the things which living things do (e.g., use energy, move).

entries.summary: langun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use all to talk about 100% of something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: All of my brothers can sing.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Langun ne me suled ku egkateu ne eg-ulahing.

entries.summary: eglalag ke hentew ka egbehayan; egtahahè te minsan nekey diyè te igkeupii; 1 pegbehey te egbehayan; 2 pegtahahè te minsan nekey diyè te igkeupii

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you allocate something to someone, you say that they are the one who will receive it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They allocated 5 kilograms of rice to each family.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miglalag sikandan te egbehayan te tiglalimma ne kilu ne behas ka tagsè pamilya.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egtahahè te minsan nekey diyè te igkeupii

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you allocate something for a particular purpose, you say that it will be used for that purpose.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They allocated 200 pesos for buying snacks.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtahahè sikandan te daruwan gatus eyew igbeli te egkakeen-keen.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegbehey te egbehayan; 2 pegtahahè te minsan nekey diyè te igkeupii

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The allocation of money was not equal: she received a lot, and he received a little.

entries.summary: egtuhut; egsugut; egtuhutan; egkaayun; egbehey te timpu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you allow someone to do something, you say that they can do it, and don't stop them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father doesn't allow me to ride his motorbike.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka amey ku kenè egtuhut ne eg-untud a te mutur din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are_allowed to do something, somebody has said that you can do it, and nobody is stopping you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I am not allowed to ride my father's motorbike.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena a egtuhutan ne eg-untud te mutur te amey ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or situation allows something to happen, they make it able to happen and do not stop it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She moved her chair to allow the man to pass.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggenat te malitan ka bangku din eyew egpakabayè ka lukes.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The fine weather allowed me to fix the roof.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you allow that something is true, you agree that it is true even though you don't want to.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I allow that it was wrong of me to do that.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eg-angkenen ku ne naseyyup a te peggimu ku due.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbehey te timpu wey ke seleppì

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you allow a certain amount of time or money for something, you plan to spend that amount of time or money.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You should allow three weeks for your application to be processed.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm late because I didn't allow for the traffic.

entries.summary: pegsabut te pegbebatasan; intahahè ne seleppì

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you make an allowance for someone, you do not expect them to behave or achieve the same as other people, because they have some problem.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Teachers need to make allowances for students who have learning problems.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me talagpanulù keilangan ne egbehey te pegsabut diyè te me istudyanti ne due prublima te pegsabut.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: money which someone receives regularly from a person or group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My company gives me an allowance of 1000 pesos a month for gas, because I need to travel a lot for my job.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Intahahaan a te kumpanya te sabeka ne libu ne seleppì te tagsè bulan eyew te gasulina ku, su keilangan a ne eggiphipanew te trabahu ku.

entries.summary: deisek naan dè iya; hapit

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use almost to say that something is close to happening, or close to 100% the case.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I am almost finished, I just need five more minutes.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Deisek naan dè iya ne egpekeimpus ad, egkeilangan e naan dè te me lalimma ne minutus.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I almost forgot my umbrella, but I remembered just before I left the house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Deisek naan dè iya ne egkalingawan kud ka payung ku, piru nasuman-suman ku seini te warè e pad mig-awè te baley.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He's four, so he's almost old enough to go to school.

entries.summary: sabsabeka; dè; rè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are alone, there is nobody with you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I like being alone so that I can think.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian a ne egsabsabeka eyew egpakasuman-suman a.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use alone to say clearly that nothing or nobody else is included, and you are only talking about one particular person or thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He said that he loved her alone, and nobody else.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migkahi sikandin ne egkeupian din ne egsabsabeka rè, wey warè durumeen [durume͡en].

entries.summary: bayè; ilis te; eggendiyè te nateil ne pabulusan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something moves along a path or line, they move with the path or line for some time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They walked along the road to the school.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggipanew sikandin bayè te kelesadda peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an].

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is along a path or line, it is on part or all of that path or line.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are many houses along the river.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due masalig ne me baley ilis te pahamayan ne weyig.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something moves along, they move in a particular direction.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We walked along, talking about many topics.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggendiyè key migpabulus, ne migpalallalahey te masalig ne guhuren.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you come or go along with other people, you come or go together with those people.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We're going to Davao. Do you want to come along?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eggendiyè key te Dabaw. Egkeupian ka ne egduma-ruma?

entries.summary: marahing ne peglalag wey ke pegbasa

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: marahing ne peglalag wey ke pegbasa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you say or read something aloud, people can hear you (you are not speaking or reading silently to yourself).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She read the story aloud to the children.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Imbasa rin ka guhuren te marahing diyè te me batè.

entries.summary: nenekegsinsinundul ne grupu te me litra ne eggamiten te pegsulat te nateil ne linalahan wey ke grupu te me linalahan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nenekegsinsinundul ne grupu te me litra ne eggamiten te pegsulat te nateil ne linalahan wey ke grupu te me linalahan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the ordered group of letters which are used for writing a particular language or group of languages.

entries.summary: e (meyitenged te neimpus wey ke neyitabù)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: e (meyitenged te neimpus wey ke neyitabù)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something has already happened, it happened before now. Sometimes you are surprised that it happened so early.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's only 2pm and you've already finished your work!

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Alas dus pad seini wey nekeimpus kad e te himu nu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Sorry, he's not here, because he's already gone to his farm.

entries.summary: ded maa; red maa; red degma; red man-e; degma

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ded maa; red maa; red degma; red man-e

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use also to add something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I lost my keys, and I also lost my cell phone.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Natarin ku ka yabi ku, wey natarin ku red man-e ka silpun ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use also to say that something is true of another person or thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She likes cooking and her brother also likes it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian sikandin ne egsusubba, wey ka suled din degma iling ded.

entries.summary: altar (ne eg-unturan te egtutungen); altar

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a structure where people do religious activities including sacrificing animals.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In some churches, the table which is used for communion (also called Mass, or the Eucharist) is called the altar.

entries.summary: egbalbalawan; egkabalbalawan; 1 pegbalew-balew; 2 pegkabalew-balew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you alter something, you change it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They altered their plans because of the bad weather.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The shirt was too big, so he altered it with the sewing machine.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The town has altered a lot since I was a child.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Dakel ka nabalbalawan te inged ligkat te batè e pad.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They made some big alterations to the house.

entries.summary: egpasel-atey; egkasel-at; egpaselsel-atey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two people or things alternate with one another, they do something in turn (the first one does something, then the second one, then the first again...).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I am sick, and I alternate between feeling hot and feeling cold.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egderalu a, egkasel-at ka eggeramen ku te egmeinit wey egmaagsil [egma͡agsil].

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use alternate to talk about two things which happen in turn.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She and I cook on alternate days. She cooked yesterday, so I need to cook today.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sikandin wey sikeddì egpaselsel-atey ka egsusubba te tagsè aldew. Gabii sikandin, sika ka kuntee sikeddiey e degma.

entries.summary: alamanan; minsan nekey ne lein ne egkaalaman nu ke kenè ka te sabeka; Senge lein seini te nalayaman e ne batasan wey pamaahi (malasi seini diyè te kineiyahan wey kenè amana te seleppì).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you can choose out of two or more things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When you buy sugar , there are two alternatives: white and brown.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke egbebeli ka te asukal, due daruwa ne alamanan: maangkag wey malalab.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne lein ne egkaalaman nu ke kenè ka te sabeka

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An alternative thing is something that you can choose if you don't choose another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If there are no motorbikes at the crossing, you'll need to find alternative transport.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke warè me mutur diyè te krusing, keilangan ne egpamitew ka te lein ne unturanan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Senge lein seini te nalayaman e ne batasan wey pamaahi (malasi seini diyè te kineiyahan wey kenè amana te seleppì).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something alternative is different from the usual or traditional ways. It usually has more focus on nature and less focus on money and 'western' science (e.g., alternative music, alternative medicine).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In alternative medicine, herbs and plants are used more than chemical drugs.

entries.summary: minsan; piru

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use although to say that one fact is not changed or affected by another fact.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father is working in the field although it's raining.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka amey ku migtrabahu te kamet minsan eg-uran.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He hated fish, although he never told his hosts that.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeepes sikandin te peit, piru warè mignangen sikandin te egdumalè.

entries.summary: kalayatan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The altitude of a place or flying thing (e.g., an airplane) is how high it is above sea level.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our town is at a high altitude, so it's cooler.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka lungsud ta diyè te matikang ne kalayatan, sika ka maagsil [mag:sil].

entries.summary: en iya; langun-langun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use altogether to talk about something that is 100% the case.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She forgot altogether to go to the shop.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nalingawan din en iya ne eggendiyè te tindaan [tinda͡an].

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use altogether to talk about the total amount

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegkeen migkentidad te tatelu ne gatus langun-langun.

entries.summary: layun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something always happens, it happens every time, or it is true all the time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Whenever I ride the bus, I always feel sick.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke eg-untud te terak, layun a egderalu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: present tense of be (first person singular)

entries.summary: impurtanti ne etew ne iyan tigpame-bè te kandin ne inged diyè te duma ne inged

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: impurtanti ne etew ne iyan tigpame-bè te kandin ne inged diyè te duma ne inged

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an important government worker who represents their own country in another country.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The Australian ambassador to the Philippines had a meeting with the President of the Philippines.

entries.summary: kenè ne mating-ew ka igpasabut; warè kating-awan te igpasabut

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is ambiguous, the meaning is not clear.

entries.summary: igkeupii ne eg-angayen diyè te umul; igkeupii ne due kalampusan, geem [ge͡em] wey ke seleppì

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: igkeupii ne eg-angayen diyè te umul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that a person wants to do in their life.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My ambition is to become a teacher.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: igkeupii ne due kalampusan, geem [ge͡em] wey ke seleppì

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the desire to have success, power or money.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That politician's ambition caused him to become corrupt.

entries.summary: mapangpanganduy; dakel wey malised ne eg-angayen ne planu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An ambitious person wants to have success, power or money.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He's very ambitious, and wants to become CEO of our company.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: dakel wey malised ne eg-angayen ne planu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a plan is ambitious, it is big and will be difficult to achieve.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Your idea of starting a new company is very ambitious.

entries.summary: egbalbalawan; pegbalew-balew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you amend something such as a document or law, you change it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They amended the rules so that younger children could join.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbalbalawan dan ka balaud eyew ka me batè egpakaapil.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a change to something such as a law (make_an_amendment to something).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They made some important amendments to the club rules.

entries.summary: duma te; te (diyè te grupu); te tagsè sabeka kandan (due tatelu wey ke masulug ne etew)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are among a group of people or things, you are in the group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is standing over there, among the children.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migsasindeg sikandin seeyè, duma te me batè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happens among a group of people, it happens in that group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was a lot of discussion among the leaders.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due dakel ne egpangguhuren te me pangulu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: te tagsè sabeka kandan (due tatelu wey ke masulug ne etew)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you divide something among three or more people, you give part of it to each person.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They divided the rice among themselves.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbaad-baad dan ka behas te tagsè sabeka kandan.

entries.summary: karakelan wey ke kabehat; egginguma te

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The amount of something is how much there is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a large amount of rice in the sack, so I can't lift it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a quantity amounts to a certain number or figure, that is how many there are or how much there is.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seleppì migginguma te hen-em ne pulu ne pisus.

entries.summary: egkangisiyan; egpakatuen; kangisiyan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something amuses you, you think it is funny.

entries.summary: pegkatuen; pegpakangisi; pegkabayat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling that something is funny.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He couldn't hide his amusement when he read his son's story.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè din igkeeles [igke͡eles] ka pegkatuen te nabasa rin e ka guhuren te me anak din ne lukes.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something (e.g., a roller-coaster) which people ride, use or do to have fun.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Cities usually have more amusements than country areas.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Masalig ka kaliwangan diyè te siyudad du te diyè te kenè pad ne siyudad ne inged.

entries.summary: ka (ka seini egkahamit ke iyan egsinundul ka me litra ne Aa, Ee, Ii, Oo, Uu. Panunggilingan 'an egg')

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka (ka seini egkahamit ke iyan egsinundul ka me litra ne Aa, Ee, Ii, Oo, Uu. Panunggilingan 'an egg')

entries.summary: pegtimbang-timbang; pegnengneng; pegpitew; natahaan [nataha͡an]; nanengnengan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of looking at something carefully so that you can know what is in it, or what it means.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The doctor did an analysis of the sick man's blood.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your analysis of something is what you understand about it after you have looked at it carefully.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I agree with your analysis of the problem.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpalintutuu a te nanengnengan nu te prublima.

entries.summary: egtimbang-timbang; egnengneng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you analyze something, you look at it carefully so that you can know what is in it, or what it means.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We analyzed the story in our English class.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Intimbang-timbang ney ka guhuren te Inglis ne klasi ney.

entries.summary: ka pegnengneng wey pegpangingaran te me baad te me pinamula wey te me mananap; ka peg-iskuyla te langun-langun ne baad te me pinamula wey te me mananap

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka pegnengneng wey pegpangingaran te me baad te me pinamula wey te me mananap

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The anatomy of an animal or plant is the structure of its body.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka peg-iskuyla te langun-langun ne baad te me pinamula wey te me mananap

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the study of the structure of animals and plants.

entries.summary: kabuybuyahan; kaap-apuan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: someone who lived before you and is part of your family line (e.g., a grandparent or great grandparent).

entries.summary: derengani (meyitenged te kaluhayan te timpu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use the word ancient to talk about things that happened a very long time ago in history (especially before the end of the western Roman Empire in AD476).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Those tools are very ancient; they are at least 2000 years old.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sika ne me kasangkapan derengani; me daruwe e ne libu ne tuig ka kaluhayan.

entries.summary: wey; pegkeimpus

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use and to say that there is another thing

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I bought rice, salt and fish.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use and if one thing happens after another thing, or if one thing causes another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They said goodbye and went home.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migakahi sikandan te kayi key e, pegkeimpus mig-ulì e te baley.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She saw the snake and screamed.

entries.summary: panalihan te Manama

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a spiritual creature who serves God.

entries.summary: kalanget; kabelù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a strong, bad feeling because you do not like something that has happened.

entries.summary: iyan ka seked wey lugar diyè te egkasiku; pikungan; egbingihen

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: iyan ka seked wey lugar diyè te egkasiku

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two lines or surfaces meet, the angle is the measurement of their different directions. An angle is measured in degrees (°).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The storm-damaged tree hasn't fallen over yet, but is leaning at a 45° angle.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone looks at something from a particular angle, that is the direction from which they are looking.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She walked around the building so that she could see it from every angle.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you angle something, you move it so it does not form a 0° or 90° angle with another surface.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Just angle the sofa so that the back is not directly against the wall.

entries.summary: eglangetan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are angry, you have strong, bad feelings because you don't like something that has happened.

entries.summary: sesakiti ne eggeramen (labi en iya te geyinawa)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sesakiti ne eggeramen (labi en iya te geyinawa)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling of strong pain (especially emotional pain).

entries.summary: mananap

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a living thing which can move by itself and eat.

entries.summary: pitsa ke ken-u neyitabù ka minsan nekey te miglihad ne tuig (iling te pegpaasaweey wey duma pad)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pitsa ke ken-u neyitabù ka minsan nekey te miglihad ne tuig (iling te pegpaasaweey wey duma pad)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the date when something happened in a past year (e.g., wedding anniversary).

entries.summary: egyangyang; eglimbey; bayew nalangeti; neupul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something annoys you, they cause you to feel a bit angry (but not very, very angry).

entries.summary: pegyangyang; peglimbey; egpakayangyang; egpekeupul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling of being annoyed (a bit angry).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She showed her annoyance by frowning.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impakita rin ka pegyangyang din te pegpakenet te ulaula rin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something not very serious that can make you feel annoyed.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The brown-out is an annoyance, but we will be OK.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpakayangyang ka warè sulù, piru warè prublima.

entries.summary: leg-un-leg-un; tuig-tuig

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something annual either happens once every year (e.g., Fiesta), or is one year long (e.g., the annual sales of a company).

entries.summary: duma pad; esa pad; lein pad; egpabalbalesey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: duma pad; esa pad; lein pad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Another thing is one more thing that is similar.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Would you like another cup of coffee?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian ka te lein pad ne keppi?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You've finished your cup of coffee. Would you like another?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Neimpusan nud ka keppi nu. Keupian ke pad te lein? (wey ke egtimul ke pad?)

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This cup is broken, so I'll bring you another one.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ne basu nabuang, egkuan kad te duma ne basu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two or more people do something to one another, the first person does that thing to the second person, and the second person does it to the first person.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My neighbor and I help one another with our gardens.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpabulbulihey key te sumbaley ku te pegtrabahu te gulayan ney.

entries.summary: egtabak; tabak; igtabak

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you answer someone, you say something to them because they said something to you first. If you answer a question, you give the information that the question is asking.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She spoke to him but he didn't answer her.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He answered all the police officer's questions.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the thing you say to someone because they said something to you first (give_an_answer).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She spoke to him, but he didn't give an answer.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An answer to a question is the information that the question is asking.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I didn't know all the answers on the test.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbales te sulat; egtabak te sulat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you answer something such as a letter or email, you write to the person who wrote to you first.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She hasn't nswered any of my letters.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: igbales ne sulat; igtabak ne sulat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the thing which you write to someone who wrote to you first.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm waiting for an answer to my email.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you answer_to someone, they are the one who has authority over you and can check your actions.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I answer to my supervisor, and he answers to the manager.

entries.summary: iteng
pegkalangè wey ke pegkalaggew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the feeling of being anxious or worried.

entries.summary: egkalaggew; egkabantalan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you feel anxious about something, you are worried.

entries.summary: Egkahamit seini ke eglalag ka te minsan hendei duma te me lalag ne 'warè iya' wey ke 'warad iya'.; egkahamit te peg-insè ke due minsan nekey; minsan nekey; minsan hendei; minsan hentew (egkahamit seini ke eglalag ka te kenè ne impurtanti ke hendei ka igkeupii nu wey ke egpilien nu)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini ke eglalag ka te minsan hendei duma te me lalag ne 'warè iya' wey ke 'warad iya'.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use any with a negative word (e.g., 'not', 'never') to talk about a zero amount of something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I do not want any of these animals.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè iya igkeupii ku ne ngalap minsan hendei kayi.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are never any mangoes on this tree.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkahamit te peg-insè ke due minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use any with a question to ask if something exists or is there in a place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Can any of your friends play the guitar?

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey; minsan hendei; minsan hentew (egkahamit seini ke eglalag ka te kenè ne impurtanti ke hendei ka igkeupii nu wey ke egpilien nu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use any to say that it is not important which person or thing you choose.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Take any chair that you like.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kuwa ka te minsan hendei ne bangku ne igkeupii nu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Any of my children can help you, just ask one of them.

entries.summary: warad e; kenad e

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is not the case any_more, it was the case in the past, but not now.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My dog died, so I don't have a dog any more.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka asu ku migpatey e, sikannaa ka warad e asu ku kuntee.

entries.summary: minsan hentew; sabeka; minsan hendei; minsan hentew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use anybody with a negative word (e.g., not, never), to talk about no people.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There wasn't anybody in the shop.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè minsan hentew dutu te tindaan [tinda͡an].

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use anybody with a question to ask if there is a person.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due sabeka kaniyu ne nakataha te tabak?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use anybody to say that it is not important which person you choose.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Anybody can tell you that the sky is blue.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Minsan hendei kaniyu ne egpakalalag te ka langit meilem.

entries.summary: piru minsan pad; wey labet pad degma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use anyhow to say that something is the case, even though the things said before are also the case.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother knows all my bad points, but she loves me anyhow.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka iney ku nakataha te maddeet ne himu ku, piru minsan pad due indakelan a nikandin te geyinawa.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use anyhow at the beginning of a sentence to give another strong reason.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't want to play basketball today, and anyhow, it's raining.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena a egkeupian ne egbubula kuntee, wey labet pad degma, eg-uran e.

entries.summary: minsan hentew; sabeka; minsan hendei; minsan hentew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use anyone with a negative word (e.g., not, never) to talk about no people.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There wasn't anyone in the shop.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè minsan hentew dutu te tindaan [tinda͡an].

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use anyone with a question to ask if there is a person.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due sabeka kaniyu ne nakataha te tabak?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use anyone to say that it is not important which person you choose.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Anyone can tell you that the sky is blue.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Minsan hendei kaniyu ne egpakalalag te ka langit meilem.

entries.summary: iya...minsan nekey; iya...ahad hendei (ke eglalag ka te warad iya); minsan nekey (diyè te peg-insè); minsan nekey; minsan hendei (meyitenged te ware tapid)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: iya...minsan nekey; iya...ahad hendei (ke eglalag ka te warad iya)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use anything with a negative word (e.g., not, never) to mean 'nothing'.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A baby can't do anything for itself.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka batè kenè iya egpekeyimu te minsan nekey para kandin.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warad iya migpangguhud sikandin te minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use anything in a question to ask if there is something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Can you remember anything about the accident?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpaksuman-suman ka te minsan nekey meyitenged te mareet ne neyitabù?

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey; minsan hendei (meyitenged te ware tapid)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use anything to say that it is not important which thing you choose.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You can eat anything that is on the table.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkakeen nu ka minsan nekey ne igkeupii nu diyè te lamisa.

entries.summary: piru minsan pad; wey labet pad degma; kuwa buwa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use anyway to say that something is the case, even though the things said before are also the case.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother knows all my bad points, but she loves me anyway.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka iney ku nakataha te maddeet ne himu ku, piru minsan pad due indakelan a nikandin te geyinawa.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use anyway at the beginning of a sentence to give another strong reason.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't want to play basketball today, and anyway, it's raining.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena a egkeupian ne egbubula kuntee, wey labet pad degma, eg-uran e.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use anyway at the beginning of a sentence to change the topic, or to try to finish the conversation.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Yes, I agree. Anyway, I should go home now.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Uya, eg-uyun a. Kuwa buwa, keilangan ad ne eg-uli diyè te baley.

entries.summary: minsan hendei; Egkahamit seini diyè te insè ke duen naa ka minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use anywhere with a negative word (e.g., not, never) to talk about no place

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I didn't go anywhere, I just stayed at home.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena a eggipanew minsan hendei, eg-uugpè e rè te baley.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We don't have anywhere to stay tonight.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè lugar ne egkeugpaan ta kunteen karusileman.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini diyè te insè ke duen naa ka minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use anywhere in a question to ask if a thing exists in a place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Is there a blanket anywhere in the house?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Duen naa ulesen diyè te baley?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Do you know of anywhere that we can stay?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Duen naa natahaan [nataha͡an] nu ne egkeugpaan ta ne lugar?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use anywhere to say that it is not important which place you choose.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You can buy those snacks anywhere along the road.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpakabeli ka te seeyè ne me pegkeen minsan hendei ilis te kelesadda.

entries.summary: nekegdiyù; nekegtalipag; warè labet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two things are apart, they are not close together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The two houses are about ten meters apart.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka daruwa ne baley ney nekegdiyù te daruwa ne mitrus.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use apart from to say that you are not including something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I sold all my animals apart from my carabao.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbelegyè ku langun ka me mananap ku warè labet te kalabew.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have nothing in my bag apart from a water bottle.

entries.summary: egbuyù te pasaylu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you apologize to someone for something, you say sorry.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He apologized to me for breaking my bike.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbuyù sikandin te pasaylu te pegdereet din te bayik ku.

entries.summary: pegbuyù te pasaylu; pegbuyù te pasinsya te kenè pegpakaapil te minsan nekey iling te kalibulungan wey duma pad

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was so angry that he would not accept my apology.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne nabelu sikandin ne kenè egdawat te pegbuyù ku te pasaylu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegbuyù te pasinsya te kenè pegpakaapil te minsan nekey iling te kalibulungan wey duma pad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you give or send an apology, you send a message to say that you are not going to join a group of people who are meeting together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My wife needs to stay home to look after our sick child, so she sends her apologies.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka asawa ku keilangan ne eg-ugpè te baley eyew te pegbantey te egderalu ne anak ney, sika ka migbuyù sikandin te pasinsya.

entries.summary: Ka duusi ne etew ne in-alam ni Hisus, wey ka migduma kandin wey ka miggubù kandin te katuenan. Migpeuyan kandan eyew te pegwali wey peggimu te me kein-inuwan. Si Paulu degma neyimu ne hibateen te naluhey.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Ka duusi ne etew ne in-alam ni Hisus, wey ka migduma kandin wey ka miggubù kandin te katuenan. Migpeuyan kandan eyew te pegwali wey peggimu te me kein-inuwan. Si Paulu degma neyimu ne hibateen te naluhey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The twelve men whom Jesus chose, and who travelled with him and learned from him. He sent them to preach and do miracles. Paul also became an apostle later.

entries.summary: palinneu seini te pegpangamuney wey ke egpegsumpul te daruwa ne lalag

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: palinneu seini te pegpangamuney wey ke egpegsumpul te daruwa ne lalag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: this symbol: '. It is used to show possession (e.g., Huwan's book), or contraction (he's = he is).

entries.summary: mahaan egkataheyi su mahaan egkakita; egkamelmelehi; pegpakita ne hendue te malehet piru kenè bes; pegparayan-dayan dè

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mahaan egkataheyi su mahaan egkakita; egkamelmelehi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a fact is apparent, we can know it easily, because it is easy to see.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is apparent that she is not happy, because she never smiles.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana egkataheyi ne sikandin warè nahalè, su kenad ma iya eggimun-gimun sikandin.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegpakita ne hendue te malehet piru kenè bes; pegparayan-dayan dè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something apparent looks like it is real or true, but is not.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His apparent interest in reading is only because he wants to impress that girl.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegpakita rin te kabagget te pegbasa kenè ne malehet su igkeupii rin dè ne egparayan-dayan te malitan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The apparent depth of the river is greater than its real depth; it's really quite shallow.

entries.summary: hendue iya te; hendue te

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use apparently to talk about information which you heard, but which you are not sure is true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I haven't spoken to her, but apparently she is going to move to Davao.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ware e pad impakiglalag kandin, piru hendue iya te eggalin sikandin diyè te Dabaw.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use apparently to say that you guess that something is the case because of something that you can see.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our sister is playing outside, so apparently she has forgotten about her work in the house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka atebey ney miggehalew diyè te ligwang, sika naa ka hendue te nalingawan din e ka trabahu rin.

entries.summary: eglepew; egkakita; hendue te

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something appears, people can start to see it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I love watching the stars appear at night.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something appears to be happening, it looks like it is happening (maybe it is true or maybe not).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It appears to be raining over on the mountain.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Hendue te uran ka seeyè te bubungan.

entries.summary: peglepew; pegpakita; ulaula

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Everyone was surprised by the appearance of three new shops in the street.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The appearance of someone or something is what they look like.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She takes care of her appearance, and is always neat and clean.

entries.summary: ibeg; gutas; alig; ibeg; igkeupii

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you have an appetite for something (e.g., power), you always want it.

entries.summary: egpalakpak wey egkuleyi puun te amana natelesi te egtengtengan wey egpamminehen; egdayan; egdeyrey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpalakpak wey egkuleyi puun te amana natelesi te egtengtengan wey egpamminehen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a group of people applaud someone, each person claps their hands together to show that they like something that the person has done.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The audience applauded the performers at the end of the concert.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you applaud an action or attitude of a person, you say that their action or attitude was very good.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The police applauded the shop assistant for his courage during the robbery.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migdayan te pulis ka suluhuanen te tindaan [tinda͡an] te kabulut din te migtakawan ka tindaan [tinda͡an].

entries.summary: makeseg ne palakpak

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of people clapping their hands together to show that they like something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: At the end of the song, there was a round of applause from the audience.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te keepusan te ulahingen, due makeseg ne pegpamalakpak te me etew ne migmammineg.

entries.summary: sulat eyew te pegbuyù te minsan nekey (labi en iya te trabahu); egkahamitan; pegpanahù; pegpanambal

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sulat eyew te pegbuyù te minsan nekey (labi en iya te trabahu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a formal letter asking for something (usually a job).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The application of a theory or rule is how it is used in a practical way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This new technology has many useful applications in everyday life.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of spreading something on a surface

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Regular application of suncream to the skin is important.

entries.summary: egsulat te maheteng ne egpanengneng te igkeupii (iling te himu); eggamit te natuenan; egpanahù

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egsulat te maheteng ne egpanengneng te igkeupii (iling te himu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you apply for something such as a job, you write a formal letter to say that you want that thing.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you apply something that you know, you use it in a practical way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In my new job, I have a chance to apply the things that I learned in my course.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te iyam ne trabahu ku, due timpu ku ne eggamit te minsan nekey ne natuenan ku puun te kursu ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you apply something to a surface, you spread that thing on that surface (e.g., paint on a wall, make-up on your face).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She applied make-up to her face.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They applied polish to the floor.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you apply yourself to something, you work hard at doing that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is very bright, but he doesn't apply himself, so his grades are not good.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne matagseb sikandin, piru warè din himuwa diyè te keugalingen din, sika ka kenè ne meupiya ka gradu rin.

entries.summary: egbehey te trabahu wey ke katenged pinaahi te pegtinurù

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbehey te trabahu wey ke katenged pinaahi te pegtinurù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or organization appoints you to a particular position, they give you that job or position.

entries.summary: egmapasalamaten; egpakataha wey egpakasabut; egkeupian

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you appreciate something, you feel thankful for it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I appreciate your help. Thank you very much.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you appreciate a fact, you know and understand it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I appreciate the fact that you are afraid to go there.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpakasabut a ne egkaaldek [egka͡aldek] ka iya ne eggendiyè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you appreciate something, such as a kind of music, you enjoy it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè egkeupian sikandin te karaan ne me musika.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egtulin ka bali; egdakel ka bali; egtubù ka bali

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something that you own (e.g. land) appreciates, the amount of money that it is worth increases.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that something becomes worth more money.

entries.summary: egpalundani; egdulug; egparani; pegpalundani; pegparani; pegdulug; pegdugpù; eggusey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something approaches you, they move towards you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We need to go home now, as the rain is approaching.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan neg-ulì kid kuntee, su ka uran egpalundaniyan e.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of moving towards something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I didn't hear his approach because he walked softly.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè ku narineg ka pegparani rin su impahanadhanad ma sikandin ka miggipanew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you approach a situation or problem a certain way, you try to fix or work with it that way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He approached the problem by speaking to her.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggusey sikandin te prublima pinaahi te pegpakiglalag te malitan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the way that you try to fix or work with a situation or problem.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We need to try a new approach to this problem.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ne eggeram ki te iyam ne paahi te peggusey te seini ne prublima.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: seleranan ne dalan; paseled ne dalan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The approach to a particular place is the way or path that you follow when you are nearly at that place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The approach to the caves is very steep.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seleranan ne dalan peendiyè te sulung su amanan masandig.

entries.summary: eleg; meupiya; pegkeeleg; pegkameupiya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is appropriate, it is polite or good for a particular situation.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is appropriate to give clothes or animals as wedding gifts.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eleg ne egbehey ki te kumbalè wey ke mananap ne dasag te eg-paasaweey.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm not sure about the appropriacy of that short dress for wearing to a wedding.

entries.summary: egpanguwa ne warè katenged; egtahahè; 1 pegpanguwa ne warè katenged; 2 pegtahahè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone appropriates something that does not belong to them, they take it, even though they don't have the right to take it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The dishonest worker appropriated money from his company.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kenè ne matulanged ne suluhuen migpanguwa te seleppì diyè te kumpanya minsan warè katenged.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a government or organization appropriates money, they separate it to use for a particular purpose.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The government has appropriated 100 million pesos for the new hospital.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka gubirnu migtahahè te sabeka ne gatus ne milyun eyew te iyam ne uspital.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was sent to prison for misappropriation (wrong appropriation) of goverment money.

entries.summary: eg-uyun su meupiya wey eleg ka minsan hentew wey ka minsan nekey; eg-uyun ka due katenged ne eggimu ka minsan hentew te minsan nekey ne eggimuwen wey ke eglalag eyew te pegdawat; pegkeupian; peg-uyun

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-uyun su meupiya wey eleg ka minsan hentew wey ka minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you approve_of someone or something, you think that they are good or right.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't approve of him as a husband for my daughter, because he is lazy.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena a eg-uyun ne sikandin ka egkaasawa te anak ku ne malitan, su pehulen sikandin.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-uyun ka due katenged ne eggimu ka minsan hentew te minsan nekey ne eggimuwen wey ke eglalag eyew te pegdawat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone with authority approves an action, they say that you can do it. If they approve something (e.g., a document), they say that they accept it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My adviser pproved my lesson plan, so now I can use it in my Field Study at the school.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka talagpangabang ku ne talagpanulù mig-uyunan din ka inggimu ne igpanulù ku, ne kuntee egkahamit kud seini te pegbebasbas ku pegpanulù diyè te iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an].

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling that you like something, and think that it is good or right.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peg-uyun te himu wey ke dukumintu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of someone in authority saying that they allow an action or accept a document.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè eg-uyun te minsan hentew wey ke minsan nekey puun su seini mareet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you disapprove_of someone or something, you think that they are bad.

entries.summary: me alahè; egginguma te me (alahè ne seel); me

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An approximate number or quantity is not exact, but is close.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What is the approximate number of students at the school?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekey ka me alahè ne seel te me batè diyè te iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an]?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I need to know the number of students at the school. Can you give me an approximate?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I need to know the approximate distance to that place, so that I know if I need to buy more gas.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a number or quantity approximates a certain number or quantity, it is not exactly the same, but it is close.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't know how many people were there, but the number approximated 200.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Wara a nakataha ke pila ka seel te me etew diyè, piru ka kasuluhan egginguma te me daruwan ne gatus.

entries.summary: nabegkul ne pegkatuntun; nabeluntu; tabek; eglegkien

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a structure (natural or man-made) in which a curved top is above a space.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The branch of the tree bent over to the ground, making an arch that we could walk through.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The arch of the foot is the part of the bottom of the foot which makes a small arch shape.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Some people have a foot with a very high arch, while other people have very flat feet.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you arch a part of your body (esp. the back), you make the muscles tight so that it makes a curved shape.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: present tense of be (second person singular and plural, first person plural, third person plural)

entries.summary: inged; lugar; sabdyik; baad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a place or part of a place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Coconuts grow well in that area of Mindanao.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Philippine history is an interesting area.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Work, family, health and money are all areas of life.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The area of something is how big it is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The area of that field is 400 square meters.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kaluahan te kamet su hep-at ne gatus ne kehun ne seked.

entries.summary: egpegkeg-apul; eg-apul; egpaap-apuley

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people argue about something, they talk about their different opinions, and give the reasons for their opinions.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My friends and I enjoy arguing about many different topics.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you argue that something is true, you say that it is true and give reasons why you think that.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She argued that it was better to wait until the next day, because it was late already.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people argue with each other, they talk angrily to each other about something they disagree about.

entries.summary: apul; apulanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a reason that you give to say why you think something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He gave many arguments to support his opinion.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a conversation in which people talk angrily to each other about something (have_an_argument).

entries.summary: egbunsud egkakita wey ke egkeyitabù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a situation arises, it starts to exist or happen.

entries.summary: belad; sugpang wey suley te kumpanya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the part of the body which is joined to the shoulder, and ends at the hand.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He put his arm around his friend.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a section of an organization which works in a particular place, or does a particular job.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I work for the Philippine arm of an international company.

entries.summary: egbehayan te panganiban; me panganiban

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone arms a person or group, they give weapons such as guns to them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They armed the young soldiers with rifles.

entries.summary: punduk te me unturanan ne egkahamit te pegpakig-ehet; panagang (iling te putew)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: punduk te me unturanan ne egkahamit te pegpakig-ehet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The armor of a military group is the set of vehicles such as tanks which they use in fighting.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The armor of a person or vehicle is the strong (usually metal) cover which protects them.

entries.summary: me utabli; me sundalu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large, organized group of people who fight on land using guns and other weapons.

entries.summary: palingut; te (meyitenged te lugar ke hendei); palibut; nakalingut; egtabileng te nateil ne lugar

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: palingut; te (meyitenged te lugar ke hendei); palibut

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something moves around something, they move in a circle with that thing in the middle.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The angry dog circled around the frightened children.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka mabulut ne asu miglingut-lingut te nenaaldek [nena͡aldek] ne me batè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If things are around something, they are in a cirle so that the thing is in the middle.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We sat around the fire and talked.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miglingut key migpinnuu te hapuy wey migpapangpangguhurey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something moves around a place, they move from point to point inside that place.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtabileng key miggiphipanew diyè te palingki.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something turns around, they move in a circle one or more times.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She turned around when she heard the noise behind her.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbagkeleng sikandin te nakarineg sikandin te dahing diyè te peka rin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There were around two hundred people at the concert.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due me daruwa ne gatus ne etew diyè te kunsirt.

entries.summary: egtapid; egplanu te egpegsunud-sunud te hitabù; egbalew-balew te ulahingen eyew egkeiyam ne egpamminehen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you arrange things, you put them somewhere in a way which is organized or which looks good.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He arranged the books on the table.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtapid din ka me libru diyè te lamisa.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you arrange a future event, or arrange to do something, you cause it to happen by making plans and doing things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She arranged a meeting with the teacher.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They arranged to meet at 2 o'clock.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbalew-balew te ulahingen eyew egkeiyam ne egpamminehen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you arrange a piece of music, you change it to make a new version (e.g., so that certain instruments can play it).

entries.summary: pegkatapid; planu te pegkasunudsunud te hitabù; pegbalew-balew te ulahingen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the way that things are sitting or standing in a place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That arrangement of flowers in the vase is beautiful.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Meupiya sika ne pegkatapid te bulak sika te tahuanan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The arrangements for an event are the plans that people have made for it (make_arrangements).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother made all the arrangements for my brother's birthday party.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An arrangement of a piece of music is a different version of it (e.g., for different instruments).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I like his new arrangement of that old song.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian a te iyam ne pegbalew-balew rin te sika ne daan ne ulahingen.

entries.summary: egdakep; pegpandakep; egpeeneng-eneng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If the police arrest a person, they catch them and take them to a place such as a police station.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There were many arrests when the police found the hide-out of the killers.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due masalig ne pegpandakep te natulituan te me pulis ka helesanan te me talaggimatey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a process arrests, it stops.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His heart arrested during the operation.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpeeneng-eneng ka pusung din te timpu te mig-upirahan sikandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He went into cardiac arrest during the operation.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something arrests a process, they stop it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This pesticide arrests the growth of weeds.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpasanggel seini ne hilu te pegtubù te me hilamunen.

entries.summary: egginguma; egginguma ne egkeyitabù; pegginguma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you arrive in or at a place, you come to that place after moving from another place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They arrived at my house just before dark.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a time or event arrives, it is time for it to happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We are waiting for their arrival.

entries.summary: mapalabew-labew (etew ne egsuman-suman ne memeupiya sikandin du te duma); pegpalabew-labew

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mapalabew-labew (etew ne egsuman-suman ne memeupiya sikandin du te duma)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An arrogant person thinks that they are better or more important than other people.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ku igkeupii ka pegpalabew-labew rin.

entries.summary: tunud; busug; aru; egtinuru

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a long, thin weapon which is shot from a bow. One end is sharp, and the other end usually has feathers.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He shot the dangerous animal with an arrow.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a shape (→) that you draw to point at something or to organize information.

entries.summary: memeupiya ne hinimuwan ne egpekeuyan te puhawang wey geramen; minsan nekey ne impangimu te me etew ne memeupiya wey egpekeuyan te puhawang wey geramen; katuenan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: memeupiya ne hinimuwan ne egpekeuyan te puhawang wey geramen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: things you can look at (e.g., paintings) which are made to be beautiful or to communicate ideas and feelings.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I love the art of Picasso.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne impangimu te me etew ne memeupiya wey egpekeuyan te puhawang wey geramen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: anything that people create to be beautiful or communicate ideas and feelings (e.g., music, poetry).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Getting a good price at the market is an art.

entries.summary: kasangkapan; butang; senge baad ne sinulat (diyè te niyuspipir wey ke magasin); artikulu

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The room was almost empty, but there were a few articles on the floor.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
