fields.text: Ka sinabeng halus warad tetahuen, piru duen pad me same-samè ne me kasangkapan diyè te seeg.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: senge baad ne sinulat (diyè te niyuspipir wey ke magasin)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a piece of writing in a newspaper or magazine.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Did you read the article about Mindanao in the magazine?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nabasa nu ka senge baad ne sinulat meyitenged te Mindanaw diyè te magasin?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a section of a formal document such as the law. Each article is about a particular topic.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Section 1, Article 2 of our constitution says that it is the people who have the power.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Siksyun sabeka, artikulu dus te kanta ne balaud migkahi te due geem [ge͡em] te me etew.

entries.summary: hinimu te etew ne me butang wey kenè ne ka neyimu e daan; me lalag wey himu ne lein te malehet ne eggeramen

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: hinimu te etew ne me butang wey kenè ne ka neyimu e daan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something artificial is made by people, and is not natural.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't like using artificial sweeteners in my coffee; I prefer sugar.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me lalag wey himu ne lein te malehet ne eggeramen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is artificial, their words and actions are different from what they really feel.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's better for people to think you are unemotional than to be artificial.

entries.summary: tetelesi ne egpitawen; mekeeeyam (meyitenged te himuwen te etew); mapandey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: tetelesi ne egpitawen; mekeeeyam (meyitenged te himuwen te etew)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something man-made is artistic, it is beautiful to look at.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That flower arrangement is very artistic.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An artistic person can create beautiful things.

entries.summary: baad te kanengnengan ne meyitenged te lalag wey peggimu te minsan nekey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: baad te kanengnengan ne meyitenged te lalag wey peggimu te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the areas of learning which are about words and creating things, not science (e.g., history, languages).

entries.summary: te (sikan dè ne timpu; iling ded ne timpu); su; isip

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: te (sikan dè ne timpu; iling ded ne timpu)

fields.label: English example
fields.text: As I walked into the room, I heard a noise.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te peggipanew ku diyè te sinabeng, nakarineg a te dahing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is unable to go, as she is sick.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè egpekeendiyè [egpeke͡endiyè] sikandin, su inderalu sikandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use as to say what something is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: As a teacher, he has a big responsibility.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Isip meistra, due dakel ne katenged din.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She loves me as her own daughter.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Inggeyinawaan a nikandin iling te pamaahi te peggeyinawa rin te anak din.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini ne lalag ke egpeg-iling ka te minsan nekey

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He isn't as tall as I am.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ne malayat sikandin ne iling te kalayat ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use as_if or as_though to say what something looks like.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She talks as if she wants to stay here. Is that true?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka lalag din iling kun te egkeupian sikandin ne eg-ugpè kayi, malehet naa sika?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She talks as though she wants to stay here. Is that true?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka lalag te malitan hendue te egkeupian sikandin ne kayi eg-ugpè, malehet naa sika?

entries.summary: basta su...ne; (meyitenged te pegweil pegkeimpus te hun-an weil)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: (meyitenged te pegweil pegkeimpus te hun-an weil)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use as_long_as to say that something will only happen if another thing happens.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: As long as you finish your homework first, you can play with your friends.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Basta su gun-eyi nu impusi ka me himu nu, ne egkaayun kad ne eggalew duma te me alukuy nu.

entries.summary: sahuhunè ne egkeyitabù pegkeimpus te hun-a ne butang

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sahuhunè ne egkeyitabù pegkeimpus te hun-a ne butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happens as_soon_as another thing happens, it happens immediately after that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: As soon as I opened the door, the cat ran into the room.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Saliyu rè te nalukatan ku ka gumawan, sahuhunè ne ka miyew migpallahuy diyè te sinabeng.

entries.summary: abu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the soft black or grey material which remains after something is burnt.

entries.summary: keyilew
parapig; pasili; gawas

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you put something aside, you put it on one side of you and don't use it, maybe because you are finished with it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She wasn't hungry, so she pushed aside her bowl of soup.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè gutasi sikandin, sika ka migsirul din parapig ka intahuan te sabew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you move aside, you move to one side of a person's pathway because they want to move past you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was walking slowly, so he stepped aside to let the other people pass him.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpahanad-ganad miggipanew sikandin, sika ka migdapig sikandin pasili eyew egpakabayè ka duma ne etew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use aside to say that you don't want to include something in what you are saying.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Aside from Monday night, it hasn't rained all week.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Gawas te marusilem te Lunis, warad iya mig-uran te langun ne simana.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: lalag ne warè labet te egpangasaken

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a short thing that someone says that is not related to the topic which they are talking about.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's hard to talk with him when he's with his friends, because he keeps making asides to them.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Malised ne egpakiglalag kandin ke due me alukuy rin, su egkasensè sikandan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's hard to talk with him, because he is always adding asides, instead of really listening to me.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you set something such as money aside, you don't use it for general things because you are waiting to use it for a particular thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Every month I try to set aside some money, because I am saving for a motorbike.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Tagsè bulan egteil a te duma ne seleppì, su eglilimud a para te mutur ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you take someone aside, you take them a small distance away from other people because you want to talk with them privately.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She took me aside and began to explain her problem.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ingganuy a nikandin pariyù wey migbunsud sikandin miglalag te prublima rin.

entries.summary: eg-insè; egpeyimu; egpabulig; eggangyù; egbuyù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you ask someone something, you say a question to that person.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He asked me why I wanted to go.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you ask someone to do something, you politely say that you want them to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She asked me to help her in the garden.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you ask someone for something, you politely say that you want them to give you something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He asked me for some money.

entries.summary: nakalipereng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are asleep, you are sleeping.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Don't make noise, because Papa is asleep.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ka egpararahing, su si Amè nakalipereng.

entries.summary: baad; nakatangkè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An aspect of something (e.g., life, or a problem), is a particular part of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I like many aspects of life in the mountains, including the cool weather and clean air.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Igkeupii ku ka masalig ne baad te peg-ugpè diyè te bubungan, labi en iya ka maagsil [ma͡agsil] ne timpu wey malinis ne kalamag.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The aspect of a building or room is the way that it faces (e.g., north).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our house has a north-east aspect.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka baley ney nakatangkè diyè te egbalabahan wey igsilè.

entries.summary: egtengteng eyew te pegnengneng; eg-el-elehan; 1 pegtengteng eyew te pegnengneng; 2 peggeram te katuenan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you assess something, you look at it carefully so that you know something about it (e.g., how good it is, how big it is, how much money it is worth).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My boss assessed my work and told me it was good.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ahalen ku migtengteng eyew te pegnengneng te himu ku wey migkahi sikandin te meupiya.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They assessed the damage to the house and decided that they could not fix it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They assessed my property so that they would know how much tax I should pay.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a teacher assesses students, they give tests and other work to them, in order to give grades to them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our teacher assesses us with a test every week.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eg-el-elehan key te meistra ney tagsè simana.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegtengteng eyew te pegnengneng; 2 peggeram te katuenan

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They took the broken motorbike to the shop for assessment.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: In-uyan dan ka mutur ne nareetan diyè te upiyaanan eyew egpatengtengan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the thing which you know after you have assessed something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: How much will it cost to fix it? What is your assessment?

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: himu wey me insè eyew te pegnengneng te katuenan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the tests and work that teachers give to students so that they can give grades to them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is the end of the school year, so we have a lot of assessment now.

entries.summary: egbehey te igpeyimu; egpapeendiyè [egpape͡endiyè] te senge etew te nateil ne inged; egkahi te nateil ne igpasabut te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you assign a piece of work to someone, you give them that work to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our teacher assigns a lot of work.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka talagpanulù ney migbehey te masalig ne igpeyimu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother assigned a job to each child: I washed the dishes, my sister cleaned the table and my brother cleaned the floor.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpapeendiyè [egpape͡endiyè] te senge etew te nateil ne inged

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you assign someone to a place or group, you send them to that place or group (usually to work).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The army assigned the soldiers to west Mindanao.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka punduk te me sundalu migpapeendiyè [migpape͡endiyè] te me sundalu te iglineb ne baad te Mindanaw.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkahi te nateil ne igpasabut te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you assign a particular meaning to something, you say that the thing has that meaning.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: People assign a special meaning to the 14th February: it is Valentine's Day.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me etew intahahè te ka pitsa 14 te Pibriru: ne seini aldew te geyinawa.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: senge himuwan ne igpeyimu te senge etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a piece of work which someone has given you to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our teacher gives us many homework assignments.

entries.summary: egbulig; pegbulig; bulig

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you assist someone, you help them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I assisted him with the heavy sack.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbulihan ku sikandin te mabehat ne saku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The job of a midwife is the assistance of pregnant women.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the help that you give to someone.

entries.summary: egbehey te dakel ne timpu te peg-elit-elit wey pegduma-ruma diyè te senge etew; duma te trabahu wey ke migparumdumeey [migparumdume͡ey] te himu; due kalabetan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbehey te dakel ne timpu te peg-elit-elit wey pegduma-ruma diyè te senge etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you associate_with someone, you spend a lot of time with them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She associates with many people from the next sitio.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: duma te trabahu wey ke migparumdumeey [migparumdume͡ey] te himu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person whom you work or spend time with.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Please invite your friends and associates to the dinner.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Palihug imbitara nu ka me alukuy nu wey dumaa [duma͡a] nu te eglabung.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are_associated with a particular person, group or idea, you are connected with with them in some way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has been associated with some criminal gangs.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpegsumpul wey ke egpeglagpù diyè te suman-suman

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you associate one thing with another thing, you connect those two things in your thinking.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I always associate biku with my grandmother, because she always cooks it.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè ne malasi ne duma piru due katenged ne iling te malasi ne duma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An associate member of an organization is not a full member, but has some of the rights and responsibilities of a full member.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is an associate member of our club, but he does not need to come to meetings.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mimbru sikandin te grupu ney ne kenè ne malasi, piru kenad keilangan ne egtambung pad sikandin te miting.

entries.summary: punduk te me etew ne due pegkabagget te nateil ne minsan nekey; pegbehey te dakel ne timpu; pegduma-ruma; egpegsumpul wey ke egpeglagpù te daruwa ne butang diyè te suman-suman

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: punduk te me etew ne due pegkabagget te nateil ne minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an official group of people who are all interested in a particular thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I am a member of an association which researches Philippine history.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegbehey te dakel ne timpu; pegduma-ruma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of spending time with a person or people.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My parents were not happy about my association with that person.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ginikanan ku kenè egkeupian te pegduma-ruma ku te seika ne etew.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpegsumpul wey ke egpeglagpù te daruwa ne butang diyè te suman-suman

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of connecting two things in your thinking (make_an_association).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The association of rain with sickness is common.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka suman-suman ne egpeglagpù ne ka uran egpakabehey te dalu su amana ne kumun.

entries.summary: kuneen; egbunsud; egweilen ka lawa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you assume that something is the case, you believe it without asking or checking.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She assumed that I wanted to go, but she didn't ask me.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kuneen din ke egkeupian a ne egduma, piru warè mig-insè sikandin keddì.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you assume something such as a job, you start doing that job.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He will assume his new role next month.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egbunsud e sikandin te iyam ne himu rin te seup ne bulan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you assume a position, you move your body to have that position.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migweil din ka lawa rin eyew te pegpinnuu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegsuman-suman ne due ka warè; 2 pegbunsud

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Many people were unhappy about his assumption of the role of director.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you believe without asking or checking (make_an_assumption).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Don't make negative assumptions about people before you know them.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ka eggimu te mareet ne sumansuman te me etew ne warè nu pad neileyi.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Your assumption about him is incorrect.

entries.summary: egpehet-pehet; lalag ne pegbagget su due pasalig ne kamalehetan; kaluwanan te geyinawa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you assure someone that something is the case, you promise them that it really is the case, so that they will feel comfortable.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I felt bad asking for help, but she assured me that she was happy to help me.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggeram ku ne mareet ka egpabulig, piru migpehet-pehet sikandin keddì ne egkahalè sikandin ne egbulig keddì.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: lalag ne pegbagget su due pasalig ne kamalehetan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: words which make you feel comfortable, because they promise that something really is the case.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She gave me many assurances that she was happy to help.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbeheyan a nikandin te masalig ne me lalag te pegbagget ne sikandin egkahalè ne egbulig.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling of being comfortable and sure about something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She spoke to the large group with assurance, and did not look nervous.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miglalag sikandin te katangenan ne due kaluwanan te geyinawa, wey egtengtengan ne warè dè.

entries.summary: egpakapeinu-inu; neinu-inu; pegkeinu-inu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something astonishes you, it causes you to feel very surprised.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Their ability to carry very heavy sacks astonishes me.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpakapeinu-inu ka katuenan din ne egpekeeleg te mabehat ne saku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is astonished, they feel very surprised.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was astonished to hear that the big tree had fallen down in the storm.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling of being very surprised.

entries.summary: te (meyitenged te lugar); diyè te; due te; sika te; te (meyitenged te uras wey aldew); te (meyitenged te kanekal wey ke keemen [ke͡emen])

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: te (meyitenged te lugar); diyè te; due te; sika te

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are at a place (e.g., school, a shop), that is the place where you are.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I stayed at my friend's house last night.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Diya a te baley te alukuy ku te miglihad ne marusilem.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happens at a particular time (e.g. 7pm, lunch-time, Fiesta), that is the time when it happens.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka peg-iskuyla egbunsud te alas siti kinsi te maselem.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: te (meyitenged te kanekal wey ke keemen [ke͡emen])

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happens or moves at a particular rate or speed (e.g. kilometers per hour), that is how fast it is happening or moving.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When he crashed, he was driving at 70km per hour.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te nabalintuad sikandin, migpapallahuy sikandin te terak te pitun pulù ne kilumitru tagsè uras.

entries.summary: hawhawanan; kawkawangan; kalamag te nateil ne lugar; geyinawa ne eggeramen te nateil ne punduk wey ke lugar

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The atmosphere of a planet is the mixture of gases and air around it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the air in a particular place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The atmosphere of that city is very dirty and smoky.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kalamag te siyudad amana ne malindit wey ebelen.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: geyinawa ne eggeramen te nateil ne punduk wey ke lugar

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The atmosphere in a particular group or place is the general feeling that is there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was an atmosphere of excitement in the group while they waited for the game to start.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due geyinawa te pegkabagget te punduk te pegtetahad te pegbunsud te galew.

entries.summary: eggimu te meupiya eyew egkaawè ka mareet ne neyimu wey ka kabelu te duma ne etew puun te neyimu ne mareet; peg-awè te seyyup wey kabelu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggimu te meupiya eyew egkaawè ka mareet ne neyimu wey ka kabelu te duma ne etew puun te neyimu ne mareet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you atone_for something bad that you did, you do something good to take away the bad, and to take away the anger of the other person. The Bible says that the death of Jesus atones_for the sins of the world.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of taking away wrong and anger.

entries.summary: egpakepkep; egpegsumpul; ka minsan nekey ne impakepkep diyè te duma ne kasangkapan; peggeyinawa te minsan nekey wey ke minsan hentew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you attach something to another thing, you join it to that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She attached the paper to the wall with a pin.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impakepkep din ka pepil diyè te alabat te simat.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka minsan nekey ne impakepkep diyè te duma ne kasangkapan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which is attached to another thing.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peggeyinawa te minsan nekey wey ke minsan hentew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling of loving something or someone.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has a strong attachment to his sister.

entries.summary: egdula (te mananap); eglusud (te etew, mananap wey lugar); eglalag te maddeet diyè te senge etew wey ke meyitenged kandin wey meyitenged te minsan nekey; 1 pegdula; peglusud; 2 peglalag te maddeet

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egdula (te mananap); eglusud (te etew, mananap wey lugar)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person, animal or group attacks another person, animal, group, they use weapons or their bodies to hurt them. If they attack a place, they try to damage or enter that place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Three dogs attacked me, and I had many bites on my legs.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The rebels attacked the town early in the morning.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eglalag te maddeet diyè te senge etew wey ke meyitenged kandin wey meyitenged te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you attack someone or something, you say bad things to them or about them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: At the meeting, the chairman attacked my suggestion, saying that it was useless.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of using something (e.g., weapons, the body, words) to hurt someone or something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Many people were killed in the attack.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggingumaan te dalu te amana ne masumpit; atakiyen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An attack is a short time when a person has an illness very badly (e.g., a heart attack).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My grandfather died of a heart attack.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I will have an asthma attack if I run too much.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She had a bad attack of diarrhoea.

entries.summary: eg-angayen; egkuen ka eg-umeen; eg-uma; peg-angey; peg-kuwa; peg-uma; naangey; nakuwa; neuma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you attain something, you get it by hard work.

entries.summary: eggeram (piru kenè egkeyimu wey egkeuma); peggeram te peggimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you attempt to do something, you try to do it, but usually can't do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I attempted to climb Mt Apo, but it was too hard, so I stopped.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggeram a migpamaneyik te bubungan te Apu, piru amana ne malised, sika ka wara ad migpabulus.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action of trying to do something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm going to try to climb Mt Apo again next week. Maybe my second attempt will be successful.

entries.summary: egpakaruma; egpakatambung; egpakaapil; egpekeiskuyla; eggimu te keilangan ne eggimuwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you attend an event such as a meeting, you go to that event.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I couldn't attend my sister's wedding because I was sick.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Wara a nakatambung te kasal te atebey ku su migderalu a.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you attend a school or college, you go there regularly.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She didn't attend school much last year, as she was sick.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè amana nekeiskuyla sikandin te miglihad ne tuig, su migderalu sikandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you attend_to a job or activity, you do the things that you need to do for it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Now, I should go home and attend to the cooking.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kuntee, keilangan a ne eg-ulì wey egsusubba.

entries.summary: pegtambung te minsan nekey; kasuluhan te me etew ne nanambung; listaan [lista͡an] ke kamenu kalasi wey karelag ka pegtambung te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of going to an event.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kasuluhan te me etew ne nanambung

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The attendance of an event is the number of people who are at the event.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: listaan [lista͡an] ke kamenu kalasi wey karelag ka pegtambung te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A person's attendance is the record of how often they are at a regular event (e.g. school).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That student has very good attendance.

entries.summary: pegtengteng, pegpammineg, wey pegsuman-suman te minsan nekey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegtengteng, pegpammineg, wey pegsuman-suman te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action or of looking at, listening to, thinking about or working on something (pay_attention).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Sorry, I didn't hear what you said, as I wasn't paying attention.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He focused his attention on his farm, and didn't go to town very often.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The loud shouting attracted a lot of attention from the neighbors.

entries.summary: menà; batasan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your attitude to someone or something is the way that you feel about them, and the way that you act towards them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She has a very good attitude to her work, and always works hard.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Meupiya amana ka batasan din te himu rin, wey amana eggimu sikandin.

entries.summary: talagpangabang (meyitenged te me kasu diyè te kurti); abugadu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: talagpangabang (meyitenged te me kasu diyè te kurti); abugadu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a lawyer; someone who works with people who have problems with the law, and speaks for them in a court of law.

entries.summary: egpakapabagget; egpekewusud; egpakasupsup; egpakahanuy

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something attracts people or animals, it causes them to move closer to it, because they are interested in it or want it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The accident attracted a crowd of people.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka aksidinti nakapabagget te kasuluhan te me etew.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In dry weather, water attracts ants.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing attracts another thing, it pulls the other thing towards it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka magnit egpakasupsup te me putew ne butang.

entries.summary: 1 pegpakabagget; 2 pegpekewusud; pegpakasupsup; pegpakahanuy; pegkeupian; pegkeupii (te malitan wey lukes); minsan nekey ne egleuyen te me etew eyew te pegpitew wey ke peggimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling of liking someone of the opposite sex.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I felt a strong attraction to him.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggeram a te amana ne pegkeupian kandin.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne egleuyen te me etew eyew te pegpitew wey ke peggimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which people visit a place to see or do (e.g., a zipline).

entries.summary: meupiya; mahayyul; gayyulen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An attractive person or thing looks good, or has something that people like.

entries.summary: egpalintutuu ne iyan aliddanan wey ke puunanan; egpalintutuu te due

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpalintutuu ne iyan aliddanan wey ke puunanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you attribute something to a person or thing, you believe that the person or thing caused it or made it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We attributed the rainy weather here to the typhoon in Luzon.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpalintutuu key ne iyan aliddanan te peg-uran-uran kayi te kanta ka bagyu diyè te Lusun.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That play is attributed to Shakespeare.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you attribute someone or something with a particular characteristic, you believe that they have that characteristic.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She attributes her son with great intelligence.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpalintutuu sikandin te ka anak din due katagseban.

entries.summary: meupiya ne menà

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a characteristic (usually good) of a person or thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Your mother has many good attributes: she is kind, hardworking and a great cook.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka iney nu amana ne masalig ka memeupiya ne batasan: amana sikandin ne buutan, mabasuk wey mangilutù.

entries.summary: grupu te me etew ne egtengteng iling te kunsirt, wey ke egpammineg te minsan nekey iling te prugrama te radyu, wey ke egbasa te minsan nekey iling te magasin

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: grupu te me etew ne egtengteng iling te kunsirt, wey ke egpammineg te minsan nekey iling te prugrama te radyu, wey ke egbasa te minsan nekey iling te magasin

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the group of people who watch something such as a concert, or who listen to something such as a radio program, or who read something such as a magazine.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me manengtengay neupian te ulahingen dan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That magazine is written for a female audience.

entries.summary: ayè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: your mother's sister, mother's brother's wife, father's sister or father's brother's wife.

entries.summary: talaggimu te libru wey ke guhuren; egsulat te nateil ne sulaten

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: talaggimu te libru wey ke guhuren

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who writes something such as a book or a poem.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Who is the author of that book?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you author something, you write it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migsulat sikandin te tatelu ne libru.

entries.summary: katenged; due me katungdanan wey katenged; due katuenan din

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the power to do something or to tell someone what to do (have_authority_over someone, be_in_authority_over someone).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Teachers have authority over their students.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me meistra due katenged diyè te me istudyanti ran.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A teacher has authority to give homework.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The authorities in a place are the people who have power (especially government power).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The authorities here work in the Barangay Hall.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An authority on a particular subject is a person who knows a lot about that subject.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is an authority on Philippine history, and has written many books about it.

entries.summary: maagsil [ma͡agsil] ne timpu ne taliwarè te ting-aldew wey tingkalamag

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: maagsil [ma͡agsil] ne timpu ne taliwarè te ting-aldew wey tingkalamag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the season between summer and winter, when the temperature becomes cooler. Some trees lose their leaves in autumn. This is also called fall.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm glad it is autumn now, because summer was so hot and uncomfortable.

entries.summary: ka talagbulig te weil ne egpanengneng eyew te katahaan [kataha͡an] meyitenged te dakel ne weil

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka talagbulig te weil ne egpanengneng eyew te katahaan [kataha͡an] meyitenged te dakel ne weil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a 'helper' verb which you use together with another verb.

entries.summary: due layun; egkaayun su warè eggimuwen; 1 due layun; 2 pegkaayun puun te warè eggimuwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is available (e.g., in shops), people can get it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Bread is available in all the shops.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka paan [pa͡an] due layun te langun ne tindaan [tinda͡an].

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person is available, they can talk to you, because they are not busy.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm sorry, he's not available at the moment. Can he call you back later?

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 due layun; 2 pegkaayun puun te warè eggimuwen

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What's your availability: are you free every day?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We will buy some mangoes, depending on availability.

entries.summary: dakel wey maluag ne kelesadda ne kasagaran ne due me kayu ne impamula te tagsè ilis; pamaahi

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: dakel wey maluag ne kelesadda ne kasagaran ne due me kayu ne impamula te tagsè ilis

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a wide street which often has trees on each side.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She lives at number 23 Main Avenue.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a way of reaching a particular goal.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We have tried everything to stop the pigs eating our cassava. Our only avenue now is to speak to the owner of the pigs.

entries.summary: ka eglihawang ne seel puun te egpegtimulen ne me grupu te me numiru wey igdibayid te langun ne seel ke pila ne grupu te numiru ka impegtimul; eleg-eleg ne karakelan; maheteng

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka eglihawang ne seel puun te egpegtimulen ne me grupu te me numiru wey igdibayid te langun ne seel ke pila ne grupu te numiru ka impegtimul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You find the average of a group of numbers by adding the numbers together, and then dividing the total by how many numbers there are.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The average of 4, 9, 1 and 6 is 5 (20 divided by 4).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The average is the usual amount. The amount is not exactly the same every time, but it is approximately the same.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I usually drink an average of about 2 liters of water per day.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Tagsè aldew eg-inum a te daruwa ne litru ne weyig ka eleg-eleg ne karakelan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An average thing is usual or normal.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is average height for his age.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Maheteng dè ka kalayat din para te idad din.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It was just an average day, nothing special.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He's an average 4-year-old boy: he loves running around and playing with his friends.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is average, it is okay, but not very good.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother is a really good singer, but my singing ability is only average.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka iney ku meupiya amana ne mangulahing, piru ka keddì ne katuenan te peg-ulahing eleg-eleg dè.

entries.summary: eg-alihu; egpanalliya; egpallahuy te himu; eglikay te himu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you avoid something while you are moving, you change your movement so that you do not touch that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The motorbike moved to the other side of the road to avoid the potholes.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka mutur diyè egbayè te limang ne ilis te kelesadda eyew eg-alihu te me lungag.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you avoid something, you cause that thing not to happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He avoided getting sick by washing his hands regularly.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eglu-luan din layun ka me belad din su egpanalliya rin ne egderalu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpallahuy te himu; eglikay te himu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you avoid doing something that you don't want to do, you don't do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She always tries to avoid helping with the housework.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Layun egpallahuy sikandin te me himu diyè te baley.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He avoided falling down by holding onto the rope.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ware neulug sikandin su nakahen-gen sikandin te lubid.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpallahuy te etew; eggeles-heles te etew; eglikay te etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you avoid someone, you try not to see them or talk to them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She has been avoiding me all week. Maybe she is angry with me.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpalpallahuy sikandin keddì te langun ne simana. Kema ke nalangetan sikandin keddì.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 peg-alihu; 2 pegpanalliya; 3, pegpallahuy te himu; peglikay te himu; 4 pegpallahuy te etew; peggeles te etew; peglikay te etew

entries.summary: nekeyimata

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are awake, you are not sleeping.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can't sleep! It's already 11pm, and I'm still awake.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena a egpakalipereng! Alas unsi e seini te marusilem, wey nekeyimata e pad.

entries.summary: nakataha; pegpakanengneng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are aware of something, or are aware that something is the case, you know about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I am not aware of any problems with the machine.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Wara a nakataha te minsan nekey ne prublima te mekina.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I am not aware that there are any problems.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the state of being aware of something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They advertised a lot to raise awareness of the new product.

entries.summary: egpariyù; mariyù; iglibed igtahù te tahuanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something moves away from a place or thing, they move so they are not in that place or near that thing.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something is away from a place or thing, they are not in that place or near that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He's lonely because he's away from home.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkalangè sikandin su mariyù sikandin te inged din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you put something away, you put it in the place where you usually put it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Put away your clean clothes, don't leave them on your bed.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Itahù nu ilibed ka me kumbalè nu te tahuanan, kenè nu engkeri diyè te hibatanan nu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use away after a verb to show that something continues to happen for a long time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He worked away on the computer.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpabulus-bulus sikandin migtrabahu diyè te kumpyutir.

entries.summary: wasey; eg-awè wey egpapeeneng-eneng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a tool for cutting wood. It is made of a heavy piece of metal (with one sharp side) joined to a wooden handle.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a company axes jobs or a program, it removes or stops those things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The radio station axed its Saturday night program, because it wasn't very popular.

entries.summary: batè ne malalab pad; nati; piyak; itù; baketin; pispis; batè pad amana; nati pad amana; piyak pad amana; itù pad amana; baketin pad amana; pispis pad amana

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: batè ne malalab pad; nati; piyak; itù; baketin; pispis

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: batè pad amana; nati pad amana; piyak pad amana; itù pad amana; baketin pad amana; pispis pad amana

entries.summary: peka; ledled; peisues

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The back of a person or animal is the part of the body which is on the other side from the chest and stomach. The back of a thing is on the other side from the first or the most important side.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He carried his younger brother on his back.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I didn't see the writing on the back of the paper.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The back of something such as a room or building is the area which is far from the front.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The owner went to the back of the store.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggendiyè ka kamuney te ledled te tindaan [tinda͡an].

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you move back, you move in the opposite direction from the way you are facing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She moved back from the fire, because it was very hot.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-isues sikandin puun te hapuy, su amanan iiniti.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something comes or goes back to a place or state, they return to that place or state.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Vacation is finished, so we have come back to school.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Neimpusan e ka bakasiyun, sika ka miglibed key e te peg-iskuyla ney.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you do something back to someone, you do it to them because they did something to you first.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The boy called to his sister, and she called back to him.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka lukes ne batè mig-umew rin ka atebey rin, wey ka atebey rin mig-umew migbales diyè te kandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you back a team or player in a competition, you want that team to win, and may bet money.

entries.summary: dayan-dayan; keinniyuhan; ayatanan; bunsuranan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: When you are looking at things, the background is the part which is far from you, behind the other things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His paintings always have trees in the background.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka druwing din layun due me kayu ne dayan-dayan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is in the background, people are not looking at it or thinking about it much.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is very shy, and likes to stay in the background when there are visitors.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne hiilawen [hi͡ilawen] sikandin, wey layun diyè te egkeinniyuhan sikandin ke due me mahaliyug.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The background of a situation is the things which caused the situation.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Let me tell you the background of this problem, so that you will understand.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kema su egpangguhuran ka te bunsuranan te prublima, eyew egpakasabut ka.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka sitwasyun te pamilya, keugpè, idukasyun wey ke nabbaybayaan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your background is your family situation, social status, education or experience.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He's from a farming background, so he knows about rice.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due natuenan din te pegbasuk, sika ka egkateu sikandin meyitenged te palayan.

entries.summary: peisues; palibed; palilingey; nabalbalangan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone moves backward, they move in the opposite direction from the way they are facing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She fell over backward and landed on her back.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Napeled sikandin peisues wey nakaragsang ka peka rin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If the direction of something is towards the back, it is backward.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A backward person or place has ideas, technology or abilities that are less than other people or places have. (This is a negative word).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That child is quite backward: he is already three years old and he can't walk yet.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sika ne batè bayew nabalbalangan: tatelu e ne tuig sikandin ne kenè pad egpekeyipanew.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Tom's name is 'Mot' if you write it backwards.

entries.summary: mareet; mareet (meyitenged te etew wey ke himu); kenè egkateu

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I had a bad day today.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His exam results were quite bad.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is in a bad mood.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mareet (meyitenged te etew wey ke himu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A bad action is wrong, and a bad person does wrong things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He's done a lot of bad things in his life.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are bad at doing something, you do not have skill in doing that thing.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is bad for you, it hurts you somehow.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Eating a lot of salt is bad for you.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: naluhey e wey ke namewu e (meyitenged te keenen)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If food such as meat or vegetables is bad, you can't eat it because it is old and rotten.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Meat goes bad quickly in hot weather.

entries.summary: kabil; kemuyut; baag [ba͡ag]; sening; puntil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a soft thing which you carry other things in.

entries.summary: grupu te me baag [ba͡ag]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Baggage is a group of bags.

entries.summary: eggilutù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you bake something such as bread, you cook it in a closed box using hot air (an oven).

entries.summary: egtimbang-timbang; natimbang; egpekegtimbang; nekegtimbang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you balance something on another thing, you put it carefully on that thing so that it does not fall.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She balanced the large basket on her head.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtimbang-timbang din ka dakel ne liyang diyè te ulu rin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something balances on another thing, it stands on the other thing and does not fall.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Don't push the tall rock, because it is just balancing, and maybe it will fall over.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè nu tukua ka malayat ne batu, su natimbang dè seika, ne kema ke egkeulug.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two things balance each other, each one helps to support the weight of the other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If I carry one bag in my left hand, and one in my right hand, they will balance each other.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke eg-uyan a te kabil kayi te gibang ku, wey sabeka degma ne kabil kayi te kawanan, egpekegtimbang ka tagsè sabeka.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nekeg-eleg; egpekeg-eleg; nekegtupù; egpekegtupù; nekeg-iling; egpekeg-iling

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two things balance each other, they fit together well.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you eat unripe guava with salt, the taste is good because the different tastes balance each other.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke egkeen ka te meyilew ne beyabas ne eg-asinan, ka nanam meupiya su ka lein-lein ne nanam egpekeg-eleg te tagsè sabeka.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They are a great couple, as his sense of humor balances her seriousness.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Balance is a situation in which two or more things fit together well, and each one is important.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is important to find a good balance between work and family life.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne keilangan ne egpamitawen ka meupiya ne balansi diyè te himu wey pamilya.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: samè wey ke nahaat [naha͡at] ne seleppì

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the amount of money that you have after you have used some of it or added some more to it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has a balance of 1000 pesos in his bank account.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due samè din ne sabeka ne libu te tahuanan din diyè te bangku.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpegtupù te migligwang wey migseled ne seleppì; egpegtukmà

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In accounting, if you balance an account, you compare how much money has come into it and how much has gone out.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I always balance the accounts at the end of the month

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Layun a egpegtupù te migligwang wey migseled ne seleppì te tagsè pegkeimpus te bulan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpekeg-iling ka seleppì ne migligwang wey ka migseled

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an account balances, the amount of money that has come into the account is equal to the amount that has come out.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our accounts did not balance this month, because some of our customers did not pay their bills.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka listaan [lista͡an] warè nekeg-iling te seini ne bulan, su ka duma ne etew warè migbayad te bayaranen dan.

entries.summary: bula; malibusen ne minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a round thing, which is used for games.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: any round thing (e.g., a ball of rice).

entries.summary: mangulahing, grupu te

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of people playing certain musical instruments together. These are usually instruments such as guitars, drums or trumpets. There are sometimes singers too.

entries.summary: gumà; ka maluag wey ke malig-et ne mabatek ne lingya; katammanan ne taman dè te taliwarè te daruwa ne punduk: kenad egsubla wey kenad eg-isues.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a thin piece of material which you use to tie things together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She always ties her hair back with an elastic band.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Layun din egputusa ka bulbul din te gumà.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka maluag wey ke malig-et ne mabatek ne lingya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a wide or narrow line which is a different color or material from the things around it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The rainbow has seven bands of color.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka beluntu due pitu ne mallig-et ne batek ne nalingya.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: katammanan ne taman dè te taliwarè te daruwa ne punduk: kenad egsubla wey kenad eg-isues.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In physics, a band is a range of frequencies (e.g., radio waves) between one frequency and another.

entries.summary: kiddil; deisek ne lugar te matikang ne tanè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the land which makes the side of a river.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She jumped from the riverbank into the water.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: deisek ne lugar te matikang ne tanè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a small area of higher ground (natural or man-made).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a bank on the side of the new road, where they pushed the earth aside.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due deisek ne lugar diyè te ilis te kelesadda, ne diyè dan igdapig ka me tanè.

entries.summary: tahuanan wey angayanan te seleppì; bangku; egtahù te seleppì

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: tahuanan wey angayanan te seleppì; bangku

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an organization which looks after money. People can keep money there or borrow money.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have an account with Metrobank, and I put in money every month.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you bank money or a cheque, you take it to a bank to put it in a bank account.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He tries to bank part of his pay every month.

entries.summary: egbewutismu; pegbewutismu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone baptizes you, they put you under the water for a short time, or put water on your head. This is a sign of being joined to Jesus in his death, and a sign that your sins have been taken away.

entries.summary: makehal, matul-id ne putew wey ke kayu; atang; balabag; elang; egbalabag: eg-atang; egpakabalabag

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: makehal, matul-id ne putew wey ke kayu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a strong, straight piece of metal or wood.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There were bars on the window for safety.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which stops you from going into a place or doing something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is no bar on joining the team, so anyone can join.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something bars a place, they stop you from going in.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I tried to enter the room, but my brother barred the doorway.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggeram a migseled te sinabeng, piru ka suled ku mig-atang te gemawan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a rectangle-shaped block of something such as soap or chocolate.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: iinumanan (meyitenged te egpakatabeleg ne me inumen)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a place where people buy and drink drinks (usually alcoholic).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: immabalabag ne me sulat eyew egkeyimu ne me malig-et wey malayat ne me kehun ne diyè te musika

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Music is divided into short sections called bars. Each bar has a certain number of counts.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That piece of music is twenty bars long.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: grupu te me etew ne egkaayun ne egtrabahu te pegkaabugadu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The_Bar is the group of people who are allowed to work with the law.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He joined the Bar after he finished his legal exams.

entries.summary: talag-alut wey talag-awè te sumpè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person whose job is to cut the hair and shave the beards of men.

entries.summary: Egsabuten ke kamenu karakel ka igbehey, egkarawat, wey ke eggimuwen; eggangyuen; sabut te daruwa ne etew (ne ka tagsè sabeka egbehey wey ke egdawat te minsan nekey); impariisekan ka bali

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egsabuten ke kamenu karakel ka igbehey, egkarawat, wey ke eggimuwen; eggangyuen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you bargain with someone, you talk with them to decide how much each person should give, receive or do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When I go to the markets, I try to bargain with the stall owners so that I can get a cheaper price.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke eggendiya a te palingki, eggeraman ku te eggangyu ka kamuney te bangku eyew egpakakuwa a te baratu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sabut te daruwa ne etew (ne ka tagsè sabeka egbehey wey ke egdawat te minsan nekey)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an agreement between two people, in which each person gives or receives something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The two managers made a bargain that their businesses would each supply 50% of the money for the project.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something you paid a very good price for, because it was cheaper than usual.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I only paid thirty pesos for that T-shirt! It was a real bargain!

entries.summary: tahuanan te weyig ne hinimu puun te kayu wey lata; tubu te sinapang

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: tahuanan te weyig ne hinimu puun te kayu wey lata

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large, round container which usually holds liquid. It is made of pieces of wood joined together, or of metal.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The barrel of a gun is the long, round part which the bullet moves through.

entries.summary: lebut; igtubù; egpapuun; mig-ugpaan; migligkatan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the lowest part of something, the part which it sits or stands on (e.g., the base of a mountain, the base of a cup).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We camped near the base of the mountain, and climbed up the next day.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you base one thing on another thing, you make it by using or changing the other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He based his book on a true story.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpapuun din ka libru rin te malehet ne pangguhuren.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The base of a person or group is the place where they stay and do their work or organize their activities (e.g., an army base).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My son is in the army, and he lives at the army base.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mareet (meyitenged te himu wey ke geramen)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A base action or feeling is one that is not good or right.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Advertising often works on people's base instincts such as greed.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka keilangan amana ne butang eyew te peggimu te lein ne butang.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: When you mix things together to make something (e.g. a food, or a chemical), the base is the most important one of those things. You add the other things to the base.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This sauce uses tomatoes as a base.

entries.summary: kinewun-aan [kinewun-a͡an], keilangan ne malemu; lelemuwi wey duen dè keilangan ne egpakatahù; hun-a ne bali wey ke nakuwa ne seleppì ne warè labet te duma ne nakatimul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is basic, it is simple and necessary.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Food and shelter are basic human needs.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka keenen wey ugpaan ka kinewun-aan [kinewun-a͡an] ne me keilangan te me etew.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: lelemuwi wey duen dè keilangan ne egpakatahù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is basic, it is very simple, and only has what is necessary (e.g., a basic cellphone, a basic house).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Their house is quite basic, with very little furniture.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka baley ran su lelemuwi rè, ne duen dè deisek ne me tahù.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have a basic cellphone which doesn't have features such as a camera.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due lelemuwi ne silpun ku ne warè me impurtanti ne iling te kamira.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have some basic computer skills, but there is still a lot that I don't know.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka malemu wey keilangan dè ubag ka natuenan ku te kumpyutir, piru duen pad masulug ne warè ku pad natueni.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: hun-a ne bali wey ke nakuwa ne seleppì ne warè labet te duma ne nakatimul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A basic price or basic income does not include extra things such as tax or bonuses.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me kasangkapan ne malemu wey keilangan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The basics are simple and important things that you need.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She taught me the basics of the guitar, and then I just practiced by myself.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impanulù e rè nikandin te malemu wey keilangan te gitara, wey migbebasbas ad te keddì dè.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you are walking a long distance, just carry the basics with you, such as rice and water.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke eggipanew ka te mariyù, uyan ke rè te keilangan nu ne malemu, iling te weyig wey keenen.

entries.summary: mig-leb-eng wey ke migmasikeung ne lugar; tanè ne natalibubù ne nasahiliran te weyig, ne ka weyig te seini tanè eg-agas diyè te beuhan wey ke lanew; weyig ne natalibubù ne nasahiliran te tanè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large, round, open container. You use it for washing, holding water or mixing things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She washed her hands in the basin on the table.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggugasan din ka me belad din diyè te planggana ne diyè te dibabew te lamisa.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mig-leb-eng wey ke migmasikeung ne lugar

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an area of land which is lower than other areas.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our town is in a basin, so we have problems with flooding.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka lungsud ney migmasikeung, sika ka due prublima ney te laneg.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: tanè ne natalibubù ne nasahiliran te weyig, ne ka weyig te seini tanè eg-agas diyè te beuhan wey ke lanew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the area of land around a river or lake. The water from that land flows into the river or lake.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That stream is in the Salug river basin.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: weyig ne natalibubù ne nasahiliran te tanè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an area of water with land around part of it. Boats can stay there, because the land protects them.

entries.summary: puunanan; ligkatanan; aliddanan wey ke kamalehetan ne egpakabulig; nateil ne pamaahi te peggimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The basis of something is the thing which it comes from.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We used the old design as a basis for the new design.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Inggamit ney ka tapey ne pegkeyimu ne puunan te iyam ne eggimuwen.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: aliddanan wey ke kamalehetan ne egpakabulig

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The basis of an idea is the fact which supports it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: On the basis of her school results, I think she may get a scholarship.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te kamalehetan te risulta te iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an] din, egsuman-suman a ne egkeiskalar sikandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have checked their situation, and I don't think they have any basis for complaining.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is done on a particular basis, that is the way that it is done.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She works for me on a part-time basis.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtrabahu sikandin keddì te nateil rè ne timpu ne pamaahi.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We meet on a regular basis, once a week.

entries.summary: liyang; binenus; leban; tahakan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an open container which is made of strips of some material (e.g. cane, bamboo, plastic) woven together.

entries.summary: pamanihusan; eg-eeled ne pegpamanihus; eg-eleran wey ke eleranan (ne iling te weyig)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a very large open container which you put water in and sit in because you want to wash yourself.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action of sitting in a large, open container of water and washing yourself (have_a_bath).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It uses less water to have a shower than to have a bath.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpakahamit ka te de-deisek dè ne weyig ke eggamit ka te syawir du te eg-eeled ka.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-eleran wey ke eleranan (ne iling te weyig)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a liquid (e.g. a chemical) which you put something in.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In our science class, we soaked the coins in a bath of acid.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te sayans ne klasi ney, ig-eled ney ka me sinsilyu diyè te eleranan ne asid.

entries.summary: egpamanihus

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you bathe, you go swimming.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you bathe, you wash your body.

entries.summary: ehetayey ne eggamit te panganiban; eggeraman egpapeeneng-eneng wey ke egdereet; peggeram pegpapeeneng-eneng wey ke pegdereet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a fight between two groups using weapons

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Many men died in the battle between the rebels and the military.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Masalig ka nammatey te ehetayey te ribildi wey sundalu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you battle something (e.g., a fire), you fight it in some way or try to stop it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The men battled the fire which was destroying the house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggeraman te me etew te eg-ebuk ka hapuy ne egpakasilab te me baley.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A battle with something is the action of trying to stop or destroy it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Sadly, she lost her battle with cancer, and died.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne amana ne malised ne eggimuwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that is very difficult to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was so tired that it was a battle to keep my eyes open.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana a nabeley sika ka amana ne malised ka peggimelat te mata ku.

entries.summary: lanew ne due egkalihawangan te weyig; natahahè ne lugar eyew te nateil ne katuyuan; eggimuwen nu ne egpakasanggel ka minsan nekey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: lanew ne due egkalihawangan te weyig

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an area on the coast where the land curves in.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We put our raft in the small bay, because the waves weren't so strong there.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Intahù ney ka gakit diyè te deisek ne lanew, su ka balud diyè kenè ne makeseg.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: natahahè ne lugar eyew te nateil ne katuyuan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an area which has a certain purpose (e.g. a sick bay in a school for sick children; a loading bay outside a factory for trucks carrying products; a parking bay by the side of the road for vehicles).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggimuwen nu ne egpakasanggel ka minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you keep something at_bay, you make it stay away from you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He used his umbrella to keep the aggressive dog at bay.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Inggamit din ka payung eyew egpakasanggel ka egpangahat ne asu.

entries.summary: Egkahamit seini te egpegsumpul te me lalag eyew te pegbehey te timul pad ne katahaan [kataha͡an] te eglalahen. Sengekakuwa due 'su', wey sengekakuwa degma warè.; Egpangguhud seini te weil wey himu ne sasangan pad ne egkeyitabù kuntee.; Egkahamit seini te peglalag te himu ne inggimu e te senge etew.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini te egpegsumpul te me lalag eyew te pegbehey te timul pad ne katahaan [kataha͡an] te eglalahen. Sengekakuwa due 'su', wey sengekakuwa degma warè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use be to join the subject of a sentence with more information about the subject.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I will be at home tomorrow.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka baag [ba͡ag] ku su diyè te baley.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egpangguhud seini te weil wey himu ne sasangan pad ne egkeyitabù kuntee.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is_VERB-ing, it is happening now (be + VERB-ing = present progressive tense).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini te peglalag te himu ne inggimu e te senge etew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is_done, then someone or something does that thing (be + PAST PARTICIPLE = passive voice).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Three pigs will be killed tomorrow.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eggilangen kaaselem ka tatelu ne babuy.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A lot of rice is eaten here.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Dakel ne behas ka nakeen kayi.

entries.summary: tuktuk

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the hard, pointed mouth and nose of a bird.

entries.summary: tukeg; suley; manipis ne lingya te minsan nekey iling te layag wey ke kanekalan te ilitrik; egpapeendiyè te kanengnengan; egpanulud te kanengnengan; egpeparineg te kanengnengan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a long, straight piece of wood or metal, which usually supports the walls or roof of a building.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He bought some tin and nailed it to the beams of the roof.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbebeli sikandin te tingga wey inlasang din seini diyè te me tukeg te atep.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: manipis ne lingya te minsan nekey iling te layag wey ke kanekalan te ilitrik

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a thin line of something such as light or electrical energy.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My small flashlight only produces a thin beam.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka deisek ne ispat ku manipis dè ka layag.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpapeendiyè te kanengnengan; egpanulud te kanengnengan; egpeparineg te kanengnengan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a radio station beams information, it uses electronic equipment (e.g. satellite) to send the information.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Pictures of the disaster were beamed all over the world.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you beam, you smile very happily.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The child beamed at his aunt when she gave him the gift.

entries.summary: nasaamul ne igngaran te bengag, sitaw, tewuri wey duma pad

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nasaamul ne igngaran te bengag, sitaw, tewuri wey duma pad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Beans are the seeds or pods (seed cases) of some kinds of plants (e.g., legumes, coffee and cocoa).

entries.summary: egpekeeleg; egpekeuyan; eg-uyan; eglesutan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something bears another thing, it carries the weight of that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The bridge needs to be strong so that it can bear the weight of all the trucks that pass.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you bear something, you carry it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She came into the room bearing a cake.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a woman bears a child, she gives birth to it.

fields.label: English explanation
