fields.text: If a tree bears fruit, it produces fruit

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you bear something difficult or painful, you continue to live with that difficult thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can't bear that terrible noise! Please stop it!

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ku egkaantus ka kahulub! Sanggela niyud!

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We can't do anything about the bad weather, so we'll just have to bear it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè egkeyimu ta kayi te mareet ne timpu, eg-antusen te naan dè iya.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you bear left or bear right, you change your direction a little to the left or right.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The road bears left at the bottom of the hill.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kelesadda migsungkiyè te igkahibang te taliwarè te labuntud.

entries.summary: dakel ne mananap, mabehat ne due makepal ne bulbul

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: dakel ne mananap, mabehat ne due makepal ne bulbul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large, heavy animal with thick hair.

entries.summary: sumpè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the hair on the cheeks and chin of a man.

entries.summary: dakdakel wey ke kinadilikaduwan ne mananap

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: dakdakel wey ke kinadilikaduwan ne mananap

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an animal that is large or dangerous.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There aren't many wild beasts in Bukidnon any more, because the forest is much smaller.

entries.summary: egbahubal; egbahung; egpamayupes; egtepung (meyitenged te minsan nekey); eglampes; eggumi; egbahung; egbahubal (meyitenged te etew wey ke mananap); egkulibbul

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbahubal; egbahung; egpamayupes; egtepung (meyitenged te minsan nekey)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you beat something, you hit it many times.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She beat the blanket because it had a lot of dust in it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impamayupes din ka ulesen su due dakel ne alinepung.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He used a stick to beat the gong.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggamit sikandin te lampes te pegbahung te ahung.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eglampes; eggumi; egbahung; egbahubal (meyitenged te etew wey ke mananap)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you beat a person or animal, you hit them hard many times, maybe using a stick.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a kind man who never beats his children.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne meupiya sikandin ne etew su warad iya miglampes te me anak din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you beat a soft or liquid food such as eggs, you stir it very, very quickly.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as your heart beats, it makes a regular sound or movement.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was so scared that I could feel my heart beating loudly.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana a naaldek [na͡aldek] su narineg ku ka makeseg ne pegketu-ketu te pusung ku.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: makeseg, kenè dè ne manekal wey kenè dè man e ne mananey wey ke pegweil, labi en iya diyè te ulahingen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a strong, regular sound or movement, especially in music.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They clapped with the beat of the music.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you or your team beats another person or team in a game or competition, you win the game or get a better result than them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our school beat all the other schools in the intramural basketball competition.

entries.summary: meupiya ne egpitawen; mateles ne egpitawen; meupiya se batasan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: meupiya ne egpitawen; mateles ne egpitawen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something is beautiful, they are very nice to look at.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is a beautiful person, they are very kind and good.

entries.summary: kateles; keupiya; pegkameupiya; pegkamateles

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He walked in the garden, enjoying the beauty of the flowers.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The beauty of a situation is the things about it which are good.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The beauty of my job is that I can choose the hours that I work.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegkameupiya te trabahu ku su egpakaalam a te uras ke ken-u a egtrabahu.

entries.summary: su; uya su; tenged te

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use because to talk about the reason for something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I cooked because I was hungry.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use because_of before a noun, to talk about the reason for something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We were wet because of the rain.

entries.summary: egbaluy; egkabaluy; egkeyimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something becomes something, they change so that they are that thing.

entries.summary: lantawan; panggew; hibatanan; katri; tanè diyè te diralem te weyig, lanew wey ke dahat; patubuanan; similyaanan [similya͡anan]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a piece of furniture which you sleep on.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: tanè diyè te diralem te weyig, lanew wey ke dahat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the bottom of a river, lake or sea.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are many stones on the riverbed.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an area of ground for growing plants.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We have a flower bed in front of our house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due patubuanan ta te bulak te tangkaan te baley ta.

entries.summary: sinabeng; hibatanan

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have been here in Sinuda for ten years.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kayi a rengan te Sinuda te seled te sapulù ne tuig.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have never been to Palawan.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ware e pad iyam sukad nekeendiyè te Palawan.

entries.summary: te warè pad; te kenè pad; ne wey e pad; te kewun-aan [kewun-a͡an]; hun-a

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: te warè pad; te kenè pad; ne wey e pad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happens before a certain time or event, it happens earlier than that time or other event.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He left the house before I arrived.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakaawè sikandin te baley nè wey e pad nekeyinguma.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is before something else, it is in front of that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He stood before them and gave a speech.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migsasindeg sikandin te kewun-aan dan wey migbehey te pangasak.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something comes before something else, it is more important than that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My family comes before my work.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Hun-a ka pamilya ku du te trabahu ku.

entries.summary: egbunsud; egsugud; egpabunsud; egpasugud; kewun-aan [kewun-a͡an]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something begins to do something, they start to do it. If something begins, it starts to happen or exist.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It has already begun to rain.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you begin something, you cause it to start to happen or exist.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was late, so he missed the beginning of the meeting.

entries.summary: eggimu wey ke egweil te nateil ne pamaahi (meyitenged te batasan)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggimu wey ke egweil te nateil ne pamaahi (meyitenged te batasan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you behave a certain way, your actions are like that.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is behaving very strangely today. Do you know what the problem is?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Lein amana ka weil din kuntee. Nakataha ka ke nekey ka prublima rin?

entries.summary: pamaahi te peg-uyan te pegkeetew; pegbebatasan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pamaahi te peg-uyan te pegkeetew; pegbebatasan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: your behavior is the way that you act, and the things that you do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our teacher doesn't accept any bad behavior in class.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka talagpanulù ta kenè egkeupian te mareet ne batasan kayi te klasi.

entries.summary: te limang; te liyu; te keinniyuhan; namewuri

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: te limang; te liyu; te keinniyuhan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is behind something else, it is on the other side of it from where you are, and close to the back of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I keep my bike behind the house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggeles ku ka bayik ku diyè te keinniyuhan te baley.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are behind, you are late.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was sick and missed school, so I am behind with my study.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migderalu a wey wara ad nekeiskuyla, sika ka namewuri e ka peg-iskuyla ku.

entries.summary: minsan nekey ne neuyag
pegpalintutuu; pegtuu; migtuuwan

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She told me about her belief in God.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpanugtul sikandin meyitenged te pegtuu rin te Manama.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She told me about her religious beliefs.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpanugtul sikandin keddì meyitenged te migtuuwan din.

entries.summary: egpalintutuu; egtuu; egpalintutuu wey egsalig

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you believe someone, you think that their words are true. If you believe something, you think that it is true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He says that he didn't steal the money, and I believe him.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you believe_in someone or something that people can't see, you are sure that it is real.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you believe_in God, you think that what he says is true, and you depend on him.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you believe_in doing something, you think it is a good thing to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I believe in always telling the truth.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpalintutuu a te layun eglalag te malehet.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you believe_in someone, you think that they will be successful in doing something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Nobody thought that I could win the competition, but my father believed in me.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Wara a migsuman-suman ne egpanalu a te galew, piru ka amey ku due pegsalig keddì.

entries.summary: bagtingan; minsan nekey ne egdahing ne egbehey te katahaan [kataha͡an]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a hollow metal thing shaped like a cup. It has another piece of metal hanging inside. When the inside piece of metal hits the sides of the cup shape, it makes a noise.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne egdahing ne egbehey te katahaan [kataha͡an]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which makes a ringing or electronic sound to give a signal (e.g., doorbell, school bell).

entries.summary: sakup; para te nateil ne lugar wey ke eleg te nateil ne tahuanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something belongs to you, it is yours.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: keddiey ka sika ne me sepatus.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: para te nateil ne lugar wey ke eleg te nateil ne tahuanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something belongs in a place, that is the right place for it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Those plates belong in the box.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sika ne me platu diyè te tahuanan dan.

entries.summary: diddiralem; de-deisek te

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is below another thing, it is lower down than that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They sat on the mountain and looked down at the town below them.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpinnuu sikandan diyè te bubungan wey migpantew sikandan te nasud ne diddiralem din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a number or level is below another number or level, it is smaller than it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka timpiratura de-deisek te sapulù ne digri.

entries.summary: tabed; hakus; egkakanat ne pinegtupù eyew te pegpatileng te baad te mekina

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a narrow piece of material (such as leather) which you put around the top of your pants.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkakanat ne pinegtupù eyew te pegpatileng te baad te mekina

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a circle of flexible material that goes around and around to move things or parts of a machine.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In a generator, there is a belt that moves the fan to keep the generator cool.

entries.summary: egpepekù; egpekuen; pekù wey siku te minsan nekey iling te pahamayan ne weyig wey ke kelesadda

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you bend down or forward, you move the top part of your body so that you are not standing or sitting straight up.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She bent down to pick up a stone.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpepekù sikandin eyew te pegpurut te batu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you bend something, you cause it to be not straight.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She bent the stick until it broke.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impekù din ka tuked taman te nahepù.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you pick up something heavy, you should bend your knees, not your back.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke eggenat ka te minsan nekey ne mabehat, dapat ne egpekuen nu ka me buel nu, kenè ne peka nu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pekù wey siku te minsan nekey iling te pahamayan ne weyig wey ke kelesadda

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a corner or change of direction in something such as a river or road.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I couldn't see the house because of the bend in the road.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ku egkakita ka baley tenged te siku kayi te kelesadda.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This pipe is not straight because there is a bend in it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini ne tubù kenè ne matul-id su due pekù kayi.

entries.summary: te diralem; diddiralem se katenged; malmalepet se katenged; warè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is beneath another thing, it is under it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She keeps a bike beneath the house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Inggeles din ka bayik diyè te diralem te baley.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: diddiralem se katenged; malmalepet se katenged

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is beneath someone else, they have a less important rank or position than the other person.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our manager always shows respect to those beneath her in the company.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ahalen ney layun egpakita te peg-addat te diddiralem din se me katenged te kumpanya.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If doing something is beneath someone, they do not do it because they are too good or too important to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Cheating is beneath him because he is very honest.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè kandin ka pegpangupiya su amana sikandin ne buutan.

entries.summary: egkakuwa, egkaangey wey egkarawat ne bulig; egpakabulig; due egkakuwa ne bulig

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkakuwa, egkaangey wey egkarawat ne bulig

fields.label: English example
fields.text: One benefit of living in the mountains is the clean air.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sabeka ne binipisiyu ta ke diyè ki eg-ugpè te bubungan ka malinis ne kalamag.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something benefits you, it helps you or gives something good to you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you study hard now, it will benefit you in the future.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke amana ka egbebasbas, egpakabulig seini keuremè kuna.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you benefit from something, you receive something good from it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You will benefit from eating vegetables.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due egkakuwa nu ne bulig ke egkeen ka te gulay.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: bulig ne seleppì puun te gubirnu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: money which an organization or the government pays to you if you have a problem such as being sick.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The government paid a sickness benefit to the man.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something beneficial helps you and brings good things to you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Eating vegetables is beneficial for your health.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegkeen te gulay mabulig te peglelawa nu.

entries.summary: napeku

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of bend

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is bent, it is not straight.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Oh no, I dropped my fork, and now it's bent.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Etuwey, neulug ku ka tinidur ku, wey napeku e seini.

entries.summary: deisek ne malibusen ne prutas ne egtubù diyè te kayu wey ke palewuken

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: deisek ne malibusen ne prutas ne egtubù diyè te kayu wey ke palewuken

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a small round, fruit which usually grows on a tree or bush (e.g., mulberry, strawberry, blueberry).

entries.summary: te kiliran; te dulug; te hulid

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: te kiliran; te dulug; te hulid

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is beside another thing, it is close to the side of that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a mango tree beside our house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due kayu ne mangga diyè te kiliran te baley ney.

entries.summary: pinakameupiya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The best thing is the number one good thing in a group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is the best runner in the class.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sikandin ka pinakameupiya ne talaglingkesu te klasi.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That is the best thing to do, I think.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sika ka pinakameupiya ne butang ne eggimuwen, te puhawang ku.

entries.summary: me-meupiya; matmateles; neulian; egpameupiyeen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is better than another thing, it is more good than that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: These bananas are better than those bananas, because they are sweeter.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ne me sahing me-meupiya te seeyè ne me sahing, su memeemis seini.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is better, they are not sick any more.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was sick for a few weeks, but he's better now.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migderalu sikandin te miglihad ne me simana, piru neulian e sikandin kuntee.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you better something, you cause it to be more good than before.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He needs to study more to better his results.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ne egbebasbas sikandin eyew egmeupiya pad ka kapangkusan.

entries.summary: elat; taliwarè; te; nakapataliwarè; ke hendei

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something moves or is between two things, it is somewhere in the space that separates those two things

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpataliwarè sikandin migpinnuu te amey wey iney rin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happens between two people, they are both involved in that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was an argument between the two friends.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due apulanan te daruwa ne talag-alukuy.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use between to talk about different options when you need to choose.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You can only take one puppy, so you need to choose between them.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sabeka rè ka egkakuwa nu ne itu, sikan naa keilangan ne eg-alam ka ke hendei kandan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you divide something between two or more people, you give part of it to each person.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We divided the rice between the three of us.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Imbaad-baad tad te tatelu ka behas.

entries.summary: diyè pad dapit; diyè layun; te kewun-aan [kewun-a͡an] pad; warad labet; kenad ne amung

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: diyè pad dapit; diyè layun; te kewun-aan [kewun-a͡an] pad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is beyond another thing, it is further away from you than that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Look at those mountains far away, beyond the river.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Pitawa nu seeyè se me bubungan ne mariyù, diyè layun te pahamayan ne weyig.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is beyond another thing, it is outside the limits of that other thing, so that you can't reach or control it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That problem is beyond my control.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sika ne prublima kenad ne labet te pegbeye-beyè ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That field is beyond our land boundary, so it doesn't belong to us.

entries.summary: bisiklita; bayik; baskilita

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a vehicle with two wheels (one in front of the other) and no motor.

entries.summary: dakel; bubuyahen; keilangan; impurtanti

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He's one of the big leaders in this area.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sabeka sikandin ne penpenengan ne datu te seini ne inged.

entries.summary: bayaranen; egpabayad; hangyù te pegbalew-balew te balaud

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a piece of paper which shows how much money you need to pay for something (e.g., an electricity bill).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We get an electricity bill every month.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone bills you, they ask you to pay for something. They usually give you a piece of paper which shows how much you need to pay.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The builder billed us for his work on our house.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In a government law-making group, a bill is a formal request to change something in the law.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The politicians talked about a bill to make cigarettes more expensive.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In America and Canada, a bill is a piece of paper money (e.g. a twenty-dollar bill).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Sorry, I don't have any coins, only a fifty-peso bill.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: listahan te me etew ne egkunsirt wey ke listahan te minsan nekey ne igpakita ran

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a list of people who will perform at a concert, or a list of the things that they will perform.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are several famous singers on the bill for that concert.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you bill something as a certain thing, you advertise it so that people will think it is that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The advertisers billed the concert as 'the best concert of the year'.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka egmapeila-ila migpanengneng te ka kunsirt 'iyan kinameupiyaan ne kunsirt te tuig'.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a piece of paper with an advertisement or notice printed on it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You are not allowed to post bills on that wall.

entries.summary: tuktuk

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the hard, pointed mouth and nose of a bird.

entries.summary: gues
bayaku; tagbis; tinggew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an animal which has wings and feathers. It produces eggs and can usually fly.

entries.summary: peglesut; peg-anak; peglihawang; egligkatan ne egkeyimu; egpuunan ne egkeyimu; eglesutan; eg-anak

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the event of a baby coming out of a woman's body.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother nearly died during my birth.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka iney ku hapit egpatey te peg-anak keddiey.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egligkatan ne egkeyimu; egpuunan ne egkeyimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The birth of something new, such as an idea or political group, is the start of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That conversation was the birth of a great friendship.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seeyè ne pegpalallalahey ka migpuunan te meupiya ne pegpaal-alukuyey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a woman gives_birth to a baby, the baby comes out of her body.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My sister gave birth to her first child last Friday.

entries.summary: aldew ne neetawan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A person's birthday is the date each year which is the same as the date when they were born.

entries.summary: baad; kinareisekan ne kanengnengan (diyè te kumpyutir); deisek ne karakelan

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I had a bit of her birthday cake.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due baad ku te kik te seeyè se aldew ne neetawan din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In maths and computer studies, a bit [b(inary + dig)it] is a basic unit of information. It can be marked as 0 or 1.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I just want a bit of rice, not too much.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian e rè te deisek dè ne hemey, kè dè ne dakel.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: bayew; deisek dè; kenè dè amana

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use a_bit to say that something doesn't happen very much, or is not very strong.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm a bit tired, but I'm okay.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Bayew a nabeley, piru warè prublima.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We talked a bit, but we were very tired, so we went to sleep quickly.

entries.summary: kakang; rinda; iglungag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a small metal bar which you put in a horse's mouth to control the horse when you are riding.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a piece of metal which you put in a tool such as a drill. When the drill turns the bit, the bit makes holes in things.

entries.summary: egkahat
mapeit iling te keenen wey ke me egkekeinum (iling te muti wey ke kalangyawan); pabulus ne nasakitan wey egkabelu meyitenged te miglihad ne neyitabù

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mapeit iling te keenen wey ke me egkekeinum (iling te muti wey ke kalangyawan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a strong taste that is not sweet.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pabulus ne nasakitan wey egkabelu meyitenged te miglihad ne neyitabù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is bitter about something that happened in the past, they continue to be hurt and angry about it.

entries.summary: meitem; mareet-deet (meyitenged te sitwasyun)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A black situation is very bad.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When his wife became very sick, his situation looked quite black for a while.

entries.summary: galang; maluag ne iling te dewun; kaluahan; dewun; labed

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The blade of something such as a knife is the sharp side of it which you can use to cut things.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: maluag ne iling te dewun; kaluahan; dewun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The blade of something such as an oar or leaf is the flat part.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Most electric fans have three or four blades which turn quickly.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a piece of grass or similar plant.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: After I sat on the grass, there was a blade of grass stuck on my leg.

entries.summary: egsendit
egbaley-baley te Manama; pegbaley-baley te Manama

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person blasphemes, they say bad things about God, or they say that they have power and authority that only God has.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of bleed

entries.summary: eglangesa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or animal bleeds, blood comes from a part of their body.

entries.summary: egpanalanginan te Manama ka senge etew; egpanalangin te senge etew (meyitenged te pegbuyù te meupiya ne umul te senge etew diyè te Manama); egpanalangin te minsan nekey (meyitenged te pegbuyù te Manama ne seini due meupiya wey ke due mateles ne kapabulusan)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpanalanginan te Manama ka senge etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If God blesses you, he causes your life to be good.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpanalangin te senge etew (meyitenged te pegbuyù te meupiya ne umul te senge etew diyè te Manama)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you bless someone, you ask God to make their life good.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpanalangin te minsan nekey (meyitenged te pegbuyù te Manama ne seini due meupiya wey ke due mateles ne kapabulusan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you bless something, you ask God to make it good or successful.

entries.summary: keilangan ne egpakarawat sikandin te pegdayan wey pegsimba te me etew (meyitenged te Manama); egdayanen; egsayeen; egpanalanginan te Manama; due kalinew wey keupianan te etew

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: keilangan ne egpakarawat sikandin te pegdayan wey pegsimba te me etew (meyitenged te Manama); egdayanen; egsayeen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you say that God is blessed, you mean that people should praise and worship him.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person is blessed, God has done good things for them.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due kalinew wey keupianan te etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you say that a person is blessed, you mean that they have peace, and all is good with them.

entries.summary: butud; egpakabutud; egpakapabutud; egpakasilang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A blind person or animal can't see.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something blinds you, it causes you to be unable to see.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The bright sun blinded me so that I couldn't see anything.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakapabutud keddì ka ne kena a egpakakita te minsan nekey.

entries.summary: nakehun ne butang ne hinimu iling te simintu ne eggamiten diyè te baley; dakel wey malayat ne baley wey kenè ne sabeka rè ne andanas; nalibulung ne me baley ne nakataliwarè te hep-at ne kelesadda ne nakehun

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nakehun ne butang ne hinimu iling te simintu ne eggamiten diyè te baley

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a square or rectangular thing, made of something such as concrete, and used in building.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: dakel wey malayat ne baley wey kenè ne sabeka rè ne andanas

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large, tall building with more than one floor (e.g., an apartment block).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nalibulung ne me baley ne nakataliwarè te hep-at ne kelesadda ne nakehun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of buildings in a city with four roads around them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The pharmacy is two blocks from here.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a fairly small area of land (e.g., a piece of land that you can buy).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He bought a block of land, but he hasn't built a house there yet.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing blocks another thing, it stops that other thing from moving past it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The stone blocked the pipe, so the water couldn't flow.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka tubù nasengsengan te batu, sika ka weyig kenè eg-agas.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something blocks another thing, it is in front of that thing so that you can't see it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can't see the TV screen, because my father's chair is blocking my view.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you block someone from going into a place, you stand in front of them so that they can't go in.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I tried to go into the room, but he blocked me because he didn't want me to enter.

entries.summary: langesa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the liquid which moves around inside the body of humans and animals.

entries.summary: eggiyup; egpangalamag; eglayap

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you blow something, you push air out through your lips towards that thing.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If the wind blows, air moves from one place to another.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something blows in the wind, the wind is moving it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The flag is blowing in the wind.

entries.summary: pegsumbag; mareet ne hitabù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action of someone or something hitting another person or thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A blow to the head can be dangerous.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something bad that happens and causes you to feel very disappointed.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Losing his job was a terrible blow.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegkatarini rin te trabahu amana ne mareet ne hitabù.

entries.summary: egpalayang; egpabetu; egbutu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you blow something up (e.g., a balloon), you fill it with air.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you blow something up, you cause it to explode by using fire with something such as gas or petrol.

entries.summary: meilem (ne iling te batek te langit)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: meilem (ne iling te batek te langit)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the color of the sky when there are no clouds.

entries.summary: malayat wey maluag ne immanipis te pegsapsap ne kayu eyew egmapatag para te baley; tabla; punduk ne due katenged diyè te kumpanya; eg-ugpè diyè te kenè ne baley nu (wey egbayaran nu)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: malayat wey maluag ne immanipis te pegsapsap ne kayu eyew egmapatag para te baley; tabla

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a long, wide piece of wood that has been cut to make it flat. Used in building.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The walls of my house are made of boards.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: punduk ne due katenged diyè te kumpanya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of people who control a company or organization, or who have some special responsibility.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The board of directors will decide about that.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-ugpè diyè te kenè ne baley nu (wey egbayaran nu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you board somewhere that is not your home, you pay to live and eat there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I boarded with my aunt and uncle when I was a high school student.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the money which you pay to live at a place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The board at that place is quite cheap, and it is a good boarding house.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you board a public transport vehicle such as a bus or airplane, you enter that vehicle.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She boarded the bus and paid the conductor.

entries.summary: egpeyidalig; egpaambug [egpa͡ambug]; hambug; due nateil ne butang (te lugar)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you boast, you talk about things that you have or do, so that other people will think you are good.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: People don't enjoy talking to him, because he is always boasting about his money.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me etew kenè egkahalè ne egpakiglalag kandin, su layun egpaambug [egpa͡ambug] [egpa͡ambug] sikandin meyitenged te seleppì din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something good which you say about yourself or your things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He makes many boasts about his abilities, but he never does anything.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Masalig ka hambug din meyitenged te katuenan din, piru warad iya neyimu rin minsan sabeka.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a place or thing boasts certain good things, it has those things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our province boasts many beautiful mountains and waterfalls.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka prubinsya ney due masalig ne memeupiya ne me bubungan wey me sampew.

entries.summary: balangey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a thing which can travel on water, and which has sides (it is not flat like a raft).

entries.summary: lawa; minatey; lawa te minsan nekey (meyitenged te ka kinarakelan wey kineelatan)

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They buried the body at the cemetery.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: lawa te minsan nekey (meyitenged te ka kinarakelan wey kineelatan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The body of something is the main part of it that is in the center (e.g., the body of a car)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kinarakelan wey ke nalibulung ne karakelan te minsan nekey (e.g., lawa te weyig wey ke kanengnengan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large amount of something all together (e.g., information, water).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: An ocean is a large body of water.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka dahat su ka kinarakelan ne lawa te weyig.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nateil ne grupu te me etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a particular group of people (it may or may not be an official group).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A large body of people helped with the work.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka dakel ne grupu te me etew migbulig te trabahu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She joined a local government body which helped students.

entries.summary: egkalè-kalè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a liquid boils, it moves and has bubbles in it because it is very hot.

entries.summary: buu; kebbulutut

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a painful, red swelling on the skin with a hard centre made of pus (a thick, white liquid).

entries.summary: egpegdekket; egpegsumpul; egkalayam; mapahetpet ne eggeramen te geyinawa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something bonds two things together, it causes them to stick or join together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The glue bonded the two pieces of paper together.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka parekket migpegdekket te daruwa ne buuk ne pepil.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you bond with someone, you start to have a close relationship with them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A baby bonds with its mother quickly.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka batè mahaan dè egkalayam te iney.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a strong feeling of love, friendship or togetherness between people.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a strong bond between my brothers and me.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due mapahetpet ne geyinawa ney te tahasuled.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: things which tie you up (like rope around your hands or feet).

entries.summary: tul-an; bekeg

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a hard thing inside the body of a person or animal which supports the body. All the bones together are called the skeleton.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was wearing a ring made of bone.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migsaluub sikandin te sising ne hinimu te tul-an.

entries.summary: libru; egnangen egpewun-a; egkabuyuan te bayad puun te pegpakasalè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something made of pieces of paper joined together at one side, inside a cover. You usually read it or write in it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you book something such as transport or entertainment, you organize it or buy a ticket because you want to use or do it later.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm planning to go to Manila next week, and I'm going to book a room at a hotel there today.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egsuman-suman a ne eggendiyè te Menila te seup ne simana, wey egnangen a egpewun-a te sinabeng te hireheanan ne baley diyè para keddiey.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkabuyuan te bayad puun te pegpakasalè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a police officer or sports referee books you for doing something wrong, they write down your information and give you a penalty (e.g., money that you need to pay).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was booked for driving too fast.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nabuyuan sikandin te bayad puun te meiyal ne pegpapallahuy te terak.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: dukumintu ne egpakita te seleppì ne naangey wey ke nahamit, wey ke me listaan [lista͡an] te me etew ne due kalabetan te urganisasyun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the documents which show the money that an organization has received or used, or the list of people who have a relationship with that organization.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That hairdressing salon has three hundred customers on their books.

entries.summary: eletanan; lingya wey ke ingkulung ne nakasahilid diyè te sidsid wey ke ilis te minsan nekey; nekegdulug; nekegdani

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the political line between two countries or areas.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She lives close to the border of Bukidnon and Cotabato.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-ugpè sikandin diyè te marani te eletanan te Bukidnun wey Kutabatu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: lingya wey ke ingkulung ne nakasahilid diyè te sidsid wey ke ilis te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a line or band around the edge of something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her skirt had a colorful border along the bottom of it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka saya rin due bebateki ne lingya diyè te diralem.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one region borders another region, it is beside that region.

entries.summary: kenè egkabennalan; kenè egkeupian; kenad egkamalehetan; warè geyinawa; kenè ne intirisadu; egpakaawè te bagget

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè egkabennalan; kenè egkeupian; kenad egkamalehetan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something bores you, you do not like it because it is very uninteresting.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you feel bored, you feel very uninterested.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something is boring, they cause you to feel bored.

entries.summary: eglulungag; egbubutbut; lungag ne maralem;

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you bore a hole in or through something hard, you make a hole.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a deep hole which people make in the ground. They are often looking for things such as oil or water.

entries.summary: egsambey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you borrow something that belongs to another person, you use it for some time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Can I please borrow your cellphone, because I have no load.

entries.summary: warè tapid; langun; elin tapid

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use both to talk about the two members of a group of two.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can't choose one of them, because I like both.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè tapid egsamilian ku kandan, sika ka warè sabeka ne eg-alamen ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Both my wife and I like gardening.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Both of my parents are old now.

entries.summary: butilya; igtahù te butilya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a glass or plastic container with a narrow top. It is usually for liquids.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you bottle something, you put it in bottles.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They bottle the spring water at the factory.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Immanahù dan te butilya ka egkeinum ne weyig diyè te kumpanya.

entries.summary: lebut; igtubù; diralem te weyig (ka egkasadsad tad ne tanè wey batu); piyus

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The bottom of something is the lowest part of it, or the part which it sits or stands on.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: diralem te weyig (ka egkasadsad tad ne tanè wey batu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The bottom of a body of water such as the sea or a river is the ground under the water.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can see my ring there on the bottom of the river.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkakita ka sising ku diyè te diralem te weyig.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your bottom is your buttocks, the part of the body which you sit on.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I've been sitting down for many hours, so my bottom is sore.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Dakel ne uras ka pegpinnuu ku, sika ka masakit e ka piyus ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of buy

entries.summary: tammanan wey ke eletanan te lugar

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: tammanan wey ke eletanan te lugar

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The boundary of an area is the edge of it, the line between that area and other areas.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That tree is inside the boundaries of the school, so it belongs to the school.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sika ne kayu nakaseled e te eletanan te iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an], su iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an] e ka kamuney due.

entries.summary: piet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a weapon used for shooting arrows. It is made of a long, strong piece of wood and a piece of string.

entries.summary: hun-aan [hun-a͡an] ne baad te bangka

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The bow of a boat is the front of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She sat in the bow of the boat so that she could see clearly.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpinnuu sikandin diyè te hun-aan [hun-a͡an] ne baad te bangka eyew egpakita sikandin.

entries.summary: eg-unduken ka ulu wey ke egpekuen ka dibabew ne baad te lawa (eyew te pegpakita te peg-addat)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-unduken ka ulu wey ke egpekuen ka dibabew ne baad te lawa (eyew te pegpakita te peg-addat)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you bow, you bend part of your body (e.g. your head, upper body) forward. Often this is to show respect.

entries.summary: masikeung ne platu; yahung
kehun; kaban; kehun (ne migsulat wey ke migdruwing); inteil ne deisek ne sinabeng iling te galawan wey ke papitawanan te me katuenan ne deisek dè ne me etew ka egkaayun ne egpatahù ne egtengteng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a square or rectangle on a piece of paper.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Write your name in the box at the top of the page.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Isulat nu ka ngaran nu sika te kehun ne dibdibabew te pahina.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: inteil ne deisek ne sinabeng iling te galawan wey ke papitawanan te me katuenan ne deisek dè ne me etew ka egkaayun ne egpatahù ne egtengteng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a special room in a building such as a sports stadium or theatre, where a small group of people can watch.

entries.summary: lukes (kenè pad ne buyag); lukes-lukes

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a male human who is not yet an adult.

entries.summary: utek

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the body organ in the head of person or animal, which controls the whole body.

entries.summary: sugpang; egsusugpang; egbebalakan; egsusuwayan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a long, thin part of a bush or tree is which grows out of the main part in the middle.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a tree branches, it divides into two or more smaller parts.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a road branches, it divides into two roads.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The road branched in two, and I took the left path.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kelesadda migbebalakan, wey diya a migbayè te igkahibang.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a river branches, it divides into two smaller rivers.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: baad te kinarakelan te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one of the parts of something larger.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Botany is a branch of science.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka peg-iskuyla te me baad te pinamula baad te sayans.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sugpang ne upisina wey ke grupu ne baad te kinarakelan ne upisina wey ke grupu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an office or groups that is part of a larger organization.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We went to the Davao branch of the national transport authority.

entries.summary: mabulut
paan [pa͡an]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a cooked food made from flour.

entries.summary: kaluag puun te tagsè ilis

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The breadth of something is how big it is from one side to the other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The breadth of the field is 10 meters.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sapulù ne mitrus ka kaluag te kamet din.

entries.summary: egkatebì; egkaperi; egkabuang; egkabugtus; egtebì; egperi; egbuang; egbugtus; nalepuan wey ke nabagbahan ne baad te te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something breaks, it becomes two or more pieces (e.g., a plate, a rope)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you break something, you cause it to become two or more pieces, but you do not use something sharp to cut it.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nalepuan wey ke nabagbahan ne baad te te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the place where the two pieces of something broke.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When she broke her arm, the break was just near her wrist.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te nalepuan ka belad din, ka nalepuan diyè te marani te palad din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a machine breaks, it doesn't work any more because it is damaged.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The Xerox machine broke because too many people used it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you break something such as a machine, you damage part of it so that it doesn't work.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He broke my toy car, and now the wheels don't turn!

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you break a rule or law, you do the thing that it says not to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: One job of the police it to catch people who break the law.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a time of stopping an activity because you want to rest (take_a_break, have_a_break).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We've been walking for hours! We need to take a break.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggipanew key te hep-at ne uras! Keilangan key ne eggimeley te deisek.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people or events break you, they cause your mind and emotions to become very weak, so that you can't do what you want to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The kidnappers tried to break the hostages by not giving them food.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me kidnapir miggeraman te egpahuyè te immangustid dan te warè pegbehey te keenen kandan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you break bad news to someone, you tell them the news.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She broke the news about his father's death.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Inpanugtul rin ka aliddanan te pegkapatey te amey rin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something breaks your fall, you hit the ground more softly, because you hit the other thing first.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He wasn't badly injured, because the bush broke his fall.

entries.summary: lem-ag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning.

entries.summary: geyinawa; peggelut (meyitenged te peggeheyinawa)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the air that goes into or comes out of someone's mouth.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She has fresh breath because she just brushed her teeth.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due meupiya ne ngareg te geyinawa rin su migpanupbras sikandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a single action of taking air into your body (take_a_breath).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He took a big breath and then jumped into the water.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggeheyinawa sikandin te dakel wey pegkeimpus mig-umbetut e diyè te weyig.

entries.summary: eggeheynawa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you breath, air comes into and goes out of your body through your mouth and nose.

entries.summary: malumamey ne hiyup te kalamag
dasag te pegpeyimu te mareet
egpanuul
kehun ne hinimu puun te malamiyak ne basak ne impahangu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kehun ne hinimu puun te malamiyak ne basak ne impahangu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a rectangular block which is made of baked or dried clay

entries.summary: teytey; tulay; ayatanan; egpegsumpul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which is above a river or road, and which you use to cross from one side to the other.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: someone or something which helps to make the difference or disagreement between two people, groups or things smaller.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That organization is a bridge between indigenous groups and the government.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sika ne grupu iyan ayatanan te samuk te me lumad wey te gubirnu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something bridges the gap between two different people, groups or things, it makes the difference or disagreement between them smaller.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Your field study days help to bridge the gap between theory and practice.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka keykew ne pegtuun te me aldew nakabulig te egpegsumpul te sinuman-suman wey ka miggimu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the hard part at the top of your nose.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: saliyu ne ngipen (kenè ne malehet ne ngipen)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a plate with artificial teeth, which you attach to other teeth.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She lost her front teeth in an accident, so she wears a bridge.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nalingab sikandin te naaksidinti rin, sika ka migsaluub sikandin te pustisu.

entries.summary: mahaan dè; egpanudtul eyew te pegpanulù; himuwen ne keilangan ne eggimuwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is brief, it only happens for a short time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We had a brief lunch break, but quickly went back to work.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mahaan dè ka pegpaniudtu ney, wey miggaan-gaan key miglibed te himu ney.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you brief someone, you tell them the things they need to know before they do a particular thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our teacher briefed us about how to do our project.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impanudtulan key te talagpanulù ney ke egmenuwen ney te peggimu ka pruyiktu ney.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a particular thing that you have to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The brief of the Peace and Order Officer is to keep the Barangay safe.

entries.summary: masil-ew; malayag (meyitenged te batek); matagseb

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a light is bright, it is very strong.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We can't look at the sun because it is very bright.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ki egpakatengteng te aldew su amana ne masil-ew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a color is bright, it is strong and colorful (e.g., red, yellow), and not pale or dark.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I like bright colors like red and yellow, not dark colors like black and brown.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian a te mallayag ne batek iling te malalab wey makalawag, kenè ne maddusilem ne batek iling te meitem wey meebul.

entries.summary: egpalayahen
eg-uyan; egdumeen [egdume͡en]; egpakabehey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you bring something to a person or place, you come to that person or place carrying it with you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He brought me some vegetables from his garden.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-uyanan a nikandin te me gulay puun te pamulaan din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you bring someone to a place, you cause them to come with you to that place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If your friends from Cagayan visit you, bring them here to my house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Emun ke egpanumbaley ka me alukuy nu ne egpuun te Kagayan, dumaa [duma͡a] nu sikandan kayi te baley ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something brings you another thing, it causes you to have or experience that thing.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegbasa amana egpakabehey te kahalaan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Stealing will only bring you trouble.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggimuwen ka minsan nekey peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te nateil ne sitwsyun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you bring something to a particular state, you cause it to be in that state.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The driver brought the jeepney to a stop.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka drayibir impasanggel din ka dyip.

entries.summary: dakel; maluag; dakel se igpasabut

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something broad has a large measurement from one side to the other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has very broad shoulders, so it's hard for him to find shirts which fit him.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amanan derakel se pamanayen din, sika ka malised kandin ka pegpamitew te kumbalè ne eg-eleg kandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a subject is broad, it includes many things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The word 'meupiya' has a very broad meaning.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka lalag na 'meupiya' due dakel ne igpasabut.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our course was very broad, so we studied many different things.

entries.summary: igpataha
nahepu; nareetan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is broken, it is in pieces or doesn't work.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The seat is broken, so you can't sit on it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pinnuuwan su nareetan e, sika ka kene nud egkapinnuuwan seini.

entries.summary: suled

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your brother is a male with the same mother and father as you.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of bring

entries.summary: meebul ne egmakalawag; bayew meitem
bras; egbras; egpakapunas; egpakasahid; egpakakaras; egpakaragket

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a thing with thin, flexible pieces of material (such as hair) joined to a handle. It can be used for things such as cleaning or painting (e.g., paintbrush, hairbrush, toothbrush).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you brush something, you use a brush (see 1) to do something to it (e.g., brush your teeth).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something brushes another thing, it touches that thing lightly and quickly while it is passing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The leaf brushed my face as it fell down.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakasahid pad ka dewun te ulaula ku te pegkeulug diyè te tanè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you brush something off another thing, you you use a quick, light movement of your hand to remove it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She brushed the ant off my arm.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ingkeyis din ka iteng pekeiyali diyè te belad ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you have a brush with someone, you have a short, bad experience with them (usually an argument).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I had a brush with my supervisor this morning, but we are okay now.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due samuk ney te ahalen ku kuntee te maselem, piru nekeg-ayuney key kuntee.

entries.summary: sakug; baldi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a round container with a handle. It is used to carry things, especially water.

entries.summary: eggimuwen; egparakelen; egpatulinen; egdakel; egkapunpun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you build something such as a table or house, you make it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you build something such as a friendship or business, you do things to cause it to grow.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He worked hard to build his business.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as noise or dust builds, or builds_up, it increases or grows.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The noise built and built until it was very loud.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is so dusty here near the highway! The dust builds up on everything.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your build is the shape of your body (e.g., slim, average, athletic)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of build

entries.summary: punpun; bagkes; grupu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a number of things joined together somehow.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: a bunch of flowers, a bunch of bananas.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: senge bagkes te me bulak, senge punpun te sahing

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I invited a bunch of friends around for dinner.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-imbitar a te grupu te me alukuy ku eyew te iglabung.

entries.summary: binagkes; egbagkesen; impanines; immanines

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a number of things tied together (e.g., a bundle of sticks, a bundle of clothes).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you bundle things, you put them together in a bundle (see 1).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He bundled up his papers and walked out of the room.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impanines din ka me pepil rin wey migligwang e te sinabeng.

entries.summary: peglebeng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of burying something, or burying a dead person.

entries.summary: egkalegleg; egkatutung te hapuy; egsilab; egtutung

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a fire burns, there is a fire.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a fire burning in the fireplace.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something burns, it has fire on it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The wood in the fireplace is burning.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you burn something, you destroy it with fire.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We burn our rubbish in the afternoons.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkatutung te kimikal wey ke meinit; egkaluwasan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you burn part of your body, you hurt it with a chemical or something hot, such as fire.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I burned my fingers on the hot pot.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a painful part of your body where a chemical or something hot has hurt it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She had bad burns on her leg.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a machine burns something such as diesel, it uses that thing to make power or energy.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The generator burns a lot of diesel.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka diniritur nakahamit te dakel ne kurudu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggalin egtahù te me kanengnengan puun te kumpyutir pendiyè te CD

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you burn information onto a compact disk, you save the information on the disk using a computer.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She burned the files onto a disk.

entries.summary: natutung

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of burn. You can also use burned

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is burnt, it has been damaged by fire, sun, a chemical, or something hot.

entries.summary: iglebeng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you bury something, you put it in a hole in the ground and cover it with earth. This includes a dead person.

entries.summary: dakel ne terak wey due masalig ne me pinuuwan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: dakel ne terak wey due masalig ne me pinuuwan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large public transport vehicle which drives on roads and has many seats.

entries.summary: klasiyan te pinamula ne deisek wey amana ne sugpangen; kalandihan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: klasiyan te pinamula ne deisek wey amana ne sugpangen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a small plant which has many wooden branches.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In some countries, the part of a country with a lot of trees, and not many people, is called the_bush.

entries.summary: himu ne due kalabetan te pegbelegyè wey pegbebeli; kumpanya eyew te pegpameligyè; nateil ne hitabù wey sitwasyun

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: himu ne due kalabetan te pegbelegyè wey pegbebeli

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: work which is connected to buying and selling things and services.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He works in business, so he travels to visit different companies.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a company which sells things or services.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The crime was a terrible business.

entries.summary: nigusyanti
warè timpu su masalig se himu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: warè timpu su masalig se himu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are busy, you don't have free time because you have many things to do.

entries.summary: piru; warè labet; gawas (egkahamit seini ke due kenè ig-apil)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use but when two things are different, or when they don't fit together somehow.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father likes dancing, but my mother doesn't (like it).

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka amey ku egkeupian ne egsayew, piru ka iney ku kenè egkeupian.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is old, but he is still very strong.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: warè labet; gawas (egkahamit seini ke due kenè ig-apil)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use but to say that something is not included.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: All but two of us rode the bus.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka langun gawas kanta te daruwa mig-untud te terak.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have sold all but one of my puppies, and I plan to keep him.

entries.summary: mewumel wey makalawag ne pegkeen ne hinimu puun te gatas ne igpanalagtag te paan [pa͡an] wey eggamiten diyè te pegsusubba; egtalagtahan wey ke egtahuan ka paan [pa͡an] te makalawag ne pegkeen ne hinimu puun te gatas

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mewumel wey makalawag ne pegkeen ne hinimu puun te gatas ne igpanalagtag te paan [pa͡an] wey eggamiten diyè te pegsusubba

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a soft, yellow food made from milk, which you can spread on bread or use in cooking.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egtalagtahan wey ke egtahuan ka paan [pa͡an] te makalawag ne pegkeen ne hinimu puun te gatas

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you butter something such as bread, you spread butter on it.

entries.summary: kalibangbang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an flying insect with a small body and colored wings.

entries.summary: tipey; butinis; egpegtipey; impegbutunis

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a small, round thing which you use to attach one part of your clothes to another part.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you button something, or button_up something, you join two parts of it together with buttons.

entries.summary: egbebeli; egpalit

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you buy something, you pay money to get it.

entries.summary: te, ni (meyitenged te kasangkapan wey ke etew ne eggimu); pinaahi te; nakarani-rani; te kiliran; te dulug; te hulid

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: te, ni (meyitenged te kasangkapan wey ke etew ne eggimu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is done by someone or something, they do that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This farm was made by my brother.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ne daag [da͡ag] ingkamet te suled ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use by to talk about the way or method that you use to do something.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekeyinguma a kayi pinaahi te terak.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nakarani-rani; te kiliran; te dulug; te hulid

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is by another thing, it is beside it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The gym is by the Barangay hall.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka gehalawan ne baley su nakarani-rani te Baranggay hul.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something moves by another thing, it passes that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She didn't see me, and just walked straight by.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè nakakita sikandin keddì, wey inliharan e rè nikandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you will do something by a particular time in the future, you will do it before that time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You must finish the test by 11 o'clock.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impusi nu ka tis te kenè pad ka alas unsi.

entries.summary: kulukug (para te bayaku); salawwew (para te manuk); kulungan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kulukug (para te bayaku); salawwew (para te manuk); kulungan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a container made of long pieces of metal or wood with spaces between them. It is usually used to keep animals or birds inside.

entries.summary: pegkeen ne hinmu puun te harina wey ke binlud

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegkeen ne hinmu puun te harina wey ke binlud

entries.summary: pegtaha te minsan nekey eyew egkaseel

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegtaha te minsan nekey eyew egkaseel

entries.summary: pegseel
kasangkapan eyew te pegpaneel
lissen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the back of the lower part of your leg.

entries.summary: nati ne baka
eg-umew (meyitenged te peg-umew ne igpamalukan); umew; eg-umew te tilipunu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you call, you speak loudly so that people who are not close to you can hear you, or so that they will come to you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They knocked on the door and called, but nobody answered them.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a sound of speaking loudly so that people can hear you or will come to you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I heard calls, but I didn't see anybody.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you call someone, you dial their phone number so that you can speak to them on the phone.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpeumew te me etew eyew te kalibulungan te inteil ne timpu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you call a meeting, you make a meeting time and ask people to come.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you call someone or something a name, you give them that name. If you call them something (e.g., a liar), you say that they are that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I am very upset because my friend called me a liar.

entries.summary: kalma
kamira

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a small machine which is used to take photographs.

entries.summary: egkukutè; egpanggirehè diyè te kutè; egkakampu; kutè; girehaan; kampu; kalibulungan eyew te peggehalew wey peggale-galè te me pila ne aldew

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkukutè; egpanggirehè diyè te kutè; egkakampu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you camp somewhere, you stay there for a short time, sleeping in tents.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We camped next to the river because we were far from home.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migkukutè key diyè layun te pahamayan ne weyig su mariyù key te baley.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a place where people are staying in tents.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We made our camp next to the river.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggimu ney ka kutè ney diyè layun te pahamayan ne weyig.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
