fields.text: kalibulungan eyew te peggehalew wey peggale-galè te me pila ne aldew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an event where people stay at a place for a number of days and do various activities.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I enjoyed our youth camp, because we played many games.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nahala a te kalibulungan te me batan-un, su migmanggehalew key te masalig ne galew.

entries.summary: egpaka-; egpeke-; egpekeyimu; egkaayun; egkateu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something can do something, it is possible for them to do it, because they have the ability or permission to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother said that I can go with you.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka iney ku miglalag te egkaayun ne egpakaruma a keykew.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can swim, because my father taught me.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpakalumbuk a, su impanulù a te amey ku.

entries.summary: seremun; tinapa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a closed container made of metal, containing food, drink, oil, paint, etc.

entries.summary: egpabayaan te weyig; kanal
kalù
egpekeyimu ne eggimu su egpakakaya; mateu; amana egkateu; pegpakakaya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something is capable of doing something, they can do it because they have the ability to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A baby is not capable of caring for herself.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka batè kenè pad egpekeyimu ne eg-ayad-ayad te kandin ne keuhalingen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This motorbike is capable of carrying 4 people.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Someone who is capable is good at doing things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is very capable, so does his work very well.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana egkateu sikandin, sika ka amana ne meupiya ke eggimu sikandin.

entries.summary: pekeyimu ne eggimu; katuenan; egpakatahù; kinarakelan ne egkeyimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your capacity for something is your ability to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She has a great capacity for making friends.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due dakel ne katuenan din te pegpangalukuy.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the amount or number that a container, room or building can hold.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The bottle has a capacity of one liter.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka butilya due egpakatahù ne me sabeka ne litru.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The capacity of the stadium is 20,000 people.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The capacity of something such as a factory or farm is the maximum amount which it can produce.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That factory has a capacity of 500 sacks per day.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That hen has a capacity of two eggs per day.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sika ne upa egpakaatelug te daruwa ne buuk te tagsè sabeka

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the job or position that you have. If you do something in a particular capacity, you do it as part of that job or position.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has many responsibilities in his capacity as Barangay captain.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Masalig ka me katenged din te himu rin ne isip kepitan te Barangay.

entries.summary: kepital
kepitan te sundalu; uluwan te sengepanungan te galew; kepitan te barku wey ke eriplanu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the leader of a sports team

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kepitan te barku wey ke eriplanu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the one who controls a ship or airplane

entries.summary: deisek ne terak ne egkeunturan dè te hep-at wey ke lalimma ne etew

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: deisek ne terak ne egkeunturan dè te hep-at wey ke lalimma ne etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a closed vehicle with four wheels, and usually with space for approximately five people.

entries.summary: kard
eggeramen ne keilangan; eggeyinawa; egtanggu; eg-atiman

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you care about something, it is important to you.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you care about someone, you love them and want good things for them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I really care about my sister.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you care_for someone or something, you do for them the things that they need.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother is caring for my sick grandmother at the moment.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They don't really care for their house, so it looks very untidy.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Care is the things that you do for someone or something (take_care_of somebody or something).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This garden needs some care, as it is very overgrown.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Thank you for your care of me while I was ill.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you are worried about.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She looks so relaxed, as if she doesn't have a care in the world.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Care is the things that you do to make sure that something bad doesn't happen (take_care).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Use care when you remove the lid from the boiling pot, as it will be very hot.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Bantey ka ke egpuwas te egkale-kalè ne kendiru, su iiniti.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This vase is breakable, so handle it with care.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are careful, you take care so that something bad will not happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Be careful! That water is hot.

entries.summary: eg-uyan; egtiang; egbaba; egsel-ey; eg-utuk; egsapipi; egsalulu; egbakutung; egpandulan; egpanggated; egpekeuma (meyitenged te dahing)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-uyan; egtiang; egbaba; egsel-ey; eg-utuk; egsapipi; egsalulu; egbakutung

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you carry something, you use part of your body (e.g., your head, your back) to hold it while you are moving. The thing doesn't touch the ground.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a bus carries people or things, it takes them to a place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There were many jeepneys carrying school students.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a sound carries, you can hear it in another place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The loud music from the concert carried to the next sitio.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In a formal meeting, if an idea is_carried, it is accepted because enough people vote 'yes' for it.

entries.summary: keritun
nateil ne sitwasyun wey ke panunggilingan; keyimtang; nateil ne sitwasyun te dalu; kasu (due kalabetan te salè)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nateil ne sitwasyun wey ke panunggilingan; keyimtang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one particular situation or example of something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In some cases, lost dogs travel long distances to return to their home.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te duma ne keyimtang, ka natarin ne asu eggipanew te mariyù eyew egpeke-ulì diyè te baley ran.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a situation in which someone has a particular illness.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There were ten cases of malaria at the hospital last week.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due sapulù ne migderalu te malarya diyè te uspital te seeyè se miglihad ne simana.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a situation in which someone has committed a crime.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The police are investigating three murder cases.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pulis mig-inse-insè te tatelu ne kasu te peggimatey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a situation in which people go to court because of a crime or problem between people.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In a formal argument, your case is the things that you say to show that you are right.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In the debate, one team had a much stronger case than the other.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te apulanan, ka sabeka ne grupu due makmakeseg ne igkalalag kunterè te limang.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you do one thing in_case another thing happens, you do the first thing because the second thing might happen and you want to be prepared.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Take your umbrella in case it rains.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Alapa nu ka payung nu su kema ke eg-uran.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is the_case, it is true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You say that I don't help my parents, but that is not the case.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migkahi ka te kena a egbulig te ginikanan ku, piru kenè ne sika ka kamalehetan.

entries.summary: tahuanan te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a container for holding or protecting something (e.g., glasses, a guitar).

entries.summary: miyew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a small animal which has soft fur, and which eats meat. It often lives with people.

entries.summary: egtapayè; egsalù; egpakataya; eggingutel; egdakep

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you catch something that is moving through the air, you take it in your hands.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He threw the ball to me and I caught it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a container catches something such as a liquid, that thing falls into the container.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She put a bowl under the tap to catch the water.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She put a blanket under the winnowing tray to catch the rice skins.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you catch a person or animal (e.g., a fish), you stop them running or moving, and then cause them to stay in a particular place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She used a dam to catch the fish.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In our game I had to run to catch my friends.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something catches on another thing, it accidently becomes attached to that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My jacket caught on the nail when I walked past.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakasanggat ka diyakit ku te lansang te mig-iyal-iyal a ka miggipanew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you catch something on another thing, it accidently becomes attached to that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I caught my jacket on the nail when I walked past.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you catch transport such as a jeepney, you get into it and travel in it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I catch the bus to Davao every month.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something on a window or door which you use to keep it closed.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakakita ke nekey ka miggimu te senge etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you catch someone doing something (usually something bad), you find them doing it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She caught her son taking bananas from the neighbor's garden.

entries.summary: egpunduk-punduk; egbaad-baad; egpegle-leinen; egpegsuwayen; eg-elinen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you categorize things, you put them into groups of similar things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Categorize the beads into different colours.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Punduk-punduka nu ka me balieg te lein-lein ne batek.

entries.summary: punduk; baad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of things which are similar.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We separated the clothes into two categories: clean and dirty.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impegsuwey ney ka kumbalè te daruwa ne baad: malinis wey ka malindit.

entries.summary: me baka

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of catch

entries.summary: egpekeyimu; puunanan; ligkatanan; ayatanan; butang ne ka etew wey ke grupu egpaningkamutan ne egkakuwa, su egpalintutuu sikandan ne eleg seini wey keilangan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing causes another thing, the second thing is the result which comes from the first thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Drinking dirty water can cause illness.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the thing which produces a particular result.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What was the cause of the accident?

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: butang ne ka etew wey ke grupu egpaningkamutan ne egkakuwa, su egpalintutuu sikandan ne eleg seini wey keilangan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that a person or group work hard to achieve, because they believe that it is right or important.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That group tries to help homeless people. I think that's a good cause.

entries.summary: sulung

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large hole in a rock or mountain, which a person or animal can enter.

entries.summary: iling te sintabus

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one hundredth part of a unit of money such as a dollar.

entries.summary: taliwarè; elat; igpataliwarè; lugar (ne egkeyitabuan te nateil ne eggimuwen)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the middle, the part of something which is an equal distance from the the sides (e.g. the center of a page).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you center something, you put it in the middle of another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You should center the writing on the page.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ne igpataliwarè nu ka sinulat te pahina.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: lugar (ne egkeyitabuan te nateil ne eggimuwen)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a place where a particular activity happens (e.g., a shopping center, a sports center).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something is the center of something, everybody is focusing on that person or thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If there is a baby in the room, he often becomes the centre of everyone's attention

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka egguhuren ne egbehayan te dakel ne timpu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something centers on a particular topic, that topic is the main focus.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our discussion centered on the new building plans.

entries.summary: sabeka ne gatus ne leg-un
egpakanengneng; egpakasiguru; iya (meyitenged te leleheti ne egkeyitabù); iya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are certain that something is the case or will happen, you feel sure about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm certain that he will help us.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakasiguru a ne egbulig sikandin kanta.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm certain that he is at home now.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If it is certain that something is the case or will happen, it really is the case or really will happen. You can also say that something is certain to happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is certain to help us.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is certain that he is at home now.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use certainly to say that you are sure that something is the case or will happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is certainly at home now.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling of being sure about something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is a certainty that he will help us.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kamalehetan seini ne egbulig sikandin kanta.

entries.summary: nateil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you talk about a certain person or thing, you talk about a particular person or thing, but you don't say exactly who or what.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A certain person in our village causes many problems.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka nateil ne etew diyè te bariyu ney ka aliddanan te me prublima.

entries.summary: kedina

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a line of metal loops all joined together.

entries.summary: pinnuuwan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a thing that is made for people to sit on.

entries.summary: uluwan
tsuk
egpakabagget (meyitenged te himu); minsan nekey ne kenè ne malemu ne eggimuwen; eggibagget

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something challenges you, it is not very easy for you to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I would like to have a job which challenges me.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne kenè ne malemu ne eggimuwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that is not very easy to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It was a challenge to climb the high mountain.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ne malemu ka pegpamaneyik te matikang ne bubungan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you challenge someone to do something that is not easy, you tell them to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The teacher challenged us to exercise every day.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka talagpanulù miggibagget kanami te egbebasbas aldew-aldew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: words which tell someone to do something difficult.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Some of us accepted our teacher's challenge to exercise every day.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egsapad wey egpanulù te naseyyup ka lalag wey ka himu te etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you challenge someone's actions or words, you tell them that they are wrong.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I didn't agree with what he said, so I challenged him about it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Wara a nabenali te inlalag din, sika ka inlalahan ku sikandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When the woman challenged her son about the missing money, he had nothing to say.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egnangen te pegpeehetey wey pegpapitawey te katuenan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you challenge someone to a fight or contest, you ask them to have a fight or contest with you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The world number 2 chess player has challenged the world number 1 to a game.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegnangen te pegpeehetey wey pegpapitawey te katuenan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a request for a fight or contest.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The world number 1 player has accepted the challenge to a game.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It was quite a challenging game, as the other team was very good.

entries.summary: timpu; panahun; kamalehetan; kasiguruwan; warè imana ne egkeyitabù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a situation where it is possible to do something which you want to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I've been very busy, so I haven't had a chance to visit my sister.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The festival is a great chance to see dancing from many tribes.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a good chance that it will rain later.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due kamalehetan ne eg-uran seini kangkuwa.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is no chance that he will come back.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè kamalehetan ne eglibed pad sikandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that things seem to happen without any reason or planning.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He doesn't believe in chance, because he believes that God controls everything.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I met my friends by chance when I was in Davao, and it was a very nice surprise.

entries.summary: egkapalin; egkaalin [egka͡alin]; egkabalbalawan; egbalbalawan; pegkapalin

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something changes, they become different from the way they were.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She has changed a lot since she was a child, and is now much quieter.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you change something, you cause it to be different from before.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which is different from usual.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There has been a change in the weather, and it's much cooler now.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you change money, you give one kind of money and receive another kind of money.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the money which you get back when you give someone more money than you needed to (e.g., in a shop).

entries.summary: baad te libru; kapitulu; sugpang wey ke baad te dakel ne grupu

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Please open your books at chapter five.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Lukati niyu pa ubag te ikalimma ne baad ka me libru niyu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sugpang wey ke baad te dakel ne grupu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one of the groups that is part of a larger organization.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a member of the local chapter of the hiking club.

entries.summary: ka langun ne due te sika ne butang nakapeyimu kandin ne pinasahì te langun; egpakabagget wey pinasahì; suman-suman wey pusung; pegkeetew

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka langun ne due te sika ne butang nakapeyimu kandin ne pinasahì te langun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The character of something is all of the things about it which make it special.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The old bridge is part of the character of the town.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka daan ne tulay baad ne nekeyimu ne ka lungsud pinasahì.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Character is the state of being interesting and special.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That town really has character, because the gardens there are very pretty.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sika ne lungsud malehet ne egpakabagget wey pinasahi, su due memeupiya ne me pinamula ne me bulak.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They have painted their fish cart with an interesting design, so it has character.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A person's character is their mind and heart (their thinking and emotions).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has a very interesting character, and I don't know anybody who is similar to him.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due makabebagget ne suman-suman din wey pusung, wey wara a nakataha ke nekey ka egpekeiling kandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Character is the fact that your mind and heart are strong, so you don't allow other people to force you to do things that you don't want. You do what is right even when it is difficult.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: People don't offer my father a bribes, because they know he is a man of character.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me etew kenè egbehey te mareet ne dasag diyè te amey ku, su nakataha sikandan te maheteng se suman-suman wey pusung din.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me etew diyè te libru wey salida

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person in a book or movie.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The main character in that book is called Pablo.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka egkapangasak ne etew diyè te libru su egngaranan ki Pablu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one thing that you write or print, such as a letter, number or other symbol.

entries.summary: ilaan; batasan; Ka layun egkakita riyè te minsan hentew wey ke minsan nekey ne batasan wey ke ilaan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something about a person or thing which is related to their physical appearance (such as colour or shape).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Yellow color is a characteristic of gold.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka makalawag ne batek iyan sika ka ilaan te bulawan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something about a person which is related to their mind or behavior.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father has many good characteristics. He is patient and hardworking.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Ka layun egkakita riyè te minsan hentew wey ke minsan nekey ne batasan wey ke ilaan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is characteristic of someone or something, it is usual or typical for them.

entries.summary: egpabayad; bayaranen ne kentidad; maheteng ne eglalahen meyitenged te neyimu ne salè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you charge someone for something, you ask them to pay for it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He didn't charge me for his work.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè migpabayad sikandin keddì te trabahu rin

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the amount that you have to pay for something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is an entry charge of 20 pesos.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: maheteng ne eglalahen meyitenged te neyimu ne salè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If the police charge you with a crime, they formally say that you have done it.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: maheteng ne pangasak meyitenged te neyimu ne salè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a formal statement by police that you have done something wrong.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is facing three charges of stealing.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an animal or person charges, they start running towards you to attack.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Suddenly the wild boar charged, and we had to climb a tree to escape him.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action of an animal or group of soldiers running to attack.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The charge in something electrical is how much electricity it carries or has in it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a 5000 volt charge running through those power lines.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you charge something such as a cellphone, you use an electric current to put power in it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The battery is flat, so I need to charge it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Charge is the fact that you are controlling a situation or group (take_charge, be_in_charge_of something).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is in charge of the office.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Nobody wants to be the leader, but we need someone to take charge.

entries.summary: lumay
deisek se bali; baratu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is cheap, the cost is less than you would expect it to cost.

entries.summary: pangupya
egnengneng wey egpitew ke warè ded prublima; pegnengneng wey pegtengteng ke warè ded prublima; egpasanggel te hitabù wey ke pegdakel amana

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egnengneng wey egpitew ke warè ded prublima

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you check something, you look at it carefully to make sure that there are no problems with it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Could you please check that the door is closed, because I can't remember if I closed it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kaayun ded ubag ne pitawa nu pa ka gemawan ke nalekeban ded, su nalingawan ku ke nalekeban ku naa.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegnengneng wey pegtengteng ke warè ded prublima

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action of checking (do_a_check of something)

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He does regular checks of his motorbike to see if there are any problems.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpasanggel te hitabù wey ke pegdakel amana

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something checks another thing, or keeps it in_check, it stops that thing happening or growing too much.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This chemical will check the growth of carabao grass.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini ne kimikal egpasanggel te pegtubù te sagbet te kalabew ne hilamunen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He cuts his fingernails often to keep them in check.

entries.summary: pepil ne intahuan te seleppì

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a document which you write to order money from your bank account to move to another person's bank account.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He wrote a check because he didn't have enough cash with him.

entries.summary: beneng
makehal wey makalawag ne hinimu ne keenen puun te gatas

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: makehal wey makalawag ne hinimu ne keenen puun te gatas

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a solid yellow food made from milk.

entries.summary: kumeng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the front part of the body between the shoulders and the stomach.

entries.summary: manuk; karni te manuk

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a bird which people keep for eggs and meat.

entries.summary: pinakakeilangan; uluwan; egdumaan [egduma͡an]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the chief thing is the most important one.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our chief problem is that we don't have enough water.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pinakakeilangan ta ne prublima ta su ka warè eleg ne weyig ta.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the leader of a group such as a tribe.

entries.summary: batè ne migsabeka pad ne pulù wey tatelu ne tuig pariralem

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: batè ne migsabeka pad ne pulù wey tatelu ne tuig pariralem

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a young human (usually younger than about thirteen years old).

entries.summary: bakè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the pointed part at the bottom of your face.

entries.summary: peg-alam; alamanan; pilianan; kasangkapan wey ke weil ne eg-alamen; naalam

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was surprised by his choice of nursing as a job.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Neinu-inu a te peg-alam din te himu ne talagtabulig te duktur.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the chance to choose from a group of different things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She didn't want to go home early, but she had no choice.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè egkeupian sikandin ne eg-ulì te baley te mahaan, piru warè egkapilian din.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a choice of colors: blue, red or yellow.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kasangkapan wey ke weil ne eg-alamen; naalam

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the thing or action which you choose.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I chose the blue shirt, and I am happy with my choice.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-alam ku ka meilem ne kumbalè, wey nahala a te naalam ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something choice is of high quality.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbeli a te meupiya ne klasi ne kalamantis.

entries.summary: eg-alam te igkeupii; eg-alam te igkeupii te eggimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you choose something from a group of things, you decide which one you want to have.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I could only buy one of the kittens, so I chose the yellow one.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can't choose between the yellow kitten and the brown one, because they are both beautiful.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you choose to do something, you do it because that is what you want to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She chose not to tell me about the problem.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-alam din ne kena a egpanudtulan meyitenged te prublima.

entries.summary: ka bulan te pegpakitkiteey te geyinawa ka tagsè sabeka

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka bulan te pegpakitkiteey te geyinawa ka tagsè sabeka

entries.summary: ka me etew ne migmalintutuu ki Hisus; nateil ne punduk te migmalintutuu; egsimba

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka me etew ne migmalintutuu ki Hisus

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: all the true Christians in the world

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The church is waiting for Jesus to return.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a particular group of Christians who meet together.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a Christian meeting (usually on Sunday) which has activities such as singing, prayer and preaching.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We visited my aunt after church.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a church on the hill.

entries.summary: malibusen ne ulaula; ka me etew ne egbehayan nu te timpu nu; malibusen

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka me etew ne egbehayan nu te timpu nu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your circle is the people whom you spend time with.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has a small circle of friends.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: round; in the shape of a circle.

entries.summary: Seini iyan sika se egpallahuy ka langesa ta te meupiya, egtileng wey ke eg-agas te meupiya.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Seini iyan sika se egpallahuy ka langesa ta te meupiya, egtileng wey ke eg-agas te meupiya.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something circulates, it moves around a group of people, or around a closed system.

entries.summary: pegtileng, peg-agas wey ke pegpallahuy te langesa; napaligwang; nabelegyè (meyitenged te niyuspipir wey ke magasin)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegtileng, peg-agas wey ke pegpallahuy te langesa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the movement of blood through the body.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: napaligwang; nabelegyè (meyitenged te niyuspipir wey ke magasin)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The circulation of a newspaper or magazine is the number of copies that are sold.

entries.summary: egtulì (meyitenged egpakangen wey egtulisen); pegtulì; me Hudiyu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you circumcise a male, you cut off the foreskin over the penis.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In the Bible, Jews sometimes called themselves 'the circumcision', because circumcision was a sign that they were God's people.

entries.summary: me litra ne igtimul te keepusan wey an-anayan te lalag

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me litra ne igtimul te keepusan wey an-anayan te lalag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of letters which are added around a word, with some before and some after (e.g. 'ka- -an' in 'katahaan').

entries.summary: pangitabù ne baad te nateil ne sitwasyun; sitwasyun ne paneleppianen; tenged te sitwasyun

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pangitabù ne baad te nateil ne sitwasyun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a happening which is part of a particular situation, and helps to cause it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She told me about the circumstances surrounding her father's death.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your circumstances are your financial situation.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Life is hard for them because of their limited circumstances.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Malised ka umul ran su ka amana ne meilù ka paneleppianen ne baad.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't usually wear shoes in her house, but it's cold. Under the circumstances, I think I need to wear shoes.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nalayaman ku ne kena a egsaluub layun te sepatus kayi te baley rin, piru maagsil [ma͡agsil] ma nahud.Tenged te seeyè ne sitwasyun, sika ka egkeilangan a ne egsaluub te sepatus.

entries.summary: egsulat te insulat te duma; eglalag wey egsulat te panunggilingan; 1 pegsulat te insulat te duma; 2 peglalag te panunggilingan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you cite a particular book or writer, you write something that they have written, and then give their name.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In her essay, she cited different writers.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te kandin ne tabak, miggamit sikandin te sinsulat te nalein-lein ne talagsulat.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you cite an example, you say or write it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He cited many examples of people who had lost their farms.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miglalag sikandin te masalig ne panunggilingan te me etew ne natarinan te me kamet.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegsulat te insulat te duma; 2 peglalag te panunggilingan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: baad te me lalag ne impanguwa diyè te duma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a part or phrase which is taken from a piece of writing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her essay had many citations from famous writers.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka tabak din ne sinulat masalig ka impanguwa rin ne lalag diyè te mabantug ne manunulat.

entries.summary: nasakup te sabeka ne nasud (ka neetewan nu wey ke diyè ka mig-ugpè); pegkasakup te inged ke hendei ka ianak wey ke hendei ka nasakup

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nasakup te sabeka ne nasud (ka neetewan nu wey ke diyè ka mig-ugpè)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a member of a country (who was born there, or who has chosen to join the country).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I am a citizen of the Philippines.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegkasakup te inged ke hendei ka ianak wey ke hendei ka nasakup

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the state of being a citizen somewhere.

entries.summary: inged ne nabaluy-baluy; siyudad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large place with many buildings close together, where many people live and work.

entries.summary: me kasangkapan ne due kalabetan te in-ugpaan wey ke inged; himu ne eggimuwen te istadu ne warè labet te Manama; warè kalabetan te me sundalu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me kasangkapan ne due kalabetan te in-ugpaan wey ke inged

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use civil to talk about things which are related to a community or country, or the citizens of that country (e.g., civil war, civil rights).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Civil engineers work on structures such as bridges and roads, which are for the community.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: himu ne eggimuwen te istadu ne warè labet te Manama

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A civil ceremony is done by the state, and is not religious (e.g., a civil marriage ceremony).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They married in a civil ceremony at the Barangay.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use civil to talk about things which are not part of the military.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He left the army and now works in a civil position.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-engked sikandin te pegkasundalu, wey kuntee migtrabahu sikandin te trabahu ne warè kalabetan te sundalu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is civil, they are polite, but not very friendly.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was very civil to all of us, but I felt that he didn't like us.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne matulanged sikandin kanta, piru egkaheram ku ne kenè egkeupian sikandin kanta.

entries.summary: etew ne kenè ne sundalu wey ke pulis; lerew ne etew

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: etew ne kenè ne sundalu wey ke pulis; lerew ne etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who is not in the military or police.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When the foreign army attacked our town, many civilians were killed.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te migsulung ka tagalein ne me sundalu diyè te lunsud ney, masalig ne me lerew ne etew ne nenammatey.

entries.summary: egkahi; eglalag; ingkahi; inlalag; eg-angken; eg-angayen iya; eg egkahiyen te kandin iya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you claim that something is the case, you say that it is the case.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He claims that he can run 100 meters in 10 seconds.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eglalag sikandin ne egpakapallahuy sikandin te sabeka ne gatus ne mitrus te sapulù dè ne sigundus.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He claims that I took his cellphone, but I didn't take it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which you say is the case (make_a_claim).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't believe his claim that he can run 100 meters in 10 seconds.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena a egpalintutuu te ingkahi rin ne egpakapallahuy sikandin te sabeka ne gatus ne mitrus te sapulù dè ne sigundus.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-angken; eg-angayen iya; eg egkahiyen te kandin iya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you claim something, you say that it is yours, or that you should receive it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a dog around here which nobody has claimed, so I'm not sure who owns it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: words which ask for something which is yours, or which say that you should have something (make_a_claim).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The FEMMATRICS helps tribal people with land claims.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka FEMMATRICS egtabang te me lumad te peg-angken wey peg-angey te tanè.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: katenged ne due egpangamunayen ne minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the right to have something (have_a_claim_on or have_a_claim_to something).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My children have a large claim on my time, of course, because they are my responsibility.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me anak ku due dakel ne katenged te timpu ku, eleg dè iya, su due iya katenged ku kandan.

entries.summary: eggimuwen ne klaru ka minsan nekey eyew egkasabut te duma; egpamelmelehan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggimuwen ne klaru ka minsan nekey eyew egkasabut te duma; egpamelmelehan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you clarify something, you make it clear, so that you and other people can understand it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't understand; can you please clarify what you mean?

entries.summary: kating-ew (ne egkakita, egkarineg wey egkasabut); pegkaklaru

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kating-ew (ne egkakita, egkarineg wey egkasabut); pegkaklaru

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was surprised by the clarity of the water. It was so clear!

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Neinu-inu a te a kating-ew te weyig. Amana ne titing-awi.

entries.summary: sabeka ne klasi ne due pegpekeg-iling; punduk te me etew ne due pegpekeg-iling (meyitenged te keugpè wey katenged); grupu te me istudyanti ne nekegduruma

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sabeka ne klasi ne due pegpekeg-iling

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of things which are similar in some way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This class of mushrooms are highly poisonous.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: punduk te me etew ne due pegpekeg-iling (meyitenged te keugpè wey katenged)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of people who have a similar social and economic position (e.g., upper class, working class).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: grupu te me istudyanti ne nekegduruma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of students who are studying together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My best friend is in my class at school.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sayans ka seup ne klasi ku kuntee.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as clothing has class, it is high quality and looks good.

entries.summary: meupiya ne panunggiling, su eg-apil te langun ne keilangan ne baad; meupiya ne klasiyan te pegkeyimu; malemu wey meupiya

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: meupiya ne panunggiling, su eg-apil te langun ne keilangan ne baad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something classic is a typical example of something, and has all the characteristics which that kind of thing usually has.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She had a classic case of the flu: headache, runny nose and fever.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a book or movie is classic, it is very good quality, so that it is famous for a long time, and many people like it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: 'Star Wars' is a classic science fiction movie.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Meupiya ne klasiyan te pegkeyimu ka 'Star Wars' ne salida.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a style is classic, it is simple and beautiful.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She wore a classic black skirt.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migsaluub sikandin te malemu wey meupiya ne saya.

entries.summary: nabatasan wey due pegkateil; Egkahamit ke eglalag te kultura te Gris wey Ruma ne nanlihad te naluhey e ne timpu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a style is classical, it is traditional and has structure.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The dancing is very classical in style.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sayew amana ne nabatasan ne pegkateil.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit ke eglalag te kultura te Gris wey Ruma ne nanlihad te naluhey e ne timpu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use classical to talk about things that were part of the culture of Greece and Rome thousands of years ago (e.g., classical poetry).

entries.summary: egklasiyen; egtapiren; pegklasi; pegtapid; grupu ne ka minsan nekey baad kayi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you classify something, you say which group it is part of.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: grupu ne ka minsan nekey baad kayi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the group which something is part of.

entries.summary: punduk te lalag ne duen dè degma igpasabut; baad te dukumintu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: punduk te lalag ne duen dè degma igpasabut

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of words which have a meaning together. There is always a subject and verb.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: 'She walked to the shop' is a clause.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a part of a legal document such as a contract.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My work contract has a clause about the number of hours that I can work.

entries.summary: dakutan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a kind of hard dirt that is sticky when it is wet. It is used to make things such as bowls.

entries.summary: meupiya (meyitenged te warè lindit); malinis; eg-awè te lapek wey ke lindit; egpanlinis; kenè egpakabehey te malindit

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is clean, there is no dirt on it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I washed the plates, so they are clean.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migkulisungan kud ka me platu, sika ka malinis e.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The water from the spring is clean, so you can drink it.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-awè te lapek wey ke lindit; egpanlinis

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you clean something, you cause it to have no dirt on it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is clean, it doesn't produce a lot of dirt.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Wind power is a clean energy source.

entries.summary: kamelmelehan; mating-ew; titing-awi (ne egkakita, egkarineg wey egkasabut); klaru; maawang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a material is clear, you can see through it (e.g., glass).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: titing-awi (ne egkakita, egkarineg wey egkasabut); klaru

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is clear, it is easy to see, hear or understand.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is clear, it doesn't have things on it or in it (e.g., a clear sky doesn't have clouds; clear skin doesn't have spots).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you clear an area, or if you clear things from an area, you remove the things from that area.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She cleared the table after dinner.

entries.summary: talagtapid
matagsèb

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: bright; a clever person has a good brain, and is able to learn things quickly and easily.

entries.summary: dalayap; tikeba

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a very steep area made of rock

entries.summary: egpamaneyik; egpanguliyambat; egpangapatkapat; egtulin; egdakel

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or animal climbs something, or climbs up something, they use their legs (and maybe arms) to move up it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a number climbs, it increases.

entries.summary: urasan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a machine which shows the time. You usually put it on a wall or a table.

entries.summary: marani; mahaan e; nekeg-iling

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing is close to another thing, it is near that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My house is close to the school.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka baley ku marani rè te iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an].

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a future event is close, it will happen soon.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's December already! Christmas is close.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Disimbri e, mahaan e ka Pasku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two things are close, they are very similar.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: These two insects are very close, so it's hard to see the difference between them.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini se daruwa ne uled-uled amana ne nekeg-iling, sika ka malised ne egkakita ka kaleinan dan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two people are close, they know and like each other a lot.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is a close friend of mine.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè pad iya egkahuhud (meyitenged te karumaan [karuma͡an], iling ke suled, atebey, anggam, wey duma pad)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two relatives are close, the relationship is quite direct, and there are not many relatives in between them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He's only a third cousin, not a close relative.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Igkatelu rè ne egkasuled sikandin, kenè amana ne marani ne karumaan [karuma͡an].

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A close look at something is careful and detailed.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you have a close look at this insect, you can see the tiny hairs on its legs.

entries.summary: eglekeban, egsupaan; egkalekeban, egkasupaan; egtiklup

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you close something, you move part of it so that you can't go into it, see into it, or take something out of it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something closes, part of it moves so that you can't go into it, see into it, or take something out of it (e.g., a door).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you close something such as an umbrella, you cause all the parts of it to come together.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you close something such as a bank account or a meeting, you cause it to stop or end.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Let's close the meeting now, as it's dark.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eg-impusan tad ka miting su marusilem e.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He closed his bank account because there was no money in it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The close of something is the end of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They set off some firecrackers at the close of the party.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migmabetu sikandan te me pabetu te keepusan te kalibulungan.

entries.summary: nalekeban, nasupaan; natiklup (iling te payung)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is closed, you can't go into it, see into it, or take anything out of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The box is closed. Don't try to open it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The windows are all closed, so there is not much fresh air in the room.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as an umbrella is closed, you can't see the middle parts of it, because the outside parts are together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: At night the flowers are closed, so you can't see the beautiful colours.

entries.summary: manggad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: material which clothes are made of.

entries.summary: egbelù te kumbalè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you clothe someone, you provide clothes for them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He works hard to feed and clothe his children.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miglasey-lasey sikandin te trabahu rin eyew te pegpakeen wey pegbelù te kumbalè te me anak din.

entries.summary: me manggad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the things that people wear on their body, such as shirts and pants.

entries.summary: me manggad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the things that people wear on their body, such as shirts and pants.

entries.summary: gapun; butaku; kibel; salahapun; alinepung

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a mass of tiny drops of water and ice floating in the sky.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a mass of tiny particles floating in the air (e.g., a cloud of dust).

entries.summary: punduk te me etew ne egkabagget te nateil ne kasangkapan; nateil ne inged te egmanesayew wey egmangiinum

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: punduk te me etew ne egkabagget te nateil ne kasangkapan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: group of people who are interested in a particular thing, and meet together to do or talk about that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a member of a chess club.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nateil ne inged te egmanesayew wey egmangiinum

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a place where people go to dance and drink.

entries.summary: makepal ne tuked ne iglampes te etew wey ke mananap; eglampes; egbaras; me kelemunggay grupu te baraha

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: makepal ne tuked ne iglampes te etew wey ke mananap

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a thick stick which is used to hit people or animals.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone clubs a person or animal, they use a thick stick to beat them.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In cards, clubs is the group of cards which have a shape on them like three circles joined together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The six of clubs (in a pack of cards).

entries.summary: ilis te dahat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the part of the land next to the sea.

entries.summary: malayat wey meinit ne dyakit; weyig (iling te pintal) wey ke pawudir ne igtalagtag diyè te ampew te minsan nekey; egtahuan; egparekketan; egpintalan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: weyig (iling te pintal) wey ke pawudir ne igtalagtag diyè te ampew te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an amount of a liquid or powder which is spread on a surface (e.g., a coat of paint).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you coat something with a liquid or powder, you cover it with the liquid or powder.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She coated the banana with sugar.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Imparekketan din ka sahing te sukal.

entries.summary: ipes
klasiyan te pegsulat te palinneu; punpun te me numiru wey ke litra ne egkahamit te pegnengneng te nenateil ne inged; punpun te me kukuman wey ke balaud

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a system of written symbols, words or actions which communicate a message. If you know the system, you can understand the message.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We couldn't understand the letter, because it was written in code.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ta egkasabut ka sulat, su insulat seini te lein ne pegkasulat iling te palinneu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: punpun te me numiru wey ke litra ne egkahamit te pegnengneng te nenateil ne inged

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a set of numbers or letters which you use to identify a particular place (e.g., a postcode, or a telephone area code).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: punpun te me kukuman wey ke balaud

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a dress code at the restaurant: no tsinillas or T-shirts.

entries.summary: keppi
sinsilyu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a round piece of money, usually made of metal.

entries.summary: eggimuwen ka iyam ne lalag wey ke iyam ne pangasakan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggimuwen ka iyam ne lalag wey ke iyam ne pangasakan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you coin a new word or new phrase, you create it.

entries.summary: maagsil [ma͡agsil]; pegkamaagsil [pegkama͡agsil]; kahew ne egpekeyimu te masakit ne ulu, egdehes ne abelengan, atisè wey buwè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that the temperature is low.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I like the cold here in the mountains.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kahew ne egpekeyimu te masakit ne ulu, egdehes ne abelengan, atisè wey buwè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a virus which can cause you to have a headache, sore throat, sneezing and coughing.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is cold towards another person, they are very unfriendly.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are cold about something, you are not excited or enthusiastic about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His music leaves me cold, and I don't find it exciting at all.

entries.summary: kuwilyu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fold of material at the top of a shirt, at the neck

entries.summary: duma nu te trabahu
punpun
pinunpun
ngaran te grupu te me etew wey ke me kasangkapan (iling te duma nu te grupu, ka pulis)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ngaran te grupu te me etew wey ke me kasangkapan (iling te duma nu te grupu, ka pulis)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a name of a group of people or things (e.g., team, crowd).

entries.summary: talagsukut
kulihiyu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a place of learning for students who have finished high school

entries.summary: peg-uripen
batek; egbatek; Ke due egpakapabatek te suman-suman nu meyitenged te minsan nekey, egpakapanulud sika keykew te pegsuman-suman ke nekey-a sika.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you color something such as a picture, you put color on it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The children used crayons to color the pictures.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She colors her hair with dye.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Ke due egpakapabatek te suman-suman nu meyitenged te minsan nekey, egpakapanulud sika keykew te pegsuman-suman ke nekey-a sika.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something colors your thinking about something, it causes you to think in a particular way about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His bad experience at the school colored his opinion of all children.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka mareet ne nabaybayaan din diyè te iskuyalaan [iskuyla͡an] ka nakabehey te nateil ne puhawang din diyè te langun ne me batè.

entries.summary: sugkad; egsukaren

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a thing with many teeth, which you use to tidy your hair.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you comb your hair, you make it tidy using a comb.

entries.summary: egparumeey [egparume͡ey]; eglimuren; egsabeka; egpegdumeen [egpegdume͡en]; egpegsewuhen; egsabekeen; egkasewug ne minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two or more things combine, they join together to make one thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The three groups combined to make one large group.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka tatelu ne grupu migparumeey [migparume͡ey] eyew te peggimu te dakel ne grupu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you combine things, you join them together to make one thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Combine the coconut milk and the sugar in the pot.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Pegsewuha nu ka gatè te niyug wey ka sukal due te kendiru.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The teacher combined all the groups students into one large group.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something combines two or more things, they have both those things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother combines kindness with strictness.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka iney ku due pegbebatasan ne meupiya wey mabulut.

entries.summary: eggendini; eggengkayi; eglepew; egginguma; egtaman; egkataman

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something comes, it moves closer to the place where you are.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migginguma sikandan te me alas siti te marusilem.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something comes to a certain point, that is where it reaches or stops.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The river is not deep: it only comes up to my knees.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka dakel ne weyig kenè ne maralem, taman dè seini te buel ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something comes from a place, or comes from another thing, that is the place where it is from, or the thing which it is made from.

entries.summary: eg-ayat; eggundug; eg-immu-immu; egliwang (te egpatayan); peg-ayat; peggundug; peg-immu-immù; egpakaayat; egpakahalè; egpakaliwang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you comfort someone who is very sad or upset, you help them to feel better.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-ayat din ka egsinehew ne batè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: help that makes someone feel better.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She tried to give comfort to the crying child.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggeram sikandin mig-ayat te egsinehew ne batè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: someone or something that causes you to feel better if you are upset about something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I miss her, but it is a comfort to know that she is happy there.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Naalimengawan a kandin, piru egpakahalè e keddì ne egkatahaan [egkataha͡an] ku ne egkahalè sikandin diyè.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My best friend is a great comfort to me when I feel sad.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggeramen te lawa nu ne uupiyei

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling of your body being relaxed with no pain.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This chair is made for comfort.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ne pinuuwan inggimu ne uupiyei te eggeramen te lawa ta.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: keugpè ne due masalig ne karatuan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the state of having many good things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They live in comfort, because they are very rich.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-ugpè sikandan te masalig ne karatuan, su amana datù sikandan.

entries.summary: maluwan se lawa; egpakabehey te meupiya ne eggeramen; maluwan se geyinawa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you feel comfortable, your body is relaxed and has no pain.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I am very comfortable in this chair.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne maluwan se lawa ku te seini ne bangkù.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a chair or clothing is comfortable, it causes your body to feel relaxed.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: These shoes are not comfortable yet, because they are new.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini ne sepatus kenè pad ne meupiya se peggeram-geram te pegsaluub, su me iyam.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you feel comfortable in a situation, you don't feel stressed or embarrassed.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't feel comfortable telling them about my problem.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ne maluwan ka geyinawa ku te pegpanugtul kandan meyitenged te prublima.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is comfortable, they don't have financial problems.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has a very high-paying job, so at the moment, they are comfortable.

entries.summary: egsuhù; igsuhù; suhù; egbehayan su eleg ne egkabehayan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you command someone to do something, you tell them strongly that they must do it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migsuhù a ni kandin te egpasanggelen a.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: words which tell someone strongly what they must do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our bad dog never obeys commands.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka asu ney kenè eglinga-linga te me suhù.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you command something such as respect, you receive it from other people because you should have it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a good leader who commands the respect of everyone.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Meupiya sikandin ne ahalen ne egbehayan te peg-addat te tagsè sabeka.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A command of something such as a language is the fact that you know it and can use it well.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She has a very good command of English.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due meupiya ne pegkateu rin te Inglis.

entries.summary: suhù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: words (especially from God) telling people to do or not do something (e.g., the Ten Commandments).

entries.summary: egbunsud; egsugud; pegbunsud; pegsugud

fields.label: English example
fields.text: School will commence next week, after the summer break.

entries.summary: igkalalag; eglalahen wey egsulaten ne igkalalag diyè te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you say or write about something (make_a_comment).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Many people made comments about my shirt.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Masalig ne me etew ne due ingkalalag meyitenged te kumbalè ku.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eglalahen wey egsulaten ne igkalalag diyè te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you comment on something, you say or write something about it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due igkalalag din te kumbalè ku.

entries.summary: egkakuwa ne baad te seleppì puun te pegbelegyè; egsuhù te pegpeyimu; me himu ne due egsuhuen eyew te peggimu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkakuwa ne baad te seleppì puun te pegbelegyè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the money that a salesperson or agent receives for selling something. It is usually a percentage of the price of the thing they sold.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He gets a 10% commission on what he sells.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sapulù ne pursintu ka egkakuwa rin ne baad te minsan nekey ne igbelegyè din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you commission someone to do an artistic work for you (e.g., a painting), you ask them to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The band commissioned a songwriter to write some new songs for them.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka punduk te mangulahing migsuhù te talagsulat te ulahingen te pegpasulat te iyam ne me ulahingen.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me himu ne due egsuhuen eyew te peggimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a project that someone asks an artist to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a great painter, and at the moment, he has commissions from ten people.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mangateu sikandin ne egsulat te me ulaula, wey te seeyè ne timpu, migsuhù degma sikandin te sapulù ne etew eyew te peggimu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: grupu te me etew ne iyan egpeyimuwen te nateil ne himuwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of people who receive power to do a particular job, such as controlling something or researching something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The government has created a commission to stop drugs in schools.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka gubirnu miggimu te grupu ne iyan egpasanggel te mareet ne bisyu diyè te iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an].

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of doing something bad.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The commission of major crimes is increasing.

entries.summary: egpekeyimu (te mareet ne himu); igbehey ka umul; egbehey wey egpahamit

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you commit a crime or sin, you do that thing.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Masalig ka neyimu rin ne dereisek ne samuk.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you commit to someone or something, you decide to make them very important in your life for a long time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When you marry, you commit your whole life to one person.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Emun ke eg-asawa ka, igbehey nu ka intiru ne umul nu diyè te sabeka ne etew.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She committed herself to the work of caring for sick children.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you commit something such as money or time to a particular activity, you say that you will give it or use it for that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: For now, I will commit two months to helping the school.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kuntee, egbehey a te daruwa ne bulan te pegbulig te iskuylaan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpanugtul te pegtuu wey ke suman-suman

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you commit to an idea or opinion, you tell people clearly what you believe or think.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Two people agreed with me, two people disagreed, and two people did not commit to an opinion.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Daruwa ne etew ka mig-uyun keddiey, daruwa ka migsupak, wey daruwa ka warè migpanugtul te kandan ne puhawang.

entries.summary: peggimu; saad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an attitude that you will continue your relationship with a person or thing, and will not change, even if it's difficult.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She showed great commitment to the team, and went to all the practices.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impakita rin ne dakel ka peggimu rin diyè te grupu, wey layun sikandin eggendiyè te pegbebasbas.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you have promised to do or go to (make_a_commitment).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When you marry, you make a big commitment to another person.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke eg-asawa ka, eggimu ka te dakel ne pegpakigsaad te lein ne etew.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm sorry, I can't come to the meeting because I already have another commitment.

entries.summary: grupu te me etew ne egpamuhawang te minsan nekey para te dakel ne grupu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: grupu te me etew ne egpamuhawang te minsan nekey para te dakel ne grupu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of people who decide and plan things for a larger group.

entries.summary: malasi; kasuluhan; nekeg-iling; minsan nekey ne inggamit te ne mimbru te grupu wey ke keet-etawan; kumun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is common, it is found often or in many places.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's common for people to speak three or more languages here.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kasuluhan te me etew kayi egpakalalag te tatelu ne linalahan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Amoeba is a common problem in that area.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Malasi ne dalu te sika ne inged ka eg-iindes.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is common to people, or they have something in_common, it is the same for them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My friend and I are close because we have many common interests.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana key iya ne marani te alukuy ku tenged su nekeg-iling ka igkeupii ney.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne inggamit te ne mimbru te grupu wey ke keet-etawan; kumun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something common is used by all the members of a group or community.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are people of different tribes at our school, and Visayan is the common language.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due masalig ne tribu diyè te iskuylaan ney, ne ka Biseyè ka layun eggamita ne linalahan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Visayan is the common language of Bukidnon.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Biseyè ka layun eggamita ne linalahan kayi te Bukidnon.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something common is not special or different from the usual.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our family doesn't celebrate Christmas; it's just a common day for us.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè mulè egsahakeen ka pamilya ku te Kristmas, su warè ney dakeli ka sika ne aldew.

entries.summary: egpakiglalag (pinaahi te pegpakiglalag wey ke pegsusulat)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakiglalag (pinaahi te pegpakiglalag wey ke pegsusulat)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you communicate a message, or communicate with someone, you tell the person things (e.g., by speaking or writing).

entries.summary: pegpakiglalag (pinaahi te pegpakiglalag wey ke pegsusulat); me sistima te pegtuhut te kanengnengan wey peggipanew

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegpakiglalag (pinaahi te pegpakiglalag wey ke pegsusulat)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of communicating with someone.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My children and I have very good communication, and we talk about a lot of things together.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me sistima te pegtuhut te kanengnengan wey peggipanew

fields.label: English explanation
