fields.text: the systems which allow information and people to move between places (e.g., cellphone networks, roads).

entries.summary: keet-etawan; me etew; grupu te me etew wey ke nasud ne due pegkeiling

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: all the people who live in a particular place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a community at Basak.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due me etew ne nangugpè diyè te Basak.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: grupu te me etew wey ke nasud ne due pegkeiling

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of people or countries which have something the same (e.g., the Matigsalug community).

entries.summary: duma
pegduma; punduk te me etew ne due himu te pegbelegyè wey pegbebeli

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A person's company is the fact that they are with you.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana a nahalè te pegduma rin.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: punduk te me etew ne due himu te pegbelegyè wey pegbebeli

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of people who have a business.

entries.summary: egpeg-iling te me kasangkapan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Adjectives and some adverbs have a comparative form. You use the comparative form to compare things, and say how they are different. For short words, you add '-er' to the adjective (e.g., 'older'). For long words, you put 'more' before the adjective (e.g., 'more beautiful'). You use 'than' after comparative adjectives.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This tree is more beautiful than that tree.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini ne kayu memeupiya te sika ne kayu.

entries.summary: egpeg-iling; egpeiling; me-meupiya, ma-mareet, nekeg-iling (meyitenged te keupiya)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you compare something with another thing, you look at the two things and find the things which are similar and different, and the things which are better and worse.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When I compare the city with the mountains, I am happy that I live in the mountains.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke egpeg-ilingen ku ka siyudad wey ka diyè te bubungan egkeupian e pad te diyè te bubungan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother never compares me with my brothers and sisters, she just loves us all.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you compare something to another thing, you say that they are similar.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He compared his wife to a beautiful flower.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impeiling din ka asawa rin te meupiya ne bulak.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing compares well with another thing, it is better than it, or equally good. If it compares badly with another thing, it is worse.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I think that Filipino movies compare very well with American movies.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekeg-iling dè iya ka Pilipinu ne me salida te keupiya te me salida te Amirika.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In comparison with his friends, my brother is very tall.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te egpeg-iling te me alukuy rin, ka suled ku ka lalayati.

entries.summary: pegkeyid-u; hiid-uwen [hi͡id-uwen]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling of sadness when you see someone in a bad situation, so that you want to help them.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a compassionate person feels sad when they see someone in a bad situation, and wants to help.

entries.summary: egsaliyu te minsan nekey ne iling ded ka bali; eggimu eyew te peggeram pegsaliyu te duma ne butang; egbehey te seleppì diyè te senge etew puun te nawara an sikandan wey ke nakabayè te mareet ne neulaula

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egsaliyu te minsan nekey ne iling ded ka bali

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is not there, and a second thing compensates for it, the value of the second thing is enough to replace the first thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: All the money in the world can never compensate for good friends.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka langun ne seleppì kayi te inged kenè egpakasaliyu te memeupiya ne alukuy.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggimu eyew te peggeram pegsaliyu te duma ne butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you compensate for something, you do something to try to replace it with another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: People who can't see often compensate for it by having excellent hearing.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka etew ne kenè egpakakita layun eggimu te pegsaliyu pinaahi te mateling te pegpammineg.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbehey te seleppì diyè te senge etew puun te nawara an sikandan wey ke nakabayè te mareet ne neulaula

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you compensate someone for something, you give them money or another thing because they have lost something, or have experienced something bad.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If a company uses land, they should compensate the land-owners for it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke ka kumpanya eggamit te tanè, keilangan sikandan ne egbehey te seleppì diyè te kamuney.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: butang ne egpakasaliyu te duma ne butang

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you are not happy, money is no compensation.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which compensates for another thing.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: tabang ne seleppì wey ke bayad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the money which is paid to someone because they have lost something, or have experienced something bad.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The criminal had to pay a lot of money to his victims as compensation for the suffering he caused them.

entries.summary: Iyan sika se egpakigtepeng wey egpakig-ehet

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Iyan sika se egpakigtepeng wey egpakig-ehet

entries.summary: kuntis
talagtalu
eg-angal
warè nalaahi; due langun; kumplitu; neimpusan; eg-impusan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something complete has all of its parts.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This kuglung is not complete, because it doesn't have any horsehair on it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini ne kuglung kenè ne kumplitu, su warè bulbul te kuddè.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The house is not yet complete, because we still need to add the roof.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka baley warè pad neimpusi, su keilangan pad ne eg-atepan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you complete something, you finish it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-impusan din ka himu rin ga-gaani.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is complete, it is 100% the case.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was complete silence in the room.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Wara iya lalahan diyè te sinabeng.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a complete stranger to me.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ne etew warè kud iya neileyi.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This room is a complete mess.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use completely to talk about something that is 100% the case, or is very much the case.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She was completely exhausted after walking all day.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Naamanaan [naamana͡an] nabeley sikandin te naapunan [na͡apunan] ne miggipanew.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The completion of high school is an achievement.

entries.summary: malised su due masalig ne baad; nalibulung ne derakel ne baley ne due nateil ne karuan; prublima te suman-suman wey eggeramen ne egpakapasuman-suman te minsan nekey te egkaamanaan [egkaamana͡an].

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: malised su due masalig ne baad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is complex, it has many parts, and so is maybe difficult to understand or fix.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Building a house is a complex job.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegpangimu te baley su malised ne himu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The pattern of this cloth is very complex, with many different colours all mixed together.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ilinganan te kumbalè su amana ne malised, ne due masalig ne batek ne nenekegsewug-sewug.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nalibulung ne derakel ne baley ne due nateil ne karuan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of buildings together (e.g., a sports complex).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The sports complex has a gym and a swimming pool, and a running track.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka nalibulung ne derakel ne baley ne due galawanan wey pamanihusan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: prublima te suman-suman wey eggeramen ne egpakapasuman-suman te minsan nekey te egkaamanaan [egkaamana͡an].

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a mental or emotional problem that causes someone to think too much about something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She has a complex about her teeth, and worries about them all the time.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegkamalised su due masalig ne baad

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The complexity of this problem makes it difficult to solve.

entries.summary: baad te minsan nekey

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This trap is made of six component parts.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini ne giman neyimu te hen-em ne baad ka senge baad.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He needed to replace a component of his motorbike, because it was broken.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ne egliwan sikandin te baad te mutur din, su nareetan.

entries.summary: neyimu puun te; egpangimu te minsan nekey iling te ulahingen; egliwangen nu ka kauhalingen nu ne egkaawè ka mareet ne suman-suman nu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is_composed of things, it is made of those things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This raft is composed of wood and rope.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini ne gakit su neyimu puun te kayu wey lubid.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpangimu te minsan nekey iling te ulahingen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you compose something such as a song or a piece of music, you create it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father composes new songs and sings them to us.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka amey ku migpangimu te iyam ne me ulahingen wey eg-ulahingen seini kayi te kanta.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egliwangen nu ka kauhalingen nu ne egkaawè ka mareet ne suman-suman nu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are upset, and you compose yourself, you cause yourself to become calm.

entries.summary: pegkeyimu te minsan nekey; pegpangimu te minsan nekey iling te ulahingen; neyimu ne ulahingen wey ke sinulat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The composition of something is what it is made of.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegpangimu te minsan nekey iling te ulahingen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of creating something such as a song or piece of music.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: neyimu ne ulahingen wey ke sinulat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a song, piece of music, or piece of writing.

entries.summary: hinimu te daruwa wey masalig ne baad ne kasangkapan; egpakatimul; egpakaamut; nateil ne tanè ne nalingutan te alad ne due me baley wey duma pad ne me bilding

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: hinimu te daruwa wey masalig ne baad ne kasangkapan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A compound thing is made of two or more parts (e.g., a compound word, a chemical compound).

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: 'Blackboard' su neyimu te daruwa ne lalag.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something compounds another thing, it adds something to it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The bad weather compounded the problems of the travellers.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka mareet ne timpu egpakatimul te prublima te egmanggipanew.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nateil ne tanè ne nalingutan te alad ne due me baley wey duma pad ne me bilding

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an area of land with a fence around it, where there are houses and maybe other buildings.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They live on a compound, and don't go out into the city much.

entries.summary: eglabet te langun ne keilangan nu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eglabet te langun ne keilangan nu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is comprehensive, it includes everything that you need.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The book was very comprehensive, so I didn't need to find more information.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka libru duen e langun ne kanengnengan, sika ka kena ad keilangan ne egpamitew pad te duma ne kanengnengan.

entries.summary: neyimu wey ke migpuun te minsan nekey; egpakapeyimu te dakel ne butang

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: neyimu wey ke migpuun te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something comprises things or people, or if it is_comprised_of them, it is made of those things or people.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our class comprises 21 girls and 19 boys.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka klasi ney neyimu te sapulù wey sabeka ne me malitan, wey sapulù wey siyew ne me lukes.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our class is comprised of 21 girls and 19 boys.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a number of things or people comprise a larger thing, they make that larger thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: These houses comprise the town of Sinuda.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini ne me baley nakapeyimu te lungsud te Simud.

entries.summary: egbehey te dakel ne suman-suman diyè te minsan nekey; egbehey te dakel ne timpu diyè te senge kasangkapan; egkalibulung

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbehey te dakel ne suman-suman diyè te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you concentrate on something, you focus your mind on it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The book was boring, so it was difficult to concentrate on it.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbehey te dakel ne timpu diyè te senge kasangkapan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you concentrate_on a particular activity, you decide to spend your time on that thing, and not other things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I will concentrate on my garden today, not on washing clothes.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egbehey a te timpu ku kuntee diyè te gulayan ku, kenè ne diyè te pegpami-pi te kasangkapan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If things are_concentrated in an area, there a lot of them there together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The shops are concentrated at the crossing.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka tindaan [tinda͡an] nalibulung diyè te bebalakan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: lein ne weyig ne in-awaan te weyig ne maheteng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a liquid which is very strong because the water has been removed from it (e.g., juice concentrate).

entries.summary: amana egsuman-suman te minsan nekey; grupu te me nenekeg-iling-iling ne butang diyè te deisek ne tahuanan wey ke inged; kamenu karakel ka insewug

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the ability to focus your mind on something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The children lost concentration during the boring speech.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: grupu te me nenekeg-iling-iling ne butang diyè te deisek ne tahuanan wey ke inged

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of similar things in a small area.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a concentration of students in that city, because it has a university.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The concentration of a substance is how much of it there is in another substance.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Coke has a high concentration of sugar.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka Kuk dakel ka sukal ne insewug.

entries.summary: kamalehetan ne puhawang te minsan nekey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kamalehetan ne puhawang te minsan nekey

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Children need to learn the concept of sharing.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me batè keilangan egpakataha te kamalehet ne puhawang te pegpabegbehayey.

entries.summary: egkasahukul; egkalangè; pegkasahukul; pegkalangè; igkasahukul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something concerns you, you feel worried about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It concerns me that my brother hasn't texted me. I hope he is OK.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling of being worried about something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I could see the concern on her face as she looked at the sick child.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you feel worried about.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My uncle's bad health is a real concern for us.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling that something is important.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My teacher shows great concern for correct spelling.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka talagpanulù ney amanan keilangan diyet kandin ka ispiling.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: meyitenged te (due kalabetan te minsan nekey)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something concerns a particular topic, it is about that topic.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His speech concerned the plans for the new building.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka guhuren din meyitenged te suman-suman te iyam ne egbaleyen.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something concerns you, then you are part of it, or it has an effect on you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Please don't ask me about that, as it's personal and doesn't concern you.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Palihug kena a insei meyitenged due, amana rè ne para keddiey sika, wey kenè ka egkalabet due.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you are part of, or which has an effect on you

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Please don't ask me about that, as it's personal , and is not your concern.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Palihug kena a insei meyitenged due, amana ren para keddiey sika, wey warè labet nu due.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are concerned about something, you are worried about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm very concerned about my sick baby.

entries.summary: eggukum; egkeimpusan; eg-impusan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you conclude that something is the case, you decide it after you think about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He looked at all the places, and concluded that the hill was the best place for his garden.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtengtengan din ka langun ne lugar, wey miggukum sikandin te ka miglabuntud ka eleg ne egkatahuan te pinamula rin.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pista egkeimpusan kayi te Birnis.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you conclude something, you finish it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They concluded the fiesta with a community lunch.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-impusan dan ka pista te pegpaniudtu te keet-etawan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people or groups conclude something such as a business agreement, they make the agreement.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The two companies concluded a deal.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka daruwa ne kumpanya nekeyimu te kasabutan.

entries.summary: pegbehey te puhawang; peggukum; keepusan; katammanan; peggimu te kasabutan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you decide after you think about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The house was quiet, so he came to the conclusion that nobody was home.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the end or last part of something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Everyone went home after the conclusion of the meeting.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I've nearly finished my essay; I just need to write the conclusion.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The conclusion of a formal agreement is the action of making the agreement.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Both companies are happy about the conclusion of their deal.

entries.summary: keugpè; keyimtang; sitwasyun; minsan nekey ne keilangan ne eggimuwen eyew te peg-angey te duma ne butang; egkapanulù (te nabaybayaan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the state of someone or something; what they are like at a particular time. (be_in_ADJECTIVE_condition).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is in a serious condition in hospital.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Diyè sikandin te mareet ne keyimtang te huspital.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The car is in very good condition

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne keilangan ne eggimuwen eyew te peg-angey te duma ne butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you need to do in order to receive another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You can stay at my house on the condition that you help with the housework.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpekeugpè ka te baley ney ke egbulig ka te himuwen te baley.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She promised to help me, but there were many conditions.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can't break the conditions of my contract, or I will lose my job.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or animal is_conditioned to think or act a certain way, they have learned to think or act that way because of their life experience.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a medical problem with part of your body.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: High blood pressure is a common condition in that place.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka malayat se langesa ka egpanggeramen te me etew te seika ne inged.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the situation and environment in which someone or something is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The work conditions for that company are not very good: staff work long hours with low pay.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka keugpè te himu te kumpanya su bayew mareet: ka me trabaanti [traba͡anti] egtrabahu te malayat ne uras piru deisek se bayad.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They were out in the mountains in terrible weather conditions.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-awè sikandan diyè te bubungan te makaliliyas ne timpu.

entries.summary: eggimu; eg-uyan; egdumalè; eg-uyan te pegkeetew (te nateil pamaahi); pamaahi te peg-uyan te pegkeetew; pegbebatasan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you conduct something such as an activity, you organize it and do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The Barangay conducted a survey of our area.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka Barangay miggimu te pegpangleuy te lugar ney.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you conduct yourself in a particular way, that is the way that you behave.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She always conducts herself very well.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Layun meupiya ka peg-uyan din te kandin ne pegkeetew.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pamaahi te peg-uyan te pegkeetew; pegbebatasan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your conduct is the way that you behave

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Parents should teach their children about good conduct.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me amey wey iney keilangan ne egpanulù te me anak dan te meupiya ne pegbebatasan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you conduct someone somewhere, or on a tour, you take them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He conducted the visitors through the caves.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-uyan din ka me mahaliyug diyè te sulung.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a material conducts something such as electricity or heat, electricity or heat can travel through it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Metal conducts heat, that's why the spoon gets hot in the pot.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka putew egpanleytayan te meinit, sika ka silut egmeinit ke igtahù te kendiru ne meinit.

entries.summary: egpalallalahey; egkabehayan; egbehey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people confer with each other, they talk together about something so that they can decide about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I need to confer with my friend before I can give you an answer.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan key pad ne egpalallalahey te me alukuy ku ne wey a egpakabehey keykew te tabak.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something confers something on you (e.g., power, or a special title), they cause you to have that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His position as Barangay captain confers on him a lot of power.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka himu rin ne kepitan te Barangay egkabehayan sikandin te dakel ne geem [ge͡em].

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The title of 'Captain' was conferred on him.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The leaders conferred an award on him for his brave action.

entries.summary: pegpalallalahey ne maheteng; kalibulungan ne dakel

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a formal meeting to talk about something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I had a conference with son's teacher.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due peglallalahey ney te me anak te me talagpanulù.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an event (often more than one day) when people meet together to talk and learn about a particular topic.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Many teachers went to the conference.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Masalig ne talagpanulù ne miggendiyè te kalibulungan.

entries.summary: eg-angken; peg-angken

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you confess that something is true, you say that it is true. If you confess to doing something bad, you say that you did it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She confessed to stealing the money.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-angken sikandin te pegpanakew te seleppì.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: words which say that something is true (especially when you say something bad that you did).

entries.summary: warè laggew te minsan nekey
Iyan sika se kenè egkaayun ne igpanudtul te minsan nekey su iggeles iya.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Iyan sika se kenè egkaayun ne igpanudtul te minsan nekey su iggeles iya.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something confidential is secret, so you can't tell other people about it.

entries.summary: eglalag te pegmemalehet; egpakita te pegmemalehet; eg-ugsien eyew te pegmemalehet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you confirm that something is true, you say that it really is true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She confirmed that she was pregnant.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miglalag sikandin te pegmemalehet ne egkaberes sikandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something confirms that a thing is true, it shows that it really is true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The X-ray confirmed that her leg was broken.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka iksri migpakita te pegmemalehet ne ka paa rin nahepù.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you confirm something such as an appointment, you contact the person to make sure that it really will happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I called the dentist to confirm my appointment.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-umew ku ka dintista eyew te peg-ugsì te keddì ne katuyuan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: lalag wey ke kasangkapan ne egpakita te kamalehetan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: words or things which show that something really is true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The doctor gave her confirmation that she was pregnant.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miglalag ka duktur te pegpamalehet ne egkaberes sikandin.

entries.summary: ehetanan wey ke apulanan; kaleinan te daruwa ne butang ne egpekeyimu kandan ne kenè egpekeg-eleg ka matagsabeka; egpekeglein

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: fighting or arguing between people or groups.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was a conflict between two men at the market yesterday.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due apulanan te daruwa ne lukes gabii diyè te palingki.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The committee doesn't work well because there is a lot of conflict between committee members.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Life is very hard in regions where there is military conflict.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kaleinan te daruwa ne butang ne egpekeyimu kandan ne kenè egpekeg-eleg ka matagsabeka

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an important difference between two things which causes them to not fit together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a conflict between the information in the two books, so I don't know which one to follow.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due kaleinan te me kanengnengan te daruwa ne libru, sika ka wara a nakataha ke hendei ka egpalintutuuwen ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something conflicts with another thing, they don't fit together well.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They seldom see each other because their work schedules conflict.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Marelag dè egpekegkita sikandan su nekeglein ka timpu te trabahu ran.

entries.summary: nabenga-benga
Iyan sika se egdayan ka te nakapenga te peg-iskuyla wey nakapenga te igkeupii rin.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Iyan sika se egdayan ka te nakapenga te peg-iskuyla wey nakapenga te igkeupii rin.

entries.summary: lalag wey ke punduk te me lalag ne egpegsumpul te me lalag; pegpekegduma wey ke pegpekegbulig te daruwa ne butang

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: lalag wey ke punduk te me lalag ne egpegsumpul te me lalag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a word or group of words that joins together words, phrases or clauses (e.g., 'so', 'although', 'as soon as').

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegpekegduma wey ke pegpekegbulig te daruwa ne butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that two things are joined or work together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The books were made by the school in conjunction with the Barangay.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me libru neyimu te iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an] puun te pegpabulihey te Barangay.

entries.summary: egpegsumpul; egpakasumpul; egsuman-suman ne due kalabetan te tagsè sabeka kandan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something connects two other things, it is between those two things, and joins them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This pipe connects the spring with the tank.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This road connects my sitio and your sitio.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you connect one thing to another thing, you join them together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He connected the spring to the tank with a pipe.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He connected the door to the wall.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing connects to another thing, those two things meet and stay together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This wire connects to that box.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egsuman-suman ne due kalabetan te tagsè sabeka kandan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you connect two things or people in your mind, you think that there is a relationship between them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I never connected him with the crime, but now I know that he did it.

entries.summary: nakasumpul; due kalabetan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing is connected to another thing, part of it joins that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This water pipe is connected to the tank.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two things are connected, there is a relationship between them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He doesn't work at the school, but his work is connected to the school.

entries.summary: pegkasumpul; kalabetan; sumpul (meyitenged te tilipunu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the place where two things join, or the thing that joins them together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The water is coming out between the pipe and the tank, because the connection is bad.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is no connection between the food he ate yesterday, and his illness today.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I couldn't hear him well on the phone, because the connection was bad.

entries.summary: egtaluwen
talagpanalu
ka baad te pegkeetew nu ne eggeram te kaleinan te eleg wey kenè

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka baad te pegkeetew nu ne eggeram te kaleinan te eleg wey kenè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your conscience is the part of you which feels the difference between right and wrong.

entries.summary: sinuman-suman (meyitenged te himu wey ke weil); egpakataha; due kalintahaan [kalintaha͡an]

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sinuman-suman (meyitenged te himu wey ke weil)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A conscious action or thing is one that you know about and think about.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She made a conscious decision to do that; it was no accident.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nasakat sikandin ka miggimu te sika ne suman-suman; kenè ne tinuyuan dè sika.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are conscious of something, or are conscious that something is the case, you know about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was not conscious that there was a snake in his bed.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè nakataha sikandin te duen bes uled diyè te lantawan din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are conscious, you are fully awake and your mind is working.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When we sleep we are not conscious.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke eglipereng ki warè kalintahaan [kalintaha͡an] ta.

entries.summary: pegtuhut; egtuhut; egpalintutuu; egsuhut

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her parents gave their consent for her to get married.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you consent to something, you allow someone to do that thing

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My parents didn't consent to my request to move to Manila.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ginikanan ku warè migtuhut te hangyù ku ne eggendiyè te Menila.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you consent to do something that people have asked you to do, you say that you will do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They asked her many times, and finally she consented to dance for them.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggangyù sikandan kandin te kamasalig, wey te naluhey migpalintutuu sikandin ne egpakigsayew kandan.

entries.summary: kapangkusan ne mareet; keilangan; impurtanti

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a result (usually a bad result) that comes from an action.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His illness is a consequence of smoking for many years.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka dalu rin iyan ka kapangkusan te pegpanihupan din seled te masalig ne katuihan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is of_consequence, it is important.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The man talked for a long time, but he didn't say anything of consequence.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Naluhey ne migpangasak ka etew, piru warè miglalag te minsan nekey ne keilangan.

entries.summary: impangkusan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A consequent action or event is a result of something that happened before.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She told me about his accident and his consequent death.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpangguhud sikandin meyitenged te aksidinti wey ka impangkusan te kamatayen din.

entries.summary: egsuman-suman; egsumsumanen eg-ay-ayari; egsuman-suman wey egtanud-tanud te nateil ne kamalehetan ke eggimu te lein

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you consider something to be the case, you think it is the case.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I consider her to be my best friend.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migsuman-suman a ne telek ne alukuy ku sikandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I consider it impolite to interrupt someone.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you consider something, you think about it carefully.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This is an important decision, so consider carefully before you decide.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egsuman-suman wey egtanud-tanud te nateil ne kamalehetan ke eggimu te lein

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you consider a particular fact, you remember it when you think or decide about something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When you make an important decision, you need to consider all the facts.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke egbehey ka te impurtanti ne puhawang, keilangan ne egtantanuran nu ka langun ne me kamalehetan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I know you are upset with him, but consider the fact that he didn't mean to hurt you.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you consider other people, you care about them, and want them to be comfortable and happy.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We should consider the feelings of others when we speak.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ne egbassaan ta ka me geyinawa te duma ke eglalag ki.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Please consider others and don't play loud music late at night.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A considerate person cares about other people and wants them to be comfortable and happy.

entries.summary: dakel; masalig

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is considerable, it is large, or there is a lot of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She spends a considerable amount of time at her friend's house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbehey sikandin te dakel ne timpu diyè te baley te alukuy rin.

entries.summary: pegsuman-suman; pegsuman-suman wey pegtanud-tanud te nateil ne kamalehetan; egtantanuran ne kamalehetan ke eggimu te lein

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of thinking about something (give_something_consideration).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Please give this problem your careful consideration.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegsuman-suman wey pegtanud-tanud te nateil ne kamalehetan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of remembering or using a particular fact when you think or decide something. (take_something_into_consideration).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When you choose a worker, you should take into consideration their character.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke eg-alam ka te trabaanti [traba͡anti] keilangan ne due pegsuman-suman nu te me batasan dan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egtantanuran ne kamalehetan ke eggimu te lein

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you need to remember or think about when you think or decide something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When choosing a boarding house, the price is a very important consideration.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an attitude of caring about other people, and wanting them to be comfortable and happy.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My roommate always shows consideration for me, and tries to be very quiet if she arrives home late.

entries.summary: neyimu puun te minsan nekey; iyan ka

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something consists of other things, it is made of those things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This soup consists of water, fish, cabbage and salt.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ne sabew neyimu puun te weyig, ngalap te weyig, gulay wey asin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something consists in another thing, the two things are the same.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her problem consisted in eating too much sugar.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka prublima rin iyan ka eg-am-amana egkeen te asukal.

entries.summary: kenè egkeiyam; kenè egkabalbalawan; nekeg-iling; nekegtupù; 1 warè pegkahalin; warè kapalinan; 2 pegpekeg-iling; pegpekegtupù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A consistent person or thing doesn't change. In a person, this is a good quality.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a very consistent player, who always plays well.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè egkabalbalawan ne eggalew sikandin su layun dè iya ne meupiya.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The weather is not consistent; some days it is sunny, and other days it rains a lot.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is consistent with another thing, those two things agree with each other and fit together well.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I believe them, because his story is consistent with her story.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpalintutuu a kandan, su ka guhuren din nekegtupù te kandin ne guhuren.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 warè pegkahalin; warè kapalinan; 2 pegpekeg-iling; pegpekegtupù

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I like his consistency in his work, because he always works hard.

entries.summary: laheng te peglalag ne egkatiem ka be-bè nu te deisek dè ne timpu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: laheng te peglalag ne egkatiem ka be-bè nu te deisek dè ne timpu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a speaking sound which you make by closing or partly closing part of your mouth for a short time.

entries.summary: malasi; dahayun; kenè egkabalbalawan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something constant is always there or always the same.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't like the constant rain.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena a egkeupian te dahayun ne uran.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you live on the highway, there is constant noise from trucks.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a number or a thing that is always the same.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My parent's love is a constant in my life.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka geyinawa te ginikanan ku kenè egkabalbalawan kayi te umul ku.

entries.summary: nakapeyimu; nekeg-iling; egpes-ek wey egpabunsud

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If things constitute a larger thing, that larger thing is made of them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: These houses constitute the town of Sinuda.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me baley nakapeyimu te inged ne Simud.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing constitutes another thing, they are the same thing.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka himu rin nekeg-iling te pegpanakew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people constitute something such as an organization or government, they formally start it and give it power.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our college was constituted ten years ago.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbunsud ka iskuylaan ney te sapulù e ne leg-un ka miglihad.

entries.summary: kasuluhan ne baad te minsan nekey; me kukuman; kanekalan te lawa

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kasuluhan ne baad te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The constitution of something is the parts which it is made of.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What is the constitution of this area? How many different tribes are there?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekey ka kasuluhan kayi ne inged? Kamenu kasalig ka tribu kayi?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The constitution of a country or organization is the set of rules which it follows.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your constitution is the health of your body.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't get sick often, because I have a strong constitution.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena a egderalu layun, su due kanekalan te peglelawa ku.

entries.summary: egpakabalabag te himuwen wey puhawang; egpakapehes te peggimu te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something constrains you, it limits what you can do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My travel is constrained by my budget.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka hipanewan ku egkabalabahan te badit ku.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakapehes te peggimu te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something constrains you to do something, it forces you to do that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His love for his son constrained him to sell his horse to buy medicine.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka geyinawa rin te anak din ne lukes egpakapehes kandin te pegbelegyè te kuddè ne igbeli te bawì.

entries.summary: balabag ke nekey ka egkeyimu nu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: balabag ke nekey ka egkeyimu nu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which limits what you can do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We only have three more days, but we will do what we can within the time constraints.

entries.summary: egpangimu; pegpangimu; neyimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you construct something, you build it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The construction of a house takes a long time.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mananey egkeimpusi ka pegpangimu te baley.

entries.summary: eg-inse-insè wey egbuyù te meupiya ne puhawang diyè te egkateu; eg-insè te puhawang te senge etew; egtengteng te kanengnengan diyè te minsan nekey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-inse-insè wey egbuyù te meupiya ne puhawang diyè te egkateu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you consult someone who knows about a particular topic, you ask them what they think about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You should consult a doctor about that problem, because it is serious.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ka ne eg-inse-insè meyitenged te prublima nu diyè te duktur, su masumpit sika.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-insè te puhawang te senge etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you consult someone about something, or consult_with them, you ask them what they think and want.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I will need to consult my wife before I decide about that.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ne eg-insè e pad te asawa ku ne wey ad egbehey te puhawang meyitenged te sika.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egtengteng te kanengnengan diyè te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you consult something such as a book, you look at it to find information.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They didn't know where the place was, so they consulted the map.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè dan nakataha ke hendei ka inged, sikak migtengteng sikandan te mapa.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peglibulung eyew te pegbuyù te meupiya ne puhawang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a meeting with a professional in which you ask them for advice.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have a consultation with my supervisor later today, as I have some questions.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They made the plan in consultation with their friends.

entries.summary: egkeen wey ke eg-inum; eg-amin; egpakaamin; egdereet taman te egkeigmuk; egpekewugmas

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you consume something, you eat or drink it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our guests consumed all the rice.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Naamin te egkeen te me mahaliyug ney ka langun ne keenen.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something consumes something else, it uses it all, so that there is none left.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His work on the house consumed all his time.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Naamin ka langun ne uras din te himu rin diyè te baley.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If fire consumes something, it completely destroys that thing, so that there is nothing left.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The fire consumed the house quickly.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mahaan dè newugmas te hapuy ka baley.

entries.summary: talagbeli; talag-amin

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who buys something or pays for a service.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Consumers spent less money on clothes last year.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Deisek dè ka nahastu ne seleppì te miglihad ne leg-un te seeyè se me talagbeli te me kumbalè.

entries.summary: pegkeen; peg-inum; pegpameli; kakeen; kaamin

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of eating or drinking.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The consumption of alcohol is not allowed in this area.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka peg-inum te egpekewubug ne inumen kenè egkaayun kayi ne inged.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of many people buying things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Consumption is less this year, because people have less money.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegpameli te seini ne leg-un deisek, puun te deisek ka seleppì te me etew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the amount of a material (e.g. fuel) that something uses.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Motor bikes have lower fuel consumption than vans.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka mutur deisek dè ka egkaamin ne gasulina kunterè te terak.

entries.summary: eg-umew wey ke egsulat eyew te pegpakiglalag; kanengnengan; kasayuran; pegpekegdagket te daruwan kasangkapan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-umew wey ke egsulat eyew te pegpakiglalag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you contact someone, you call them or write to them because you want to communicate with them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My old schoolfriend contacted me when she came to my town.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka daan ne alukuy ku te peg-iskuyla ku mig-umew keddì te nekeuma sikandin te lunsud ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that you meet or communicate with someone.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Unfortunately I've lost contact with most of my old schoolfriends.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te warè ku rè nataheyi ne warad e kanengnengan ku te me alukuy ku dengan te peg-iskuyla ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Nurses come into contact with many different kinds of people.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that one thing is touching another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Bread becomes dry when it is in contact with the air.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person you know who is useful to know (e.g., because they have information, or can help you somehow).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has a contact in that Barangay, so it will not be difficult to visit.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due etew ne natahaan din ne egpakabulig diyè te Barangay, sika ka kenè ne malised ka peggendiyè.

entries.summary: due tahù; due nakatahù (minsan nekey); egpapeeneng-eneng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a bag contains another thing, that other thing is in it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sika ne saku due tahù ne behas.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a substance contains a thing, that thing is one of the parts that make it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That coffee contains a lot of sugar, so it's very sweet.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sika ne keppi due dakel ne sukal, sika ka eemisi.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you contain something bad, you stop it from becoming bigger or moving to other areas.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The men contained the fire so that no more houses were damaged.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me kaluklukesan migpapeeneng-eneng te hapuy eyew warad baley ne egkareetan.

entries.summary: langun ne baad wey sitwasyun; ka me lalag wey guhuren ne nakaalingkus te sabeka ne lalag. Egpakabulig sika kaniyu te pegsabut te seeyè ne me lalag wey guhuren.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The context of an action or problem is the whole situation which that action or problem is part of.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In the context of a wedding, it's no problem if you cry.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Langun ne baad wey sitwasyun te pegkekasal, warè prublima ke egsinehew ka.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He thinks I said something bad about his work, but he took my words out of context. I was actually talking about the whole team, not him specifically.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In the context of the recent natural disasters, the organization's focus on emergency care has been very useful.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka me lalag wey guhuren ne nakaalingkus te sabeka ne lalag. Egpakabulig sika kaniyu te pegsabut te seeyè ne me lalag wey guhuren.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The words and sentences around a word or sentence are the context. They help you to understand that word or sentence.

entries.summary: pabulus-bulus (meyitenged te pegkalibed-libed)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A continual action happens again and again.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are continual storms in our area.

entries.summary: egpabulus eggimu; egpabulus wey ke egleus (meyitenged te egpeendiyaan [egpe͡endiyaan]); pegpabulus-bulus te peggimu te iling ne pamaahi, wey kenè ne dakel se pegsanggel wey pegbalew-balew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something continues, it does not stop. If you continue to do something, or continue doing something, you don't stop doing it, or you start doing it again after a break.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The bad weather continued for three more days.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They continued working, even after it became dark.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's time to stop now, but you can continue working on that tomorrow.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpabulus wey ke egleus (meyitenged te egpeendiyaan [egpe͡endiyaan])

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you continue along a road or path, you go further along the path.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Continue east for about 2km, and then turn south.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegpabulus-bulus te peggimu te iling ne pamaahi, wey kenè ne dakel se pegsanggel wey pegbalew-balew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If there is continuity, there is not a large break or change, and things continue in a similar way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's important to have some continuity between the studies in each grade, so that students can revise what they learned the previous year.

entries.summary: mapabulus; egpabulus-bulus

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A continuous action keeps happening with no stop.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We've had continuous rain for three days and nights.

entries.summary: kasabutan ne ka etew wey urganisasyun eg-uyun ne eggimu te minsan nekey para te tagsè sabeka (malasi diyè te trabahu seini); egpatrabahu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kasabutan ne ka etew wey urganisasyun eg-uyun ne eggimu te minsan nekey para te tagsè sabeka (malasi diyè te trabahu seini)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a legal document in which people or organizations agree to do something for each other (often related to work).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I signed a contract and will start work on Monday.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpirma a te kasabutan wey egbunsud a ne egtrabahu te Lunis.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one person or company contracts another person or company to do some work, they formally agree to pay that person or company.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My boss contracted five new workers.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ahalen ku migpatrabahu te lalimma ne iyam ne suluhuen.

entries.summary: egderalu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you contract an illness, you become sick with that illness.

entries.summary: egmalepet; egmalibutut; egkalibulung ne keseg; egpulun-pulun ne keseg

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something contracts, it becomes smaller or shorter.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Metal contracts when it becomes cold.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkalibulung ne keseg; egpulun-pulun ne keseg

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a muscle contracts, it becomes shorter and not relaxed.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you lift something, your arm muscles contract.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke eggenat ka te minsan nekey, ka keseg nu egpulun-pulun.

entries.summary: pegmalepet; peglibulung; pinegsumpul ne lalag puun te daruwan lalag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of something becoming smaller or shorter.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A cramp is a strong, painful contraction of a muscle.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pinegsumpul ne lalag puun te daruwan lalag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one word which is made of two words joined together, with one or more letters taken out. When you write it, you put an apostrophe (') in the place of the letters which were taken out.

entries.summary: kenè egpekeg-ayun; kenè egpekegtulitù; supak

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as an idea is contrary to another thing, it is the opposite of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His thinking is contrary to the thinking of many people here.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka suman-suman din supak te me suman-suman te me etew.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Contrary to what people think, he is not rich.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Q: Is he rich? A: On the contrary. He actually doesn't have much money.

entries.summary: egpekeglein; egpeglein; pegkalein

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two things contrast with each other, they are different in some way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her white shirt contrasts nicely with her dark blue skirt.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you contrast two things, you say what the difference between them is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If I contrast Sinuda and Davao, I can find many differences.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that is different between two people or things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a big contrast between the two brothers: one is talkative, and the other is very shy.

entries.summary: eg-amut; egbehey (iling te pamaahi wey ke puhawang); egpakabehey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you contribute something such as money, you give it to help something happen. Usually, you are one of several people who give.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We all contributed food for the party.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eg-amut ki te pegkeen te kalibulungan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbehey (iling te pamaahi wey ke puhawang)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you contribute something such as an idea or piece of writing, you share it with a group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is very shy, and doesn't often contribute in meetings.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne hiilawen [hi͡ilawen] sikandin, wey kenad iya egbehey te puhawang diyè te kalibulungan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He contributed a story to the magazine.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something contributes to another thing, it is one of the things that cause that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His tiredness contributed to his bad mood.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegkabeley rin nakabehey te mareet ne isip din.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our community newspaper depends on the contribution of articles from people in the community.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We are asking everyone to make a contribution of 50 pesos towards the meal.

entries.summary: egbeye-beyè; pegbeye-beyè; egbeybeyaan ka karakel

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you control someone or something, you have power to make them do things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That area is controlled by rebels.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't want to ride that horse, because I can't control him.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the power to make someone or something do things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Unfortunately she doesn't have much control over her children, so they are very naughty.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That area is under rebel control.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you control something, you limit the amount of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We are trying to control the amount of sugar that we eat.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggimuwan te kukuman eyew te pegbeye-beyè te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you control something, you make rules about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are strict government controls on immigration.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka me baad te mekina eyew te pegpaandar

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the parts of a machine which you use to work the machine.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you want to ride a motorbike, you should first learn how to use all the controls.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke egkeupian ka ne eg-mumutur, keilangan ne egbebasbasan nu pad ka langun ne me baad te mekina eyew te pegpaandar.

entries.summary: egpatemtemuwey eyew te pegpalallalahey; egpatawag te kalibulungan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a group of people convene, they meet together for a formal meeting.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The committee will convene next Monday.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me nabehayan te himuwen egmatemtemuwey te seup ne Lunis.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you convene a meeting, you call people to meet together for it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The leader convened a meeting of the committee.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ahalen migpeumew te kalibulungan para te me nabehayan te me himuwenen.

entries.summary: dakel ne kalibulungan te grupu; nabatasan; kasabutan te nasud wey ke grupu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large meeting of a group, who meet for a particular reason (e.g., a youth convention).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I went to a Manobo youth convention last month.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggendiya a te dakel ne kalibulungan te me Menubù ne me kanakan wey mengebay te miglihad ne bulan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a custom or the usual, accepted way of doing something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is a convention for the man to wear a tangkulu at a tribal wedding.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nabatasan e ne ka lukes egsaluub te tangkulu te timpu te pegpasaweey ne minenubù.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kasabutan te nasud wey ke grupu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a formal agreement between countries or groups.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka eg-ikul te nalayaman ne pamaahi te peggimu ne warè nakasuwey te duma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Someone or something conventional follows the usual ways of doing things, and is not different from others.

entries.summary: eggimuwen ne lein; egkaayun ne eggimuwen ne lein ne kasangkapan; egsaliyu te peggamit te ikaruwa ne klasiyan te seked

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you convert one thing into another thing, you change it to become the other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They converted the house into a shop.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggimu ran ka baley ne tindaan [tinda͡an].

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkaayun ne eggimuwen ne lein ne kasangkapan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something converts into another thing, it can become that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This chair converts into a bed at night.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini ne pinnuuwan egkaayun ne eglantawanen ke marusilem.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egsaliyu te peggamit te ikaruwa ne klasiyan te seked

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you convert an amount from one unit of measurement to another, you change it into the second unit of measurement.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Do you know how to convert miles into kilometers?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kateu ka ne egsaliyu te milya peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te kilumitru?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you convert from one religion to another, you change your religion.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She converted to Christianity last year.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nabalbalawan ka pegtuu rin peendiyè te Kristuwanen seeyè se miglihad ne tuig.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: etew ne nabalbalawan se me pegtuu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who has changed their religion.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is a new convert to Christianity.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 peggimu ne egleinen; 3 pegsaliyu te peggamit te ikaruwa ne klasiyan te seked; 4 pegkabalbalawi te pegtuu

entries.summary: egsubbeen; egsusubba

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you cook something, you prepare it for eating using heat (e.g., a fire).

entries.summary: bayew maagsil [ma͡agsil]; egmaagsil [egma͡agsil]; egkabewu; egpamaagsil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a little cold, but not very cold.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something cools, or cools_down, it becomes cool.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I will wait for the coffee to cool.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egtaharan ku ka keppi ne egkabewu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you cool something, or cool something down, you cause it to become cool.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He cooled his food by blowing on it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impamaagsil [impama:gsil] din ka keenen din te peggiyup.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is cool, they are calm and quiet, not angry or stressed.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Everyone was very worried, but she stayed cool.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana nalaggew ka duma, piru warè dè diyè te kandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is cool towards another person, they are not friendly.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They were very cool towards him, because they were angry with him.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If peole are cool about something, they are not excited or enthusiastic about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Unfortunately, the group was very cool about my idea.

entries.summary: egpabulihey; eggimu ke nekey ka igpeyimu; 1 pegpabulihey; 2 peggimu ke nekey ka igpeyimu; pegparuma-ruma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you cooperate with someone, you work together with them to do something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The two brothers cooperated in planting their fields.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka daruwa ne tahasuled migpabulihey te pegpamula te kamet dan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone cooperates with you, they do what you tell them to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Teaching is difficult if students don't cooperate.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegpanulù malised ke ka me istudyanti kenè egparuma-ruma.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegpabulihey; 2 peggimu ke nekey ka igpeyimu; pegparuma-ruma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is cooperative, they do what you want them to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Teaching is difficult if students are not cooperative.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegpanulù malised ke ka me istudyanti kenen maparuma-ruma.

entries.summary: eggimu te peglibulung te langun ne me etew wey ke butang eyew meupiya ka peggimu; egpekegbulig; egpekeg-eleg; egpekeggayul

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggimu te peglibulung te langun ne me etew wey ke butang eyew meupiya ka peggimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you coordinate an activity, you organize all the people and things so that they work together well.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother coordinated the party, so she was the one who told everyone what to bring.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka iney ku miggimu te kalibulungan, sika ka sikandin ka migkahi te tagsè sabeka ke nekey ka eg-alapen.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you coordinate two actions or two parts of your body, you make them work together well.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is not good at basketball because he can't coordinate his eyes and hands.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ne meupiya sikandin te pegbubula su kenè egpekegbulig ka mata rin wey me belad din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If things such as colors coordinate with each other, they fit together well.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Your T-shirt doesn't coordinate with your pants.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kumbalè nu kenè egpekeggayul te salual nu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: litra wey numiru eyew te pegpakita te minsan nekey diyè te mapa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a letter or number that shows where something is on a map.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can't find that city on the map. What are its coordinates?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ku egkakita ka siyudad kayi te mapa. Nekey buwa ka me litra wey numiru eyew egkanengnengan seini?

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peggimu te peglibulung te minsan nekey eyew ka langun ne baad egpekegbulig te himu

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our manager's job is the coordination of all the teams in the company.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the state of things fitting or working together well (senses 2 & 3).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is not good at basketball because his hand-eye coordination is poor.

entries.summary: eg-iling
taliwarè te minsan nekey (iling te behas); keilangan wey impurtanti ne baad te minsan nekey; deisek ne grupu te me etew ne layun ne apil te grupu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: taliwarè te minsan nekey (iling te behas)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the middle part of something, such as some fruits.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This marketplace is at the core of the city.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ne palingki diyè te taliwarè te siyudad.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The core of an apple doesn't taste good.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka taliwarè te mansanas mareet se nanam.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: keilangan wey impurtanti ne baad te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the most basic or important part of something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The core of the problem is that she is just lazy.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka nakita ku ne egpuunan te prublima diyè te kandin sika se pagkapehulen din.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: deisek ne grupu te me etew ne layun ne apil te grupu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the small group of people who are the main regular members of a group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We have a core staff of 6, but other people work with us.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due hen-em dè ne trabahanti ney, piru ka duma ne etew egbulig egtrabahu kanami.

entries.summary: aheley

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a kind of seed which you can eat. It is usually yellow or white.

entries.summary: pikungan ne pupul ne pinegtemu te mapatag ne kasangkapan; pikungan te baley; nasiku

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pikungan ne pupul ne pinegtemu te mapatag ne kasangkapan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a place where two sides of something join (e.g., the corner of a table or building).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I hurt my hand on the corner of the table.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Masakit ka belad ku ne nakasangkak te pikungan ne pupul ne pinegtemu te lamisa.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the area in a room where two walls meet.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a chair in the corner of the room.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due bangku te pikungan te baley.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the area of land where two roads meet.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His house is on the corner.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka baley rin su diyè te nasiku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a difficult situation which is hard to get out of (be_in_a_corner).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is in a corner, because his boss says that he needs to move to another city or he will lose his job.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you corner a person or animal, you catch them in a place which they can't get away from.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She cornered the piglets and put them in a box.

entries.summary: due kalabetan te dakel ne kumpanya; eggimuwen ne himu te grupu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due kalabetan te dakel ne kumpanya

fields.label: English explanation
