fields.text: Something corporate is related to large businesses or companies.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The businessman goes to many corporate meetings.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I am wearing a suit, because we have to wear corporate dress.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something corporate is done by a group

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We have corporate singing at church.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due himu ney ne peg-ulahing diyè te simbaan.

entries.summary: dakel ne kumpanya
eleg

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is correct, the information is right.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She gave ten correct answers on the test.

entries.summary: egpekeg-iling; egpegsulatey; nekeg-iling; nekeg-eleg

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two things correspond with each other, they fit together or they are similar.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't believe them because their stories don't correspond with each other.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena a egpalintutuu kandan su warè nekeg-iling ka guhuren dan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This is the wrong key, because it doesn't correspond with the lock.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two people correspond with one another, they write letters to one another.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use corresponding to talk about something which fits with another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She put the key in the corresponding lock.

entries.summary: pegpekeg-iling; pegpasulatey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that two things fit together or are similar.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a close correspondence between their stories.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due karaniyan ne pegpekeg-iling te guhuren dan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of people communicating with each other by writing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They continued their correspondence for a year.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impabulus dan ka pegpasulatey te me katuihan.

entries.summary: bali; kentidad; igpabali; egpakaawè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The cost of something is how much you need to pay for it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What is the cost of that chair?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something costs a certain amount, that is how much you pay for it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: How much did that chair cost?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Pila a ka igpabali te bangku?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an action costs you something, it causes you to lose that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The accident cost him his leg.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The cost of an action is the thing that you lose because of that action.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Professional sportspeople spend a lot of time training, sometimes at great cost to their family life.

entries.summary: gapas

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a natural material which comes from plants and can be used to make cloth.

entries.summary: egbuween; pegpabubuwè; prublima te lawa ne egpakapabuwè te amana; buwè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you cough, you push air out of your mouth in a short, noisy action.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a single action of coughing (see sense 1)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: prublima te lawa ne egpakapabuwè te amana; buwè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a problem with your body which causes you to cough a lot.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have a bad cough, but I feel OK.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due mareet amana ne buwè ku, piru hendue e te peggeram-geram ku ne meupiye e.

entries.summary: nekeyimu; naayun; nateu; buwa (egkahamit seini ke duwa-ruwa ne egkeyitabù); kaayun ded ubag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you could do something, you were able to do it in the past.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I couldn't see because it was dark.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ku egkakita su marusilem seeyè.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: buwa (egkahamit seini ke duwa-ruwa ne egkeyitabù)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something could happen, maybe it will happen in the future.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It could rain tomorrow, but I'm not sure.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eg-uran buwa kaaselem, piru kena an siguradu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use could to ask for something politely.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kaayun ded ubag ne egbulihan an keykew?

entries.summary: grupu te me etew ne egparumdumeey [egparumdume͡ey] eyew te pegbehey te me disisyun; gubirnu te lukal ne me lugar (iling te Barangay); labet te grupu; apil te grupu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: grupu te me etew ne egparumdumeey [egparumdume͡ey] eyew te pegbehey te me disisyun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of people who meet together to make decisions.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a member of the church council.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: gubirnu te lukal ne me lugar (iling te Barangay)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the government of a local area (e.g., the Barangay Council).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: labet te grupu; apil te grupu

entries.summary: egseel te numiru; egseel te etew wey ke kasangkapan; pegseel

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you count, you say numbers one after the other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My young son can count to twenty.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egseel te etew wey ke kasangkapan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you count people or things, you see how many there are.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She counted the children and wrote the number in her notebook.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: At the last count, there were 320 people in the village.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you count something, you include it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our teacher will count our test tomorrow towards our final grade.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka talagpanulù ney eglakes te tis ney kaaselem eyew te malehet ne gradu ney.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something counts, it is included.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our test tomorrow counts towards our final grade.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka tis ney kaaselem egkalagkes e eyew te malehet e ne gradu ney.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something counts, it is important.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Tell me what you think, because your ideas count.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nangeni a ke nekey ka suman-suman nu, su ka me puhawang nu egkeilanganen.

entries.summary: ngaran te minsan nekey ne egkaseel nu, uya su mahaan nu egkakita ka sabeka kayi (iling te kuddè, hibatanan)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ngaran te minsan nekey ne egkaseel nu, uya su mahaan nu egkakita ka sabeka kayi (iling te kuddè, hibatanan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the name of something which you can count, because it is easy to see one of it (e.g., horse, bed).

entries.summary: dalepè; inged; inaranan; nasud; ka inged ne due nateil ne tahù wey ke ulaula; ka inged ne warè siyudad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an area of land and people with their own government (e.g., The Philippines, Australia).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka inged ne due nateil ne tahù wey ke ulaula

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use country to talk about an area of land which has some particular characteristic (e.g., the people who live there, the shape of the land).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Matigsalug country, mountainous country, snake country.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: inged te me Matigsalug, bubunganen ne inged, uleren ne inged.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The_country is an area which does not have cities.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I prefer living in the country, because cities are too noisy and busy for me.

entries.summary: alunggun wey ke due rilasyun ne lukes wey malitan; daruwa ne etew ne egpegsukubey; pegparisey; egpekegsumpul wey ke egpekegtimul

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: alunggun wey ke due rilasyun ne lukes wey malitan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a male and female who have a relationship (e.g., husband and wife, or boyfriend and girlfriend).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There's a new couple in our town.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due iyam ne alunggun te lungsud ney.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: daruwa ne etew ne egpegsukubey; pegparisey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is coupled with another thing, the two things join together to produce some result.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A headache coupled with a backache made me very uncomfortable.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Masakit ne ulu ne egpekegtimul te masakit ne peka nekeyimu keddì te kenè ne meupiya se peggeheyinawa.

entries.summary: senge buuk ne deisek ne pepil ne egkasaliyuan te minsan nekey (diyè te tindaan [tinda͡an] wey duma pad)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: senge buuk ne deisek ne pepil ne egkasaliyuan te minsan nekey (diyè te tindaan [tinda͡an] wey duma pad)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a small piece of paper which you can exchange for something (e.g., in a shop).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have a coupon for a free Coke at Jollibee.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due senge buuk ku te deisek ne pepil eyew te libri ne Kuk diyè te Dyalibi.

entries.summary: bayaanan; eggimuwen nu ne himuwen te nateil ne keyimtang; layun egkeyitabù ne kapabulusan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the path that a person or vehicle is travelling along.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The ship changed course, so that it was moving east, not south.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our course took us into the forest.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is difficult to know the course that a typhoon will take, because it can change direction quickly.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggimuwen nu ne himuwen te nateil ne keyimtang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the thing that you decide to do in a particular situation.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What course of action should we follow now: should we search for the lost group, or wait until it is light?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I think that the best course of action is to wait.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the way that something naturally happens.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In the course of that disease, patients usually get a fever on the second or third day.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka egkeyitabù te sika ne dalu, ka pasyinti egdatengen te ikaruwa wey ke ikatelu ne aldew.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It will be interesting to see the course that the weather takes in the next few days.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sunud-sunud ne egnengnengen te nateil ne guhuren

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a series of lessons or subjects about a particular topic (e.g., a nursing course).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one of the parts of a meal (e.g., main course, dessert).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happens in_the_course_of or over_the_course_of a period of time, it happens during that time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He met many new people in the course of the day.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakaalukuy sikandin te masulug ne me alukuy te seeyè ne aldew.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He met a lot of famous people in the course of his life.

entries.summary: galawanan; husayanan; hukumanan; kurti

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an area with marks on the ground, for playing sports such as basketball and tennis.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a place where someone such as a judge decides about problems with the law.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The criminals appeared in court so that the jury could decide if they were guilty.

entries.summary: egpaal-alihey; egparumdumeey [egparumdume͡ey]; egpandalaha; eggimu te minsan nekey eyew igkeupii wey egbulihan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: if a man and a woman court, they spend time together, because they are thinking about getting married.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My parents courted for a year before they decided to marry.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ginikanan ku migparumdumeey [migparum-dume͡ey] pad te senge tuig ne wey pad migpaasaweey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a man courts a woman, he tries to cause the woman to love him so that she will marry him.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggimu te minsan nekey eyew igkeupii wey egbulihan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you court a person or group of people, you do things because you want them to like you or support you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The mayoral candidate is courting the people in that sitio by promising to help them.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggimu te minsan nekey eyew te pegkuwa te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you court something such as fame, you try to get it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That singer has been courting publicity by giving a lot of free concerts.

entries.summary: suled

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your first_cousin is the child of your mother's sister or brother, or the child of your father's sister or brother. There are other kinds of cousins that are not so close.

entries.summary: kasabutan ne ka etew wey ke urganisasyun egsaad ne eggimu te minsan nekey para te lein ne etew wey ke urganisasyun; saad ne inggimu te Manama diyè te me etew, wey ke kasabutan ne inggimu te Manama diyè te me etew.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kasabutan ne ka etew wey ke urganisasyun egsaad ne eggimu te minsan nekey para te lein ne etew wey ke urganisasyun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a legal document in which a person or organization promises to do something for another person or organization.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: saad ne inggimu te Manama diyè te me etew, wey ke kasabutan ne inggimu te Manama diyè te me etew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a promise which God makes to people, or an agreement which God makes with people.

entries.summary: egpekeempet; bunbun; supè; hagpi; keub; egsupè; egtel-eb; egbun-bun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something covers another thing, it is spread all over that other thing (e.g., vines over a field, mud over feet).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The sweet potato vine covers the whole field.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Water from the flood covered the floor.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something such as a lid or a cloth, which you put on another thing.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you cover something with another thing, you put the other thing on it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They covered the rice pot and took it off the fire.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The air was very dusty, so they covered the computers with a cloth.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It was cold, so she covered the baby with a blanket.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka hun-a ne makepal ne bunbun te libru

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the outside part of a book or magazine.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The cover of the book was damaged when he carried it in his schoolbag.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you cover particular topics when talking or studying, they are the topics which you talk about or study.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The lesson covered the last 50 years of Philippine history.

entries.summary: baka
talawan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: someone who doesn't do something because they are afraid.

entries.summary: bagtad
eggimu; peggimu; hinimuwan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you create something new, you cause it to exist.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The Bible teaches about the creation of the world.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka bibliya egpanulù meyitenged te peggimu te kalibutan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The purpose of this new government project is the creation of 500 new jobs.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Mickey Mouse is a creation of Walt Disney.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka Mickey Mouse hinimuwan ni Walt Disney.

entries.summary: peutang; egseled ne seleppì; egbehey te sika ne karakelan wey egkahi te egkaayun ne egkahamit nu ne seleppì

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a system in which you can get something now (on_credit) and pay for it later.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't buy things on credit, because it is hard to pay for them later.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena a egkuwa te kasangkapan ne peutang, su malised ka pegbayad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an amount of money that comes into a business or a bank account.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This was a good month for our business because we received many credits.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Meupiya ne bulan kuntee te nigusyu ta su dakel ka migseled ne seleppì.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbehey te sika ne karakelan wey egkahi te egkaayun ne egkahamit nu ne seleppì

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a bank or organization credits you with a certain amount, or credits a certain amount to you, they give you that amount, or say that you can use that amount.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Globe credited me with 100P worth of free texts.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka Glub migbehey keddì te sabekan gatus ne pisus ne tiks.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Globe credited 100P of free texts to my cellphone.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbehayan a te Globe te libri ne tiks te silpun ku.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: seleppì ne igpahamit puun te kumpanya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an amount of money which an organization gives you, or says that you can use.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When I returned the shoes, the shop didn't refund my money. They just gave me a credit to get something else at the store.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpalintutuu ne miggimu wey egpalintutuu ne due

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you credit someone with some good action, you believe they did it. If you credit someone with an ability, you believe they have it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Datu Gawilan is credited with saving the Matigsalug tribal land.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Si Datu Lorenzo Gawilan Sr. migpalintutuuwan ne migluwas wey ke migbulig te tanè te Matigsalug.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Of course I understand! please credit me with some intelligence.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the praise that people give to someone for doing something good.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She should get a lot of credit for the good work that she did.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a school or college gives you credit for a subject, they say that you have passed in this subject, and do not need to study it again.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My new college gave me credit for a subject that I did at another college.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a bank account is in_credit, there is still money in it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His bank account is in credit, because he always tries to put in more money than he takes out.

entries.summary: beuhan
limerang
peglapas te balaud

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action which breaks the law.

entries.summary: etew ne egguhus te balaud; due kalabetan te peglapas te balaud

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who breaks the law.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due kalabetan te peglapas te balaud

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That is a dangerous town because there is a lot of criminal activity there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's a criminal act to steal.

entries.summary: me basiyanan; me tengtenganan te peg-alam

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me basiyanan; me tengtenganan te peg-alam

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the things that you use to judge the quality of something. The singular form is criterion.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What criteria do they use to select the mutya in the search?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekey ka me basiyanan te peg-alam te mutya te kuntis.

entries.summary: basiyanan
etew ne egdew-ey te senge etawan wey te minsan nekey; etew ne iyan himu se egpanulat te me puhawang wey suman-suman dan (diyè te libru wey ke salida)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: etew ne egdew-ey te senge etawan wey te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who says bad things about someone or something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are many critics of the new plan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: etew ne iyan himu se egpanulat te me puhawang wey suman-suman dan (diyè te libru wey ke salida)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: someone whose job is to write their ideas and opinions about things such as books and movies.

entries.summary: amana ne keilangan; mareet se keugpè (meyitenged te peglelawa); mareet ne impanlalag nu diyè te senge etew wey te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is critical, it is absolutely necessary.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is critical that you turn off the gas after you finish, because it will be very dangerous if you do not.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is in a critical condition, they are very sick, and in danger of dying.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His daughter is in a critical condition in hospital after the accident.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mareet ne impanlalag nu diyè te senge etew wey te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are critical of someone or something, you say that they are bad.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: People have been very critical of that man because of what he did.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpekeyimu ne egbehey te puhawang ne meupiya wey ke mareet pinaahi te pegtengteng te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If your thinking is critical, you are able to look at something carefully and decide the good and bad things about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our teacher tells us to use critical thinking when we read, to decide whether the writer is correct or not.

entries.summary: pegpandew-ey te senge etew wey te minsan nekey; igkarew-ey; himu te pegnengneng te minsan nekey ne amana ne maayad-ayad (iling te druwing wey ke guhuren) wey pegsulat ke nekey ka egkasuman-suman nu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegpandew-ey te senge etew wey te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of saying the things which you think are bad about someone or something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I respect him, because he can listen to criticism without getting angry.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which you think is bad about someone or something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Your work is very good overall, but I just have one small criticism.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: himu te pegnengneng te minsan nekey ne amana ne maayad-ayad (iling te druwing wey ke guhuren) wey pegsulat ke nekey ka egkasuman-suman nu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the work of studying something carefully (e.g., art or literature), and writing what you think about it.

entries.summary: egdew-ey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you criticize someone or something, you say something bad about them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I feel upset if people always criticize my cooking.

entries.summary: buaya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large reptile with a long body, short legs, a long, powerful snout and sharp teeth. Similar to an alligator.

entries.summary: pinamula
eglapas; egpekegsumbalak; egpekegtemu; krus

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you cross something such as a road or river, you move from one side of it to the other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Check for trucks before you cross the road.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Tengteng ka te terak ke eglapas ka te kelesadda.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two things cross (e.g., roads, pieces of wood), one of them stretches from one side to the other side of the other thing.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a shape that looks like the small letter 't'. A symbol of Christianity.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a shape like this: x. It is often used to show that something is wrong.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There were many crosses on my exam, because many of my answers were not correct.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Masalig ne iks te iksam ku, su masalig ka tabak ku ne kenè ne eleg.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpeg-amut wey ke egpeg-abid te mananap wey ke pinamula; egpegliwat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you cross one animal or plant with a different one, you breed them together to create a new kind of animal or plant.

entries.summary: kasuluhan te me etew, dakel ne grupu te me etew; egkarasek (meyitenged te me etew)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kasuluhan te me etew, dakel ne grupu te me etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large group of people all together.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people crowd somewhere, they all fit close together into a small space.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Twenty people crowded into the van.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Daruwan pulu ne me etew ka narasek diyè te ban.

entries.summary: kuruna
amana ne keilangan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A crucial thing is absolutely necessary, and you have a problem if you don't have it or do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is crucial that you arrive on time, or you will miss the boat.

entries.summary: eggimatey ne pinaahi te peglansang wey ke pegpansal diyè te krus; peglansang wey ke pegpansal te etew diyè te krus

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggimatey ne pinaahi te peglansang wey ke pegpansal diyè te krus

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone crucifies a person, they kill them by attaching them to a cross.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peglansang wey ke pegpansal te etew diyè te krus

entries.summary: egsinehew; pegsinehew; egpanagyawan (te panunggiling, puun te nasakitan wey ke eyew te pegbuyù te bulig)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you cry, tears come from your eyes, usually because you feel sad or emotional.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I felt better after I had a long cry.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpanagyawan (te panunggiling, puun te nasakitan wey ke eyew te pegbuyù te bulig)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you cry, or cry_out, you make a loud sound, maybe because of pain, or to ask for help.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She cried out when the dog bit her.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpanagyawan sikandin te ingkahat sikandin te asu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a loud sound that someone makes.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I heard his cries for help.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Narineg ku ka sagyawan din te pegpakitabang.

entries.summary: Iyan sika se peggimu wey pegbungkag te tanè eyew egkapamulaan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Iyan sika se peggimu wey pegbungkag te tanè eyew egkapamulaan.

entries.summary: menà; kultura; himuwen ne due kalabetan te ulahingen wey duma pad; pamaahi wey pegbebatasan te etew diyè te grupu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the ways of life of a tribe or nation of people, including things such as music, attitudes and food.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In traditional Matigsalug culture, old people are respected.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: himuwen ne due kalabetan te ulahingen wey duma pad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: activities related to things such as art, music and literature.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The art gallery in that city is free, so everyone can experience some culture.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pamaahi wey pegbebatasan te etew diyè te grupu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The culture of an organization or group is the way that people in the group behave and feel.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our family has a culture of respect for others.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sikanami se taltalaanak due pegbebatasan ne egtahud te duma.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of bacteria or cells which somebody is growing (usually for science, or for food such as yoghurt).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This yoghurt has three different good bacteria cultures.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 due kalabetan te menà wey kultura; 2 due kalabetan te ulahingen wey duma pad; 3 due kalabetan te pegbebatasan te etew diyè te grupu

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She would love to go to cultural events such as concerts, but she doesn't have enough money.

entries.summary: pakawan; ubab

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which you drink out of

entries.summary: egbawì
Iyan ka batasan te me etew ne amana egkapanseb ke nekeyà è ì ù

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Iyan ka batasan te me etew ne amana egkapanseb ke nekeyà è ì ù

entries.summary: kunteen pad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something current is happening now, or belongs to now (e.g., the current month, meaning this month).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I want to know current news, not old news.

entries.summary: kabeheng te pegduù [pegdu͡ù]; peg-usug te kalamag; peg-usug te kurinti te alambri

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a strong flow of water in a river or the sea.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Be careful of the current in the river, because it is very strong.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Bantey ka te kabeheng te weyig su amana ne kekesehi.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was a current of air flowing through the house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due peg-usug te kalamag diyè te baley.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a flow of electricity through wires.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's dangerous to touch wires if they are carrying an electric current.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Dilikadu ka eggen-gen te me wayir ke due kurinti.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: geyinawa wey puhawang ne diyè te punduk te me etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling or idea that is there in a group of people.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There were currents of unhappiness within the group.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due geyinawa te warè pegkahalè te grupu.

entries.summary: egdilus (meyitenged te etew); egduyè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone curses you, they say words to cause something bad to happen to you (e.g. an accident or illness). If God curses a person or group, he says that bad things will certainly happen to them.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone curses you, they say that they want bad things to happen to you.

entries.summary: kurtina
egtempug; egtulis; egkulit; tulis

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you cut something, you use something sharp (e.g., scissors, a knife) to separate it into pieces or take off part of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He cut the sugar cane into pieces

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He used the scissors to cut the paper.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You need to cut your fingernails, because they are long and dirty.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you cut something, you make a mark in it with something sharp

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I cut my finger while I was washing the knife.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Natulis ka kemel ku te miggugasan ku ka ilab.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He cut his name into the tree.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtulis din diyè te kayu ka ngaran din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a mark in something, which has been made with something sharp.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There were a lot of cuts on his leg after he cleared the field.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due masalig ne tulis te paa rin pegke-impus te peggawan din te kamet.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What are those cuts in the bamboo?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you cut something, you make it smaller

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The doctor told me to cut the amount of salt in my diet.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka duktur migkahi te igpareisek ka karakel te asin te pegkeen ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The shop had a big sale and cut many of their prices.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action of making something smaller

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We were happy because there were many price cuts in the sale.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Unfortunately, he lost his work in the job cuts which his company made.

entries.summary: egkalibed-libed ne pegkeyitabù te nateil ne pamaahi; egbebayik eyew te pegtalibeng; egkalibed-libed ne hitabù

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkalibed-libed ne pegkeyitabù te nateil ne pamaahi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a set of events which happen in a particular order again and again (e.g. the life cycle of a moth).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you cycle to a place, you ride a bicycle to it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The seasons of the year are cyclical.

entries.summary: tagsè aldew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A daily thing happens every day.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have one cup of coffee daily.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eg-inum a te sabeka ne basu ne keppi te tagsè aldew.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I enjoy my daily cup of coffee.

entries.summary: egsayew; sayew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you dance, you move your body in time with music.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of body movements which you do with music.

entries.summary: mareet ne sitwasyun; hendue te due mareet ne egkeyitabù; minsan nekey ne egpakarereet te etew wey ke kasangkapan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that someone can get hurt or killed.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is in danger because there is a fire near her house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Diyè sikandin te mareet ne sitwasyun su due hapuy ne marani te baley rin.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: hendue te due mareet ne egkeyitabù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If there is a danger of something, or a danger that something bad will happen, it is possible that thing will happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a danger that he will be angry if you ask him.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Hendue te egkalangetan sikandin ke eg-insaan nu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne egpakarereet te etew wey ke kasangkapan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that can hurt people or things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That man is a danger to this town.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something is dangerous, they can hurt people or things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That big dog is dangerous because he sometimes bites people.

entries.summary: marusilem; meebul; malised wey ke makaaldek-haldek [maka͡aldek-haldek]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a place is dark, there is not much light from the sun or another light.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It was very dark in the room, because there was no window.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a color is dark, it is heavy and strong, not pale, and has some black in it (e.g., dark blue).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a period of time is dark, it is very difficult or frightening.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That was a very dark time for my family.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mareet (meyitenged te suman-suman wey ke himu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as thoughts or actions are dark, they are bad or not happy.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that there is not much light.

entries.summary: nenapunpun ne me kamalehetan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a set of facts or numbers about a particular topic.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We measured how tall all the students were, and wrote the data in a chart.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Scientists measured the blood pressure of 20,000 patients, and then analysed this/these data using computers.

entries.summary: nateil ne aldew wey bulan te tuig; himu te kanakan wey mengebay ne pegpabehayey te timpu eyew egpeggeyinaweey; egkaraan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nateil ne aldew wey bulan te tuig

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a particular day in a month in a year (e.g., June 22nd, 2004).

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekey ne aldew ka kasal nu?

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: himu te kanakan wey mengebay ne pegpabehayey te timpu eyew egpeggeyinaweey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a social activity in which a male and female spend time together because they want to have a relationship.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something dates, it begins to look old-fashioned, because it comes from a particular time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That style is very fashionable, but it will date quickly.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sika ne pegkeyimu amana ne mabantug, piru mahaan sika egkaraan.

entries.summary: anak ne malitan
aldew; maaldew

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are 365 days in one year.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the part of a 24-hour period when there is light from the sun.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We worked all day, from sunrise to sunset.

entries.summary: napatey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person, animal or plant is dead, they are no longer living.

entries.summary: tuliyen
kasabutan; egbeli wey ke egbelegyè te minsan nekey; egpamehey wey ke egtalad-talad te baraha

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an arrangement between people or companies where each one agrees to do, give or pay something (make_a_deal).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The two farmers made a deal to help each other at harvest time.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbeli wey ke egbelegyè te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a business deals in a particular product, that is the product that they buy or sell.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Sorry, we don't deal in that brand of televisions.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpamehey wey ke egtalad-talad te baraha

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you deal cards in a card game, you give them out to the people in a group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He dealt the cards and then waited for people to arrange their cards.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a book or movie deals_with a particular topic, it is about that topic.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The movie deals with the issue of homelessness.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you deal_with a person, you communicate with them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is an English teacher, so she deals with international students all the time.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Inglis sikandin ne talagpanulù, sikak egpakalalag sikandin te me istudyanti gawas te nasud te langun ne timpu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you have to deal_with something bad or difficult, you experience that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She has many problems to deal with.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Masalig ne prublima rin ne egsalerepen.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you deal_with a problem, you are able to do something to solve it or survive it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our cat deals with the rats, so we don't have a rat problem now.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of deal

entries.summary: pegkapatey

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She cried about the death of her dog.

entries.summary: egpaapuley; apulanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people debate about something, they talk about their different opinions and the reasons for their opinions.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The two men debated about the problem.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka daruwa ne etew migpaapuley meyitenged te prublima.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a situation where people say their different opinions about something, and give the reasons for their opinions.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a lot of debate about the best way to fix that problem.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due masalig ne apulanan meyitenged te kinameupiyaan ne pamaahi te pegsulbad te prublima.

entries.summary: utang; nekeutang (meyitenged te kenè ne seleppì)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you have debt or are in debt, you need to pay money to one or more people or organizations, because they gave you the money before.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Life is hard when you are in debt.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My uncle has a lot of debts, because he borrowed money from many people.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you feel that someone has helped you a lot, you say that you owe them a debt.

entries.summary: sapulù ne leg-un
nammewu
egpakapamuhawang; egpakabehey te puhawang; egkaalam ne egpalintutuuwen; egpakabehey te kanengnengan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you decide to do something, you choose to do it after you think about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I decided to go home because it was cold.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakapamuhawang ad ne eg-ulì diyè te baley su maagsil [ma͡agsil] nahud.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We talked about what to do next, and decided to go fishing in the river.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpeglalahey key te seup ne eggimuwen ney, wey nasabekaan ney ne egngengalap key diyè te dakel ne weyig.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you decide that something is true, you choose to believe that it is true after you think about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I decided that his idea was a good one.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Naalam ku ne ka kandin ne puhawang ka meupiya.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something decides another thing, it causes a particular result or choice.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The weather will decide our plans for tomorrow: if it's fine, we'll go to the farm, and if not, we'll work at home.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka timpu ka egpakabehey te kanengnengan te puhawang ta kaaselem: ke meupiya, eggendiyè ki te kamet, ke kenè, kayi ki rè te baley eggimu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The result of the game tomorrow will decide which team goes to the final.

entries.summary: puhawang ne mig-alam; katuenan te pegbehey te puhawang ne meiyal wey siguradu meyitenged te suman-suman din

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the thing that you choose to do (make_a_decision).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't agree with his decision to sell his carabao.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The Barangay is going to make a decision about the new water pipe soon.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: katuenan te pegbehey te puhawang ne meiyal wey siguradu meyitenged te suman-suman din

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the ability to decide things quickly and feel sure about them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She lacks decision, so it is difficult for her to decide things.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kulang sikandin te katuenan te pegbehey te meiyal ne puhawang puun te suman-suman, sika ka malised kandin ka pegdisisyun.

entries.summary: eglalahen te eleg ne geem [ge͡em] wey katenged; eglalahen te titing-awi wey mapahetpet; eglalahen ne due katenged, ne ka minsan nekey due diyè te keykew, eyew egkanengnengan dan wey degma egbayaran nu ka taks

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eglalahen te eleg ne geem [ge͡em] wey katenged

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone in authority declares something, they say it officially.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: After the wedding ceremony, the pastor declared the couple to be man and wife.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Pegkeimpus te sirimunyas te asaweey, ka pastur miglalag diyè te impeg-asawa te alunggun e sikandan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That country just declared war on its neighbor.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you declare that something is the case, you say it clearly and quite strongly.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She declared that she didn't like the idea.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eglalahen ne due katenged, ne ka minsan nekey due diyè te keykew, eyew egkanengnengan dan wey degma egbayaran nu ka taks

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you declare something that you have, you tell someone in authority that you have it. This is so that they can check it, or because you have to pay tax on it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I need to declare all the money I earn when I fill up my tax papers.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ne iglalag ku ka langun ne seleppì ne egkakita ku ke egsulat ad te pepil te taks.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 peglalahen te eleg ne geem [ge͡em] wey katenged; 2 peglalag te titing-awi wey mapahetpet; 3 peglalag ne due katenged, ne ka minsan nekey due diyè te keykew

entries.summary: egdeisek; pegdeisek; egmareet wey egmahuyè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a number declines, it becomes smaller.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The number of people in that town is declining.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kasuluhan te etew te lungsud migdeisek.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of a number becoming smaller.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There has been a decline in the number of motorbike accidents this year.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due pegdeisek te seel te aksidinti te me mutur te seini ne tuig.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something declines, it becomes less good or strong.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I am sad because my grandfather's health is declining.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana a ne egkalangè su ka apu kun lukes egmahuye e.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of something becoming less good or strong (be_in_decline).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The power of that country is in decline.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka geem [ge͡em] te seeyè ne nasud su migmahuyè.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There has been a decline in the quality of things from that shop.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eglalag te meupiya te kenè pegpalintutuu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you decline to do something, you say politely that you will not do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The politician declined to comment when the journalist asked him a question.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you decline an invitation, you politely say no to it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I declined their invitation, because I already had plans for that day.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè ku palintutuwa ka hinggat dan, su duen e napuhawang ku te seeyè ne aldew.

entries.summary: egdeisek; egpareisek; pegdeisek

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something decreases, it becomes less, or smaller.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you decrease something, you cause it to become less.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of something becoming less.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There has been a decrease in the number of students.

entries.summary: egkatahaan [egkataha͡an] (puun te duma ne kanengnengan ne diyè te kuna)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkatahaan [egkataha͡an] (puun te duma ne kanengnengan ne diyè te kuna)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you deduce something, you are able to know it from other information that you have (you didn't see it or hear about it directly).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She didn't tell me that she was from Malaysia, but I deduced it from her accent.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè migpanugtul sikandin ne impuun sikandin diyè te Malisya, piru natahaan [nataha͡an] ku diyè te peglalag-lalag din.

entries.summary: egsalinan; eg-awaan; egkuan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you deduct one amount from another amount, you take the first amount away from the second amount.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She deducted 300 pesos from my pay because I was absent without a reason.

entries.summary: pegnengneng; pegtaha (puun te duma ne kanengnengan ne diyè te kuna); natahaan [nataha͡an]; nanengnengan; pegsalin

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegnengneng; pegtaha (puun te duma ne kanengnengan ne diyè te kuna)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of using other information to know about something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The detective used deduction to find out who the criminal was.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you know by using other information.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I agree with her deduction that the businessman is corrupt.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of taking one amount away from a larger amount.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an amount that someone takes away from a larger amount.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I received a deduction in my tax because I had given some money to charity.

entries.summary: iyan ka himu ne mareet wey ke meupiya; iyan kalig-enan meyitenged te tanè wey baley

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: iyan ka himu ne mareet wey ke meupiya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that a person does (e.g., a good deed or a bad deed).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: a brave deed, a good deed, a terrible deed

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: iyan kalig-enan meyitenged te tanè wey baley

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a legal document, usually about who owns land or a building.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has the deeds to this land, so he can choose whether to sell it.

entries.summary: maralem; karalem; malayat ne bayaanan puun te tangkaan peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te peka

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as water or a hole is deep, it is a long way from the top down to the bottom.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use deep to give the measurement of something from the top to the bottom.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The well is one meter deep.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka belun su sabeka ne mitru ka karalem.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: malayat ne bayaanan puun te tangkaan peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te peka

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a shelf is deep, it is a long way from the front to the back of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The shelf is very deep, so it comes out a long way from the wall.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When he was a child he had a high voice, but now his voice is very deep.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A deep feeling is very strong or real.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has a deep respect for his father.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due leleheti ne pegrispitu rin te amey rin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a word or meaning is deep, it is difficult to understand, or it is something which you need to think about.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That word is deep Matigsalug, and a lot of young people don't know it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That story has a deep meaning which you won't get if you just read it quickly.

entries.summary: usa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a wild animal which has hard feet (hooves) and eats grass. Males often have antlers (branched horns).

entries.summary: pegtalu
egpakig-ehet te pegpangabang te duma eyew kenè egkasakitan; egpangabang te pegpangatarengan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakig-ehet te pegpangabang te duma eyew kenè egkasakitan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you defend a person, thing or place against someone or something, you fight to stop them from being hurt.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When the attackers came, he stood in front of his wife to defend her.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The men defended the house against the fire.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you defend someone or something that people say bad things about, you say why that person or thing is not bad.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Nobody in the committee liked his idea, so he needed to defend it.

entries.summary: nakasalè; pasangilan; bayungan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In a law court, the defendant is the person who people say has done something bad.

entries.summary: pegpakig-ehet eyew te pegpeengked te etew, butang wey ke lugar ne egkasakitan; pegpangabang; pegpangabang te pegpangatarengan; egpakapangabang; egpakaalang; egpakaatang; egpakabulig

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegpakig-ehet eyew te pegpeengked te etew, butang wey ke lugar ne egkasakitan; pegpangabang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of fighting to stop a person, thing or place from being hurt.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Their defense of the city was successful, and the attackers could not enter.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of saying why a person or thing is not bad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which can stop a person, thing, or place from being hurt.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Vitamin C is a good defense against the flu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Some ancient cities had walls as a defense against attack.

entries.summary: egluwas; egpanluwas

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you define a word or phrase, you say what it means.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka diksyunari egpanluwas te me lalag.

entries.summary: nateil e; kenad egkabalbalawan; malehet; mapahetpet ne peglalag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a plan is definite, it is already decided, and probably will not change.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Maybe we will travel on Friday, but our plans are not definite yet.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Hendue te eggipanew key te Birnis, piru ka puhawang ney warè pad nateil.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is definite, you are sure that it is real.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was a definite sound of thunder just then, I'm sure.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due dahing ne malehet te luhung kuntee, siguardu a.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are definite about something, you are strong and sure when you speak about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She was very definite that she could not help us.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mapahetpet sikandin ne migkahi te kenè egpakabulig kanta.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a definite color or shape is strong and clear, so that you know what it is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The color is not definite; it is sort of between blue and pink.

entries.summary: pegbehey te kaluwasan; punpun te me lalag ne egpasabut te kaluwasan; egkamelmelehan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: punpun te me lalag ne egpasabut te kaluwasan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of words which explain the meaning of another word or phrase.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A dictionary is a book of definitions.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka diksyunari iyan ka libru te me kaluwasan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the state of a picture being clear and showing detail.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The photos don't have good definition, so I can't see people's faces clearly.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka litratu kenè egkamelmelehan, su kenè mating-ew ka me ulaula.

entries.summary: kamenu karakel wey ke kamenu kakeseg; baad te timpu; baad te kaluahan te egkasiku

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kamenu karakel wey ke kamenu kakeseg

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The degree of something is how much or how strong it is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This job requires a high degree of skill and commitment.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a unit of temperature. The symbol is °. We usually measure temperature either in degrees Celcius or degrees Fahrenheit.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a unit of measurement for angles. The symbol is °. There are 360° (degrees) in a circle.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: neimpusan ne kursu te pegkeimpus te pegiskuyla diyè te unibirsidad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a qualification you receive after finishing study at a university.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have two degrees: a Bachelor of Science and a Master of Education.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka baad ne kaluahan te natahuan te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a unit of measurement of the position of a place in the world, compared with the equator (north-south) and a place in England called Greenwich (east-west).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The location of the Philippines is 13° 00 N, 122° 00 E [Source: www.mapsofworld.com/lat_long/philippines-lat-long.html]

entries.summary: langan
pegpaalap
eglalag te mapahetpet ne pegbuyù; mapahetpet wey pehes ne pegbuyù; egkeilangan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you demand something from someone, or demand that they give you something, you tell them strongly that they must give it to you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He demanded an answer from the frightened child.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a very strong request for something (make_a_demand).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They did not listen to the demands of the kidnappers.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something demands something, it needs that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Babies demand a lot of time and patience.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka batè egkeilangan te dakel ne timpu wey pasinsya.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The problem demanded my immediate attention, so I left work in order to to fix it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A demand on you is something that you need to do or give.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: As barangay captain, there are a lot of demands on his time.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegkakeilangan (meyitenged te kasuluhan te me etew ne egmambebeli)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The demand for a particular product is how many people want to buy it and can buy it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This product is very popular: there is a high demand for it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini ne pruduktu amana ne mabantug: due dakel ne pegkakeilangan te me etew kayi.

entries.summary: busew; due kalabetan te me busew
egpakita wey eggimu te himu; egpakita ke egmenuwen te eggimu ka minsan nekey; egparid wey ke egmiting (eyew te pegpakita te kenè pegkahalè)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you demonstrate that something is the case, you show that it is the case by using actions, examples or reasons.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She demonstrated that she was sorry by changing her behavior.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpakita wey miggimu sikandin te pegbuyù te pasaylu pinaahi te pegbalewbalew te kandin ne pegbebatasan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakita ke egmenuwen te eggimu ka minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you demonstrate how to do something, you do it to show people how.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father demonstrated how catch fish because I didn't know how.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka amey ku migpakita ke egmenuwen te egdakep ka ngalap te weyig su kena a egkateu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egparid wey ke egmiting (eyew te pegpakita te kenè pegkahalè)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a group of people demonstrate, they have a parade or public meeting to show that they are unhappy about something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In the capital city, hundreds of people demonstrated about their bad work conditions.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Diyè te iney ne siyudad, eggatus ka me etew ne migpakita te warè pegkahalè te sitwasyun te trabahu ran.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegpakita wey peggimu te himu; 2 peggimu wey peggamit eyew te pegpakita; 3 egpakita te warè pegkahalè

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Many people watched his demonstration of how to use a computer.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegparid wey ke pegmiting (eyew te pegpakita te kenè pegkahalè)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an event in which people demonstrate in a public parade or meeting.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Hundreds of workers joined the demonstration in the capital.

entries.summary: pegpahunwarè ne warè ka minsan nekey; pegtetalù ne warè minsan nekey su kenè igkeupii; kenè peg-angken

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegpahunwarè ne warè ka minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of saying that you didn't do something, or the action of saying that something is not the case.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegtetalù ne warè minsan nekey su kenè igkeupii

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of not allowing someone to have something.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of saying that you do not have a relationship with someone.

entries.summary: egpahunwarè ne warè ka minsan nekey; egtetalù ne warè ka minsan nekey su kenè igkeupii; kenè eg-angkenen

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpahunwarè ne warè ka minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you deny doing something, or deny that you did something, you say that you didn't do it. If you deny that something is the case, you say that it is not the case.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpahunwarè sikandin ne warè din kua ka seleppì.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He denied that his dog was dangerous.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migkahi sikandin te ka asu rin kenè ne dilikadu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She denied that she had taken the money.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egtetalù ne warè ka minsan nekey su kenè igkeupii

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you deny someone something, you don't allow them to have it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He denied the children another mango.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtetalù sikandin te warad duma ne mangga diyè te me batè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you deny someone, you say that you do not have a relationship with them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His mother denied him when he went to prison.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè angkena sikandin te iney rin te naprisu sikandin.

entries.summary: baad te dakel ne nigusyu, tindaan [tinda͡an] wey ke urganisasyun (apil ka gubirnu) ne due nateil ne himu wey ke katuyuan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: baad te dakel ne nigusyu, tindaan [tinda͡an] wey ke urganisasyun (apil ka gubirnu) ne due nateil ne himu wey ke katuyuan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a particular part of a large business, shop or organization (including the government). It has a particular job or purpose.

entries.summary: egkeilangan te bulig diyè te sabeka; egsalig; iyan egkataharan ka duma ne kasangkapan; egdipindi

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkeilangan te bulig diyè te sabeka; egsalig

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you depend_on someone or something, you need them to help you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother depends on me to help her in the house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka iney ku egsalig te bulig ku diyè te baley.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: iyan egkataharan ka duma ne kasangkapan; egdipindi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing depends_on a second thing thing, the second thing controls it, so that it changes when the second thing changes.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our plans depend on the weather: if it is sunny, we will go walking.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka planu ney egdipindi te timpu: ke eg-aldew, egmanggipanew key.

entries.summary: ka me etew ne egkeilangan te bulig eyew egkeuyag (iling te seleppì)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka me etew ne egkeilangan te bulig eyew egkeuyag (iling te seleppì)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who needs your financial support to live.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have six dependants: my wife, my two children and my parents.

entries.summary: egsalig; egtahad te newun-a; pegsalig te duma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are dependent on someone or something, you need them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My children are dependent on me for food.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me anak ku egsalig keddì te pegkeen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My friend is very dependent on me for advice.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing is dependent on a second thing, the second thing controls it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our plans are dependent on the weather.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Iyan egkataharan te puhawang ta ka timpu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the state of being dependent on someone or something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm not happy about her dependence on me, because she is already an adult.

entries.summary: seked ne karalem; Eggamit ka kayi diyè te pegbehey te seked te minsan nekey puun te tangkaan peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te peka.; keyimulung

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The depth of something such as water is the measurement from the top to the bottom.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What is the depth of the water?

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Eggamit ka kayi diyè te pegbehey te seked te minsan nekey puun te tangkaan peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te peka.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The depth of something such as shelf is the measurement from the front to the back of it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The depth of a sound is how low it is.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The depth of a feeling is how strong or real it is.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The depth of a meaning is how complex it is, or how much you need to think about it to understand it.

entries.summary: egligkat; egpuun; ingkuwa; egpapuun; migligkat; peg-alawat, pegpapuun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something derives from another thing, it comes from that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her sickness derives from bad food.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka dalu rin migligkat te mareet ne pegkeen.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you derive something from another thing or place, then you get it from that other thing or place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This shampoo is derived from plants.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka siyampu ingkuwa ligkat te pinamula.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The derivation of coconut oil from coconuts takes time.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the source that something such as a custom or word came from.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't know the derivation of that custom.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: wara a nakataha te ligkatanan te pegmemanè.

entries.summary: kabuhalan; kaligkatan; kabuwaran

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The descendant of a person is their child, grandchild, great-grandchild, etc. That is, they live later and come from that person's family.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I am a descendant of a famous datu: he was my grandfather's grandfather.

entries.summary: egpahunsiling; egpanunggiling; eg-ilingan wey egsulaten ne ulaula; pegpahunsiling

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you describe something, you talk or write about it so that people will know it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When my friend described her home town, I wanted to visit that place, because it sounded beautiful.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you describe a shape, you make that shape, (e.g., by drawing, or moving).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In baseball, the four bases describe a diamond.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te bisbul, due hep-at ne baley ne neiling te dayamun.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I recognized him immediately because of the description which he had given me in his letter.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sahuhunè ne neilaan [neila͡an] ku sikandin tenged te lalag ne pegpahunsiling ne imbehey keddì diyè te sulat.

entries.summary: eg-engked; eg-awè; iyan ke eg-awè ne warè migpataha

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone deserts a person, they go away from that person and don't help them any more.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Those children don't have much food because their father deserted them and and moved to Luzon.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone deserts a place, they go away from that place so that it is empty.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Everyone deserted the village after the fire.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: iyan ke eg-awè ne warè migpataha

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a soldier deserts, they leave the army without permission.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Many of the soldiers deserted and joined the other side.

entries.summary: inged ne mammara ne kenè egkeupaan te egkaluhey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: inged ne mammara ne kenè egkeupaan te egkaluhey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an area of land where there is not much water and not many plants.

entries.summary: egsumansuman te ulaula; nasulat wey ke neyimu ne ulaula te minsan nekey; pegkeyimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you design something, you plan what it will look like, and what parts it will have.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He designed the house and then built it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migsusuman-suman din ka ulaula te baley wey miggimu rin seini.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nasulat wey ke neyimu ne ulaula te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a drawing of what something will look like, and what parts it will have.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He showed me the design for the house that he wanted to build.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impakita rin ka neyimu rin ne ulaula te baley ne igkeupii rin ne eggimuwen.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the way that something looks and the different parts it has.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The design of that bridge is not very attractive, but it is strong.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegkeyimu te sika ne teytey kenè amana ne meupiya, piru malig-en.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a pattern on something such as clothes.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That is a very pretty design on her skirt.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana sika ne meupiya ne dayan-dayan te saya rin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your design when you do something is the thing that you want to achieve.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His design in walking to the river was to see the horse.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka igkeupii rin ne egkuen te pegbayè diyè te weyig iyan ka pegtengteng te kuddè.

entries.summary: egkeupian; pegkeupian; igkeupii

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you desire something, you want it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He told me of his desire to be a doctor.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkeupian ne eggilabet (meyitenged te malitan wey lukes)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you desire someone, you want to have sex with them.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegkeupii ne eggilabet (meyitenged te malitan wey lukes)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling of wanting to have sex with a person.

entries.summary: lamisa; pinuuwan; senge sinabengan te dakel ne baley ne eggendiyaan te me etew eyew te pegnengneng te me guhuren

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a table that is used for study or work. It often has drawers.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: senge sinabengan te dakel ne baley ne eggendiyaan te me etew eyew te pegnengneng te me guhuren

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a place in a building such as a hotel or office where people can go to receive service from the staff.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I received the information I needed from the girl at the front desk.

entries.summary: minsan pad...piru; egkahamit nu seini ne lalag ke egpangguhud ka te nekeg-lein ne guhuren piru elin mallehet.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkahamit nu seini ne lalag ke egpangguhud ka te nekeg-lein ne guhuren piru elin mallehet.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use despite to say that one fact is not changed or affected by another fact.

fields.label: English example
