fields.text: Despite loving sport, she doesn't play much now.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Minsan pad te meupiya sikandin ne eggalew piru kenad kuntee amana sikandin eggalew.

entries.summary: egdereetan; pegdereet; nareetan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something destroys a thing, they break or damage it very badly, so that it can't be used any more.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The dog destroyed my shoes, so I can't wear them now.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was destruction everywhere after the typhoon hit the city.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due nareetan minsan hendei pegkeimpus te bagiyu ne migginguma te siyudad.

entries.summary: deisek wey ke kenè amana ne keilangan ne baad te minsan nekey; langun ne dereisek wey ke maralem ne baad te minsan nekey; nenateil ne baad te me katahaanan [kataha͡anan] meyitenged te etew wey butang

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: deisek wey ke kenè amana ne keilangan ne baad te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a small or complex part of something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She just told me the story quickly, because she didn't have time to tell me all the details.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The color of the paper is just a minor detail, and we'll decide that later.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father fixed the date of the party, but my mother planned all the details, such as food and decorations.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: langun ne dereisek wey ke maralem ne baad te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: all of the small or more complex parts of something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a lot of detail in his paintings, so they are very clear and also very interesting.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He went into a lot of detail when he told the story.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He described the woman in detail.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nenateil ne baad te me katahaanan [kataha͡anan] meyitenged te etew wey butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The details of someone or something are particular pieces of information about them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She gave me her contact details, so that I could call or email her.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't know all the details about the party, but I know that it is some time in June.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egsulaten wey egbehey te duma pad ne kanengnengan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you detail things, you list them and give extra information about them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In your report, you need to detail everything that happened.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egsuhù eyew te peggimu te nateil ne minsan nekey ne himu (meyitenged te sundalu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone in the military details a soldier to do something, they order the soldier to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The commander detailed three soldiers to guard the building.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ahalen te sundalu migsuhù te tatelu ne me sundalu ne egpabantayan ka dakel ne baley.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: himu ne insuhù ne igpeyimu te me sundalu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A soldier's detail is the job which someone has ordered them to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Their detail is to guard the building.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka insuhù kandan ne himu iyan ka egpabantayen te dakel ne baley.

entries.summary: 1 kataharan; 2 pegnengneng; 3 peg-alam; pegpehes peggimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an attitude that you will do something even if it is very difficult, or other people don't want you to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Successful sportsmen have a determination to win.

entries.summary: egkataharan; egkeinsaan; egnengneng; eg-alam

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing determines another thing, it causes the other thing to be a certain way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The weather will determine our plans for tomorrow.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka timpu ka egkataharan te planu ta kaaselem.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My test results will determine whether I pass the subject.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka risulta te te tis ku ka egkataharan ke nakapasar e naa te sabdyik ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you determine something, you know it by checking the facts about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The doctor did some tests to determine the patient's exact illness.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka duktur miggmu te duma ne peggeram eyew egnengneng te eleg ne dalu te pasinti.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you determine something, you decide and choose it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My parents allowed me to determine my own plans for the vacation.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ginikanan ku migtuhut keddì ne eg-alam ke hendei a egbakasyun.

entries.summary: egkapehes ne eggimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are determined to do something, you are going to do it, even if it is very difficult, or even if other people don't want you to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is determined to buy a horse.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Napehes sikandin ne egbebeli te kuddè.

entries.summary: Lalag seini ne eggamiten nu te kenè pad ka ngaran eyew te pegbehey te katahaan pad te ngaran ne lalag.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Lalag seini ne eggamiten nu te kenè pad ka ngaran eyew te pegbehey te katahaan pad te ngaran ne lalag.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a word which you use before a noun phrase to give more information about the noun phrase.

entries.summary: egtulin; egmatesan; egmeupiya; egdakel; egbunsud e (meyitenged te prublima wey ke sitwasyun); egkabaluy (meyitenged te inged); egkeyimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something develops, they grow or become more mature or complete.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbunsud e (meyitenged te prublima wey ke sitwasyun)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a problem or situation develops, it starts to exist.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a country develops, it becomes richer and has better technology and more industry.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you develop something, you make it become better or more complex.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggimu te iyam ne minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you develop something new (e.g., a computer program), you create it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you develop a film from a camera, you use chemicals to make photographs from the film.

entries.summary: ahalen te me busew; Satanas

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The_Devil is the leader of all evil spirits and the enemy of God.

entries.summary: kekehali wey amana ne keilangan ne klasiyan te batu; Iyan ka due daruwa ne maliddus ne pulipusan wey hep-at ne amulan ka pikungan.; galawanan te bisbul

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kekehali wey amana ne keilangan ne klasiyan te batu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a very hard precious stone, made of crystallized carbon. It is often transparent.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Iyan ka due daruwa ne maliddus ne pulipusan wey hep-at ne amulan ka pikungan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a shape like two triangles joined together.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the field where baseball is played (because the four bases make a diamond shape).

entries.summary: nekeyimu; neyimu; Eggamiten ka seini te me inse wey ke due 'ware' ne igtimul ne lalag meyitenged te minsan nekey ne miglihad e.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Neyimu ku ka himu te migsabsabeka.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Eggamiten ka seini te me inse wey ke due 'ware' ne igtimul ne lalag meyitenged te minsan nekey ne miglihad e.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use did in questions or with 'not' to talk about something from the past.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Q: Did you go to the river yesterday? A: No, I didn't.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Q: Nekeendiyè [neke͡endiyè] ka te pahamayan ne weyig gabii? A: Warè, wara a miggendiyè.

entries.summary: egpatey; egpeeneng-eneng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person, animal or plant dies, it stops living.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as an engine dies, it stops working.

entries.summary: kaleinan; apulanan; ka egkahaat [egkaha͡at] te eg-awaan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that is different between two things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What's the difference between these two words?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an argument, because people have different thinking about something.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The difference of two numbers is the number that you have after you take one number away from the other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The difference of ten and four is six.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka egkahaat te sapulù ke eg-awaan te hep-at su hen-em.

entries.summary: nekeglein; nekeg-esa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing is different from (or different than) another thing, they are not the same.

entries.summary: egpakakita wey egpakameleg-meleg te kaleinan; egpakapasuwey; egpakapalein; pegpakakita wey pegpakameleg-meleg te kaleinan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you differentiate between two things, or differentiate one thing from another, you can see the things that are different.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The twins look the same, and many people can't differentiate between them.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seping iling te egpekeg-iling, wey masalig ne etew ne kenè egpakakita wey egpakameleg-meleg te kaleinan dan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is color blind, and so he can't differentiate red from green; they both look the same to him.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something differentiates one person or thing from others, it makes them different from the others.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His brown hair differentiates him from his black-haired friends.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka makalawag ne bulbul rin egpakapasuwey kandin te me alukuy rin ne memeitem se bulbul.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The differentiation of green and red is difficult for color blind people.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegtengteng te kaleinan te meilem wey malalab su amana ne malised diyè te kenè egpakameleg-meleg ne me etew te batek.

entries.summary: malised; malasey; malehen (meyitenged te batasan te etew)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is difficult to do or understand, it is not easy.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's difficult to see the path in the dark.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Liliseri ka pegtengteng te dalan te marukilem.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His name is difficult to remember.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Malised ka ngaran din ne egsumsumanen.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A difficult situation is painful and uncomfortable.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Life is very difficult for them at the moment, because they lost their field.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Malasey ka umul dan kuntee, su nawarè ka kamet dan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A difficult person quickly becomes angry, and it is not easy to make them happy.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a difficult man, and argues with many people.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Malehen ne etew sikandin, wey egpakig-apul te masalig ne me etew.

entries.summary: kalised; prublima

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the state of being difficult to do or understand.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was surprised by the difficulty of the exam.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana a natekew te kalised te iksam ney.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We all have many difficulties in our life.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due masalig ne me prublima te me umul ta.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That swimmer is in difficulty! We need to help her.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka talaglumbuk diyè te prublima kuntee! Keilangan ne egbulihan ta sikandin.

entries.summary: egkalut
baad te minsan nekey; kaluag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A dimension of something is a part of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Sport is a very important dimension of school life.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka galew ne baad amana ne keilangan te peg-iskuyla.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The dimensions of something are the measurements of how long, wide and deep it is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What are the dimensions of that box?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekey ka kaluag te sika ne kehun?

entries.summary: iglabung

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a meal (the midday or evening meal). 'Supper' may be a more common name for the evening meal.

entries.summary: matul-id (meyitenged te bayaanan wey ke lingya); amana egkatahaan [egkataha͡an] ne due kalabetan; warè kehè ne peglalag

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: matul-id (meyitenged te bayaanan wey ke lingya)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A direct path or line is straight.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This is the direct route to the school. The other way is much longer.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ka matul-id ne ruta peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an]. Ka duma ne dalan su amana ne maddiyù.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If there is a direct relationship between two things, it is very clear that one thing causes the other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a direct link between smoking and lung cancer.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My boss has direct contact with the president.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are direct, you say exactly what you mean very clearly, and don't try to be too polite.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She was very direct, and told me that I was going to fail if I didn't work harder.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you direct something at another thing, you move it so that it points at that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He directed the gun at the frightened people.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you direct someone to a place, you tell them how to get there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They directed me to the bus terminal.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you direct someone to do something, you tell them that they must do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He directed them to take off their shoes.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you direct a group or organization, you lead and control it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If there is direct communication between two people, they talk to each other, and don't have another person carrying messages between them.

entries.summary: iyan ka duritsu ne egdawat te weil

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: iyan ka duritsu ne egdawat te weil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In English, the direct_object of a verb is the person or thing that is the receiver of the verb action.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She sold the chicken [the chicken is the direct object]

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Imbelegyè din ka manuk [ka manuk ka duritsu ne egdawat te weil]

entries.summary: egpatangkaan; pabulusan; igkeupii ne puhawang ne eggimuwen te egginguma; pegpapalingkesu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the place or point which something moves or faces towards.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Q: Which direction were they going in? A: They were going west.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: igkeupii ne puhawang ne eggimuwen te egginguma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The direction of a person or group is the things that they want and plan to do in the future.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She was studying business, but she has decided to change direction and study education.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of leading and controlling a group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His direction of the company is very different from his father's.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The directions for doing something (e.g. cooking) or going somewhere are the words which tell you how to do that thing or go to that place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You should follow the doctor's directions when you take medicine.

entries.summary: etew ne eg-uyan te grupu wey ke kumpanya; talagpanulù te egpangimuwen te me etew te salida

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: etew ne eg-uyan te grupu wey ke kumpanya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one of the people who control an organization.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: talagpanulù te egpangimuwen te me etew te salida

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The director of a movie is the person who tells the actors and assistants what they should do, and who controls the making of the movie.

entries.summary: lindit; bilu; lapek puun te tanè; malindit

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that makes another thing not clean.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You have dirt on your face.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the material that the ground is made of

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is dirty, it has dirt on it.

entries.summary: kenè eg-uyun; kenè egpekeg-uyun; kenè egkabennalan; kenè egpekegbennaley; kenè egpekegsinabut

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè eg-uyun; kenè egpekeg-uyun; kenè egkabennalan; kenè egpekegbennaley; kenè egpekegsinabut

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you disagree with someone, you have different thinking about something.

entries.summary: egkatarin; egkawarè; pegkatarin; pegkawarè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something disappears, people either can't see it or can't find it any more.

entries.summary: hibateen ne eg-ikul wey egnengneng puun te nateil ne talagpanulù

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: hibateen ne eg-ikul wey egnengneng puun te nateil ne talagpanulù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: someone who follows and learns from a particular teacher.

entries.summary: egkakita; egkatuenan; egkatahaan [egkataha͡an]; 1 pegpakakita; 2 pegkateu, pegkataha

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you discover something, you find it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I discovered a snake near our CR.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you discover that something is true, you learn something that you didn't know before.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I discovered that my father was a fast runner when he was young.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Natuenan ku ne ka amey ku meiyal ne eglingkesu dengan te batè pad sikandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He made an interesting discovery when he went walking in the mountains.

entries.summary: maaddat; mabassa; kenè ne malemu ne egkatahaan [egkataha͡an]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are discreet, you are careful to respect the secret or private information of another person, so that you don't embarrass them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Please be discreet with the information I just told you, because I don't want my friends to know.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ampingi nu ma ubag ka inlalag ku keykew ra, su kena ag keupian negkapeyilawan ka alukuy ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was very discreet, and did not ask any questions about my phone call.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A discreet action or thing is not very easy to notice.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In the meeting, he sent a few discreet text messages, but nobody noticed.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I like her earrings, because they are discreet, not big and bright.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you don't want anyone to see you, leave by the back door, as it is more discreet.

entries.summary: nabaad-baad te tagsè sabeka

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Discrete things are clearly separate from each other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The body of an insect has three discrete parts: the head, the thorax and the abdomen.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka lawa te insiktu due tatelu ne pegkabaad-baad: ka ulu, ka kumeng wey ka getek.

entries.summary: pegbassa, pegtahud, wey ke peg-addat te duma; geem [ge͡em] wey katuenan te pegbehey te uupiyei ne puhawang ne eggimuwen te nateil ne sitwasyun

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegbassa, pegtahud, wey ke peg-addat te duma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that you are careful to respect the private information of others.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Thank you for your discretion yesterday, when you left the room when I received the personal phone call.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Salamat te peg-addat nu gabii, te peg-awè nu te nakarawat a te umew puun te silpun.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: geem [ge͡em] wey katuenan te pegbehey te uupiyei ne puhawang ne eggimuwen te nateil ne sitwasyun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the power and ability to decide what is the best thing to do in a particular situation.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In his job he has the discretion to choose new workers.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te seini ne trabahu due geem din te peg-alam te iyam ne trabahanti.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I trust you to decide how much money to offer for the horse, so you don't need to ask me; just use your discretion.

entries.summary: egpakakita wey egpakameleg-meleg te kaleinan; egleig-leig; 1 pegpakakita wey pegpakameleg-meleg te kaleinan; 2 pegleig-leig

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you can discriminate between things, you can see that they are different.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Some people can't discriminate between red and green, and think they look the same.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka duma ne etew kenè egpakameleg-meleg te kaleinan te malalab wey meilem, wey egsuman-suman te nekeg-iling dè sikandan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you discriminate against someone, you treat them worse than other people because of something about them such as their race, sex or age. If you discriminate in favor of someone, you treat them better than other people.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegpakakita wey pegpakameleg-meleg te kaleinan; 2 pegleig-leig

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is sometimes discrimination against indigenous groups.

entries.summary: egpeglalahey; pegpalallalahey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people discuss something, they talk about it together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We discussed the movie after we watched it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpeglalahey key te salida te neimpusan ney te egtengteng.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was a lot of discussion at the meeting.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My friends and I had a discussion about the movie.

entries.summary: dalu; kahew (diyè te lawa te etew, mananap wey ke pinamula)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: dalu; kahew (diyè te lawa te etew, mananap wey ke pinamula)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something in or on the body of a person, animal or plant which makes them sick.

entries.summary: hugasenen
egpakita te minsan nekey diyè te etew; pegpakita te minsan nekey; egpanahù te minsan nekey diyè te egkakita te me etew

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakita te minsan nekey diyè te etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you display something, you show it to people.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She displayed her new earrings to her friends.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impakita rin ka iyam ne eritis din diyè te alukuy rin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We were surprised by his loud display of anger.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Neinu-inu key te malangit ne laheng din te pegpakita te kalanget din.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpanahù te minsan nekey diyè te egkakita te me etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you display something, you put it in a place where many people can see it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He displayed the photos on the wall.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impanahù din ka me litratu diyè te alabat.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: natahuan te me minsan nekey eyew egpitawen te me etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a thing or group of things which is in a place so that people can look at it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She walked around the shops and looked at the displays in the windows.

entries.summary: 1 pegdegpak; 2 pegduwad pinaahi te pegbehey wey pegbelegyè; egkeyimu nu wey egkakuwa nu te mahaan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegdegpak; 2 pegduwad pinaahi te pegbehey wey pegbelegyè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of disposing of something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Burning is the most popular method of garbage disposal here.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egsilaban ka nabantug ne pamaahi te pegdegpak te basura.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkeyimu nu wey egkakuwa nu te mahaan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you have something at_your_disposal, you can get it easily and can do what you want with it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is rich, and has a lot of money at his disposal.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeyimu wey ke egkakuwa rin mahaan ka minsan nekey su meyaman sikandin.

entries.summary: egdegpak; egduwaren pinaahi te pegbehey wey pegbelegyè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you dispose_of something such as garbage, you throw it away or somehow remove it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We dispose of our garbage by burning it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Igdegpak ney ka basura ney pinaahi te pegsilab.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egduwaren pinaahi te pegbehey wey pegbelegyè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you dispose_of something that you own, you give or sell it to someone.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We disposed of our horse by selling him.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migduwad ney ka kuddè ney pinaahi te pegpabeli.

entries.summary: eggeramen ne igkeupii te eggimu; ka eggeramen nu (meyitenged te etew wey ke kasangkapan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are disposed to do something, you feel that you want to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We talked to the Barangay captain, and he was disposed to help us.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpakiglalag key te Barangay kepitan, wey miggeram ney ne egbulig sikandin kanta.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka eggeramen nu (meyitenged te etew wey ke kasangkapan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are disposed towards someone or something in a particular way, that is the way that you feel about them.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè egkeupian sikandin te me batè.

entries.summary: kariyuan; seeyè te diriyui

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The distance between two things is how far they are from each other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's only a short distance from here to the shops, so we can walk.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Deisek dè ka kariyuan te tindaan [tinda͡an] puun kayi, sika ka egkaayun dè ne eggipanawen ta.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is in_the_distance, it is far away.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can see smoke in the distance, so maybe there is a fire in the mountains.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due egkakita ku ne ebul seeyè te diriyui, kema ke nasilaban ka bubungan.

entries.summary: mariyù; kariyuan te dengan ne timpu wey ke kariyuan pegkeimpus kuntee ne timpu (kariyuan te dengan; kariyuan te egginguma); duen e kariyuan te rilasyun te karumaan [karuma͡an]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is distant from you, it is far away from you.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kariyuan te dengan ne timpu wey ke kariyuan pegkeimpus kuntee ne timpu (kariyuan te dengan; kariyuan te egginguma)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use distant to talk about a time long before or long after now (the distant past, the distant future).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: duen e kariyuan te rilasyun te karumaan [karuma͡an]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two relatives are distant, the relationship is not very direct, and there are many relatives in between them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is my grandmother's second cousin: quite a distant relative.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is distant when they speak to you, they are not very friendly.

entries.summary: nekegsuwey; nekeglein; mating-ew; egkamelmelehi; mahaan egkakita, egkarineg, wey egkataheyi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something distinct is different and separate from other things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are two distinct yokes in this egg.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due daruwa ne natù ne nekegsuwey te seini ne atelug.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mating-ew; egkamelmelehi; mahaan egkakita, egkarineg, wey egkataheyi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something distinct is clear and easy to see, hear or know.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He saw the distinct shadow of a snake on the fence.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakakita sikandin te mating-ew ne alung te uled diyè te alad.

entries.summary: pegkasuwey; kaleinan; pegtengteng te kaleinan; pegkameupiya; amana ne meupiya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The distinction between two things is the difference between them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Those two colors look the same, and I can't see any distinction between them.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sika se daruwa ne batek nekeg-iling, wey warè nakita ku ne kaleinan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of seeing differences between things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The distinction of red and green is difficult for people who are color-blind.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegtengteng te kaleinan te malalab wey meilem ne batek su malised te etew ne kenè egpakakita te batek.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the state of being very, very good.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He finished his study with distinction.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-impusan din ka peg-iskuyla te pegkameupiya rin.

entries.summary: egpakakita wey egpakameleg-meleg te kaleinan; egpakakita wey ke egpakarineg; egpakapeyimu te kaleinan te lein ne butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you can distinguish things, you can see the difference between them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My sister and I are twins, and not many people can distinguish us.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you can distinguish something that is far away or not clear, you can see or hear it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He could distinguish a house on the far away

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakapeyimu te kaleinan te lein ne butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a particular feature of something distinguishes it, it causes that thing to be different.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is very tall, and this distinguishes him from his classmates.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Malayat amana sikandin, wey seini na nakapeyimu ne lein sikandin te me klasmit din.

entries.summary: egpamehey; egpanalad; egpanalagtag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you distribute something to a group of people, you give some of it to each person.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She distributed the rice to the children.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you distribute something, you spread it so that it is in many parts of that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you make biku, distribute the ginger through the rice, so that all the ginger is not together.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke eggimu ka te biku, igpanalagtag nu ka luya diyè te hemey eyew egpakasewug.

entries.summary: pegpamehey; pegpanalad; pegpanalad

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I helped with the distribution of food at the party.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbulig a te pegpamehey te keenen diyè te kalibulungan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the distribution of something is the amount which is spread in an area, and where it is spread.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The distribution of money in the world is not equal.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegpanalad te seleppì kayi te inged kenè ne eleg.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What is the distribution of schools in the west part of the city? How many are there, and where are they?

entries.summary: baad te dalepè wey ke nasud

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: baad te dalepè wey ke nasud

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a part of a town or country.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The Philippines has many pineapple-growing districts.

entries.summary: masalig ne klasiyan; kalkalasiyan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a group of things or people is diverse, there are many different kinds of things or people.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a diverse range of birds in the forest.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due masalig ne klasiyan te bayaku te katalunan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I enjoy the diversity of the birds in the forest.

entries.summary: egbaad-baad; egpegsuwey-suwey; egkabaad; egpakapataliwarè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you divide something into parts, you cause it to be in parts, not one thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our teacher divided us into three groups.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Imbaad key te tatelu ne grupu te talagpanulù ney.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She divided the apple into 4 parts, using a knife.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something divides, it becomes more than one thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The road in that sitio divides in two.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kelesadda te sityu nabaad te daruwa.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something divides two areas, it is between them, and causes them to be two areas, not one.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This fence divides my land and his land.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ne alad nakapataliwarè te tanè ku wey te tanè din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something divides a group of people, it causes problems between them, because they don't agree about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Sadly, this problem has divided my family.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Makalelangè, seini ne prublima ka nakahuhus te pamilya ku.

entries.summary: pegpansuwey-suwey; pegbaad-baad; sitwasyun ne due prublima te grupu tenged te kenè egpekegsinabut; pegpakahuhus; baad te dakel ne punduk ne seled te nateil ne lugar wey ke due nateil ne himu

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We used plastic bags for the division of the bread.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eggamit ki te silupin eyew te pegpansuwey-suwey te paan [pa͡an].

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sitwasyun ne due prublima te grupu tenged te kenè egpekegsinabut; pegpakahuhus

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In a group, division is the fact that there are problems in the group because people don't agree.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Unfortunately there is a lot of division in our team at the moment.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: baad te dakel ne punduk ne seled te nateil ne lugar wey ke due nateil ne himu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a part of a large organization which is in a particular area, or which has a particular job.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I work in the Mindanao division of a Philippine company.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtrabahu a diyè te Mindanao ne baad te Pilipinas ne kumpanya.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegpekegsuwey wey nekeglein te tagsè sabeka

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The state of things being separate and different from each other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In our family, there is a clear division between the roles of men and women.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te kanami ne taltalaanak, due klaru pegpekegsuwey ne himuwen te me lukes wey me malitan.

entries.summary: egpekeyimu; egkeyimu; Egkahamit seini ke eggimu ka te inse wey ke eggamit ka te "kenè", meyitenged te minsan nekey ne malehet kuntee wey ke layun, wey ke layun dè sika egkeyitabù.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The snake isn't doing anything, it is just lying on the ground.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka uled kenè egpekeyimu te minsan nekey, eggibat dè iya diyè te tanè.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini ke eggimu ka te inse wey ke eggamit ka te "kenè", meyitenged te minsan nekey ne malehet kuntee wey ke layun, wey ke layun dè sika egkeyitabù.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use do in questions, or with 'not', to talk about something that is true now or always, or that always happens.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due naan pad me suled din?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: How often do you go to Luriga?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kamenu ke naa kalasi ne eggendiyè te Lorega?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: someone who understands the body and helps sick people.

entries.summary: kalig-enan; ka me tahuanan diyè te kumpyutir ne due me sinulat wey litratu; egsulaten eyew te egkatantanuran

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a piece of paper with official information on it (e.g., a graduation certificate).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka me tahuanan diyè te kumpyutir ne due me sinulat wey litratu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a computer file with words or pictures.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you document something, you write down information about it so that you will have a record.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She documented everything that they talked about in the meeting.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migsulat din langun-langun ka migpanlalag dan te kalibulungan.

entries.summary: asu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an animal which eats meat and often lives with people. There are many different kinds of dog.

entries.summary: timman te seleppì

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the unit of money in countries such as Australia and the USA. The symbol is $.

entries.summary: nateil ne baad te umul; inged ne migpangamuney wey ke diralem te pegbeye-beyè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a particular part of life or a particular subject.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He doesn't enjoy his job, but is happy in the domain of home life.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: inged ne migpangamuney wey ke diralem te pegbeye-beyè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a place that someone owns or controls.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ne lugar migpangamuney te me Matigsalug.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The kitchen is my mother's domain.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kusina diralem te pegbeye-beyè te iney ku.

entries.summary: minsan nekey ne hitabù ne naseled te nateil ne nasud; ka minsan nekey ne due kalabetan diyè te baley wey te taltalaanak

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne hitabù ne naseled te nateil ne nasud

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something domestic happens or exists inside a particular country (e.g., a domestic airport).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka minsan nekey ne due kalabetan diyè te baley wey te taltalaanak

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something domestic is related to the home and family (e.g., domestic work, domestic violence, domestic animal).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother spends a lot of time doing domestic work, such as cooking and washing.

entries.summary: dereseni, keilangan, wey ke malampusen (ne etew wey ke butang); pegkamaresen; pegkakeilangan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: dereseni, keilangan, wey ke malampusen (ne etew wey ke butang)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Someone or something dominant is the most powerful, important or successful person or thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is the dominant cat in the area, because he always wins fights.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Bubuluti ne miyew sika kayi ne lugar, su layun dè egpanalu te ehetayey.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Rice birds are the dominant bird species in our area.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are many reasons for the dominance of males in the building industry.

entries.summary: maresen wey egpandeeg te minsan nekey; egbeye-beyè; 1 pegkamaresen wey pegpandeeg; 2 pegbeye-beyè

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: maresen wey egpandeeg te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something dominates, they are the most powerful or successful person or thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our basketball team has won all our games, so we've dominated the competition.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you dominate someone, you control them in some way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is not popular, because she always dominates people.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ne mabantug sikandin, su layun din egbeybeyei ka me etew.

entries.summary: lekeb

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the thing which you open and close when you go into a room or building.

entries.summary: tulduk

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a very small round mark. We say dot in Internet addresses (e.g., dot com).

entries.summary: dubli
geyinawa te pegduwa-ruwa; egduwa-ruwa; egkaruwa-ruwa (te etew); kenè egsalig (te etew)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling of not being sure if something is true or good.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have doubts about going there, because maybe it is dangerous.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you doubt that something is true or will happen, you think that it probably is not true or will not happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I doubt that he will come, because he is very tired.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egduwa-ruwa a ke egginguma sikandin, su amana nabeley sikandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you doubt someone, you don't feel sure that they are telling the truth, or you don't feel sure that they can do something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has lied before, so I doubt him now.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-uubat sikandin dengan, sika ka egkaruwa-ruwa ad kandin kuntee.

entries.summary: egtupang; egpatupang; patupang; pariralem; diddiralem; egbayè pariralem; egbayè patupang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you move down something such as a ladder, you move to a lower position on that thing.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is located down something such as a ladder, it is located at a lower position on that thing

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Their house is about 2km down the mountain.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka baley ran me daruwa ne kilumitru patupang te bubungan.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka baley ran me daruwa ne kilumitru diyè te diralem te bubungan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you move down something such as a road, you move to a lower or further place along that thing.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egbayè ki patupang sika te kelesadda.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is located down something such as a road, it is located at a further position on that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Their house is about 2km down the road.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka baley ran me daruwa ne kilumitru pad diyè te kewun-aan te kelesadda.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a number or level goes down, it becomes lower or smaller.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The water level went down after it stopped raining.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka karakel te weyig migtigkus te pegsanggel te uran.

entries.summary: sabeka ne dusina; sapulù wey daruwa; senge dusina

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sabeka ne dusina; sapulù wey daruwa; senge dusina

entries.summary: egbebasbasan pad egsulata; pewun-a ne peggeram te pegsulat diyè te pepil; dukumintu ne egpanugtul ke kamenu karakel ka igbehey keykew ne seleppì te bangku

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you draft something such as a letter or essay, you write it the first time, and plan to fix it later for the final copy.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She drafted a letter to the mayor.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbebasbasan din pad sulata ka sulat ne igpaalap te mayur.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pewun-a ne peggeram te pegsulat diyè te pepil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the first try of a piece of writing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She wrote three drafts of the letter before she was satisfied with it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Katatelu migliwan sikandin te pegsusulat ne henduen pad natagbew sikandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This is only a first draft of my essay, so there are still a lot of mistakes in it.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: dukumintu ne egpanugtul ke kamenu karakel ka igbehey keykew ne seleppì te bangku

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A bank draft is a document which tells a bank how much money they need to give you.

entries.summary: hiyup te maagsil ne kalamag diyè te sinabeng; karakelan te minsan nekey ne eg-inumen iling te bawì; ka mananap ne egpangguyud te mabehat ne alapen

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: hiyup te maagsil ne kalamag diyè te sinabeng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a flow of cold air in a room.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was cold because of the draft from the door, so I moved my chair.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Naagsil [na͡agsil] a te hiyup te kalamag puun te gumawan, sikak mig-ensig ku ka bangku ku.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: karakelan te minsan nekey ne eg-inumen iling te bawì

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an amount of something that you drink, such as medicine.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She prepared a draft of cough medicine for the child.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtahahè sikandin te eleg ne karakel te bawì te buwè te anak din.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She tipped back her head and took a long draft of the fruit drink.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka mananap ne egpangguyud te mabehat ne alapen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A draft animal is one which pulls heavy loads (e.g., a carabao).

entries.summary: egpehes te pegpaapil te sundalu; pegpamehes te pegpaapil te sundalu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If the government drafts you, they force you to join the military.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father was drafted during the Second World War.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka amey ku su napehes te peg-apil te sundalu te timpu te Ikaruwa ne Gira.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The draft is the action of forcing people to join the military.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was a draft because there were not enough soldiers.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due miggimu te pegpamehes te pegpaapil te sundalu su kenad ne eleg ka sundalu.

entries.summary: egsulat te nateil ne ulaula; egganuy; egtuyuk; eggusud; egbarut

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you draw a picture of something, you use a pencil and paper to show what it looks like.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Can you draw a map to show me where it is?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something draws another thing, it pulls that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The carabao drew the cart along.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She drew the child close to her side.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you draw something out of another thing, you pull it out of that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He drew the gun out of the holster.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He drew a pencil out of his pocket.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkuwa wey ke eg-angey te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you draw something from somewhere, you get that thing from that place (e.g., water from a well).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We draw our water from the spring.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The writer drew many of her ideas from her own life experiences.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something draws you, it attracts you, so that you want to go to it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The light is drawing a lot of moths.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The singing competition drew a large audience.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: galew ne eggusud ka te pepil diyè te tahuanan ne warè nu nakita

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a competition in which someone pulls a ticket out of a container without looking, to find a winner (a lottery).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpekeg-iling ka nakuwa te tagsè punduk te kelag; egkatabla

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two sports teams draw, they finish with equal scores in the game.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nekeg-iling ka nakuwa te tagsè punduk te kelag; tabla

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the result in a game where the two teams finish with equal scores.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakarulug wey ke egpakapalundani te nateil ne pegkatahù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something draws to a particular position, it comes to that position.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is drawing closer to the leader in the race, but I don't think he will overtake him.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpakarulug e sikandin te uluwan te lumba, piru kena a egpalintutuu ne egkaliyuwan din ka uluwan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The motorbike drew to a stop.

entries.summary: egdrawing
taheinep; egpakataheinep; igkeupii

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: pictures or actions in your mind while you are sleeping (have_a_dream).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I had a strange dream last night.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you dream, you see pictures or actions in your mind when you are sleeping.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Last night I dreamed that I lost my dog.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you want to achieve in the future, or something that you really hope will happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His dream is to become a teacher.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka igkeupii rin su egkeyimu ne talagpanulù.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkeupian ne egkeyitabù wey ke egkakuwa ka igkeupii

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you dream of something, you really want it to happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He dreams of having his own farm.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian sikandin ne due kandin ne kamet.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of dream. You can also use dreamed.

entries.summary: egkukumbalè; egpakumbalè; egkukumbalè te nateil ne pamaahi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you dress, or get_dressed, you put on clothes.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I showered and dressed before breakfast.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpamanihus a wey migkukumbalè wey a migkeen.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you dress someone, you put clothes on them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She dressed her son for school.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpakumbalaan din ka anak din ne lukes ne eg-iskuyla.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you dress a certain way, that is the kind of clothing that you wear.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Layun dè meupiya ka pamaahi te pegkukumbalè din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Dress is the kind of clothes that you wear.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We wear traditional native dress at Fiesta.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a piece of clothing for women, which looks like a skirt and top joined together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is wearing a nice blue dress.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migsaluub sikandin te meupiya ne meilem ne kumbalè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you dress a part of your body where the skin is broken, you cover it to keep it clean.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The doctor dressed the cut on my leg.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbukusan te duktur ka palì te paa ku.

entries.summary: eg-inum; senge ubab te minsan nekey ne egkeinum; eg-iinum

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or animal drinks, they take liquid into their body through their mouth.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: senge ubab te minsan nekey ne egkeinum

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a cup of liquid that you can drink.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Can I please have a drink of water?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone drinks, they drink alcohol.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He doesn't drink because he hates alcohol.

entries.summary: egpangulu te terak; eggated; egpapeendiyè [egpape͡endiyè] (te peg-alew)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you drive something such as a car or truck, you control it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you drive someone somewhere, you take them there in a vehicle which you are controlling.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He drives many children to school in his jeepney.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you drive someone or something to a place, you make them go there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She tried to drive the chicken into a corner, so that she could catch it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Inggeraman din ipapeendiyè [ipape͡endiyè] alawa ka manuk te pikungan, eyew egkarakep din.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He drove the nail into the wall.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something drives another thing, it causes that thing to move (e.g., parts of a machine).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something drives another thing, it causes the other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His ambition drives his hard work.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka panganduy rin nakaated [naka͡ated] kandin te pegpanaman-taman din pegtrabahu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His concern for his sick son drove him to travel all night to get medicine for him.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The hard work drove him to exhaustion.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kanekal wey igkeupii te peggimu te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: energy and desire to do something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He's a good employee because he has a lot of drive.

entries.summary: egbilis-bilis

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If it is raining lightly, it is drizzling.

entries.summary: egkalekaan; eglekaan; egkeulug; egdeisek

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you drop something, it leaves your hands and falls.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He dropped the cup while he was washing it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something drops, it falls to a lower place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The cup dropped from the table onto the floor.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an amount or level drops, it becomes smaller.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The noise level dropped suddenly when he closed the door.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The price of rice has dropped a little.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A drop in an amount or level is the action of it becoming lower.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There has been a drop in temperature in the last hour, so it's much cooler now.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was a drop in the price of rice last month.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a very small, round quantity of liquid (e.g. a drop of rain).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It started to rain with large, heavy drops of rain.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbunsud mig-uran te dakel, wey mabbehat ne me tihis te uran.

entries.summary: deisek ne tihis
newubug

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is drunk, they can't fully control their mind or body, because they had too much alcohol.

entries.summary: nahangu; egkahangu; egpahangu; egpakahangu; egdalap; egpeinit

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something that is dry doesn't have much or any liquid in it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The clothes are dry now, so we can wear them.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me manggad nenaggangu e kuntee, sika ka egkaayun e ne igpansaluub.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This rice is very dry, because I didn't use much water when I cooked it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something dries, the liquid disappears from it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The clothes are drying in the sun.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me manggad egkaggangu te aldew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something dries something, they cause the liquid to disappear from it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She dried the baby with a towel.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impahangu rin ka batè te tawil.

entries.summary: patuk; bibi
timpu ne keilangan ne egkeyitabù ka minsan nekey; keilangan ne eg-impusan wey ke egbayaran; eleg ne egkarawat

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: timpu ne keilangan ne egkeyitabù ka minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is due to happen at a particular time, that is the time when it should happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is due to have her baby next month.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Duen e anak din te seup ne bulan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her baby is due next month.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: keilangan ne eg-impusan wey ke egbayaran

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a project or bill is due on a particular date, you need to finish it or pay it by that date.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka himuwen ku keilangan ne egkeimpusan kud te me kaaselem.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your due is the thing which you should receive (e.g., money, praise).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You should pay your workers their due.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ne egbayaran nu ka me trabaanti [traba͡anti] nu te eleg ne egkarawat dan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is due you, you should receive it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A lot of thanks is due him for all that he has done.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka langun ne pegpasalamat naangey rin puun te neyimu rin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You should pay your workers the money that is due them.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini ke eglalag ki te eleg ne patangkaan wey ke pabulusan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use due to say that you are talking about an exact direction (e.g., due west)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is due to another thing, it happens because of that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We will not travel today due to the bad weather.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ki eggipanew kuntee tenged te mareet ne timpu.

entries.summary: menika
te (meyitenged te timpu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use during to talk about the period of time when something happens.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She woke up three times during the night.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eggimata sikandin te katatelu te marusilem.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She changed a lot during the three years that she lived with our family.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Dakel ne pegkabale-balew kandin te tatelu ne tuig ne peg-uugpè din diyè te kanami ne pamilya.

entries.summary: abug; alinepung; egtepung; egpayupes; dakel se abug; alinepungen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: fine, dry dirt that can be in the air or on things.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you dust things, you remove dust from them by wiping them.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a place or thing is dusty, there is a lot of dust.

entries.summary: himuwen ne keilangan ne eggimuwen su eleg ne eggimuwen seini; geyinawa te pegkeilangan te peggimu su eleg ne eggimuwen; taks te gubirnu, labi en iya diyè te me butang ne igpeendiyè te lein ne nasud

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: himuwen ne keilangan ne eggimuwen su eleg ne eggimuwen seini

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you should do because it is right to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is our duty to care for our parents when they are old.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: geyinawa te pegkeilangan te peggimu su eleg ne eggimuwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling that you should do something because it is right to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has a strong sense of duty, so he will care for his parents.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: taks te gubirnu, labi en iya diyè te me butang ne igpeendiyè te lein ne nasud

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a government tax, especially on things that you import into the country.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka me butang ne keilangan ne eggimuwen nu ne baad te trabahu nu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the things that you have to do as part of your job.

entries.summary: maagsik-agsik (dakel se kanekal wey iyam ne me puhawang); layun egkapalin; masalsaliyu; mapalin

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: maagsik-agsik (dakel se kanekal wey iyam ne me puhawang)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A dynamic person or group has a lot of energy and new ideas.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Many people like our leader, because he is dynamic.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Masalig ne me etew ne egkeupian te ahalen ney, su maagsik-agsik sikandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Weather is a dynamic thing which changes from day to day.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka timpu layun egkapalin ne butang ne egsalsaliyu te aldew-aldew.

entries.summary: me pamaahi ne ka tagsè sabeka diyè te grupu ne due kalabetan; ka pegpalin te kanekal wey pegkameyimulung te dahing

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me pamaahi ne ka tagsè sabeka diyè te grupu ne due kalabetan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The dynamics in a group are the way that the people in the group relate to one another.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The dynamics of our group are interesting, because there are some very different people in the group.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kalabetan te tagsè sabeka te grupu ta su makabebagget, su due me duma ta ne iyam te grupu ta.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka pegpalin te kanekal wey pegkameyimulung te dahing

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In music, the dynamics are the changes in loudness and softness of the sounds.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The song was boring because there were no dynamics; it was all loud and strong.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ulahingen warè keupiya su warè pegpalin te kanekal wey ke pegpeyimulung; derahingi wey amanan kekesehi.

entries.summary: tagsè sabeka; egpabalbalesey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use each to talk about every member of a group as an individual.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Each student in the class needs to bring a pencil.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka tagsè istudyanti te klasi keilangan ne eg-uyan te lapis.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Each of the students in the class needs to bring a pencil.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are twenty students in the class, and each needs to bring a pencil.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two or more people do something to each_other, the first person does that thing to the second person, and the second person does it to the first person.

entries.summary: kabagget
talinga

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the part of your head which you use to hear

entries.summary: mahaan dè (te kenè pad ka nataha ne uras wey ke timpu); maselem-selem; seselemi; hun-a ne baad te nateil ne timpu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mahaan dè (te kenè pad ka nataha ne uras wey ke timpu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is early, or happens early, it happens before the usual time, or before the time when it should happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It started to rain hard, so they went home from the farm early

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbunsud e mig-uran te makeseg, sika ka mahaan dè mig-ulì sikandan puun te kamet dan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The invitation said 3pm, but many people arrived early, around 2:30.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sulat migkahi te alas tris pad te maapun [ma͡apun], piru duen dè mahaan nanginguma, te me alas dus midya.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is early, or happens early, it happens in the first part of the morning.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She always wakes up very early, when it is still dark.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Layun sikandin ne maselem-selem ne eggimata, te egpamalatpalat pad.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: hun-a ne baad te nateil ne timpu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use early to talk about the first part of a period of time (e.g., early in the year).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She came here in early January, not long after New Year.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I moved to this town early in my teenage years, when I was fourteen.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use early to talk about something when it was quite new, at the beginning of its development.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Early cellphones were quite big and heavy.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka nekewun-a ne me silpun bayew derakel wey mabbehat.

entries.summary: inged; inaranan; dalepè; keyilawan; kalibutan; tanè; deisek ne kasangkapan ne eg-uyan te kurinti peendiyè te tanè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Earth or the Earth is the third planet from the sun. Humans live here.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the material on the surface of the land in which plants grow.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: deisek ne kasangkapan ne eg-uyan te kurinti peendiyè te tanè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In a piece of electrical equipment, the earth is a wire which carries the electrical current to the ground if there is a problem with the equipment.

entries.summary: linug

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: shaking of the ground because of movement of the earth.

entries.summary: igsilè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the direction which is opposite west. It is the direction where the sun rises.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something eastern is in or from the east part of a place.

entries.summary: malemu; mahaan; masayun; egkalemuwan; kenè egkamenew-menew; malemu-lemu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something easy is not difficult or uncomfortable.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you feel easy about something, you feel comfortable about it, and not worried or stressed.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't feel easy about doing that, because it's dangerous.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena a egkalemuwan ne eggimu due, su dilikadu sika.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the state of being able to do something easily.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She jumped over the fence with ease.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Malemu-lemu rin dè umbetuta ka alad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you do something easily, it is not difficult or uncomfortable for you to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She jumped over the fence easily.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Gehaani rè nekeumbetut sikandin diyè te alad.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I feel uneasy about doing that, because it's dangerous.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkamenew-menew a ne eggimu due, su dilikadu sika.

entries.summary: egkeen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or animal eats, they take food into their body.

entries.summary: eglekep; peglekep; peglekep te maaldew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one planet or moon eclipses another planet, moon or star, it moves in front of that other planet, moon or star. This blocks the light coming from the planet, moon or star.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The moon will eclipse the sun at around 3:15 this afternoon.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an event in which one planet, moon or star eclipses another.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There will be an eclipse this afternoon.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In a solar eclipse, the moon moves between the sun and the earth, and blocks some or all of the light from the sun.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In a lunar eclipse, the earth moves between the moon and the sun, and blocks some or all of the light from the moon.

entries.summary: Emun ke egkahi ki te ikunumiya seini meyitenged te me kasangkapan ne due kalabetan te seleppì (iling te nigusyu, pruduktu, pegpabelbeliyey) te nasud wey inged.; Sabdyik seini ne eg-iskuyla meyitenged te me seleppì te nasud wey ke inged.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Emun ke egkahi ki te ikunumiya seini meyitenged te me kasangkapan ne due kalabetan te seleppì (iling te nigusyu, pruduktu, pegpabelbeliyey) te nasud wey inged.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something economic is about things connected to money (e.g., business, production, trade) in a country or area.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Masalig ne nasud ne due prublima te ikunumiya.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Sabdyik seini ne eg-iskuyla meyitenged te me seleppì te nasud wey ke inged.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: This subject is the study of things connected to money in a country or area.

entries.summary: kenè ne meeun [me͡eun]; matalintek

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something economical is cheap to use, because it doesn't use a lot of resources.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Motorbikes are more economical than vans because they don't use much gas.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka mutur kenè ne meeun te tubil kunterè te terak.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An economical person uses something (especially money) carefully, so that they do not use much. This is a positive word.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She can live on little money because she is very economical.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeuyag sikandin minsan deisek ka seleppì din, su matalintek amana sikandin.

entries.summary: baad ne punduk ne due kalabetan te nigusyu, pruduktu, wey belegyè te nasud.; kenè ne maalas; kenè ne mahal; baratu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: baad ne punduk ne due kalabetan te nigusyu, pruduktu, wey belegyè te nasud.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The economy of a country or area is the relationship between the things connected to money (business, production, trade).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Tourism is an important part of that country's economy.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of using something carefully or slowly so that you don't use too much of it

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Motorbikes have better fuel economy than cars.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me mutur kenè ne maalas [ma͡alas] te tubil kunterè te me terak.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you describe something as economy, it is cheap and basic.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ne dakel se bali, baratu ne klasiyan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakaamuy-amuy su deisek se bali su masalig ka tahù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An economy pack of something has many items in it, and you pay less for each item.

entries.summary: sidsid wey ke ilis te minsan nekey; keepusan; katammanan; bunsuranan; galang; iddus te pupul te nasiku ne baad te minsan nekey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sidsid wey ke ilis te minsan nekey; keepusan; katammanan; bunsuranan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The edge of something is the border of it, the part of it where it stops or begins (e.g., the edge of the road).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The edge of her long skirt touches the ground.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sidsid te malayat ne saya rin egpakaragket te tanè.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I planted trees around the edge of my land.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The edge of something such as a knife is the sharp part which cuts.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The knife had a very sharp edge.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: iddus te pupul te nasiku ne baad te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a place where two sides of something join (e.g., the edge of a box).
