fields.label: English example
fields.text: I hit my head on the edge of the table.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakasangkub ka ulu ku diyè te iddus te pupul te lamisa.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that helps you to do something better than other people.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is very tall, so he has an edge when he plays basketball.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne malangkew sikandin, sika ka egpakameupiya kandin te peggalew rin te baskitbul.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you edge somewhere, you move there very slowly.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She edged closer to the door, so that nobody would see her.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggipanew sikandin pahanad-ganad diyè te gumawan, eyew warè egpakakita kandin ne minsan hentew.

entries.summary: egpitawen wey egbalbalawan eyew egmeupiya pad ne sinulat; egsaliyu wey ke egbalew-balew pinaahi te peg-awè wey pegtempug

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpitawen wey egbalbalawan eyew egmeupiya pad ne sinulat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you edit a piece of writing, you check it and change things to make it better.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You need to edit your story before you give it to your teacher.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ne egpitawen nu pad wey egbalbalawan ka guhuren te kenè nu pad igbehey te meistra.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egsaliyu wey ke egbalew-balew pinaahi te peg-awè wey pegtempug

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you edit something recorded such as music or a video, you change the recorded file (e.g., by cutting out or moving different parts of it).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They used a computer to edit the recording of his song.

entries.summary: nateil ne baseen [base͡en] ne igpaligwang te nateil ne timpu; me baad ne egpasinsinunduley diyè te tibi wey radyu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nateil ne baseen [base͡en] ne igpaligwang te nateil ne timpu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a particular version of a book, newspaper or magazine which is printed at a particular time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That is yesterday's edition of the newspaper.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This is the second edition of that book, and they changed it a lot from the first edition.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me baad ne egpasinsinunduley diyè te tibi wey radyu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An edition of a TV or radio series is one of the shows that is part of the series.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Welcome to tonight's edition of our program.

entries.summary: egpanulù diyè te iskuylaan; egpanulù wey egpasabut te kanengnengan; peg-iskuyla wey pegnengneng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you educate someone, you teach them at a school or college.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was educated at the local national high school.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpanulù sikandin te lukal nasyunal hayiskul.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you educate someone about a particular topic, you give them information about it so that they know it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We need to educate young people about the dangers of drugs.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ne egpanulù ki te me mengebay wey me kanakan te pegkamareet te bisyu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The midwife gave some health education courses for new mothers.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I want my children to get a good education.

entries.summary: egkaheram; egpangkusan; egkatamanan; egpangkusan; egpeyitabù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the effect of something is the result or change which it causes (have_an_effect_on something).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The medicine had no effect, and my headache did not stop.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you effect something, you cause it to happen. (used in formal language).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He effected many good changes in the town.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sikandin ka migpeyitabù te masalig ne meupiya ne pegbalew-balew diyè te lungsud.

entries.summary: manedted; bagnel; egbunsud te nateil ne pitsa (iling te balaud wey sistima)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is effective, it produces the result that you want it to.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A mosquito net is the most effective way of protecting yourself from mosquitoes at night.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbunsud te nateil ne pitsa (iling te balaud wey sistima)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a rule or system is effective from a particular date, that is the time when it starts.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The new bus prices will be effective from next month.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka iyam ne bali te terak ne bas egbunsud te seup ne simana.

entries.summary: kanekal

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the hard work that you do in order to achieve something (put_effort_into something, make_an_effort).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She put a lot of effort into her project, so the result was really good.

entries.summary: atelug; atelug te malitan ne egkeyimu ne bate

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the round thing produced by female animals such as chickens or snakes, in which a baby animal grows. We can eat the eggs of some animals.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: atelug te malitan ne egkeyimu ne bate

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the cell inside a female animal or human which can develop into a baby.

entries.summary: naa (...wey ke); minsan; tagsè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use either...or to talk about two things when you need to choose one of them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You can have either chicken or pork.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkaayun minsan hendei ka egkuen nu, manuk naa wey ke karni te babuy.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Either you can take food or buy some when you arrive there.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Diyè te kuna ke eg-uyanen nu naa ka keenen wey ke egbebeli kad te lein ke egpekeyinguma kad diyè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use either to talk about two things you can choose, when it doesn't matter which one you choose.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Sit at either end of the table. I don't care.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Pinnuu ka minsan diyè te pupul te lamisa. Ware labet ku kuna.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It doesn't matter if you cook chicken or pork. Either of them will be good.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use either to talk about both of two things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are trees growing on either side of the road.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due me kayu ne impanubù te tagsè ilis te kelesadda.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We walked on either side of her: I was on her right, and he was on her left.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use either with a negative word (e.g., not) to say something the same about two things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't like either of those movies.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè igkeupii ku minsan hendei due te salida.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use either with a negative word (e.g., no, not) to say that one person or thing is the same as another.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She doesn't like bread, and I don't like it either.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè egkeupian sikandin te paan [pa͡an], wey iling e red degma.

entries.summary: siku
buyag; igbuyag; buyag-buyag; kakey; kakey-kakey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an older person in a group who has some authority and responsibility to lead.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use elder before 'sister' and 'brother' if they are older than you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I live with my elder sister.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-ugpa a diyè te kakey ne atebey ku.

entries.summary: eg-alam te eggimuwen; eg-alam te etew ne igpapinnuu te katenged ne igkeupii ran; in-alam ne egbeheyan wey ke eggimuwen ne due katenged, piru warè pad iya migbunsud te himu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you elect to do something, you choose to do that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We elected to wait until the rain stopped.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-alam ki ne egtatahad taman te egkerit e ka uran.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-alam te etew ne igpapinnuu te katenged ne igkeupii ran

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people elect someone to a position (e.g., in government or in a committee), they choose that person by voting for them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The government is elected by the people.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: in-alam ne egbeheyan wey ke eggimuwen ne due katenged, piru warè pad iya migbunsud te himu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use elect to describe someone who has been voted into a position, but hasn't officially started doing the job yet.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The president elect will officially become president next month.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka in-alam ne prisidinti egpinnuu e kayi te seup ne bulan.

entries.summary: timpu te pegpaal-alamey te nateil ne katenged; peg-alam te me etew eyew te nateil ne katenged

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: timpu te pegpaal-alamey te nateil ne katenged

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an event in which people vote to choose people for certain positions.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is an election next month.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peg-alam te me etew eyew te nateil ne katenged

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of voting to choose people for certain positions.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our club had a meeting for the election of committee members.

entries.summary: meyitenged te langun ne eggamit te kurinti

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: meyitenged te langun ne eggamit te kurinti

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something electric uses electricity (e.g., an electric light).

entries.summary: kurinti

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: energy which runs along wires, and is used for things such as lights and machines.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We have electricity at our house, so we can listen to the radio.

entries.summary: baad te minsan nekey; nenekeg-iling-iling ne grupu te me etew; putew ne egmeinit

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An element of something is a part of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That teacher's classes often have an element of fun.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka klasi te talagpanulù layun due baad ne kahalawan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nenekeg-iling-iling ne grupu te me etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Within a large group, an element is people who are similar to each other, or who make a smaller group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are some elements in the community who make trouble.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The element in an electrical thing such as a heater is the metal thing that becomes hot.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you use an electric kettle, you should always cover the element with water.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kasangkapan ne hinimu te sabeka rè ne klasi te atum iling te silbir, karbun, wey haydrudin

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a material which is made up of only one type of atom (e.g., silver, carbon, hydrogen).

entries.summary: due kalabetan te malemu wey keilangan ne me balaud te minsan nekey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due kalabetan te malemu wey keilangan ne me balaud te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: related to the basic rules about something.

entries.summary: me keilangan amana ne balaud wey pamaahi meyitenged te minsan nekey; egmakarereet ne timpu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me keilangan amana ne balaud wey pamaahi meyitenged te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The elements of something are the basic rules about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My friend taught me the elements of the guitar.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka alukuy ku migpanulù keddì te keilangan amana ne balaud te gitar.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We build houses to protect us from the elements.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggimu ki te me baley eyew egpakapangabang kanta puun te mareet ne me timpu.

entries.summary: eg-awè; egkaawè; peg-awè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you eliminate something, you completely remove it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We want to eliminate drugs from our Barangay.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian key ne eg-aween ka druga te Barangay ney.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or team is_eliminated from a contest, they are taken out of the contest because other people or teams were better than them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our team was eliminated when we lost the game.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka grupu ney naawè te natalu key te galew ney.

entries.summary: duma; lein; esa; ke kenè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use else to talk about another, different person, thing or place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I ran, but everybody else walked.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpallahuy a, piru ka me duma nangipanew rè.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My house was destroyed, so I needed to find somewhere else to live.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nahuhus e ka baley ku, purisu keilangan ne egpamitew a te lein ne egkeugpaan ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I only told my sister about it, nobody else.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use or_else to say what the result will be if something does not happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Take this jacket or else you will get cold.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ku-a nu seini se diyakit ke kenè egkaagsilan [egka͡agsilan] ka.

entries.summary: duma wey ke lein; lein ne lugar; duma ne lugar

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: duma wey ke lein; lein ne lugar; duma ne lugar

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This shop doesn't have any eggs, so I'll need to buy them elsewhere.

entries.summary: eglihawang; egkabukalasan; egkabukalkalan; 1 peglihawang; 2 pegkabukalasan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something emerges from a place, they come out of that place so that people can see them.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a situation or problem emerges, it starts to exist, or people start to see it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: As the twins become older, some differences between them will start to emerge.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Taheed te egkabuyag e ka talaseping, ka me kaleinan dan egbunsud e egkabukalkali.

entries.summary: peglalag wey te pegpakita te pegkakeilangan; eggemhemenan te eglalag ne baad te lalag eyew egkeeleg ka peglituk

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peglalag wey te pegpakita te pegkakeilangan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an emphasis on something is an action of saying or showing that it is important.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our school has an emphasis on sport.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggemhemenan te eglalag ne baad te lalag eyew egkeeleg ka peglituk

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the stronger sound which you use for a word or part of a word to have the correct pronunciation.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In the word 'maselem', the emphasis is on the second syllable.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te lalag ne 'maselem', ka eggemhemenan te eglalag ne baad su ka ikaruwa.

entries.summary: eglalag ka te impurtanti ne minsan nekey te titing-awi; egpeila seini te duma ne butang eyew egkamelmelehan egkakita; eggemhemenan te eglituk

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eglalag ka te impurtanti ne minsan nekey te titing-awi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you emphasize something, you say that it is important.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother emphasized that I must not play on the road.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka iney ku miglalag te keilangan ne kena a eggalew diyè te kelesadda.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpeila seini te duma ne butang eyew egkamelmelehan egkakita

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something emphasizes another thing, it causes that other thing to be seen very clearly.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His heavy shoes emphasized his big feet.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka mabehat ne sepatus din migpeila te dakel ka paa rin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you emphasize a word or part of a word, you say it more strongly than the other words or parts of words.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In the word 'maselem', you emphasize the second syllable, 'sel'.

entries.summary: puun te hinimuwan wey ke nabaybayaan kenè ne puun te puhawang (meyitenged te kanengnengan)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: puun te hinimuwan wey ke nabaybayaan kenè ne puun te puhawang (meyitenged te kanengnengan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If information is empirical, it comes from experiments and real experience, not just from ideas.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a lot of empirical evidence showing that fish oil is very good.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due dakel ne ibidinsiya puun te nabaybayaan ne egpakita ne ka mentika te ngalap te weyig amana ne meupiya.

entries.summary: egpaseleren nu te himu eyew egbayaran nu; eggamit te nateil ne pamaahi; egpakahamit te timpu wey suman-suman

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpaseleren nu te himu eyew egbayaran nu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you employ someone, you pay them to work for you.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you employ a particular method of doing something, you use that method.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They employed new methods of farming.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an activity employs you, it uses your time and thinking.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Reading employs many hours of her time.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that a person or people have a job.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We want to increase the level of employment in our country.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegpaseled te himu; 2 peggamit te nateil ne pamaahi

entries.summary: trabaanti [traba͡anti] te kumpanya wey ke talagbulig te senge etew

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: trabaanti [traba͡anti] te kumpanya wey ke talagbulig te senge etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: someone who is paid to work for a company or person.

entries.summary: warè tahù; eg-aween ka tahù te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is empty, there is nothing in it.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-aween ka tahù te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you empty something, you take everything out of it.

entries.summary: egpakapeyimu te me butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something enables you to do something, it makes it possible for you to do that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The good weather enabled us to dry the rice.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka meupiya ne timpu ka nakapeyimu ne nakahangu ki te paley.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My brother's job enables me to go to school.

entries.summary: egbagget; egliwang; egbagget; egpakapeyitabù te lelemuwi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you encourage someone to do something, you try to make them do it by saying that it's a good idea.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My teacher encouraged me to join the football team.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka talagpanulù ku migbagget keddì te pegpaapil te putbul ne grupu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you encourage someone, you help them to feel more happy or confident.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother encouraged me when I was nervous about my exam.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka iney ku migbehey te me pegbagget te egkalaggew a te iksam ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something encourages another thing to happen, it causes it to happen more easily.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you cut off dead flowers, it will encourage more flowers to grow.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke egmanempuhen nu ka migpamatey ne me bulak, egpakapatubù seini te masalig pad.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegbagget; 2 pegliwang wey pegbagget; 3 pegpeyitabù te lelemuwi

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Thank you for your encouragement when I was feeling sad last week.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Salamat te pegliwang nu keddì te nalanga a te miglihad ne simana.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is an encouragement to see so many people who want to help us.

entries.summary: pupul; pulipusan; keepusan te timpu wey ke himuwen; igkeupii ne egkuen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The end of something long (e.g., a hair) is the part of it just before it stops.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You need to cut your hair, because the ends are old.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We had to stop because we reached the end of the road.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: keepusan te timpu wey ke himuwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The end of a period of time or an activity is the last part of it, just when it finishes.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She was very late, so she only saw the end of the dance.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your end in doing something is your purpose, the thing that you want to achieve.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our end in moving to the village was to be closer to our parents.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something ends, it finishes (in space or time).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The wedding party ended at about 4pm.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you end something, you cause it to finish.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They ended the meeting because nobody had anything more to say.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-epus dan e ka miting su warad e egkalalag dan ne minsan nekey.

entries.summary: kunterè; kalaban

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person or group that doesn't like another person or group, and wants to hurt them in some way.

entries.summary: kanekal; kanekalan ne egpuun iling te weyig wey ke aldew ne egpakabehey te kurinti; nenekali

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the power to move and do things, and not feel tired, because your body is strong.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have no energy today because I didn't sleep well last night.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè kanekal ku kuntee su wara a amana nakalipereng gabii.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Children have a lot of energy, and can play and run for hours.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kanekalan ne egpuun iling te weyig wey ke aldew ne egpakabehey te kurinti

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: power from things such as water and the sun, which you can use to produce electricity.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Solar panels collect energy from the sun.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Turn off lights if you are not using them in order to save energy.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An energetic person has a lot of energy, and does a lot of things.

entries.summary: egpamanekal te balaud; pegpamanekal te balaud

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people with power enforce a rule or law, they check that people obey it and punish people who do not obey it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The peace and order committee enforce the 9pm curfew.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka talagbantey te kalinew migpamanekal te alas nuyibi ne kurpyu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of enforcing rules or laws.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Law enforcement is one of the main jobs of the police.

entries.summary: mangupiya te kelesadda, baley wey mekina; mangayad-ayad te mekina; eggamit te matagseb ne puhawang eyew egkeyitabù ka minsan nekey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mangupiya te kelesadda, baley wey mekina

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: someone who designs things such as roads, buildings or machines.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggamit te matagseb ne puhawang eyew egkeyitabù ka minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you engineer something, you use clever planning to cause it to happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She was able to engineer a meeting with the mayor.

entries.summary: klasiyan te linalahan (iling te matig-Ingland, Amirika, Awstraliya wey Singgapur); puun diyè te Ingland (meyitenged te etew wey ke butang); me etew ne namuun te Ingland

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: klasiyan te linalahan (iling te matig-Ingland, Amirika, Awstraliya wey Singgapur)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the language which is spoken as a first language in countries such as England, the USA, Australia and Singapore.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: puun diyè te Ingland (meyitenged te etew wey ke butang)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An English person or thing comes from England.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me etew ne namuun te Ingland

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The_English are the people who come from England.

entries.summary: egpameupiyeen; pegpameupiya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something enhances a thing, they make it better.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A little salt enhances the taste of some foods.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka deisek ne asin egpameupiya te nanam te keenen.

entries.summary: egkeupian; egpakabayè; diyè te nateil ne sitwasyun; makabebagget

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you enjoy something, or enjoy_doing something, you like it.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakabayè; diyè te nateil ne sitwasyun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you enjoy something good, you have it or experience it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Diyè sikandin te meupiya ne peglelawa.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is enjoyable, it is nice to do, so that people enjoy it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I get a lot of enjoyment out of reading.

entries.summary: amana ne dakel
eleg

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you have enough of something, you have the same amount that you need, or more.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We have enough food for everybody.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due eleg ne pegkeen ta te langun.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is tall enough to touch the roof.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eleg e ka kalayatan din ne egpekeuma te atep.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: No more food for me, thanks. I have eaten enough.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warad keenen para keddiey. Meupiya su eleg e ka nakeen ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That's enough! Stop talking right now!

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eleg e sika! Peeneng-eneng kad kag lalag due.

entries.summary: egsiguru

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you ensure that something happens, you check or do something so that it really does happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you boil water, always ensure that young children are not near the pot.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke eg-iinit ka te weyig, layun nu siguruwa ne mariyù ka dereisek ne me batè te initanan.

entries.summary: eglasud; egseled; egseled wey eglasud te punduk wey ke iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an] eyew egkaapil, wey egpakabunsud e te himu wey ke te peg-iskuyla naa; eg-apil te pegpapitawey te katuenan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you enter a place, you come or go into it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She removed her tsinillas when she entered the house.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egseled wey eglasud te punduk wey ke iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an] eyew egkaapil, wey egpakabunsud e te himu wey ke te peg-iskuyla naa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you enter an organization or school, you join them, or start to work or study there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He entered university when he was 20 years old.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you enter a contest, you join the contest to try to win.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He entered a singing contest and came second.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egtahù te kanengnengan (te minsan hendei kayi, kumpyutir; libru)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you enter information in a book or on the computer, you write the information in the book or type it into the computer.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The clerk entered my name in the computer.

entries.summary: langun te minsan nekey; intiru

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He ate the entire packet of crackers, so there are no more.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migkeen din ka langun ne krakirs, sika ka warad e.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He invited the entire team to his birthday party.

entries.summary: pegpakasuwey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that is separate from other things, and is not just part of another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A sitio is a separate entity, with its own leaders and celebrations.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sityu due pegpakasuwey, due pangulu kayi wey due pista.

entries.summary: lasuranan; peglasud; pegseled

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the place where you go into a building.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of entering a place.

entries.summary: peglasud; pegseled; minsan nekey ne igpewun-a ne igbehey diyè te eg-uyan te pegpapitawey te katuenan eyew te peg-apil (iling te litratu wey ke ulahingen naa); sinulat wey ke kanengnengan diyè te libru wey ke kumpyutir

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of entering a place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Nobody noticed her entry into the room.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They refused him entry to the shop because he was very aggressive.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne igpewun-a ne igbehey diyè te eg-uyan te pegpapitawey te katuenan eyew te peg-apil (iling te litratu wey ke ulahingen naa)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something (e.g., a picture or song) which you put in a competition.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you want to join the drawing competition, you need to give us your entry before the end of the month.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There were 23 entries in the singing competition.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due daruwan ne pulù ne migpalista eyew te peg-apil te pegpapitawey te katuenan te ulahingen.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sinulat wey ke kanengnengan diyè te libru wey ke kumpyutir

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a piece of writing or information which someone has written in a book or typed into a computer.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She writes an entry in her journal every night.

entries.summary: me kasangkapan te palibut ne kenen hinimu te etew; langun ne nakapalibut; meyitenged te nakapalibut wey palibut

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me kasangkapan te palibut ne kenen hinimu te etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the natural world: animals, plants, air, water and other things that are not man-made.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I try to care for the environment.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your environment is all the things that are around you, including people, natural things, and man-made things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My home is a happy environment.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My teacher tries to make our classroom an attractive, interesting environment by putting interesting quotes and pictures on the walls.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Dirty air is an environmental problem.

entries.summary: imma
nekeg-iling se karakelan; egpekeg-iling ne karakelan; nekeg-iling se katenged wey ke peg-uyan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one amount is equal to another amount, the two amounts are the same.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has equal amounts of sugar and coffee in his drink.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The prices of the two fish were equal.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one amount equals another, the two amounts are the same.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nekeg-iling se katenged wey ke peg-uyan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people are equal, they have the same rights and power, and are treated the same way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In some places men and women are not equal in the eyes of the law.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: etew ne iling te katenged nu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: someone who has the same status or rights as you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our boss treats us as his equals, and really shows us respect.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ahalen ku eg-elit-elit kanami ne iling key rè kandin, wey amana egpakita te pegbassa kanami.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: etew wey ke butang ne keiling se keupiya te lein ne etew wey ke butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: someone or something which is as good as another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is the champion, and has no equal in his sport.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sikandin ka migpanalù, wey warè keiling te peggalew rin.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegpekeg-iling se katenged wey ke peg-uyan

entries.summary: nekeg-iling; egpeg-iling

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something equates to something else, it is the same as that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Thirty packets of this shampoo equate to one bottle.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sapulù ne pakiti te siyampu ka egpekeiling te sabeka ne butilya.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you equate something with something else, you say that they are the same thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is not right to equate beauty with good character, because they are not the same thing.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ne eleg ne egpeg-iling ka te kateles wey keupiya te menà su warè nekeg-iling seini.

entries.summary: pegpeiling; egpangguhud te ka sabeka ne kasangkapan iling ded te dangeb

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of saying that two things are the same.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The equation of beauty with good character is a mistake.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegpeiling te kateles wey keupiya te menà kenè ne eleg.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpangguhud te ka sabeka ne kasangkapan iling ded te dangeb

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In maths, an equation is a statement in which one thing equals another thing.

entries.summary: egbehey te me kasangkapan eyew te peggimu te minsan nekey; egpakapatahana

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbehey te me kasangkapan eyew te peggimu te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you equip someone or something, you give them the things that they need in order to do something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father equipped me with a bolo and sent me to the field.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbehayan a te amey ku te ugpit wey impapeendiyè [impape͡endiyè] a te kamet.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something equips you for a particular situation or job, it causes you to be ready for that situation or able to do the job.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My study equipped me for my job.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka peg-iskuyla ku nakapatahana keddì te trabahu ku.

entries.summary: me butang ne keilangan te peggimu te nateil ne butang

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me butang ne keilangan te peggimu te nateil ne butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the things that you need to do a particular thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The equipment for volleyball is a ball and a net.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me gamit te balibul su bula wey nit.

entries.summary: iling ded, nekeg-iling; pegkeiling

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing is equivalent to another, or is the equivalent of another, it is the same as that thing in some way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The price of a carabao is the equivalent of many months' pay.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka bali te kalabew nekeg-iling te masalig ne bulan te pegbayad.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Mix equivalent amounts of water and coconut milk.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sewug te nekeg-iling ne karakelan te weyig wey gatè.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In a school, the principal is the equivalent of a company manager.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The vitamin C in one of these tablets is equivalent to the vitamin C in four of those tablets.

entries.summary: seyyup; seyyup ne pegtuu

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There were many spelling errors in the letter.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The problem with the computer was caused by user error, not the computer itself.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He taught us carefully to see the difference between truth and error.

entries.summary: egpakaligwang; egpakaawè; eg-agas; egbutelak; egtubud; egpallahuy te himu; eglikay te himu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or animal esapes from a place where they are locked or held, they are able to get out of that place.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as water or gas escapes from a place, it comes out of that place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Water escaped slowly from a small hole in the pipe.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpallahuy te himu; eglikay te himu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you escape something bad, you are able to not do it or experience it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The motorbikes passed very close to each other, but they escaped an accident.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegpakaligwang; pegpakaawè; 2 peg-agas; pegbutelak; pegtubud; 3 pegpallahuy te himu; peglikay te himu

entries.summary: labi en iya; egkahamit seini ke eglalag ka te leleheti du te naanaran

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use especially to say that something is more true than usual for a particular group or situation.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You need to keep drinking water, especially if you are working outside.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ne layun ka eg-inum te weyig, labi en iya ke egtrabahu ka diyè te lihawangan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Amoeba is a dangerous illness, especially for children.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka dalu ne amuwiba su amana ne dilikadu ne dalu labi en iya diyè te me kabbatean.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkahamit seini ke eglalag ka te leleheti du te naanaran

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use especially to say that something is more than usual.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Today is an especially hot day.

entries.summary: amana ne keilangan; mallemu wey me keilangan ne baad te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An essential thing is absolutely necessary, and you have a problem if you don't have it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Water is essential for cooking rice.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Water is an essential if you are walking a long way.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mallemu wey me keilangan ne baad te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a simple and important part of something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He taught me the essentials of the guitar.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He taught me the essential skills of the guitar.

entries.summary: eggimu; egpes-ek; egkanengnengan; meupiye e

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you establish something such as an organization or rule, you create it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The rich man established a new hospital.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka meyaman ne etew migpes-ek te iyam ne uspital.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you establish something, you know it because you checked the facts about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They studied the body to establish the cause of death.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtengtengan dan ka lawa te minatey eyew egkanengnengan dan ka aliddanan te pegkapatey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something is established in a place, they are comfortable or strong there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The plants are now established, so you don't need to water them every day.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pinamula meupiye e, sika ka kenad keilangan ne egweyihan pad tagsè aldew.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We have been in this town for two years, so we are established here now.

entries.summary: pegpes-ek; pegtahù; peg-ugsi-ugsì; pegpangugsì; nigusyu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of creating something such as a rule or organization.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The establishment of a new hospital was expensive.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegpes-ek te iyam ne uspital amana ne dakel ka bali.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The problems they experienced during the competition led to the establishment of some new rules for competitors.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of checking the facts about something so that you can be sure about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: One of a doctor's jobs is the establishment of the cause of sickness.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sabeka ne himu te duktur ka pegpangugsì te egpuunan te dalu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a business, or the building where the business is.

entries.summary: kasangkapan ne impangamuney te napatey e; maluag ne tanè te inged ne impangamuney te senge etawan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kasangkapan ne impangamuney te napatey e

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the things which were owned by someone who has died.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When he died, his wife got his whole estate.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te pegpatey rin, ka asawa rin migkuwa te langun ne impangamuney rin ne kasangkapan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: maluag ne tanè te inged ne impangamuney te senge etawan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large area of land in the country, which someone owns.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has an estate in the mountains.

entries.summary: eg-alahè; egbana-banà; alahè; bana-banà; pegtengteng; pegsuman-suman

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you estimate a quantity or number, you don't measure it exactly, you just say what you think it is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I estimate that there are 40 people here.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a number which is not exact, just what you think.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My estimate of the cost is about 8000 pesos.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka alahè te ku ne bali su me walu ne libu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your estimate of someone or something is what you think of them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: By my estimate, he is a dangerous man.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te keddì ne pegsuman-suman, mareet sikandin ne etew.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Estimation of is a useful skill in maths.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka peg-alahè amana egkahamit ne katuenan diyè te mat.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: what you think of someone or something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have a very high estimation of him.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due amana matikang ne pegtengteng ku kandin.

entries.summary: warè patamanan; due layun te warè bunsuranan wey warè egtamanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is eternal, it continues forever.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due layun te warè bunsuranan wey warè egtamanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: When we say that God is eternal, we mean that he has always existed, and will always exist forever.

entries.summary: due kalabetan te punduk te me kabuhalan wey ke menà te sika ne me etew; nateil ne migligkatan ne tribu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due kalabetan te punduk te me kabuhalan wey ke menà te sika ne me etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something ethnic is related to the race or cultural group that people are part of (e.g., ethnic conflicts, an ethnic group, ethnic food, ethnic music).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your ethnicity is the fact that you come from a particular race or cultural group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't know her ethnicity, but she's from somewhere in Eastern Europe.

entries.summary: egpitew ke kamenu keupiya, kakeilangan wey ke karakel; egsusi; pegpitew; pegsusi; ka puhawang nu pegkeimpus te pegpitew wey pegsusi nu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpitew ke kamenu keupiya, kakeilangan wey ke karakel; egsusi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you evaluate something, you decide how good, important or large it is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We had a test to evaluate how much we had learned.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due peggeram kanta eyew egpitawen ke hendeid taman ka natuenan ta.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Evaluation of the students will take about a week.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka puhawang nu pegkeimpus te pegpitew wey pegsusi nu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: what you think about something after you have evaluated it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: According to his evaluation, it will take about 6 months to complete this project.

entries.summary: iling (egkahamit seini ke kenè egkabalbalawan wey ke nekeg-iling ka langun ne baad); nekeg-iling; mapatag; egpekegseked

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: iling (egkahamit seini ke kenè egkabalbalawan wey ke nekeg-iling ka langun ne baad)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something even is the same at different times or in different parts of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She continued at an even speed when she was running, and didn't slow down or speed up.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpabulus sikandin te iling ne kakeseg te pegpallahuy, wey warè migmeyimulung wey ke migmakmakeseg.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Try to keep the fire at an even temperature.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two things are even, they are equal or at the same level.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The scores of the two teams are even.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka nakuwa te daruwa ne grupu nekeg-iling.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An even surface is flat and smooth.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When you write, it is easier if you put the paper on an even surface.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An even number can be divided by 2 (e.g., 4, 6, 8)

entries.summary: minsan; pad iya; minsan ke

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use even to say that you are surprised about something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She didn't even say thank you!

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warad iya migkahi sikandin minsan te pegpasalamat.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use even if one thing is more than another thing, and the other thing is already a lot.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father is tall, but my brother is even taller

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka amey ku malangkew, wey ka suled ku lelangkawi pad iya regma.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use even_if to say one fact will not be changed by another fact.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have no clean clothes, so I will wash them, even if it rains.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè malinis ne kumbalè ku, sikak migpami-pian ku minsan ke eg-uran.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use even_though to say that one fact is not changed by another fact.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father is working in the field even though it's raining.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka amey ku migtrabahu diyè te kamet minsan pad eg-uran.

entries.summary: marusilem

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the late part of the day between afternoon and the time that you sleep.

entries.summary: hitabù; pangitabù ne miggimu te me etew; sabeka ne galew te pegpasaliyey

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I remember the events of that day very clearly.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pangitabù ne miggimu te me etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a happening that people organize, such as a wedding or a sports competition.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The Olympics is the most famous sporting event in the world.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one of the races or competitions in a sports meeting (e.g., the 100 meter event).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The 100 sprint is my favorite event.

entries.summary: iya mulè; dè due; rè due; layun

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: iya mulè; dè due; rè due

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: at any time (past, present or future)

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I haven't ever seen a cobra.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ware e pad iya mulè nakakita te dulepu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Do you ever feel sick in the morning?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè ke rè due migderalu te maselem?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's the best coffee I've ever tasted.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ka amana ne tetelesi ne sikan ku pad iya mulè naherami.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I will not ever do that again.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena ad iya mulè eg-abey eggimu due.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I haven't ever seen a tarsier.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ware e rè due nakakita te tinekkak.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use ever to say that something is always the case. (used in formal language).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Malaria is an ever-present problem there.

entries.summary: egpabulus-bulus te warè egpatamanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is everlasting, it continues forever.

entries.summary: tagsè sabeka (meyitenged te minsan nekey wey ke minsan hentew); te tagsè (meyitenged te kamenu kalasi-lasi egkeyitabù); tagsè seup te seup ne aldew

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: tagsè sabeka (meyitenged te minsan nekey wey ke minsan hentew)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use every to talk about all the members of a group as individuals.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Every student in the class will bring a pencil.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Tagsè sabeka ne istudyanti te klasi eg-uyan te lapis.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: te tagsè (meyitenged te kamenu kalasi-lasi egkeyitabù)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use every to talk about how often something happens.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I go to Davao once every six months

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eggendiya a te Dabaw te tagsè hen-em ne bulan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: tagsè seup te seup ne aldew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use phrases such as every_other day or every_second month to say that something happens one day or month, and not the next, and happens again the next day or month, and not the next, and so on.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I wash my hair every other day (meaning Monday, Wednesday, Friday...)

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eggugasan ku ka bulbul ku te tagsè seup te seup ne aldew.

entries.summary: ka tagsè sabeka; ka langun ne etew

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka tagsè sabeka; ka langun ne etew

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Everybody in my class is tired today.

entries.summary: ka tagsè sabeka; ka langun ne etew

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka tagsè sabeka; ka langun ne etew

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka tagsè sabeka egkeupian te hemey.

entries.summary: langun-langun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: all of the things in a particular situation

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Everything is okay, and there are no problems.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She told me everything that had happened.

entries.summary: minsan hendei
egkakita ne kamalehetan; ibidinsya; amana egkakita ne eggeramen ne geyinawa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the things which show that something is true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a lot of evidence which shows that fish is a healthy food.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due masalig ne egkakita ne kamalehetan ne ka peit meupiya ne egkakeen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The lawyer produced many pieces of evidence to show that the man was innocent.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: amana egkakita ne eggeramen ne geyinawa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you evidence something such as a feeling, you show it clearly.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She evidenced sadness when she looked at the pictures.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana egkakita ka kalaggew rin ke egpitew sikandin te litratu.

entries.summary: mahaan egkataheyi su mahaan egkakita; egkamelmelehi

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mahaan egkataheyi su mahaan egkakita; egkamelmelehi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a fact is evident, we can know it easily, because it is easy to see.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It was evident that she didn't like the food.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana egkataheyi ne kenè din egkeupian te keenen.

entries.summary: me panisingan ne maddeet se geem [ge͡em]; dereeti ne minsan nekey ne duen buwa kalabetan te maddeet ne geem [ge͡em] ne me panisingan; mareet ne minsan nekey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me panisingan ne maddeet se geem [ge͡em]

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: dereeti ne minsan nekey ne duen buwa kalabetan te maddeet ne geem [ge͡em] ne me panisingan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is evil, it is very bad, and maybe has some connection to bad spiritual powers.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that is bad about a thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My grandfather fought in the war, and told me about the evils of war.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka Apu ku ne buyag migpakig-ehet diyè te gubut, wey migpanugtul sikandin meyitenged te me mareet diyè te gubut.

entries.summary: pegkabalbalawi te malambened

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of something slowly changing to become bigger, better or more complex.

entries.summary: egkabalbalawan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something evolves into something bigger, better or more complex, it changes through time to become that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In thirty years the small town evolved into a busy city.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te tatelunpulù ne leg-un ka deisek ne lunsud nabalbalawan e peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te eg-etawen ne siyudad.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Treatment of that disease has evolved a lot, and is now much better than it was twenty years ago.

entries.summary: eleg; eggamit ka te geem [ge͡em] eyew egpakabehey ka lein ne etew; eleg-eleg dè iya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is exact, it is very correct.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The exact time is 7:27, and twenty seconds.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka eleg ne uras su alas siti beyinti siti, wey beyinti ne sigundu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggamit ka te geem [ge͡em] eyew egpakabehey ka lein ne etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you exact something from someone, you use your power to make them give it to you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The bank exacted payment from him.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggamit ka bangku te geem [ge͡em] eyew egpakabayad sikandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use exactly to talk about something that is very correct.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eleg-eleg dè iya ne daruwa ne kilu ka behas.

entries.summary: gahag
pegtengteng ne amana egdandanii [dandani͡i] wey eg-ay-ayari; pegpitew wey ke pegleuy te peglelawa; peggeram te me istudyanti

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegtengteng ne amana egdandanii [dandani͡i] wey eg-ay-ayari

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of looking at something very closely and carefully.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Examination of the plant showed that it had small spots on the leaves.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegpitew wey ke pegleuy te peglelawa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action of a doctor checking your body to find problems.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I went to the doctor for an examination.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggendiya a te duktur eyew te pegpapitew te peglelawa ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a test for students. The short form is 'exam'.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have a history examination tomorrow.

entries.summary: egpaay-ayaran egtengtengi; egpitawen ka lawa ke duen naa dalu; egbehey te peggeram (meyitenged te katuenan te istudyanti)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you examine something, you look at it very closely and carefully.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpitawen ka lawa ke duen naa dalu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a doctor examines you, they check your body to find problems.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbehey te peggeram (meyitenged te katuenan te istudyanti)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a teacher examines students, they give a test to the students.

entries.summary: panunggilingan; ilinganan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you can look at to understand more about all the members of its group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Roses and daisies are examples of flowers.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: someone or something which people can copy

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He sets his children a bad example by his behavior.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I really respect that sportsman: he is an example for young sports players.

entries.summary: eglapew ka karakelan wey ke kakeseg; eglapew te balaud wey ke tamanan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eglapew ka karakelan wey ke kakeseg

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an amount exceeds another amount, it is more than that other amount.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It was very, very hot! The temperature exceeded 35 degrees.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne iiniti! Ka keinit miglapew e te tatelu wey lalimma ne pulù ka keinit.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He often exceeds the speed limit when he drives in the city.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eglapew te balaud wey ke tamanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you exceed a rule or limit, you do more than you should do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He exceeded his authority when he closed my shop, because he doesn't have the authority to do that.

entries.summary: meup-upiya; pegkameupiya
warè labet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use except or except_for to say that someone or something is not included.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Everybody except me knew the song.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka langun egkateu ne egkanta warè labet ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Everyboy except for me knew the song.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which doesn't follow a usual rule or pattern.

entries.summary: egpegsaliyuey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two people exchange things, the first person gives something to the other, and the other person gives something to the first.

entries.summary: egpakabagget; egpakabehey te nateil ne eggeramen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something excites you, it causes you to feel very happy and have lots of energy.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something excites a particular feeling or reaction from people, it causes them to feel that way, or do that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His comments excited anger from the crowd.

entries.summary: kenè egpaseled wey egpaapil; egpagawas; kenè iglabet; egpakasiguru ke malehet naa wey kenè ka minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you exclude someone from something, you do not allow them to enter or join that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was sad because the other children excluded him from their game.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne nalangè sikandin su ka duma ne me batè warè migpaseled kandin te galew ran.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you exclude something from another thing, you do not allow it to be part of that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They are going to exclude disco parties from the fiesta program this year.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè dan igpalabet ka sayawan te prugrama ran te pista te seini ne tuig.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakasiguru ke malehet naa wey kenè ka minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you exclude something that you can choose, you become sure that it is not a correct or good choice.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We have excluded the possibility that the dog was poisoned. It must have just got sick.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakasihuru kid ne ka asu ware hiluwi, Migderalu bu rè.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 kenè egpaseled wey egpaapil; 2 pegpagawas; 3 pegpakasiguru ke malehet naa wey kenè ka minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of excluding someone or something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was sad about his exclusion from the game.

entries.summary: para rè te nateil ne etew; egpakahamit ka meyaman wey ke mabantug ne me etew (meyitenged te lugar wey ke ugpaanan); egkateil dè ka magasin wey ke prugrama te tibi ne egkatahuan wey ke egkakitaan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: para rè te nateil ne etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something exclusive is only for a certain person or people.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This fishpond is for my family's exclusive use, not for everyone in the sitio.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ne uyahanan te ngalap te weyig para rè te pamilya ku, kenè ne para te langun ne me etew te sityu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakahamit ka meyaman wey ke mabantug ne me etew (meyitenged te lugar wey ke ugpaanan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An exclusive place is used only by rich or famous people (e.g., an exclusive hotel).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkateil dè ka magasin wey ke prugrama te tibi ne egkatahuan wey ke egkakitaan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a news story or interview in a magazine or on TV is exclusive, it is only in that particular magazine or TV program.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Tomorrow night, we will have an exclusive interview with the president.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kaaselem te marusilem, due peg-inse-insè ney te prisidinti te sikanami rè.

entries.summary: eggimu te me panglawa ne pegweil-weil ne egpekeyimu te lawa ne egmanekal wey meupiya; peggimu te me panglawa ne pegweil-weil ne egpekeyimu te lawa ne egmanekal wey meupiya; eggamiten nu ka nateil butang

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggimu te me panglawa ne pegweil-weil ne egpekeyimu te lawa ne egmanekal wey meupiya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you exercise, you do physical activities to cause your body to be strong and healthy.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peggimu te me panglawa ne pegweil-weil ne egpekeyimu te lawa ne egmanekal wey meupiya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: physical activities that you do to make your body strong and healthy.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you exercise something, you use that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You should exercise your right to vote.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ne eggamiten nu ka katenged nu te pegpilì.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka butang ne keilangan ne egbebasbasan wey ke peggeram te duma ne katuenan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a thing that you need to do to practice or test some skill.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My teacher gave us ten maths exercises for homework.

entries.summary: duen e; due iya; duen iya

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: duen e; due iya; duen iya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something exists, it is real and it is here in the universe.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Some children believe that Santa Claus exists.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka duma ne me batè egpalintutuu ne ka Santa Klaws due iya.

entries.summary: due kamalehetan; umul; pamaahi te keuyahan

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Some children believe in the existence of Santa Claus.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka duma ne me batè migpalintutuu ne due kamalehetan te Santa Klaws.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They have a hard existence, because they are very poor.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due mahirap ne umul ran, su amana sikandan ne pubri.

entries.summary: egdakel, egmaluag; egparakelen; egpamaluahen; egbehey te duma ne kanengnengan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something expands, it becomes bigger.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When you eat, your stomach expands because of the food in it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That company has really expanded, and now has many customers.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you expand something, you cause it to become bigger.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We decided to expand our farm by clearing more land.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you expand_on something that you said, you give more information about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She only said that there was something that she needed to do, but she didn't expand on that.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migkahi rè sikandin te due duma ne keilangan ne eggimuwen din, piru warè din e migbehey te duma pad ne kanengnengan.

entries.summary: egtuu; siguradu; egtatahad; egpallateng (meyitenged te peg-agseb te pegginguma); eg-iman-iman wey ke eglalag te keilangan ne eggimuwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you expect that something is the case or will happen, you think that it is probably the case or will probably happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I expect that you are hungry after your long trip.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egtuu a ne eggutasan ka impus te mariyù ne hipanewen.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egtatahad; egpallateng (meyitenged te peg-agseb te pegginguma)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you expect something, you are waiting for it, because you feel sure that it will come.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm expecting a text from my friend.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-iman-iman wey ke eglalag te keilangan ne eggimuwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you expect someone to do something, you believe or tell them that they should do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My parents expect me to help on our farm.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eg-iman-iman ka ginikanan ku ne egbulig a kandan diyè te kamet.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling that something will probably happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is the expectation of rain tomorrow.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peg-iman-iman wey ke peglalag te keilangan ne eggimuwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that someone believes you should do, or tells you that you should do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our teacher has high expectations of us, and doesn't allow us to be lazy.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Matikang ka peg-iman-iman kanami ka meistra ney, wey kenè sikandin egtuhut ne egpapepehul key.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The expectation is that we will pay for ourselves.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are expectant, you are excited because you feel that something good or exciting is going to happen.

entries.summary: seleppì ne eggastuwen; minsan nekey ne keilangan ne egbeliyen wey ke egbayaran; eg-antus te minsan nekey ne mareet

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She went to a lot of expense to fix the house.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne keilangan ne egbeliyen wey ke egbayaran

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you need to buy or pay for.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-antus te minsan nekey ne mareet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happens at the expense of a person or thing, that person or thing suffers something bad.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She was upset because they told many jokes at her expense [this means that the jokes were about her].

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The girl was upset by their joking, because the joke was at her expense.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Neepes ka malitan te me kawalian nikandan su meyitenged seini kandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She helped me at the expense of her free time [this means she lost her free time].

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbulig sikandin keddì te bakanti rin ne uras.

entries.summary: mahal

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something expensive costs a lot of money.

entries.summary: egpakabayè; egpekeulaula; eggeram; pangitabù; neulaula; nabaybayaan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you experience something, it happens to you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I experienced a big flood when I was a child.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I am experiencing a lot of back pain at the moment.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that has happened to you, or that you have done.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The big flood was a terrible experience.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is a good person for the job, because she has a lot of experience in this type of work.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I respect my grandfather's advice, because he has a lot of life experience.

entries.summary: peggeram wey pegnengneng te minsan nekey ne eggimuwen ne kenè dè ne sumansuman dè.; eggimu te iyam ne himuwen eyew egkakita ka egkapabulusan; minsan nekey ne eggimuwen eyew te peggeram wey te pegnengneng ne kenè ne suman-suman dè.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peggeram wey pegnengneng te minsan nekey ne eggimuwen ne kenè dè ne sumansuman dè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something practical that you do to test an idea, or to learn something new (do_an_experiment).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I love science because we do experiments with chemicals.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggimu te iyam ne himuwen eyew egkakita ka egkapabulusan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you experiment with something, you try something new so that you can see the result.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She loves cooking and is always experimenting with different kinds of vegetables.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne eggimuwen eyew te peggeram wey te pegnengneng ne kenè ne suman-suman dè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is experimental, it is like an experiment.

entries.summary: mateu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: someone who knows a lot about a particular topic, or is very good at doing something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Don't fix the electric wires yourself. It's safer to call an expert.

entries.summary: egpasabut; egbehey te aliddanan; 1 pegpasabut; 2 aliddanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you explain something to someone, you help them to understand it by talking about it very clearly

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't understand this word. Could you explain it to me please.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you explain that something is the case, or explain something, you give reasons why a particular thing happened.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He missed the meeting, and explained that his child had been sick.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè nakatambung sikandin te miting, wey migbehey sikandin te aliddanan te ka anak din migderalu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His explanation of the word was very difficult to understand.

entries.summary: titing-awi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is explicit, someone says it or shows it very clearly and with a lot of detail.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She gave very explicit instructions, so we know exactly what we should do.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbehey sikandin te titing-awi ne panulù, sikak nakataha key amana te eleg ne eggimuwen ney.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That movie has a sexually explicit scene.

entries.summary: egbelegyè diyè te lein ne nasud; pegbelegyè diyè te lein ne nasud; belegyè

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbelegyè diyè te lein ne nasud
