fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a group or country exports something, they sell it to another country.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That country exports 30% of its rice to Europe.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sika ne inged egbelegyè te tatelun pulù ne pursintu te behas diyè te Iyurupa.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegbelegyè diyè te lein ne nasud

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of selling to another country.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The export of fruit is important for our country.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a product or service that a person or country sells to another country

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Beef is an important export for Australia.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In computing, if you export a file from one program, you save it so that another program can read it.

entries.summary: egpakita; egwakis; eglekis; egpaligwang; egpanengneng; egpabayè; egpasalerep; egpasaharal

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you expose something, you open it or take away the cover, so that people can see it or something can touch it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He cut the fish open to expose the inside.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migperi rin ka ngalap te weyig eyew egkakita ka diralem.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: People with white skin get sunburned if they expose their skin on sunny days.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me etew ne memaangkag se laplap su egkatutung ke egkarampil te meinit ne aldew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you expose something that is secret, you cause people to know about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The newspapers exposed the corruption in the company.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka guhuren diyè te pepil migpanengneng te pegpanakew te seleppì diyè te kumpanya.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you expose someone to something, you cause them to experience that thing, or to be close to that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you smoke, you expose your body to dangerous chemicals.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke egpanihupan ka, egpaserepan nu ka lawa nu te dilikadu ne kimikals.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She loves music, because her parents have exposed her to all kinds of music since she was a small child.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you take your children there, you will expose them to danger, because it is not a safe place.

entries.summary: pegkakita; pegpahawa-hawa; pegpanengneng te hineles; pegsalerep; pegsaharal; pegparani

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that something has no covering, so people can see it or something can touch it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of causing people to know about something that was secret.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: People were shocked by the exposure of corruption in the company.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Natekkew ka me etew te pegpanengneng te pegpanakew te seleppì diyè te kumpanya.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that you experience something or are close to that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His exposure to dangerous chemicals is causing health problems.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegsalerep din te dilikadu ne kimikals egpakabehey kandin te prublima te peglelawa.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Some people believe that exposure to rain causes sickness.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka duma ne etew egpalintutuu ne ka pegsilengleng te uran egpakabehey te dalu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: dalu te lawa puun te mareet ne timpu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: bad effects on the body which happen if you are outside in very cold or bad weather.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The children died of exposure because they were out at the time of the typhoon.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegkamatey te me batè, puun su diyè sikandan te ligwang te timpu te bagyu.

entries.summary: eglalag wey egpalihawang te puhawang wey ke geyinawa; egpakita wey egpalihawang te eggeramen ne geyinawa; Egkahamit seini ke eglalag ki te meiyal ne pegpeyipanew wey ke pegpeuyan te minsan nekey.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eglalag wey egpalihawang te puhawang wey ke geyinawa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you express an idea or feeling, or express yourself, you talk about your idea or feeling.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is very quiet, and doesn't express his feelings very much.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne kenè ne malalag-lalag sikandin, wey kenè amana egpalihawang te eggeramen din.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakita wey egpalihawang te eggeramen ne geyinawa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If your action, or part of your body expresses a feeling, it shows that you have that feeling.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka mata rin migpakita te pegkalangè din.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini ke eglalag ki te meiyal ne pegpeyipanew wey ke pegpeuyan te minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use express to talk about fast and direct travel or sending (e.g., an express bus, express post).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That is an express bus, so it only stops at the terminals.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: titing-awi wey eleg (iling te panulù wey ke igkeupii)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something express is very clear and exact (e.g., express instructions).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He came here with the express purpose of speaking to her.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggendini sikandin ne due eleg ne katuyuan te pegpakiglalag kandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He gave me express orders to only give this to you.

entries.summary: epad (meyitenged te layun igsangkalit ne lalag te etew); geyinawa wey ke eggeramen ne egkakita diyè te ulaula; pegpanugtul wey ke pegpakita te suman-suman wey geyinawa

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: epad (meyitenged te layun igsangkalit ne lalag te etew)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a phrase or sentence that people say (e.g., 'time flies').

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: geyinawa wey ke eggeramen ne egkakita diyè te ulaula

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The expression on your face is the feelings that you show on your face.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He had a worried expression on his face.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegpanugtul wey ke pegpakita te suman-suman wey geyinawa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of telling or showing your thoughts and feelings.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Writing songs is a popular form of expression.

entries.summary: egliyu; diyè pad dapit; egparakelen wey ke egpamalayaten; egpamananey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something extends to a certain point, that is how big or how long it is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My land extends to the river.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka tanè ku migliyu pad te pahamayan ne weyig.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you extend something, you make it bigger or longer.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They extended their house by putting one more room on the side.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you extend something, you make the period of time longer.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: At first, I planned to stay for one week, but I extended my stay to two weeks.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te hun-a, migsuman-suman a ne eg-uugpè te sabeka ne simana, piru ka peg-uugpè ku migpeyinguma ku te daruwa ne simana.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you extend a part of your body, you stretch it out so that it is more straight.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She extended her arm in order to shake his hand.

entries.summary: tembil; sumpul; patuhut ne timpu; numiru ne igtimul nu ta numiru te tilipunu te kumpanya eyew egkaayun ka ne egpakalalag duritsu diyè te nateil ne etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that is added to another thing to make it bigger (e.g., a room added to a building, a part added to a road).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They are putting an extension on their house.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I asked my teacher for a three-day extension for my project, because I had been sick.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbuyù a te patuhut pad ne tatelu ne aldew te talagpanulù ku eyew te peg-impus te himuwen ku, su migderalu a nahud.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: numiru ne igtimul nu ta numiru te tilipunu te kumpanya eyew egkaayun ka ne egpakalalag duritsu diyè te nateil ne etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a number which you add to the telephone number of a company. This extra number allows you to reach a particular person directly.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I dialled the number of the company, and then dialed extension number 15 to reach my uncle's office directly.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Indayal ku ka numiru te kumpanya, wey lagkes te igtimul ne numiru eyew te diritsu diyè te upisina te anggam ku.

entries.summary: kamenu karakel wey ke kamenu kasulug ka minsan nekey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kamenu karakel wey ke kamenu kasulug ka minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the extent of something is how big or how much it is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I haven't seen the house since the storm, so I don't know the extent of the damage.

entries.summary: ligwang ne baad te minsan nekey; puun te ligwang te etew wey kasangkapan; due kalabetan te lein ne inged

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ligwang ne baad te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something external is on the outside part of something (e.g., the external wall of a house, an external pocket on a bag).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You must not eat that medication, only put it on your skin, because it is for external use only.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè nu keena ka sika ne bawì, itahù nu rè sika diyè te laplap nu, su eggamiten dè seini te panligwang ne baad te lawa.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: puun te ligwang te etew wey kasangkapan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something external comes from outside a person or thing (e.g., a problem).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She feels peaceful, even though there are a lot of external stresses.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Malinawen sikandin, minsan pad masalig ka egpakaralusung kandin puun te ligwang.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due kalabetan te lein ne inged

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: For a country, external things are connected to other countries.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: External sales decreased last year, but sales within the country increased.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka belegyè ne diyè te lein ne inged te seini ne tuig migmeyinay, piru ka belegyè kayi te seled te inged migmanekal.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: panligwang ne egkakita ne sitwasyun (meyitenged te kenè ne malehet)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is external, it is what something looks like, and it is not the real situation.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His happiness is only external, and in reality he is lonely.

entries.summary: Ke ka me pinamula wey mananap egpamatey e, egkawarè e seini taman te patamanan.; Ka egkataman wey egpatey e ne bulkan ne warè nakabetu te naluhey e ne timpu, kenad e iya seini egbetu pad.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Ke ka me pinamula wey mananap egpamatey e, egkawarè e seini taman te patamanan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a species of plant or animal is extinct, it doesn't exist anymore.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Ka egkataman wey egpatey e ne bulkan ne warè nakabetu te naluhey e ne timpu, kenad e iya seini egbetu pad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An extinct volcano hasn't erupted for a long time, and is not likely to erupt.

entries.summary: eg-awè; egpaligwang; egpaawè; egpehè; me lalag ne egkuen puun te sinulat wey ke libru

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you extract something from another thing (e.g., a tooth from your mouth), you pull it out. It is usually not easy to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The dentist extracted a bad tooth from my mouth.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka dintista mig-awè te mareet ne ngipen kayit te be-bè ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you extract a substance like oil from a thing such as a plant or the ground, you take that substance out of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They press the coconut to extract the oil from it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpehè dan ka niyug eyew egligwang ka mentika.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me lalag ne egkuen puun te sinulat wey ke libru

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: words which are taken out of a piece of writing or a book.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our teacher read an extract from the poem.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka meistra ney miglalag te me sinulat puun te tula.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Mining is the extraction of things such as oil from the ground.

entries.summary: amana; naamanaan; kekesehi; kenè ne eleg wey ke meupiya ne suman-suman wey himu tenged su egkaamanaan dè [egkaamana͡an]; naamanaan [naamana͡an] dè iya man e; kinataneban; kinapupulan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is extreme, it is very strong or great.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She has an extreme fear of rats.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due amana liyas din te me ambew.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She moved from Manila to a very small sitio. That's going from one extreme to the other.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè ne eleg wey ke meupiya ne suman-suman wey himu tenged su egkaamanaan dè [egkaamana͡an]; naamanaan [naamana͡an] dè iya man e

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something that a person believes or does is extreme, it is not good because it is too strong or too much.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He burned the house because there were three rats. That was extreme!

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migsilaban din ka baley ran su due tatelu ne ambew. Naamanaan dè iya man e.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use extreme to talk about the part of something which is at the edge of it, far from the middle (e.g., the extreme left).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She lives on the extreme edge of the province, almost in the next province.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-ugpè sikandin diyè te kinataneban e te prubinsya, dulug e te seup ne prubinsya.

entries.summary: mata; egtengteng; lungag te simat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you eye someone or something, you look at them.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the hole in a needle through which you put a thread.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the calm part in the middle of a typhoon

entries.summary: ulaula; tangkaan; egtangkè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the part of the body at the front of the head, which has the eyes, nose and mouth.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the front of something such as a watch, a building, or a playing card.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something faces in a particular direction, that is the direction which their front is pointing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We faced east so that we could watch the sun rise.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you face something difficult, or something difficult faces you, you are going to experience that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Many problems will face you in your life.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Masalig ne me prublima ne igsalerep te umul nu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is going to Cebu tomorrow, so she is facing a very long, boring bus ride.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eggendiyè sikandin te Sibu kaaselem, su egsalerep sikandin te makapepela ne peg-untud te terak.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you face something such as a problem, you agree that it is real, and you don't try to run away from it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He needs to face the fact that he is getting old.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ne egdawaten din ne buyag en iya sikandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is afraid of buses, but she needs to face her fear and start catching the bus.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you face someone, you speak to them, even though it is very difficult.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It was very hard for the doctor to face the parents of the child who had died.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the part of a situation or someone's life that you can see.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: On the face of it, everything looks okay, but there are some big problems in the family.

entries.summary: egbulig; egpangabang; pegbulig; pegpangabang; talagbulig; talagpangabang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you facilitate something, you help it to happen more easily.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I facilitated a meeting between the two leaders by arranging a time and place.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbulig a te kalibulungan te daruwa ne pangulu pinaahi te pegbehey te timpu wey lugar.

entries.summary: kamalehetan; senge baad te kanengnengan te kamalehetan; te pegkamalehet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that is really true or that really happened.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is a scientific fact that the planets move around the sun.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sayantipiku ne kamalehetan ne ka me planita egmantileng ka eg-alingkus te aldew.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That movie is based on fact.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: senge baad te kanengnengan te kamalehetan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a piece of information about something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our teacher taught us lots of interesting facts about monkeys.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka talagpanulù ney migpanulù te masalig ne makabebagget ne kamalehetan meyitenged te ubal.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use in_fact when you give more details about something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't like gabi tops. In fact, I don't like any vegetables.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena a egkeupian te tubed. Te pegkamalehet, kena a egkeupian te minsan nekey ne gulay.

entries.summary: aliddanan; numiru ne igpakatayimis wey igpakadibayid; eglabet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which helps to produce a result.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The good weather was a factor in our wonderful day at the beach.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka meupiya ne aldew ka aliddanan ne mateles ka aldew diyè te ilis te dahat.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: One factor in the team's success was their excellent goal defence.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a number by which you multiply or divide another number.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our sales increased by a factor of 5, so that we sold 100 units per month instead of 20 units.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you factor something in, you include it when you decide something, or work out an amount.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When you calculate the total cost, you need to factor in the cost of food.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke egseel ka te langun ne bali, keilangan ne eglabeten ka bali te pegkeen.

entries.summary: kumpanya ne himuwanan te minsan nekey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kumpanya ne himuwanan te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a place where many people work to produce large amounts of something.

entries.summary: lubad
warè nakuwa ka igkeupii; warè neyimu; warè neyimu ka langun ne eggimuwen; egkapakyas

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you fail, you are not able to do something that you try to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He tried to carry the big sack, but failed.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggeraman din te egtiang ka dakel ne saku, piru warè din neelehi.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you fail to do something that you should do, you don't do it. If something fails to happen, it doesn't happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He failed to pay his workers last week.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè din nabayari ka me trabaanti [traba͡anti] rin te miglihad ne simana.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It failed to rain last week, so the road is very dry.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: warè neyimu ka langun ne eggimuwen; egkapakyas

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you fail in a duty, you do not do everything that you should do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She feels that she has failed as a mother.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggeram din ne napakyas sikandin te pegkainey rin.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egsanggel te peg-andar su due prublima

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a machine fails, it stops working because there is a problem.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The generator failed, so we had no light.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka diniritur kenad eg-andar, sika ka warè sulù ta.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His heart failed and he died.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: warè nakuwa ka kalayat wey ke karakel ne eleg ne egkakuwa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you fail something such as a test, your result is not good enough to pass.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nabagsak sikandin te tis din te maat [ma͡at].

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegkawarè nakuwa ka igkeupii; 2 pegkawarè neyimu; 3 pegkawarè neyimu ka langun ne eggimuwen 4 pegsanggel te peg-andar su due prublima; 5 pegkabagsak

entries.summary: malaag [mala͡ag]; meupiya; eleg wey meupiya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If hair or skin is fair, it is light in colour.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The Americana has fair skin, so she gets sunburned easily.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka malitan ne melikanu malaag [mala͡ag] se laplap, sika ka mahaan egkatutung ka laplap din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as weather is fair, it is good.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We had fair weather for our trip.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due meupiya ne timpu te peggipanew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something fair is right and good because it gives everyone what they should get.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's not fair that she should do more work than all the others.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ne meupiya ne eggimu sikandin te mas masulug ne himuwen kunterè te duma.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A fair person does what is right and good for other people by giving them what they should get.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a good referee for basketball, because he is always fair, and does not favor one team.

entries.summary: pegpalintutuu wey pegsalig (egkahamit layun seini ke eglalag ki meyitenged te Manama); pegsalig; pegtuu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegpalintutuu wey pegsalig (egkahamit layun seini ke eglalag ki meyitenged te Manama)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Faith is the fact that you are sure about someone or something that you can't see, and you depend on them. We especially use it to talk about faith in God.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have faith that my friend will keep his promise to me.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have faith that God will do everything that He said.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that you feel sure that someone will be successful in doing something (have_faith_in_someone).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was nervous about my exam, but my father had faith in me.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The set of things that people believe in a particular religion, such as Christianity, Islam or Buddhism.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She taught me about the Christian faith.

entries.summary: mapalintutuu; matinumanen; egpabulus-bulus te geyinawa diyè te senge etew, wey kenè egkeiyam wey ke egkabag-u.; kenè egpanlibug diyè te asawa te senge etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is faithful, they continue to do the things which they have promised, or the things which are their responsibility.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpabulus-bulus te geyinawa diyè te senge etew, wey kenè egkeiyam wey ke egkabag-u.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is faithful, they continue their relationship with a person, and do not change (e.g., a faithful friend).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè egpanlibug diyè te asawa te senge etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is faithful to their husband or wife, they don't have sexual relationships with other people.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegkamapalintutuu; pegkamatinumanen; 2 pegpabulus-bulus te geyinawa diyè te senge etew; 3 kenè pegpanlibug diyè te asawa te senge etew

entries.summary: egkeulug; egkatahak; egkapeled; egdeisek; egtigkus

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something falls, it moves suddenly from a higher place to a lower place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The broken branch fell from the tree onto the ground.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something falls, they suddenly and quickly move from standing or sitting to being on the ground. Usually they didn't plan to do this.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The sick carabao fell to the ground because it was very weak.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a number or level falls, it becomes smaller or lower.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The river level is slowly falling, so soon it will be easy to cross.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The population of that area is falling.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: maagsil ne timpu wey egkekeulug ka me dewun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: autumn (the season after summer and before winter). In some countries the leaves of trees change color and fall in this season.

entries.summary: ubat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is false, it is not true.

entries.summary: pegkamabantug

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the state of being famous, so that many people know about you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is not interested in fame, he just loves singing.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè egkabagget sikandin te pegkamabantug, egkeupian din dè iya ne eg-ulahing.

entries.summary: nekeila; neila; 1 pegpekeila; 2 pegkeila

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are familiar with someone or something, you know them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm sorry, I'm not familiar with that song.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is familiar, it is known.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Your face is familiar. Have we met before?

entries.summary: senge lunggun; taltalaanak; taltalagduma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group which is usually made of a husband, wife and their children.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are three families living in the house: my brother's family, my sister's family and my own family.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She's my second cousin, so she's family.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of things which are similar or related to one another (e.g. the Manobo family of languages).

entries.summary: mabantug

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or thing is famous, many people know about them.

entries.summary: bangkil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the long tooth of an animal such as a dog or snake.

entries.summary: mariyù; diriyui; mariyu-diyù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are far from something, there is a big distance between you and that thing. If you move far, you move a big distance.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We live far from the school, so we need to walk for more than an hour.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-ugpè key mariyù te iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an], sikak keilangan key ne eggipanew te me subla te uras.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He can throw a ball really far.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a time that is far in the past or future is a long time before or after now.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's only March, so Christmas is still far away.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Marsu pad seini, sikak diriyui pad ka Pasku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: When you compare things, you use far to say that something is much more than another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is far older than his sister, maybe 20 years older.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mariyu-diyù ne buyag sikandin te atebey rin, me daruwam pulù ne tuig buwa ka kabuyahan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This one is better than the others by far.

entries.summary: kamet; egkamet wey eg-eayam

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a place where people grow food or keep animals for food.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you farm an area of land, you grow food on it or keep animals there.

entries.summary: diyè dapit (meyitenged te kariyuan te sabeka ne lugar puun te sabeka); madmariyù

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: diyè dapit (meyitenged te kariyuan te sabeka ne lugar puun te sabeka); madmariyù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use farther (or further) to compare distances. If one thing is farther from a place than another thing, it is more far (the distance is bigger).

entries.summary: kinamariyuan; diriyui

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The farthest (or furthest) place or thing is the most far away.

entries.summary: meiyal

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is fast, it happens in a short time, or moves somewhere in a short time.

entries.summary: kenè egkeen eyew te peg-ampu; egpuasa (malasi diyè te pangkristuwanen wey ke pegpanambal ne katuyuan)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè egkeen eyew te peg-ampu; egpuasa (malasi diyè te pangkristuwanen wey ke pegpanambal ne katuyuan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you fast, you don't eat for some time (often for religious or medical reasons).

entries.summary: Iyan sika se egpegserepen iling butinis wey eggeheten.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Iyan sika se egpegserepen iling butinis wey eggeheten.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you fasten something, you close or connect it with something like a clip or button.

entries.summary: kalambuan; tabè; malambeg

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a solid, white, oily material in the bodies of people and animals.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A fat person or animal has a lot of fat in their body.

entries.summary: amey; egpaberes; egpeyiberes

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a man fathers a child, he causes a woman to become pregnant and give birth to a child.

entries.summary: salè
batasan ne egkeupian te duma; pegbulig; eglapig wey ke egdapig

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has the favor of the people, so I think he will be chosen at the election.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you do for someone just to help them (do_someone_a_favor).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Could you please do me a favor? Could you go to the shops for me, because I'm busy.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kaayun ded ubag ne egpabulig keykew? Kaayun ded ubag ne hendiyei e pà te tindaan [tinda͡an], su amana ne masalig ka himu ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you favor someone, you like them and treat them better than other people.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's not fair, because my grandmother favors my brother, and doesn't care about me.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are in_favor_of something, you agree with it, and think that people should do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I am in favor of building the new road.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eg-uyun a ne eggimu te iyam ne kelesadda.

entries.summary: egkaliyasan; egkaaldek [egka͡aldek]; liyas; liyasen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you fear something, you have a bad feeling about it because you think that it will hurt you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He really fears snakes, because he was bitten last year.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a bad feeling about something because you think that it will hurt you somehow.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has a great fear of snakes.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When there is fighting in an area, people live in fear.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are fearful, you fear something.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is fearful, people are afraid of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A bad storm is a fearful thing.

entries.summary: pista
pakpak
impurtanti ne baad te minsan nekey; egkalabet; egkakita ne labet; egpalabet; egpaapil

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: impurtanti ne baad te minsan nekey

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Traditional dancing is a very important feature of the Kaamulan fiesta.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegsayew te sayew ne karaan amana ne impurtanti ne baad te Kaamulan ne kalibulungan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something features in another thing, they are part of that thing, so you can see them in it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Traditional dancing often features in fiestas.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegsayew te sayew ne karaan layun egkalabet diyè te me kalibulungan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Jackie Chan features in that movie.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Si Diyaki Tsan nalabet te seika ne salida.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something features another thing, that other thing is a part of it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Malasi egpalabet ka me pista te me kinaraan ne me sayaw.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This house features double bamboo walls.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a movie features an actor or performer, the actor is in that movie.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a part of your face (e.g., your nose).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her features are very similar to her mother's.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka baad te ula-ula rin amana nekeiling te iney rin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a special television program or piece of writing in a newspaper or magazine.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Last night on TV there was a feature on Mt Apo.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The team's win was the feature news story in the local paper.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of feed

entries.summary: klasiyan te gubirnu ne due pangkatangenan wey due deisek, wey migtalad-talad ka geem [ge͡em] dan.; ke eglalag ka te pangkatangenan ne gubirnu te seini ne sistima te gubirnu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: klasiyan te gubirnu ne due pangkatangenan wey due deisek, wey migtalad-talad ka geem [ge͡em] dan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A federal form of government has a central government and smaller regional governments, and power is shared between them.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ke eglalag ka te pangkatangenan ne gubirnu te seini ne sistima te gubirnu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use federal to talk about the central government in a federal system.

entries.summary: bayad ne seleppì te pegseled te lugar wey ke eggimu te minsan nekey.; igbayad ne seleppì para te inggimu rin ne minsan nekey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: bayad ne seleppì te pegseled te lugar wey ke eggimu te minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: money that you need to pay to enter a place or to do something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The fee to enter the park is 50 pesos.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka bayad te pegseled te le-leuhan su lalimman pulu ne pisus.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: igbayad ne seleppì para te inggimu rin ne minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: money that you need to pay someone for something that someone does for you.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Daruwan gatus ka igbayad te duktur.

entries.summary: egpakeen; egsungit; egpanabtab

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you feed a person or animal, you provide food for them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother feeds our family three times a day.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka iney ku egpakeen te pamilya ney te katatelu te tagsè aldew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you feed someone such as a baby, you put food in their mouth.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She fed the baby with a spoon.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migsungit din ka batè te keenen te silut.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If animals feed on something, they eat it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The carabao is feeding on the grass.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegkeen para te in-uyag ne me ayam

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They bought feed for their pigs.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbebeli sikandan te pegkeen te babuy.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something feeds another thing, it keeps giving the other thing what it needs to continue.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka bukal egpapabulus te pahamayan ne weyig.

entries.summary: eggeram; egtuu; egtaluheramen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you feel a certain way, that is the state of your body, mind or heart.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you feel that something is the case, you believe that it is the case.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I feel that we should help her.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egtuu a ne keilangan ki ne egbulig kandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you feel something, you use your hands to help you know what it is like.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She felt the bag to find out what was inside.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtaluheram din ka kabil ke nekey ka tahù.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you feel_like doing something, you want to do that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm tired, so I feel like going to bed.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nabeley a, sika ka egkeupian a ne eggendiyad te hibatanan.

entries.summary: marani se rilasyun wey nekeg-iling se suman-suman te grupu te me etew; pegpekegsabeka; grupu te me etew ne egpalintutuu te nekeg-iling ne butang wey ke eggimu te minsan nekey ne impurtanti kandan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: marani se rilasyun wey nekeg-iling se suman-suman te grupu te me etew; pegpekegsabeka

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: close relationships and similar thinking in a group of people.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: grupu te me etew ne egpalintutuu te nekeg-iling ne butang wey ke eggimu te minsan nekey ne impurtanti kandan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of people who believe the same thing, or are doing something important together.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of feel

entries.summary: malitan; upa; beyan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a human or animal that can produce eggs or have babies; a plant or part of a plant that can produce fruit.

entries.summary: alad
dateng
deisek dè; salimbeka rè (meyitenged te kasuluhan); deisek ubag (meyitenged te kasuluhan)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: deisek dè; salimbeka rè (meyitenged te kasuluhan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use few with a count noun to talk about a small number of things. It has a negative feeling, because you are focusing on what is lacking.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has few friends here in Sinuda, so he's lonely.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Deisek dè ka alukuy rin kayi te Simud, sika ka egkalangè sikandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use a_few with a count noun to talk about a small number of things. It has a positive feeling, as you are focusing on what is there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has a few friends here in Sinuda, so he's not lonely.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Duen ded ubag deisek ne alukuy rin kayi te Simud, sika ka kenè ded ubag egkalangè sikandin.

entries.summary: kamet; talihebè; kaluahan te tanè ne natahuan te me miniralis; panggahalawan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an area of flat land without trees which can be used to grow food or to keep animals

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kaluahan te tanè ne natahuan te me miniralis

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large area which contains minerals such as oil. It may be on land or on the bottom of the sea.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an area of flat, grassy land where people play sport

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large subject of study (e.g. history)

entries.summary: egpasukubey; egpeehetey; egpabutengey; egpahansingey; egpaap-apuley; pegpeehetey; pegpabutengey; pegpaapuley

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people or animals fight with each other, they try to hurt each other by using weapons or their bodies.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The soldiers and the rebels fought near the village.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The boy lost a tooth when he fought with his brother.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people fight with each other, they talk angrily to each other about something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Those two friends are not speaking to each other, because they b:fought yesterday.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a situation in which people or animals fight with each other, or people talk angrily with each other (have_a_fight).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you fight something (e.g., a fire, a social problem), you try to stop it or destroy it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pulis eggeram egpapeeneng-eneng te krimin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The men fought the fire with buckets of water.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was very sleepy, but he fought sleep because he needed to finish his work.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A fight against something is the the action of trying to stop or destroy it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Many people support the fight against drugs in the Barangay.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpehes eggeram ne eggimu wey egkuwa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you fight for something, or fight to do something difficult, you try very hard to do it or get it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They had to fight to breathe in the thick smoke.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpehes sikandan miggeheynawa te makepal ne ebel.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He really had to fight to finish the race, because he was very tired.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The injured man is in hospital fighting for his life.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegpehes peggeram ne peggimu wey pegkuwa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A fight for something is the action of trying very hard to do it or get it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was very tired from his fight to finish the race.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana nabeley sikandin puun te pegpehes din ne eg-impusan ka lumba.

entries.summary: kasuluhan (meyitenged te seel); ula-ula (meyitenged te kasangkapan); kehun-kehun wey ke baglis diyè te libru

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't know the exact figure, but there are approximately 500 students at my college.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A pentagon is a figure with five sides.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pintagun iyan ka due lalimma ne pikungan se ilis.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kehun-kehun wey ke baglis diyè te libru

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a diagram or graph in a book.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the shape of a person who you can't see very clearly

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I saw a figure coming towards me, but in the dark I couldn't see who it was.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due napamulinggitan ku ne ula-ula te etew ne egparani keddì, piru warè ku namelmelehi su marusilem.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A person's figure is the shape of their body.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She exercises a lot, so she has a good figure.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A public figure is a famous person.

entries.summary: grupu te me lalag ne duen dè igpasabut ne kenè ne klaru ke me lalag dè.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: grupu te me lalag ne duen dè igpasabut ne kenè ne klaru ke me lalag dè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of words with a special meaning that is not clear from just the words.

entries.summary: pinunpun ne kanengnengan meyitenged te etew wey ke kasangkapan.; tahuanan wey ke helesanan te me pepil; egtapid te me pepil

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pinunpun ne kanengnengan meyitenged te etew wey ke kasangkapan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a collection of information about a person or thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The hospital keeps a file with my information in it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggeles ka me pinunpun ne me kanengnengan ku te uspital.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: tahuanan wey ke helesanan te me pepil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something in which papers are kept.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you file papers, you organize them and put them into the correct place.

entries.summary: lingya te me etew ne egmanggipanew; egmanggipanew ne nalingya

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: lingya te me etew ne egmanggipanew

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We walked single-file because the path was not wide.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Englingya ki ka egmanggipanew su kenè ne maluag ka dalan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a group of people file somewhere, they walk in a line to that place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The students filed into the classroom.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me istudyanti miglingya ka migmanggipanew peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te klasiyanan dan.

entries.summary: limbas ne putew; eglimbas

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a metal tool with a rough surface that you use for making things smooth or changing their shape.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you file something (e.g., your fingernails), you use a file (see sense 1) on it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She filed her nails with a nail file.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miglimbasan din ka sulu rin te limbas te sulu.

entries.summary: egkapenù; eggipenù; egpakasubal ne eggimu te himu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a container or space fills with a thing such as water, it becomes full, so that there is no more space in it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The water tank quickly filled with water in the heavy rain.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you fill a container or space with a thing such as water, you cause it to become full of that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She filled the baby's mouth with food.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He filled the bucket with stones.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you fill a job or role, that becomes your job or role.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother died when I was very young, so my older sister filled the role of mother for me.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When my boss left, we needed to find someone to fill his position.

entries.summary: salida; eg-angey te egweil ne alung para te salida; ka egkatahuan te me alung diyè te kamira

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-angey te egweil ne alung para te salida

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you film something, you use a video camera to record moving pictures of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He filmed the basketball game on his video camera.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka egkatahuan te me alung diyè te kamira

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the roll of plastic in a camera (non-digital) which you put photographs on.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This film has 24 photos on it.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: manipis ne lapis te minsan nekey iling te lindit

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a very thin layer of something such as dirt.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was a film of dust on the table.

entries.summary: katammanan; katapusan; kewulugan; katammanan ne galew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something final is the last thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That is my final decision and I'm not going to change my mind.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sika ka katammanan ne puhawang ku wey kè kud sika egbalbalawan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This is the final evening of fiesta.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ka katammanan ne karusileman te pista.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A final is the last game in a sports competition, to decide which player or team is the best in the competition.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our team won the final, so we are the champions.

entries.summary: trabahu ne pegdumalè te seleppì, peutang wey te pegpasambey; egpamayad; seleppì

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: trabahu ne pegdumalè te seleppì, peutang wey te pegpasambey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the work of managing money, credit and investment.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He studied finance and then got a job in a bank.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you finance something, you give the money for it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My uncle is financing my college study.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka anggam ku iyan egpamayad te peg-iskuyla ku te kulihiyu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the money that a person or company has.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our family's finances are quite low, so it's not easy to pay for everything.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seleppì te pamilya ney kuntee amana ne deisek, sika ka malised ne egpamayad te langun-langun.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something financial is related to money, credit and investment.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That company has a lot of financial problems at the moment.

entries.summary: egkakita impus te pegpamitew; egpakakita (meyitenged te kenè ne tinibebè); egpakataha; egpakanengneng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you find something, you see or have it after you searched for it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: After looking all around the house, I finally found the money that I had lost.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was very busy, but he found the time to help me with my work.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you find something that is not yours, you see it when you were not expecting to.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was just walking along the road when I found a ten-peso coin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you find that something is the case, you know it because you studied it or experienced it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The doctors found that the medicine was not helpful for children.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me duktur nakataha ne ka bawì kenè ne mabulig te me batè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you find something a certain way (e.g., difficult, interesting), that is your experience or feeling about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I found the exam very difficult.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Naheram ku ne ka iksam amana ne malised.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nakita ne due meupiya wey keilangan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something good or important that someone has found.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This chair was a great find! It was very cheap, but it's so comfortable.

entries.summary: malintek; meupiya se klasiyan; warè prublima

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as hair, sand or cloth is fine, the individual pieces are very thin or small

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The baby's hair is very fine and soft.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She used very fine threads to weave the cloth, so the cloth was very light, and the pattern was very clear.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you make pansit, it's good to chop the carrots into fine pieces.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something fine is of very good quality.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That shop makes very fine chairs, but they are expensive.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something is fine, there is not a problem. If it is fine to do something, there is no problem if you do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Your X-ray looks fine, so I think no bones are broken.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's fine to wear your shoes in this part of the house.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm fine, thanks, and how are you?

entries.summary: seleppì ne bayad ke egkasupak nu ka balaud.; egpabayaren te peggimu te mareet

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: seleppì ne bayad ke egkasupak nu ka balaud.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: money that you pay to the government or organization if you break the law.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I had to pay a fine for driving without a license.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If the government or an organization fines you, they tell you that you must pay money because you did something wrong.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was fined for driving without a license.

entries.summary: kemel; egtaluheramen te kemel

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you finger something, you feel it with your fingers.

entries.summary: eg-impusan; egpeeneng-eneng; egsanggel; egpeeneng-eneng su keepusan e

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you finish something, you work on it until everything is done.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I need to finish this project.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you finish, you stop doing something.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something finishes, it stops because it is at the end.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggamiten wey ke eg-aminen ka langun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you finish something, you use all of it, so that there is no more.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He finished all the rice because he was hungry.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: dibabew te minsan nekey (iling te kayu wey ke putew)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the surface of something such as wood or metal.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That bamboo chair has a beautiful, smooth finish.

entries.summary: due tammanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is finite, it has limits.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a finite amount of gasoline in the world.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due tammanan te karakelan te gasulina te kalibutan.

entries.summary: hapuy; egpabetu te sinapang; pegpabetu te sinapang

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They lost all their things in the fire.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Natarinan sikandan te langun ne kasangkapan dan te hapuy.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The fire destroyed their corn crop.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka hapuy nakareet te ahelayan dan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We use fire to clear their fields.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She put the pot of rice on the fire.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you fire a gun at something, you shoot.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He fired at the animal and it fell to the ground, dead.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Fire is the shooting of guns.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He heard the sound of gunfire close by.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our commander told us to hold fire, so we stopped shooting.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-initen ne puun te siramiks eyew egpakehalen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you fire something made of ceramics, you bake it in a very hot fire to make it hard.

entries.summary: egpepaaween te trabahu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an employer fires you, they tell you that you can't work for them any more, usually because you did something they didn't like.

entries.summary: bayew makehal; dereseni; kekehali (meyitenged te kenè egkaalin [egka͡alin]); makeseg

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a material is firm, it is not very soft, so that when you press on it, it doesn't change shape very much (e.g., an apple).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is firm, it does not move easily from its place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The wind was strong, but the roof held firm because it was well-built.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an action with the body is firm, it is strong and controlled.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The child tried to run away, but his mother kept a firm hold on his hand.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mapahetpet te minsan nekey (meyitenged te sumam-suman)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are firm, your mind is strong, and you do not allow people to change your mind.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is very firm with her children, and does not allow them to control the house.

entries.summary: punduk te me etew ne due himu te pegbelegyè wey pegbebeli; kumpanya

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: punduk te me etew ne due himu te pegbelegyè wey pegbebeli; kumpanya

entries.summary: nekewun-a te langun; kinewun-aan [kinewun-a͡an]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is first, it is before other things in time or space.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I arrived first; there was nobody else there yet.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekewun-a a nekeyinguma; warè pad minsan hentew diyè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is first, it is more important than other things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: At work, my first responsibility is to help customers.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te trabahu ku, ka kinewun-aan [kinewun-a͡an] ne eggimuwen ku iyan ka egbulihan ku ka me mameliyay.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The customers come first at my shop.

entries.summary: isda; ngalap te weyig; egngengalap (egkaayun ne egpamunuwit; egteteen te bubu; egseseneb; eg-eeti wey duma pad)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egngengalap (egkaayun ne egpamunuwit; egteteen te bubu; egseseneb; eg-eeti wey duma pad)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you fish, you try to catch fish.

entries.summary: kemù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the shape that your hand makes when you close it strongly.

entries.summary: eleg ka kaluag (kenè ne dakel wey kenè ne deisek); egpekegtupù; egpekeg-eleg; 1 pegkeeleg; 2 pegpekegtupù; pegpekeg-eleg

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eleg ka kaluag (kenè ne dakel wey kenè ne deisek)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something fits, it is the right size, not too big and not too small.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: These tsinillas don't fit me because they are too big.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini ne sinilas kenè ne eleg keddì su amana ne dakel.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something fits another thing, the two things are good together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His story didn't fit the facts, so I didn't believe him.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka guhuren din warè nekegtupù te kamalehetan, sika ka kena a egpalintutuu kandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This shirt is not a good fit, because it is too big.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That job is a good fit for you.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakepkep; egparekket; egtahù (diyè te lein ne kasangkapan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you fit something somewhere, you attach it to that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He fitted a new lock on the door.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Intahù sikandin te iyam ne paggul te lekeb.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eleg pad ne egkahamit te nateil ne igkeupii wey ke meupiya pad te sika ne butang.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is fit for a particular purpose, it is good enough to use for that purpose. If someone is fit to do something, they are good enough to do that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That food is old, and is not fit to eat.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sika ne pegkeen naluhey e, wey kenad ne meupiya ne egkeenen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is sick, and is not fit to travel.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are fit, you are strong and healthy, because you exercise.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I go jogging to keep fit.

entries.summary: dalu te lawa ne sahuhunè ne egginguma ne kenè egkakaya wey warè kalintahaan [kalintaha͡an].; egderalu te dalu te lawa ne warè kalintahaan [kalintaha͡an] ta ke egginguma.; deisek ne baad te timpu ne egpakabayè ka te minsan nekey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: dalu te lawa ne sahuhunè ne egginguma ne kenè egkakaya wey warè kalintahaan [kalintaha͡an].

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a medical problem in which a person suddenly can't control their body, and they become unconscious (have_a_fit).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egderalu te dalu te lawa ne warè kalintahaan [kalintaha͡an] ta ke egginguma.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone fits, they have a fit (see 1).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: deisek ne baad te timpu ne egpakabayè ka te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A fit of something such as laughing or anger is a sudden, short period of time when you experience that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She had a fit of laughter, and needed to leave the room.

entries.summary: eg-ay-ayaran; eg-upianan; egpanahù wey ke igpakepkep nu seini diyè eyew kenè egkaweil wey egkaawe-awè.; egkekerew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you fix something that is broken or has a problem, you make it okay again.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My bike was broken, but I fixed it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nareetan ka bayik ku, piru in-upianan ku.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpanahù wey ke igpakepkep nu seini diyè eyew kenè egkaweil wey egkaawe-awè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you fix something somewhere, you put or attach it there so that it will stay and not move.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I fixed the picture to the wall with a nail.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Immakepkep a te litratu diyè te alabat te lansang.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you fix something such as a date, you decide it for sure.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We haven't fixed a date yet for our Thanksgiving party.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè key rè due nakakekerew te pitsa te sahakeen ney te pegpasalamat.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggamit te limbung ne pamaahi eyew te pegkuwa te nateil ne risulta.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person fixes something such as an election or a game, they use dishonest ways to get a particular result.

entries.summary: bendila
mapatag; malanang; nakemì (iling te batiri wey ke ligid); meyimulung dè te keilangan ne dahing ne egkuen (meyinged te musika)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a surface is flat, it is smooth and without curves, and it is often horizontal.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nakemì (iling te batiri wey ke ligid)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a battery is flat, there is no more power in it. If a tire is flat, there is no more air in it.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: meyimulung dè te keilangan ne dahing ne egkuen (meyinged te musika)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a musical sound is flat, it sounds lower than it should sound.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: palinneu diyè te musika ne keilangan ka ne egparahing te nuta te egpariralem te kasabeka

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a symbol in music which means that you should play a note one step lower. The symbol looks like a letter 'b' with a pointed bottom part.

entries.summary: sewug
purgas
sapù
mahaan egkapekù wey kenè egkahepù; mapekù; mahaan egpakabalew-balew eyew eg-eleg te sitwasyun; 1 pegkamapekù; 2 pegkamabalew-balew eyew egkeeleg te lein-lein ne keugpè

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mahaan egkapekù wey kenè egkahepù; mapekù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is flexible, you can bend it easily and it doesn't break.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The long piece of bamboo is flexible.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mahaan egpakabalew-balew eyew eg-eleg te sitwasyun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something is flexible, they can change easily to fit the situation.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We can travel on any day. I am flexible.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She works flexible hours, not 9 to 5 every day.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegkamapekù; 2 pegkamabalew-balew eyew egkeeleg te lein-lein ne keugpè

entries.summary: layap
baggiyu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a problem where there is too much water in a place because it rained a lot.

entries.summary: seeg; mapatag te diralem te minsan nekey; baad te baley paribabew; andanas

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the part of a house or building which people stand on.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There were no chairs, so we sat on the floor.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mapatag te diralem te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the flat bottom of something (e.g., the ocean floor).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one of the levels of a building.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She lives on the fifth floor of that building, so she has good view of the city.

entries.summary: harina
eg-agas; egdalanag; peg-agas; pegdalanag; meupiya ka pegweil te minsan nekey ne kenè ne mewumel iling te weyig

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The river flows to the sea.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He tried to stop the flow of water from the pipe.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: meupiya ka pegweil te minsan nekey ne kenè ne mewumel iling te weyig

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something that is not liquid flows, it moves smoothly and freely (e.g., air, traffic).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are no accidents, so the traffic is flowing freely.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka meupiya ne weil te minsan nekey ne ware egpakabanggew (iling te kalamag wey ke trapiku).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of something moving smoothly and freely.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The wall stopped the flow of air through the house.

entries.summary: bulak; tibelus; egbubulak; egpanibelus

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a plant flowers, it produces flowers.

entries.summary: eglayang; eggendiyè te lein ne inged ne eg-untud te eriplanu; egpapalayang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something flies, it moves in the air.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The ball flew through the air.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggendiyè te lein ne inged ne eg-untud te eriplanu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you fly to a place, you travel there by plane.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He flew to Davao and then took the bus to Sinuda.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-untud sikandin te eriplanu peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te Davao wey pegkeimpus mig-untud e man e sikandin te terak peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te Simud.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you fly a plane, you are the pilot who controls it.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggendiyè te minsan hendei te amana ne iiyali

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something flies, they move very quickly.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggendiyè sikandin te sinabeng te amana ne iiyali.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Wow, it's December already! The year has flown.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an insect with two pairs of wings.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You should cover the meat so that the flies don't walk on it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ne egtel-eban nu ka karni eyew kenè egkalatunan te langew.

entries.summary: egbehey te dakel ne timpu; egbehayan te dakel ne timpu; egpakameleg-meleg

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you focus_on something, you give most of your thinking or time to that thing, and not to other things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In our science class we are focusing on plants at the moment.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te sayans ne klasi ney migbehey key te dakel ne timpu kuntee diyè te me pinamula.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The focus of a person or group is the main thing that they give their thinking and time to.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In our science class, our focus is plants at the moment.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te sayans ne klasi ney migbeheyan ney te dakel ne timpu kuntee ka me pinamula.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If your eyes (or equipment such as cameras) focus, they cause the thing that you are looking at to be clear.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: After he hit his head, he could not focus: he saw two of everything.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te nakasungkul rè iya ka ulu rin, kenad e sikandin egpakameleg-meleg: egkararuwe e ke egteng-teng sikandin te minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the state of a picture being clear. Something is in_focus.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In that picture, the girl's face is in focus, and the background is out of focus.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te seika ne litratu, ka ula-ula te malitan amana namelmelehan, wey ka dayan-dayan miggalap-halap dè.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egteng-ew te sabeka rè ne kasangkapan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you focus lines of something (e.g., light) on another thing, you cause all the lines to point at that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They all focused their flashlights on the frog.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka langun ne sulù dan nakateng-ew diyè te bakbak.

entries.summary: eglulupì
egsinundul; eg-ikul; egpakasinundul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you follow someone, you move after them, going the same way they they are going.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you follow a path or line, you move along that path or line.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Follow the highway until you get to Valencia.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something follows another thing, it comes after that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: An afternoon storm sometimes follows a hot morning.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you follow instructions, you do what the instructions say to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you take medicine, you should follow the doctor's instructions carefully.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you follow something that someone says, you understand it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Sorry, I don't follow. Could you please explain it to me again?

entries.summary: egkeupian; due geyinawa; meyilut; malasi; pegkeupian

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are fond of someone, you love them.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are fond of doing something, you do it often because you like doing it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is fond of pinching her father's ears.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Meyilut sikandin ne egkebeng te talinga te amey rin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the state of being fond of someone or something.

entries.summary: keenen
palapala; seked te kalayat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the part of your body at the end of your leg, which you walk on

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a measurement which equals 12 inches or 30.48cm.

entries.summary: eyew (meyitenged te pegpangabang); para; eyew (meyitenged te egbehayan wey eggamit); para; seled te (pila ne aldew)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you do something for someone, you do it to help or benefit them in some way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I carried the heavy bag for my mother.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-uyan a te mabehat ne baag [ba͡ag] para te iney ku.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eyew (meyitenged te egbehayan wey eggamit); para

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is for someone, they are going to receive it or use it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini se paan su para keykew.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ne libru egkahamit te me batè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happens for a period of time, that is how long it takes.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I've been studying English for five years.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-iskuyla a te Inglish te seled te lalimman tuig.
