fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use for to talk about why someone does something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I go walking every day for exercise.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eggipgipanew a tagsè aldew eyew te pegweil te me lawa ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I paid 30 pesos for the rice.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egbayad a te tatelun pulu eyew te hemey.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egtahaha a eyew te pista ne egginguma

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: diyè te (egpangguhud ke nekey ka egguhuren)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use for to say who you are talking about.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Last year was a very difficult year for my family.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka miglihad ne leg-un ka amana ne malised ne leg-un diyè te pamilya ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He lived with his uncle, for both of his parents were dead.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-ugpè sikandin diyè te anggam din, su ka ginikanan impamatey e.

entries.summary: igkenè
egpehes; egpakapehes; egpehes (meyitenged te pegbingig, peggulibid wey ke pegpeku); kakeseg

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something forces you to do something, they cause you to do it, even though you don't want to.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I had no choice, they forced me to give them the money.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The bad weather forced us to wait another day.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka mareet ne timpu egpakapehes kanta ne egpakatahad te seup ne aldew.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpehes (meyitenged te pegbingig, peggulibid wey ke pegpeku)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you force something into a particular position or place, you push it strongly into that position, even though it doesn't move easily.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The door was jammed, but they forced it open.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka lekeb kenè egkaweil, piru impehes dan lukati.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She broke the key because she forced it into the wrong lock.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The force of something is the strength or power of it. It can be physical or non-physical.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The force of the impact broke the wall.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kakeseg te pegkasungkul ka nakarereet te alabat.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He often gets what he wants just by the force of his personality.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: keseg ne eggamiten diyè te minsan hentew wey ke minsan nekey ne igkeupii nu ne egpeyimuwen te igkeupii nu ne eggimuwen.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the strong physical power that you use to cause someone or something to do what you want.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They used force to remove the people from the house.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that can cause other things to move or change.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The wind is one of the forces of nature.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kalamag sabeka ne kanekal te kinaiyahan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That man is the driving force behind that company.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: grupu te me etew ne due nateil ne eggimuwen wey labi en iya ke due geem [ge͡em] dan wey panganiban (meyitenged te pulis, armi wey duma pad ne due me sinapang).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of people who have a particular job to do, especially if they have power and weapons (e.g., the police force, the airforce, the armed forces).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggebè te baad te lekeb wey ke bintanà eyew te pegseled

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you force something such as a door or lock, you break part of it so that you can get into a place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The thieves forced the window to enter the building.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggebè te me takawen ka bintanà eyew te pegseled te baley.

entries.summary: buked
puun te lein ne nasud wey ke diyè te lein ne nasud; iyam; nakatahù diyè te kenè ne eleg ne egkatahuan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: puun te lein ne nasud wey ke diyè te lein ne nasud

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Someone or something foreign comes from another country or is in another country.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The shop sells many foreign imports.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I would like to learn a foreign language such as German.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is foreign to you, it is new to you, or you don't understand it because you have not experienced it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The hospital environment was very foreign to him, because he had never been in a large hospital before.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nakatahù diyè te kenè ne eleg ne egkatahuan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an object is foreign, it is in a place where it should not be.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was a foreign body in his coffee: a small stone which had fallen in.

entries.summary: katalunan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large area with many trees

entries.summary: egkalingawan; egkalingew; lilingawen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you forget something that you knew before, it is not in your mind any more. If you forget something, you leave it somewhere by mistake.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Sorry, I have forgotten your name.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Oh, I forgot my lunch! I left it at home.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you forget to do something, you don't do it because it is not in your mind to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She forgot to close the window.

entries.summary: egpasaylu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you forgive someone who has done something bad to you, you decide to stop being angry with them.

entries.summary: napasaylu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A forgiven person is one who has done something wrong to someone, but has been forgiven by God or the other person.

entries.summary: tinidur
ula-ula te minsan nekey; lein ne pamaahi te ula-ula puun te minsan nekey ne egkakita; egkeyimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The form of something is the structure of it; what it looks like.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The form of the building is like a cross.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: lein ne pamaahi te ula-ula puun te minsan nekey ne egkakita

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A form of something is one of the shapes or ways in which it appears.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I like to eat banana in the form of banana-cue.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian a ne egkeen te sahing ke egsandahen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She drank dirty water in the form of ice.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-inum sikandin te malindit ne weyig ne iling te impakehal ne weyig.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something forms, it starts to exist.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Holes started to form on the bottoms of her shoes.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me lungag egbunsud e egkeyimu diyè te diralem te sepatus din.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggimu wey ke egpangimu te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people or things form something, that thing is made by them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: These rooms form the new Barangay office.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ne me sinabeng eggimuwen ne iyam ne upisina te Barangay.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We formed a circle around the table.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpangimu key te malibusen palingut te lamisa.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a type or kind of thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She has a rare form of malaria.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due marelag ne klasiyan te malarya ne miggeram din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a printed document with space to write information (e.g., an application form).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a shape (especially a shape which you can't see very clearly).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She could see forms running through the dark street.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakakita sikandin te me ula-ula ne egpamalpallahuy ne kenè egkamelmelehan diyè te egmarusilem ne kelesadda.

entries.summary: newun-a; dengan; hun-a te daruwa ne kasangkapan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use former to describe something which you had before, but not now (e.g., your former boss)

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I met my former science teacher when I visited the school.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nalambag ku ka newun-a ne talagpanulù ku te sayans te pegleuy ku diyè te iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an].

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use former to talk about something that you did in the past, but not now.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father is a former teacher, but now he works in an office.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka amey ku meistru dengan, piru kuntee migtrabahu e sikandin diyè te upisina.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use former to talk about the first of two things (and you use latter to talk about the second).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She tried a red shirt and a blue shirt, and she liked the former.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Inggeraman din ka malalab ne kumbalè wey ka meilem ne kumbalè te egsaluub, wey ingkeupii rin ka hun-a ne in-eleg-eleg din.

entries.summary: eg-ikulen ne me pamaahi wey balaud ke egmenuwen te eggimu ka minsan nekey.; grupu te me litra, numiru wey me palinneu ne egpakita te matimatikal ne paamahi te pegpangimu te minsan nekey ne eggimuwen ne kimikal.; grupu te me lalag ne eggamiten te nateil ne sitwasyun

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-ikulen ne me pamaahi wey balaud ke egmenuwen te eggimu ka minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a rule which says how something should be done or made.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A general formula for making native coffee is two parts corn to one part coffee.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: grupu te me litra, numiru wey me palinneu ne egpakita te matimatikal ne paamahi te pegpangimu te minsan nekey ne eggimuwen ne kimikal.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of letters, numbers and symbols which show a mathematical rule, or which show what something such as a chemical is made of.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The formula for water is H₂O.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: grupu te me lalag ne eggamiten te nateil ne sitwasyun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a set of words which are always used for a particular situation (e.g. a ceremony).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pangamut te weyig (iling te binlud) eyew te gatas te batè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a powder which you mix with water to make milk for babies.

entries.summary: kulis
egpabulus; te kewun-aan [kewun-a͡an]; pewun-a

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone moves forward, they move in the same direction that they are facing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The motorbike rolled forward down the hill.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Pabulus ne nalilid ka mutur patupang te labungtud.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is located forward, it is close to the front.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She always sits far forward, because her eyes are not strong.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Layun egpinnuu sikandin diyè te kewun-aan, su kenè egpakameleg-meleg sikandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If the direction of something is forward, it is moving or facing towards the front.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is forward, they like to tell people what they think and want, even if they shouldn't. They are happy for many people to see and hear them, and they are not respectful. This is a negative word.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is very forward, and is always telling me what to do, even though we are not close friends.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amanan mapewun-a-hun-a sikandin, wey layun egpanugtul sikandin keddì ke nekey ka eggimuwen ku, minsan kenè key ne telek ne talag-alukuy.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you forward a letter or email to someone, you receive it and then send it to them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He forwarded me the text message that his brother sent him.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impaleus din ipasa ka tiks te suled din kayi te keddì.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of fight

entries.summary: egpabunsud te urganisasyun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you found an organization such as a school, you start it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of find

entries.summary: baad te baley ne egpakapes-ek te tanè; malemu wey keilangan ne baad wey ke pegtuu; grupu ne egpamitew te seleppì eyew te nateil ne katuyuan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: baad te baley ne egpakapes-ek te tanè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the foundation (or foundations) of a building is the part of it in the ground, which it sits on.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Before you build a house, you must build a foundation.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: malemu wey keilangan ne baad wey ke pegtuu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the foundation (or foundations) of something is the basic idea or belief which the thing depends on.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Love is the foundation of true friendship.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka geyinawa ka hun-a wey keilangan ne baad te malehet ne pegpaal-alukuyey.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: grupu ne egpamitew te seleppì eyew te nateil ne katuyuan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an organization which provides money for a particular purpose such as research or charity work.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She started a foundation to help homeless children.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpabunsud sikandin te grupu te pegpamitew te seleppì eyew te warè me ugpaan ne me batè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The action of starting an organization.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The foundation of this school was in 1975.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegpabunsud te seini ne iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an] neyitabù te 1975.

entries.summary: tahuanan te litratu; egtahù te litratu diyè te tahuanan; me bantal (kayu wey ke putew)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a flat thing which you put around a picture. It is made of something such as wood or metal.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That photo will look better if you put it in a frame.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka litratu egmeupiya pad ke igtahù te tahuanan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egtahù te litratu diyè te tahuanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you frame a picture, you put it in a frame (sense 1).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the strong pieces of wood, metal or other material which make the basic shape of something such as a house or window.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We've built the frame of the house, but we haven't put the roof or walls on yet.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpanday ney e ka me bantal te baley, piru warè ney pad itahù ka me atep wey me alabat.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The glass is broken, but the window frame is still okay.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you frame something such as a plan, you create it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They framed a plan to catch the criminal.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eggimu sikandan te pamaahi eyew te pegdakep te mangimatey.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Eggimuwen ne iyan nakasalè ka lein ne etew te salè ne warè din neyimu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone frames you, they try to make you look as though you committed a crime, even though you didn't.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I didn't take it! I've been framed.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Wara a migkuwa kayi! Miggim-gimuwan e rè ne iyan nakasalè te kenè ne keddì ne karupangan.

entries.summary: sistima te balaud wey ke me pegtuu; baad te minsan nekey ne nakabulig te ligwang ne baad

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sistima te balaud wey ke me pegtuu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a system of rules or beliefs which controls what people do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You can't do whatever you want at work, because you need to stay within the framework of the rules.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: baad te minsan nekey ne nakabulig te ligwang ne baad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the part of something such as a house which supports the outside parts of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He built the framework of his house out of wood, and made the walls out of bamboo.

entries.summary: due kaligwangan te peg-ugpè; gawasnen; eglekaan; due kaligwangan (meyitenged te eggimu te minsan nekey)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or animal is free, they are not locked in a place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was finally free after ten years in prison.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakalihawang sikandin te prisuwan impus te sapulù ne tuig.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't like putting birds in cages, because it's better for them to be free.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you free a person or animal, you take them out of the place where they are locked.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He freed the bird from the cage.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miglekaan din ka bayaku puun te kulukug.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due kaligwangan (meyitenged te eggimu te minsan nekey)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are free, you can do what you want to do, because nobody controls you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Feel free to come over anytime you want to.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due kaligwangan nu te eggendini minsan ken-u ke egkeupian ka.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something is free from a thing, they don't have that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her illness is totally gone, and she is free from pain.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is free, you don't need to pay for it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a seat is free, nobody is in it, so you can use it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Excuse me, is this seat free?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Tebbiyè pad, warè migpinnuu kayi ne pinnuuwan?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is free, it can move around easily because there is nothing holding it.

entries.summary: kamenu kalasi egkeyitabù (meyitenged te minsan nekey); kakeseg te weil diyè te kalamag. Seini ka egbeye-beyè ke kamenu kalayat wey kameyimulung ka dahing. Lein-lein ne prikwinsi ka inggamit te lein-lein ne istasyunan te radyu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kamenu kalasi egkeyitabù (meyitenged te minsan nekey)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the frequency of something is how often it happens.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What is the frequency of her falls?

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kakeseg te weil diyè te kalamag. Seini ka egbeye-beyè ke kamenu kalayat wey kameyimulung ka dahing. Lein-lein ne prikwinsi ka inggamit te lein-lein ne istasyunan te radyu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the speed of waves in the air. This decides how high or low a sound is. Different frequencies are used by different radio stations.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Dogs can hear sounds at very high frequencies.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We can't listen to that radio station because our radio can't get that particular frequency.

entries.summary: malasi; layun eggendiyè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an action or event is frequent, it happens often.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you frequent a place, you go there very often.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This is the shop that he frequents.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ka tindaan [tinda͡an] ne layun din eggendinii [eggendini͡i].

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happens frequently, it happens often.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I frequently eat at my aunt's house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Malasi a egkeen diyè te baley te ayè ku.

entries.summary: warè pad nakatahù te lata wey ke naprisirba; iyam pad (iling te keenen) wey ke malinis (iling te kalamag); egkeinum ne weyig kenè ne weyig puun te dahat

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: warè pad nakatahù te lata wey ke naprisirba

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If food such as vegetables or fish is fresh, it is natural, not canned or preserved.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: iyam pad (iling te keenen) wey ke malinis (iling te kalamag)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as food or air is fresh, it is new or clean.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkeinum ne weyig kenè ne weyig puun te dahat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If water is fresh, then it is not saltwater (like water in the sea).

entries.summary: alukuy; alukuy (meyitenged te grupu wey ke kumpanya); telek ne alukuy

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person whom you like and care for, and who likes and cares for you.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: alukuy (meyitenged te grupu wey ke kumpanya)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A friend of a particular organization is someone who helps that organization.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a friend of the school, and has helped at many school activities.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The two girls have a close friendship.

entries.summary: maal-alukuy

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A friendly person speaks in a nice way to other people.

entries.summary: puun te; ligkat te; bunsud te (meyitenged te lugar ne egpuunan); puun te; ligkat te; bunsud te (meyitenged te panahun); puun; ligkat; bunsud (meyitenged te an-anayan ne pilianan)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: puun te; ligkat te; bunsud te (meyitenged te lugar ne egpuunan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something comes from a place, that is the place where they started. If something comes from another thing, it is made of that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I came from Davao this morning.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ligkat epad iya diyè te Dabaw kuntee te maselem.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My house is about one kilometer from the crossing.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: puun te; ligkat te; bunsud te (meyitenged te panahun)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you do something from a particular time, that is the time that you start.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-iskuyla a puun te alas utsu te maselem peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te alas kwatru te maapun [ma͡apun].

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: puun; ligkat; bunsud (meyitenged te an-anayan ne pilianan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use from to talk about the first thing in a range of things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Everybody, from the old people to the young children, helped with the work.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka langun, puun te buyag peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te me batè, migbulig te trabahu.

entries.summary: tangkaan; minsan nekey ne eggamiten ne helesanan te malehet ne sitwasyun; te kewun-aan [kewun-a͡an]; katangkaan; te tangkaan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The front of something is the part of it which people usually see or use (e.g., the front of a house), or the part of it which is first (e.g., the front of a motorbike).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne eggamiten ne helesanan te malehet ne sitwasyun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which someone uses to hide the real situation.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That shop is just a front for an illegal drug market.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sika ne tindaan [tinda͡an] helesanan ne belegyaanan te ingkenè ne druga.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He acts loud and confident, but that is a front; he is really very shy.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is in_front_of another thing, the other thing is behind it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can't see because a tall person is standing in front of me.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena a egpakakita su ka malayat ne etew migsasindeg diyè te kewun-aan [kewun-a͡an] ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a tree in front of my house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due kayu diyè te tangkaan te baley ku.

entries.summary: prutas; behas te egkakeen ne kayu; risulta te nateil ne himu wey ke weil

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: prutas; behas te egkakeen ne kayu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: risulta te nateil ne himu wey ke weil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The fruit of a particular action is the result that comes from it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His success is the fruit of his hard work.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kalampusan din ka risulta te mangune-kunè ne pegtrabahu rin.

entries.summary: napenù; due masalig; warè nalaahi; due langun; langun-langun; kumplitu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a container is full of something, there is no more space in it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The glass is full of water.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The jeepney could not take any more passengers because it was already full.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is full of something, it has a lot of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This mango is full of fruit.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This apple is full of worms.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: warè nalaahi; due langun; langun-langun; kumplitu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something full is complete, and includes all of it (e.g., full name).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't know the full details of the story.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Wara a nakataha te langun-langun pangasak te guhuren.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Please write your full name here, including your mother's maiden name.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Palihug isulat nu ka kumplitu ne ngaran nu, apil ka aplidu te iney nu te mengebay pad.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I paid a deposit today, and will pay the full amount next week.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpewun-a e rè kuntee egbayad, wey kayi te seup ne simana egbayaran ku ka langun-langun.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He threw the ball the full length of the basketball court.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are full, you don't want to eat any more, because you have eaten enough.

entries.summary: karuan; himu; eg-andar; egdahing; eglalag; egkaayun ne egkahamit te igkeupii

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The function of something is the thing that it is created to do. A person's function is their role, the thing that they should do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The function of a window is to let in air and light.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka karuan te bintana egpaseleran te kalamag wey layag.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something functions, you can use it, because it works.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The radio doesn't function because somebody broke it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka radyu kenè eg-dahing su nareetan te duma.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something functions as something else, you use it for that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our long chair functions as a bed when we have visitors.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka malayat ne bangku ney egkahamit ne hibatanan ke due me mahaliyug ney.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a formal social event such as a dinner.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They killed a pig for the function.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggilang sikandan te babuy eyew te kalibulungan ne inggimu ran.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkabalbalawan ka sabeka ke egkabalbalawan ka dangeb

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is a function of another thing, it changes when the other thing changes (it depends on that other thing).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The price of rice is a function of the weather in the growing season.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is functional, you can use it because it works.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The radio is not functional now.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka radyu kenè egkaayun wey ke egkahamit kuntee (nareetan).

entries.summary: seleppì ne tabang eyew te nateil ne tumung; egtabang te seleppì; seleppì

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: seleppì ne tabang eyew te nateil ne tumung

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a supply of money to use for a particular purpose.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The rich man created a fund to help poor students go to college.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka meyaman ne etew migbehey te pundu para te pubri ne istudyanti ne egkulihiyu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you fund something, you provide the money for it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His uncle is funding his college study.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka anggam din migbehey te seleppì para te peg-iskuyla rin te kulihiyu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We don't have the funds to buy a motorbike.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè seleppì ta ne igbeli te mutur.

entries.summary: malemu wey keilanganen ne egnengnengen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is fundamental to a particular subject, it is one of the simple and important things that you need to know about that subject.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The multiplication table is fundamental to mathematics, so you should learn it well.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka multiplikisyun tibul su ka malemu wey keilangan te matimatiks, sika ka keilangan ne egbebasbasan seini eg-upiani.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I know the fundamentals of that language, but I can't really understand much.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kateu a te malemu wey keilangan te sika ne linalahan, piru kena a amana egpakasabut.

entries.summary: imbudu
kangisiyan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is funny, it causes you to laugh or smile.

entries.summary: diyè pad dapit (meyitenged te kariyuan te sabeka ne lugar puun te sabeka); madmariyù; diyè layun; pabulus-bulus; duma pad

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: diyè pad dapit (meyitenged te kariyuan te sabeka ne lugar puun te sabeka); madmariyù; diyè layun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use further (or farther) to compare distances. If one thing is further from a place than another thing, it is more far (the distance is bigger).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I walk further than my friend.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eggipanew a diyè pad dapit te alukuy ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I live further from the school than my friend, so it takes longer for me to walk there.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you do something further, you continue to do it, or do it more.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm tired, and I can't walk any further.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nabeley ad, wey kenè ad eggipanew pabulus-bulus.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She didn't answer his questions clearly, so he questioned her further.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'd like to talk with you further about this.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If there are further things, there are more of them remaining.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have finished my work, and there is no further work to do.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Neimpusan kud ka trabahu ku, warad duma pad ne eggimuwen ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: After we fixed the roof we had no further problems with rain.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He would like to do further study after he finishes high school.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you further something, you help it to become bigger or better.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He went to the night classes to further his chances of getting a job.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eg-iskuyla sikandin te marusilem eyew te pegparakel te timpu rin ne egpakakuwa te trabahu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is furthering his education in Manila.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use further to add extra information which makes something stronger.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She closed the door and, further, put a 'do not disturb' sign on it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Inlekeban din ka gemawan, wey labet pad maa migtahù sikandin te kanengnengan ne warè egsamuk.

entries.summary: labet pad maa; labet pad due

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: labet pad maa; labet pad due

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use furthermore to add another idea or fact to what you have just said.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't like those flowers because they are ugly. Furthermore, they have sharp thorns.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena a egkeupiyan te seeyè ne me bulak su mareet. Labet pad man e, memaggalang se duhi.

entries.summary: kinamariyuan; diriyui

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The furthest (or farthest) place or thing is the most far away.

entries.summary: keuremè; pangitabù ne egginguma; Egkahamit seini ke eglalahen ta ka minsan hentew wey ke minsan nekey ne due nateil ne katenged te egginguma pad ne timpu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The_future is the period of time after now.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't know what life will be like in the future.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena a egpakataha ke mamenu ka umul keuremè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A future event is something that will happen in the time after now.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: So what are your future plans?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She asked me to help with future meetings.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini ke eglalahen ta ka minsan hentew wey ke minsan nekey ne due nateil ne katenged te egginguma pad ne timpu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use future to describe someone or something that will have a particular role in the future (but doesn't have it yet).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I am a new teacher, and I hope that I can help my future students.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Iyam a ne talagpanulù, wey eglaum a ne egpakabulig a te egginguma pad ne me istudyanti ku.

entries.summary: egpakaangey; egpakaangey te masalig wey ke dakel pad; pegpakaangey te karakelan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you gain something that you didn't have before, you get it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He gained a lot of skills when he worked at the Barangay.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakaangey sikandin te dakel ne katuenan te pegtrabahu rin te Barangay.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He gained many new friends when he moved to a new town.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I gained a lot from the free classes.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakaangey te masalig wey ke dakel pad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you gain something that you have already (e.g., weight), you get more of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The bus gained speed as it went down the mountain.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migmeiyal pad ka terak te pegpatupang e te bubungan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The baby gained 1 kilogram in her first month.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of something becoming bigger.

fields.label: English example

entries.summary: galew; mahintalunan ne mananap

fields.text: an activity or sport with rules, which people play for enjoyment (e.g., football, chess, parlor games).

fields.label: English explanation

entries.summary: gardin; pamulaan; egtrabahu diyè te gardin

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a small area where people grow food or flowers. It is usually near a house.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you garden, you work in a garden.

fields.text: equipment; the things that you need to do a particular thing.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is_geared to a particular group or purpose, it is made so that it fits that group or purpose.

fields.text: This book is geared to children, not adults.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation

entries.summary: lukes wey malitan (ne etew) wey ke lukes wey beyan (ne ayam)

entries.summary: kamalehetan te langun; malehet te langun ne timpu wey keyimtang; labet ka langun-langun kenè ne sabeka rè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something general is true for most or all of the members of a group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In our village there is a general feeling that we need a high school.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kamalehetan te langun ne suman-suman ney diyè te bariyu ney egkeilangan key te hayiskul.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: malehet te langun ne timpu wey keyimtang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something general is true most of the time, and in most situations.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: As a general rule, you should try to arrive home before dark.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: labet ka langun-langun kenè ne sabeka rè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something general includes many things, and does not focus on just one thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Some doctors practice general medicine, while others focus on a particular problem.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè eg-apil te duma wey ke te kasuluhan ne me kanengnengan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something general does not include a lot of information or detail.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't really know how to use that machine, because he only gave me very general instructions.

entries.summary: egpekeyimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing generates another thing, it produces that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you rub two pieces of wood together, it generates heat.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke egpeglakulas ka te daruwa ne tempug te kayu, egpekeyimu seini te meinit.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You can use wind to generate electricity.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The radio advertisements generated a lot of interest in the movie.

entries.summary: langun ne me etew ne nekeg-iling-iling se kabuyahan; klasiyan te kabuyahan; pegpekeyimu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: langun ne me etew ne nekeg-iling-iling se kabuyahan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: all of the people who are a similar age.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That kind of music is popular with the younger generation.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sika ne klasiyan te ulahingen mabantug te kuntee ne me batè pad ne kabuhalan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: One step in the cycle of people growing up and having children. In humans, one step is about 30 years.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We have three generations living in our house: my grandmother, my parents and me.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due tatelu ne klasiyan te kabuyahan ne nangugpè te baley ney: ka inè te apu ku, ka amey wey iney ku, wey sikeddì.

entries.summary: matumpis
kenè ne me Hudiyu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who is not a Jew.

entries.summary: buutan; kenè egkeupian ne egpakapasakit te senge etew; malumaney (te kalamag); meyimulung (te samsam); kabaluan (te labuntud)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: buutan; kenè egkeupian ne egpakapasakit te senge etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A gentle person is kind and does not want to hurt people.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: malumaney (te kalamag); meyimulung (te samsam); kabaluan (te labuntud)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is gentle, it is not very strong or very much (e.g., a gentle wind, a gentle hill, a gentle touch).

entries.summary: egpakakuwa; egpakarawat; eg-angey; egkuen; egkeyimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you get something, you receive it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I got a present for my birthday.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakakuwa a te dasag te aldew ne neetawan ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you get something, you go to a place and take the thing from there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Can you please get my cup? It's on the table.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She stopped swimming because she got cold.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migsanggel e sikandin su egkaagsil [egka͡agsil] e sikandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you get someone to do something, or get something done, you ask or cause someone to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I got my daughter to help me.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpabulig a te anak kun malitan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I got my motorbike fixed yesterday.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impeupianan ku ka mutur ku gabii.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you get to a place, you travel there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Q: How will you get there? A: By motorbike.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Q: Egmemenu kaa ka eggendiyè? A:Egmumutur a.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you get public transport, you use that transport to go somewhere.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I got a bus to Davao.

entries.summary: dasag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you give to someone.

entries.summary: malitan (kenè pad ne buyag); beyi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a female human who is not yet an adult

entries.summary: egtaruwey; egbehey; egpakabehey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you give something to someone, or give someone something, you use your hand to pass it to them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She gave me the cup of coffee.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She gave the cup of coffee to me.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you give something to someone, or give someone something, you cause them to have it, and they don't need to pay for it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I didn't sell the bike to her, I gave it to her as a gift.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Thank you for giving your time to care for me at the hospital.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She gives a lot of time to her friends.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something gives you something, it causes you to have it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The sunny weather gives me a chance to work on my garden.

fields.text: You use global to talk about something related to the whole world (e.g., a global financial problem).

fields.text: You use global to talk about the whole of something, with all the parts included.

fields.label: English example

fields.label: Matigsalug translation

fields.text: something which people make (e.g., out of wood), which represents a spirit that they worship.

fields.text: If someone or something is gone, they are not there in that place anymore.

fields.text: I think this is a good job for me, because it fits my personality.

fields.text: This is good chance for you to speak to her.

fields.text: Ka timpu ka egpakabeye-beyè te me himuwen ta. Ke eg-uran, egpakabalew-balew ki te pamaahi ta.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone governs a place, they are the leader who controls that place.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the group of politicians who control a particular country or area.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of governing a place

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Many people appreciate his good government of the Barangay.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the political leader who controls a particular area

fields.text: a short prayer before a meal thanking God for the food.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is a good dancer because she is graceful.

fields.text: If someone is gracious, they are very kind and good.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She was gracious to me, and shared her lunch.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne buutan sikandin keddì, wey intuhen a nikandin te paniudtu rin.

fields.text: maluwan, meupiya wey mahal (meyitenged te minsan nekey)

fields.text: If something such as a house is gracious, it is very comfortable, beautiful and expensive.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you grade something, you decide how good it is compared with other things.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbehey te eleg ne naangey ne karakelan wey ke kamenu keupiya ka himu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a teacher grades students, she checks their work and writes a number or letter to show how good it is.

fields.text: the result that you get in a test or a project.

fields.text: She got a high grade in her test.

fields.label: English explanation

entries.summary: pahanad-ganad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as movement or change is gradual, it happens slowly.

fields.text: If a person with power grants you something, they formally give it to you, maybe because you asked for it.

fields.label: English example

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an amount of money that an organization gives to a person or group to use for a particular thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The farmers received a grant from the government to buy seed.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you grant that something is true, you say that it is true, even though you may not want to.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation

fields.text: past and past participle of grind

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A ground material (e.g., corn, fish) is in small pieces, because it has been crushed between two hard things.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the small particles of something (e.g., coffee, coconut) in a liquid.

entries.summary: punduk; grupu; egpunduk

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a number of people or things together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a member of a mountain climbing group that meets every month.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you group people or things, you arrange them into groups.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The teacher grouped us into teams of three.

entries.summary: egdakel; egtubù; egtubù; egpatulin te pinamula

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something grows, they become bigger.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If plants grow in a particular place, they are there in that place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A lot of good grass grows around our well.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you grow plants, you care for them and help them to become bigger.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It was getting late, and she was growing tired.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We've been excited about the growth of our business. Now we hire three workers.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was a thick growth of weeds in the garden.

entries.summary: egsaad; egpasalig; egpakabehey te pegpalintutuu; egpasalig te pegbulig ke due prublima (meyitenged te kumpanya); eggerentiya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you guarantee that something will happen, you promise that it will certainly happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I guarantee that you will enjoy your time there.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egsaad a te egkahalè ka te peg-uugpè nu diyè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is a guarantee of another thing, it causes you to be sure about the other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Rain is a guarantee that it will be muddy.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka uran ka egpakabehey te pegpalintutuu ta ne due basak.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpasalig te pegbulig ke due prublima (meyitenged te kumpanya); eggerentiya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a company guarantees something that they make, they promise that they will help you if there are problems with it (e.g., they promise to fix it, or give you a new one).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sinulat ne puun te kumpanya ne egkahi te egbulig ke due igkasahukul wey ke prublima te butang ne imbeli nu puun te kumpanya; gerentiya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a piece of writing from a company saying that they will help you if you have any problems with something that you buy from them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This cellphone has a 6 month guarantee.

entries.summary: Eggeram egpasanggel te minsan nekey ne mareet ne egkeyitabù te minsan hentew wey ke minsan nekey.; egbantey te minsan hentew eyew kenè egpakapallahuy; talagbantey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Eggeram egpasanggel te minsan nekey ne mareet ne egkeyitabù te minsan hentew wey ke minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you guard something or someone, you try to stop anything bad happening to them.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbantey te minsan hentew eyew kenè egpakapallahuy

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you guard a person, you stand near them so that they will not run away.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who stands somewhere to stop bad things happening to a place or person, or to make sure that a person does not run away.

entries.summary: agseb
mahaliyug; bisita

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who is just visiting a home or place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There were many guests staying at the hotel.

entries.summary: due salè; nakasalè; mareet ne eggeramen puun te nekeyimu ka te kenè ne meupiya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that you have done a bad thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He admitted guilt for the crime.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-angken din ne due salè din te krimin.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mareet ne eggeramen puun te nekeyimu ka te kenè ne meupiya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the bad feeling you have because you did a bad thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has a lot of guilt because he caused an accident.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due dakel ne eggeramen din ne mareet su sikandin ka aliddanan te aksidinti.

entries.summary: nakasalè; mareet se eggeramen puun te nekeyimu te mareet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are guilty of doing something bad, you did that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is guilty of stealing the money.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakasalè sikandin te pegpanakew te seleppì.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mareet se eggeramen puun te nekeyimu te mareet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you feel guilty, you feel bad because you did a bad thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I feel guilty, because I forgot my friend's birthday.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mareet ka eggeramen ku, su nalingew a te aldew ne neetawan te alukuy ku.

entries.summary: sinapang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a metal weapon with a long round part which is used for shooting.

entries.summary: duen e; Egkahamit seini ke eglalag ki te weil ne neimpusan e te ware pad duma ne weil ne miglihad.; Egkahamit seini ke eglalag ki te weil ne migbunsud te miglihad e ne timpu, wey pabulus pad taman te duma ne timpu ne miglihad.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I had a dog but it died.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Duen e asu ku piru migpatey.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini ke eglalag ki te weil ne neimpusan e te ware pad duma ne weil ne miglihad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you had done something, you did it before another event in the past (had + PAST PARTICIPLE = past perfect tense).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was not hungry because I had already eaten dinner.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Wara ad gutasi su nekeimpus ad miglabung.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini ke eglalag ki te weil ne migbunsud te miglihad e ne timpu, wey pabulus pad taman te duma ne timpu ne miglihad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you had_been doing something, you started before another time in the past and continued until that time (had + been + VERB-ing = past perfect progressive tense).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When my friends arrived, I had been waiting for 30 minutes.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te miggingume e ka me alukuy ku, nakatetahad ad te tatelu ne pulù ne minutu.

entries.summary: bulbul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one or many of the thin fibers which grow from the skin of animals or the head of humans

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I found a hair in my rice.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakakita a te bulbul diyè te keenen ku.

entries.summary: tengè; katengè; naru-ruwa wey duwa-ruwa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one of two equal parts when you divide something into two

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She ate half the pineapple, and gave the other half to her sister.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: In-keen din ka tengè te pinya, wey imbehey rin ka katengè te suled din ne malitan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Half of the group said 'yes', and half said 'no'.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use half to say that something is partly the case, but not fully the case.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He invited them to join him, but he half hoped that they would say no.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migginggat din sikandan ne egsabeka ran dè, piru mignaruwa-ruwa sikandin ne egkene-kenè sikandan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He gave me a half smile, but I could see that he was not happy.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ku egkatahaan [egkataha͡an] ke nahalè naa sikandin, su duwa-ruwa ka pengisi rin keddì.

entries.summary: libulungan ne baley; malayat ne bayaanan ne paseled diyè te baley

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large room or building for public events.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We had the singing contest in the hall.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due kuntis te ulahingen diyè te libulunganan ne baley.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: malayat ne bayaanan ne paseled diyè te baley

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In a large house, a hall or hallway is a long room which you pass through to enter other rooms.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She walked along the hall and opened the door to her room.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggipanew sikandin diyè te bayaanan ne paseled te baley wey miglukatan din ka gemawan te sinabeng din.

entries.summary: buntuk; dunsul
belad; egtaruwey; etew ne egtrabahu pinaahi te belad wey talagbulig

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the part of your body at the end of your arm, used for holding things and for many other actions.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you hand something to someone, you give it to them using your hand.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Could you just hand me my cup, please?

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: etew ne egtrabahu pinaahi te belad wey talagbulig

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who helps with physical work in a place (e.g., a farmhand).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use hand to say that someone causes something to happen, or helps it to happen (have_a_hand_in doing something).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She had a hand in planning the surprise party.

fields.label: Subentry
fields.text: on the one hand...on the other hand

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use on_the_one_hand and on_the_other_hand to talk about two sides of an argument or situation.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: On the one hand, I love sugar, but on the other hand, I know that it is not good for my teeth.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te lein ne baad, egkeupian a te sukal, piru te lein ne baad, nakataha a ne seini egpakarereet te me ngipen ku.

entries.summary: panyù
gen-genanan; pakkew; eggen-gen; egsamsam; egbeye-beyè wey eggimu te nateil ne himuwen wey ke kasangkapan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the handle of something such as a cup or door is the thing which you hold when you use it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The door handle is broken so it's hard to shut the door.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you handle something, you touch or hold it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Don't handle the bananas too much, or they will become black.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbeye-beyè wey eggimu te nateil ne himuwen wey ke kasangkapan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you handle a particular thing or activity, you control it and do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: At our farm, I handle the baby plants and my father handles the larger ones.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggimu te peggusey wey ke pegbulig te nateil ne sitwasyun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you handle a particular situation or problem, you do things to fix that problem or help the situation.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: How did you handle the problem with your pigs? What did you do?

entries.summary: sinulat

impamitey; nabitey; egbitin; egsanggat; egsampey; egbitey; egbitayen (meyitenged te peggimatey te etew ne due salè te balaud), pinaahi te peggiket te lubid diyè te lieg ne kenè egpekeuma te tanè ke me paa.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something hangs somewhere, it is connected to something high, so that it isn't touching the ground.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The clothes are hanging on the fence.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me kumbalè impamitey diyè te alad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you hang something somewhere, you attach part of it to something high, so that it is not touching the ground.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She hung the clothes on the fence.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbitayen (meyitenged te peggimatey te etew ne due salè te balaud), pinaahi te peggiket te lubid diyè te lieg ne kenè egpekeuma te tanè ke me paa.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone hangs a person, they kill that person by putting a rope around their neck and attaching the rope high so that the person's feet do not touch the ground. In some countries, this is a punishment for crime.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In some countries, criminals are hanged (by the government).

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Diyè te duma ne nasud, egbitayen ka me talagbunù (te gubirnu).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egluhè (pinaahi te peggiket te lubid diyè te lieg)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone hangs themself, they kill themself by putting a rope around their neck and attaching the rope high.

fields.label: Paradigm form
fields.text: hung [hang], hung (for senses 1 and 2); hanged [hængd] , hanged (for senses 3 and 4).

entries.summary: egkeyitabù; egkeukulan

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't know what happened; The tree just suddenly fell over.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Wara a nakataha te neyitabù; sahuhunè dè ne napeled ka kayu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use happen to say that something is by chance, and is not planned.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I happened to meet him on the way to the shops.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Neukulan ne nasinug-ung ku sikandin te dalan peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te tindaan [tinda͡an].

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I happened to hear the news while I was at the shops.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Neukulan ne diya a te tindaan te nakarineg ku ka balita.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It happens that I know your friend too.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeukulan ne egkeila ku degma ka alukuy nu.

entries.summary: nahalè; due kahalaan; warè prublima te peggimu te himu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are happy, you have good feelings.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a time or a relationship is happy, it causes you to have good feelings.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We had a very happy day at the river.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: warè prublima te peggimu te himu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are happy to do something, you feel no problem about doing it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm happy to help if you have a problem.

entries.summary: makehal; malised; mangune-kunè ne peggimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is hard, it does not change shape at all when you press it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The glass broke on the hard concrete floor.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is hard, it is difficult to understand, do or live with.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That's a very hard question and I don't know the answer.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amanan malised sika ne insè wey wara a nakataha te tabak.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It was hard to lift the heavy sack.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Their life is very hard in that sitio.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you do something hard, you use a lot of energy to do it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtrabahu ki te mangune-kunè te seini ne kaseleman.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She thought hard and finally remembered the answer.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She studied hard for her exam.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They listened hard, and finally heard the soft sound.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She hit the table hard with her hand.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a hard action (e.g., hard work, hard thinking, hard study), uses a lot of energy.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm not afraid of hard work.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena a egkaaldek te mangune-kunè ne trabahu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A hard person is not kind to other people.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a hard man, and he will not help them.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mareet se batasan din ne etew, wey kenè egbulig sikandin kandan.

entries.summary: halus; hapit

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use hardly to say that something is almost not the case.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I could hardly see anything because of the heavy rain.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ku halus egkakita ka minsan nekey tenged te dakel ne uran.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can hardly talk because I have a very sore throat.

entries.summary: umeen
kalù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which you wear on your head. It is usually has a special shape.

entries.summary: egkeepes; pegkeepes

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you hate someone or something you have a very strong feeling of not liking them.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling of hating someone or something.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling of hating someone or something.

entries.summary: due keykew (ne minsan nekey); me himuwenen nu ne igpeyimu nu te duma para keykew; inggimu te newun-a piru due kalabetan te kuntee

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you have something, it is yours, or it is with you at the moment.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me himuwenen nu ne igpeyimu nu te duma para keykew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you have something done, you ask someone to do it for you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I had my hair cut yesterday.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: inggimu te newun-a piru due kalabetan te kuntee

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you have done something, you did it before now, but there is some connection to now (have + PAST PARTICIPLE = present perfect tense).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have seen that movie, so I don't want to watch it again now.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakita kud sika ne salida, sika ka kenè kud igkeupii ne egliberan pad egtengtengi sika kuntee.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Neyimu ne minsan nekey te miglihad ne me aldew wey sasangan pad kuntee.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you have done something for a period of time, you started before now, and continued until now (have + PAST PARTICIPLE = present perfect tense).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have lived here for ten years, and I hope I live here for ten more years.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sapulù ne leg-un ne mig-ugpa a kayi, wey perem egpekeugpè e pad maa te sapulù pad maa ne katuihan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Neyimu ne minsan nekey te miglihad ne me aldew wey sasangan pad kuntee.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you have_been doing something, you started before and continued until now (have + been + VERB-ing = present perfect progressive tense).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have been living here for two years.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kayi ad e mig-ugpè seled te daruwa ne leg-un.

entries.summary: sikandin; nikandin; din; rin (igsubal te ngaran te lukes)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sikandin; nikandin; din; rin (igsubal te ngaran te lukes)

entries.summary: ulu; egdumaan [egduma͡an]; uluwan; egpangulu; egdumalè

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The principal is the head of a school.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you head or head_up an organization, you are the leader.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ulu te minsan nekey (iling te lansang)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the top part of something such as a nail or screw.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the front of a line of people or things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She waited in line for hours until finally she was at the head of the line.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggendiyè egpabulus te nateil ne eggendiyaan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you head to a place or head for a place, you go in the direction of that place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's getting late, so it's time to head to bed.

entries.summary: masakit ne ulu.
sangkad
peglelawa; peglelawa ne manekal-nekal wey meupiya; meupiya se peglalawa wey ke tubù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The health of a person or animal is how strong and good their body is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He doesn't get sick often, but his sister has bad health.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè malasi sikandin egderalu, piru ka atebey rin dilikadu se peglelawa.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that your body is good and strong.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Health is a very good thing.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka meupiya ne peglelawa amana ne meupiya.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: meupiya se peglalawa wey ke tubù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A healthy person, animal or plant has a strong, good body.

entries.summary: egpakarineg; pegpakarineg

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you hear words or a sound, you know about it through your ears.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I heard that you are planning to sell your horse.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakarineg a ne igbebentan nu igbelegyè ka kuddè nu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can't hear very well at the moment, because I have an ear infection.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My grandmother has almost lost her hearing, so it's difficult to speak with her.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of hear

entries.summary: pusung; pusung (baad te lawa ta ne egpuunan te eggeramen wey geyinawa ta); taliwarè te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the part of a person or animal which pumps blood around the body

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pusung (baad te lawa ta ne egpuunan te eggeramen wey geyinawa ta)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the part of the body where emotions come from (people say), especially emotions such as love and kindness

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The sad story touched their hearts.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka makalelangè ne guhuren nakatandug te pusung ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the centre of something (e.g., a cabbage, a city).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The hospital is in the heart of the city.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pinakakeilangan ne baad te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the most important part of something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The heart of the problem is that there is not enough water there.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a shape with a pointed bottom, and two round parts at the top.

entries.summary: meinit; egpameinit

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't like the heat in Davao.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The heat from the fire will warm the house.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you heat something, you cause it to become hot.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She heated the water in a pot on the fire.

entries.summary: langit; due kalabetan te langit; malayen; aw-awangan
mabehat; dakel; gehetengi wey keilangan te dakel ne pegsuman-suman

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is heavy, it weighs a lot, so it is difficult to carry or push.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is heavy, there is a lot of it, or it is very strong (e.g., heavy rain, heavy bleeding, heavy traffic).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: gehetengi wey keilangan te dakel ne pegsuman-suman

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something in art or literature is heavy, it is serious and you need to think about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His movies are very heavy, because they are about social problems.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me salida rin amana ne gehetengi wey keilangan te dakel ne pegsuman-suman, su meyitenged seini te prublima te kasuluhan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pangimuwanan te kasangkapan ne eggamit te putew wey egpangimu te derakel wey mabbehat ne kasangkapan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Heavy industry involves using materials such as iron and steel, and making large, heavy things.

entries.summary: palu
katingangan; katikang; kalayat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: how far something is above the ground.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What's the height of that bird?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the measurement of a person or thing from bottom to top (how tall it is).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What is the height of that mountain?

entries.summary: etew ne egpakakuwa wey egpakapanunud te karatuan ke egpatey ka senge etew.; diyè te Bibliya, iyan ka egpakarawat te me butang ne insaad

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: etew ne egpakakuwa wey egpakapanunud te karatuan ke egpatey ka senge etew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: someone who will receive the money and other things of another person when that person dies.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: diyè te Bibliya, iyan ka egpakarawat te me butang ne insaad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In the Bible, an heir of a promise is the one who will receive the thing that is promised.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of hold

entries.summary: linew ne hapuy; impirnu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The lake of fire, the place of eternal punishment.

entries.summary: egbulig; pegbulig; kenè egpakabeye-beyè; kenè egpakapapeeneng-eneng; kenè egpakapeengked

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you help someone, you do something to make their task or situation easier.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Please help me carry this sack.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Bulihi e pa ubag te egtiang te seini se saku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The things that you do to help someone.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè egpakabeye-beyè; kenè egpakapapeeneng-eneng; kenè egpakapeengked

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you can't_help something, or can't_help doing something, you can't control it or stop it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can't help it if you always forget your key.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena a egpakapasanggel kuna ke layun nu egkalingawi ka yabi nu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can't help hearing their conversations because their house is next to mine.

entries.summary: sikan naa; pad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use hence to say that one thing happens or is true because of another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The room was very crowded and hence hot and uncomfortable.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sinabeng amane e ne napenù sikan naa ke meinit wey kenè ne maluwan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something willl happen a certain period of time hence, it will happen at that time in the future. (used in formal language).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Many years hence, I'm sure we'll still remember this trip to Cebu.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
