fields.text: Masalig pad ne tuig, nakasiguru a ne egkasuman-suman te pad seini se hipanew ta te Sibu.

entries.summary: sikandin; kandin; din; rin (meyitenged te malitan); kandin; din; rin (meyitenged te malitan)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sikandin; kandin; din; rin (meyitenged te malitan)

entries.summary: kayi; dini

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: this place, the place where you are

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have lived here in Bukidnon for five years.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekeugpa a kayi te Bukidnun te me lalimma ne tuig.

entries.summary: eggeles; eggeheles; egpakaringding; egpakabunbun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you hide from someone, you stay somewhere so that they can't find you.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you hide something somewhere, you put it in a place where people can't find it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing hides a second thing, it covers that second thing so that you can't see it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her hat hid her hair, so that I couldn't see it at all.

entries.summary: nakaampew; matikang; katikang; katikangan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a bird is high, it is far above the ground.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Can you see that bird high above us?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something high has a large measurement from bottom to top (e.g., a high mountain).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use high to give the measurement from the bottom to the top of something, or from the ground to something in the air.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka katikang te tikeba su sapulù ne mitrus.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The airplane is about 2000m high now.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka katikangan te eriplanu su daruwe e ne libu kuntee.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kekesehi, nenekali (meyitenged te kakeseg); lalantusi (meyitenged te kariyuan te pegdegpak); iiniti (meyitenged te keinit aldew); deralemi (meyitenged te karalem te weyig)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something that you can measure is high, the measurement or level is large, or larger than usual (e.g., temperature, speed, water level).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They drove at a high speed along the highway.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A high position in a company or society is an important one.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The manager has the highest position in the company.

entries.summary: labuntud

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a piece of ground which is higher than the ground around it.

entries.summary: sikandin; kandin; din; rin (meyitenged te lukes)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sikandin; kandin; din; rin (meyitenged te lukes)

entries.summary: kandin; din; rin (meyitenged te lukes)
impurtanti ne neula-ula diyè te guhuren

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: impurtanti ne neula-ula diyè te guhuren

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is historic, it is or will be important in history.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The EDSA revolution was a historic event for our country.

entries.summary: due kalabetan te me panguhuren

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He found a lot of historical documents at the museum.

entries.summary: guhuren (meyitenged te nanlihad e); ka pegnengneng meyitenged te nanlihad e ne neula-ula

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the things that happened in the past of a particular place or person.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't know much about that man's history; he just arrived in our village last week.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our village has a very interesting history.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka bariyu ney due guhuren ne makabebagget.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka pegnengneng meyitenged te nanlihad e ne neula-ula

entries.summary: egsumbag; eglampes; egpakasangkub; egpakabundul; pegpakasangkub; pegpakabundul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you hit someone or something, you touch them strongly and quickly with your hand or fist, or with something such as a stick.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He hit the dog with a stick.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miglampesan din ka asu te tuked.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing hits another thing it touches it strongly and quickly.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action of one thing hitting another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The dog suffered a direct hit from the motorbike.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka asu nalasey te duritsu ne pegkabundul te mutur.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something bad hits a person, place or thing, that person, place or thing experiences the bad thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A bad typhoon hit Manila last year.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka bagyu migpasalerep te Menila te miglihad ne tuig.

entries.summary: eggen-gen; egsapipi; egkatahuan; egpakahen-gen; egkaseleran; egpekeeleg; warad egdereetan; warad egbuangan; warad egpesaan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you hold something, you keep it in your hands or arms.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Could you please hold my cup for me while I open the door?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something holds another thing, you can put that other thing on it or in it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That small strap won't hold your heavy bag, it will break.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sika ne hiket kenè egpekeeleg te baag [ba͡ag] nu, egkabugtus sika.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini ne butilya egkatahuan te lalimma ne gatus ne miligram ne weyig.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini ne sinabeng egkaseleran te mahatus ne etew.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: warad egdereetan; warad egbuangan; warad egpesaan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something holds, it doesn't break.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I repaired the pipe with rubber, and it is holding.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The peace treaty between the groups has held for two months.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something has a hold over you, they control you in some way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Unfortunately drugs have gained a hold over him.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggen-gen (meyitenged te katenged wey ke himu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you hold a particular position or job, that is your position or job.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She has held the position of committee secretary for three years.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggen-gen sikandin te katenged ne kumiti te sikritari te tatelu ne tuig.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you hold an event such as a meeting, you organize or host the event.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The Olympic Games are held every four years.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka Olimpik ne Galew egkeyitabù te tagsè hep-at ne tuig dè.

entries.summary: lungag; butbut

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a space in the ground which is empty because a person or animal moved the dirt out of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A well is a hole in the ground.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an open part in or through something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a hole in my shirt.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The coconut made a hole in the roof.

entries.summary: matulus (meyitenged te malinis, warè salè); matulus (due kalabetan te Manama); balaan; 1, 2 pegkamatulus; 2 pegkabalaan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is holy, it is related to God.

entries.summary: Panisingan te Manama; Ispiritu Santu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the Spirit of God, the third member of the Trinity (Father, Son and Holy Spirit).

entries.summary: ugpaan; baley; inged; uyahanan (meyitenged te nateil ne ugpaanan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the country or area where you live or where you feel that you belong.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Sinuda is home for me, because I grew up here.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a place where a particular group of people (e.g., children) live and are cared for.

entries.summary: kamalehetan
bansa; eg-addat; egbassa; peg-addat ne eleg te katenged te minsan hentew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a personal quality of always doing what you believe is right.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a man of honor, so he will not lie to you.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Etew sikandin ne due bansa, sika ka kenè eg-uubat sikandin keykew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you honor someone, you are polite and respectful because of their age or position.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He honors his mother by doing what she tells him.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egbassaan [egbassa͡an] din ka iney rin te pegpalintutuu ke nekey ka igsuhù kandin.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peg-addat ne eleg te katenged te minsan hentew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: politeness and respect to someone, because of their age or position.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He always shows honor to his mother.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Layun egpakita sikandin te peg-addat te iney rin.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakita te pegpasalamat wey ke pegsuman-suman te minsan hentew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you honor someone (e.g., Rizal), you do something publicly to thank or remember them, or to show that you think they are very good.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: On Rizal Day, we honor Dr José Rizal.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te Aldew ni Risal, egpasalamat wey egsuman-suman ki kandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was a special dinner at the Barangay Hall to honor the visitors.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: himu te pegpakita te pegpasalamat wey pegdayan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: public actions to thank or praise someone, or to show that you think they are good.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The old teacher received honor at the graduation ceremony.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka buyag ne talagpanulù nakarawat te pegpasalamat te gradwisyun.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: himu ne tineil wey amana ne keilangan ne eggeram te pegkahalè te peggimu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An honor is an action that is very special and important, so that someone feels very happy to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It would be an honor for me to carry the flag in the parade.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egdawat te minsan nekey ne egkaayun ne egkaseleppì

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a bank or shop honors something such as a cheque or credit card, they accept it as money.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The bank didn't honor his cheque, because there was no money in his account.

entries.summary: eg-iman-iman; perem; meupiya perem; eglaum; peg-iman-iman; peglaum; egpallateng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you hope that something will happen, or hope for something, you wish for it to happen. It may or may not happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I hope that it doesn't rain tomorrow.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Meupiya perem ke kenè eg-uran kaaselem.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The exam was not too difficult, so I hope I passed.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Wherever she is, I hope she is safe now.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling of wishing for something good (which may or may not happen).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She told me about her hope of going to college.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migkahiyan a nikandin meyitenged te peg-iman-iman din ne egpakakulihiyu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you hope for something that will certainly happen, you wait for it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Christians hope for the return of Jesus.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me Kristuwanen egpallateng te peglibed ni Hisus.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a good feeling because you are sure that something will happen in the future.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I miss him very much, but I know he will come next month, so I have hope.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana a naalimengawi kandin, piru nakataha a ne egginguma sikandin te seup ne bulan, sika ka eg-im-imanen ku.

entries.summary: nakabalabag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the line where the earth and sky look like they meet.

entries.summary: kuddè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large, fast animal, which people use for transport or carrying things.

entries.summary: huspital; bawianan te egmanderalu; uyananan wey bawianan te egmanderalu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a place where doctors and nurses care for people who are sick.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My brother is in hospital after his accident.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka suled ku diyè te huspital te pegkeimpus te mareet ne neyitabù kandin.

entries.summary: meinit; masakit (meyitenged te keenen iling te due dakel ne benisil ne intahù wey ke in-amut); meinit (meyitenged te guhuren)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is hot, the temperature is high.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Be careful because that pot is hot.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: masakit (meyitenged te keenen iling te due dakel ne benisil ne intahù wey ke in-amut)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Hot food is spicy (e.g., because it has a lot of chilli peppers in it).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That food has lots of chillies in it, so it is very hot.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sika ne egkakeen due dakel ne benisil ne in-amut, su sika sesakiti.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A hot topic is one that many people want to talk or argue about.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Politics is a hot topic at the moment.

entries.summary: baley ne eg-ugpaan te malepet dè ne timpu wey egbayaran

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: baley ne eg-ugpaan te malepet dè ne timpu wey egbayaran

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a place where you pay to stay for one or more nights. It often has places where you can eat.

entries.summary: uras
baley; egbehayan te egpeugpaan; egkatahuan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a building for people to live in

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you house someone, you give them a place to live.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a building or container houses people or things, the people or things stay in that place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That workroom houses all our computers.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: dakel ne baley eyew te peg-elit-elit

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large building for entertainment (e.g., a theater).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They showed the movie to a full house.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kumpanya ne due nateil ne nigusyu, wey ke lugar ne diyè egkekeen wey eg-iinum te etew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a company which has a particular business, or a place where people can eat or drink (e.g. a publishing house, a coffee house).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: grupu te talagpangimu te me balaud

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In government, a House is one of the groups which make laws (e.g., House of Representatives).

entries.summary: menuwen; immenu; menu-a (meyintenged te peg-insè ke meupiya naa ka sitwasyun wey se kenè); kamenu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use how to ask or talk about the way or method.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He showed me how to fix it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impakita rin ke immenu rin te eg-ayad-ayad.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: menu-a (meyintenged te peg-insè ke meupiya naa ka sitwasyun wey se kenè)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use how to ask if something is good or not.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use how to ask or talk about the amount or size of something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: how big, how old, how many?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: kamenu karakel, kamenu kabuyag, kamenu kasulug?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was surprised by how tall he was.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini te peglalag meyitenged te nateil ne weil wey ke sitwasyun, wey ke immenu seini ne neyitabù.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use how to talk about a particular action or situation, or the way that it happens.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I love how my puppy runs to meet me when I arrive home.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana kud iya igkeupii ka pegpallahuy te itu ku ne egsinug-ung keddì ke eggingumaad te baley.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I remember how my grandfather used to take me fishing.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: menu-a ke (ke egpeuma ka te lein ne puhawang)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use how_about when you suggest something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: How about going to Lorega tomorrow?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Menu-a ke eggendiyè ki te Lorega kaaselem?

entries.summary: piru; minsan nekey; minsan egmenuwen; minsan pad ke (egkahamit seini ke eglalag te karakelan te minsan nekey ne kenè ne impurtanti

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is old. However, he is still very strong.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Buyag e sikandin. Piru, manekal pad.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father likes dancing. My mother, however, doesn't like it much.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use however to say that the way something happens is not important.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Arrange the pictures however you want to.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Teila nu ka litratu minsan nekey ka igkeupii nu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan pad ke (egkahamit seini ke eglalag te karakelan te minsan nekey ne kenè ne impurtanti

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use however to say that the amount of something is not important.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She never needs to wear a sweater, however cool the weather is.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ne keilangan ne egsaluub sikandin te makepal ne kumbalè, minsan pad ke maagsil [ma͡agsil] ka timpu.

entries.summary: etew
mapariralem

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of hang (senses 1 and 2)

entries.summary: gutas

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the state of feeling hungry, because you need to eat.

entries.summary: eggutasan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are hungry, you feel that you need to eat something.

entries.summary: panitingen
makeseg ne uran ne due balisusu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: makeseg ne uran ne due balisusu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a kind of tropical storm with very strong winds and rain.

entries.summary: eg-agpas

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you hurry, you move or do something quickly.

entries.summary: nasakitan
asawa ne lukes

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the man to whom a woman is married

entries.summary: puhawang; suman-suman; eggimu te puhawang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an idea about how something happened, or how something works. You are not certain about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My hypothesis is that the robbers entered the building through the window.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka keddì ne puhawang ka takawen migseled te baley ne sika migbayè te bintanà.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you hypothesize, you make a hypothesis.

entries.summary: a; sikeddì; sikeddiey; ku; siak; siaken

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: a; sikeddì; sikeddiey; ku; siak; siaken

entries.summary: migkehal ne weyig
puhawang; suman-suman; paahi; eg-umeen ne igkeupii; tuyù; suman-suman (meyitenged igkeupii ne eleg ne egkeyitabù)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something in your mind that comes from thinking (have_an_idea).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have an idea: we can use my bike to carry the bags.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The idea of collecting our own firewood is to save money.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka tuyù te pegpamunpun te igtemeg ne kayu iyan ka peglimud te seleppì.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our idea is to leave early tomorrow, so that we will arrive before dark.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: suman-suman (meyitenged igkeupii ne eleg ne egkeyitabù)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your idea of something is what you think it is or should be.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My idea of cleaning is different from my sister's, so our houses are very different.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka suman-suman ku te egpanlinis su lein te atebey ku, su ka me baley ney amana ne nekeglein.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kanengnenganan wey ke katuenan ne deisek dè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you have an idea of something, you know a little about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have an idea of how to play the guitar, but I am not good at all.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due katuenan ku ke egmenuwen te egpanggitar, piru kena a amana egkateu te egkateu langun.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have no idea how to fix a water pipe.

entries.summary: pinakameupiya; pamaahi meyitenged te minsan nekey ne eleg perem te kalibutan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is ideal, it is perfect, or the best possible thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Teaching is my ideal job: I love every part of it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegpanulù ka pinakameupiyan trabahu para keddì: igkeupii ku ka langun ne baad kayi.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pamaahi meyitenged te minsan nekey ne eleg perem te kalibutan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an idea about what something should be like in a perfect world.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My ideal is that everyone is honest, but it's not true.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka eleg perem para keddiey su ka tagsè sabeka kenè ne ubaten, piru kenè seini ne malehet.

entries.summary: nekeg-iling

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two things are identical, they are exactly the same as each other.

entries.summary: 1 pegpangilala; 2 pegpeila; 3 pegnengneng; pegpamitew; 4 pegpekeila; kalig-enan; katahaanan [kataha͡anan]

fields.label: English example
fields.text: One of the jobs of a zoologist is the identification of new species.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a document which says who you are (e.g. an ID card).

entries.summary: egpangilaleen; egkeila; egpeila; egpataha; egnengneng; egpamitew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you identify someone or something, you know or say who or what they are.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I know most of these plants, but I can't identify this one.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nateu a te langun ne me pinamula, piru kenè ku egkeila ka seini.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something identifies a person or thing, it shows other people who or what they are.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His clothes identify him as a soldier.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kumbalè din egpeila ne sikandin sundalu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you identify something that you didn't know or see before, you find it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Police are trying to identify the cause of death.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me pulis miggeram te egnengneng te aliddanan te kamatayen.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you identify one person or thing with another person or thing, you feel that they are similar, or have a connection.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Many people identify the color white with weddings.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Masalig ne me etew ne egpekeila ne ka batek ne maangkag para te kasal.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakasabut puun te nekeg-iling ka imbayè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you identify_with someone, you understand their feelings or experience, because you have a similar experience.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can identify with children who have no parents, because my parents died when I was young.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpakasabut a te me batè ne me ilu, su neilu a te deisek e pad.

entries.summary: palinneu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your identity is who you are.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't know the identity of the man who took my horse.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Wara a nakataha te palinneu te etew ne migtakew te kuddè ku.

entries.summary: panunggilingan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of words with a special meaning that is different from what you expect.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: hairy hands [means robber like a hairy hands of monkey]

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: bulbulen se belad [takawen iling te ubal]

entries.summary: ke (meyitenged te minsan nekey ne kenè ne klaru wey ke malehet); ke (insè ne uya wey kenè ka tabak); perem ke; emun perem ke

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ke (meyitenged te minsan nekey ne kenè ne klaru wey ke malehet)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use if to talk about something that is not sure or not real.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Maybe I will go to Davao tomorrow. If I go, I will visit my friend.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kema ke egpekeendiyè [egpeke͡enndiyè] a te Dabaw kaaselem. Ke egpekeendiyè a, egleuy a te alukuy ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If I knew the answer, I would tell you (but I don't know the answer).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ke (insè ne uya wey kenè ka tabak)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use if to talk about questions which have a 'yes' or 'no' answer.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She asked me if I wanted to stay.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-insè sikandin keddì ke egkeupian a ne egpalunggehaat [egpalunggeha͡at].

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't know if he knows.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use if_only to talk about something now or in the past that you are not happy with, and that you wish were different.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If only I hadn't missed the bus (but I missed it).

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Emun perem ke wara a neengkeri te terak (sikan ma iya se neengkeran e ma).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If only I could play the guitar (but I can't).

entries.summary: warè nakataha te kamalehetan; warè nakataha amana; warè pegpakataha

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are ignorant of a fact, you don't know about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was ignorant of the fact that she was sick.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Wara a nakataha te migderalu bes sikandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An ignorant person doesn't know very much.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He thinks I am ignorant because I don't know the answers to his questions.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was surprised by his ignorance of the election.

entries.summary: egbalahad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you ignore someone or something, you act as if you didn't see or hear them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I said hello, but he ignored me.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migkahi a te meupiya, piru migbalahad a nikandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He ignored my advice and did what he wanted.

entries.summary: due dalu; dalu; pegpandaralu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are ill, you have something in your body that is causing a problem.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a problem which causes a person to have bad health

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can't go to the wedding because of illness.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a lot of illness in my village at the moment [It means that many people are ill].

entries.summary: eggamit te panunggilingan wey ke litratu eyew te pegbulig te pegpasabut te igpasabut.; egpasabut; egtahuan te litratu ka sinulat

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggamit te panunggilingan wey ke litratu eyew te pegbulig te pegpasabut te igpasabut.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you illustrate something that you say, you use an example or picture to help to show what you mean.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our teacher used a basketball and a tennis ball to illustrate how the moon moves around the earth.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something illustrates another thing, it shows that the other thing is true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His expensive clothes illustrate that he is rich.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka mahal ne kumbalè din egpasabut te meyaman sikandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you illustrate a piece of writing, you add pictures to it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This book is illustrated with beautiful colored pictures.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini ne libru migtahuan te meupiya wey inbatek ne me litratu.

entries.summary: panunggilingan ne egbulig egpasabut wey egpakita te kamalehetan.; litratu; 1 peggamit te panunggilingan; pegpasabut; 3 pegtahù te litratu diyè te sinulat

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: panunggilingan ne egbulig egpasabut wey egpakita te kamalehetan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an example which helps to explain something or show that something is true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We understood about the moon and the sun because of our teacher's illustration.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His speech was not boring, because he used a lot of illustrations from his own life.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a picture in a book or piece of writing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That book has beautiful colored illustrations.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sika ne libru due meupiya wey imbatek ne me litratu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 peggamit te panunggilingan; pegpasabut; 3 pegtahù te litratu diyè te sinulat

entries.summary: alung wey ke litratu; alung ne egpakatahù te suman-suman; ula-ula wey puhawang diyè te etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a picture of somebody or something on a screen or in a mirror.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She looked at the images on the TV screen.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtengteng sikandin te alung diyè te tibi.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I had an image of the old house in my mind, because I remembered it from when I was a child.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpakatahù pad te suman-suman ku ka daan ne baley ney, uya su egkasuman-suman ku pad seini puun te malintek e pad.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ula-ula wey puhawang diyè te etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The image of a person or organization is the picture and idea that other people have about them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That actor always wears crazy sunglasses; it's part of his image.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We wear a uniform at work to give us a more professional image.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: someone or something that looks very similar to another person or thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is the image of her mother.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sikandin ka nekeiling te ula-ula te iney rin.

entries.summary: egsuman-suman; egpakasuman-suman te pangitabù piru kenè ne malehet; egsumsumanen ne egkamalehet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you imagine something, you make a picture of it in your mind.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Try to imagine him with no hair.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sumsumana nu ne warè bulbul din.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakasuman-suman te pangitabù piru kenè ne malehet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you imagined something, you thought that it happened, but actually it didn't.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I thought I heard voices, but there is nobody there, so maybe I only imagined it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Hendue te nakarineg a te me laheng, piru warè minsan hentew diyè, su kema ke nasuman-suman ku rè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you imagine that something is the case or will happen, you think that it is probably the case or will probably happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I imagine that they will need dinner when they arrive.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egsuman-suman a ne egkeilangan sikandan te iglabung ke egpekeyinguma ran.

entries.summary: eg-iling
mig-iling

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use imitation to talk about something which is a copy of a real thing (e.g., imitation leather).

entries.summary: sahuhunè; taltalaanak (iling te amey wey iney nu, wey ka me kakey wey hari nu); sahuhunè ne egkeyitabù impus te newun-a

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an action is immediate, it happens just after another action.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He sent an immediate answer to my text message.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sahuhunè ne migpeuyan sikandin te tabak te tiks ku kandin.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: taltalaanak (iling te amey wey iney nu, wey ka me kakey wey hari nu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your immediate family are your parents, brothers and sisters (not your cousins, uncles or other relatives).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I could only have 4 visitors for my graduation, so just my immediate family came: my parents and my two brothers.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Duen dè hep-at ubag ne bisita ku te graduwisyun ku, ka sikanami rè iya ubag se taltalaanak: ka me ginikanan ku wey ka daruwa ne suled ku.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sahuhunè ne egkeyitabù impus te newun-a

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happens immediately after another thing, it happens just after that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They went home immediately after lunch.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sahuhunè ne mig-ulì sikandin pegke-impus te paniudtu.

entries.summary: amana ne dakel
nangugpè ne etew ne puun te lein ne nasud; langyaw

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nangugpè ne etew ne puun te lein ne nasud; langyaw

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who comes to a foreign country to live.

entries.summary: eggalin eg-ugpè te lein ne nasud; eglangyaw; peggalin peg-ugpè diyè te lein ne nasud; peglangyaw

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggalin eg-ugpè te lein ne nasud; eglangyaw

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you immigrate, you come to a foreign country to live.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A lot of Chinese immigrate here to the Philippines for business.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kasuluhan te me Insik miglangyaw kayi te Pilipinas eyew te pegpamelegyè.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peggalin peg-ugpè diyè te lein ne nasud; peglangyaw

entries.summary: kakeseg te sabeka ne butang ne egpakasuhat diyè te lein ne butang.; igkabehey wey egkalibed ne eggeramen ne egpakabalew-balew puun te minsan nekey.; egpakabehey te meupiya wey ke mareet ne kapabulusan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kakeseg te sabeka ne butang ne egpakasuhat diyè te lein ne butang.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action or force of one thing hitting another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In the accident, the impact of the car caused the tree to fall down.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te aksidinti, ka kakeseg te terak ka nakapapeled te kayu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: igkabehey wey egkalibed ne eggeramen ne egpakabalew-balew puun te minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The impact of something on a person or situation is the way that it changes or affects them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That book had a big impact on me, and changed my thinking.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sika ne libru dakel ka ingkabehey keddì, wey sika ka nakapabalew-balew te suman-suman ku.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakabehey te meupiya wey ke mareet ne kapabulusan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something impacts a person or situation, it changes or affects them in some way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Your decision will impact a lot of people, so be very careful about what you decide.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka puhawang nu egpakapabalew-balew te katangenan, sika ka ayad-ayad ka te pegbehey te puhawang.

entries.summary: kasangkapan wey ke malemu ne butang ne eggamiten nu te peggimu te minsan nekey.; eggimu; egpatuman; peggimu; pegpatuman

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kasangkapan wey ke malemu ne butang ne eggamiten nu te peggimu te minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a tool or simple thing (e.g., a fork) that you use to do something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Bolos, knives and scissors are all cutting implements.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ugpit, ilab wey me gunting iyan sika me pantempug ne kasangkapan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't know the name of it, but this is an implement for removing staples.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you implement a plan or system, you do the action that you planned, or start to use the system.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We will start implementing the new rules next week.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egbunsud ki eggimu te iyam ne balaud te seup ne simana.

entries.summary: egpakita te due kalabetan te himu ne mareet

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakita te due kalabetan te himu ne mareet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If somone or something implicates you in a crime, they say or show that you were part of the crime.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The man's story implicates his wife in the crime too.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka inlalag te etew migpakita ne ka asawa rin due degma kalabetan te kasu.

entries.summary: igpasabut; kapabulusan wey ke kapangkusan te himu; egpakita ne due kalabetan nu te neyimu ne krimin

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The implication of words or actions is the meaning that they communicate.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He didn't say so directly, but his implication was that we should help him.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè din utasa te eglalag, piru ka igpasabut din ne keilangan ki ne egbulig kandin.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kapabulusan wey ke kapangkusan te himu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an implication of an action is an effect that is expected to come from it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There will be a lot of implications for your family if you choose to move to another area.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due masalig ne egkapabulusan niyu te taltalaanak ke eg-alam ka ne eggalin ugpè diyè te lein ne inged.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakita ne due kalabetan nu te neyimu ne krimin

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your implication in a crime is the fact that something shows you were part of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His implication in the robbery caused him to lose his job.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegkalabet din te pegpanakew nakapaawè kandin te trabahu.

entries.summary: kenè eglalahen egpanteka piru igpakita nu diyè te lein ne pamaahi.; egpakapeyimu keykew seini ne egsuman-suman ka ne ka duma ne butang malehet.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè eglalahen egpanteka piru igpakita nu diyè te lein ne pamaahi.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you imply that something is true, you don't say it directly, but you show that you think it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She didn't say that she wanted to stay, but she implied it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè migkahi sikandin te egkeupian din ne eg-ugpè, piru impakita rin ne egkeupian sikandin.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakapeyimu keykew seini ne egsuman-suman ka ne ka duma ne butang malehet.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something implies another thing, it causes you to think that the other thing is true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His bright eyes imply an intelligent mind.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka malayag ne mata rin ka katahaan [kataha͡an] te matagseb sikandin.

entries.summary: keilanganen; keilangan; derakel se katenged; kamenu kakeilangan; derakel se katenged

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is important, you need it or care about it a lot.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An important person has power or a high social position.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the importance of someone or something is how important they are.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Don't worry, it's not of much importance.

entries.summary: egpehes ne egpeyimu; peggimu te minsan nekey minsan kenè perem igpeyimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you impose something on someone, you force them to do or suffer that thing. If you impose your thinking on someone, you try to force them to think or behave the same way as you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The owner of the house imposed a lot of rules on the students who were living there.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kamuney te baley migpehes te pegpeyimu te masulug ne balaud te me istudyanti ne nangugpè.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The bank imposed many fees on its members.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peggimu te minsan nekey minsan kenè perem igpeyimu

entries.summary: egmeupiya; egpameupiyeen; pegkeiyam te minsan nekey ne egkeyimu ne mas meupiya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something improves, it becomes better.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The weather is very bad today, but I hope that it will improve tomorrow.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His health has improved since he started exercising

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you improve something, you cause it to become better.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She worked hard to improve her school results.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They improved their house by putting new tin on the roof.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegkeiyam te minsan nekey ne egkeyimu ne mas meupiya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a change in which something becomes better.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There has been a big improvement in his behavior this year.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a change in which you cause something to become better (make_an_improvement).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He made some improvements to his house.

entries.summary: te (meyitenged te seled wey ke tahù); te (meyitenged te lugar); sitwasyun ne sasangan ne egkeyitabù

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: te (meyitenged te seled wey ke tahù)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something is in a place, the walls or sides of the place are around them.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is in a place such as a city or a country, that is the place where they are.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are in a particular state or situation that is state or situation now.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something is in a group, they are a member of that group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is in the basketball team.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Apil sikandin te egmambubula ne grupu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happens in a particular week, month, season or year, that is when it happens.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka aldew ne neetawan ku su kayi te Iniru.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka aldew ne neetawan ku seeyè dè se Eniru.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: te (meyitenged te nateil timpu te pegkeyitabù)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is done in a particular period of time, that is the amount of time that it takes.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He finished the test in thirty minutes.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekeimpus sikandin te tis din te tatelun pulù dè ne minutus.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something will happen in a number of minutes, days, years, etc. in the future, it will happen after that number of minutes, days, years, etc.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Wait here, because he'll be home in five minutes.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Tahad ka kayi, su kayid e kuntee sikandin pegkeimpus te lalimman minutus.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a particular style is in, it is fashionable or popular.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Faded jeans are in at the moment.

entries.summary: keupianan ne egkakuwa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a good result or thing that you will receive if you do something. This causes you to want to do that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If we buy three bags, we get one free, so that is an incentive to buy.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke egbebeli ki te tatelu ne baag [ba͡ag], pakakuwa ki te sabeka ne libri, sika ka keupianan ne egkakuwa ta.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: One incentive for working hard at school is the chance to get a scholarship.

entries.summary: seked te kalayat; eggipanew ne mapahanad-ganad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you inch in a particular direction, you move that way very slowly.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We inched along the bad road.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpahanad-ganad key miggipanew diyè te mareet ne kelesadda.

entries.summary: kamenu karahayun ka mareet ne hitabù

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kamenu karahayun ka mareet ne hitabù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The incidence of something (usually something bad, such as a disease), is how often it happens or how common it is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a high incidence of TB in that area.

entries.summary: egkeyitabù

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was an incident at the crossing before: a man hit someone.

entries.summary: egpalabet; egpaapil; eglabet; eg-apil; 1 pegpalabet; pegpaapil; 2 peglabet; peg-apil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you include something in another thing, you cause it to be part of that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The organizers included merienda in the price.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Don't forget to include Pablo when you invite people to the wedding.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing includes another thing, that other thing is part of it.

entries.summary: labet; apil; egkaayun ne egseled ka minsan hentew wey ke kasangkapan egkaayun ne baad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is inclusive of another thing, that other thing is part of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The price was inclusive of merienda.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka bali labet e ka mirinda.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We will be there from the 8th to the 11th of January inclusive [this means 'including the 8th and 11th']

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkaayun ne egseled ka minsan hentew wey ke kasangkapan egkaayun ne baad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a group is inclusive, many different kinds of people or things can be part of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That club is very inclusive: anybody can be a member.

entries.summary: layun egkarawat ne seleppì; suwildu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your income is the money that you regularly get (from working or from other sources).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has a job, so he has a regular income.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due himu rin sika ka due layun suwildu rin.

entries.summary: egpaapil diyè te senge baad; eg-apil te minsan nekey; 1 pegpaapil diyè te senge baad; 2 peg-apil diyè te senge baad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you incorporate one thing into another thing, you cause it to be part of that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I incorporate a lot of vegetables into my diet.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something incorporates another thing, that other thing is part of it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka Manila mig-apil te masalig ne siyudad.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegpaapil diyè te senge baad; 2 peg-apil diyè te senge baad

entries.summary: egtulin; egdakel; egparakelen; pegtulin; pegdakel

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something increases, it becomes more.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was a lot of rain, so the level of the river increased quickly.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The price of gas has increased a lot since last month.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you increase something, you cause it to become more.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I am happy because my boss just increased my pay.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of something becoming more.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There has been an increase in the price of gas.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due pegparakel te bali te gas.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I am happy about the increase in rain, because it has been very dry.

entries.summary: iya; te pegkamalehet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use indeed to say that something is very much the case.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Q: Do you like coffee? A: I do indeed.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Q: Keupian ka te keppi? A: Uya buwa iya.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a very good swimmer indeed.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use indeed when you give more details about something, and say it more strongly.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She was tired; indeed, she was ready to lie down right there.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nabeley sikandin; te pegkamalehet, egkeupian e sikandin ne eggibat due.

entries.summary: listaan [lista͡an] te me lalag diyè te peka te libru ne egpataha ke hendei egpamitawa ka lalag wey ka uluwan.; listaan [lista͡an] te me butang iling te unag wey ke bayad ne egpakita ke pilaa ka nabalbalawan te peglihad te me timpu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: listaan [lista͡an] te me lalag diyè te peka te libru ne egpataha ke hendei egpamitawa ka lalag wey ka uluwan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a list at the back of a book which tells you where you can find words and topics in the book.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I couldn't remember which part of the book talked about Bonifacio, so I checked the index.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: listaan [lista͡an] te me butang iling te unag wey ke bayad ne egpakita ke pilaa ka nabalbalawan te peglihad te me timpu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a list of things such as prices or wages which shows how much they change over time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The Consumer Price Index shows the average prices of things.

entries.summary: egpeila; egtinurù; eglalahen ne kenè amana egkanengnengan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing indicates another thing, it shows that the other thing is true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her face indicates that she is not happy.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ula-ula rin egpeila te sikandin warè nahalè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you indicate something, you point at it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: "Those are mine," she said, indicating the eggs on the table.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: "Sika keddiey," migkahi sikandin, ne egtinurù te me atelug diyet lamisa.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you indicate that something is the case, you say it, but not always very clearly or strongly.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She didn't ask for the skirt, but she indicated that she wanted it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè mig-insè sikandin te saya, piru migkahi sikandin te egkeupian.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a measuring tool such as a thermometer indicates a measurement, it shows that measurement.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The thermometer indicates a temperature of 37 degrees.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a driver of a vehicle indicates, they use lights on the sides of the vehicle to show that they are moving right or left.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's sometimes dangerous if drivers don't indicate when they turn the corner.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that shows that another thing is true (give_an_indication).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She gave no indication that she was feeling sick.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè migpeila sikandin ne sikandin egderalu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing is indicative of another thing, it shows that the other thing may be true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her cough and thinness are indicative of TB.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka buwè din wey peggehasè din su ilaanan [ila͡anan] te dalu ne tibi.

entries.summary: ka etew wey ke butang ne egpakakuwa te binipisyu wey ke butang ne puun te weil te himu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka etew wey ke butang ne egpakakuwa te binipisyu wey ke butang ne puun te weil te himu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The indirect_object of a verb is the person or thing that gets some benefit or thing from the verb action. In English, the indirect object comes directly after the verb or after a preposition.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother bought a hat for me / My mother bought me a hat [me is the indirect object in both sentences].

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbeliyan a te iney ku te kalu / Migbeliyan a te kalu te iney ku [a ka kenè ne duritsu ne kasangkapan te daruwa ne pangasak]

entries.summary: tagsè sabeka; sabeka ne etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An individual thing is one thing which is separate from other things in the group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We did not have individual plates, and we all took food from one big plate.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè platu para te tagsè sabeka kanta, egpatuheney ki rè sika te dakel ne platu.

entries.summary: due kalabetan te pegpangimu te minsan nekey diyè te kumpanya.; due kalabetan te pegtabang te me trabaanti [traba͡anti] eyew due meupiya ne keyimtang te trabahu wey bayad.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due kalabetan te pegpangimu te minsan nekey diyè te kumpanya.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: relating to the work of making things in factories.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due kalabetan te pegtabang te me trabaanti [traba͡anti] eyew due meupiya ne keyimtang te trabahu wey bayad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: relating to the action of helping workers to have good work conditions and pay. Industrial_action includes things such as workers' strikes.

entries.summary: mabasuk
pegpangimu te masalig ne me belegyè diyè te himuwanan; klasiyan te himu (meyitenged te sabeka rè ne himu)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegpangimu te masalig ne me belegyè diyè te himuwanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: work that is connected to making things in factories

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a lot of heavy industry in that place because there are mines close by.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: klasiyan te himu (meyitenged te sabeka rè ne himu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a kind of work that is connected with one thing (e.g., the tourist industry, the entertainment industry, the banana industry).

entries.summary: Seini ne klasiyan te weil ne lalag 'malemu wey keilangan' ne klasi ne egkakita nu diye te diksyunari.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Seini ne klasiyan te weil ne lalag 'malemu wey keilangan' ne klasi ne egkakita nu diye te diksyunari.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The infinitive form of a verb is the 'basic' form which you can find in a dictionary. It is not past or present or future.

entries.summary: me litra ne egpakatahù diyè te elat te me lalag

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me litra ne egpakatahù diyè te elat te me lalag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a letter or group of letters which are added inside a word (e.g., '-in-' in 'binulalu').

entries.summary: egpakabehey te meupiya wey ke mareet ne kapabulusan; pegbalew-balew; geem [ge͡em] te pegbalew-balew ne egpakaapiktu te suman-suman te me etew.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakabehey te meupiya wey ke mareet ne kapabulusan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something influences a person or thing, it produces some result or change in them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Your diet influences your health a lot.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegkeen nu dakel ne egpakaapiktu te peglelawa nu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The weather in Luzon sometimes influences the weather here in Mindanao.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His experiences abroad really influenced his thinking.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The influence of something on another thing is the way that it changes or affects that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: TV can have a big influence on children.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka tibi due dakel pegbalew-balew te me batè.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was driving under the influence of alcohol.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: geem [ge͡em] te pegbalew-balew ne egpakaapiktu te suman-suman te me etew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your influence is your power to change or affect the thinking of other people.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Parents have a lot of influence over their children.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has a lot of influence in his town, because he his rich.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone influences you, they cause you to think a certain way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father influenced me to go abroad.

entries.summary: egpakapabalew-balew; due geem [ge͡em] te pegbalew-balew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something is influential, they cause a change or result.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His experiences at school were very influential in his development.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An influential person has a lot of power to change or affect the thinking of other people, because they are rich, famous or powerful.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is an influential businessman who has several companies.

entries.summary: egpataha

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you inform someone of something, or inform them that something is the case, you tell them that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She informed her mother of the news.

entries.summary: egpakakamuney; egpakarawat; egpakapanunud; egpakatalipun (te minsan nekey ne egkeengkeran te egpatey); egsupu; eg-iling (due egkeilingan nu diyè te ginikanan nu ne ula-ula wey ke baad te pegkeetew ran); diyè te Bibliya, egpakarawat te insaad ne saad

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakakamuney; egpakarawat; egpakapanunud; egpakatalipun (te minsan nekey ne egkeengkeran te egpatey)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you inherit something, you receive it from somebody who has died.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When my father died, I inherited his carabao.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te migpatey e ka amey ku, migpanunud ku ka kalabew rin.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egsupu; eg-iling (due egkeilingan nu diyè te ginikanan nu ne ula-ula wey ke baad te pegkeetew ran)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you inherit a characteristic (e.g. straight hair) from one of your parents, you have that characteristic because they have it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He inherited straight hair from his father.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-iling sikandin te amey rin ne matul-id se bulbul.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: diyè te Bibliya, egpakarawat te insaad ne saad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In the Bible, if you inherit a promise, you receive the things that are promised.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me butang ne egkarawat nu puun te etew ne napatey, wey ke puun te saad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the things that you inherit, from someone who died, or because of a promise.

entries.summary: egpapeeneng-eneng te hitabù wey ke eggimuwen pad ne meyimulung dè.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpapeeneng-eneng te hitabù wey ke eggimuwen pad ne meyimulung dè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something inhibits another thing, it stops that other thing from happening, or causes it to happen more slowly.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Alcohol inhibits your ability to control yourself.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We don't want to inhibit you from having a good time, but you must follow the rules.

entries.summary: pegpapeeneng-eneng te hitabù wey ke pegpeyimu pad kayi te meyimulung dè.; eggeramen ne kaaldek [ka͡aldek] wey ke keyilew ne egpasanggel te peggimu te minsan nekey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegpapeeneng-eneng te hitabù wey ke pegpeyimu pad kayi te meyimulung dè.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggeramen ne kaaldek [ka͡aldek] wey ke keyilew ne egpasanggel te peggimu te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling of fear or embarrassment that stops you from doing something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has a lot of inhibitions, so he always acts very formally.

entries.summary: bunsuranan; an-anayan; hun-a; hun-a ne litra te ngaran te etew; egsulat te hun-a ne litra te ngaran; egpirma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something initial is at the beginning.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My initial plan was to go abroad, but then I decided to stay with my family.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka hun-a ne suman-suman ku su eggendiyè te lein ne inged, piru pegkeimpus nakasuman-suman a ne eg-ugpè duma te pamilya ku.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: hun-a ne litra te ngaran te etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the first letter of the name of a person.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Don't sign you whole name, just write your initials.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egsulat te hun-a ne litra te ngaran; egpirma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you initial a document, you write the first letter of your names (usually first name and surname) on it.

entries.summary: egpabunsud; egpanulù te iyam ne katuenan wey ke kanengnengan; egpanuluen te nateil ne pegbebatasan te punduk eyew igpaseled

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you initiate something, you cause it to start.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He initiated a conversation with the visitor.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpanulù te iyam ne katuenan wey ke kanengnengan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you initiate someone into a new skill or area of knowledge, you teach them about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He initiated the students into the study of history.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpanulù din ka me istuyanti te pegbebasbas te guhuren.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpanuluen te nateil ne pegbebatasan te punduk eyew igpaseled

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a group initiates a new member into the group, they have special ceremonies for the new member to join, and they teach the person about the particular customs of the group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was initiated into the club.

entries.summary: minsan nekey ne keilangan ne eggimuwen te me etew; kateunan nu ne eggimuwen nu ne kenè egtahad te suhù te duma

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne keilangan ne eggimuwen te me etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an important project which a group or person does.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The Barangay has started an initiative to help students.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kateunan nu ne eggimuwen nu ne kenè egtahad te suhù te duma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the ability to do something yourself, and not wait for other people to tell you to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you want to have your own business, you need to have initiative.

entries.summary: egdereetan; eggintingan (te me mananap)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something injures you, they hurt a part of your body somehow.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The dog injured him badly when it attacked him.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana nakarereet kandin ka migdula sikandin te asu.

entries.summary: paddel; egpakarereet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: damage to a part of your body, caused by someone or something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He received serious injuries in the accident.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Naamanaan [naamana͡an] sikandin napaddel puun te aksidinti.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Drinking a lot is injurious to your health.

entries.summary: lalag wey himu ne ingkabehey wey ingkabulig diyè te grupu; egtahù te sinulat ne kanengnengan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: lalag wey himu ne ingkabehey wey ingkabulig diyè te grupu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: When a group of people are talking about something or doing something, your input is what you say or do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We need input from everybody in the group, so please tell us your ideas.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeilangan ki te me lalag te langun kayi te grupu, palihug ilalag niyu ka me puhawang niyu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We asked for input from the leaders so that we could know what they wanted.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you input information into something such as a computer, you type it into the computer.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He input the information into the computer.

entries.summary: uled
seled te; lasud te; te diralem (meyitenged te eggeramen)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is inside a place such as a building or room, the walls or sides of the place are around it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Please step inside my office for a moment.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you feel something inside you, you have that feeling in your body or emotions, and may not show other people.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nabelu-belu sikandin diyè te diralem din.

entries.summary: hitabù te senge timpuwan; te panunggilingan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An instance of something is one time that it happens.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I cannot remember one instance of my father getting drunk.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè egkasuman-suman ku minsan sabeka ne hitabù ne newubug ka amey ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Vegetables are a great source of vitamins. Carrots, for instance, are rich in vitamin A.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me gulay dakel ne egpuunan te me bitamina. Te panunggilingan, ka karuts dakel ne egpuunan te bitamina ne A.

entries.summary: nasì; mulè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you do one thing instead of another thing, you do the first thing and not the second thing. The first thing is in the place of the second thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We turned right instead of left and got totally lost.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nasì key migsuwey te igkakawanan te perem diyè key te igkahibang sika ka nalaag key.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was no Coke, so we bought Sprite instead.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè Kuk, sika ka migbebeli key naan dè mulè te Isprayt / Warè Kuk, sika ka migbebeli key naan dè mulè nasi te Isprayt.

entries.summary: pamitawanan te me kanengnengan; panuluanan; eggimu wey egbunsud eggamit

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an organization or place for certain work, especially research and teaching (e.g., the Matigsalug Bible Institute).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you institute something such as a rule or way of doing something, you make it and start to use it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our boss instituted a new rule.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ahalen ney miggimu wey migpabunsud te peggamit te iyam ne pamaahi.

entries.summary: dakel, impurtanti ne urganisasyun iling te unibirsidad wey ke bangku; malu-ag ne ugpaan, iling te prisuwan wey ke tahuanan te me batè ne baley ne due nateil ne aliddanan.; menà wey ke kukuman (iling te peg-asawa)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: dakel, impurtanti ne urganisasyun iling te unibirsidad wey ke bangku

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large, important organization such as a university or bank.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The University of Central Mindano is a very large educational institution.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: malu-ag ne ugpaan, iling te prisuwan wey ke tahuanan te me batè ne baley ne due nateil ne aliddanan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large place such as a prison or children's home where people stay for a particular reason.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: menà wey ke kukuman (iling te peg-asawa)

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Marriage is an institution in most societies.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegbunsud te peggamit te minsan nekey (iling te kukuman wey pamaahi)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of making and starting to use something such as a rule or way of doing something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The institution of the new system will take time.

entries.summary: egpanulù; egsuhù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you instruct someone, you teach them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The teacher instructed us in mathematics.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you instruct someone to do something, you tell them to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The teacher instructed us to sit down.

entries.summary: pegpanulù; pegsuhù te peggimu; panulù ne lalag

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our teacher gave us instruction in mathematics.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which someone tells you to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a good child who follows his parents' instructions.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: words which which tell you how to do something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I bought a cellphone, and it had a small book of instructions to teach me how to use it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbebeli a te silpun, wey due deisek ne libru ne egpanulù ke egmenuwen te eggamit seini.

entries.summary: kasangkapan
insultu
egpegtimul; egpegsewug; egsewug, eg-apil wey eg-iling; 1 pegtimul; 2 pegsewug, peg-apil wey pegpeiling

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you integrate one thing with another, you join those things together so that they become one.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They integrated the preschool with the elementary school to make a larger school.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you integrate into a group of people, you become part of that group, and feel comfortable in that group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When they went abroad, it was very difficult for them to integrate into the new culture.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te peggendiyè dan te lein ne inged malised amana kandan ka egsewug wey ke eg-iling te iyam ne pegbebatasan.

entries.summary: pegkamahaan egtulik; pegkamatagseb; hineles ne kanengnengan te kunterè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: secret information about the enemies of a country and their plans. This information is used by the government or military.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The army received intelligence of a plan to bomb the building.

entries.summary: mahaan egtulik; matagseb; egpakasaliyu te himu (meyitenged te kumpyutir)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An intelligent person is bright, and can learn and understand things quickly.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is only 5, but she can read because she is very intelligent.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a computer is intelligent, it can change its actions depending on what happens around it.

entries.summary: egpaseg-sewuhey; egbehey te uras te duma wey egpakilalag kandan; egpaalukuyey; egpekeg-ayuney te peggimu wey ke egpekegbalew-balew ka tagsè sabeka wey ke egpekeyimu te lein ne minsan nekey.; 1 pegpalalahey; egpaalukuyey 2 pegpekeg-ayuney te peggimu wey ke pegpekegbalew-balew ka tagsè sabeka wey ke pegpekeyimu te lein ne minsan nekey.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpaseg-sewuhey; egbehey te uras te duma wey egpakilalag kandan; egpaalukuyey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you interact with other people, you spend time with them and communicate with them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's fun watching children interact with each other.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne egpakalingaw ke egpipitew te me batè ne egpaalukuyey.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpekeg-ayuney te peggimu wey ke egpekegbalew-balew ka tagsè sabeka wey ke egpekeyimu te lein ne minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two things interact with one another, they cause each other to change somehow.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Some medicines interact with each other if you take them at the same time, and that is not good.
