fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka duma ne me bawì ke egpegsewuhen nu te eg-inum te sabeka ne timpu, kenè ne meupiya egpakabehey seini te lein ne kapabulusan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegpalalahey; egpaalukuyey 2 pegpekeg-ayuney te peggimu wey ke pegpekegbalew-balew ka tagsè sabeka wey ke pegpekeyimu te lein ne minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of two or more people or things interacting.

entries.summary: egpakabagget; bagget; ahet; pegbagget (meyitenged te eggeramen nu ne igkeupii nu te eggimu ne minsan nekey, wey ke pegneneng pad te minsan nekey); minsan nekey ne igkeupii nu te eggimu wey ke egnengneng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something interests you, you want to do it or know more about it.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: bagget; ahet; pegbagget (meyitenged te eggeramen nu ne igkeupii nu te eggimu ne minsan nekey, wey ke pegneneng pad te minsan nekey)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling that you want to do something, or know more about something (have_an_interest in something).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has an interest in farming

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother encouraged an interest in learning.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka iney ku mig-ahet keddì te pegbagget te pegbebasbas.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne igkeupii nu te eggimu wey ke egnengneng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you like doing or learning about.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has many interests, including music and history.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that something will affect you (have_an_interest in something).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We should include farmers when making plans for the land, because they have an interest in the decision.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ne eg-apilen ta ka mangametay ke eggimu ki te planu te tanè, su due me kalabetan dan te pegbehey te me puhawang.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: that fact that you own part of a company (have_an_interest in a company).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: anak (meyitenged te tubù); tubù te nasambayan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the extra money which you pay when you borrow money. Usually a percentage of the amount which you borrow.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are interested_in something, you want to do it or know more about it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is interesting, it causes you to want to know more.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I think that history is very interesting.

entries.summary: deisek ne lalag ne eggamiten te kandin dè(kenè ne labet diyè te pangasak). Sengekakuwa egpalihawang te eggeramen (iling te 'tuwi'; 'keyey', wey duma pad).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: deisek ne lalag ne eggamiten te kandin dè(kenè ne labet diyè te pangasak). Sengekakuwa egpalihawang te eggeramen (iling te 'tuwi'; 'keyey', wey duma pad).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a small word which is used alone (not as part of a sentence). It sometimes expresses a feeling.

entries.summary: diyè te diralem te etew wey ke minsan nekey; diyè te diralem te suman-suman wey eggeramen; egkeyitabù seled te nasud wey ke punduk.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: diyè te diralem te etew wey ke minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something internal relates to the inside of something (e.g., the body, a machine).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He received internal injuries in the accident: his stomach and lungs were damaged.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: diyè te diralem te suman-suman wey eggeramen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something internal relates to your mind or feelings.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: On the outside she looked happy, but internally she was very unhappy.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egtengtengan nu sikandin ne mahale-galè, piru ka diralem din warad iya kahalaan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She had a strong internal struggle as she tried to decide what to do.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkeyitabù seled te nasud wey ke punduk.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something internal relates to the things that happen inside a country or group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was a lot of internal fighting in the family.

entries.summary: egkalabet ka masulug ne inged

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something international includes more than one country (e.g., international sports).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The Olympics are an international competition.

entries.summary: egsabut; egpasabut te igpasabut te ulahingen wey sayew; egluwas

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you interpret something, you decide what the meaning is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They interpreted the results of the survey, and published their discoveries in a book.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She interpreted his silence as agreement, even though he really didn't agree.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpasabut te igpasabut te ulahingen wey sayew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you interpret something such as a song or dance, you show the meaning by the way that you perform it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She interpreted the song very nicely, so that we felt like we understood it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impasabut din ka ulahingen ay-ayari, su eyew egkaheram ta ne iling te nakasabut ki.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you interpret, you take things from one language and say what they mean in another language.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I know Korean language, so I interpreted for our Korean visitors.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The interpretation of animal noises is not easy, because we can't really know what they are thinking.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: what you understand about something after you have interpreted it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The three people all had different interpretations of the meaning of the story.

entries.summary: egpakapeelat ne timpu te daruwa ne pangitabù

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakapeelat ne timpu te daruwa ne pangitabù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a period of time between two events.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The pains came at intervals of 10 minutes.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was an interval of a month when she wasn't here, because she visited her family.

entries.summary: bituka
paseled; palasud; egpakasukeung; egpakasangkub; egkabaluy; egkeyimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you come or go into a place, you move from outside the place to inside the place.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you run or crash into someone or something, your body or vehicle hits them while you are moving.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I wasn't looking, so I ran into the tree.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Wara a migtengteng, sika ka nakasangkub a te kayu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something changes into another thing, it becomes that thing.

entries.summary: weil ne due eglalahen piru warè egpangasakan. Due etew wey ke butang ne eggimu te weil, piru warè etew wey ke butang ne egdawat te weil.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: weil ne due eglalahen piru warè egpangasakan. Due etew wey ke butang ne eggimu te weil, piru warè etew wey ke butang ne egdawat te weil.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a verb which has a subject but no object. There is a person or thing who does the action, but there is no person or thing which receives the action.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We cried ['cried' is an intransitive verb].

entries.summary: Iling ke ka sabeka ne etew egpataha te ngaran din wey egpataha te me ngaran te duma rin

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Iling ke ka sabeka ne etew egpataha te ngaran din wey egpataha te me ngaran te duma rin

entries.summary: pewun-a
kenè egkaayun ne etew puun su due dalu wey ke paddel

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè egkaayun ne etew puun su due dalu wey ke paddel

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who is very weak because of sickness or an injury.

entries.summary: eggamit te seleppì; eggastu te sika ne butang eyew due eglibed ne dakel pad ne seleppì peg-impus; eggamit te timpu wey keseg te sabeka ne etew wey ke butang, su migsuman-suman ka ne due meupiya ne egkeyitabù pegkeimpus kayi.; 1 peggastu; peggamit te seleppì; 2 peggamit te timpu wey keseg

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggamit te seleppì; eggastu te sika ne butang eyew due eglibed ne dakel pad ne seleppì peg-impus

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you invest money in something, you spend money on that thing so that you can get more money back later.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He invested his money in a fishpond.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggastu rin ka seleppì din diyè te uyahanan te isda.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggamit te timpu wey keseg te sabeka ne etew wey ke butang, su migsuman-suman ka ne due meupiya ne egkeyitabù pegkeimpus kayi.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you invest time or energy in someone or something, you use your time and energy for that person or thing, because you think there will be a good result later.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He invested a lot of time in preparing his field so that he could get a good crop.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbehey sikandin te dakel ne timpu te peg-andam te kamet din su eyew egpakahaani sikandin te meupiya.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 peggastu; peggamit te seleppì; 2 peggamit te timpu wey keseg

fields.label: English example
fields.text: For people with a lot of money, investment in business shares is a popular way of making more money.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne egtahahaan nu te seleppì wey panahun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you have spent money or time on because you want to get a result.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A carabao is a big investment.

entries.summary: egtengtengan eg-ay-ayari wey ke eg-inse-insè (eyew te pegnengneng te me katahaan [kataha͡an]); peg-inse-insè

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egtengtengan eg-ay-ayari wey ke eg-inse-insè (eyew te pegnengneng te me katahaan [kataha͡an])

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you investigate something, you look at it carefully or ask questions, so that you can know exactly what happened, or what it is like.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Police are investigating the robbery now.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pulis eg-inse-insè te pegpanakew kuntee.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The researcher is investigating the causes of the disease.

entries.summary: egginggat; egginalig; egpeyimu te maaddat ne pegpeyimu ke egkeupian; hinggat; hinalig

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you invite someone to a place or event, you ask them politely to come if they want to.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpeyimu te maaddat ne pegpeyimu ke egkeupian

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you invite someone to do something, you ask them politely to do it if they want to.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The speaker invited us all to stand up.

entries.summary: eglabet; eg-apil; egpalabet; 1 peglabet; 2 pegpalabet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an action or event involves someone or something, that person or thing is part of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My job involves a lot of walking.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due peggipgipanew ne eglabet te himu ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A lot of people were involved in the parade.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you involve someone in something, you cause them to be part of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The leaders tried to involve all the young people in the game.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me labew miggeram ne egpalabet te me kanakan wey me mengebay te galew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that someone or something is part of something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His parents were not happy about his involvement in the sports team.

entries.summary: putew; plansa; egplansa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a strong kind of metal (symbol Fe).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a things which you heat and then use to make clothes smooth.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you iron clothes, you use an iron to make them smooth.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Your uniform will look much better if you are able to iron it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: present tense of be (third person singular)

entries.summary: natalibubù ne miglabuntud ne nasahiliran te weyig

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: natalibubù ne miglabuntud ne nasahiliran te weyig

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an area of land which has water all around it.

entries.summary: keilangan ne me guhuren ne egpangasaken; peglihawang te guhuren; egpamehey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: keilangan ne me guhuren ne egpangasaken

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an important topic which people think, talk or disagree about.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Unemployment is a serious issue in many places.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An issue of a magazine or newspaper is the version of it that is printed for a particular day, week or month.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Did you see Thursday's issue of the newspaper?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakita nu ka peglihawang te guhuren te pepil te seeyè se Huwibis?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone issues something to people, they produce it or give it so that the people can use it or buy it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The teacher issued paper to the students.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka talagpanulù migpamehey te pepil diyè te egmangiskuyla.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The aid workers issued blankets to homeless families after the landslide.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing issues from another thing, it comes out of that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A good smell issued from the kitchen.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka meupiya ne ngareg migligkat diyè te keenanan.

entries.summary: seini; sika (panaliyu wey panubal te ngaran te mananap wey minsan nekey)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: seini; sika (panaliyu wey panubal te ngaran te mananap wey minsan nekey)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: third person singular pronoun (animals or things).

entries.summary: kasangkapan; kasangkapan ne nalista; senge guhuren meyitenged te etew wey minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one of the things written on a list.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are nine items on our list of things to buy in town.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due siyew ne kasangkapan ne nalista kayi ne egbeliyen diyè te lungsud.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: senge guhuren meyitenged te etew wey minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a piece of news about someone or something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was an item on the TV news about the lost money.

entries.summary: bakè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the bone which makes the bottom of your face (from your ears to your chin).

entries.summary: me mahalen ne dereisek ne kasangkapan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me mahalen ne dereisek ne kasangkapan

entries.summary: himu; trabahu; senge himuwan; sabeka ne himu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the work that you do to earn money.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She lives in Malaybalay because she has a job in a shop there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It was a big job to cut down the large tree.

entries.summary: egduma; egtampu; eg-apil; egpegsumpul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you join a group of people, you go to them and do something with them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We are eating dinner; please join us.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkekeen key te iglabung; duma ka kanami.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you join a group, you become a member of that group.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you join two things, you cause them to hold together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He joined the pieces of wood with a nail.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impegsumpul din ka daruwa ne tempug te kayu pinaahi te lansang.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the place where two things meet and hold together.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkabayaan peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te daruwa ne kasangkapan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a road joins things, you can use it to move between those things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This road joins the two towns.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini ne kelesadda egkabayaan peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te daruwa ne lungsud.

entries.summary: sumpulan; impegsumpul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the place where two things connect (e.g., two bones in the body).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You describe something as joint if two people or groups own it or use it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My husband and I have joint ownership of the house.

entries.summary: kawalian
malasi ne baseen [base͡en] meyitenged te egnengnengen; sulatananan meyitenged te keilangan ne panghitabu te umul wey geyinawa te minsan nekey ne aldew

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: malasi ne baseen [base͡en] meyitenged te egnengnengen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a regular magazine about a technical or academic subject.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The college library gets that scientific journal every month.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sulatananan meyitenged te keilangan ne panghitabu te umul wey geyinawa te minsan nekey ne aldew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a personal book in which you write regularly about your life and feelings.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I keep a journal and write in it a few times a week.

entries.summary: hipanew; eggipanew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action of traveling to a place.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you journey to a place, you travel there.

entries.summary: galè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a deep feeling of being very happy.

entries.summary: talaggukum; huwis; eggukum ke egmenuwen te eggamit ka balaud te nateil ne sitwasyun; eggukum ke meupiya naa wey ke mareet (meyitenged te butang, etew wey ke himu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the most important person in a law court, who can decide how to use the law in a particular situation

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggukum ke egmenuwen te eggamit ka balaud te nateil ne sitwasyun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a judge judges someone who has a problem with the law, they decide how to use the law in that situation.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggukum ke meupiya naa wey ke mareet (meyitenged te butang, etew wey ke himu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you judge something, you decide if it is good or bad. If you judge someone, you decide if their actions and their character are good (in your opinion).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You need to judge your own work before you give it to the teacher.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ne eggukuman nu pad ka himu nu te kenè nu pad igbehey te talagpanulù nu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is very quick to judge people, even when she doesn't know their situation.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne malabundus sikandin ne eggukum te me etew, minsan warè nakataha sikandin te sitwasyun.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you judge something such as an amount, you try to guess how big it is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's hard to judge the distance between here and there. Maybe it's about 2km.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Malised ne eg-alaheen ka kariyuan kayi wey diyè. Kema buwa ke me daruwa ne kilumitru.

entries.summary: eg-inumen ne memeemis ne egpahagsilen
eg-umbetut
iyam pad iya; sikan pad iya; en iya; dè iya

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: iyam pad iya; sikan pad iya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something just happened, it happened a very short time ago.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She has just arrived and is taking off her shoes now.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sikan pad iya nekeuma sikandin, wey sikan pad iya egluluung sikandin te sepatus din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is just happening, it is happening now, or will happen very soon.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use just to say that something happens only at the last moment, or is only true by a small margin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He only just finished his work before it started to rain.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekeimpus dè iya sikandin te himu rin ne migbunsud e ka uran.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We arrived just in time for the start of the program.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My younger brother is just tall enough to pick the santol from the tree.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: dè; rè (egkahamit seini diyè te minsan nekey ne kenè dè amana ne dakel wey ke impurtanti, wey ke de-deisek dè te duma ne me butang).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use just if something is not very big or important, or is less than you expected.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Don't be frightened, it's just a small dog.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ka egkaaldek, deisek dè sika ne asu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He just told me his name, nothing more.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpanugtul dè sikandin te ngaran din, warad lein.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There's just a santol tree in front of our house, nothing else.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Don't be frightened, it's just a lizard.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I didn't bring much with me, just an extra set of clothes.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Thank you, it's just what I wanted.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Salamat, seini iya ka igkeupii ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She told me just what she heard.

entries.summary: eleg wey meupiya su nakabehey te katagbewan te tagsè sabeka; matulanged; matalengteng; kenè ne eleg wey meupiya su warè nakabehey te katagbewan te tagsè sabeka; kenè ne matulanged wey ke matalengteng.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eleg wey meupiya su nakabehey te katagbewan te tagsè sabeka

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something just is right and good because it gives everyone what they should get.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The murderer only went to prison for two years. That is not just.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka mangimatey naprisu rè te daruwa ne leg-un. Kenè sika ne eleg.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A just person does what is right and good for other people by giving them what they should get.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That judge is just because he doesn't accept bribes.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Matalengteng mulè sika ne ebugadu su kenè egdawat te seleppì ne bayad eyew egpeyimuwen sikandin te mareet.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a just man, who always pays his workers what he should.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Matulanged sikandin ne lukes, su egpamayaran din iya ka me etew ke nekey ka eleg.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè ne eleg wey meupiya su warè nakabehey te katagbewan te tagsè sabeka; kenè ne matulanged wey ke matalengteng.

entries.summary: pegbehey te himu wey suman-suman ne eleg wey malehet ne egkaangey te tagsè sabeka; ka sistima te nasud ne egdusa te me etew ne egsupak te balaud; egpakita ke kamenu keupiya ka sabeka ne butang wey ke etew.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegbehey te himu wey suman-suman ne eleg wey malehet ne egkaangey te tagsè sabeka

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: actions and decisions which are right and good, because they give everyone what they should get.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The poor man finally got justice, and received his land back.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pubri ne etew nabehayan te eleg ne hustisya, wey naawì [na͡awì] din ka tanè din.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The criminal was brought to justice.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We want to have justice in this criminal trial.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If a judge is fair, they will not accept bribes, and will do justice.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka sistima te nasud ne egdusa te me etew ne egsupak te balaud

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the legal system of a country, which punishes people who break the law.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakita ke kamenu keupiya ka sabeka ne butang wey ke etew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something does_justice to another thing, it shows how good it really is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That photo doesn't do her justice; she is much more beautiful than that.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sika ne litratu warè migpakita te keupiya rin; uupiyei pad sikandin du te sika.

entries.summary: egpakameupiya; eglalahen nu ke mania te meupiya diyè te kuna ka peggimu te minsan nekey; egkahi te matareng (meyitenged te Manama).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing justifies another, it causes that other thing to be right.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Getting good results doesn't justify cheating.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te pegkuwa te meupiya ne gradu kenè egpakameupiya ka egpanlimbung.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eglalahen nu ke mania te meupiya diyè te kuna ka peggimu te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you justify something that you do, you say why it is right for you to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She just said sorry, and didn't try to justify her actions.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migkahi rè sikandin te pasaylua a, wey warè miglalag sikandin ke mania te neyimu rin seeyè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If God justifies you, he says that you are righteous or good.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egmatul-iren ka tagsè ilis te sinulat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you justify writing on a computer, you cause the lines of writing to be straight on the left side, the right side or both sides.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegpakameupiya; 2 peglalag ke mania te meupiya ka peggimu te minsan nekey; 3 pegkahi te matareng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which causes another thing to be right.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is no justification for cheating.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me lalag ne egpangguhud ke mania te meupiya diyè te kuna ka peggimu te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: words which explain why it was right for you to do something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She gave no justification for what she had done.

entries.summary: warè ibehey wey ke iregpak ka minsan nekey; egtahù layun; eggeles; egpabulusbulus te peggimu te himuwen

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: warè ibehey wey ke iregpak ka minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you keep something, you continue to have it, and you don't give it away or throw it away.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I will always keep this ring, because my mother gave it to me.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you keep something somewhere, that is the place where you usually put it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I keep my cellphone in my pocket.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Igtahù ku layun ka silpun ku te burusa ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She keeps her money under her bed.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Igtahù din layun ka seleppì din diyè te diralem te hibatanan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you keep doing something, or keep_on doing it, you continue to do it, and don't stop.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was tired, but I kept running.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nabeley ad, piru migpabulus-bulus e pad te pegpallahuy.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I pressed the brake, but the bike kept moving.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you keep_doing something, or keep_on_doing it, you do it many times.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpabulus diyè te nateil ne sitwasyun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you keep in a particular state (e.g., quiet, still, away), you continue in that state.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's difficult to keep warm when it is raining.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Malised ne layun egpameinit ke eg-uran.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Please keep still while I check your hair.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Palihug kenè ka weil te egpitawen ku ka bulbul nu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you keep someone or something in a particular state (e.g., clean, awake), you cause them to continue in that state.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka mahulub iyan layun egpakapukew keddì.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's hard work to keep the house clean.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Malised ne trabahu ka layun ne malinis ka baley.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegpallahuy layun egpekeyimu keddì ne manekal-nekal.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She tries hard to keep her son out of trouble.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you keep something from happening, you stop it from happening.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She held the child's hand to keep him from running away.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggen-genan din ka belad te batè eyew egpapeeng-eneng te peglingkesu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Put enough water in the pot to keep it from burning.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Tahui nu te eleg-eleg ne weyig ka kendiru eyew kenè egkatutungan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you keep a rule, you do the thing that it says to do.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of keep

entries.summary: yabi; amana ne impurtanti te peggimu wey ke pegsabut te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the small metal thing that you put into a lock to open it.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: amana ne impurtanti te peggimu wey ke pegsabut te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that is very important for doing or understanding something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The key to being a good musician is listening.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka impurtanti eyew meupiya ne musikiru su ka pegpammineg.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a key member of the team.

entries.summary: egsipeen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you kick something, you hit it hard with your foot.

entries.summary: eggimatey (te etew wey ke pinamula); eggilang (te ayam wey ke ngalap); egpahangu wey ke eggihangu (te pinamula)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggimatey (te etew wey ke pinamula); eggilang (te ayam wey ke ngalap); egpahangu wey ke eggihangu (te pinamula)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone kills a person, animal or plant, they cause them to die.

entries.summary: hiid-uwen [hi͡id-uwen]; pegkeeyid-uwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A kind person likes to do good to people or animals, and does not like them to be hurt.

entries.summary: sabeka ne karumaan [karuma͡an] te punduk ne due pegpekeg-iling; kalasi; egbayad pinaahi te butang wey ke himu, kenè ne seleppì.; pegsulì iling te inggimu ran diyè te kuna

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sabeka ne karumaan [karuma͡an] te punduk ne due pegpekeg-iling; kalasi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one of the members of a group of similar people or things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He's the kind of person who can talk to anyone.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbayad pinaahi te butang wey ke himu, kenè ne seleppì.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you pay someone in_kind, you pay them with something that is not money (e.g., things, or something that you do for them).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegsulì iling te inggimu ran diyè te kuna

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone does something to you, and you respond to them in_kind, you do the same thing back to them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She threw water at her friend, who responded in kind.

entries.summary: harì

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the man who rules a country. He usually becomes king because of his family, and is not chosen by the people.

entries.summary: kaharian; migharian

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the rule of a king, or the area which is ruled by a king.

entries.summary: eggarek

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you kiss someone, you press your lips on them.

entries.summary: abuwan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a place in a house where people cook and prepare food.

entries.summary: buel; eggisuhaten te buel

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the part that bends in the middle of the leg.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you knee someone, you hit them with your knee.

entries.summary: panimbuel

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you kneel, you put your knees on the ground.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of kneel

entries.summary: ilab; gepes; egdugsuan; egdunggaben

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone knifes another person, they attack them with a knife.

entries.summary: egtektek
egpakataha; egpakanengneng; nekeila; egkateu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you know something, or know that something is the case, it is in your mind.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I know that you have three brothers.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you know someone, you have have met them before.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you know how to do something, you have the skills and information to be able to do it

entries.summary: katuenan; pegkateu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the things that people can learn and know.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: One reason that we go to school is to get knowledge.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sabeka ne aliddanan te egpangendiyè ki te iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an] ka eg-angey te katuenan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that you know someone or something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His knowledge of the Matigsalug language is very helpful.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegkateu rin te linalahan te Matigsalug amana ne mabulig.

entries.summary: sinulat ne nakakepkep eyew te kanengnengan; egpakepkep te sulat eyew te kanengnengan; egngaran te senge etew (malasi ne mareet)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sinulat ne nakakepkep eyew te kanengnengan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which you write on and attach to another thing to show information such as what it is, what is in it, or its owner.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The bag had a label on it with a phone number.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't know which company made that T-shirt, but the label will tell us.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakepkep te sulat eyew te kanengnengan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you label something, you attach something to it to show information.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She labelled the boxes to show what was in each one.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egngaran te senge etew (malasi ne mareet)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you label someone or something, you give them a name (often negative) to describe them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They labelled him as lazy because he was a slow worker.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migngaranan dan sikandin te pehulen su malambened sikandin ne egtrabahu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a name which is given to someone or something to describe them.

entries.summary: egtrabahu; trabahu; himu; lesutan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you labor, you do hard work, especially physical work.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They labored hard to finish the house before the wet season.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My brother labors at the rice mill.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My friend fixed my bike, so I didn't pay for labor.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the painful time when a pregnant woman gives birth (in_labor).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She went into labor at around midnight, and the baby was born the next morning.

entries.summary: deisek te keilangan nu; kulang; warè wey ke warè nasampung

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If there is a lack of something, there is none of it, or less than what you need.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a lack of light in the room because there are no windows.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something lacks something, they don't have it, or don't have enough of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He lacks the money to start a shop.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè seleppì din te pegpabunsud te tindaan [tinda͡an].

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This room lacks a window, so it is quite dark.

entries.summary: haheran
maleman ne malitan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a woman, especially a woman who speaks and behaves in a nice way. She can be married or not married.

entries.summary: migpeyibat; mig-elen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of lay (1)

entries.summary: miggibat
lanew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large flat body of water that is not moving.

entries.summary: sulù
tanè (meyitenged te langun ne warè neumeyi te weyig); tanè (meyitenged te due mig-angken wey ke migkamkamuney); tanè (meyitenged te egkapamulaan)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: tanè (meyitenged te langun ne warè neumeyi te weyig)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the part of planet Earth which is not covered by water.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: After sailing for many days on the ocean, the people in the boat finally reached land.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: tanè (meyitenged te due mig-angken wey ke migkamkamuney)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an area of ground which someone owns.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This land belongs to my father.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The_land is a general word for areas which have a lot of farms.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a farmer, so he lives on the land.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a boat or plane lands, it reaches the ground from the water or air.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you land a boat or plane, you cause it to reach the ground from the water or air.

entries.summary: talagbantey ne lukes
lunew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an event where rocks, trees and mud fall down the side of a mountain.

entries.summary: linalahan; linalahen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the system of words and grammar that a particular group of people use to communicate.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He speaks three languages: Matigsalug, Visayan and English.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpakalalag sikandin te tatelu ne linalahan: Matigsalug, Biseyè wey Inglis.

entries.summary: bubuyahen; dakel
kinamewuriyan; keepusan; naan dè iya; iyam miglihad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The last thing is at the end, after all the others (in time or place).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This is my last day of school, because our vacation starts tomorrow.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ka kinamewuriyan ne aldew ku te peg-iskuyla, su ka bakasyun ney egbunsud e kaaselem.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She came last in the race.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The last thing is the only thing that remains.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This is my last egg. I need to buy some more.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini naan dè iya ka nasamè ne atelug. Keilangan a ne egbebeli ad e man-e.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The last thing is the one which happened the closest time before now.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My last birthday was my best one.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka iyam miglihad ne aldew ne neetawan ku ka kinameupiyaan para keddiey.

entries.summary: egpabulus taman te (meyitenged te kaluhayen); egpekeuma taman te (meyitenged te kaluhayen); due eleg ne egkahamit taman te kalayatan te aldew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something lasts for a certain amount of time, it continues for that time.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pista migpabulus taman te lalimma ne aldew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something lasts for a certain amount of time, it is good for that time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This fruit will not last until next week, because it is ready now and the weather is hot.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini ne prutas kenè egpekeyinguma taman te seup ne simana, su eleg e seini wey ka timpu ta meinit.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due eleg ne egkahamit taman te kalayatan te aldew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something lasts for a certain amount of time, there is enough to use for that time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We have enough rice to last us three more days.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due eleg ne behas ne egkakeen ta taman te tatelu ne aldew.

entries.summary: namewuri; naluhey; mananey; keepusan te aldew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something is late, they are after the correct time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We will start at 9am. Don't be late!

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egbunsud ki te alas nuwibi te maselem. Kenè ka egpamewuri!

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happens late, it happens after that kind of thing usually happens.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He married late; he was about forty.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mananey ne nakaasawa sikandin; su kuwarinte e ka idad din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the end of the day or the end of the evening.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's getting late, and it will be dark soon.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeepus e ka aldew, wey egmaresilem seini kuntee te kenè egkaluhey.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He went to bed very late, so he's sleepy now.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use late to talk about the end part of a period of time (e.g., late morning, the late 1990s).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A late person is someone who has died.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My late husband was a teacher.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka napatey ne asawa ku su talagpanulù.

entries.summary: namewurì
ka ikaruwa (te daruwa ne kasangkapan); baad te hitabù wey te senge timpuwan ne marani e te keepusan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use latter to talk about the second of two things (and you use former to talk about the first).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Sometimes we have white rice and sometimes we have red rice. I like the latter.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sengekakuwa ne due maangkag ne behas ney wey sengekakuwa degma due malalab. Egkeupian a te ikaruwa.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: baad te hitabù wey te senge timpuwan ne marani e te keepusan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The latter part of an event or period of time is the part closer to the end.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The latter part of the game was very exciting.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka marani e te keepusan te galew su amane e ne makabebagget.

entries.summary: egngisi; nginisiyan; pegngisi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you laugh, you make a particular sound, often because something is funny.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a sound that you make if something is funny.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has a very loud laugh.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action or sound of laughing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I could hear laughter coming from the next classroom.

entries.summary: kukuman; balaud; puhawang meyitenged ke egmemenu ka kalibutan ne eggimu; ka hun-a ne lalimma ne libru diyè te Tapey ne Kasabutan te Bibliya (Hinisis, Iksudu, Libitiku, Numiru wey Diyutirunumiyu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a rule or group of rules which the people in a society must obey.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is against the law to steal.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: puhawang meyitenged ke egmemenu ka kalibutan ne eggimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a basic idea about how the world works (e.g., the law of gravity).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka hun-a ne lalimma ne libru diyè te Tapey ne Kasabutan te Bibliya (Hinisis, Iksudu, Libitiku, Numiru wey Diyutirunumiyu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the first five books of the Old Testament in the Bible (Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers and Deuteronomy).

entries.summary: abugadu
egpeyibat; eg-atelug

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you lay something somewhere, you put it there so that it lies flat there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She laid the baby on the bed.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpeyibat din ka malalab ne batè diyè te katri.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a bird lays an egg, it produces an egg.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That hen lays two eggs every day.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sika ne upa eg-atelug te daruwa te tagsè aldew.

entries.summary: miggibat
karakelan ne natalagtag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an amount of something which is spread or put flat on a surface.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Mango float is made of layers of mango and biscuits.

entries.summary: pehulen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a lazy person doesn't like to work hard.

entries.summary: eggun-a eyew te pegpanulù te egbayaan; egkitkit; egtuyuk; eg-uyan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggun-a eyew te pegpanulù te egbayaan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you lead people, you go before them to show them the way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He led the group of people along the path.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggun-a sikandin te punduk te me etew diyè te dalan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you lead a person, you go before them holding their hand or arm. If you lead an animal, you go before it holding it with something like a rope.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She led the horse along the path.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtuyuk din ka kuddè diyè te dalan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you lead a group or activity, you organize or control it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He led some games for the children.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-uyan sikandin te duma ne galew te me batè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a path leads to a place, it goes there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This path leads to my house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini ne dalan egpeendiyè te baley ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a situation leads to another situation, it causes that situation.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His bad action led to many problems.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka mareet ne weil din nakahated te masalig ne prublima.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The_lead is the first position in front of a group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I know the way to that place, so I will take the lead.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakataha a te dalan te sika ne lugar, su sikeddì ka eggun-a.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A person's lead is the things they do that others copy.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He sat down and we followed his lead.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpinuu sikandin wey mig-iling key te inggimu rin.

entries.summary: timehè; ka eg-agi ne baad te lapis

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That old paint is poisonous because it has lead in it.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka eg-agi ne baad te lapis

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the gray material in the middle of a pencil (this material is graphite).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He dropped the pencil, so the lead broke.

entries.summary: pegdumala
dewun
egkaangey; egkanengnengan; egbebasbasan; egpepanulù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you learn something, or learn about something, you start to know it because of experience, or because someone teaches you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has learned from experience that you can't trust everybody.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Naangey rin diyè te nabaybayaan din ne kenè ka egpakasalig te langun ne me etew.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We learned about dolphins today in our science class.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nanengnengan ney kuntee ka meyitenged te me dulpin te klasi ney.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you learn something, you study it so that you can remember it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I need to learn these facts because we have a test about them tomorrow.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you learn of something, or learn that something is the case, someone tells it to you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When she arrived at the house, she learned that he had already left.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of learn. You can also use learned.

entries.summary: kinareisekan; pinakareisek; pinaka- (meyitenged te kinareisekan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use the_least when you compare amounts, to talk about the smallest amount.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She's the smallest in our family, so she eats the least food of all of us.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sikandin ka kinareisekan diyè te taltalaanak ney, sikak egkeen sikandin te pinakareisek ne pegkeen te langun kanami.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use the_least when you compare different things, to talk about the thing that is last.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That is the least interesting of all his movies.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sika ka pinakareisek se kabaggetan te langun ne salida rin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Black is my least favorite color.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is the least tired of all of us, because he is very strong.

entries.summary: eg-awè; eg-engked; eg-engkeran; egpakahaat [egpakaha͡at]; eggaat [egga͡at]; egpakalingew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you leave a place, you go from that place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I usually leave home at about 6:30am.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you leave a person or organization, you go away from them and do not plan to come back to them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He left his wife and four children.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He left his job because his boss was unfair.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something leaves a thing somewhere, they go away from that place but that thing stays there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Oh! Someone left their umbrella on the bus.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Tuwey! Due nakahaat [nakaha͡at] te payung din kayi te terak.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She left a gift for you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Eating balingbing seeds can leave a strange taste in your mouth.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegkeen te behas te balingbing egpakahaat [egpakaha͡at] te lein ne nanam te be-bè nu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They left mud on the floor when they walked through the house in their shoes.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you leave someone or something alone, or leave them be, you do not go near them or do anything to them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If the children are arguing, just leave them, and don't get involved in their argument.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you leave something, you don't use it, so that it remains.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you can't eat all the rice, just leave it, and we will eat it later.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: We’ll eat the mangoes, but we’ll leave the apples for him

entries.summary: pegpataha te kenè peggimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: permission to be absent from work (e.g., sick leave).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She took three days' leave from work when her sister visited.

entries.summary: pegpanulù; egpanulù diyè te katangenan; egpakiglalag te mapahetpet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a speech in which someone teaches a group about something (give_a_lecture).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He gave an interesting lecture on Philippine history.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbehey sikandin te amana ne makabebagget ne pegpanulù puun te guhuren te Pilipinas.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone lectures, they teach a group about something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He lectures in science at the University.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpanulù sikandin te Sayans diyè te siyudad ne iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an].

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you lecture someone about something, you talk to them strongly for a long time because you think they are wrong, or did something wrong.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When I arrived home after dark, my mother lectured me about safety.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a long talk by someone because they think you are wrong or did something wrong (give_someone_a_lecture).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When I arrived home after dark, my mother gave me a lecture about safety.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of lead (1)

entries.summary: gibang; igkagibang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The left side of something is side that is to the west, if the thing is facing north.

entries.summary: naan dè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of leave.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is left, it remains, so it is still there after other things have been used.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are only 5 minutes left until the end of the class.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Duen naan dè lalimma ne minutus ne egkeimpusan e ka klasi.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a lot of rice left because we didn't eat much.

entries.summary: paa; paa te minsan nekey; sabeka ne baad te hipanawan ne masalig se baad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the part of the body which is joined to the lower body, and ends at the foot.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a part of something such as a chair or table which causes it to stand up.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This chair only has three legs.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini ne pinnuuwan tatelu se paa.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sabeka ne baad te hipanawan ne masalig se baad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one of the parts of a trip which has several parts.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The Davao-to-Maramag leg of my trip was very slow, because the weather was bad.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka Dabaw peendiye te Maramag ne egkabayyaan te hipanawan ku su amana ne mananey, su mareet nahud ka timpu.

entries.summary: kenè ne supak te balaud; igtuhut te balaud ne himu; egkaayun; due kalabetan te balaud; warè pegsupak te balaud; pegkaayun

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè ne supak te balaud; igtuhut te balaud ne himu; egkaayun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is legal, the law allows people to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Is it legal to ride a motorbike without a helmet?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè naa ne supak te balaud ka eg-untud ki te mutur ne warè kalu ne hilmit?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is legal, it is related to the law.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That company is having some legal problems.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kumpanya due duma ne prublima diyè te balaud.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm not sure about the legality of doing that. Maybe we are not allowed to do it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Wara a nakataha te kaayunan te peggimu rue. Kema ke kenè egkaayun.

entries.summary: eg-umul te balaud; egpangimu te balaud; eggimu te balaud; peg-umul, peggimu, wey pegpangimu te balaud; balaud; kukuman

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-umul te balaud; egpangimu te balaud; eggimu te balaud

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a government legislates, it makes laws.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peg-umul, peggimu, wey pegpangimu te balaud

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of making new laws.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The government has produced two new pieces of legislation.

entries.summary: egpasambayan te minsan nekey diyè te duma

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpasambayan te minsan nekey diyè te duma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you lend something to someone, or lend someone something, you say that they can borrow it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My brother doesn't have a bike, but I always lend my bike to him.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka suled ku warè baskilita, piru layun ku egpasambayan ka baskilita ku kandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My brother doesn't have a bike, but I always lend him my bike.

entries.summary: kalayat; kaluhayan; kalayatan te senge buuk

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the length of a thing is the measurement from one end to the other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The length of that road is 2 kilometers.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kalayat te kelesadda su daruwa ne kilumitru.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the length of something that happens is how much time it takes.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The length of the meeting was 2 hours.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kaluhayan te miting su me daruwa ne uras.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A length of something long (e.g., a rope) is a piece of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He gave me a length of rope and asked me to tie it around the small sticks.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of lend.

entries.summary: de-deisek te (eyew te epeg-iling te kareisekan); bayew...du te (eyew te egpeg-iling te klasiyan)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: de-deisek te (eyew te epeg-iling te kareisekan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use less when you compare amounts, to talk about a smaller amount of something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have less water than you in my cup.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: De-deisek ka weyig ku te pakawan du te kuna.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I ate less of the bread than you did.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: bayew...du te (eyew te egpeg-iling te klasiyan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use less when you compare different things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I like vegetables less than fruit.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian a bayew te gulay du te prutas.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The mountains are less crowded than the city.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She finished her work less quickly than her sister.

entries.summary: pariisekan
kase igpanulù
egbalahad; egbalaharen; egbehey te timpu eyew egkeyitabù; egpeugpaan (meyitenged te pegpabayad); egpaabangan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you let someone do something, you don't stop them doing it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Don't let your child hit you.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè nu egbalaharen ne egpasakitan ka te anak nu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My parents let me stay at my friend's house last night.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbalahad a te iney wey amey ku ne mig-ubpe diye te baley te alukuy ku seeye se miglihad ne karusileman.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or situation lets something happen, they make it able to happen and do not stop it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She moved her chair to let him pass.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggenat din ka bangku din eyew egpakabayè sikandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you let a building, people pay you rent so that they can live or work there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We let our house here while we were living in another town.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpeugpaan ney ka baley ney kayi taheed te eg-ugpè key diyè te lein ne lungsud.

entries.summary: sulat; litra

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a kind of message that you write on paper to someone.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one of the symbols in an alphabet (e.g., a, b, c).

entries.summary: kamenu katikang wey karakel ka minsan nekey; palinneu (meyitenged te neumaan [neuma͡an] te minsan nekey iling te weyig); nekegseked; nekeg-iling; mapatag; malumapayag

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kamenu katikang wey karakel ka minsan nekey; palinneu (meyitenged te neumaan [neuma͡an] te minsan nekey iling te weyig)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a level is how high or how much something is

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our village is high above sea level, so it gets quite cold sometimes.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The table is only at knee-level.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has a very high-level job in the company.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are high levels of sugar in their diet.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I got to level 2 in that game on my cellphone.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two things are level with one another, they are as high as each other (the same height), or as much as each other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The two team's scores are level: it's 20 all.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The two runners are now level, and I'm not sure who's going to win.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Make sure that the plate is level when you put food on it, or the food will fall off!

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sigurua nu ne ka platu malumpayag ke egtahuan nu te keenen seini, wey ke egkeulaan seini.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something levels another thing such as a building, it completely destroys it, so that it is not standing.

entries.summary: ubaten; etew ne eglalag te natahaan [nataha͡an] din kenè ne malehet

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ubaten; etew ne eglalag te natahaan [nataha͡an] din kenè ne malehet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who says things which they know are not true.

entries.summary: egdawat te masalig ne puhawang wey pamaahi; kenè amana egpalintutuuwan te mapahetpet ka igpasabut; dakel ne karakelan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egdawat te masalig ne puhawang wey pamaahi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone's thinking is liberal, they think that many different ideas and ways are okay. Some people think this is a positive quality, and other people think it is negative. A liberal is a person who thinks in this way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has very liberal ideas about training children.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due puhawang din ne iling kayi eyew te pegpanulù te me batè.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè amana egpalintutuuwan te mapahetpet ka igpasabut

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone's understanding of something is liberal, they don't follow the meaning strictly. A liberal is a person who thinks in this way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His explanation of the story was very liberal, because he said that it wasn't really true, but was just a picture.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegpasabut din te guhuren su amana rè ne iling kayi ne puhawang, su migkahi sikandin te seini warè amana kamalehetan, piru seeyè alung man dè degma.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A liberal amount of something is a large, generous amount.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He put a liberal amount of sugar in my coffee, so that it was very sweet.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtahù sikandin te dakel ne sukal te kepi ku, sika ka amana ne meemis.

entries.summary: kaligwangan
talagtameng te me libru.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who works in a library.

entries.summary: masalig ne grupu te me libru ne nanakatahù; tahuanan te me libru

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: masalig ne grupu te me libru ne nanakatahù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large group of books all kept together.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a place where many books are kept.

entries.summary: kalig-enan eyew te pegbehey te pegtuhut te peggimu te minsan nekey.; egbehey te pegtuhut

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kalig-enan eyew te pegbehey te pegtuhut te peggimu te minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a document which says that you can do something or have something (e.g., a driver's license).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If the government or an organization licenses you to do or have something, they give you permission to do or have it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The department licensed him to carry a gun.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka gubirnu migbehey kandin te pegtuhut te peg-uyan te sinapang.

entries.summary: supè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a top on a container that you can open or remove

entries.summary: eg-uubat; ubat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you lie to someone about something, you say something that you know is not true.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something you say which you know is not true (tell_a_lie).

entries.summary: eggibat; nekeyibat; nakatahù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you lie or lie_down somewhere, you move your body so that most of it is on the ground or another flat place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Stop running around! It's time to lie down and go to sleep.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or animal is_lying, most of their body is on the ground or another flat surface.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I saw the dog lying asleep on the floor.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakakita a te miglipereng ne asu ne nekeyibat diyè te seeg.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something lies somewhere, it is there in that place, and is not moving or doing anything.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His cellphone was lying on the table.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakatahù ka silpun ku diyè te lamisa.

entries.summary: umul; kinabuhi; pegkeuyag; pegkinabuhi; kaluhayan te timpu egkeuyag wey ke egkahamit

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that something is alive, and doing the things that living things do (e.g., using energy, growing).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A stone does not have life.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the time between when you are born and when you die, and all the things that happen in that time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My grandmother had a very long life.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due malayat ne pegkeuyag te Inè ne buyag ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Life is very difficult for them.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegkinabuhi dan amana ne malised.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kaluhayan te timpu egkeuyag wey ke egkahamit

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The life of something such as a battery is the amount of time which it exists or can be used.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My cellphone has a long battery life.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is full of life, they have a lot of energy and they are usually talkative and friendly.

entries.summary: eggenat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you lift something, you hold it and move it higher.

entries.summary: layag; malayag; sulù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the brightness which helps us to see things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If there is a full moon, there is a lot of light at night.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a place is light, there is brightness there, so that you can see.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's only 5pm, so it's still light.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There were many lamps, so the room was quite light.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something such as a lamp or candle, which you can use to see in a dark place.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: When you light something which can burn (e.g., a fire, a match, a candle), you cause it to start burning.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nateil ne peg-agseb (meyitenged te minsan nekey)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you see something in a particular light, you have a particular opinion about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: At first I didn't like him much, but as I came to know him better I began to see him in a different light.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te hun-a kena a egkeupian kandin, piru te neila kud amana sikandin migbunsud a mig-agseb te lein-lein diyè te kandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a colour is light, it is pale, not strong or dark (e.g., light blue).

entries.summary: maagkap; kenè ne maheteng; meyimulung

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something light is not heavy, and has a small weight.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something light is not serious or deep (e.g., light entertainment)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A light action is not strong (e.g., a light touch).

entries.summary: parekketan
egkeupian (meyitenged te meupiya ne eggeramen); egkeupian (meyitenged te igkeupii ne butang wey ke himuwen)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you like someone or something, you have a good feeling about them. If you like to do something, or like doing it, you enjoy doing it.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkeupian (meyitenged te igkeupii ne butang wey ke himuwen)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you would like something, you want it. If you would like to do something, you want to do it. Would_like is more polite than want.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'd [I would] like to buy some bread.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian a ne egbebeli te paan [pa͡an].

entries.summary: pekeiling; iling; iling (eyew te panunggilingan); iling te; hendue te

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is like another thing, it is similar to that other thing.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Pekeiling sikandin ne eglalag-lalag te amey rin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use like to give an example

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I bought a few things, like soap and salt.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbebeli a te deisek ne me kasangkapan, iling te sebun wey asin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use like to say what something seems to be.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She looks like she is sick.

entries.summary: egkamalehet buwa iya; kamenu karakel ka timpu ne egkeyitabù ka minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is likely to happen, or if it is likely that something will happen, it will probably happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's likely to rain this afternoon, because it is very hot.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kamenu karakel ka timpu ne egkeyitabù ka minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The likelihood of something happening is how much chance there is that it will happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What is the likelihood of it raining this afternoon?

entries.summary: eg-alahè (meyitenged te kenè eg-amanaan [eg-amana͡an]); tamananan; katamanan (meyitenged te pulipusan); ilis; keepusan; pupul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you limit something, you don't allow it to be more than a particular amount or level.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You should limit the amount of sugar that you eat, because too much sugar is not good for you.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the maximum of something (e.g., an amount or level) which you can't have more than.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Two cups of coffee per day is my limit; if I have more, I can't sleep well.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a two-hour time limit for the exam.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: katamanan (meyitenged te pulipusan); ilis; keepusan; pupul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The limits of an area are the edges of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Please stay within the limits of the town. Don't go outside it.

entries.summary: lingya; malayat ne kasangkapan ne due nateil ne eggamitan; pegkateil te etew wey ke kasangkapan ne nalingya

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Please stand behind the yellow line.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: malayat ne kasangkapan ne due nateil ne eggamitan
