fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a long string or wire which has a particular job (e.g., fishing line, clothes line).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegkateil te etew wey ke kasangkapan ne nalingya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an arrangement of people or things next to each other or one after the other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We waited in a line at the shop.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: punduk te me lalag diyè te ulahingen wey ke diyè te balak

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of words in a song or poem.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I only know the first two lines of the song.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: bayaanan ne layun egbaybayei te me unturanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The way which a bus, train or ship regularly travels along.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I live on a bus line, so it is easy to catch the bus.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a way of thinking or behaving.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What line of action will you take in this situation: what will you do?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekey ne pamaahi wey weil ka eggamiten nu te seini ne keyimtang: nekey ka eggimuwen nu?.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpeilis diyè te lein ne butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing lines another thing, it is all around the edges of that other thing (e.g., paper lines a box, people line the streets).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: People lined the streets to watch the parade.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me etew migpeilis te kelesadda su egtengteng te parid.

entries.summary: egpegsumpul; egsumpul; egsuman-suman ne due kalabetan te tagsè sabeka kandan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something links two things, it connects them in some way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This road links Davao and Cagayan.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ne kelesadda ka nekegsumpul te Dabaw wey Kagayan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That road is the link between Davao and Calinan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egsuman-suman ne due kalabetan te tagsè sabeka kandan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you link two things in your mind, you believe that there is some relationship between them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Many people link rain with sickness.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Masalig ne etew ne impalintutuu ne ka uran ka aliddanan te me dalu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka sabeka ne butang iyan aliddanan te sabeka ne butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If there is a link between two things, one thing causes the other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a strong link between smoking and lung cancer.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due makeseg ne kalabetan te pegpanihupan wey te dalu te bahè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one of the pieces of a chain.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kedina due pitun pulù ne sumpul.

entries.summary: bibig

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the soft part at the top and bottom where your mouth opens. We have two lips: an upper lip and a lower lip.

entries.summary: langun ne ula-ula ne egkeiling te weyig minsan nekey ne batek.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: langun ne ula-ula ne egkeiling te weyig minsan nekey ne batek.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a substance which can move like water.

entries.summary: grupu te mallepet ne kanengnengan ne layun igsulat te diralem te duma; listaan [lista͡an]; eglista

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: grupu te mallepet ne kanengnengan ne layun igsulat te diralem te duma; listaan [lista͡an]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of short pieces of information, often written one under the other

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She wrote a list of names of people who she needed to speak to.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you list pieces of information, you write or say them one after the other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She listed the names on a piece of paper.

entries.summary: egpammineg; egpalintutuu; egpammineg

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you listen_to a sound, you focus your ears and mind on that thing.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you listen_to someone, you think or act differently because of what they tell you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her children are very bad, and don't listen to her.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She usually listens to her brother's advice.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of light.

entries.summary: sinulat ne due keupiya wey mabantug te masalig ne katuihan; sinulat meyitenged te nateil ne kanengnengan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sinulat ne due keupiya wey mabantug te masalig ne katuihan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Written things such as poetry and novels which are very good quality, and so are famous for many years.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her books are not really literature, but they are fun to read.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sinulat meyitenged te nateil ne kanengnengan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: written things about a particular subject.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Doctors need to read a lot of medical literature.

entries.summary: deisek; deisek dè (meyitenged te karakelan); dagdahew rè; deisek dè (meyitenged te weil)

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Meupiya seini se deisek ne baley.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use little before an uncount noun to talk about a small amount of something. It has a negative feeling, because you are focusing on what is lacking.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have little money, so I can't afford to buy that.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Duen dè deisek ne seleppì ku, sika ka kenè e rè egpekeutel due.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: dagdahew rè; deisek dè (meyitenged te weil)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use little after a verb to say that an action isn't very much, or doesn't happen often. It has a negative feeling, because you are focusing on what is lacking.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She slept little, so she feels very tired.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakaragdahew rè nakalipereng sikandin, sika ka amana nabeley sikandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use a_little before an adjective to say that something isn't very much.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm a little tired, but it's no problem.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Bayew a nabeley, piru warè prublima.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use a_little before an uncount noun to talk about a small amount of something. It has a positive feeling, because you are focusing on what is there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have a little money, so I can buy that.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due ubag deisek ne seleppì ku, sika ka egpakabeli a due.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use a_little after a verb to say that the action isn't very much, or doesn't happen very often. A_little has a positive feeling, because you are focusing on what is done.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She slept a little, so she doesn't feel too tired.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakarallut sikandin nakalipereng, sika ka kenè amana sikandin egpakaheram te pegkabeley.

entries.summary: eg-ugpè; egkeuyag; neuyag pad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you live in a house, town, or country, that is your home.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you live, you have life, and are not dead.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It was a very bad accident, but I think he will live.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Dereeti seeyè ne pangitabù, piru te suman-suman ku egkeuyag ded sikandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My grandmother lived until she was 90.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Neuyag ka inè ku ne buyag taman te siyew ne pulù ka idad din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A live animal or plant is not dead.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They sell live pigs, so you need to kill the pigs yourself.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpamelegyè sikandan te neuyag pad ne babuy, sika ka keilangan ne sikeykew pad ka eggimatey.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkakita wey egkarineg (iling te tibi wey radyu) te timpu te pegpakita wey pegparineg.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A live television or radio program is heard on the TV or radio at the same time that it is made. In a live performance, you watch a real person or group performing, not a recording.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The Mangulahing band is going to perform live in our village.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka Mangulahing ne grupu egpakita te katuenan ne egkakita ta diyè te bariyu ney.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A live wire has electric current in it.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: guhuren ne masalig ka me puhawang puun te me etew wey ke masalig ka egkeupian ne eglalahen seini.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A live topic is something that a lot of people have opinions about or want to talk about.

entries.summary: atey
bakutungen; binabaan; dinulanan; karga; egpababa; egpatiang; egpabakutung; egparulan; egpakarga; egbabala

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the thing which a person, animal or thing is carrying.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The carabao moved slowly because it had a heavy load.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mananey ka kalabew su mabehat ka dinulanan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you load a person, animal or vehicle with something, or load something onto a person, animal or vehicle, you put it on the person, animal or vehicle so that they will carry it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They loaded the truck with sacks.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ingkargaan [ingkarga͡an] dan ka terak te sinaku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They loaded the sacks onto the truck.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ingkarga ran ka me sinaku diyè te terak.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you load a weapon such as a gun, you put bullets in it so it is ready to use.

entries.summary: egpasambayan ka minsan nekey diyè te duma; peggamit wey ke pegsambey te minsan nekey ne impangamuney te senge etew; insambayan ne seleppì

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpasambayan ka minsan nekey diyè te duma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you loan something to someone, or loan someone something, you say that they can borrow it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My brother doesn't have a bike, but I always loan my bike to him.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka suled ku warè baskilita, piru layun ku egpasambayi ka baskilita ku kandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My brother doesn't have a bike, but I always loan him my bike.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peggamit wey ke pegsambey te minsan nekey ne impangamuney te senge etew

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Can I have a loan of your bike, because mine is broken.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: money that you borrow from someone.

entries.summary: minsan nekey ne diyè dè te nateil ne inged; etew ne nangugpè te in-ugpaan nu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne diyè dè te nateil ne inged

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something local is in and around a particular place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When I went to the dentist, he gave me a local anaesthetic in my mouth.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The damage from the flood was only local, and the people in the next barangay didn't have any problems.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I bought some of the local coffee when I visited the village.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: etew ne nangugpè te in-ugpaan nu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who lives in the area where you are

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you can't find the building, ask one of the locals.

entries.summary: egkakita; egtahù; egtukud; nakatahù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you locate something, you find it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My friend told me where her house is, but I just can't locate it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka alukuy ku migpanugtul keddì ke hendei ka baley ran, piru warè ku nakita.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you locate something somewhere (e.g., a building), you put it there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They located the school on the hill.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtukud dan ka iskuylaan diyè te bubungan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is_located somewhere, that is where it is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The school is located on the hill.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an] nakatahù diyè te bubungan.

entries.summary: natahuan; pegtahù; pegtukud; pegpamitew

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't know the exact location of his house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Wara a nakataha ke hendei ka natahuan te baley rin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of putting something big somewhere (e.g. a building).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't understand their location of the building so far from the village.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of finding where something is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The location of the lost child took some time.

entries.summary: paggul; egpaggulan; eglekeban; egkasanggel te nateil ne pegkatahù wey kenè egkaweil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a thing which you put on something such as a door, so that people can't open it without a key.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you lock something such as a door, you use a lock (sense 1), so that people can't open it without a key.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkasanggel te nateil ne pegkatahù wey kenè egkaweil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something locks, it stops in a certain position and can't move from that position.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The motorbike rider stopped suddenly, and the wheels of his bike locked.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sahuhunè ne migsanggel ka mig-untud te mutur, ne ka me ligid te mutur din nasanggel wey warad natileng.

entries.summary: baley ne egpanggirehaan te egpangirehè ne due me seleppì.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: baley ne egpanggirehaan te egpangirehè ne due me seleppì.

entries.summary: kayu
kukuman wey ilinganan te suman-suman

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the rules and patterns of thinking which someone uses to understand and decide things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is always raining when I want to go out, but it's not good logic to say that my plans cause the rain.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Malasi eg-uran ke egkeupian a ne egligwang, piru kenè ne meupiya ne eggeenduen [egge͡enduen] a ne ka planu ku iyan aliddanan te uran.

entries.summary: meupiya wey due karuan ne suman-suman

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: meupiya wey due karuan ne suman-suman

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If thinking is logical, it is good and makes sense.

entries.summary: kalangè
malayat; kalayat; naluhey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something long has a large measurement from one end to the other.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use long to give the measurement of something from one end to the other.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kamenu kalayat ka ban ne terak?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kalayat te terak ne ban su tatelu ne mitrus.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something long takes a lot of time.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use long to say how much time something continues for.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kaluhayan te miting su tatelu ne uras.

entries.summary: amana egkeupian

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you long for something, or long to do something, you want that thing very much.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm so thirsty! I'm longing for a drink of water.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkamaraan [egkamara͡an] a! Amana a egkeupian ne eg-inum te weyig.

entries.summary: egpitew; egtengteng; egsumsumanen; 1 pegpitew; 2 pegsuman-suman

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you look_at something, you focus your eyes on that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Why are you looking at me?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you look_at something such as a question or problem, you think about it or work on it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We need to look at the question of where to store the rice.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you look_for someone or something, you try to find them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm looking for my brother. Do you know where he is?

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: iling te wey ke hendue te (meyitenged te nakita)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something looks a certain way, you think it is that way because of what you see.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It looks as if it will rain.

entries.summary: Magbebayè; Magbebayè ne Manama
egkalaag; egkatarin; nalingawan ke hendei nakatahù ka minsan nekey; egkareeg; egkatalu; egkapildi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you lose something, you don't have it any more, maybe because of an accident, or because someone took it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He lost all his corn in the storm.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Natarin ka ahelayan din te baggiyu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She lost her eyesight when she got older.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He lost his job because the company closed.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I lost my cellphone when I visited Davao, but I don't know where.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nalingawan ke hendei nakatahù ka minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you lose something, you don't know where it is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I've lost my key. Can you help me to find it please?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nalingawan ku ke hendei ku ingkatahù ka yabi. Kaayun ded ubag ne egbulihan a ni kuna te egpamitew?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you lose something such as a game, another person or group is more successful than you, and has better result than you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We lost the game because the other team were much better than us.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nareeg ki te galew su ka duma ne grupu me-mateu kanta.

entries.summary: pegkatarin; pegkaawè; pegkatalu; pegkareeg; pegkapildi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of losing something, so that you don't have it any more.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was very sad about the loss of his cellphone.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of not winning a game or contest.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our team had three wins and two losses.

entries.summary: natarin; nalaag; nalingawan; nalaag te bayaan wey ke egpabulusan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of lose

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is lost, you don't have it any more, and can't get it back.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is lost, you don't know where it is.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nalaag te bayaan wey ke egpabulusan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is lost, they don't know where they are, and don't know where to go.

entries.summary: punduk te etew wey ke kasangkapan; tanè ne impangamuney te etew; kulis

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: punduk te etew wey ke kasangkapan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of people or things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This is the second lot of people who have visited the Barangay hall today.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ka ikaruwa ne punduk te me etew ne nakabisita te Barangay Hall.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She bought two lots of eggs, because one lot was not enough.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an area of land which someone can own.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They bought a lot and started to build a house.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My aunt says that it is her lot in life to have no children.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pamaahi te peggimu te puhawang in-ilingan wey ke intengtengan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the system of making decisions in which people choose without looking from a group of pieces of paper (choose_something_by_lot).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The leader was chosen by lot.

entries.summary: masulug; masalig; dakel; layun egkeyitabù wey ke amana rè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large amount or number of something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is not busy, so she has a lot of free time.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè himu rin, su masalig ka bakanti ne timpu rin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She works a lot, so is busy.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: layun egkeyitabù wey ke amana rè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happens a lot, it happens often, or very much.

entries.summary: makeseg (meyitenged te dahing)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A loud sound is a big sound.

entries.summary: eggeyinawaan; geyinawa; igkeupii te eggimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you love a person or animal, you have a deep feeling about them, and you want good for them.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a deep feeling about a person or animal who is very important to you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I really appreciate my best friend's love.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you love something, or love_doing something, you like or enjoy it very much

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling of liking or enjoying something very much.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My love of reading started when I was a young child.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegkeupii ku te pegbasa migbunsud te deisek e pad ne batè.

entries.summary: mababew; malepet; malibutut; deisek (meyitenged te seked wey ke palinneu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something low is not as far as usual above the ground or floor (e.g. a low roof).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The ceiling of the house is quite low, so we need to bend our heads in the house.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something low has a small measurement from bottom to top (e.g., a low table or fence).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: deisek (meyitenged te seked wey ke palinneu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something that you can measure is low, the measurement or level is small, or smaller than usual (e.g., temperature, speed, water level).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Sometimes we have quite low temperatures at night here in the mountains.

entries.summary: due sabeka ne lalag
due lalag
suwirti
aperu
paniudtu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the meal in the middle of the day.

entries.summary: bahè
mekina

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which is made of different parts, and which does a particular job. It usually needs a power source such as electricity or gas.

entries.summary: belù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of make

entries.summary: pamaahi te pegpeuyan te sulat; me sulat wey me parsil ne migpapeendiyè [migpape͡endiyè] te duma; egpeuyan te sulat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a country's system for sending letters and parcels.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He sent me a letter by mail

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me sulat wey me parsil ne migpapeendiyè [migpape͡endiyè] te duma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: letters and parcels which are sent.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you mail something such as a letter, you put a stamp on it and send it.

entries.summary: kinewun-aan [kinewun-a͡an] wey amana ne keilangan; bubuyahen ne tubu ne nakapataltaliwarè te weyig wey ke wayir ne nakapataliwarè te sistima te ilitrik; sumpul ne egpamehey te weyig wey ke kurinti

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the main thing is the most important one.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The main street in the town has many cars.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: bubuyahen ne tubu ne nakapataltaliwarè te weyig wey ke wayir ne nakapataliwarè te sistima te ilitrik

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the large pipe at the center of a water system, or wire at the centre of an electric system.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The houses in the street don't have water because the main is broken.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me kabbalayan ilis te kelesadda warè weyig su nareetan ka bubuyahen ne tubu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sumpul ne egpamehey te weyig wey ke kurinti

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Mains is a network for sending something such as water or electricity to houses.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our house is connected to mains electricity.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka baley ney nakasumpul te egpamehey te kurinti.

entries.summary: eg-ayad-ayaran layun; eg-upianan layun; egtanggu; eg-atiman; egpabulbulusan egkahiya; egpabulbulusan eglalaha

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you maintain something such as a vehicle, you continue to care for it so that it goes well or is in good condition.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They maintain the path to their village well, so it is a very good path.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Layun dan upiani ka dalan te bariyu ran, sika ka amana meupiya.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She maintains her fitness by walking every day.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you maintain someone, you provide them with the things they need to live.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He maintains his sister's family because they are poor.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtanggu rin ka pamilya te atebey rin su egkaleig-leig nahud sikandan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you maintain that something is true, you continue to say that it is true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He maintains that he didn't steal the rice.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpabulbulusan din kahiya ne warè iya migpanakew sikandin te behas.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She has always maintained that she doesn't want to get married.

entries.summary: peg-ayad-ayad layun; peg-upiya layun;; seleppì ne layun igbehey wey ke bayad ne egkeilanganen eyew egkeuyag.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of caring for something so that it goes well, or is in good condition.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Owning a motorbike is expensive, because you need to pay for gas and maintenance.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: seleppì ne layun igbehey wey ke bayad ne egkeilanganen eyew egkeuyag.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the money which a person regularly gives to provide someone with the things that they need to live.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father pays maintenance to my aunt every month, because she is a widow.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka amey ku egbehey te seleppì te tagsè bulan diyè te ayè ku, su balu sikandin.

entries.summary: kinarakelan wey keilangan; sabdyik ne egbehayan nu te dakel ne uras; egbehayan te dakel ne uras ne sabdyik

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A major thing is very large or important.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This is a major road, so there are a lot of trucks.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ka kinarakelan ne kelesadda, sikak masalig ne me terak.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That school is the major school in our area, although there are some other smaller ones too.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sabdyik ne egbehayan nu te dakel ne uras

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In a general college course where you can choose subjects, your major is the area of study which you choose to focus on.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is studying science with a major in biology.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbehayan te dakel ne uras ne sabdyik

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In a general college course, if you major in an area of study, that is the area of study which you choose to focus on.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is going to major in biology in his science course.

entries.summary: kinarakelan ne baad te langun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large part of a whole group of people or things (more than 50% of the group).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The majority of people here can swim.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kinarakelan te me etew kayi egkateu ne eglumbuk.

entries.summary: eggimu; egpehes; egpekeyimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you make something, you cause it to exist (by using other things or putting them together).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father made a seat for our house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka amey ku miggimu te pinnuuwan para te baley ney.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you make someone do something, you force them to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His mother always makes him help in the garden.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Layun egpehes ka iney rin ne egpabulig kandin te gulayan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something makes you do something, it causes you to do that thing. If something makes you ADJECTIVE, it causes you to be that way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The good news made me happy.

entries.summary: lukes; lumansad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a human or animal that can cause the eggs of a female to develop into babies; a plant or part of a plant that can cause a female plant to produce fruit.

entries.summary: lukes (buyag-buyag e); me etew

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My brother is only fourteen; he is not a man yet.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the human species, including both males and females. Also called mankind.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Man is very different from the animals.

entries.summary: egpekeeleg te minsan malised; egpakakaya te minsan malised; egkeuyag; egpakateil wey ke egpakaalahè (meyitenged te pegteil wey peg-alahè te uras wey seleppì)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpekeeleg te minsan malised; egpakakaya te minsan malised

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you manage to do something, you are able to do it, even though it is difficult.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The river was deep but they managed to cross it together.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Maralem ka weyig piru nakalapas ded langun sikandan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you manage, you are able to survive or continue, even though it is difficult.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We don't have much money, but we manage.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè amana seleppì ney, piru neuyag key red.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Your house is so far from water. How do you manage?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mariyù amana ne weyig ka baley niyu. Menuwen niyu te egkeuyag?

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakateil wey ke egpakaalahè (meyitenged te pegteil wey peg-alahè te uras wey seleppì)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you manage something such as time or money, you control it or organize it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She has many things to do, but she manages her time very well, so she is able to do everything.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Masalig amana ka eggimuwen din, piru amana rin egkaalahè ka uras din, su egpekeyimu pad sikandin te minsan nekey.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-uyan wey ke egpapallahuy (iling te nigusyu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you manage something such as a business, you control and organize it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The son managed the store after his father became sick.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka anak ka mig-uyan te tindaan dan te pegderalu te amey rin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of controlling or organizing people or things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She has excellent money management skills.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne meupiya sikandin ne egpaneil te seleppì.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the people who control a company.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't have authority to do that; I'll have to check with management.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè katenged ku te peggimu due; eg-inseen ku pad diyè te talag-uyan.

entries.summary: pamaahi te peggimu; pamaahi te peglalag wey pegweil-weil; me pamaahi te peg-addat te kukuman (iling te eglalag ne egkeen)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A manner of doing something is a way of doing it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They did the job in a fast, lazy manner, so the result was not good.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A person's manner is the way that they speak and act.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She has a quiet, gentle manner.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me pamaahi te peg-addat te kukuman (iling te eglalag ne egkeen)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your manners are the way that you obey social rules about things such as eating and speaking.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is good manners to say 'please' and 'thank you'.

entries.summary: egpangimu te masalig; pegpangimu te masalig; eggimu-himu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a place such as a factory manufactures something, they produce a lot of it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kumpanya ne egpangimuwanan te me te gatas.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of a factory producing something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The manufacture of paper uses a lot of water.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegpangimu te pepil egpakaamin te dakel ne weyig.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you manufacture something such as a reason, you create one that is not true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He manufactured an excuse for being late, but it was not true.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggimu-himu sikandin te aliddanan te namewuri te klasi, piru kenè ne malehet.

entries.summary: kasuluhan; masalig; masulug; subla; pilaa (eg-insè te kasalig)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use many with a count noun to talk about a large number.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè amana kasuluhan te libru ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Many of my friends can play the guitar.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use many_more when you are comparing numbers of things, to say that there is a big difference in number.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are many more mangoes on the tree now than before.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Subla ne masulug ka behas te mangga kuntee kunterè te dengan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use the question how_many to ask about the number of things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: How many brothers do you have?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use too_many if there are more things than there should be, so there is a problem.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are too many people on that motorbike, so it's dangerous.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne masalig ka etew ne nanguntud te mutur, sikak dilikadu.

entries.summary: mapa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a picture which shows where things are (e.g., houses, mountains, rivers).

entries.summary: Marsu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the third month of the year

entries.summary: tagsè ilis te pepil ne warè sulati; ilis; tammanan; kulang wey ke labew

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: tagsè ilis te pepil ne warè sulati

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: On paper, the margins are the spaces around the writing on each side of the paper.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Leave a wide margin on the left side of the page, so that the teacher can write comments.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the edge of or limit of something (e.g., an area).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They live right on the margins of the town, so they are far from the market.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-ugpè sikandan te ilis te lungsud, sika ka mariyù sikandan te palingki.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He stayed on the margins of the basketball court, and didn't join in the game much.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: People with mental illness are often on the margins of society, and are lonely.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the difference between two amounts or numbers.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The team won the game by a margin of 8 points.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka punduk migdeeg te walu ne labew te nakuwa.

entries.summary: kenè amana ne dakel wey keilangan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè amana ne dakel wey keilangan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is marginal, it is not very big or important.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are some marginal differences between the two things, but they are very similar.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due kenè amana ne dakel ne kaleinan te daruwa ne kasangkapan, piru amana sikandan nekeg-iling.

entries.summary: due nakapulit ne malindit; tapil; tuus; egpulitan; egsulatan; egbaglisan; palinneu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due nakapulit ne malindit; tapil; tuus

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A mark on a surface is a small area which looks different. Maybe someone put it there (e.g., a pencil mark or a question mark), or maybe it was an accident (e.g., a spot on a shirt, or a scratch on a table).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You can't wear that shirt because there is a dirty mark on it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He kicked the wall, and his black shoe left a mark on the wood.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She slapped my hand, and it left a red mark.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you mark a surface, you put a mark on it (see sense 1).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She marked the wall with a pencil to show how tall she was.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpulitan din ka alabat te lapis eyew egkakita ke kamenu kalayat sikandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She marked the book with her name, so that she would not lose it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migsulatan din ka libru te ngaran din, su eyew kenè egkatarin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you leave something wet on wood, it will mark the wood.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A punctuation mark is a symbol used in writing (e.g., a question mark (?), an exclamation mark (!)).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a particular level or number which someone or something reaches.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The floodwaters have reached the 1 meter mark.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka baggiyu te weyig nekeyinguma te sabeka ne mitru ne katamanan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The runner in the race reached the 200 meter mark very quickly.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something marks a particular position or place, it shows where it is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This fence marks the edge of our property.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ne alad ka tuus te ilis te impangamuney ney.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She used a piece of paper to mark her place in the book.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is a mark of another thing, it is a sign which shows that the other thing is real or is there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The ability to listen to advice is a mark of maturity.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka katuenan te pegpammineg te pegpanulù iyan sika palinneu te pegkatesan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The desire to serve others is one of the marks of a good leader.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A bad cough is one of the marks of tuberculosis.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something marks a person or thing as a particular type, it shows that they are that type of person or thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her accent marks her as a Matigsalug.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka peglituk din egpeila kandin ne Matigsalug iya.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eleg ne karakelan te tabak ne egkuen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a point that you get for a correct answer in a test.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This question is worth two marks.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: naangey ne karakelan te tabak puun te hinimuwan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the result that you get in a test or for a project.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What mark did you get in your test?

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbehey te eleg ne naangey ne karakelan wey ke kamenu keupiya ka himu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a teacher marks students' tests or work, she checks it and writes a number or letter to show how good it is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our teacher marked our tests and gave them back to us.

entries.summary: inged ne masalig ne nalibulung ne dereisek ne me tindaan [tinda͡an] ne egkabeliyan te masalig ne minsan nekey; palingki; grupu te me etew ne egbebeli wey ke ne egkaayun ne egbebeli te nateil ne egbeliyen; egpeila-ila te igbelegyè ne pruduktu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: inged ne masalig ne nalibulung ne dereisek ne me tindaan [tinda͡an] ne egkabeliyan te masalig ne minsan nekey; palingki

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a place which has many small shops where you can buy fresh foods and many other things.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: grupu te me etew ne egbebeli wey ke ne egkaayun ne egbebeli te nateil ne egbeliyen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the group of people why buy, or who may buy a particular product.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This product is aimed at the female market.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini ne pruduktu iyan tuyù ka me kamalmalitanan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The market for rice is much bigger in the Philippines than in Australia.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: 85% of the market for that product is here in the Philippines.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you market a product, you help to sell it by creating advertising

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The company is marketing that drink as a health drink.

entries.summary: peg-asawa; pegpaasaweey; kasal

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the relationship of a husband and wife.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka peg-asawa sengekakuwa malised ne himu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I went to the marriage of my friend.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggendiya a te kasal te alukuy ku.

entries.summary: eg-asawa; egpeg-asaweey; egpeg-asawa; egpegsewug; egpeg-amul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two people marry, they make promises in order to become husband and wife.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father married my mother 25 years ago.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father and mother married 25 years ago.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone with authority marries two people, he or she performs the ceremony in which the two people become husband and wife.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The pastor married my boyfriend and me.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you marry two things or ideas, you put them together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His songs marry tribal music and modern music.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two people get_married, they become husband and wife.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father and mother got married 25 years ago.

entries.summary: makehal ne karakelan te minsan nekey ne warè nateil ne ula-ula; kamenu ka karakelan wey ka kaluahan ne egkahamit; Eggamit ka seini ke eglalag ke te amana ne dakel wey ke susuluhi (ne minsan nekey).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: makehal ne karakelan te minsan nekey ne warè nateil ne ula-ula

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a solid quantity of something all together, with no special shape (e.g., a mass of rice).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kamenu ka karakelan wey ka kaluahan ne egkahamit

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the mass of something is how big it is, and how much space it uses.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We measured the mass of the basketball.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migseked ney ka kaluahan te baskitbulan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Eggamit ka seini ke eglalag ke te amana ne dakel wey ke susuluhi (ne minsan nekey).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use mass to talk about a very large amount of something, or a very large group of people (e.g., mass media, mass-production).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Mass-produced products from factories are cheaper.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people or things mass together, they move together to make one large body.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The fish massed together when the sharks came.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miglibulung ka me peit te migginguma ka ihu.

entries.summary: himuwen diyè te simbaan [simba͡an] ne egkeen te paan [pa͡an] wey eg-inum te binu eyew te pegsuman-suman te kamatayen ni Hisus (seini ka igngaran te me Katuliku).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: himuwen diyè te simbaan [simba͡an] ne egkeen te paan [pa͡an] wey eg-inum te binu eyew te pegsuman-suman te kamatayen ni Hisus (seini ka igngaran te me Katuliku).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In the Catholic church, the Mass is the name of the celebration in which people eat bread and drink wine to remember the death of Jesus. In other churches, this celebration is called Communion, Eucharist or Lord's Supper.

entries.summary: ahalen; egpakabeye-beyè te langun; kinewun-aan [kinewun-a͡an] ne neyimu ne iyan eg-ilingan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the man who owns and manages a place, slave or animal.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a light switch is the master, it is the one which controls all the others.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kinewun-aan [kinewun-a͡an] ne neyimu ne iyan eg-ilingan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a key or CD is the master, it is the original, which you can use to make copies.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you master something, you learn to do it very well.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She practiced the difficult song until she mastered it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbebasbasan din ka malised ne ulahingen taman te natu-tuenan din e.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use master to describe someone who has learned to do something very, very well.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a master guitar player.

entries.summary: ikam
egpekeg-eleg; egpeg-eleg; eleg

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing matches another thing, or two things match, they fit together well.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Your red shirt and green pants do not match.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you match things that are similar or connected, you fit them together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The police matched the footprints to the criminal's shoes.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: two things that fit together very well.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This key is a match for this lock.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: someone or something that is as good as another person or thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can run faster than everyone else, but my brother is my match.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpakapallahuy a te iiyali te minsan hentew pad, piru ka suled ku ka keiling ku.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: galawen iling te baskitbul wey ke balibul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a sports event such as a game of basketball or volleyball.

entries.summary: pulitu te sipuru

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a small piece of wood with a chemical at one end, which you use to make fire.

entries.summary: kasangkapan (meyitenged te impanggamit te pegpangimu); butang; manggad; minsan nekey ne egamiten nu te nateil ne peggamit

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kasangkapan (meyitenged te impanggamit te pegpangimu); butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that a thing is made of.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The materials for this house are bamboo, wood and tin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She bought some material to make a skirt.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne egamiten nu te nateil ne peggamit

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you can use for a particular purpose (e.g., reading material, writing material).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The dentist has some reading material in the waiting room: a few magazines and newspapers.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She bought some writing materials such as pens and paper.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka egkakita wey egkasamsam (kenè ne labet ka me sumansuman wey ka me ispirituwanen kayi te inged)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something material is something which you can see and touch, so does not include thoughts and the spiritual world.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a fact is material, it is useful or important to know or think about.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is not material whether you needed the money or not. It was just not right to steal it.

entries.summary: Eg-iskuylaan ne eglalag meyitenged te me pegseel.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Eg-iskuylaan ne eglalag meyitenged te me pegseel.

entries.summary: kasangkapan; pangitabù, labi en iya ke due prublima; ka minsan nekey ne keilangan ne egsumsumanen wey egtinesen.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: anything which things in the universe are made of.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pangitabù, labi en iya ke due prublima

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that happened, especially if there was a problem.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He told me about the whole matter, and asked for my help.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mignangenan a nikandin te langun ne pangitabù, wey migpabulig keddì.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka minsan nekey ne keilangan ne egsumsumanen wey egtinesen.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which you need to think about or fix.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We discussed the matter of payment, and fixed an amount.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something matters, it is important.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It doesn't matter if you don't finish it today.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenen keilangan ke kenè nu eg-impusan kuntee seini.

entries.summary: egpamaluahen; egparakelen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you maximize something, you cause it to be as large as possible.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I catch the bus early to maximize my time in Quezon.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-untud a te unturan te seselemi eyew dakel ka timpu ku diyè te Kisun.

entries.summary: kinarakelan; pinakarakel

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That van can carry a maximum of ten people.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sika ne unturanan egpekeuyan te kinarakelan ne me sapulù ne etew.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The temperature reached a maximum of 30 degrees.

entries.summary: Mayu (ngaran te bulan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fifth month of the year

entries.summary: duwa-ruwa; kema buwa ke; kema ke; kaayun (eyew te egbuyù wey ke egbehey te pegtuhut); perem (eyew te peglalag ne mapahetpet ne igkeupii te egginguma ne timpu)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: duwa-ruwa; kema buwa ke; kema ke

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something may be the case or may happen, perhaps it is the case or will happen, or perhaps not.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I may visit her this afternoon, but it depends on the weather.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kema ke egleuy a kandin kangkuwa te maapun [ma͡apun], piru egpitawen ku pad ka timpu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She may have your book, so you should ask her.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kaayun (eyew te egbuyù wey ke egbehey te pegtuhut)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use may to ask if you are allowed to do something, or to say that someone can do something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Q: May I please borrow your bike? A: Yes, you may.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Q: Kaayun a ne egsambey te bayik nu? A: Uya, egkaayun.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: perem (eyew te peglalag ne mapahetpet ne igkeupii te egginguma ne timpu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use may to say a strong wish about the future.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: May you two have a very happy life together.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Perem sikaniyu se daruwa due meupiya ne pegparumdumeey [pegparudume͡ey].

entries.summary: kema buwa ke

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use maybe to say that it is possible that something is true or will happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Maybe he is there, but I don't know.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kema buwa ke diyè sikandin, piru wara a nakataha.

entries.summary: keenen
igpasabut; eggimuwen ne due tuyù; para (meyitenged pegbehey wey ke peggamit)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you mean something, that is the message that you want to communicate. If something means something, that is the message that it communicates.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You misunderstood me; I didn't mean that I wanted to leave now.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Bad weather here in Mindanao often means that there is a typhoon in Manila.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you mean to do something, you do it because you want and choose to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He meant to step on your foot! It was not an accident.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Intuyuan din iya te egdiek ka paa nu ne! Kenè mulè ne aksidinti rè.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Oh, I'm sorry! I didn't mean to step on your foot! It was an accident.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Tuwey, pasayluwa a, warè ku tuyua ne egdiekan ku ka paa nu! Aksidinti rè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is_meant for a particular person or purpose, you want to give it to that person or use it for that purpose.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Don't eat that bread! It's not meant for you.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ne duen naa (egpuunan ke mania te due ka duma ne butang)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something means another thing, it causes that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If it rains a lot, it means that we will have a flood.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke eg-uran seini te dakel, ne duen naa baggiyu.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke masulug ka manuk masulug naa degma ka atelug.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something means something to you, it is important to you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This bracelet means a lot to me because my best friend gave it to me.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini ne bulawan due keimpurtanti kayi te keddiey su imbehey seini te telek ne alukuy ku.

entries.summary: mareet; kenè ne meupiya (su egpakapasakit te etew); leheren; deisek (meyitenged te karakelan)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mareet; kenè ne meupiya (su egpakapasakit te etew)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A mean person or action is not kind, and hurts people.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She cried because her brother said something mean to her.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A mean person does not like to spend or share things (especially money).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A mean amount is very small.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They only received a mean amount of rice each, so they were hungry.

entries.summary: ka eglihawang ne seel puun te egpegtimulen ne me grupu te me numiru wey igdibayid te langun ne seel.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka eglihawang ne seel puun te egpegtimulen ne me grupu te me numiru wey igdibayid te langun ne seel.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the average number (which you find by adding a group of numbers together and dividing the total by how many numbers there are).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The number of people who attend varies from week to week, but the mean is about 15.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of mean (1)

entries.summary: taheed
eleg-eleg
egseked; paseked; seked

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you measure something, you use something (e.g., a ruler) to find out the exact size or level of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He used his hand to measure the size of the table.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which you use to find the size or level of a thing (e.g., a tape measure, a 1-cup measure).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a number which says what size something is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What are the measurements of that building?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The measurement of an earthquake needs special equipment.

entries.summary: karni

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the bodies of animals, used as food

entries.summary: baad-baad te mekina ne eggimu te nateil ne eggimuwen; pamaahi ne eggamiten eyew te peggimu te nateil ne kasangkapan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: baad-baad te mekina ne eggimu te nateil ne eggimuwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of moving parts which do a particular action in a machine.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a problem with the brake mechanism on my motorbike.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pamaahi ne eggamiten eyew te peggimu te nateil ne kasangkapan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the method that is used to do a particular thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Vomiting is the body's mechanism for removing something bad from the stomach.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka peg-iileb su sabeka seini ne pamaahi te lawa para te peg-awè te minsan nekey ne memaddeet puun te getek.

entries.summary: egpataliwarè; pegpataliwarè; tigpataliwarè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you mediate between two people or groups who are fighting, you are the one between them, who helps them to stop fighting.

entries.summary: due kalabetan te peglelawa te me etew wey ka himu te pegbawì

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due kalabetan te peglelawa te me etew wey ka himu te pegbawì

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something medical is related to people's health problems, and to the work of treating them.

entries.summary: bawì; delemetan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the things which a sick person eats or drinks to help their body.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the area of knowledge related to sickness and health. You study this to become a doctor.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My brother finished studying medicine last year, so now he is a doctor.

entries.summary: egpeg-il-ileey [egpeg-il-ile͡ey]; egpekeg-ila-ila; egpekegsinug-ung; egpekegkita; egpasinug-ungey; egpakiteey; egpalamlambahey; egliblibulung

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one person meets another person, they talk to each other for the first time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My best friend and I met when we were 12 years old.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka telek ne alukuy ku nekeg-ila-ila key te dusi anyus key pad.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I met many new friends when I visited the other town.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people who already know each other meet, they are in the same place at the same time. Maybe they planned it, or maybe not.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My sister and I met at the basketball court after school.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekegsinug-ung key te atebey ku diyè te baskitbulan pegke-impus te klasi.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I met my mother at the bus terminal when she came to Davao.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a group of people meet, they spend time together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The committee meets once a month.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me kumitiba egpalamlambahey kasabeka te senge bulan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakasinug-ung; egpekegsinug-ung; egpakasungkul; egpekegsungkul; egpakarengkek; egpekegdengkek; egpakabundul; egpekegbundul; egpakabahung; egpekegbahung; egpakaragket; egpekegdagket; egpekegdeeg

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a moving thing meets another thing, or the two things meet, they touch each other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The cup broke when it met the ground.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Napesè ka ubab te nakareeg te tanè.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakalambag; egpekeglambag; egpakasumpul; egpekegsumpul; egpakatupù; egpekegtupù; egpakatemu; egpekegtemu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a non-moving thing meets another non-moving thing, they are joined together (e.g. two roads).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The road to my village meets the highway soon after the river.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kelesadda peendiyè te bariyu ku egpekeglambag ded te dakel ne kelesadda ke diyad layun te dakel ne weyig.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you meet something such as a problem, you experience that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We met a lot of problems during our trip.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migsalerep key te dakel ne prublima te hipanew ney.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggimu ke nekey ka keilangan ne eggimuwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you meet a requirement, you do what that requirement says you need to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you are not at school, you don't meet the requirements for getting a student price.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke warè ka mig-iskuyla, kenè nu egkeyimu ka me keilangan eyew te pegkuwa te dasag te istudyanti.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He didn't pass his project, because he didn't meet the standard.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was some money, but not enough to meet our needs.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakasuhat (te igkeupii wey ke kenè igkeupii ne eggeramen)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something meets_with a particular feeling or reaction from people, that is how people feel about it or react towards it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her song met with cheers from the crowd.

entries.summary: egkaleney
karumaan [karuma͡an]; sakup; pegkaruma; langun ne karumaan [karuma͡an] te punduk

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person or thing who is part of a particular group.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that you are a member of a group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He stopped his membership of the team, because he didn't have time.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migsanggel sikandin te pegkaruma te grupu, su warè timpu rin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the people who are part of a group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This association has a membership of more than 200.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We will need to ask our membership what they want.

entries.summary: kalantus te pegtanud-tanud wey pegsuman-suman; minsan nekey ne neyitabù ne miglihad ne egkasuman-suman nu; pegsuman-suman te migpatey

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She has a very bad memory, and is always forgetting to do things.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne neyitabù ne miglihad ne egkasuman-suman nu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that happened in the past that you remember.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have some nice memories from when I was a child.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due memeupiya ne egkangasuman-suman ku puun te deisek e pad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The memory of someone who has died is the fact that people remember them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My grandmother's memory will continue for a long time.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: tahuanan te me kanengnengan diyè te kumpyutir

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the space on a computer where it keeps information.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That computer has a lot of memory, so I can put photos on it.

entries.summary: kaluklukesan
due kalabetan te suman-suman

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something mental is related to the mind (e.g., mental development, mental illness).

entries.summary: egkahi te ka minsan nekey ne iyan iya, wey meiyal ne pegkakahi, ne kenè amana egget-getengan.; eg-apil te ngaran; eglabet te ngaran; 1 pegkahi te minsan nekey; 2 pegkahi wey peg-apil te ngaran

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkahi te ka minsan nekey ne iyan iya, wey meiyal ne pegkakahi, ne kenè amana egget-getengan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you mention that something is the case, you say it briefly, in just a few words.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She mentioned that she had a headache.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migkahi rin ne masakit ka ulu rin.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-apil te ngaran; eglabet te ngaran

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you mention someone in a speech or piece of writing, you include their name.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The Barangay captain mentioned my father in his report.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kepitan miglabet te amey ku diyè te lalahen din.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegkahi te minsan nekey; 2 pegkahi wey peg-apil te ngaran

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of saying something or including someone's name (make_mention_of something).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She made no mention of the fact that she had a headache.

entries.summary: pameligyè
keyid-u; pegkeyid-u; hid-u; hiid-uwen [hi͡id-uwen]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: kindness to someone who is weak or in a bad situation.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The rich man showed mercy to the sick man by taking him to hospital.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka meyaman ne etew migpakita te pegkeyid-u te migderalu ne etew pinaahi te peg-uyan diyè te uspital.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A merciful person is kind and wants to help someone who is weak or in a bad situation.

entries.summary: dè; rè (kenè amana masalig wey ke dakel); dè; rè

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: dè; rè (kenè amana masalig wey ke dakel)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use mere to say that something is not very much or not very big. (used in formal language).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It was so cheap! We paid a mere 10 pesos for it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Baratu amana! Migbayad ki rè te sapulù ne pisu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She's a mere child, and is not yet ready to leave home.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use merely to show that something is less than you expected.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She didn't say anything, she merely looked at me.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè miglalag sikandin minsan nekey, migtetengteng dè sikandin keddì.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The roadworkers merely filled the hole with dirt.

entries.summary: guhuren te pegpakiglalag te minsan hentew

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: guhuren te pegpakiglalag te minsan hentew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you communicate to someone.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of meet

entries.summary: epad seini ne egngaranan nu ka sabeka ne butang te senge lein ne ngaran

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: epad seini ne egngaranan nu ka sabeka ne butang te senge lein ne ngaran

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an expression in which you say that one thing is another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is a tarsier [This means that she's a liar].

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Tinekak sikandin [ ka igpasabut kayi su ubaten sikandin].

entries.summary: pamaahi

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He catches fish using traditional methods.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpanguwa sikandin te peit ne eggamit te kinaraan ne pamaahi.

entries.summary: taliwarè; taltaliwarè (meyitenged te timpu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the center, the part of something which is between the sides and is an equal distance from the the sides (e.g. the middle of the road, the middle finger).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The dog is in the middle of the road.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka asu diyè te taliwarè te kelesadda.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The middle finger is in the middle of all the fingers.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka tinlelabew ne kemel nakapataliwarè te langun ne kemel.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Members of the middle class are not very, very rich, but not very poor.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sakup te elat-elat te meyaman wey amana ne pubri su kenè ne amana ne meyaman, piru kenè degma ne pubri amana.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the time between the first part and the last part of a period of time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She arrived in the middle of the afternoon, around 3pm.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migginguma sikandin te taltaliwarè te maapun [ma͡apun], me alas tris.

entries.summary: kema buwa ke; kema ke

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something might be the case or might happen, maybe it is the case or will happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She might have your book, but I'm not sure.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kema ke diyè te kandin ka libru nu, piru kena a ne siguradu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Don't be late because it might rain.

entries.summary: pegkamakeseg wey pegkamaresen; dereseni wey kekesehi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the state of being very strong and powerful.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In ancient times, many nations were destroyed by the might of the Roman army.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The door wouldn't open, so he gave it a mighty push to open it.

entries.summary: dagpù; langyaw

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who moves from one country to another to live.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are a lot of migrants from China in my area.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due masalig ne dagpù puun te China diyè te lugar ku.

entries.summary: eggalin eg-ugpè te duma ne inged; eggendiyè te duma ne inged ka me mananap tenged te lein-lein ne timpu.; 1 peggalin peg-ugpè te duma ne inged; 2 peggendiyè te duma ne inged tenged te lein-lein ne timpu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggalin eg-ugpè te duma ne inged

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you migrate, you move to another place or country to live.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My parents migrated from China to the Philippines thirty years ago.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ginikanan ku miggalin mig-ugpè puun te China kayi te Pilipinas te me tatelu-en pulu ne tuig.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggendiyè te duma ne inged ka me mananap tenged te lein-lein ne timpu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If birds or animals migrate, they move to a place with different weather at a certain time of the year.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In cold countries, some birds migrate to warmer places in winter.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 peggalin peg-ugpè te duma ne inged; 2 peggendiyè te duma ne inged tenged te lein-lein ne timpu

entries.summary: kabaluan
seked te kariyuan
gatas; eggedded

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you milk a female animal such as a carabao or goat, you get milk from it.

entries.summary: galingan; egpanggaling

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a place where you grind grains such as corn or rice.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you mill a grain, you grind it.

entries.summary: suman-suman; kenè igkeupii; eg-upianan; eg-ay-ayaran; egbantayan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the part of you which you use to think, understand and remember.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She told me, but it went straight out of my mind.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you mind something, you don't like it, and don't want it to happen. If you don't_mind something, it is OK for you if it happens.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Q: Do you mind if I open the window? A: No problem. I don't mind.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Q: Egkaayun ded ke eglukatan ku ka bintanà? A: Warè prublima. Kenen impurtanti keddì.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you mind something dangerous or breakable, you take care so that you do not hurt yourself or damage the thing.

fields.label: English example
