fields.text: Mind your head, as the doorway is very low.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Bantayi nu ka ulu nu, su mababew ka gemawan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Mind the step when you enter the building.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egtuganulen wey egtangguwen te malepet ne timpu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you mind someone or something, you care for them for a short time, usually when the person who owns them is not there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Could you please mind my children while I go to the shops.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use mind to tell someone that they need to do something because it is important

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Mind you don't forget to switch off the light.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are mindful of something, you remember it when you think or make a decision.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When you plan your day, be mindful of the fact that it may rain in the afternoon.

entries.summary: keddì
kinareisekan ne karakelan

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You need to get a minimum grade of 60% to pass in this subject.

entries.summary: pangulu; uluwan; egdumaan [egduma͡an] (meyitenged te dipartamintu te gubirnu); talagwali te guhuren te Manama; pastur; egtanggu wey egbulig

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pangulu; uluwan; egdumaan [egduma͡an] (meyitenged te dipartamintu te gubirnu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the leader of a government department (e.g., the Minister for Education).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: talagwali te guhuren te Manama; pastur

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you minister to someone who has a need or problem, you care for them and help them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When I was sick, my sister really ministered to me.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te pegderalu ku, ka atebey ku iyan amana migtanggu keddì.

entries.summary: nateil ne punduk te gubirnu; Kristuwanen ne himu te pegbulig

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a government department (which has a minister as its leader)(e.g., the Ministry of Education).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the things that a Christian person does to help others and their church.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His ministry is teaching Sunday School.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has a ministry to people in hospital.

entries.summary: kenè ne dakel wey kenè amana ne keilangan ne butang wey ke etew.; etew ne kenè pad egkaayun te nateil ne me butang

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè ne dakel wey kenè amana ne keilangan ne butang wey ke etew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A minor thing is not very large or important.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Don't worry, because it's just a minor problem.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ka kalaggew su deisek dè sika ne prublima.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is one of the minor leaders in the area.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: etew ne kenè pad egkaayun te nateil ne me butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who is not yet legally an adult, so they can't vote or buy alcohol.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is illegal to sell alcohol to a minor

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Supak te balaud ke egbebelegyè ki te inumen te me batè pad.

entries.summary: kasuluhan te etew wey ke minsan nekey ne deisek dè te 50 ne pursintu te langun ne kasuluhan.; grupu te me etew ne due lein ne linalahan, kultura wey ke rilihiyun puun te langun ne etew ke hendei nangugpè sikandan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kasuluhan te etew wey ke minsan nekey ne deisek dè te 50 ne pursintu te langun ne kasuluhan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a number of people or things which make less than 50% of the whole group

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are four boys in the family,and two girls, so she is in the minority.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: People who like milk are in the minority in that town, as most people drink coffee.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me etew ne eg-inum te gatas te sika ne lungsud warè dè nakatengè te me etew ne eg-inum te kepi.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: grupu te me etew ne due lein ne linalahan, kultura wey ke rilihiyun puun te langun ne etew ke hendei nangugpè sikandan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of people with a different language, culture or religion from most of the people where they live.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are a number of small tribal minorities living in that area.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Duen dè deisek ne me menubù ne mig-ugpè te sika ne inged.

entries.summary: minutu
amana ne deisek; minutu
kein-inuwan; egkeyitabù pinaahi te keinu-inuwan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a strange and amazing action (e.g., removing sickness), which is done using spiritual power.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something miraculous happens by a miracle.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Everyone was amazed by the sick woman's miraculous healing.

entries.summary: kenè egpekeuma wey ke kenè egpakasuhat; egpakakabus; egpekeipi; kenè egkakita wey ke kenè egkaangey; nakaseip; egkaalimengawan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè egpekeuma wey ke kenè egpakasuhat; egpakakabus; egpekeipi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you miss something, you are not able to reach it or hit it when you try to.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I missed the basket when I threw the basketball.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè egkakita wey ke kenè egkaangey; nakaseip

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you miss something, you are not able to see it or get it (maybe because you are too late, or can't go to it).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I missed the bus, so I had to wait for the next one.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakaseip ad te bas, sika ka egtetahad a te seup.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I missed the concert because I forgot about it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you miss someone or something, you feel sad because they are not there with you.

entries.summary: seyyup; egkaseyyup

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something wrong which you do (make_a_mistake). Maybe you do it by accident, or maybe because you don't know enough.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you mistake one thing for a second thing, you think (wrongly) that the first thing is the second thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My sister and I look similar, so a lot of people mistake me for her.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sikeddi wey ka atebey ku nekeg-iling, sika ka me etew egkaseyyup su kahiyen dan ne sikeddi ka atebey ku

entries.summary: naseyyup

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are mistaken about something, you are wrong.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I thought I saw her, but maybe I was mistaken.

entries.summary: egpegsagul; egpegsewug; egpekegsewug; egpekegsagul; nekegsewug; nekegsagul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you mix things together, you put them together to make them into one thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Mix the coconut milk and the brown sugar.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two things mix, they can be put together to make one thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Oil and water do not mix.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of things that have been mixed or joined together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The concert was a mix of rock music and pop music.

entries.summary: impegsewug

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which is made of two or more things mixed together.

entries.summary: deisek ne butang ne mig-ilingan te dakel wey malehet ne kasangkapan.; etew wey ke kasangkapan ne eleg ne eg-ilingan; eggimuwen ne egpekeiling te lein ne minsan nekey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: deisek ne butang ne mig-ilingan te dakel wey malehet ne kasangkapan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a small thing which is a copy of a large real thing (e.g., a model airplane).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We are making a model of the building to show what it will look like.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He built a model car out of wood.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In science we built a model of the solar system.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: etew wey ke kasangkapan ne eleg ne eg-ilingan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person or thing which people should copy because they are a good example.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a good man, so he is a good model for his children.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Meupiya sikandin ne etew, sikak eleg ne eg-ilingan wey meupiya ne panunggiling te me anak din.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggimuwen ne egpekeiling te lein ne minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you model something on another thing, you try to make it similar to that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I modelled my picture on the picture in the book.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggimu ku ne nekeiling ka litratu ku te litratu ne diyè te libru.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nateil ne klasi wey pegkeyimu te mekina

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A model of a machine (e.g., a car or computer) is a particular version of it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka mutur din su daruwa ne gatus wey lalimma ka ngaran te klasiyan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pamaahi wey ke puhawang ke egmemenu ka minsan nekey ne eggimu wey egkeyitabù.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an idea about how something works.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are many different models of how people learn languages. I'm not sure which one is correct.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: etew ne egsaluub te nateil ne kasangkapan eyew egpakita ke nekey ka egkeilingan dan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who wears certain clothes to show what they look like.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is an actor now, but before that he worked as a model for a famous clothes brand.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: etew ne egsasindeg wey egpinnuu eyew egkeilingan te duma pinaahi te pegsulat wey egkalitratuwan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who stands or sits so that an artist can paint a picture or take a photo of them.

entries.summary: kabaluan
iyam; bag-u

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is modern, the style or technology is new, and comes from the present time.

entries.summary: egbalbalawan te deisek; pegbalew-balew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you modify something, you change it a little.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He modified the engine of his motorbike to make it faster.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbalbalawan din ka mekina te mutur din eyew egmeiyal pad iya seini.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the change that you make to something, or the action of changing something (make_a_modification).

entries.summary: eglimusungan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is moist, it is a little bit wet.

entries.summary: beg-ang
maliblibutut ne kariyuan te uras; te seini kuntee ne timpu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a very short period of time (e.g., a second)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: this exact time, or the time around now

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm not hungry at the moment, so I'll eat something later.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena a eggutasan te seini kuntee ne timpu, sika ka kangkuwan ad egkeen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our country is preparing for an election at the moment.

entries.summary: seleppì

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the paper or coins which are used to buy things

entries.summary: egtengteng wey ke egbantey ne egpabulus-bulus; talagtengteng; talagbantey; mekina eyew te pegnengneng te pangitabù

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egtengteng wey ke egbantey ne egpabulus-bulus

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you monitor something or someone, you continue to watch them carefully.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The doctor said he should stay in the hospital so that they can monitor him.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka duktur migkahi te ugpè ka te uspital eyew egkatengtengan nu sikandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The police monitored the suspect from a car near the house.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You need to monitor your spending, so that you still have money at the end of the week.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who watches something carefully, to make sure that it is done properly.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The UN sent monitors to that country during the election, to make sure that the voting was fair.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mekina eyew te pegnengneng te pangitabù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a machine which checks what is happening with something (e.g., a heart monitor checks what your heart is doing).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They attached a heart monitor to his chest to measure his heart rate.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a screen which shows information (e.g., a computer screen).

entries.summary: ubal
bulan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one of the twelve periods of about 30 days into which the year is divided (e.g., March, September)

entries.summary: bulan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large, round object in space which moves around a planet

entries.summary: layag te bulan
due kalabetan ke nekey ka meupiya wey mareet; meupiya wey eleg (meyitenged te menà); panulù ne egkaangey puun te guhuren wey ke sitwasyun

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due kalabetan ke nekey ka meupiya wey mareet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something moral is related to what is right and wrong.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has a moral duty to help his parents.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Moral behavior is good and right.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Moral behavior encourages others to behave well also.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: panulù ne egkaangey puun te guhuren wey ke sitwasyun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The moral of a story or situation is the lesson that you can learn from it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The moral of that story is to always be prepared.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me pegtuu (meyitenged ke nekey ka meupiya wey mareet)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Morals are things you believe about what is right and wrong.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's against my morals to do that.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Parents need to teach their children good morals.

entries.summary: pegkameupiya wey pegkamareet te minsan nekey; sistima wey ke grupu te me pegtuu ke nekey ka meupiya wey mareet.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegkameupiya wey pegkamareet te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The morality of something is whether it is right or wrong.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We disagree about the morality of bribes.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sistima wey ke grupu te me pegtuu ke nekey ka meupiya wey mareet.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a system of beliefs about what is right and wrong.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Western morality is very different from what it was 50 years ago.

entries.summary: minsan nekey ne subla puun te masulug wey ke minsan nekey ne nasamè.; mas masulug; mas masalig; dakel-dakel (eyew te epeg-iling te karakelan); Egkahamit seini ke egpeg-iling wey egpahunsiling te lein lein ne me butang

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne subla puun te masulug wey ke minsan nekey ne nasamè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: More of something is extra or something which remains.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We need more time because we are not finished yet.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ki te dakel ne timpu su warè ki rè due nekeimpus.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you use all of the paper, there is more on the table.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke egkaamin nu ka langun ne pepil, duen pad masalig sika te lamisa.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mas masulug; mas masalig; dakel-dakel (eyew te epeg-iling te karakelan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use more when you compare numbers or amounts, to talk about a larger number or amount.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You have ten santols, but I have more.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due sapulù ne santul nu, piru mas masulug ka keddì.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have more santols than you in my bag.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini ke egpeg-iling wey egpahunsiling te lein lein ne me butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use more when you compare different things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The mountains are more beautiful than the sea.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me bubungan mas meupiya pad iya te dahat.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She finished her work more quickly than her sister.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I like vegetables more than fruit.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian a te gulay du te prutas.

entries.summary: maselem (puun te alas dusi marusilem, peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te alas dusi te meudtu)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: maselem (puun te alas dusi marusilem, peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te alas dusi te meudtu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the period of 12 hours starting at midnight and finishing at midday.

entries.summary: kasuluhan; karakelan; kinarakelan; pinakarakel; kina- (meyitenged te matikang se pegkaklasi); pinaka-

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use most to talk about a large part of a group or thing (but not all of it).

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kasuluhan te me etew kayi egkateu ne eglumbuk.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We ate most of the rice, but there is still a little.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakeen ney e ka karakelan te behas ney, piru duen pad ubag deisek.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use the_most when you compare numbers or amounts, to talk about the largest number or amount.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is carrying the most rice because he is stronger than all his friends.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sikandin ka migtiang te kinarakelan ne behas su man-manekal sikandin te langun ne me alukuy rin.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kina- (meyitenged te matikang se pegkaklasi); pinaka-

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use the_most when you compare and describe things, to talk about the thing that is number one.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I think that the rose is the most beautiful flower in the world.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Hendue te ka rusas ne bulak ka iyan kinameupiyaan ne bulak kayi te kalibutan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She finished her work the most quickly of anyone in the group.

entries.summary: kalibangbang
iney; eglitan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you mother someone, you care for them like they are your child.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Don't mother him too much, because he is already twenty and needs to become mature.

entries.summary: pegweil
egpakabehey te pegpakabagget; egbagget

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something motivates you to do something, it gives you a reason to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The chance to win motivates sportsmen to practice.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka eglaum te kareehan egpakabehey te pegpakabagget te me manggalaway te pegbebasbas.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her fear of failing motivates her to work hard.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Food motivates my dog to obey me.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you motivate someone, you cause them to want to do something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is a good teacher, because she motivates us to study hard.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Meupiya sikandin ne meistra su egbagget kanta te egbebasbas.

entries.summary: nakabagget; kabagget te peggimu ne mapahetpet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your motivation for doing something is the thing which causes you to choose to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His motivation for visiting is to talk to my brother.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka nakabagget kandin te pegpanumbaley iyan ka egpakiglalag te suled ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you have motivation, you have the interest and the energy to do something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has a lot of motivation, so we don't need to tell him to work.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amanan dakel ka kineiya rin te peggimu, sikak kenad keilangan ne eglalahan te pad sikandin ne eggimu.

entries.summary: aliddanan ke mania te miggimu ka minsan nekey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: aliddanan ke mania te miggimu ka minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your motive for doing something is the reason why you do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't know the motive for the murder.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Wara a nakataha te aliddanan te peggimatey.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She had good motives when she did that, but the result was bad.

entries.summary: baad te mekina ne egpakapaweil wey egpakapeyimu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: baad te mekina ne egpakapaweil wey egpakapeyimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the part of a machine which causes it to move or work.

entries.summary: bubungan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a very high area of ground with steep sides

entries.summary: be-bè; kebig; bibig

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the part of your face which you open and close to eat and speak.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the mouth of something such as a cave or hole is the part of it where it opens.

entries.summary: eggipanew wey ke eggalin diyè te lein ne lugar; peggipanew; peggalin; eggenaten; eggalinen

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggipanew wey ke eggalin diyè te lein ne lugar

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something moves, they go to another place.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action of moving to a place.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you move something, you put it in another place.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or animal moves, they change the position of part of their body.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something moves you, it makes you feel a particular emotion (e.g., sadness, compassion).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The sad story moved me, so I cried.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In a formal meeting, if someone moves a motion, or moves that something should happen, they say something that people can vote about.

entries.summary: peggipanew; pegweil; grupu te me etew ne due nekeg-iling ne puhawang wey igkeupii meyitenged te minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action in which someone or something moves to another place.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action of changing the position of part of your body.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: grupu te me etew ne due nekeg-iling ne puhawang wey igkeupii meyitenged te minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of people who have similar ideas and aims about something.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kinarakelan wey keilangan ne baad te sengebuuk te nateil ne musika iling te simpuni.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a major section of a piece of classical music such as a symphony.

entries.summary: dakel; kabaluan wey eleg-eleg (meyitenged te kenè amana ne dakel); subla; amana

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: dakel; kabaluan wey eleg-eleg (meyitenged te kenè amana ne dakel)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use much with an uncountable noun to talk about an amount. You often use it with 'not', to talk about a small amount.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I do not have much time.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kabaluan naan dè ka uras ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I spend much of my time working.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I usually don't put much sugar in my coffee.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use much when you are comparing things, to say that they are very different.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is much taller than his sister.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Subla ne malayat sikandin te atebey rin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is much more interested in maths than in history.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use much to show that something happens often, or is strong.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't go to Quezon much.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use the question how_much to ask about the amount of something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: How much rice do you want?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kamenu karakel ka behas ne igkeupii nu?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use the question how_much to ask about how often something happens.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: How much do you go to Quezon?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kamenu ka karelag ne eggendiyè te Kisun?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use too_much if there is a problem because something is more than it should be.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is fat because he eats too much food.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Malambeg sikandin su amana egkasublaan [egkasubla͡an] ka pegkeen din.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You will be unhealthy if you sit down too much.

entries.summary: basak
eggimatey; peggimatey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone murders a person, they kill them, and it is not an accident; they choose to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They murdered his wife, but they didn't kill him.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Murder is a very bad crime.

entries.summary: libbes
ulahingen ne laheng dè wey ke dahing dè te me kasangkapan; palinneu para te ulahingen wey ke dahing

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ulahingen ne laheng dè wey ke dahing dè te me kasangkapan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an art form in which people produce sounds with their voices or instruments.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: palinneu para te ulahingen wey ke dahing

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: symbols on paper which tell people which sounds they should make with their voice or instrument.

entries.summary: mangulahing
keilangan ne eggimuwen puun su igpeyimu wey tenged te sitwasyun.; Egkahamit seini ke egpakasiguru ka te minsan nekey, minsan warè nu nakita wey narineg.; keilanganen

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: keilangan ne eggimuwen puun su igpeyimu wey tenged te sitwasyun.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you say that someone must do something, you are saying that it is necessary because you told them to do it, or because of the situation.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We must leave right now because it's getting dark.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ki ne egligkat e kuntee su egmarusilem e.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini ke egpakasiguru ka te minsan nekey, minsan warè nu nakita wey narineg.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you say that something must be the case, you are sure that it is the case even though you haven't seen or heard it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There's nobody in the office. They must be having lunch.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warad etew te upisina. Migmaniudtu e sikandan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There's nobody in the office. They must have gone home.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Tsinillas are a must here in the Philippines.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me sinilas keilanganen kayi te Pilipinas.

entries.summary: kein-inuwan
sulu
ngaran; egngaran; egngaranan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the word that people call someone or something

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you name someone or something, you give them a name.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you name someone, you say who they are so that other people will know.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I won't name all the people who helped, but I'd like to thank you all.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè kud egngaranan ke langun ne me etew ne migbulig, piru egkeupian a ne egpasalamat kaniyu langun.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your name is what other people think of you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has a very good name in his community.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due uupiyei ne pegkeetew rin diyè te kandin ne kumunidad.

entries.summary: malig-et; egmalig-eten; kenè eglabet te masalig ne lein-lein ne me butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something narrow has a small measurement from one side to the other (e.g., a path).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you narrow something, you cause it to become more narrow.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The cat narrowed her eyes until they were like two thin lines.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè eglabet te masalig ne lein-lein ne me butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a range of things is narrow, it doesn't include many different things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That shop only has a narrow range of clothes.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkuan wey ke eg-awaan ka egpilien ne butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you narrow or narrow_down a group of things that you are choosing from, you remove some of the things, so that there are not so many to choose from.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are many dresses, but I've narrowed it down to these two. Which one should I buy.

entries.summary: dalepè; inged; nasud

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large group of people connected with a particular area, and who have their own independent government (e.g. the Philippines).

entries.summary: due kalabetan te kinatibuk-an ne nasud, wey kenè ne baad dè; due kalabetan te nateil dè ne nasud; etew ne sakup te nateil dè ne nasud

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due kalabetan te kinatibuk-an ne nasud, wey kenè ne baad dè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: relating to a whole nation, and not just a part of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I like to know about the national news, not just the local news.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due kalabetan te nateil dè ne nasud

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Ice-hockey is a national sport in Canada.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: etew ne sakup te nateil dè ne nasud

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: someone who a citizen of a particular nation.

entries.summary: mahinged
eleg (meyitenged te himu); e iya (meyitenged te katuenan wey weil); kenè ne hinimu te etew su puun te palibut (meyitenged te me kasangkapan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something that you do is natural, it is normal, so people are not surprised that you do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's natural that you should miss your friends when you are away from home.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eleg ne egkaalimengawan ka te me alukuy nu ke mariyù ka te kaniyu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: e iya (meyitenged te katuenan wey weil)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A natural ability or action is something that a person or animal is born with, and so they don't have to learn it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is a natural instinct for babies to cry.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Batasan e iya te me batè ka egsinehew.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has a lot of natural musical ability.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due iya dakel ne katuenan din te musika.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè ne hinimu te etew su puun te palibut (meyitenged te me kasangkapan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A natural product comes from the environment, and is not man-made.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka gapas kasangkapan ne puun te palibut.

entries.summary: langun ne kayi te inged ne kenè ne hinimu te etew; Egkahamit seini ke eglalag ka ke nekey ne klasiyan te butang ka minsan nekey.; ka batasan te minsan nekey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: langun ne kayi te inged ne kenè ne hinimu te etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: all of the world that is not made by humans (e.g., animals, plants, water).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He loves walking in the mountains because he enjoys nature.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini ke eglalag ka ke nekey ne klasiyan te butang ka minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use nature to say what kind of thing something is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She wanted to talk to me about a problem of a financial nature.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian sikandin ne egpakiglalag keddì meyitenged te prublima te paneleppì ne baad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The nature of something is what it is like, and the things which are part of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you have ameba, you will get diarrhoea. That is the nature of ameba.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke due amiba nu, egpangindes ka degma. Su sika ka batasan te amiba.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: menà wey ke batasan te etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A person's nature is their personality and character.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has a very gentle nature.

entries.summary: te dulug; marani; lenged; egpalundani

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are near something, you are not far from it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpinnuu sikandin te dulug te hapuy.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something nears something else, it moves closer to it (in space or time).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We are nearing the town now.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We are nearing the end of the year.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpalundaniyan kid e te keepusan te tuig.

entries.summary: malinis
amana ne keilangan; pegkakeilangana; keilanganen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is necessary, you need it, or need to do it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka weyig amana ne keilangan te umul.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is necessary to wear warm clothes if you climb Mt Apo.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father reminded me of the necessity of arriving at the village before dark.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He didn't take much with him, only a few necessities such as water and a toothbrush.

entries.summary: lieg
egkeilangan; pegkeilangan; keilangan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you need something or need to do something, you have a problem if you don't have it or do it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka langun ne etew egkeilangan te pegkeen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's getting dark, so we need to leave now.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that you need something (have_a_need_for something, or be_in_need_of something).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We have a need for a new teacher.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due pegkeilangan ta te iyam ne talagpanulù.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Food is a basic human need.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the state of being very poor, and not having enough (be_in_need).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In that community there are many people who live in need.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te keet-etawan due masalig ne nangugpè ne egkaayu-ayu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A needy person is very poor, and doesn't have enough.

entries.summary: simat
egpakabehey te warè karuan diyè te sabeka ne butang; pegpakabehey te warè karuan diyè te sabeka ne butang

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakabehey te warè karuan diyè te sabeka ne butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something negates another thing, it causes that other thing to have no value.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His unkind actions negated his friendly words.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka mareet ne inhimu rin nakabehey te warè karuan te pegpangalukuy rin.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegpakabehey te warè karuan diyè te sabeka ne butang

entries.summary: pelalag-lag ne eg-apil te me lalag ne kenè wey ke warè; kenè egkeupian; mareet; kenè egpakabulig

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pelalag-lag ne eg-apil te me lalag ne kenè wey ke warè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In grammar, a negative sentence includes a word such as 'no' or 'not'.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He answered all the questions in the negative.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtabak din ka langun ne insè te warè wey kenè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are negative about something, you don't like it and have bad feelings about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her reaction to my idea was very negative.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka igkalalag din te puhawang ku su kenè ne meupiya.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His attitude to life is very negative: he is always unhappy and bitter.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something negative is bad or unhelpful.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The dry weather has a negative effect on our garden.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka numiru ne deisek pad te siru

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A negative number is less than zero (0).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a medical test is negative for a particular illness, the person does not have that illness.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: All his medical tests were negative, so we don't know what his illness is.

entries.summary: balaharen
sumbaley; egpekegdulug; egpekegdani; egpekegsumbaley; egpekegsinundul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: someone who lives near or next to you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Indonesia is a near neighbor of the Philippines.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing or place neighbors another thing or place, it is next to that other thing or place.

entries.summary: kasumbaleyan
kenè...wey minsan; minsan...wey ke...kenè; minsan hendei...kenè

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè...wey minsan; minsan...wey ke...kenè; minsan hendei...kenè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use neither to talk about two things, to mean 'not one and not the other'. You sometimes use it together with nor.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Neither my father nor my mother likes durian.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Minsan ka amey ku wey ke ka iney kenè egkeupian te durian.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Neither of my parents likes durian.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Minsan hendei te ginikanan ku kenè egkeupian te durian.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That girl can't swim, and neither can her younger brother.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sika ne malitan kenè egpakalumbuk wey minsan sikandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She neither ate nor drank anything, because she felt sick.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè sikandin egkeen wey minsan eg-inum te minsan nekey, su egderalu sikandin.

entries.summary: anaken ne lukes

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the male child of your brother or sister.

entries.summary: salag
nit

punduk te me kasangkapan ne nekegsumpul wey langun ne eggimu; punduk te me etew ne due kalabetan te tagsè sabeka; punduk te me istasyun te radyu wey ke tibi ne egparineg wey egpakita te nenekeg-iling ne prugrama.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: punduk te me kasangkapan ne nekegsumpul wey langun ne eggimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of things (e.g., computers, roads) which are joined and work together.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: punduk te me etew ne due kalabetan te tagsè sabeka

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of people who have relationships with each other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She has a large network of friends.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due dakel ne punduk te me alukuy rin.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: punduk te me istasyun te radyu wey ke tibi ne egparineg wey egpakita te nenekeg-iling ne prugrama.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of radio or television stations which broadcast the same program at the same time (e.g., the ABS-CBN).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The GMA network is broadcasting the game at 7pm tomorrow.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you network, you try to meet new people.

entries.summary: egpataliwarè; kenè egpakita ke nekey ka egkasuman-suman wey egkaheram.; bayew maangkag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or country is neutral, they do not support one side or the other in an argument, fight or war.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I try not to take sides if my friends argue; I just stay neutral.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eggimuwen ku ne kenè egdapig te tagsè sabeka te alukuy ku ke egpeehetey; egpataliwarè e rè.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè egpakita ke nekey ka egkasuman-suman wey egkaheram.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as your face or voice is neutral, it does not show how you think or feel.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His face was neutral, so I did not know if he was angry.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ula-ula rin kenè egpakita ke nekey ka egkaheram, sikak kenè ku egkeila ke nalangetan naa sikandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A neutral color is not strong (e.g., white, cream).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: On a vehicle such as a motorbike, neutral is a position of the gearbox, where the gears are not connected to the engine.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He stopped the motorbike and put it in neutral.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impasanggel din ka mutur wey intahù din te niyutral.

entries.summary: warè iya mulè; warè pad iya mulè; warad iya mulè

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: warè iya mulè; warè pad iya mulè; warad iya mulè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something never happens, there is no time (in the past, present or future) when it happens.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have never been to Manila.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè e pad iya mulè nekeendiyè [neke͡endiyè] te Menila.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warad iya mulè nakasuman-suman sikandin te aldew ne neetawan ku.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè kud iya mulè egkalingawan si kuna.

entries.summary: piru minsan pad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use nevertheless to say that one fact is not changed or affected by another fact.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He felt very tired. Nevertheless, he went to work.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nabeley-beley sikandin. Piru minsan pad due, miggendiyè ded sikandin te trabahu rin.

entries.summary: iyam; bag-u

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Someone or something new has not been here for very long, or is different from what was before.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This bolo is new, so it is still very sharp.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Do you like my new phone? I bought it from my friend.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a new family in our village. They arrived last week.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This song is new to me, so I don't know the words.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The other method didn't work, so let's try a new way.

entries.summary: kanengnengan meyitenged te etew wey ke me butang ne neyitabù

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kanengnengan meyitenged te etew wey ke me butang ne neyitabù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: information about people or about things that have happened.

entries.summary: baseen [base:n]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something for reading that is made of large pieces of paper folded together. It is usually published every day or every week.

entries.summary: seup; egsinundul; sinundul; kilid; hulid; dulug

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The next thing comes after another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She missed the bus so she needed to wait for the next one.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Namewuri sikandin te terak sika ka keilangan sikandin ne egtatahad te seup ne terak.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He came first in the race, and I came next.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you choose one thing in a row of things, the next thing is the one beside it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She lives in the next house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-ugpè sikandin te sinundul ne baley.

entries.summary: te kiliran; te dulug; te hulid

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: te kiliran; te dulug; te hulid

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her house is next to mine.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka baley rin kiliran dè iyat keddiey.

entries.summary: meupiya
anaken ne malitan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the female child of your brother or sister.

entries.summary: marusilem

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the part of a 24-hour period when it is dark.

entries.summary: kenè (meyitenged te tabak); warè; kenè iya

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Q: Do you like coffee? A: No, I don't.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Q: Egkeupian ka te kepi? A:Kena a.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use no when there is zero, or not any.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use no when you compare things, to strongly say 'not'.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is no older than my brother.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè iya ne buyag sikandin te suled ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The new plan is no different from the old one.

entries.summary: warè minsan hentew; etew ne kenè ne impurtanti wey ke kenè ne mabantug

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Nobody in my family likes swimming.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè minsan hentew diyè te pamilya ku ne egkeupian te pegpamanihus.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: etew ne kenè ne impurtanti wey ke kenè ne mabantug

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who is not important or famous.

entries.summary: gulug
warè; warad

fields.label: English example
fields.text: None of my friends like cats.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè alukuy ku ne egkeupian te miyew.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I ate all the rice, so there is none left.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-amin ku ka langun ne hemey, sika ka warad nasamè.

entries.summary: meudtu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: 12 o'clock pm (12 in the middle of the day).

entries.summary: kenè...wey minsan; minsan...wey ke...kenè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use nor to talk about two things, to mean 'not one and not the other'. You sometimes use it together with neither.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Neither Coke nor Pepsi is very healthy.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Minsan Kuk wey ke Pipsi kenen meupiya.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I didn't forget and nor did my sister.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Wara a nalingew wey minsan ka atebey ku.

entries.summary: maheteng; eleg; pegkamaheteng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Someone or something normal is not different from the usual.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is normal for babies to cry when they are getting teeth.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Maheteng dè iya ne egsinehew ka batè ke egngipenan.

entries.summary: balabahan ne igkahibang ke egtangkè ki te igsilè

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: balabahan ne igkahibang ke egtangkè ki te igsilè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the direction which is opposite south. If you face the rising sun, north is the direction on your left.

entries.summary: egbalabahan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something northern is in or from the north part of a place.

entries.summary: irung

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the part of the face above the mouth, used to breath and smell

entries.summary: lungag te irung

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one of the holes at the bottom of your nose.

entries.summary: kenè; warè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use not to make a sentence negative.

entries.summary: malepet-lepet ne sinulat ne guhuren; sengebuuk ne pepil ne seleppì; kelit wey ke palinneu te pegkelit

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She wrote him a quick note to remind him about their visit.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a piece of paper money (e.g., a twenty-peso note).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kelit wey ke palinneu te pegkelit

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a musical sound, or a symbol of a musical sound.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That song is so high that I can't sing the top notes

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She can sing really well, but she can't read notes.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you note something, you especially see it and don't forget it, because it is important.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Please note that smoking is not allowed on the bus.

entries.summary: nutbuk

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a book with empty pages for you to write in.

entries.summary: warè; deisek; warè karuan

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is nothing in the bag so it's not heavy.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that is very small or unimportant

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A: Why are you crying? B: Don't worry, it's nothing.

entries.summary: egkakita; pegtengteng; pegkakita; pepil ne intahuan te katahaanan [kataha͡anan]; pahibalu diyè te pepil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you notice that something is the case, you see it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She noticed that he did not eat anything.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakita rin ne kenè egkeen sikandin te minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of people seeing or looking at something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She attracted notice because of her loud speaking.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pepil ne intahuan te katahaanan [kataha͡anan]; pahibalu diyè te pepil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a piece of paper in a public place which gives information about something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was a notice on the wall about the singing contest.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegpataha wey pegpanengneng te pegsanggel te himu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action of telling your employer that you are going to stop working for them, or an action of an employer telling you that your job is going to end (give_notice).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I found a new job, so I gave my boss two weeks' notice.

entries.summary: pegtuu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you think or believe.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has some interesting notions about health and sickness.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due egpakabagget ne pegtuu meyitenged te peglelawa wey dalu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His notion of success is very different from mine.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has no notion of how much it costs to run a generator.

entries.summary: ngaran te etew, lugar, kasangkapan wey pangitabù

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ngaran te etew, lugar, kasangkapan wey pangitabù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a word for a person, place or thing (physical or non-physical).

fields.label: Compare
fields.text: count noun, uncount noun, plural noun, proper noun, collective noun.

entries.summary: sabeka ne grupuwan te lalag para te etew, lugar, wey me kasangkapan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sabeka ne grupuwan te lalag para te etew, lugar, wey me kasangkapan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of words for a person, place or thing (physical or non-physical) (e.g., the big tree)

fields.label: English example
fields.text: the man with grey hair; seven green mangoes; my fear

entries.summary: kuntee

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He sold his horse, and now he had enough money to buy a carabao.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our ancestors were hunters, but now we have farms.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We made a tank to collect water, so now we don't have to carry so much water.

entries.summary: mahulub
numiru (gamiten eyew te pegseel); punduk te me numiru ne due nateil ne igpasabut; egseel

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a word which tells you how many things there are (e.g., 1, 3, 10)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: punduk te me numiru ne due nateil ne igpasabut

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of numbers (any of the characters 0 to 9) in a particular sequence, which have a special meaning (e.g. a Philhealth number, a cellphone number).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I gave her my cellphone number.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbehayan ku sikandin te numiru te silpun ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you number things, you count them.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ku egkaseel ka me bituen.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people or things number a certain amount, that is how many there are.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our group numbered more than thirty.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migginguma ka grupu ney te subla te tatelun pulù.

entries.summary: talagbulig te me duktur.; egtanggu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: someone who cares for sick people in hospital, and helps doctors.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you nurse a sick person, you care for them.

entries.summary: uyahanan te me similya te minsan hentew wey minsan nekey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: uyahanan te me similya te minsan hentew wey minsan nekey

entries.summary: minsan nekey ne egpekeiling te niyug

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne egpekeiling te niyug

entries.summary: saad; pahunlibet; lalew
mapalintutuu; maparuma-ruma; pegpalintutuu; pegparuma-ruma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An obedient person does what people in authority tell them to do.

entries.summary: eg-ikul; egpalintutuu; egtuman

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you obey a person or a rule, you do what they tell you to do.

entries.summary: kasangkapan; butang; ka egkakita wey egkabehayan te panahun; Te Inglis ne pegkalalag, ka egguhuren te weil ne lalag iyan ka etew wey ke butang ne diyè nakatahù te impus te weil ne lalag.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His motorbike hit a large object on the road.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka mutur din nakasukeung te dakel ne butang diyè te dalan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka egkakita wey egkabehayan te panahun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The object of your emotion or action is the person or thing that you feel the emotion about, or do the action to.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You are the object of his love.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sikeykew ka egkabehayan te eggeramen din ne geyinawa.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Te Inglis ne pegkalalag, ka egguhuren te weil ne lalag iyan ka etew wey ke butang ne diyè nakatahù te impus te weil ne lalag.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In English grammar, the object of a verb is the person or thing which is after the verb. The object receives or experiences the action of the verb.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My brother hates bread ('bread' is the object of the verb 'hate').

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka suled ku egkeepes te paan [pa͡an] (ka paan [pa͡an] ka egguhuren te weil ne lalag 'egkeepes')

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka igkeupii te eg-uma wey ke egkuen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your object is the thing that you want to achieve.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My object is to find a job.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka igkeupii ku ka egpamitew te trabahu.

entries.summary: eglalag te kenè pegkeupii; kenè igkabennali

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you object to something, you say strongly that you do not like it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The boy objected when his friend took his notebook.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka batè ne lukes miglalag te kenè pegkeupii te pegkuwa te alukuy rin te nutbuk din.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have two objections to your idea.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due daruwa ne kenè ku igkabennali te puhawang nu.

entries.summary: igkeupii; tuyù; tumung; malehet ne kamalehetan; eggamit te kamalehetan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an aim; something that you plan to achieve.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My objective is to finish my work by the end of the week.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka igkeupii ku ne egkeimpusan ku ka himu ku pegke-impus te simana.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Objective information is real facts, not ideas or feelings.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They think that he stole the chickens, but they don't have any objective information to prove it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migsuman-suman sikandan ne migtakew rin ka manuk, piru warè kamalehetan ne kanengnengan ne igpakapakita ran.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are objective about something, you use facts, not your feelings, to decide about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Be objective when you choose the winner; don't just choose your friend.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Gamit ka te kamalehetan ke eg-alam ka te egpanalu, kenè dè ne eg-alamen nu ka alukuy nu.

entries.summary: 1 peg-ipat; 2 pegkakita; 3 pegkahi; 4 pegpalintutuu; egkakita; pangguhuren; panugtulen

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Watch the children for a while, and write down your observations.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Tengteng ka te me batè taheed, wey ipansulat nu ka egkakita nu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you say about a thing you have noticed (make_an_observation).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He made some very interesting observations about the movie.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggimu sikandin te amana ne makabebagget ne pangguhuren meyitenged te salida.

entries.summary: eg-ipat; egkakita; egkanengnengan; egkahi; egnangen; eglalag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you observe someone or something, you watch them carefully.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The police observed the suspect for three days.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you observe something, you see or notice it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He observed that it was getting dark, and decided to stop work for the day.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you observe that something is the case, you say it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She observed that it was a beautiful day.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you observe a rule, you do what it says.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She always observes the road rules when she drives.

entries.summary: egkuen pinaahi te pegbuyù, pegbeli, wey te peggimu te minsan nekey.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkuen pinaahi te pegbuyù, pegbeli, wey te peggimu te minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you obtain something, you get it by asking for it, buying it or doing something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She went to her relatives to obtain some help for her sick child.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggendiyè sikandin te me karumaan [karuma͡an] din eyew te pegbuyù te bulig te egderalu ne anak din.

entries.summary: mahaan egkataheyi su mahaan egkakita; egkamelmelehi

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mahaan egkataheyi su mahaan egkakita; egkamelmelehi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a fact is obvious, we can know it easily, because it is easy to see.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is obvious from her tidy house that she is hardworking.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkakita wey egkatahaan [egkataha͡an] iya ne mabasuk sikandin su egkakita diyè te malinis ne baley rin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She ate a lot of santols, so obviously she likes santols.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migkeen sikandin te santul, sika ka amana egkatagtaheyi ne amana egkeupian sikandin te santul.

entries.summary: nateil ne timpu te hitabù; tineil ne timpu te peggimu te tineil ne himuwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a particular time, when a particular thing happens.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: On one occasion, she brought her pet rabbit to school in her bag.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due kasabeka ne timpu, mig-uyan din ka ayam din ne ambew diyè te iskuyalaan [iskuyla͡an] diyè te baag [ba͡ag] din.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: tineil ne timpu te peggimu te tineil ne himuwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a special time when people do something special.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His first birthday was a special occasion for our family.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kinewun-aan [kinewun-a͡an] ne aldew ne neetawan din su amana ne tineil timpu te pamilya ney.

entries.summary: marelag ne hitabù wey ke kasangkapan; marelag dè ne egkeyitabù

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: marelag ne hitabù wey ke kasangkapan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An occasional event or thing is something that doesn't happen very often.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We see an occasional snake here, but not very many.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happens occasionally, it happens sometimes, but not very often.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I occasionally go to Quezon, but not every month.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Marelag dè ne egpekeendiyè [egpeke͡endiyè] a te Kisun, kenè ne tagsè bulan.

entries.summary: mahinged; nangugpè; kamuney

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An occupant of a house is a person who is living there.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka baley due pitu ne me mahinged.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the occupant of a place is the person who is in that place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The seats all have occupants, and there are no extra spaces.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka langun ne pinuuwan duen e kamuney, wey warad e bakanti.

entries.summary: himu; trabahu; igkeupii nu ne eggimuwen (meyitenged te egbehayan nu te dakel ne timpu ne himuwen); pegbeye-beyè te me sundalu te duma ne inged

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the work that you usually do

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Q: What's your occupation? A: I'm a nurse.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Q: Nekey ka trabahu nu? A: Nars a.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: igkeupii nu ne eggimuwen (meyitenged te egbehayan nu te dakel ne timpu ne himuwen)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you spend your time doing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Basketball is a very popular occupation here in the Philippines.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka eggahalew te bula ka amana igkeupii kayi te Pilipinas.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegbeye-beyè te me sundalu te duma ne inged

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of soldiers from another country coming to a place and controlling it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That country's occupation of their neighbor has continued for 10 years now.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegbeye-beyè te me nasud te sumbaley ran ne nasud migpabulus-bulus te sapulu ne tuig kuntee.

entries.summary: egkatahuan; eg-ugpè; eggamit te timpu wey suman-suman

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something occupies a place, they are in that place so that another person or thing can't be there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The bed occupied most of the small room.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka hibatanan natahuan te langun ne me dereisek ne sinabeng.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was nowhere to sit on the bus because children were occupying all the seats.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you occupy a house, you live there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Renters will occupy our house while we are staying with our relatives.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something occupies you, it uses your time and thinking. If you occupy yourself with something, you use your time and mind to do that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His work occupies a lot of his time.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka trabahu rin eggamit te dakel ne timpu rin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: On rainy afternoons she occupied herself with making bead necklaces to sell.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te me maapun [ma͡apun] ne eg-uran miggamit din ka timpu rin te pegpaniyuk te balieg ne igbelegyè.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-ugpè wey egbeye-beyè te sengeinged te pinehes

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If soldiers occupy a place, they come to that place and control it by force.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Their army has occupied the government buildings of the neighboring country.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me sundalu ran mig-ugpè te baley te gubirnu te sumbaley ne nasud.

entries.summary: egkeyitabù; egkakita; egpakalambag te suman-suman

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A solar eclipse will occur next Friday afternoon.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka lekep egkeyitabù kayi te seup ne Birnis.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something occurs somewhere, it is there in that place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This plant only occurs in the Philippines.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini ne pinamula kayi rè egkakita te Pilipinas.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This kind of weather pattern only occurs near the equator.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something occurs to you, you suddenly think of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was taking a rest when it occurred to me that I had forgotten to collect water.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggimeley a te nakalambag te suman-suman ku ne nalingew e bes ne egpanakeru.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The occurrence of an eclipse is always interesting.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Eclipses are not a common occurence.

entries.summary: dahat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the area of salt water which covers a large area of the earth.

entries.summary: Egkahamit seini ke ka sabeka ne lalag egbehey te dakel ne kanengnengan te lein ne lalag.; te (egpegsumpul te pegpangamuney); te (egpegsumpul te baad wey te langun)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini ke ka sabeka ne lalag egbehey te dakel ne kanengnengan te lein ne lalag.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Of connects words when one word gives more information about the other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She was sad after the death of her grandfather.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nalangè sikandin impus te pegpatey te apu din ne lukes.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have no idea of what to do.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè puhawang ku ke nekey ka eggimuwen ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Of connects the owner and the thing that they own.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a friend of my father.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: te (egpegsumpul te baad wey te langun)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Of connects the part and the whole.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The cat is on the roof of the house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka miyew diyè te atep te baley.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: te (egpegsumpul te karakelan wey ke tahuanan wey te minsan nekey)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Of connects the quantity or container and the material

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I bought a kilo of rice.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbebeli a te sabeka ne kilu te behas.

entries.summary: aween; warad e; paawè; nekegdani; nekegdulug

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is off another thing, it is not attached to that thing and that thing is not supporting it any more.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The cup was on the chair, but I moved it, so now it's off the chair.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ubab su diyè te pinnuuwan, piru mig-awè ku seini, su kuntee warad seini diyè te pinnuuwan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Please take your cup off the chair.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Palihug awaa nu ka pakawan nu due te pinnuuwan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone moves off, they move away from the place where they were.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a place is off another place, it is near or beside that other place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The island is just off the coast.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka isla nekegdani rè te ilis te dahat.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is off something (e.g. medicine), they have stopped using it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The doctor took me off painkillers.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka duktur migpapeeneng-eneng e ka egbehey keddì te delemetan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone has time off work or study, they don't do their work or study.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I had a week off college because I was sick.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due simana ne miggimeley a te kulihiyu su migderalu a.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè eggimu (meyitenged te mekina); kenè eg-andar

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If equipment such as the radio is off, it is not active.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mareet e (meyitenged te keenen ne daan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If food such as meat is off, it is bad because it is too old.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We need to throw away this meat, because it is off.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ne igdegpak tad seini se karni, su mareet e.

entries.summary: egginggat ke due egkeupian; egbehey ke due egkeupian; egkahiyen ne egbulig ke egkeupian ne egbulihan; peglalag ne egbehey te bulig ke due egpabulig

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egginggat ke due egkeupian; egbehey ke due egkeupian

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you offer someone something, or offer something to someone, you ask them if they want it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She offered me a cup of coffee.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They offered me a ride on their motorbike, but I wanted to walk.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkahiyen ne egbulig ke egkeupian ne egbulihan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you offer to do something, you say that you will do it if other people want you to.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She always offers to help with the cleaning.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Layun eglalag sikandin ne egbulig te pegpanlinis.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peglalag ne egbehey te bulig ke due egpabulig

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: words which say that you will give someone something or help them with something if they want.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Thank you for your offer of help, but I've just finished.

entries.summary: egpanubaran; iggalad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something such as an animal or gift that is offered to God, or to a spirit.

entries.summary: dakel ne baley wey ke sinabeng naa ne diyè eggimu iling te kumpyutir wey ke nigusyu se himu; upisina; nateil ne katenged wey ke himu (iling te gubirnu wey ke kumitiba)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: dakel ne baley wey ke sinabeng naa ne diyè eggimu iling te kumpyutir wey ke nigusyu se himu; upisina

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a building or room where people do work such as computer or business work.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The receptionist didn't know the answer to his question, so she asked someone at the accounting office.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nateil ne katenged wey ke himu (iling te gubirnu wey ke kumitiba)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a special position or job (e.g., in government, or on a committee).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She held the office of committee treasurer for six years.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The president came to office three years ago.

entries.summary: etew ne pulis; etew ne due katenged diyè te grupu wey ke sundalu

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I want to be a police officer.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian a ne egkeyimu ne upisyalis te pulis.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: etew ne due katenged diyè te grupu wey ke sundalu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person with authority in the army or other group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is an officer in the army.

fields.label: English example
