fields.text: There is an officer's meeting for committee members tomorrow.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due miting te me due katenged ne mimbru kaaselem.

entries.summary: egpuun diyè te gubirnu wey diyè te senge etew ne due katenged; etew ne due himu wey katenged diyè te gubirnu wey ke punduk

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpuun diyè te gubirnu wey diyè te senge etew ne due katenged

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is official, it comes from the government or from someone in authority.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We know who won the election, but there has not been an official announcement yet.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: etew ne due himu wey katenged diyè te gubirnu wey ke punduk

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who has a position of authority in the government or in an organization.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There were a number of government officials at the ceremony.

entries.summary: dahayun; malasi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happens often, it happens many times, with not a long wait between these times.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I often forget my friend's birthday.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Malasi ku egkalingawi ka aldew ne neetawan te alukuy ku.

entries.summary: mentika; lana; egmentikaan; eglanaan [egla͡an]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a thick, smooth liquid which doesn't mix with water, and can burn. There are many different kinds of oils, which come from plants, animals and the ground (e.g., vegetable oil, coconut oil, fish oil).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you oil something such as wood or a machine, you spread oil on it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You need to oil your bike because it is noisy.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ne eg-esitiyan nu ka bayik nu su matalè e.

entries.summary: buyag; nabuybuyahan; nalugluhayan; daan; tapey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An old person has lived for a long time.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An old thing has existed for a long time.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use old to say that someone has had a particular task or position for a long time (e.g., an old friend).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: All of the other members only joined last year, so she is the oldest member of the team.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is an old friend of mine.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Daan kud e sikandin ne alukuy

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you have two things, the old one is the one that you had first, before now.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When my uncle bought a new cellphone, he gave me his old one.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te migbebeli ka anggam te iyam ne silpun, imbehey rin e keddì ka tapey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use old to talk about something that you had before, but don't have now.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migleuy a te newun-a ne talagpanulù ku.

entries.summary: karaan
sika te; kayi te; diyè te; seeyè te; nakakepkep; nakakapli; seeyè se; dengan te; kayi te (meyitenged te aldew)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sika te; kayi te; diyè te; seeyè te

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is on a thing such as a table, that thing is supporting it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Your books are on the table.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka libru nu sika te lamisa.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is on a thing such as a wall, it is attached to that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was a picture on the wall.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due litratu ne nakakepkep te alabat.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: seeyè se; dengan te; kayi te (meyitenged te aldew)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happens on a particular day or date, that is the day or date when it happens.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She arrived on the 20th of January.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migginguma sikandin seeyè se pitsa beyinti te Iniru.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: te (egpangguhud meyitenged te nahamit ne kasangkapan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you do something on a particular machine or instrument (e.g., a computer, the guitar), you use that machine or instrument.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She played a solo on the guitar.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpangelit sikandin te gitar se sabsabeka.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: te (meyitenged te nekeglegsè wey ke nekegsinundul ne weil)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing happens on another thing, it happens immediately after that other thing, or at the same time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: On graduating from school, she looked for a job.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te pegkeimpus din te peg-iskuyla, migpamitew sikandin te trabahu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is on something such as a medicine, they are using it regularly

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use on to say that something continues.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He walked on / He kept on walking.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If equipment such as the radio is on, it is active.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Parahinga nu kun pa ubag ka radyu

entries.summary: kasabeka; due kasabeka (egkahamit seini ke eglalag ka te neimpusan e ne timpu); te

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I went to Davao once last year.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekeendiyè [neke͡endiyè] a te Dabaw kasabeka seeyè se miglihad ne tuig.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due kasabeka (egkahamit seini ke eglalag ka te neimpusan e ne timpu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use once to talk about a finished time in the past

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I once had a dog, but it died.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due kasabeka ne mig-aasu a, piru migpatey.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The child stopped crying once she had eaten something.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka batè mig-engked e te pegsinehew te nakakeen sikandin.

entries.summary: sabeka; ka tagsè sabeka

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the number 1, or a single person or thing.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use one to mean a general person, not a particular person.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: One should always wash one's hands before cooking.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka tagsè sabeka keilangan ne layun egpanlu-lù te me belad dan te kenè pad egsusubba.

entries.summary: dè (egkahamit ke warè labet ne duma); dè (eggamiten diyè te bayew kenè dakel wey bayew kenè ne keilangan)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: dè (egkahamit ke warè labet ne duma)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use only to say that nothing or nobody else is included.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She was the only one who helped me.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sikandin dè iya ka sabsabeka ne migbulig keddì.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: dè (eggamiten diyè te bayew kenè dakel wey bayew kenè ne keilangan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use only if something is not very big or important, or is less than you expected.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He's only a child. He can't carry that heavy sack.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Batè dè sikandin. Kenè egpekeeleg sikandin sikat mabehat ne saku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I asked him a question, but he didn't answer, he only smiled.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Don't worry, I'm only going to the next sitio; it's not far.

entries.summary: napuwasan; nalukatan; egpuwas, eglukat; egkalukatan; egkapuwasan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is open, you can go into it, see into it, or take something out of it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you open something, you move part of it so that you can go into it, see into it, or take something out of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She opened the box and looked inside.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something opens, it moves so that it is open.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a book or your hand is open, you can see the middle of it, because the outside parts of it are not close together.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you open something such as a book or your hand, you move the outside parts so that you can see the inside parts.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something opens, the outside parts move so that you can see the inside parts.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The flower opened slowly in the sun.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An open area does not have a lot of buildings or trees, so there is a lot of space.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's easy to make a farm on this land, because it is quite open.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you open something such as a shop, a bank account or a conversation), you start it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He opened a shop at the crossing.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is open to someone, they can do that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That job is only open to females.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sika ne trabahu egkeyimu rè te me malitan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are open about something, you don't hide it or lie about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is very open about her feelings.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne meutas-utas sikandin te eggeramen din.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you are not happy about something, please be open about it, because it's much better to tell me.

entries.summary: duen e wey sasangan e ne eggimu (meyitenged te kumpanya wey ke grupu); eg-uyan (te kumpanya); eg-andar

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: duen e wey sasangan e ne eggimu (meyitenged te kumpanya wey ke grupu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a group or business operates, it exists and works.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The factory is operating well now, and production is good.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kumpanya duen e wey sasangan e ne eggimu kuntee, wey meupiya ka me neneyimu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you operate a business, you manage and control it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He operates a fish-selling business in the area.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a machine operates, it works.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Don't put your hands in the machine while it is operating.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you operate something such as a machine, you control it and cause it to work.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I know how to operate a computer.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I am learning to operate the gears on a motorbike.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If doctors operate on you, they cut open part of your body to fix or remove something.

entries.summary: 1 duen e wey sasangan e ne eggimu; 2 peg-uyan (te kumpanya); 3 peg-andar; 4 pegpaandar; hinimu ne me pamaahi; peg-ebù; peg-upira

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 duen e wey sasangan e ne eggimu; 2 peg-uyan (te kumpanya); 3 peg-andar; 4 pegpaandar

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The operation of heavy machinery needs training.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegpaandar te mabbehat ne me mekina egkeilangan te pegbebasbas.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an organized process which includes many people.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was a police operation to find the drug dealers.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due hinimu ne me pamaahi te me pulis te pegpamitew te mameligyaay te druga.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a process in which a doctor cuts open part of your body to fix or remove something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She needed to have an operation to remove her appendix.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeilangan sikandin te peg-ebù eyew te peg-awè te apindik din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is in_operation, it is working or doing what it usually does.

entries.summary: puhawang; suman-suman; pegsuman-suman ke kamenu keupiya wey kareet (etew wey ke kasangkapan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your opinion about something is what you believe and think about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In my opinion, we should not sell our horse.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegsuman-suman ke kamenu keupiya wey kareet (etew wey ke kasangkapan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your opinion of someone or something is how good or bad you think they are.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She has a very low opinion of that TV program.

entries.summary: keugpè ne egbehey te timpu te peggimu te minsan nekey ne igkeupii nu te eggimu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: keugpè ne egbehey te timpu te peggimu te minsan nekey ne igkeupii nu te eggimu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a situation which gives you a chance to do something which you want to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The fine weather gave us an opportunity to dry our clothes.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My employer said he will help me go to college, so that's a wonderful opportunity.

entries.summary: eg-apul
talipag te; deyipag te; kabaliyungan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing is opposite another thing, it is on the other side from it (e.g., across a road).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They live in the house opposite us.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-ugpè sikandan te baley ne talipag te baley ta.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing is the_opposite of another thing, they are completely different in one critical way, e.g. size (tall/short, fat/thin) or direction (left/right, up/down, backwards/forwards).

entries.summary: kunterè
alamanan; pilianan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one of the things which you can choose.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You have two options while you are here: you can either stay with me, or with your aunt.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due daruwa ne alamanan nu taheed te kayi ka: kaayun ka ne eg-ugpè kayi te keddiey, wey ke diyè naa te ayè nu.

entries.summary: egpakaalam ke egkeupian ka wey ke kenè

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakaalam ke egkeupian ka wey ke kenè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is optional, you can choose if you want it or not.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The basketball game tomorrow is optional, so you don't need to join if you don't want to.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka baskitbul kaaselem egpakaalam ka, sika ka kenè ne keilangan ne eg-apil kew ke kenè kew egkeupian.

entries.summary: wey ke (ke due alamanan); wey ke (ke egbehey te lein ne ngaran)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use or if you can choose between different things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Would you like to eat now or later?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian ka ne egkeen kuntee wey ke kangkuwan e?

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: wey ke (ke egbehey te lein ne ngaran)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use or to give another name for someone or something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Peter, or Pete, is my best friend.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Si Pitir wey ke si Pit, alukuy kun telek.

entries.summary: malalab
egsuhù; suhù; egpeuyan wey ke egpabehey te minsan nekey ne igkeupii (iling diyè te inumanan te keppi wey ke keenanan ne egbayaran).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you order someone to do something, you tell them that they must do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father ordered me to help my mother.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka amey ku migsuhù keddì te pegbulig te iney ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: words which tell someone what they must do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I always follow my father's orders.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Layun a egpalintutuu te me suhù te amey ku.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpeuyan wey ke egpabehey te minsan nekey ne igkeupii (iling diyè te inumanan te keppi wey ke keenanan ne egbayaran).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you order something from a shop, you ask them to get it for you or send it to you. If you order food in a restaurant, you ask them to bring it to you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I ordered some chicken in the restaurant.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpabehey a te manuk diyè te keenanan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I ordered some shoes from the catalogue.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegpabehey; pegparulung (meyitenged te minsan nekey diyè te keenanan wey ke tindaan [tinda͡an]).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a request to a shop to get something for you, or to a person in an eating place to bring you a particular food.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The lady in the calendaria took my order for soup and rice.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka malitan diyè te keenanan mig-uyan te igkeupii ku ne sabew wey keenen.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you order things, you arrange them so that one thing is first, another thing is second, and so on.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She ordered the children from oldest to youngest.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migteil din ka me batè puun te buyag-buyag peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te kinabataan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an arrangement of things one after the other (with one thing first, another thing second, and so on).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In a dictionary, the words are in alphabetical order.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te diksyunari, ka me lalag wey litra nenekegsinsinundul.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a state of things being well-organized.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Everything in her house is in order, because she cleaned this morning.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Langun ne diyè te baley rin nenateil, su migpanlinis sikandin te maselem.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use in_order_to to explain the purpose of doing something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She fed the baby in order to stop him crying.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impakeen din ka batè eyew egsanggel ka egsinehew.

entries.summary: kenè ne ispisyal wey ke lein te nateil

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè ne ispisyal wey ke lein te nateil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: not special or different from usual.

entries.summary: baad-baad te me lawa te mananap wey etewey.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: baad-baad te me lawa te mananap wey etewey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one of the parts of the body (usually inside the body) such as the heart or liver.

entries.summary: grupu te me etew ne migsabeka; 1 pegpangimu te himuwen eyew egkeyitabù; 2 pegteil; pegtapid; pegkateil

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: grupu te me etew ne migsabeka

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of people who are joined together in a formal way for a particular reason (e.g., a business, a charity group).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegpangimu te himuwen eyew egkeyitabù; 2 pegteil; pegtapid

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The organization of a wedding is a big job.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the state of being in a particular order or place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What is the organization of these books: is it alphabetical, or in subject groups?

entries.summary: egpangimu te himuwen eyew egkeyitabù; egteilen; egtapiren; nateil; natapid

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you organize an event, you cause it to happen by doing all the things to make it happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother organized a party for my birthday.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka iney ku migpangimu te kalibulungan eyew te aldew ne neetawan ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you organize things, you put them in a particular order or place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He organized the books into subject groups.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If things are organized, they are in a particular order or place because somebody put them like that.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her study notes are very organized.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An organized person plans their time and their things very well.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is very organized. Everything in her room has a particular place

entries.summary: egnengneng ke hendei ka; egnengneng wey egkalayam

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you orient yourself, you find out where you are and which way you are facing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you are lost, you can use the sun to orient yourself.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke egkatarin ka, egkahamit nu ka aldew te pegnengneng ke hendei ka.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He got lost in the strange city, and could not orient himself.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you orient yourself to a new place or situation, you get to know it and become accustomed to it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It took him some time to orient himself to his new school, but he finally felt comfortable there.

entries.summary: pegpanulù te me katahaanan [kataha͡anan] ne egpakabulig te me etew te pegnengneng te iyam ne lugar wey ke sitwasyun.; me himu ne due ne igkabagget te eggimu; namenu te pegkatahù wey pegkatangkè

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegpanulù te me katahaanan [kataha͡anan] ne egpakabulig te me etew te pegnengneng te iyam ne lugar wey ke sitwasyun.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: teaching or information which helps people know a new place or situation.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Many colleges have a day for orientation for new students.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me himu ne due ne igkabagget te eggimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the things that a person or group is interested in and wants to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has a practical orientation, so he'd like to do a job in which he can use his hands.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The orientation of something is the way that it is facing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What's the orientation of the building: does it face north or east?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekey ka pegkatahù te baley: migtangkè naa seini te balabahan wey ke igsilè?

entries.summary: puunanan; ligkatanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the place, group or thing which someone or something comes from.

entries.summary: puunanan; ligkatanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something originates in a place, or originates from a thing, it comes from that place or thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This cooking style originated in China.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka puunanan kayi ne pamaahi te peggilutu su diyè te China.

entries.summary: duma pad; esa pad; lein pad; tagsè seup te seup ne aldew; duma ne me etew wey ke kasangkapan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: duma pad; esa pad; lein pad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Other people or things are more, or different ones.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My wife will take our baby on the bus, and I will take the other children on the motorbike.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eg-untud ka asawa ku wey ka malalab pad ne anak ney te batsilur, sikeddiey wey ka duma ne me anak ney eg-untud key rè mulè te mutur.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: tagsè seup te seup ne aldew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use phrases such as every_other day or every_other month to say that something happens one day or month, and not the next, and happens again the next day or month, and not the next, and so on.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I buy vegetables every other day.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egbebeli a te gulay te tagsè seup te seup ne aldew.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: duma ne me etew wey ke kasangkapan

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Some people like hot weather, while others prefer cool weather.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka duma ne me etew egkeupian te meinit ne timpu, nè ka duma mulè egkeupian te maagsil [ma͡agsil].

entries.summary: eleg iya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you ought to do something, you should do it, because it is a right and good thing to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You ought to say sorry for what you did.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eleg iya ne egkahi ka te pasaylu para te neyimu nu.

entries.summary: neebukan; nabukalkalan; natahaan [nataha͡an]; nanengnengan; nakalihawang wey ke nekeyinguma ne egkaayun e ne egbeliyen (iling te magasin).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a light or something that was burning is out, it is not shining or burning any more.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's dark because all the lights are out.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Marusilem su ka langun ne sulù neebukan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He put the fire out with some water.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as news or a secret is out, it is public, so people know about it.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nakalihawang wey ke nekeyinguma ne egkaayun e ne egbeliyen (iling te magasin).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a magazine or CD is out, it has arrived in shops so that people can buy it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That movie will come out on DVD in December.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sika ne salida egpakalihawang te DVD kayi te Disimbri.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kulang wey ke nalaahan (meyitenged te pegseel)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a number or quantity is out by a certain amount, it is not correct.

entries.summary: nakaligwang; nakaligwè; mariyù e; nakaligwang e; nakaawè e; naaminan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something is out_of a place, they are not there in that place any more.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The pencil is out of the bag.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She took a pencil out of her bag.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mariyù e; nakaligwang e; nakaawè e

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are out_of a particular situation or condition, that is not your situation or condition any more.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is still sick, but is out of danger.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egderalu pad sikandin, piru mariyù e te karereetan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are out_of something, it means that you don't have any more of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We're out of rice, so we need to buy some more.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Naaminan kid te behas, sikak keilangan kid man e ne egbebeli.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is made out_of a material, that material is the original material.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That bowl is made out of glass.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sika ne yahung puun te bildu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: puun te (meyitenged te aliddanan ne eggeramen)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you do something out_of a particular feeling, that feeling is your reason for doing that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She helped them out of kindness.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbulihan din sikandan puun te pegkeyid-u rin.

entries.summary: natamanan; kapangkusan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the result of something, or the situation that exists after something has happened.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They were very happy with the outcome of the meeting.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nahalè amana sikandan te natamanan te kalibulungan dan.

entries.summary: karakel ne egpakapalihawang; kanekal ne egpuun te puunanan te kurinti; kanengnengan ne migpuun te kumpyutir

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the amount of something that is produced by someone or something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The factory has an output of 500 pieces per day.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kumpanya ne himuwanan due karakelan ne igpakapalihawang ne lalimman gatus tagsè aldew.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kanekal ne egpuun te puunanan te kurinti

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the power that comes from an electrical source.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the information that a computer produces.

entries.summary: te ligwang; te ligwè; warè labet; kenè ne eleg; ampew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is outside a place, it is close to that place, but is not there in it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Diyè pad sikandin te ligwang te baley.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is outside a particular range or group, it is not included in that range or group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can't join the youth group, as I'm outside the age-range.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena a egpakaapil te grupu te me mengebay wey me kanakan, su kenè ne pad ne eleg ka idad ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The outside of something is the part of it which is around the other parts of it, and which you can see.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Only the outside of the wood is burned.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Iyan dè natutung ka ampew te kayu.

entries.summary: dibabew; te dibabew; ampew; te ampew; te (meyitenged te tel-eb wey ke terung); due katenged te

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: dibabew; te dibabew; ampew; te ampew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something moves over something else, it moves above it from one side of it to the other. If it is over something else it is directly higher than it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are some big branches over our house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due derakel ne sugpang diyè te ampew te baley ta.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The bird flew over our house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miglayang ka bayaku ampew te baley ta.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: te (meyitenged te tel-eb wey ke terung)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is over something else, it is covering it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a cover over the computer.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She put a cloth over the food.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Intel-eban din te manggad ka keenen.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are over someone else, you have responsibility and authority to tell them what to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My husband is over six other people in his company.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka asawa ku due katenged te hen-em ne me duma rin diyè te kumpanya.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a certain number is over another number, it is more than that other number.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are over 100 workers in that company.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due subla te sabeka ne gatus ne trabaanti [traba͡anti] te sika ne kumpanya.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happens over a certain period of time, that is the period of time when it happens.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'll teach you that program over the next three weeks.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpanuluen ku si kuna sika ne prugrama taman te tatelu ne simana.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are over something such as an illness, you do not have that illness any more.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something turns over, it moves so that the other side is on top.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The car rolled over in the accident.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something falls over, it suddenly moves from standing up to lying down.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The post fell over in the strong wind.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Napeled ka pes-ek te makeseg ne kalamag.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is over, it is finished.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Fiesta will start on Sunday and will be over by Friday.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egbunsud te Duminggu ka pista wey egkeimpusan te Birnis.

entries.summary: langun-langun; te langun-langun (malehet ke egsumsumanen ka langun ne baad)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: An overall amount or result is what you have when you include everything.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The overall cost of the food was 800 pesos.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Walu ne gatus ka langun-langun ne kentidad te keenen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She put flowers all around the room, and the overall effect was beautiful.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtahù sikandin te bulak palibut te sinabeng, wey migmeupiya ka langun-langun ne egtengtengan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: te langun-langun (malehet ke egsumsumanen ka langun ne baad)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is true overall, it is true if you think about all of the parts together, even if it is not true for every individual part.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Overall, the weather was good, even though there were a few rainy days.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te langun-langun, ka timpu meupiya, minsan pad due tallintek ne peg-uran-uran te me pipila ne aldew.

entries.summary: egliyuwan
egbaggiyu
diyè te lein ne nasud; abrud

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: diyè te lein ne nasud; abrud

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a different country from your home country (e.g., go overseas, work overseas).

entries.summary: egpangamuney ne minsan nekey; Egkahamit seini ke egpataha te minsan nekey impangamuney te minsan hentew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you own something, it is yours.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini ke egpataha te minsan nekey impangamuney te minsan hentew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use own to say strongly that something belongs to somebody.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is very kind! He gave me his own blanket.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne buutan sikandin! Imbehey rin keddì ka kandin ne ulesen.

entries.summary: impangamuney

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that you own something.

entries.summary: kabil
impanines
sabeka ne ilis te sengebuuk ne pepil te libru

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sabeka ne ilis te sengebuuk ne pepil te libru

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one side of one piece of paper in a book.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of pay

entries.summary: masakit eggeramen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a bad feeling in some part of your body because there is a problem with it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has a lot of pain in his leg.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due memasakit ne eggeramen din te paa rin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is in a lot of pain.

entries.summary: pintal; eggimu te minsan nekey ne ula-ula diyè te pepil wey ke minsan hendei ne eggamit te pintal.; egbatek te minsan nekey ne eggamit te pintal

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a thick, colored liquid which you spread onto something flat such as paper or a wall

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggimu te minsan nekey ne ula-ula diyè te pepil wey ke minsan hendei ne eggamit te pintal.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you paint a picture, you put paint on something such as paper to make a picture.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbatek te minsan nekey ne eggamit te pintal

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you paint something such as a wall, you use a brush or roller to spread paint on it.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpanunggilingen te amana ne titing-awi eyew amana egkanengnengan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you paint a picture with words, you describe something clearly so that people can imagine it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In his speech, he painted a very dark picture of life in that country.

entries.summary: atag; paris; butang ne neyimu te daruwa ne baad ne nekegsumpul iling te gunting wey duma pad.; egpeg-atag; egpegparis

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: two things that belong together (e.g., a pair of shoes).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: butang ne neyimu te daruwa ne baad ne nekegsumpul iling te gunting wey duma pad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a thing which is made of two parts joined together (e.g., a pair of scissors, a pair of jeans).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you pair things, you put them in groups of two.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our teacher paired me with my sister for the activity.

entries.summary: palad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a family of trees that have a straight trunk with no branches, and pointed leaves at the top. Includes coconut trees.

entries.summary: tukuwan
pepil; nasulatan te me guhuren ne pepil; sinulat ne egnengnengen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the flexible, flat material made from processed wood. You often write on it. It is counted as pieces or sheets (e.g., two sheets of paper).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nasulatan te me guhuren ne pepil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a long piece of writing about something that you have studied.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I wrote a paper about mosquitoes for my science class.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sinulat ne me insè eyew te peggeram

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Please leave your exam papers on the table when you have finished.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me keilangan ne pepil ne natahuan te kanengnengan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your papers are pieces of paper with important personal information on them (e.g., your birth certificate).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Keep your papers in a safe place.

entries.summary: panunggilingan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a short story which teaches something.

entries.summary: nekeglundug; nekeg-iling te egpatangkaan; nekeg-iling; egpekeg-iling

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one line or thing is parallel to another, it goes in the same direction as that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our fence is parallel to the road.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka alad ta nekeg-lundug te kelesadda.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing or situation is parallel to another, it is similar to it, or happens at the same time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My friend and I are in parallel situations: we are both the oldest in the family.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka alukuy ku wey siak nekeg-iling key te sitwasyun: sikanami daruwa ka me panganey ne anak te pamilya.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There were parallel graduation ceremonies at the two schools, so my grandmother couldn't go to both.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing or situation parallels another, it is similar to it, or happens at the same time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Your experience with the snake parallels another story that I heard last week. Maybe it is the same snake.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka nakita nu ne uled egpekeg-iling te duma ne guhuren ne narineg ku seeyè se hun-a ne simana. Kema ke iyan ded ne uled.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that is similar between two things or situations.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's difficult to find parallels between the two movies, because they are completely different.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne malised ka egpeg-iling te daruwa ne salida, uya su amana ne nekeg-lein sikandan.

entries.summary: egkatammanan dè te egkeyimu nu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a limit which controls what you can do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother gives me quite a lot of freedom within certain parameters.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka iney ku migbehey te bayew dakel ne kaligwangan te nateil tamananan.

entries.summary: amey wey ke iney; ginikanan; egpanulù wey egtanggu te batè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you parent your child, you teach them and care for them.

entries.summary: le-leuhanan diyè te siyudad ne due hilamenen wey kayu; egtahù te terak (diyè te nateil ne lugar)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: le-leuhanan diyè te siyudad ne due hilamenen wey kayu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a public area in a city or town with grass and trees.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egtahù te terak (diyè te nateil ne lugar)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you park a vehicle somewhere, you drive it to that place and leave it there for some time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She parked the motorbike in front of the gate.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Imparking din ka mutur diyè te tangkaan te gemawan.

entries.summary: baad; kenè ne langun te minsan nekey (meyitenged te baad); ka karakel te sengebutang ne igsewug te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one of the pieces that something is made of.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè ne langun te minsan nekey (meyitenged te baad)

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She could only remember part of the song; she forgot the chorus.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka karakel te sengebutang ne igsewug te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an amount of something which you mix with another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: To make native coffee, mix one part coffee to two parts corn.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te peggimu te menubu ne kepi, egsewuhan ka sengebaad te kepi te daruwa ne baad te aheley.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are part of a group, you are in that group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is part of a jogging club.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your part in an activity is the thing that you do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He played a large part in the planning of the talent night.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two people or things part with each other, or part from each other, they leave each other so that they are not together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When my friend left my village, we parted with hugs and tears.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you part two things or people, you cause them to become separate.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The young couple were parted by their families, who did not want them to marry.

entries.summary: etew ne egtambung te me himuwen

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: etew ne egtambung te me himuwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who joins in an activity.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There were ten participants in the contest.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due sapulù ne migtambung te pegpapitawey te katuenan.

entries.summary: eg-apil; peg-apil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you participate in an activity, you join in.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I participated in the singing contest.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-apil a te egpapitawey te katuenan te ulahingen.

entries.summary: nateil; mapahetpet te nateil ne pamaahi; me kanengnengan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you talk about a particular person or thing, you are talking about that person or thing and not others.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is one particular person who always helps me with my work.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due nateil ne etew ne layun egbulig te himu ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She spoke to the whole group, but I know she meant the message for one particular person.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use particular to say that something is special or more than usual.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Lack of rain is a particular problem there.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kakulangen te uran ka nateil ne prublima diyè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is particular about something, they like things to be exactly a certain way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is very particular about being clean, and washes her hands often.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana sikandin ne mapahetpet meyitenged te pegkamalinis, wey malasi egpanlulu sikandin te me belad din.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She just said that she was sick, but she didn't give any particulars.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migkahi sikandin te egderalu rin, piru warè iya mignangen sikandin te minsan nekey te kanengnengan.

entries.summary: talagduma; asawa; atag; paris

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person or organization that works together with another person or organization (e.g., in business).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who you have a long-term sexual relationship with (this word is sometimes used for 'husband' or 'wife' also).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the person who you are dancing with.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My brother and his friend formed a partnership making and selling bamboo furniture.

entries.summary: kalibulungan (due keen-keen); grupu te me etew ne due nasabekaan ne eggimuwen; grupu te me pulitiku

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an event when people meet together to have fun or to celebrate something such as a birthday. There is usually food.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: grupu te me etew ne due nasabekaan ne eggimuwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of people who are doing something together (e.g., traveling, searching for someone).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A large party of people walked to the next village.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His daughter was lost, so he sent out a search party.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a political group who want to get some political power

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: grupu te me etew ne nekegsinabut

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If there is a problem or agreement between two groups or people, each group or person is a party.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: After listening to both parties, the Barangay captain decided who was in the wrong.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Pegke-impus te pegpammineg te tagsè grupu, ka Barangay kepitan miglalag ke hentew ka nakasalè.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We are trying to sell our van, and at the moment there are three interested parties.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are a party to an action, you know about it, and help to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't like your plan, and I will not be a party to it, so you'll need to find someone else to help you.

entries.summary: egbayè; eglihad; egbehey; egtaruwey; egpasar; egpakapasar

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you pass something, or go past it, you move from one side of it to the other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: On your way to Valencia, you pass CMU.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The bullet passed right through his hand.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We passed through the mountains to get to the village.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you pass something to someone, or pass someone something, you use your hand to move it to them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Could you please pass me the salt.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you pass a test or exam, or pass in a subject, your score is good enough.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm happy because I passed in all my subjects.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If time passes, it goes by.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Many years passed before they saw one another again.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a law-making group passes a law, they accept it so that it can become a law for everybody.

entries.summary: lambasan
pasayru

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: someone who is travelling in a vehicle such as a bus or car, but is not driving.

entries.summary: kenè egpakig-ehet ke nekey ka igkeupii ran, egbalaharen dan dè ka minsan nekey ne egkeyitabù kandan.; ka eglalahen te pangasak iyan ka sabeka ne egdawat te weil.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè egpakig-ehet ke nekey ka igkeupii ran, egbalaharen dan dè ka minsan nekey ne egkeyitabù kandan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is passive, they don't fight for what they want; they just allow things to happen to them.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka eglalahen te pangasak iyan ka sabeka ne egdawat te weil.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In grammar, in a passive sentence, the subject of the sentence is the one who receives the action.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The cake was eaten by the boy ['The cake' is the subject of the sentence, and it is the thing which receives the action].

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kik egkeenen te batè [ka 'kik' ka eglalahen te pangasak, wey seini ka butang ne egdawat te weil].

entries.summary: nanlihad; miglihad; miglihad (aldew ne iyam pad neimpusi)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The_past is the period of time before now.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In the past, people had larger families.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te nanlihad, ka me etew due dakel ne pamilya.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A past event is something that happened some time before now.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have attended the past three meetings.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakaapil a te katatelu ne miglihad ne kalibulungan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The past period of time (e.g., the past month) is a period of time which has just finished.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The past month has been very busy.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka miglihad ne bulan amana ne dakel se himu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you move past something, or pass it, you move close by it, from before it to after it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She didn't talk to me, she just walked straight past.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè migpakiglalag sikandin keddì, miglihad dè sikandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: When telling the time, past means 'after'

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Beyinti ne minutus e ne nakalihad ka alas siti.

entries.summary: egparekket
dalan; bayaanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a narrow way which you walk along.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the line that someone or something moves along (e.g., the path of a snake; the path of a landslide).

entries.summary: mapariralemen; kenè egkapelaan ne egtatahad; pegkamapariralemen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a patient person does not get angry or upset if they have to wait a long time, or if people don't do what they want.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Please be patient while you are waiting for me.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A teacher of children needs to be patient.

entries.summary: ka egtangguwen te duktur; pasinti

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: someone who is receiving care from a doctor or in a hospital.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are many patients at the hospital.

entries.summary: eggeyinawa te inged

pamaahi te peggimu te minsan nekey ne layun egpekeg-iling.; pegkasinsinundul te me kasangkapan te nateil ne pamaahi.; kasangkapan eggamiten eyew te peggimu te minsan nekey eyew te pegpakita te ula-ula wey te lein-lein ne baad.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pamaahi te peggimu te minsan nekey ne layun egpekeg-iling.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a way of doing something that is always the same.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They always follow the same pattern when they get home: shower, cooking, dinner and then resting.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegkasinsinundul te me kasangkapan te nateil ne pamaahi.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an arrangement of things in a particular order, repeated again and again.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was an interesting pattern of stars on the tablecloth.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due egpakabagget ne pegkasinsinundul te me bituen te hapin te lamisa.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kasangkapan eggamiten eyew te peggimu te minsan nekey eyew te pegpakita te ula-ula wey te lein-lein ne baad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something such as a diagram which you use when you make something, to show you the shape of the different parts (e.g., a skirt pattern).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is very clever, because she can make a skirt without using a pattern.

entries.summary: sanggel
egbayad te seleppì eyew te pegtrabahu; bayad; suwildu; egbayad te pegbebeli

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbayad te seleppì eyew te pegtrabahu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you pay someone, you give them money because they did some work for you.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the money that you receive for working.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Here is your pay for this week

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you pay someone, or pay for something, you give money because you are buying something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I paid the shop assistant for the eggs.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you pay for something that you did, you experience something bad because you did that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you don't care for your teeth now, you will pay for it when you are older.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke kenè nu eg-apingan ka ngipen nu kuntee, egkalasey ka kayi ke egkabuyag kad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an action pays, it brings a good result.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Your hard work now will pay in the harvest season.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka amana nu ne pegtrabahu ka egpakabehey te dakel ne egkahaani nu te tinggaani.

entries.summary: meupiya ne sitwasyun, ne due meupiya ne rilasyun, peglelawa wey warè kalaggawan; keupianan; kalinew; warad ehetanan; warè samuk; pegkamalinew te lugar

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: meupiya ne sitwasyun, ne due meupiya ne rilasyun, peglelawa wey warè kalaggawan; keupianan; kalinew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a good situation, with good relationships, health and no worries.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She has no peace because she is always worrying about her son.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If there is peace between groups or countries, there is no fighting.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: After years of fighting, there was finally peace between the two countries.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a state of quietness in a place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I love walking in the mountains, because I enjoy the peace and quiet there.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian a ne egleug-leug te me bubungan, su amana a egkeupian te kalinew wey kenè ne mahulub diyè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A peaceful activity does not include fighting

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We hope the two countries will find a peaceful solution to the problem.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: malinawen (meyitenged te lugar wey ke timpu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a peaceful place or time is quiet and not stressful.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The mountain is a peaceful place where I can hear birds and water.

entries.summary: puntul; iddus; katammanan; pupul; egpatamanen; egtamanen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the pointed top of a mountain.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The peak of something is the time or place when it is highest or best.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone peaks, they reach their best level of ability. If something (e.g. a company's monthly profit) peaks, it reaches its highest level.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Peak time is the busiest time (e.g., peak season for tourism, peak hour for traffic).

entries.summary: Makehal, malurung-lurung ne malibusen seini, ne diyè dè egtubù te diralem te uwistir. Maangkag wey meebul-ebul seini, wey egpangimuwen seini ne balieg.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Makehal, malurung-lurung ne malibusen seini, ne diyè dè egtubù te diralem te uwistir. Maangkag wey meebul-ebul seini, wey egpangimuwen seini ne balieg.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a hard, smooth round object, which grows inside an oyster. It is usually white or gray, and is used in jewelry.

entries.summary: bulpin
lapis

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a writing tool made of a long piece of black lead or graphite, with wood around it.

entries.summary: me etew
te tagsè; ikul te (meyitenged ke nekey ka panulù)

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are enough bananas for three per person.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due tigtatelu ne sahing te tagsè etew.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ikul te (meyitenged ke nekey ka panulù)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you do something as per the instructions, you do what the instructions say to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I added one cup of sugar, as per the recipe.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtimul a te sabeka ne basu ne sukal, ikul te egkahiyen te eggilutuen.

entries.summary: tagsè gatus; pursintu; pursintu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Per_cent means "in each hundred". Symbol: %. Five per_cent means five parts in every 100 parts.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They lost eighty per cent of their vegetables in the landslide.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a number or amount which you can measure using per_cent.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They lost a large percentage of their vegetables in the landslide.

entries.summary: egkatuenan (pinaahi te pegtengteng, pegdineg, peggarek, peggeram wey ke peggeram-geram); egsuman-suman

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkatuenan (pinaahi te pegtengteng, pegdineg, peggarek, peggeram wey ke peggeram-geram)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you perceive that something is true, you know it by seeing, hearing, smelling, tasting or feeling it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She perceived that he was very upset.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Natuenan din ne amana nabelù sikandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Dogs can perceive that a thunderstorm is coming before humans can.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you perceive someone or something as a certain thing, you think they are like that.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She perceives her older brother as a hero.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Insuman-suman din ne ka kinakakayan ne suled din bahani.

entries.summary: pegkateu pinaahi te pegtengteng, pegdineg, peggarek, peggeram wey pegsabut.; katuenan ne egpakakita wey egpakasabut te malised ne egkakita wey egkasabut.; pegsuman-suman; pegtuu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegkateu pinaahi te pegtengteng, pegdineg, peggarek, peggeram wey pegsabut.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of knowing something by seeing, hearing, smelling, tasting, feeling or understanding it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The perception of very small sounds is easy for dogs.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: katuenan ne egpakakita wey egpakasabut te malised ne egkakita wey egkasabut.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the ability to see or understand things that are not very easy to see or understand.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My sister has a lot of perception; she always knows if people are upset about something.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your perception of someone or something is what you think about them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Many people have a wrong perception of sharks, and think that they are all dangerous.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Masalig ne etew ne due seyyup ne pegsuman-suman te ihu, egsuman-suman ne ka langun ne ihu dilikadu.

entries.summary: egpakakita wey egpakasabut te malised ne egkakita wey egkasabut.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakakita wey egpakasabut te malised ne egkakita wey egkasabut.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A perceptive person is able to see or understand things that are not easy to see or understand.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My sister is very perceptive, and always know if people are upset about something.

entries.summary: warè seyyup; warè prublima (meyitenged te minsan nekey); malinis; warè salè; eg-up-upianan; egmeupiyeen; eg-ay-ayaran

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: warè seyyup; warè prublima (meyitenged te minsan nekey)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is perfect, there is nothing wrong with it: it has no problems.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her teeth are perfect! Straight and white, with no holes at all.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is perfect, they have no sins.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you perfect something, you work on it to make it perfect.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His English is okay, but he should practice more to perfect it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka Inglis din eleg, piru keilangan ne egbebasbas pad sikandin kayi eyew egmeupiya pad.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegkawarè seyyup; pegkawarè prublima; 2 pegkamalinis; pegkawarè salè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of causing something to be perfect.

entries.summary: eggimu te weil; egpapitew te minsan nekey (iling te pegsayew)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you perform an action, you do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The doctor performed an operation on the child.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka duktur miggimu te peg-upira te batè.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpapitew te minsan nekey (iling te pegsayew)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you perform something such as a dance, you do it in front of a group of people.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The children performed a dance at the concert.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me batè migpapitew te sayew diyè te kunsirt.

entries.summary: peggimu te minsan nekey; kamenu keupiya ka peggimu diyè te minsan nekey; pegpapitew te minsan nekey

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is very weak, so the performance of daily jobs is difficult for him.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana sikandin mahuyè, su ka peggimu te inaldew-aldew ne trabahu rin malised para kandin.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kamenu keupiya ka peggimu diyè te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The performance of a person or thing is how well they do something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That motorbike has very good performance.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne meupiya sika ne mutur (meyitenged te himu).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action of doing something such as a dance in front of a group of people.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Everyone liked the children's dance performance.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka tagsè sabeka neupian te pegpapitew te sayew te me batè.

entries.summary: kema buwa ke; kema ke

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use perhaps to say that something is possibly true or will possibly happen.

entries.summary: kaluhayan te uras wey ke timpu; tulduk; langeseen

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kaluhayan te uras wey ke timpu

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She stayed with us for a period of one month.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-ugpè sikandin kanami te seled te sabeka ne bulan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our dog sometimes goes into the mountains for long periods. Last time we didn't see him for two weeks.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In writing, a period is a dot at the end of a sentence. It is also called a full-stop. Symbol: .

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the process in which a woman loses blood every month (menstruation).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use ‘periodic’ to talk about something that happens rather regularly.

entries.summary: malasi ne baseen [base͡en] meyitenged te egnengnengen

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: malasi ne baseen [base͡en] meyitenged te egnengnengen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something such as a journal that is published regularly (e.g., every month). The subject is usually serious or academic.

entries.summary: layun
pegpekeyimu te minsan nekey (meyitenged te pegtuhut te lein ne etew)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegpekeyimu te minsan nekey (meyitenged te pegtuhut te lein ne etew)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that you are allowed to do something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You need to ask permission from the teacher if you want to leave the room.

entries.summary: egtuhut; egbehey te timpu; kalig-enan ne eglalag te egpekeyimu ka ne eggimu te minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you permit someone to do something, you say that they can do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our teacher permitted me to leave class early.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You are not permitted to enter that building.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or situation permits something to happen, they make it able to happen and do not stop it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The bad weather didn't permit us to travel yesterday.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kalig-enan ne eglalag te egpekeyimu ka ne eggimu te minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a document which says that you can do something or have something (e.g., a building permit).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You need to get a building permit if you want to build a house.

entries.summary: eglaseyen wey ke eglised-liseren (puun su kenè dan igkeupii ka minsan nekey ne diyè te kuna iling te rilihiyun wey duma pad); peglaseylasey wey ke peglisedlised; pegbayad-bayad

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eglaseyen wey ke eglised-liseren (puun su kenè dan igkeupii ka minsan nekey ne diyè te kuna iling te rilihiyun wey duma pad)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people persecute you, they make life very difficult for you because they don't like something about you (e.g., your religion).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: bad things that you experience because people persecute you.

entries.summary: egpabulus

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something persists, it continues to exist.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He took medicine, but the pain persisted.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you persist_with something, or persist_in doing something, you continue to do it, even though it is not easy or popular.

entries.summary: etew
pegtuu; pegsabut; katuenan ne egpakakita te sitwasyun ne malehet; pegtengteng ne hendue te mariyù ne hendue man e te marani

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your perspective on something is what you think about it, and how it affects you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: From a farmer's perspective, the dry weather is bad.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Para te me mabasuk ne pegtuu, ka mammara ne timpu mareet.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you want to understand people, it is important to try to look at things from their perspective.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: katuenan ne egpakakita te sitwasyun ne malehet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the ability to see a situation as it really is. You say that something is in_perspective.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When I see the problems of others, it helps me to put my own small problems in perspective.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te nakita ku ka prublima te duma, nakabulig seini keddì ne egkakita ku ne deisek bes dè ka keddin prublima.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegtengteng ne hendue te mariyù ne hendue man e te marani

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In a painting, perspective is the fact that some things in the picture look like they are far away from you, and other things look like they are close.

entries.summary: ayam
sabeka ne baad te sesalihi ne eggimuwen wey pegsaliyu; sengebaad te ula-ula ne egkakita te bulan wey kalibutan; egbalew-balew te mapahanad-ganad

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sabeka ne baad te sesalihi ne eggimuwen wey pegsaliyu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one of the steps in a series of actions or changes.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The frogs are in the tadpole phase at the moment.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka bakbak diyad e te butitì ne baad kuntee.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sengebaad te ula-ula ne egkakita te bulan wey kalibutan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a phase of the moon or of a planet is one of the shapes that we see it in, depending on light from the sun.

fields.label: English explanation

fields.text: If you plan to do something, it is in your mind that you will do it, and you get ready for it.

fields.text: If you plan something that you are going to do, you think about how you will do it. If you plan something that you are going to make, you think about what it will look like, and what parts it will have.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His school results were poor, so he could not graduate.

entries.summary: mabantug; due kalabetan te langun ne me etew; inggimu te lerew ne me etew (kenè ne deisek dè ne grupu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something is popular, many people like them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is very popular at school, and has many friends.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This candy is very popular with children, so we sell a lot of it.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due kalabetan te langun ne me etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something popular relates to all or most people.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In popular thinking, he is a hero.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: inggimu te lerew ne me etew (kenè ne deisek dè ne grupu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something popular is made for ordinary people, not just a small group (e.g., popular music).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He reads popular books, but his brother read very serious, heavy books.

entries.summary: keet-etawan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the population of a place is all the people who live there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The population of our town is about 500.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka keet-etawan te kanami ne lungsud su me lalimma ne gatus.

entries.summary: baad
nakatahù; egtahù; egteilen; pegteil te lawa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The position of something is the place where it is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Their house is in a really great position because it's close to the school and also close to their field.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you position something somewhere, you put it in that place

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She positioned herself so that she could watch the parade easily.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your position is the shape that you put your body in.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She was in a sitting position.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Your back will become sore if you sit in that position for a long time.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your position on a particular topic is what you think and believe about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What's your position on global warming?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the job that you have in an organization or group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He accepted the position of president of the committee.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has a high position in our village

entries.summary: kenè ne duwa-ruwa; siguradu; egkeupian; igkeupii, igkabennali; meupiya wey mabulig

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are positive that something is true, you are sure.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm positive that I locked the door yesterday.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Siguradu a ne impaggul ku ka gemawan gabii.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are positive about something, you like it and think that it is good.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Many people were very positive about the new teacher.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Masalig ne me etew ne egkeupian meyitenged te iyam ne meistra.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something positive is good or helpful.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The new bridge will be very positive for our village.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The new bridge will be a big positive for our village.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka iyam ne tulay dakel ne bulig te kanami ne bariyu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka me numiru ne paribabew te siru

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A positive number is more than zero (0).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a medical test is positive for a particular illness, the person has that illness.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtengtengan wey miggeraman sikandin ne due iya dalu rin ne tibi.

entries.summary: egpangamuney ne minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
