fields.text: If you possess something, it is yours.

entries.summary: kasangkapan ne impangamuney
Sabeka seini ne lalag ne egpangguhud ke hentew-a ka migpangumuney te minsan nekey. Te kenè pad ka ngaran.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Sabeka seini ne lalag ne egpangguhud ke hentew-a ka migpangumuney te minsan nekey. Te kenè pad ka ngaran.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a word which tells you who owns something. It is before a noun. It is a kind of determiner.

entries.summary: Sabeka seini ne lalag ne egpanengneng keykew ke hentew-a ka kamuney te minsan nekey. ware ngaran pegkeimpus kayi.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Sabeka seini ne lalag ne egpanengneng keykew ke hentew-a ka kamuney te minsan nekey. ware ngaran pegkeimpus kayi.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a word which tells you who owns something. There is no noun after it.

entries.summary: 1 pegkaayun; 2 hendue te; 3 pegkeyitabù; egkeyitabù (meyitenged te duwa-ruwa)

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is no possibility of success without hard work.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which may be the case or may happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are two possibilities: either they are very late, or they are not coming today.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due daruwa ne egkeyitabù: namewuri amana sikandan wey ke kenè eglepew sikandan kuntee.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's a possibility that we will go to Valencia next week, but it depends on my work.

entries.summary: egkeyimu; egkaayun; hendue te; kema ke; egkeyitabù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If it is possible to do something, you can do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's not possible to swim across the Pacific Ocean.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè egkaayun ne egpamalasen dè te eglumbuk ka peglapas te dahat.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If it is possible that something is the case, maybe it is the case.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's possible that she still lives there, but I really don't know.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Hendue te diyè pad mig-ugpè sikandin, piru warè ad amana nakataha.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If it is possible that something will happen, maybe it will happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's possible that we will buy a horse next month.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeyitabù e ne egpakabebeli kid e te kuddè te seup ne bulan.

entries.summary: pamaahi te pegpeuyan te sulat; egpeuyan te sulat; egtahù diyè te tahuanan ne masalig ne etew ka egpakabasa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a country's system for sending letters and parcels.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He sent me a letter by post.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you post a letter or parcel you put a stamp on it and send it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He posted a letter to me.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egtahù diyè te tahuanan ne masalig ne etew ka egpakabasa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you post something such as an advertisement, you put it in a place where many people can read it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The teacher posted the list of winners on the wall.

entries.summary: sungkaleg; pes-ek

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a tall thing made of wood, metal or concrete which stands up out of the ground.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The posts hold the electric wires.

entries.summary: katenged wey ke trabahu diyè te kumpanya wey ke gubirnu; egpapeendiyè [egpape͡endiyè] wey ke egpeuyan eyew te pegpatrabahu.; egtahù te etew eyew te pegpabantey te minsan hendei

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: katenged wey ke trabahu diyè te kumpanya wey ke gubirnu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a position or job in a company or the government.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She has a teaching post in a remote area.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due trabahu rin ne pegpanulù diyè te me palewuken ne me lugar.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpapeendiyè [egpape͡endiyè] wey ke egpeuyan eyew te pegpatrabahu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If your employer posts you somewhere, they send you to that place to work.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The army posted him to northern Luzon.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sundalu migpeuyan kandin diyè te balabahan ne baad te Lusun.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egtahù te etew eyew te pegpabantey te minsan hendei

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people post a guard or soldier somewhere, they tell the guard or soldier to stand there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Banks post guards at the front door.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtahù ka bangku te talagbantey te tangkaan ne gemawan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the place where a guard or soldier has to stay.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The guard stayed at his post for ten hours.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka talagbantey mig-ugpè diyè te egbantayan din ne lugar te sapulù ne uras.

entries.summary: warè nakabulus.
kendiru

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a round metal container which you cook things in.

entries.summary: meyitenged seini ke eglalag ka te minsan hentew wey ke minsan nekey ne egkaayun, ne egkeyimu ne sika ne butang.; keyimuwan; kaya; katuenan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: meyitenged seini ke eglalag ka te minsan hentew wey ke minsan nekey ne egkaayun, ne egkeyimu ne sika ne butang.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you say that someone or something is a potential thing, you mean that maybe they will become that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I've found a potential buyer for my motorbike, but I need to talk with him more.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakakita ad te egkaayun ne egbebeli te mutur ku, piru keilangan e pad ne eg-abey egpakiglalag kandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The potential of a person or thing is what they can become or do in the future.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This plant has the potential to help many sick people around the world.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ne pinamula due keyimuwan ne egpakabulig te egmanderalu ne me etew kayi te kalibutan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something has potential, they have the ability to become successful.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Your son is a great musician, and has a lot of potential.

entries.summary: egdekdeken; egbinayuwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you pound something you hit it hard many times.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She pounded on the door, but he didn't open it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They pounded the rice to remove the skins.

entries.summary: seked te kabehat ne 0.45 wey ke 0.37 dè ne kilugram

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: seked te kabehat ne 0.45 wey ke 0.37 dè ne kilugram

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a measurement of weight which equals 0.45kg or 0.37kg

entries.summary: eg-itis; egbusbus
kawalad-en

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the state of being very poor.

entries.summary: katenged; due geem [ge͡em]; due katenged; kurinti

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the ability to control things or people, or to do certain things (maybe because you have a high political or social position, or because you are rich).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The president of a country has a lot of power.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In some countries, the people have no power, because the government controls everything.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That businessman has a lot of power because he owns three of the largest companies in the town.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The police have the power to arrest people.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm sorry, I don't have the power to decide that. You will need to speak to my boss.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Only the president has the power to declare war.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person, group or country which is very strong in some way (e.g., it has a strong economy or military)

fields.label: English example
fields.text: China is one of the biggest economic powers in our region.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In ancient times, the Romans were a major world power.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: electrical energy which moves along wires and which is used to run machines and equipment.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is no power today because there was a brown-out in the storm.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an energy source powers something such as a machine, it provides the energy to run it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a powerful person, group or country can control others because they are rich or strong in some way.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something powerful is very strong (e.g., a machine)

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That is a very powerful motorbike, because it has a large engine.

entries.summary: due kalabetan te pegpangimu te minsan nekey, kenè dè ne suman-suman wey ke lalag.; malampusen su eleg te kamalehetan; kamenu kamalampusen wey keeleg te kamalehetan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due kalabetan te pegpangimu te minsan nekey, kenè dè ne suman-suman wey ke lalag.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something practical is related to doing things, not just ideas or words.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an idea or plan is practical, it can succeed because it fits reality.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is not practical to move all those sacks without a truck.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ne malampusen ne egweilen ta langun ka saku ne warè terak.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kamenu kamalampusen wey keeleg te kamalehetan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the practicality of something is how practical it is (sense 2).

entries.summary: egbebasbas; pegbebasbas; eggimu layun (te minsan nekey)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you practice something, or practice doing something, you do it more than once so that you can learn to do it well.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The children practiced their dance every day for the Fiesta.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of doing something more than one time so that you can learn to do it well.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It requires a lot of practice to play the guitar well.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We have a dance practice this afternoon for next month's Fiesta.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you practice a particular activity, you do it regularly.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The Matigsalug elders practiced herbal medicine.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me Matigsalug ne me buyag eggamit layun te me bawì puun te me sagbet.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a practicing Catholic, but his brother is Catholic in name only.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is my practice to get up at 5:30 in the morning.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ka layun ku eggimuwa ne eg-unew te alas singku midya te maselem.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I hope she will put my advice into practice.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you practice a particular profession (e.g., law, medicine), you do it as your job.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: punduk te me etew ne eggimu te nateil katuenan iling te bawì wey ke kukuman.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a company of people who do a particular kind of work, such as medicine or law.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has a small legal practice in the city, with three attorneys.

entries.summary: egsayè; egdayan; egdeyrey; me geyinawa, me lalag, wey me ulahingen te pegpasalamat wey pegsaye te Manama; egdeyrey puun te meupiya ne neyimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you praise God, you thank and honor him.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me geyinawa, me lalag, wey me ulahingen te pegpasalamat wey pegsaye te Manama

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: feelings, words and songs which thank and honor God.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was a time of praise at the beginning of the church meeting.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egdeyrey puun te meupiya ne neyimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone praises you, they tell you or other people that you are very good, or that something you have done is very good.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My teacher always praises us if we work hard.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Layun key egdeyraya te talagpanulù ney ke egtrabahu key te mangune-kunè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: words which say that you are very good, or that something you have done is very good.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He received praise from the teacher because of his hard work.

entries.summary: eg-ampù; egpanubad-tubad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you pray, you talk to God.

entries.summary: peg-ampu; pegpanubad; ig-ampu; igtubad-tubad; tubtubaren

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a particular thing which you say to God.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: God answered her prayer for the child.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka Manama migtabak te tubtubaren din para te batè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you preach, you speak to a group of people about religious things.

entries.summary: egpekewun-a; eggun-a

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing precedes another thing, it comes before it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone precedes you, they walk before you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My brother preceded me into the house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka suled ku miggun-a keddì diyè te baley.

entries.summary: amana ne keilangan du te duma ne butang

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: amana ne keilangan du te duma ne butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something takes precedence over another thing, it is more important than that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This job is the most important one, so it takes precedence over the other things that you want to do.

entries.summary: eggimuwen te nateil ne sitwasyun ne egkeyimu ne ilinganan keuremè; aliddanan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggimuwen te nateil ne sitwasyun ne egkeyimu ne ilinganan keuremè; aliddanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something that you do in a particular situation which creates a pattern for the future. When a similar situation happens again, you feel that you need to do the same thing again (set_a_precedent).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you give your child candies when she cries , it will set a precedent, so that she will always want candy when she cries.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke egbehayan nu te kindi ka anak nu ke egsinehew, egkeyimu e sika ne aliddanan ne ke egsinehew sikandin egbuyù naa te kindi.

entries.summary: amana ne keilangan
eleg; pegkamalehet; pegkeeleg

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a something is precise, it is very correct and exact.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We don't know the precise location of the lost group, we just know the general area where they are.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè key nakataha te eleg ne natahuan te nalaag ne grupu, nakataha key rè te natahuan dan ne inged.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A stopwatch gives very precise measurements of time.

entries.summary: baad te pangasak piru kenè ne sika ka eglalahen te pangasak. Ka seini ne lalag eglabet te weil ne lalag wey te me lalag impus te weil ne lalag.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: baad te pangasak piru kenè ne sika ka eglalahen te pangasak. Ka seini ne lalag eglabet te weil ne lalag wey te me lalag impus te weil ne lalag.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the part of a sentence which is not the subject. The predicate includes the verb and the words after the verb (e.g., the object).

entries.summary: eg-agseb; peg-agseb; agseb

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you predict that something will happen in the future, you say that it will happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He predicts that the Sinuda team will win the game.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-agseb sikandin ne ka grupu te Simud egdeeg te kuntis.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you say will happen

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I do not agree with his prediction that the Sinuda team will win.

entries.summary: igkeupii nu ka hun-a ne butang du te ikarangeb; igkeupii ne minsan nekey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: igkeupii nu ka hun-a ne butang du te ikarangeb

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you prefer one thing to another thing, you like the first thing better than the second thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My preference is to leave early rather than late.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Igkeupii ku ne eggipanew a te seselemi du te egkamewuri a.

entries.summary: me litra ne egkakita diyè te kewun-aan te lalag.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me litra ne egkakita diyè te kewun-aan te lalag.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a letter or group of letters which are added to the beginning of a word (e.g., 'un-' in 'unhappy', 'eg-' in 'eglibed').

entries.summary: egpangandam; egpanahana; egtahahè; egtahana; eg-andam; egtahana

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you prepare for something, you get ready for it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He's busy preparing for his exam tomorrow.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you prepare something, you cause it to be ready.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My sister prepared dinner and I washed the dishes after.

entries.summary: sabeka seini ne lalag ne egpakita te rilasyun te daruwa ne kasangkapan diyè te pangasak. Wey egkakita seini te kenè pad ka ngaran ne me lalag.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sabeka seini ne lalag ne egpakita te rilasyun te daruwa ne kasangkapan diyè te pangasak. Wey egkakita seini te kenè pad ka ngaran ne me lalag.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a word which shows the relationship between two things in a sentence. It comes before a noun phrase or clause.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The pen is on the table [on shows the relationship between the pen and the table]

entries.summary: due; pegkarue; pegkariyè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something is present in a place, they are there in that place.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the state of being there in a place.

entries.summary: dasag; egbehey te minsan nekey diyè te minsan hentew (meyilut maheteng wey ke diyè te kalibulungan ne pamaahi).; egpakita; egpapitew

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbehey te minsan nekey diyè te minsan hentew (meyilut maheteng wey ke diyè te kalibulungan ne pamaahi).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you present someone with something or present something to someone, you give it to them (usually in a formal or public way).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My co-workers presented me with a gift when I left my job.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you present something such as ID, you show it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You will need to present some ID to enter that place.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpanengneng wey ke egpeila te minsan hentew diyè te grupu te kenè pad eglalag wey ke eggimu diyè te tangkaan te grupu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you present someone to a group of people, you introduce them in a formal way, because they are going to speak or do something in front of the group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Now may I present the next singer in our program.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakita te minsan nekey ne katuenan diyè te kasuluhan (iling te salida wey ke duma pad).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you present something such as a movie or performance, you show it in public.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The band presented a few of their songs.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me mangulahing migpakita te duma ne me ulahingen dan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something presents another thing, it causes or brings that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This sports competition will present a challenge for all of the players.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ne pegpapitawey te katuenan egpakabehey te pegkabagget te langun ne manggalaway.

entries.summary: pegbehey; pegpeila-ila; pegpakita; pegpapitew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of giving something to someone.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of introducing someone or something to a group.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: himuwen (meyitenged te pegbehey te minsan nekey)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a formal ceremony in which someone receives something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We attended the presentation for the high school graduates.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegpapitew (meyitenged te ulahingen, sayew wey duma pad)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an event such as such as a concert, where people perform.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: All the parents are invited to the dancing presentation at the school.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ke nekey ka egkeilingan (meupiya naa wey ke mareet)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The presentation of a person or thing is what they look like.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Your project should not just have good research; attractive presentation is also important.

entries.summary: prisirba
egdumaan [egduma͡an] te inged; egdumaan [egduma͡an] te punduk wey ke panuluanan; talagdumalè; pegkadumaan te inged

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egdumaan [egduma͡an] te punduk wey ke panuluanan; talagdumalè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the leader of something such as a company or college.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Next election, he is going to run for the presidency.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: te timpu pad te nateil ne prisidinti

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the period of time that someone is president.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That happened during the presidency of George Bush.

entries.summary: egpesel; egdakesel; egdisè; egplansa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you press something, you push on it with your hand or foot.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She pressed the button to start the machine.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The doctor pressed my leg to find the painful part.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you press something somewhere, you push it onto or into that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She pressed her back against the wall.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She pressed the cooked rice into the plastic container.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you press clothes, you use an iron to make them smooth.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Your uniform will look much better if you are able to press it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you press someone to do something, you try very hard to make them do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They pressed me to go with them, and finally I said yes.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mekina eyew te peggimu te libru wey ke baseen [base͡en]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A (printing) press is a machine for printing books and newspapers.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The printing press was invented in Germany.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The press is journalists and newspapers

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They are trying to keep the story out of the press.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He had many interviews with the press.

entries.summary: pegpesel; peggeram te pegpehes eyew te pegpeyimu te minsan nekey; pegkabeley

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of pressing on something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Apply gentle pressure to the cut to stop it bleeding.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peggeram te pegpehes eyew te pegpeyimu te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of trying hard to make someone do something (put_pressure_on someone).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They put a lot of pressure on me to go with them, even though I didn't want to go.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that something difficult is causing you stress (be_under_pressure).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is under a lot of pressure at work at the moment, because they are very busy.

entries.summary: kuneen; kahiyen; eggimu te minsan nekey ne warè katenged

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you presume that something is true, you believe it without asking or checking.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I presume that you know the answer.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kuneen ku ke nakataha ka te tabak.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Your plan for the surprise party presumes that he will not come home early. But what if he comes home early?

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggimu te minsan nekey ne warè katenged

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you presume to do something, you do that thing even though you do not have the right or authority to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She presumed to borrow her boss's motorbike without asking.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migsambey sikandin te mutur te ahalen din ne warè migkahi minsan warè katenged din.

entries.summary: pegpalintutuu te warè peg-insè wey peg-ugsi-ugsì; peggimu te minsan nekey ne warè katenged

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegpalintutuu te warè peg-insè wey peg-ugsi-ugsì

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you believe is true without asking or checking.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Your presumption that she took the money is not correct.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegsuman-suman nu ne ingkuwa rin ka seleppì su kenè ne melehet.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peggimu te minsan nekey ne warè katenged

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: wrong behavior, in which someone does something that they don't have the right to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She showed a lot of presumption when she borrowed her boss's motorbike.

entries.summary: lilibat
meupiya ne egpitawen; bayew iya; malù iya; balù iya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person (female) or thing is pretty, they are very nice to look at.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is a very pretty girl.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne meupiya sikandin ne malitan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: bayew iya; malù iya; balù iya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: to some extent (used in non-formal language).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She's not the best singer in the group, but she's pretty good.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ne sikandin ka kinameupiyaan te grupu, piru bayew iya egkateu sikandin.

entries.summary: egpapeeneng-eneng; egsapad; egbalabag; egpakapeeneng-eneng; pegpapeeneng-eneng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone prevents you (from) doing something, they don't allow you to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father prevented me from going to the gym, because he was worried about the storm.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something prevents you (from) doing something, it causes you to not be able to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His health problems prevented him joining the sports team.

entries.summary: hun-a ne neyitabù; miglihad; newun-a; nekewun-a

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something previous happened before another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This job is very similar to my previous job.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ne himu amana ne iling te hun-a ne himu ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I didn't need to buy any rice last Friday, because I had bought rice the previous day.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can't come to your party because I have a previous arrangement.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happened previously, it happened before another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I told her previously that I was going to visit, so she knew.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekewun-a a mignangen kandin te egpanumbaley a, sika ka nakatahe e sikandin.

entries.summary: bali; ka mareet ne igsalerep ke due egkuen nu ne minsan nekey wey ke eggimuwen nu ne minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the amount that you need to pay for something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The price of that bread is 15 pesos.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka mareet ne igsalerep ke due egkuen nu ne minsan nekey wey ke eggimuwen nu ne minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the bad thing that you experience in order to get something, or because you did something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Tooth problems are the price that you will pay if you don't care for your teeth.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Prublima te ngipen ka igsalerep ne egkakuwa nu ke kenè nu eg-ampingan ka me ngipen nu.

entries.summary: garbu
talagpanubad; pari

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In some religions (e.g. Judaism), a priest is a person who offers sacrifices to their god, and does other religious ceremonies.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In the Catholic church, a priest is a person who teaches and who does things such as baptize and lead Mass.

entries.summary: kinewun-aan [kinewun-a͡an] wey amana ne keilangan; kinabunsuran; egbunsud pad; malemu wey keilangan ne me kasangkapan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something primary is the most important thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My primary reason for buying a bike is to travel to work.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kinewun-aan [kinewun-a͡an] ne aliddanan ku te pegbebeli ku te bayik su eyew due egkeunturan ku te egtrabahu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something primary is at the beginning.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is in the primary stages of TB.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egbunsud pad iya ka dalu rin ne tibi.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: malemu wey keilangan ne me kasangkapan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something primary is simple and basic.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Food is a primary human need.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka keenen ka malemu wey keilangan te me etew.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne migpuun duritsu te puunanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something primary comes directly from a source.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The writings of Rizal are a primary source for Philippine history.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me sinulat ni Risal ka duritsu ne migpuunan te guhuren te Pilipins.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Primary resources are things that come directly from the environment (e.g. iron, rice).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: mainly; you use primarily to talk about the most important thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He bought the bike, primarily to travel to work.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka dakel ne aliddanan te pegbebeli rin te bayik, su keilangan din te peggipanew peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te trabahu rin.

entries.summary: kinarakelan; kinameupiyaan ne klasi; timpu te pegkeuyag ne kekesehi pad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The prime person or thing is the main one or most important one.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The police arrested the prime suspect.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migdakep te pulis ka kinarakelan te egbayungan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The Prime Minister is the most powerful minister in the government.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something prime is the best quality.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That is prime pork, so it is more expensive than the other pork.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sika ka kinameupiyaan ne klasi te karni te babuy, sikak bayew dakel se bali du te duma.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: timpu te pegkeuyag ne kekesehi pad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the period of life when someone is strongest and most active. You say that someone is in_their_prime, or in_the_prime_of_life.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He died when he was only forty, still in the prime of life.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpatey sikandin te hep-at pad ne pulu ka idad din, makeseg pad ne baad te umul.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you prime something, you prepare it (e.g., prime a wall for painting or a gun for firing).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Before you use a water pump, you need to prime it by filling it with water.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te kenè ke pad egpasupsup te weyig, keilangan ne eg-andamen nu seini pinaahi te pegtahù te weyig.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you prime someone, you tell them something that they need to know to prepare them for something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They didn't prime us before the test, so we had no idea what we needed to do.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè migpanengneng sikandan kanta te warè pad ka tis, sikak warè puhawang ta ke nekey ka eggimuwen ta.

entries.summary: amana ne keilangan wey kinarakelan ne etew wey ke butang; eg-uyan te iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an]

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: amana ne keilangan wey kinarakelan ne etew wey ke butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The principal person or thing is the biggest or most important one.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was the principal actor in the movie.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sikandin ka amana ne keilangan ne etew diyè te salida.

entries.summary: kinewun-aan ne balaud wey puhawang ke egmemenu ka minsan nekey ne eggimu.; balaud meyitenged te meupiya ne weil; puhawang meyitenged te weil

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kinewun-aan ne balaud wey puhawang ke egmemenu ka minsan nekey ne eggimu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a basic law or idea about how something works.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Freedom of speech is one of the principles of a free society.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This water tank works on the principle of gravity.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: balaud meyitenged te meupiya ne weil; puhawang meyitenged te weil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a rule about good actions which a person follows because they believe it is good and right

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has high principles, and so he is a very honest and good man.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a man of principle, so I trust him.

entries.summary: pewun-a; nekewun-a

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something prior happened before another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They arrived with no prior warning, so we were surprised.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migginguma sikandan ne warè pewun-a ne katahaanan [kataha͡anan], sikak amana key natekew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A prior commitment is something that you arranged before now.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm sorry, I can't come to the meeting because I have a prior commitment.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Pasayluwa e rè te kena a egpakaapil te miting su duen e nekewun-a ne nasaaran ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a place where people sometimes go when they have done something bad and illegal.

entries.summary: warè egpakabanggew (meyinged te peggimu ne ware egtengteng ne etew)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: warè egpakabanggew (meyinged te peggimu ne ware egtengteng ne etew)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that you can do things without people watching.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I practice singing at home because I have privacy there.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Diya a egbebasbas egkanta te baley su warè egpakabanggew keddì diyè.

entries.summary: minsan nekey ne impangamuney te nateil dè ne etew wey ke grupu; baad te keykew ne pegkeetew kenè ne baad te trabahu nu; minsan nekey ne kenè egkaayun ne masalig ka egpakataha

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne impangamuney te nateil dè ne etew wey ke grupu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is private, a particular person or group owns it, not the government, so not everyone can use it (e.g., private land, a private school).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That is private land, so we shouldn't pass through it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Duen e migpangamumey sika te nateil ne tanè, sika ka kenè ki egkaayun ne due egbayè.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: baad te keykew ne pegkeetew kenè ne baad te trabahu nu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is private, it is part of your personal life, not part of your work.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I am going to Davao on private business, not for work.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne kenè egkaayun ne masalig ka egpakataha

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is private, you don't want many people to know about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I had a private talk with her.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due guhuren ku kandin ne kanami rè.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: inged ne deisek dè ka etew ne nakakita (nekeeles wey ke nakataneb)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A private place is quiet, and not many people can see it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Their house is very private, because it is not near the road.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka baley ran su neeles or nakataneb, su kene ne marani te kelesada.

entries.summary: dasag
buwa iya; peg-agseb ne due dakel wey deisek ne katumanan wey ke kasiguruwan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is probable, then there is a good chance that it is the case or that it will happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's probable that it will rain tomorrow.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkamalehet ne eg-uran buwa iya kaaselem.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peg-agseb ne due dakel wey deisek ne katumanan wey ke kasiguruwan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the chance that something is the case or will happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a high probability that it will rain tomorrow.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Dakel ka pusibilidad ne eg-uran kaaselem.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is probably the case or will probably happen, there is a good chance that it is the case or that it will happen.

entries.summary: minsan nekey ne kenè ne eleg meyitenged te minsan nekey; prublima; minsan nekey ne malised wey masakit; insè ne keilangan ne egsumsumanen eyew te pegtabak

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne kenè ne eleg meyitenged te minsan nekey; prublima

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that is not right about something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a problem with my motorbike.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne malised wey masakit

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that is difficult or painful.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has many problems in his life.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: insè ne keilangan ne egsumsumanen eyew te pegtabak

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a question that you need to think about to find the answer.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We have five maths problems for homework.

entries.summary: pamaahi; puhawang; himu ne due me mallintek ne baad te weil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The procedure for doing something is the usual or correct way to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother showed me the procedure for making pancit.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: himu ne due me mallintek ne baad te weil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action which includes a number of smaller actions, and which brings some result.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Making biku is a simple procedure.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Delivering a baby is a sometimes a complex procedure.

entries.summary: egpabulus; egpeendiyè [egpe͡endiyè] te kewun-aan [kewun-a͡an]; egpabulus eggimu; eggimu (impus te lein ne himuwen)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you proceed to a place, you move forward to that place. (used in formal language).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When you have finished, proceed to the door.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke nekeimpus kad, pabulus kad diyè te gumawan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you have a ticket, please proceed to the front of the line.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you proceed with something you continue to do it, usually after stopping it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: After a short break, they proceeded with their work.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you proceed to do something, you do it, usually after you have done something else.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She started a fire and proceeded to cook dinner.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggehapuy sikandin wey migsusubba eyew te iglabung.

entries.summary: punduk te me weil wey pegbalew-balew; egpangimu ne due pegkasunud-sunud; egpamitew wey ke eggamit (ka kumpyutir)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: punduk te me weil wey pegbalew-balew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of actions or changes which happen one after the other and produce some result.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Choosing a place is the first thing in the process of building a house.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The healing process of a broken bone can take a long time.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people process something such as a food, they do a series of actions to it to prepare it for other people to use.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That factory processes coconuts to produce coconut milk and oil.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a computer processes information, it checks or uses things in that information.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpanengneng te etew meyitenged te kasayuran

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an organization processes people, it checks information about them using a series of actions.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The refugees have not been processed yet, so they don't know if they will be able to stay in the country.

entries.summary: egpuunan te lein ne butang; egpangimu; egpapitew (meyitenged te ID)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something produces another thing, that other thing comes out of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The tree is producing fruit now.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you produce something thing, you make it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That writer produces one new book every year.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you produce something such as ID (identification), you show it to someone.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We needed to produce identification in order to enter the buildling.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone produces a movie, they are the one who organizes everything to make the movie.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was wonderful fresh produce for sale at the market.

entries.summary: neyimu; behas; belegyè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the thing that something produces or makes.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Steam is a product of hot water.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka inuwang neyimu puun te meinit ne weyig.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that is made and sold.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That company sells agricultural products such as fertilizer.

entries.summary: pegkeyimu; pegpangimu wey ke pegpatubù; peglibulung eyew te pegpangimu iling te salida wey ke CD

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of one thing creating another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This carabao's milk production is very good.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Meupiya amana ne pegkeyimu ka seini ne gatas te kalabew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of making or growing something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This city has a lot of car production.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ne siyudad due masalig ne pegpangimu te terak.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peglibulung eyew te pegpangimu iling te salida wey ke CD

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of organizing everying to make something such as a movie or CD.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something such as a play, which actors perform in a theater.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I saw a production of Shakespeare's 'Romeo and Juliet'.

entries.summary: trabahu ne keilangan te due neimpusan ne kursu te peg-iskuyla wey pegbebasbas.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: trabahu ne keilangan te due neimpusan ne kursu te peg-iskuyla wey pegbebasbas.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a job which needs a long period of special study and training (e.g., lawyer, doctor).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He wants to join the teaching profession.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian sikandin te egpanalù ne trabahu.

entries.summary: etew ne keilangan te due neimpusan ne kursu; ka etew ne eggimu te nateil ne himu ne ka trabahu rin; naay-ayaran te eggimu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: etew ne keilangan te due neimpusan ne kursu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who works in a job which needs special study and training (e.g., a lawyer, a doctor).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka etew ne eggimu te nateil ne himu ne ka trabahu rin

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A professional person does a certain thing as their job (e.g., a professional sportsman).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is professional, it has been made or done very well. If a person is professional, they do their job very well.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A typed letter looks more professional than a letter written by hand.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka egtayipen ne sulat amana ne meupiya ne egpitawen su naay-ayran te egsulat du te insulat dète belad.

entries.summary: ganansiya
nasinsinundul ne me himuwen; pepil ne nasulatan te nateil e ne me himuwenen; igmakita diyè te tibi wey egkarineg diyè te radyu

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What is the program for the fiesta?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekey ka me himuwen te pista?

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pepil ne nasulatan te nateil e ne me himuwenen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a piece of paper which shows a series of planned events.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We printed a program for the fiesta, to show all the activities.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: igmakita diyè te tibi wey egkarineg diyè te radyu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a show on television or the radio.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpeyimu te nateil ne pamaahi (meyitenged te kumpyutir wey ke mekina rè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you program a machine or computer, you cause it to work in a particular way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They programmed the electric bell to ring at 4pm every day.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: punduk te me panulù para te kumpyutir

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of instructions for a computer.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I had to write a computer program for my computer class.

entries.summary: egmeupiya te peggimu wey ke egpekeyimu te subla pad; egkameupiya wey ke egpalundaniyan e te pegkapenga; 1 pegmeupiya te peggimu wey ke pegkeyimu te subla pad; 2 pegkameupiya wey ke pegpalundaniyan te pegkapenga

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egmeupiya te peggimu wey ke egpekeyimu te subla pad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you progress in doing something, you become better at doing it, or you do more of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My son started learning to read last year, and he is progressing fast.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkameupiya wey ke egpalundaniyan e te pegkapenga

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something progresses, it gets better or gets closer to being finished.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Work on the new road is progressing fast, and we hope it will be finished by December.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegtrabahu te iyam ne kelesadda amana ne meiyal, wey eglaum key ne egkeimpusan seini te me Disimbri.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegmeupiya te peggimu wey ke pegkeyimu te subla pad; 2 pegkameupiya wey ke pegpalundaniyan te pegkapenga

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of getting better or getting closer to finishing (make_progress).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We are making good progress in our work, and we should finish by next week.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My teacher is happy with my progress. carefully.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an event progresses it continues to happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Many people arrived as the meeting progressed.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Masalig ka me etew ne migpanginguma te ka egkasasangan ka miting.

entries.summary: himuwen ne egkabehayan te dakel ne timpu te peggimu; pruyiktu; egleput; migketul; egpakita; egpalepew

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: himuwen ne egkabehayan te dakel ne timpu te peggimu; pruyiktu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you work on that takes a lot of time and work.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Building the new road will be a very big project.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegpangimu te iyam ne kelesadda egkeyimu ne egkabehayan te dakel amana ne timpu te peggimu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something projects from another thing, part of it is further forward than that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The large shelf projected from the wall.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka bubuyahen ne bantal migketul puun te alabat.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you project something, you 'throw' it (e.g., pictures onto a screen, your voice so that people can hear it).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The lamp projected light onto the wall.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sulù egpakita te layag diyè te alabat.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The teacher projected her voice so that we could all hear her.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you project something such as a number, you predict what it will be in the future.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We sold 200 pieces last year, and 300 this year. The projected sales for next year are 500.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakabelegyè key te daruwa ne gatus ne buuk te miglihad ne tuig, wey tatelu ne gatus kuntee ne tuig. Ka eg-agseben ne egkabelegyè te seup ne tuig su me lalimma ne gatus.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which projects from another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A thin person's backbone looks like a line of projections from their back.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka tul-an te peka te mahasè ne etew iling te lingya ne migleput ne diyè te peka rin.

entries.summary: eglalew; egsaad; lalew; saad; hendue te meupiya diyè te kinamuwuriyan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you promise to do something, or promise that you will do something, you say that you will certainly do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She promised not to tell anybody.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you say that you will do (make_a_promise).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She made a promise not to tell anybody.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: hendue te meupiya diyè te kinamuwuriyan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something promises to be something good, they look like they will be good in the future.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The weather promises to be fine today because the sky is very clear.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka timpu hendue te meupiya kuntee su maawang ka langit.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Your daughter promises to be a good singer when she is older.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegtengteng ne meupiya ka minsan nekey diyè te kinamewuriyan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that someone looks like they will be good at something in the future (show_promise).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Your daughter shows a lot of promise as a singer.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: hendue te meupiya diyè te kinamuwuriyan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Someone or something promising looks like it will be good in the future.

entries.summary: egpanengneng eyew egkaneng-nengan te me etew wey igkeupii; egpamalehet; egpeyitabù; egpakameupiya; egbehey te me-meupiya ne himu wey meupiya degma ne bayad

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpanengneng eyew egkaneng-nengan te me etew wey igkeupii

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you promote something, you try to cause people to like it or want it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He always promotes peace in his writings.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Layun din igpanengneng ka kalinew diyè te me sinulat din.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are many advertisements promoting the new movie.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due masalig ne pegpeyitaha eyew te pegpanengneng te iyam ne salida.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something promotes another thing, it causes that thing to happen or exist.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegkeen te gulay egpakameupiya te peglelawa.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbehey te me-meupiya ne himu wey meupiya degma ne bayad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If your boss promotes you, he gives you a better job, usually with better pay.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His boss promoted him because of his good work.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ahalen din migbehey kandin te me-meupiya ne trabahu tenged te meupiya ne himu rin.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegpanengneng eyew egkanengnengan; 2 pegpamalehet, pegpeyitabù, pegpakameupiya; 3 pegbehey te me-meupiya ne trabahu wey meupiya degma ne bayad

entries.summary: lalag ne igpanubal te ngaran te me etew, inged, kasangkapan, wey me pangitabù.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: lalag ne igpanubal te ngaran te me etew, inged, kasangkapan, wey me pangitabù.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a word which is in the place of a name (of a person, place or thing).

entries.summary: eglituk
peglalag
pegpamalehet ne ka duma ne butang malehet

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegpamalehet ne ka duma ne butang malehet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which shows that another thing is true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The footprints are proof that somebody was here.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me kemes iyan pegpamalehet ne due senge etew ne nekeendini [neke͡endini].

entries.summary: eleg; malehet wey eleg

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A proper thing is something which is right and correct for a particular situation. If someone's behavior is proper, it fits with society's rules about good behavior.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What is the proper thing to wear for the parade?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekey ka eleg ne igpansaluub te egparid?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In our culture it's not proper for a boy and girl to spend a lot of time alone together.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te kanta ne batasan kenen eleg ne ka lukes wey malitan egparumdumeey [egparumdume͡ey] te dakel ne timpu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A proper thing is real, complete or enough.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I didn't have a proper shower, I just washed my head.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè malehet ne pegpamanihus ku, migtutuliyuk e rè.

entries.summary: ngaran te etew, lugar wey ke butang (iling te Toto, Dabaw). Ne ka hun-a ne litra dakel (kapital).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ngaran te etew, lugar wey ke butang (iling te Toto, Dabaw). Ne ka hun-a ne litra dakel (kapital).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the name of a particular person, place or thing (e.g., Toto, Davao). The first letter is a capital letter.

entries.summary: kasangkapan ne impangamuney; balayanan; baad te tanè; kabagnelan; katedted

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your property is the things that you own.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Those animals are my property, because I bought them last week.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a piece of land and the buildings on it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We put a fence around our property to protect our animals.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A property of a thing such as a plant or chemical is something that it does.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Masalig ne me hirbal ne tambal ne due kabagnelan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A property of iodine is that it can disinfect.

entries.summary: pegpangguhud te igpalalag te Manama; pegpanagnè; panagnè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of speaking messages from God.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of saying what will happen in the future.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: words which say what will happen in the future.

entries.summary: egpangguhud te igpalalag te Manama; egtagnè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you prophesy, you speak a message from God.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you prophesy, you say something that will happen in the future (you know by means of power from God or the spiritual world).

entries.summary: prupita

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who speaks messages from God.

entries.summary: kaluag wey kasulug kunterè te lein; karaniyan te lein lein ne baad ne eleg ka kaluag wey karakelan kunterè te duma.; egbaad-baaren te nateil ne karakelan wey ke kaluag

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kaluag wey kasulug kunterè te lein

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the size of one number or quantity compared to another number or quantity.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What is the proportion of males to females in the group?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekey ka kasulug te me lukes kunterè te me malitan te punduk?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Pork is only a small proportion of our food.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka karni deisek dè se karakelan te pegkeen ta.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: karaniyan te lein lein ne baad ne eleg ka kaluag wey karakelan kunterè te duma.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a relationship between different parts in which they are all a good size or amount compared with each other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is very short, so his big feet are not in proportion to his height.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana sikandin ne malibutut, su ka derakel ne paa rin kenè ne eleg te kalayat din.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbaad-baaren te nateil ne karakelan wey ke kaluag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you proportion something, you make it so that the different parts are a certain size or amount compared with each other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He proportioned the house so that it had a very low roof.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbaad-baad din ka kaluag te baley rin eyew due mababew ne atep.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me seked te kaluahan wey ke karakelan te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the measurements of how big something is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The proportions of this house are 10ft x 12ft x 6ft

entries.summary: planu ne igpaambit nu diyè te duma ne etew te pegnengneng ke egkeupian naa sikandan ne eggimu kayi; lalag ne egbuyù minsan hentew ne eg-asawa keykew

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: planu ne igpaambit nu diyè te duma ne etew te pegnengneng ke egkeupian naa sikandan ne eggimu kayi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a plan which you share with other people to see if they want to do it.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: lalag ne egbuyù minsan hentew ne eg-asawa keykew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: words which ask someone to marry you.

entries.summary: Igpanugtul nu ka planu eyew egpakasuman-suman ka duma ke egkeupian naa sikandan ne eggimu.; egbuyuen nu ne eg-asaween nu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Igpanugtul nu ka planu eyew egpakasuman-suman ka duma ke egkeupian naa sikandan ne eggimu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you propose an idea, you tell people your idea so that they can decide if they want to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I propose that we leave after lunch.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you propose to someone, you ask them to marry you.

entries.summary: egpeggasal
egpamalehet; egkakita; egkanengnengan (meyitenged te egkakita ne kamalehetan peg-impus te sabekan timpu te sika ne butang)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you prove something, or prove that something is true, you show that it really is true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He showed his ID to prove that he was the owner.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkakita; egkanengnengan (meyitenged te egkakita ne kamalehetan peg-impus te sabekan timpu te sika ne butang)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something proves to be a thing, you see after some time that it really is that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She was nervous before, but the exam proved to be easy.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne nalaggew sikandin, piru ka iksam amana bes dè ne lelemuwi.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She proved to be a very good singer.

entries.summary: pegpamalehet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past participle of prove. You can also use proved.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is a proven fact, someone has showed that it really is true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Repairing roads is a proven way to reduce accidents.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Peg-ayad-ayad te kelesadda su ka pegpamalehet ne pamaahi te pegpareisek te karereetan wey ke disgrasya.

entries.summary: egbehey; egpakabehey; eg-uyag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you provide someone with something, or provide something for someone, you give it to them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'll provide the food for the team.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egbehey a te keenen para te grupu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something provides a particular thing, it gives that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The hen provides eggs for our family.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka manuk ne upa egpakabehey te atelug para te kanami ne pamilya.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you provide for someone, you give them the things that they need to live.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He works hard to provide for his family.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpanaman-taman sikandin migtrabahu eyew te peg-uyag te pamilya rin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you provide for something that might happen, you prepare so that you will be ready if it happens.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You need to provide for the fact that it might rain: don't forget to take umbrellas.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ne egpaney-paney ka su kema ke eg-uran: kenè ka egkalingew ne eg-uyan te payung.

entries.summary: basta su...ne (meyitenged te pegweil impus te hun-an weil)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: basta su...ne (meyitenged te pegweil impus te hun-an weil)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use provided to say that something will only happen if another thing happens.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Provided you finish your homework first, you can play with your friends.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Basta su gun-eyi nu impusi ka me himu nu, ne egkaayun kad ne eggalew duma te me alukuy nu.

entries.summary: basta su...ne; (meyitenged te weil pegke-impus te hun-an weil)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: (meyitenged te weil pegke-impus te hun-an weil)

entries.summary: 1 pegbehey; 2 pegpakabehey; 3 peg-uyag; sulaten ne dukumintu (meyitenged te igpeyimu wey kenè igpeyimu)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sulaten ne dukumintu (meyitenged te igpeyimu wey kenè igpeyimu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something in a law or document saying what you do or don't have to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't trust that document. There are so many provisions that they don't really promise us anything.

entries.summary: pegnengneng te sumansuman wey batasan te me etew; due kalabetan te sumansuman

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegnengneng te sumansuman wey batasan te me etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the study of the human mind and human behavior.

entries.summary: me etew; due kalabetan te keet-etawan; egkatahaan [egkataha͡an] te langun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The_public are all people in a place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This building is private, so it is not open to the public.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something public relates to all or most the people in an area.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a lot of public support for the new law.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If information is public, many people know it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is public knowledge that his wife is pregnant again.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Natahaan [nataha͡an] te langun ne ka asawa rin egkaberes e man e.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A public place is a place where all people can go, and where there are many people (e.g., a public park).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kasangkapan ne ka keet-etawan wey ke gubirnu ka kamuney

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A public facility is owned by the community or government, and is for the community to use (e.g., a public school).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: a public park, a public school, public money

entries.summary: egpangimu te masulug ne kupya eyew igbelegyè (iling te libru); egsusulat eyew te peggimu wey pegbelegyè; egtahù diyè te baseen [base͡en]

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpangimu te masulug ne kupya eyew igbelegyè (iling te libru)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a company publishes something such as a book, they produce many copies of it so that people can buy it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This book was published two years ago.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egsusulat eyew te peggimu wey pegbelegyè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a writer publishes something, they write something which a company prints and sells.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a company such as a newspaper company publishes something, they print it in their newspaper or magazine.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The magazine published the story that I wrote.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka magasin migtahù te guhuren ne migsulat ku.

entries.summary: eggangken; eggusud; egganuy; egpalihawang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you pull something, you hold it and move it towards you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She pulled the child towards her.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or animal pulls something, they move forward and cause it to follow them.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you pull something out of a place such as a bag, you take it out of that place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He pulled his notebook out of his bag.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpalihawang din ka nutbuk din puun te baag [ba͡ag] din.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She gave one pull and the shoe came off her foot.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that something attracts you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The pull of the city causes many young people to leave their sitios.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegpekeimma te siyudad te me batan-un iyan aliddanan te pegpangawè dan te bariyu ran.

entries.summary: eglegpad; egdusa; egparusa; peglegpad; pegdusa; pegparusa; legpad; dusa; parusa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you punish someone, you do something painful or bad to them to teach them, because they did something bad.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The teacher punished me for arriving late.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the painful or bad thing that someone does to you because of your bad action.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My punishment for being late was to pick up rubbish in the garden.

entries.summary: egbebeli; egpalit; pegbebeli; pegpalit; nabeli; napalit

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you purchase something, you buy it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They purchased a few things at the store.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The purchase of cigarettes is illegal for people under 18.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: After she came home from the shop, she showed me her purchases.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Pegkeimpus din te migginguma te baley puun te tindaan [tinda͡an], impakita rin keddì ka nenabbeli rin.

entries.summary: warè sewug; neY; malinis; telek; warè sewug ne lein ne langesa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is pure, it is not mixed with anything else (e.g., pure oil, pure cotton).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This shirt is pure cotton, so it is very comfortable.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ne kumbalè neelin ne gapas, sika ka amana seini ne maluwan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as water is pure, it is clean, and has no dirt in it.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: telek; warè sewug ne lein ne langesa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use pure to describe someone who has the blood of only one tribe in them.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: malinis se pusung wey umul puun te warè salè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person is pure, their heart and life are clean, without sin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She won the game by pure luck, not skill.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migdeeg sikandin te galew pinaahi te kumplitu ne suwirti, kenè ne puun te katuenan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegkawarè sewug; pegkeelin; 2 pegkamalinis; 3 pegkatelek; pegkawarè sewug ne lein ne langesa; 4 pegkamalinis te pusung wey umul

entries.summary: eg-awè te malindit diyè te minsan nekey iling te weyig wey ke bulawan eyew egmalinis.; peg-awè te malindit

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-awè te malindit diyè te minsan nekey iling te weyig wey ke bulawan eyew egmalinis.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you purify something such as water or gold, you remove dirt or other things from it to make it clean or unmixed.

entries.summary: keyimuwan; tuyù; igkeupii ne egkuen (pinaahi te peggimu te weil); due igkeupii wey egpuhawangen ne eg-angayen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The purpose of an object is the thing that it was made to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The purpose of a pot is to cook things in.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: igkeupii ne egkuen (pinaahi te peggimu te weil)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The purpose of an action is the thing that you want to achieve by doing that action.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The purpose of going to Quezon was to buy fruit.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The purpose of the concert was to promote his new CD.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due igkeupii wey egpuhawangen ne eg-angayen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling of wanting and planning to achieve something (a_sense_of_purpose).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you do something on purpose, you intend to do it, and it was not an accident.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Mum, she stood on my foot on purpose!

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Inè, migsasindeg sikandin te paa ku ne due katuyuan.

entries.summary: eglupug eyew te pegdakep; eggeraman te egkuwa ka minsan nekey; egpabulus te peglalag wey te pegpanginsè meyitenged kayi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you pursue someone, you move after them quickly in order to catch them.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggeraman te egkuwa ka minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you pursue a goal, you try to achieve that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She pursued her goal of becoming a teacher.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggeram migkuwa sikandin te igkeupii rin ne egkeyimu ne talagpanulù.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpabulus te peglalag wey te pegpanginsè meyitenged kayi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you pursue a particular topic, you continue to talk and ask questions about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He wanted to know more, so he pursued the topic.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian sikandin ne egpakataha pad te duma, sika ka mig-insè pad migpabulus sikandin.

entries.summary: peglupug eyew te pegdakep; peggeram te peggimu eyew te peg-angey te igkeupii; minsan nekey ne malasi nu eggimuwa, labi-en iya ke eggimeley ka

fields.label: English explanation
