fields.text: the action of moving after someone in order to catch them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The cat ran quickly, with the dog in pursuit.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka miyew migpallahuy te sisiyapati, te eglupuhen te asu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peggeram te peggimu eyew te peg-angey te igkeupii

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of trying to achieve a goal.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He worked hard in the pursuit of good grades.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana migtrabahu sikandin, eyew te peg-angey te meupiya ne gradu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne malasi nu eggimuwa, labi-en iya ke eggimeley ka

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you regularly do, especially something that you do to relax.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Walking in the mountains is his favorite pursuit in his free time.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegpamaneyik te bubungan ka amana rin igkeupii ne malasi rin eggimuwa ke warè trabahu rin.

entries.summary: egtukù; egsinumag; egpesel; pegtukù; pegsinumag; pegpesel; eggeraman ne ka me etew egkeupian kayi wey eggimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you push something, you use your weight or strength to make it move away from you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She pushed the door with her shoulder.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Intukù din ka lekeb te pamanayen din.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She pushed the button and the door opened.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpesel din ka iglukat ne nalukatan e ka gumawan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The car wouldn't start, so they needed to push it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She gave the door a strong push.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggeraman ne ka me etew egkeupian kayi wey eggimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you push something such as an idea, you try to cause people to want it or to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The parents of the students are pushing for an extra teacher, because there are many students.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me ginikanan eggeram ne eggimu ne ka iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an] egpakakuwa te iyam ne talagpanulù.

entries.summary: egtahù; egsabuk; eglalahen te nateil ne pamaahi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you put something somewhere, you move it so that it is in that place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She put the book on the table.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you put something a particular way, you say it that way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He basically told them to leave, but he didn't put it exactly like that.

entries.summary: atuken
minsan nekey ne egkakita nu diyè te nateil ne butang; baad te pegkeetew; kamenu keupiya ka minsan nekey (iling te klasiyan)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne egkakita nu diyè te nateil ne butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A quality of a thing is something about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The afternoon sunlight has a golden quality.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka layag te aldew te maapun [maapun] su egkakita nu ne due pegpamalawag.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In a person, a quality is a part of who they are (e.g., kindness, friendliness).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has many good qualities: he is kind, hardworking and friendly.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due masalig ne meupiya ne baad te pegkeetew rin: buutan sikandin, mabasuk, wey maal-alukuy.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kamenu keupiya ka minsan nekey (iling te klasiyan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The quality of something is how good it is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: These tsinillas were very cheap and low quality, so they broke very quickly.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne baratu seini ne sinilas wey mareet se klasiyan, sika ka mahaan egkareeti.

entries.summary: lalag ne egpakita ke pilaa wey kamenu kasulug ka minsan nekey ne eglalahen nu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: lalag ne egpakita ke pilaa wey kamenu kasulug ka minsan nekey ne eglalahen nu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a word which shows how many or how much of something you are talking about (e.g., a lot, some). A quantifier is a kind of determiner.

entries.summary: egpaap-apuley; apulanan; ehetanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people quarrel with each other, they talk angrily to each other about something they disagree about.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a conversation in which people talk angrily to each other about something (have_a_quarrel).

entries.summary: sabeka ne baad te hep-at ne pikungan ke eggunting ka te minsan nekey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sabeka ne baad te hep-at ne pikungan ke eggunting ka te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you cut a thing into four equal parts, a quarter is one of those parts.

entries.summary: rayina
insè; eg-insè; eg-inseen

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She asked me many questions about my family.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you question someone, you ask them questions.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you question something, you are not sure if it is good or true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our boss gets angry if we question his decisions.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkalangetan ka ahalen ney ke eg-inseen ney ka me disisyun din.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I question if that is the best thing to do. In my opinion, we should try another way.

entries.summary: meiyal
mewumel ne sapù diralem te sulu te etew wey ke mananap

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mewumel ne sapù diralem te sulu te etew wey ke mananap

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The soft flesh under the nails of a person or the claws of an animal or bird.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Be careful if you cut the claws of an animal, because you will hurt them if you reach the quick.

entries.summary: warè kahuluban; kenè ne malalag-lalag; warè amana himu wey gulub

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something quiet doesn't make very much noise. A quiet place doesn't have very much noise.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Please be quiet, because I'm trying to sleep.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If I need to think, I go to a quiet place.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A quiet person doesn't talk very much.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is a quiet girl who thinks before she speaks.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that there is not much noise or action in a place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I like the peace and quiet of the mountains.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian a te kalinew wey ka warè guhuluben te me bubungan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The shop is very quiet this morning, with almost no customers.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkaawè wey ke egdeisek ka gulub; egmeyimulung ka gulub

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something quiets or quietens, it becomes quiet.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The noise quieted/quietened down at about 10pm.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kahulub naawè te me alas dyis te marusilem.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you quiet or quieten someone or something, you cause them to become quiet.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She quieted/quietened her children by giving them some food.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpapeeneng-eneng din ka me anak din te peg-ayat te egkakeen.

entries.summary: bayew iya; malù iya; balù iya; iya (eggamit ka kayi ke eglalag ka te minsan nekey ne leleheti iya).; Eggamit ka kayi ke eglalag ka te minsan nekey ne kenè amana, piru deisek dè iya ka kulang.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: bayew iya; malù iya; balù iya

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She's not the best singer in the group, but she's quite good.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ne sikandin ka kinameupiyaan te grupu, piru bayew iya egkateu sikandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Cooking is not my favorite thing to do, but I quite like it.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: iya (eggamit ka kayi ke eglalag ka te minsan nekey ne leleheti iya).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use quite to say that something is totally and absolutely the case.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You're quite right about that, and I agree with you 100%

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkamalehetan a iya kuna meyitenged due, wey egpalintutuu a iya kuna.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: After the long, hard walk, she lay down on the floor, quite exhausted.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Yes, I'm quite sure that he was there, because I saw him.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Eggamit ka kayi ke eglalag ka te minsan nekey ne kenè amana, piru deisek dè iya ka kulang.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use not quite to say that something is not 100% the case, although it may be almost the case.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Just wait five minutes; I'm not quite finished yet.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Tahad ka te lalimma ne minutu su warè ku pad neim-impusi.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I think I know how to do that, but I'm not quite sure.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Hendue te egkateu a ne eggimu due, piru kena a amana ne siguradu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He's not quite old enough to go to school, but next year he will be able to.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè pad ne eleg ka kabuyahi rin ne egpekeiskuyla, piru kayi te seup ne tuig egkaayun e.

entries.summary: ambew ne ayam wey maangkag.
egpalumbeey; lumba

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people or animals race, they do something (e.g., run, swim) together to see who is faster.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The two boys raced to the tree and the older boy got there first.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka daruwa ne batè migpalumbeey diyè te kayu wey ka buyag-buyag nakareeg.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action of people or animals doing something together to see who is faster (have_a_race).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The two boys had a race.

entries.summary: kabuwaran; kabuhalan; ka langun ne me etew; due kalabetan te me kabuwaran

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of people who come from the same ancestor, and who have similar things about them, such as skin colour.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My brother married an American, so they have a mixed-race marriage.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The human race is all people.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: All people are members of the human race.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Fair hair is a racial characteristic of people from northern Europe.

entries.summary: radyu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an electronic piece of equipment that receives signals and plays them as sound

entries.summary: gakit
uran; eg-uran

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: When water is falling from clouds, it is raining.

entries.summary: igparibabew; egparakelen; pegparakel te bayad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you raise something, you move it to a higher position.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We raise the flag every Monday.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Tagsè Lunis igparibabew ney ka plag.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He raised his hand in the air.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you raise an amount or number, you cause it to be more.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My boss raised my pay because he was happy with my work.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ahalen ku migparakelan din ka bayad ku su neupian sikandin te himu ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My boss gave me a raise.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ahalen ku migparakelan din ka bayad ku.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eglibulung te seleppì eyew te nateil ne aliddanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you raise money, you collect it together for a particular reason.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That group raises money for poor children.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seika ne punduk eglibulung te seleppì para te egkaleig-leig ne me batè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you raise children or animals, you care for them so that they grow up.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka amey ku mig-aayam te me babuy.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something raises a question or problem, they cause people to think about that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She raised the question of payment, because nobody else asked.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpeuma sikandin te insè meyitenged te pegbayad, su warè minsan hentew ne mig-insè te seini.

entries.summary: karas
grupu te nenekeg-iling ne kasangkapan; grupu te me numiru ne taliwarè te daruwa ne katammanan; egpakataliwarè te daruwa ne tammanan (meyitenged te me numiru wey ke minsan nekey)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of similar or related things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The shop sells a wide range of foods.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: grupu te me numiru ne taliwarè te daruwa ne katammanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of numbers or things between two limits.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can't buy that kind of motorbike, because it is outside my price range.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakataliwarè te daruwa ne tammanan (meyitenged te me numiru wey ke minsan nekey)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If numbers or things range between two limits, they are all between those two limits.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The students range in age from seven to ten years old.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me istudyanti mig-idad te taliwarè te pitu peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te sabeka ne pulù ne leg-un.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The range of something (e.g., a weapon) is how far it can reach.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That gun has a range of 300 meters.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Mt Everest is part of the Himalayan mountain range.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large stove which has an oven.

entries.summary: masahensek; meiyal; makeseg

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is rapid, it is fast.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our town is experiencing rapid growth.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka lungsud ney migsalerep te masahensek ne pegdakel te etew.

entries.summary: me tuwalen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a shallow area of a river where the water moves quickly.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's dangerous to swim in rapids.

entries.summary: marelag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is rare, it is not common, because there aren't many of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That bird is rare now, because many have died.

entries.summary: karakel te seleppì ne igbayad te tagsè timpu wey ke butang; keemen [ke͡emen] kakeseg; kalantus; egbehey te puhawang ke kamenu keupiya wey ke karakel ka minsan nekey.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: karakel te seleppì ne igbayad te tagsè timpu wey ke butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the amount of money that you pay for a service or a thing, per period of time (e.g., per hour) or per amount (e.g., per kilo).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His rate of pay is 30 pesos per hour.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka karakel te bayad din te tagsè uras su tatelu ne pulù.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The rates for that hotel are very expensive: 1000 pesos per night!

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We paid a rate of 300 pesos per tank for gasul.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We are walking at a rate of about 4km per hour.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eggipanew ki te kakeseg ne hep-at ne kilumitru te tagsè uras.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbehey te puhawang ke kamenu keupiya wey ke karakel ka minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you rate something, you decide how good or how big it is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Most people rate him as the best player in the team.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My head really hurts. On- on a scale of 1 to 10, I rate the pain at about 9.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something rates another thing, it is good or big enough to receive that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I think his brave actions rate a medal.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka suman-suman ku ka weil din ne kabulut egkabehayan te midalyun.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My problem is so small that it doesn't really rate a mention.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His performance at the talent night was so good that the judges thought it rated a special award.

entries.summary: bayew; du te; igkeupii pad

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He's a rather good singer; not the best in the village, but quite talented.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Bayew meupiya sikandin ne manggulahing; kenen kinameupiyaan te bariyu, piru bayew mateu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are talking about two things, you use rather_than to say that you choose one thing, and not the other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We should leave in the morning rather than the afternoon, because it will get dark.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ki ne eg-awè te maselem du te maapun [ma͡apun], su egmarusilem e.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you would_rather do one thing than another thing, you want to do the first thing more than the second thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I would rather live in the mountains than in the city, because it is much cleaner here.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Igkeupii ku pad ne eg-ugpè kayi te bubungan te diyè te siyudad, su amanan malinis kayi.

entries.summary: kasuluhan wey ke karakelan ne igpeg-iling te tagsè sabeka

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kasuluhan wey ke karakelan ne igpeg-iling te tagsè sabeka

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the size of two numbers or amounts compared with each other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are twenty girls and ten boys in our class, so the ratio of girls to boys is two to one.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due daruwan pulu ne malitan wey sapulu ne me lukes diyè te klasi ney, su ka kasuluhan te malitan wey lukes daruwa ne malitan te sabeka ne lukes.

entries.summary: meupiya wey mapaayad-ayad ne pegsuman-suman

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If thinking is rational, it is good and careful, and uses logic.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is very upset at the moment, so her thinking is not rational.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Neepes amana sikandin kuntee, sika ka suman-suman din kenen meupiya.

entries.summary: layag
egkeumaan [egkeuma͡an]; egkasinagkew; eg-umeen [eg-ume͡en]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you reach a place, you arrive there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: After walking for three hours, we finally reached the village.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you can reach something, it is close enough so that you can touch or get it

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The ball is high in the tree, so we can't reach it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you reach for something that is not close to you, you move your arm to get that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His cup was on the other side of the table, so he reached across the table to get it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: how far someone or something can move to touch something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That water is hot. Keep it out of the reach of the child.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Meinit ka weyig. Itahù nu seini ne kenè egkeumaan te batè.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's good to live on higher ground, because it is out of the reach of flood waters.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something reaches a certain place or level, it goes as far as that place or level.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The water is not deep: it only reaches my knees.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mababew rè ka weyig: kayi rè taman te buel ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The population of the Barangay has reached 20,000.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you reach someone, you are able to communicate with them, or give them a message.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I tried calling their cellphone, but I couldn't reach them.

entries.summary: Eggimu wey ke eggeram te minsan nekey tenged te neyitabù.; due prublima te lawa puun te minsan nekey iling te keenen; egpekeg-ayuney te peggimu wey ke egpekegbalew-balew ka tagsè sabeka wey ke egpekeyimu te lein ne minsan nekey.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Eggimu wey ke eggeram te minsan nekey tenged te neyitabù.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you react to something that happened, you do or feel something because of what happened.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She reacted to the good news by dancing around the house and laughing.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migsayew-sayew sikandin wey migngisi diyè te baley tenged te meupiya ne guhuren.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due prublima te lawa puun te minsan nekey iling te keenen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you react to something such as a food, that thing causes your body to have a problem.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My skin reacted to the soap, and became very red.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka laplap ku due prublima te sebbun, wey migmalalab-lalab seini.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpekeg-ayuney te peggimu wey ke egpekegbalew-balew ka tagsè sabeka wey ke egpekeyimu te lein ne minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two things such as chemicals react with one another, they work together or change each other or to produce something else.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 peggimu wey ke peggeram te minsan nekey tenged te neyitabù 2 prublima te lawa puun te minsan nekey iling te keenen; 3 pegpekeg-ayuney te peggimu wey ke pegpekegbalew-balew ka tagsè sabeka wey ke pegpekeyimu te lein ne minsan nekey

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was surprised by her angry reaction to what I said.

entries.summary: egbasa; egbasa ne marahing; egpitawen wey egnengnengen ka igpasabut

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you read words, you look at them and understand them.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you read words, you look at them and say them aloud.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Could you please read that sentence to the class.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Palihug basaa [basa͡a] nu pa ubag te marahing ka pangasak.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you read something that does not have words (e.g. an X-ray or a thermometer), you look at it and understand the information on it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I could read from his face that he was upset

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can't read this map. It's too small.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a piece of measuring equipment reads a certain number, it shows that number.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's so hot! The thermometer reads 37.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the measurement that you can read on a piece of equipment.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The reading on the thermometer is 37.

entries.summary: nataggel; nakataggel; egtaggel

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is ready, they can do something right now. If something is ready, it can be used now.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He's not ready yet, so we need to wait.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè pad nataggel sikandin, sika ka keilangan ne egtaharan te pad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are ready to do something, you are willing and happy to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is very ready to help us if we ask.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Layun nakataggel sikandin ne egbulig ke egpangananey ki kandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you ready something, you cause it to be ready.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She readied our bags for our trip.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtaggel din ka me kemuyut ney eyew te peggipanew ney.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Thank you for your readiness to help.

entries.summary: malehet egkakita wey egkeyitabù; malehet; dakel; keilangan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something real actually exists or happens.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It was real, I didn't just imagine it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Malehet iya seeyè, kenè ne suman-suman ku rè.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She said that she was busy, but the real reason that she didn't come was that she was shy.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something real is natural, not a copy or fake.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That food has real fruit in it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sika ne egkakeen due malehet ne prutas ne sewug.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something real is big or important (e.g., a real problem).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You need to accept the reality that you won't see your friends for a few years.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ne egdawaten nu ka kamalehetan ne kenè nu egkakita ka me alukuy nu te deisek ne me katuihan.

entries.summary: egpakamamalehet; egkanengnengan; egkaangey; egkamalehet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you realize that something is true, you suddenly know it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She suddenly realized that everybody was listening to her.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakamamalehet sikandin ne ka langun migpammineg kandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you realize that something is true, you know or understand it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She doesn't realize how bad the problem is.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè din nanengnengi ke kamenu karakel ka prublima.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I realize that you don't want to buy it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you realize something such as a goal, you cause it to become real by making it happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: After many years she realized her dream of becoming a professional musician.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impus te pila ne me katuihan namalehet e ka igkeupii rin ne egkeyimu rin ne mangulahing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She felt very embarrassed upon her realization that everyone was listening to her.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The realization of your goals needs hard work.

entries.summary: amana

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use really to say that something is very true.

entries.summary: aliddanan; meupiya ne suman-suman; egpalintutuu puun te migsuman-suman

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The reason for something is the thing which causes it to happen or to be true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The reason that I went home was that I felt sick.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: good and careful thinking about something, which causes you to make good decisions

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I told her it was not a good idea to travel alone, but she wouldn't listen to reason.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migkahi a kandin te kenè sika ne meupiya ne pamaahi ne egsabsabeka ka eggipanew, piru warè din pamineha ka meupiya ne suman-suman.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you reason that something is the case, you believe it after you think carefully and use logic.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She reasoned that if she could ride a bicycle, she could probably ride a motorbike too.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbehey sikandin te puhawang ne ke egkateu sikandin ne eg-uyan te bayik, due kasiguruwan din degma ne egkateu sikandin eg-uyan te mutur.

entries.summary: eggamit te meupiya, egpeg-ilingen ne pegsuman-suman, wey kenè egbuyù te subla para kandan.; eleg-eleg ka minsan nekey iling te bali wey ke insè; kenè amana ne meupiya piru egkaayun ded

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggamit te meupiya, egpeg-ilingen ne pegsuman-suman, wey kenè egbuyù te subla para kandan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is reasonable, they use good, fair thinking, and don't ask for more than they should.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is not reasonable to ask her to carry your bag as well as her own bag.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eleg-eleg ka minsan nekey iling te bali wey ke insè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something (e.g., a price or a question) is reasonable, you can accept it, because it is fair.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I often go to that shop because the prices are very reasonable.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè amana ne meupiya piru egkaayun ded

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is reasonable, it is not very, very good, but it is okay.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We have had a few rainy days, but the weather has been reasonable overall.

entries.summary: risip
egpakakuwa te igbehey; egpakarawat te igbehey; eggeram wey ke eglalag te nateil ne pamaahi tenged te minsan nekey; egpakarawat; egdawat te etew

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakakuwa te igbehey; egpakarawat te igbehey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you receive something, someone gives or sends it to you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I received a Christmas gift from my godfather.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggeram wey ke eglalag te nateil ne pamaahi tenged te minsan nekey; egpakarawat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you receive something in a particular way, you feel or talk about it that way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She didn't receive the news very well; in fact, she was very upset.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè din narawat ka balita; kamalehetan, neepes sikandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His new movie has been very well-received by the public.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you receive a person, you welcome them to a place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her job as receptionist was to receive visitors and clients.

entries.summary: miglihad (meyitenged te warè pad naluhey ne timpu); miglihad (meyitenged te iyam pad migsinundul te newun-a ne hitabù)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: miglihad (meyitenged te warè pad naluhey ne timpu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use recent to talk about something that happened a short time ago.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The road is still muddy from the recent rain.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kelesadda basaken pad puun te miglihad ne uran.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: miglihad (meyitenged te iyam pad migsinundul te newun-a ne hitabù)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: if something happened recently, it happened a short time ago.

entries.summary: egkaheram wey egkalalag meyitenged te minsan nekey; ka kakeseg wey ke kalantus iling te tibi te peg-angey te signal wey egbalewbalew kandan peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te dahing wey me litratu.; el-elitanan (meyitenged te lugar)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkaheram wey egkalalag meyitenged te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: People's reception of something such as an idea or a new movie is the way that they feel or talk about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was embarrassed because his suggestion met with a very bad reception from the rest of the group.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka kakeseg wey ke kalantus iling te tibi te peg-angey te signal wey egbalewbalew kandan peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te dahing wey me litratu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the ability of something such as a TV to catch signals and change them into sounds and pictures.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We tried to listen to the radio, but the reception was poor, so the picture was very unclear.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggeram key migpammineg te radyu, piru kenè ne makaseg ka signal, sika ka kenè egkamelmelehan ka me alung.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the area in an office or hotel which visitors go to when they first arrive.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She works at the reception desk, so she sees everyone who arrives in the building.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka kalibulungan pegke-impus te kasal (due pegkekeen)

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We attended the wedding ceremony, but we couldn't go to the reception.

entries.summary: ka etew ne egdawat te minsan nekey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka etew ne egdawat te minsan nekey

entries.summary: weil ne eglalag te daruwa ne etew ne eggimu te nekeg-iling ne butang te tagsè sabeka.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: weil ne eglalag te daruwa ne etew ne eggimu te nekeg-iling ne butang te tagsè sabeka.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a verb which talks about two people doing the same thing to each other (e.g., fighting with each other).

entries.summary: egpakanengneng; egpalintutuu; eg-angken

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you recognize someone or something, you know them because you have seen or heard them before, or because someone has told you about them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A baby can recognize the voice of his mother early in life.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I had never met him before, but I recognized him from my sister's description.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't recognize the handwriting, so I don't know who wrote that.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you recognize that something is true, you agree that it is true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: "I recognize that I made a mistake," he said.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an organization or group recognizes something (e.g., a certificate), they accept that it is real or legal.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The transport authority does not recognize licenses from other countries, so you need to get a Philippine driver's licence.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people recognize you for doing something good, they publicly thank you or praise you for doing that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The hospital had a special ceremony to recognize the volunteers who worked there.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of recognizing someone or something.

entries.summary: eglalag te meupiya ne eggimuwen dan ka minsan nekey; eglalag ka diyè te duma ne meupiya ka minsan hentew wey ke minsan nekey ne ingkahi nu.; egpakameupiya diyè te minsan hentew wey ke diyè te minsan nekey ne batasan wey ke kalidad dan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eglalag te meupiya ne eggimuwen dan ka minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you recommend that someone do something, you tell them that it's good for them to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I recommended that he go to the hospital.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ingkahiyan ku sikandin te meupiya ke eggendiyè sikandin te uspital.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eglalag ka diyè te duma ne meupiya ka minsan hentew wey ke minsan nekey ne ingkahi nu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you recommend someone or something, you tell another person that they are good.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sipgard ne sebun ka gamita nu su meupiya.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I recommend him for the job because he is a very good worker.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakameupiya diyè te minsan hentew wey ke diyè te minsan nekey ne batasan wey ke kalidad dan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a characteristic of a person or thing recommends them, it is a good thing about them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She has many good characteristics to recommend her: she is kind, hardworking and good.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 peglalag te meupiya ne eggimuwen dan ka minsan nekey; 2 peglalag diyè te duma ne meupiya ka minsan hentew wey ke minsan nekey ne ingkahi nu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: words saying that it is good to do something, or that someone or something is good.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I chose that school on my friend's recommendation.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne meupiya diyè te etew wey ke kasangkapan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that is good about a person or thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That is a very bad place. Its only recommendation is that it has a good weather in winter.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mareet seeyè ne lugar. Wey rè meupiya ka timpu ke panahun te tingkalamag.

entries.summary: egpeg-ulì te meupiya ne geyinawa pinaahi te peggusey; egkasabut ke namenu ne egpekeg-eleg; egdawaten wey kenè eggeraman ne egbalbalawan seini

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpeg-ulì te meupiya ne geyinawa pinaahi te peggusey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you reconcile two people who are arguing, you cause them to stop being enemies and to have a good relationship.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The mother tried to reconcile her two sons, but they refused to speak to each other.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka iney miggeram te egpeg-uli te geyinawa te daruwa ne me anak din ne lukes, piru kenè eglaglag ka tagsè sabeka.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: After years of fighting, the two brothers were finally reconciled.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impus te masalig ne katuihan te pegpeehetey, ka daruwa ne tahasuled nekeg-uli e te meupiya ne geyinawa.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you reconcile two things which are different, you can understand how they fit together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can't reconcile his young face with the fact that he is quite old.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ku egkasabut ke namenu ne ka ula-ula rin batè pad, ne ka malehet bayew e buyag sikandin.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egdawaten wey kenè eggeraman ne egbalbalawan seini

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are_reconciled to something bad, you accept it and don't try to change it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Even though I would love to be tall, I am reconciled to the fact that I will never be tall.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Minsan pad egkeupian a ne malangkew, narawat kud ne kena ad iya egmalangkew.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegpeg-uli te meupiya ne geyinawa pinaahi te peggusey; 2 pegkasabut ke namenu ne egpekeg-eleg; 3 pegdawat wey kenè peggeram te pegbalew-balew kayi

entries.summary: egpanahù (meyitenged te pegsulat); eglista; nakatahù ne kanengnenganan (meyitenged te nasulat); listaan [lista͡an]; egtahù te ulahingen wey ke minsan nekey (meyitenged te peggalin wey peg-iling)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you record something, you write it down to show that it has really happened, or to help people to remember.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She recorded their payments in the accounting book.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Inlista rin ka bayaranen dan diyè te libru ne listaanan [lista͡anan] te seleppì.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nakatahù ne kanengnenganan (meyitenged te nasulat); listaan [lista͡an]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a piece of writing which shows what happened.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She keeps careful records of who comes to the Barangay Hall.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana sikandin eglista ke hentew seeyè se eggendiyè te Barangay Hall.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egtahù te ulahingen wey ke minsan nekey (meyitenged te peggalin wey peg-iling)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you record sounds, you put them onto something such as a computer or CD, so that you can play them again and again.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We recorded his song using an MP3 player.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migrikurd key te kanta rin ne iyan ney inggamit ka MP3 ne pliyir.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kinameupiyaan wey marelag dè ne neyimu diyè te nateil ne weil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the best result ever for a particular action (e.g., a world record)

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He broke the world record for the 100m sprint at the last Olympics, and set a new record.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nahuhus din ka tetelesi ne neyimu te intiru ne kalibutan ne iyan sika se pegpallahuy te sabeka ne gatus ne mitrus diyè te katamanan ne Ulimpik, wey duen e man-e iyam ne lista.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Wow, we caught 43 fish! That's a record.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Huwi, nekeutel key te hep-at ne pulu wey tatelu ne ngalap! Seini ka kinameupiyaan wey marelag dè ne egkeyitabù.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He finished his dinner in record time, and ran outside to play with his friends.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakapenga sikandin ka miglabung sumalè te uras ne egpekeimpus sikandin, wey migpallahuy e ka egpakiggalew te me alukuy rin.

entries.summary: egkahawì; egkakuwa; egkeulian te eggeramen; pegkahawì; pegkakuwa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you recover something that you lost, you get it back by doing something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He never recovered the money that the men took.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè din e nakuwa ka seleppì ne migkuwa te etew.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He had to go in the river to recover the ball.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you recover_from something bad (e.g, bad news, or an illness), you return to feeling okay.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It took her a long time to recover after her husband died.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Naluhey neulii ka pegkalangè ne eggeramen din te pegkapatey te asawa rin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is strong, so we hope she will recover from her illness quickly.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of recovering something that you lost.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The recovery of the ball was difficult.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action of recovering after you are sick or something bad happens (make_a_recovery).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We hope she will make a quick recovery from her illness.

entries.summary: malalab

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the colour of blood, or of rambutans

entries.summary: eggawien egbeliya wey ke egkua; eglekat; egpangabang te uripen; egluwas te uripen; eglekat; migluwas; egtubus

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggawien egbeliya wey ke egkua; eglekat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you redeem something that you owned before, you buy it back from the new owner.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'll redeem my watch today, because now I have enough money.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eggawien kud kuntee ka rilu ku, su duen e eleg ne seleppì ku.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpangabang te uripen; egluwas te uripen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In the past, if someone redeemed a slave, they paid money so that the slave would be free.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: When Jesus redeems people, he pays a prcie to save them from being slaves of sin. The price was his death on the cross.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you redeem something such as a coupon, you take it to a shop and exchange it for something that you want.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My uncle gave me a voucher for that shop, and I need to redeem it before the end of the year.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka anggam ku migbehey keddì te deisek ne pepil para igbehey diyè te tindaan [tinda͡an], wey keilangan ne eg-uyanen ku seini eyew egsalyuan te igkeupii ku te kenè pad egkeimpusan ka tuig.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 peggawi; 2 pegluwas te uripen; pegpangabang te uripen; 3 peglekat; 4 pegkuwa eyew te pegpasaliyu te igkeupii

entries.summary: egpareisek; egsalinan; eg-angayan; egkuan; eg-awaan; egpekeyimu diyè te nateil ne sitwasyun (iling te egkaluwaan wey ke egpakapubri)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you reduce something, you cause it to become smaller or less.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The doctor said I need to reduce the amount of salt in my diet.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpekeyimu diyè te nateil ne sitwasyun (iling te egkaluwaan wey ke egpakapubri)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something reduces you to a certain state (e.g., tears, poverty), it causes you to be in that state.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The sad movie reduced all of us to tears.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka makalulunù ne salida nakapatihis te luwè ney langun.

entries.summary: pegpariisek; pegsalin; peg-angey; pegkuwa; nasalin

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of causing something to be smaller or less.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The reduction of prices will be very welcome.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A reduction in something is an amount which is taken away from it to make it less.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This month there was a 10% reduction in the price of gas.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te seini ne bulan nasalinan te sapulu ne pursintu ka bali te gasulina.

entries.summary: egliberen; peglibed

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you reduplicate something, you repeat it, so that it is double.

entries.summary: eglalahen; egtengteng te kanengnengan diyè te minsan nekey; egpanginginsè diyè te egpuunan te kanengnengan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you refer_to someone or something, you talk about them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When she talks, she always refers to people whom I don't know.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke eglalag sikandin, layun din eglalaha ka me etew ne warè ku neneileyi.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egtengteng te kanengnengan diyè te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you refer_to something such as book, you check information in it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The speaker forgot something, so he needed to refer to his notebook.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nalingew ka talagpangasak (te minsan nekey), sika ka keilangan ne egtengteng sikandin diyè te nutbuk din.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpanginginsè diyè te egpuunan te kanengnengan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you refer someone to a source of information or help (e.g., a book, or another person), you tell them to go to that source.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The doctor didn't know what the problem was, so he referred me to a specialist.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of a doctor referring you to another doctor (give_a_referral).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The doctor gave me a referral to the specialist.

entries.summary: peglalag meyitenged te minsan hentew wey ke minsan nekey; libru wey duma ne sinulat ne inggamit te minsan hentew diyè te kandan ne sinulat.; Egkahamit nu seini ke eglalag ka meyitenged te libru wey ke duma pad ne sinulat ne egkaangayan nu te me kanengnengan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peglalag meyitenged te minsan hentew wey ke minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of talking about someone or something (make_reference to something).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She made many references to her grandmother in her book.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: libru wey duma ne sinulat ne inggamit te minsan hentew diyè te kandan ne sinulat.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a book or other piece of writing which someone has used in their own writing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I know where he got the information for his book, because he listed the references in the back.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit nu seini ke eglalag ka meyitenged te libru wey ke duma pad ne sinulat ne egkaangayan nu te me kanengnengan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use reference to talk about a book or other piece of writing that you can get information from.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A dictionary is a kind of reference book.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sinulat meyitenged te batasan te minsan hentew wey ke katuenan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a piece of writing about somebody's character or abilities. You sometimes need a reference from someone when you apply for a job.

entries.summary: egpakita te alung; egkasuhat te dahing wey ke layag wey eglambas puun kayi peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te duma.; egpakita ne panuggilingan te ka ikaruwa ne butang malehet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a mirror reflects a thing in front of it, it shows exactly what that thing looks like.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkasuhat te dahing wey ke layag wey eglambas puun kayi peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te duma.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something reflects another thing such as light, heat or sound, the light, heat or sound hits it, and then moves away from it again.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I shouted loudly, and the cliff reflected my voice, so that I heard my words again.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Mirrors work because the glass reflects images.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakita ne panuggilingan te ka ikaruwa ne butang malehet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing reflects a second thing, it is an example which shows that the second thing is true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His friendly smile reflects his friendly personality.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you reflect on something, you think about it quietly and slowly.

entries.summary: alung; pegkasuhat te dahing wey ke layag wey peglambas puun kayi peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te duma.; pegsumsuman te mapaayad-ayad wey mapahanad-ganad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the picture that you can see in a mirror or glass.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegkasuhat te dahing wey ke layag wey peglambas puun kayi peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te duma.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of reflecting something such as light, heat or sound.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of thinking about something quietly and slowly.

entries.summary: egbalibad; egkene-kenè; kenè egkuen; kenè egdawaten; 1 pegbalibad; 2 kenè pegkuwa; kenè pegdawat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you refuse to do something, you say strongly that you will not do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He refused to help me, even though I asked him many times.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you refuse something that someone offers to you, you don't accept it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I offered to help her, but she refused my help.

entries.summary: lapek

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The street was very dirty, because there was a lot of refuse.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kelesedda su amana ne malindit, su due masalig ne lapek.

entries.summary: egsumsumanen; peg-addat wey ke pegbassa; egpalintutuu; egparuma-ruma; eg-addat; egtahud

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you regard someone or something as a certain thing, that is what you think about them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He regards all dogs as dirty and dangerous.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egsumsumanen din ne ka langun ne me asu mallindit wey dilikadu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your regard for someone is the fact that you think they are very good (hold_someone_in_regard).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: People hold that leader in high regard.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you regard something such as rules, you do what they say to do.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your regard for rules is the fact that you obey them (show_regard_for rules).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He always shows great regard for safety in his work.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a dangerous driver because he shows no regard for road rules.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you regard another person, or their feelings, you care about them, and want them to be comfortable and happy.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Please regard other people if you arrive home late, and don't make a lot of noise.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Palihug addati niyu ka duma ne etew ke egkamewuri kew egginguma diyè te baley.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your regard for someone is the fact that you care about them, and want them to be comfortable and happy (show_regard_for someone).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He always shows regard for his wife's feelings, and speaks politely to her.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eglabet; meyitenged te; due kalabetan te

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a topic regards a particular person or thing, it includes or is about that person or thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You need to listen to this, because it regards you.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ne egpammineg ka kayi, su ka seini meyitenged kuna.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: friendly greetings. You say, 'Give my regards to X' to ask someone to pass on a greeting from you. You can use 'Regards' as a polite and friendly ending for a letter.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use with_regard_to, or regarding, to say what you are talking about.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Now, with regard to our budget, what did we decide?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kuntee, meyitenged te badit ta, nekey ka suman-suman ta.

entries.summary: klasiyan te peg-uyan te inged ne amana malasey wey warè kaligwangan wey malised ka pegbebalaud.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: klasiyan te peg-uyan te inged ne amana malasey wey warè kaligwangan wey malised ka pegbebalaud.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a system of government of a country or organization, often a very hard or undemocratic system, with strict rules.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Under the new regime, workers are not allowed to receive personal calls during work hours.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Life was very hard for people under that leader's regime.

entries.summary: lugar ne due nateil ne kaleinan; nateil ne baad te minsan nekey; due kalabetan te nateil ne me lugar

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: lugar ne due nateil ne kaleinan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an area which has a certain characteristic (e.g., a mountainous region).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nateil ne baad te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a particular area of something (e.g., the body).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She has a lot of pain in the lower back region.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due amana masakit diyè te diralem ne peka rin.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due kalabetan te nateil ne me lugar

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due kalabetan te me lugar ne mariyù te siyudad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: related to the non-city areas of a country.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She lives in regional Mindanao, far from any major cities.

entries.summary: tahuanan te me katahaanan [kataha͡anan]; listaanan [lista͡anan]; egpalista; ka mekina ne egpanulat te kanengnengan iling te me kentidad te seleppì.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an official list of information such as names or events, or a book for that kind of list.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our teacher keeps a register of our attendance at school.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you register something such as a name or vehicle, someone writes it in an official list of those things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: On the first day at our new school, we registered our names at the office.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te hun-a ne aldew te peg-iskuyla ney, impalista ney ka ngaran ney diyè te upisina.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You need to register your motorbike with the transport authority before you can drive it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She sent the important documents by registered post.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka mekina ne egpanulat te kanengnengan iling te me kentidad te seleppì.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a machine which records information such as amounts of money (e.g., a cash register at a supermarket).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The shop assistant at the grocery store put my money in the cash register.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkakita ne seked diyè te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something registers on a piece of measuring equipment such as a thermometer, the equipment shows the measurement of that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The earthquake registered 6 on the Richter scale.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kakeseg te linug su migginguma te hen-em diyè te sekeranan ne Richtir.

entries.summary: pegpalista (iling te ngaran wey ke unturanan); seleppì ne igbayad eyew te pegpalista iling te unturanan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegpalista (iling te ngaran wey ke unturanan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of registering something such as a name or vehicle.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We went to the office for registration.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: seleppì ne igbayad eyew te pegpalista iling te unturanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the money that you pay to register something such as a vehicle.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The registration for a van is expensive.

entries.summary: layun; eg-abey-abey; nekeikul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an event is regular, it happens quite often

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a regular visitor to our shop.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sikandin ka layun ne mahaliyug ney te tindaan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an event is regular, it happens repeatedly, with around the same amount of time between each happening.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The doctor makes regular visits to the village. He comes once a month.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eg-abey-abey eggendiye ka duktur te bariyu. Eggendiye sikandin kasabeka te tagse bulan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is regular, it follows a pattern. E.g., 'watch' is a regular verb, because you just need '-ed' to make the past tense and past participle forms (watched). This is the usual way to make the past tense in English.)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè ne ispisyal wey ke lein te nateil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A regular person or thing is not special or different from usual.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This is just a regular shop, so we don't sell tools.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: happening in a regular way (senses 1 and 2)

entries.summary: egpakasuhù (meyilut ne kukuman)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you regulate something, you control it, often with rules.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Traffic police regulate traffic in the city.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka trapiku pulis egpatuman te kukuman te trapiku diyè te siyudad.

entries.summary: kukuman; balaud; palisiya; pegpakasuhù, pinaahi te me kukuman

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The government has a lot of regulations if you want to open a school.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The regulation of traffic is one of the jobs of police.

entries.summary: eglalag wey ke egpakita te kenè pegkeupii; egsamilì; igdegpak e wey kenad egkahamit ne minsan nekey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eglalag wey ke egpakita te kenè pegkeupii

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you reject someone, you say or show that you don't want to have a relationship with them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His friends rejected him because he told them many lies.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me alukuy rin migpakita te kenè pegkeupii kandin su layun din eg-ub-ubati.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you reject something, you decide not to have it or use it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The fish-cart seller rejected my fish, because they were too small.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka egpamelegyè te ngalap te weyig migsamilian ka ngalap ku, su dereisek.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: igdegpak e wey kenad egkahamit ne minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you throw away or decide not to use.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: These small fish are cheap because they are rejects.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Baratu e seini se dereisek ne isda su igdegpak e su kenad egkahamit.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 peglalag wey ke pegpakita te kenè pegkeupii; 2 pegsamilì

entries.summary: due kalabetan; meyitenged te; egpakigduma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something relates to another thing, they have some connection.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something relates to a particular topic, it is about that topic.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you relate to someone, you spend time with them and communicate with them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is very shy, and it is hard for him to relate to new people.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne hiilawen [hi:lawen] sikandin, wey malised para kandin ka pegpakigduma te iyam ne me etew.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My two sons relate to each other very well.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you can relate to someone or something, you understand them because you have experienced the same thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can relate to students, because I have been a student myself.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpakataha a te me istudyanti, su migbaya a iya degma te pegkaistudyanti.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you relate a story, you tell it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He related the story of what had happened.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impangguhud din ka guhuren ke nekey ka neyitabù.

entries.summary: due kalabetan te tagsè sabeka; karumaan [karuma͡an] te taltalaanak

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two things are related to each other, there is a connection between them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His headache and back ache are related; they are not two separate problems.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His headache is not related to the pain in his legs.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka masakit ne ulu rin warè kalabetan te memasakit ne me paa rin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are related to someone, they are a family member.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I am not related to her, she is just my friend.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ku ne karumaan [karuma͡an] sikandin, alukuy ku rè sikandin.

entries.summary: karumaan [karuma͡an] te taltalaanak; kalabetan wey ke sumpulan te daruwa ne kasangkapan wey duma pad.; geyinawa wey himu ne due kalabetan te daruwa ne grupu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a member of your family (e.g., a cousin).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Many of my relations came to my birthday party.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kalabetan wey ke sumpulan te daruwa ne kasangkapan wey duma pad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The relation of one thing to another, or the relation between two things is the way that they are connected.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is no relation between his headache and the pain in his legs.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: geyinawa wey himu ne due kalabetan te daruwa ne grupu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Relations between countries or groups are the communications, feelings and actions between the two groups.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Relations between the two countries are not good at the moment.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegpanengnengey te daruwa ne nasud kenè ne meupiya te seini kuntee.

entries.summary: kalabetan te daruwa ne kasangkapan ne seini nekegsumpul wey ke egpekeg-eleg; geyinawa wey kalabetan te daruwa ne etew wey ke grupu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kalabetan te daruwa ne kasangkapan ne seini nekegsumpul wey ke egpekeg-eleg

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The relationship between two things is the way that they fit together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is no relationship between his headache and the pain in his legs.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: geyinawa wey kalabetan te daruwa ne etew wey ke grupu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the feelings and connection between two people or groups.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: My sister and I have a close relationship.

entries.summary: karumaan [karuma͡an] te taltalaanak; me suled (meyitenged te sakup dè te pamilya dapit te iney wey ke amey); Egkahamit seini ke egpeg-iling ka te minsan nekey diyè te lein.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: karumaan [karuma͡an] te taltalaanak; me suled (meyitenged te sakup dè te pamilya dapit te iney wey ke amey)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a member of your family (e.g., cousin).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Many of my relatives came to my birthday party.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini ke egpeg-iling ka te minsan nekey diyè te lein.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use relative to say that you are comparing something with another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Tonight is a time of relative quiet, but there is still some noise [this means that it is quiet now compared to the usual noise].

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kuntee na marusilem ka kenè ne mahulub ne marusilem, piru duen ded deisek ne egpanlelalag [igpasabut ne bayew meyimulung ka kahulub du te nalayaman e ne kahulub].

entries.summary: grupu te me lalag ne egbehey pad te kanengnengan meyitenged te minsan hentew wey ke minsan nekey.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: grupu te me lalag ne egbehey pad te kanengnengan meyitenged te minsan hentew wey ke minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of words which give more information about someone or something. A relative_clause starts with a relative_pronoun.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have a friend who likes cooking. ['who likes cooking' is the relative clause].

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due alukuy ku ne egkeupian te pegsusubba. ['ne egkeupian te pegsusubba' iyan sika ka seini ne lalag].

entries.summary: lalag ne eggamiten nu te an-anayan te seini ne lalag

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: lalag ne eggamiten nu te an-anayan te seini ne lalag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a word which you use at the beginning of a relative clause.

entries.summary: mabulig wey keilangan; pegpakabulig wey pegkakeilangan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is relevant to someone or something, it is useful or important for them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That radio program is relevant to both older and younger people.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sika ne prugrama te radyu, amana ne mabulig diyè te me buyag wey me kabataan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What is the relevance of your question to our topic today?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekey ka bulig te insè nu kuntee te guhuren ta?

entries.summary: kasalihan (ne etew wey ke kasangkapan); makasesalig

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is reliable, you can be sure that they will do what they say, or what they should do. If something is reliable, you can be sure that it will do what it should do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That motorbike is not very reliable; sometimes it won't start in wet weather.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sika ne mutur kenè amana egkasalihan; sengekakuwa kenè eg-andar ke lengleng.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is a very reliable friend; she is always there when I need her.

entries.summary: keilangan su egpakabulig; egsalig; pegkakeilangan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are reliant on someone or something, you need them because they help you in some way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My family is reliant on our garden for food.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sikanami se taltalaanak egsalig dè diyè te pamulaan ney para te pegkeen ney.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the state of being reliant on someone or something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I am worried about her reliance on me. She needs to become independent.

entries.summary: patarin
egpalintutuuwan; migtuuwan; pegpamakey; tuluuwen; tulumanen; due kalebetan te tuluuwen; mapalintutuu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a set of beliefs about the physical world and spiritual world, and the actions which people do because they believe those things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I asked him about his religious beliefs, but he only told me about his political beliefs.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A religious person feels that their religion is very important.

entries.summary: egkeilangan; egsalig

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you rely_on someone or something, you need them because they help you in some way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother is sick, and she relies on me to cook for the family.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka iney ku egderalu, wey egkeilangan sikandin keddì eyew te pegsusubba para te pamilya ku.

entries.summary: egpalinggahaat [egpalinggaha͡at]; egpabulus diyè te nateil ne sitwasyun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something remains in a particular place, they do not leave that place.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpabulus diyè te nateil ne sitwasyun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something remains in a particular state, they do not change.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Please stop moving around and remain still.

entries.summary: igkalalag; egbehey te lalag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you say about something (make_a_remark).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you remark on something, or remark that something is the case, you say something.

entries.summary: egpakasuman-suman; egkasuman-suman

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you remember something, you suddenly think of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She suddenly remembered where she had put her umbrella.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you remember something, you keep it in your mind, and don't forget.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I will always remember my grandfather who died last year.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I remember when I was a child we always spent the summer with my uncle.

entries.summary: egpasuman-suman
eg-awè; eggalinen; egluluung; 1 peg-awè; peggalin; 2 pegluluung

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you remove something from somewhere, you take it away from that place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He removed the books from the table because it was breakfast time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The governer removed the politician from her position after she told lies.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you remove clothes, you take them off your body.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It was hot, so he removed his sweater.

entries.summary: abang
eg-ay-ayaran; eg-upianan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you repair something that is broken or has a problem, you make it okay again.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My bike was broken, but I repaired it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nareetan ka bayik ku, piru in-upianan ku.

entries.summary: egkalibed-libed; eg-abayen; egliberen; 1 pegkalibed-libed; 2 peg-abey; peglibed

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something repeats, it happens again.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you repeat something, you do or say it again.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She didn't hear me, so I repeated my question.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè nakarineg sikandin keddì, sika ka in-abayan ku ka insè ku.

entries.summary: eg-inniyug te salè; egginulsul; peg-inniyug te salè; pegginulsul; amana migginulsul te mareet ne neyimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you repent of sin, you say sorry to God, and decide to change your attitude and action.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: amana migginulsul te mareet ne neyimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are repentant, you are very sorry for something bad that you have done.

entries.summary: egkasaliyuan; egkaliwanan; egsaliyuwan; egsubalan; eg-ilisan; egpuliyan; eglibed (te pegtahù)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something replaces another thing, it is there instead of that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Fruit has replaced candy as my favorite food.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kindi nasaliyuan te prutas ne ka igkeupii ku ne pegkeen.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you replace one thing with another thing, you stop using the first thing, and start using the new thing instead.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My shoes are broken, so I need to replace them.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me sapatus ku nenaddeetan e, sika ka keilangan e ne egsaliyuan kud seini.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you replace something, you put it back in the place where it was before.
