fields.label: English example
fields.text: She replaced the pen on the table.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Inlibed din itahù ka bulpin diyè te lamisa.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: someone or something that replaces another person or thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our teacher left, so the school is looking for a replacement.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka meistra ney mig-awè, sika ka iskuylaan ney egpamitew te igsubal.

entries.summary: bales

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you reply to someone, you say something to them because they said something to you first.

entries.summary: egpangguhud (meyitenged te nakita wey ke natuenan); guhuren ne sinulat wey ke pangasak (meyitenged te nakita wey ke natuenan); egpanugtul

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpangguhud (meyitenged te nakita wey ke natuenan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you report on something that you have seen or learned, you speak or write about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He reported that three people had been injured in the accident.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He met with his colleagues and reported on his research.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The children listened excitedly to his report of his trip.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: guhuren ne sinulat wey ke pangasak (meyitenged te nakita wey ke natuenan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a piece of speaking or writing about something that you have seen or learned.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The police officer wrote a report of the accident.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He presented a report on his research.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you report a crime, or report someone to an authority such as the police, you tell the authority about the person's bad action.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I reported the robbery to the police.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They reported the dangerous driver to the transport authority.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you report to someone in your work, they have authority over you, so they can tell you what to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I report to my supervisor at work.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggendiya a te ahalen ku eyew te pegtrabahu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you report to a place for something, you arrive there to do something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You need to report for work at 7am tomorrow.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ne eggendiyè ka te trabahu nu kaaselem te alas siti te maselem.

entries.summary: egbehayan te geem eyew te pegpame-bè wey peggimu; egpasabut; egpamalehet

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbehayan te geem eyew te pegpame-bè wey peggimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you represent a country, group, or another person, you speak and act for them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He wants to represent the Philippines at the Olympics.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: An attorney represents people in court.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka abugadu iyan tigpame-bè te me etew diyè te kurti.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something represents another thing, it is a symbol of that other thing, so that you understand it to mean the same as the other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In this picture, the circles represent people.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te seini ne litratu, ka mallibusen egpasabut te me etew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you represent someone or something as a particular thing, you say that they are that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He represented his boss as very unkind, but in reality, she was a very good boss.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpamalehet sikandin te ka ahalen din amana ne dereti, piru ka kamalehetan, amana sikandin ne uupiyei se batasan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The advertisers represented the product as being environmentally friendly.

entries.summary: tigpame-bè; panunggilangan seini ne egpakita ke mamenu ka egkeilingan te duma.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who speaks and acts for a country, group or another person.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: panunggilangan seini ne egpakita ke mamenu ka egkeilingan te duma.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is representative of another thing, it is an example which shows what the other thing is like.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His kind words today are representative of the kind way in which he always speaks.

entries.summary: eggangyù; egbuyù; egsuhù te pegpeyimu te maaddat; hangyù; buyù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you request something, you ask for it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you request someone to do something, you ask them to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I heard her request for help.

entries.summary: egkeilangan; egsuhù; minsan nekey ne keilangan; keilanganen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you require something, you need it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: All humans require food and shelter.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Langun ne me etew ne egkeilangan te pegkeen wey baley.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Food and shelter are required by all humans.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or law requires you to do something, they say that you must do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The law requires us to wear a seatbelt in a vehicle.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka balaud egsuhù te pegsasaluub te hakus ke eg-untud te terak.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We are required by the law to wear a seatbelt in a vehicle.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Food and shelter are requirements for all humans.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Wearing a seatbelt is a legal requirement.

entries.summary: egluwas
eglibulung wey egpamitew te masalig ne kanengnengan; pegpamitew wey peglibulung te kanengnengan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eglibulung wey egpamitew te masalig ne kanengnengan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you research something, you carefully collect information about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is researching his family history.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sikandin eglibulung wey egpamitew te me kanengnengan te guhuren te kaligkatan din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of carefully collecting information about something (do_research).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His is doing research on his family history.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpangimu sikandin te peglibulung wey pegpamitew te guhuren te kaligkatan din.

entries.summary: risirba
eg-ugpè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you reside somewhere, you live there. (used in formal language).

entries.summary: ugpaan; baley; peg-ugpè
nangugpè; eg-ugpè; ugpaanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are resident somewhere, you live in that place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our school has a resident caretaker.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A residential place is one where people can live.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The school is residential: it has two dormitories.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an] su ugpaanan; due daruwa ne durmituryu.

entries.summary: eg-engked

mapahetpet ne suman-suman ne egpabulus eggimu te minsan nekey minsan malised.; mapahetpet ne pegbehey te puhawang eyew te peggimu te minsan nekey.; natuman ne suman-suman puun te peg-uyun ta kalibulungan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mapahetpet ne suman-suman ne egpabulus eggimu te minsan nekey minsan malised.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a strong attitude that you will continue to do something, even though it is difficult.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I didn't try to change her mind, because I could see the resolution on her face.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mapahetpet ne pegbehey te puhawang eyew te peggimu te minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a strong decision to do something (make_a_resolution).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He made a New Year's resolution to start jogging every day.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: natuman ne suman-suman puun te peg-uyun ta kalibulungan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a decision made at a formal meeting by a vote.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a resolution of a problem or argument is the final good result.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's a big problem, and it will be hard to find a resolution.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Dakel seini ne prublima, wey amana malised seini ne egpamitawan te kasulbaran.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kamenu kating-ew ka alung diyè te iskrin

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the resolution of an image on a screen is how clear it is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The screen has quite bad resolution, so I'm not sure exactly who that is in the photo.

entries.summary: egpehet-pehet; mapahetpet ne suman-suman te peggimu te minsan nekey minsan malised.; eg-ayad-ayad; egsulbad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you resolve to do something, you decide strongly that you are going to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: After her bad experience, she resolved never to travel alone again.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impus te mareet ne nabaybayaan din, migpehet-pehet sikandin ne kenad eg-abey eggipanew ne egsabsabeka.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mapahetpet ne suman-suman te peggimu te minsan nekey minsan malised.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a strong attitude that you will continue to do something even if it is difficult.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It took a lot of resolve for her to finish the race, because she was in pain.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you resolve a problem, you fix it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people resolve an argument, they stop arguing or fighting.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The couple have resolved their differences, and are not going to separate.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Napeeneng-eneng ka gubut te alunggun, wey kenad egpasuwayey sikandan.

entries.summary: minsan nekey ne egpakabulig; karatuan; puunanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you can use to help you do something.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seleppì amana egpakabulig ne kasangkapan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If people are poor, they have limited resources.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that a country can use to make money.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The Philippines has many resources, such as fish.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka Pilipinas amana ne susuluhi se karatuan, iling te me ngalap te weyig.

entries.summary: eg-addat; egbassa; peg-addat; pegbassa; egpakita te peg-addat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you respect someone, you think that they are very good.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I really respect him because he is always honest.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana a egtahud kandin su gehetengi sikandin ne etew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling that someone is very good (have respect for someone).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have a lot of respect for him, because he is always honest.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne dakel ka peg-addat ku kandin, su gehetengi sikandin ne etew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you respect someone, you are polite to them, and treat them in a way which fits their age or position.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My parents taught me to respect the elderly.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ginikanan ku migpanulù keddì te peg-addat te me buyag.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: politeness to someone, because of their age or position (show_respect_to_someone).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't like my boss much, but I show him respect because he is my boss.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena a amana egkatelesan te ahalen ku, piru migpakita a diyè te kandin te peg-addat su ahalen ku ma sikandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In class, you should show respect to your teacher and your classmates.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you respect something such as a person's things, you do not damage them, because they belong to that person.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that you do not damage someone's things

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you borrow my bike, please treat it with respect.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke egsambey ka te bayik ku, palihug upiani nu wey behayi nu te peg-addat.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person is respectable, people can respect them (sense 1), because they do not do bad things in public.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are respectful towards someone, you are polite and treat them with respect (sense 4).

entries.summary: egtabak; egbales; egkabawian

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you respond, you write or say something because someone wrote or said something to you first.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I spoke to her, but she didn't respond.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miglalag a kandin, piru warè migtabak sikandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you respond to an action or situation, you do something because of that action or situation.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you smile at a baby, it may respond by smiling at you.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke eggimgimunan nu ka batè, egbales degma sikandin eggimun-gimun.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Many people responded to the request for donations after the flood.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a sick person or an illness responds to treatment, the person starts to get better because of the treatment.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is responding well to the medicine.

entries.summary: tabak; bales

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the thing that you write or say because someone wrote or said something to you first.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have sent three text messages to her, but I haven't received a response.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Katatelu ad migtiks kandin, piru warè tabak puun kandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the thing that you do because of a particular action or sitation.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her crying was a response to the bad news.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegsinehew rin ka bales te mareet ne guhuren ne narineg din.

entries.summary: katenged ne himu; pegpekeyimu te pegkeyitabù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you need to do or organize, or someone whom you need to care for.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His responsibility is to clean the kitchen after meals.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A leader has a responsibility to serve their people.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that you caused something to happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He needs to accept responsibility for the accident, because it was his fault.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ne egdawaten din ka pegkeyitabù te aksidinti, su salè din ma.

entries.summary: matanggu-tanggu; maal-alumama; due katenged ne eggimu; iyan miggimu te minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person is responsible, they are careful and make good decisions.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is young, but I trust her to care for my baby because she is very responsible.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are responsible for something, or for doing something, it is your job to do or organize that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The secretary in our committee is responsible for making notes during the meeting.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sikritari te grupu ka due katenged ne eggimu te pegpanulat diyè te miting.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are responsible for something that happened, you caused it to happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I want to know who is responsible for the broken seat.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian a ne egpakataha ke hentew a ka nakarereet te pinnuuwan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was not responsible for the accident. It was somebody else's fault.

entries.summary: eggimeley; peggimmeley; kenè pegweil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you rest, you stop work, and relax.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I feel tired, so I will rest now.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a state of relaxing, not working (have_a_rest).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I feel tired, so I will have a rest now.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a state of not moving (be_at_rest, come_to_rest).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The ball rolled down the hill and came to rest at my feet.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something rests on another thing, it is on that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The fallen tree is resting on the roof.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her hand rested on the child's head for a moment.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you rest something on another thing, you put the weight of it on that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She rested her head on the table.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She rested the child on her knees, because her arms were tired.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which is made to support another thing (e.g., a footrest).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The seats on the bus are comfortable because they have headrests, but they usually don't have armrests.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She used the plate as a spoon rest for the dirty spoon.

entries.summary: nahaat [naha͡at]; duma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The rest of something is the amount that remains, or the amount which is not included.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Jim ate the rest of the rice, so there is no more.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ingkeen e ni Dim ka nahaat [naha͡at] ne hemey, sika ka naamin e.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He likes corn, but the rest of us prefer sweet potato.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian sikandin te aheley piru ka duma egkeupian te kasilè.

entries.summary: keenanan
eg-alahè; egbalabag; egpapeeneng-eneng; 1 peg-alahè; 2 pegbalabag; pegpapeeneng-eneng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you restrict something, you control the amount of it so that it is smaller.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She restricted her coffee drinking to one cup per day.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-alahè din dè ka kepi ne egkeinum din te sabeka rè ne pakawan te tagsè aldew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you restrict someone or something, you stop them doing some things or going to some places.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The bad weather restricted our activities.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka mareet ne timpu migbalabag te eggimuwen ney.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a rule which stops you doing something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are no restrictions on how many santols you can pick, so take as many as you want.

entries.summary: natamanan; egpakabehey te kapangkusan; egpuunan te egkapangkusan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the thing that happens or exists because of a particular action.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her healthy garden is the result of many hours of hard work.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing results in a second thing, it causes that second thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The storm resulted in several damaged houses.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nenakarereet te masalig ne baley ka baggyu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing results from another thing, the other thing causes it to happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her death resulted from heart disease.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kamatayen din puun te dalu te pusung din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the result of something such as a competition or a test is the final score.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She got excellent results in her exams.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't know the result of the basketball game yesterday.

entries.summary: pegkeuyag puun te pegkapatey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of a person becoming alive after they were dead.

entries.summary: eggeles

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you retain something, you keep it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They retained the tin from the old house to use on their new house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggeles ka me lata diyè te daan ne baley eyew eggamiten diyè te iyam ne baley ran.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This type of material will not retain color well, because it loses a lot of color when you wash it.

entries.summary: peggen-gen eyew kenè egkalaag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of keeping something and not losing it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This soil is always wet, because it has high water retention.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ne tanè layun egkasubid, su due matikang ne peggen-gen te weyig.

entries.summary: neepus e ka timpu te himu puun te buyag e

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: neepus e ka timpu te himu puun te buyag e

entries.summary: eglibed; peglibed diyè te lugar; eg-ulì

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you return to a place where you were before, you go back there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We are going to Valencia, but we'll return later today.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of going back to a place where you were before.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Everyone was very happy about my brother's return to our village.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you return something, you take it back to the owner or to the place where it was before.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Thank you for letting me borrow your bolo. I'll return it later today.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She returned the cup to the kitchen after she finished the coffee.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If work or business returns money, it produces money for you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His new business is not returning much money, so maybe he will need to stop.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the money that you get from work or business

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His vegetables are very good quality, so he gets high returns when he sells them.

entries.summary: egpangguhud te minsan nekey diyè te me etew; egpakita wey egpasabut; egpakita te minsan nekey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpangguhud te minsan nekey diyè te me etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you reveal something that was secret, you tell people about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She revealed that she had a boyfriend.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpangguhud sikandin te duen e alukuy rin ne kanakan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something reveals another thing, it shows that that thing is true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His question revealed that he did not understand.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka insè din egpakita ne warè sikandin nakasabut.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you reveal something, you show it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He moved the bed to reveal the hole in the floor.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-awè din ka hibatanan eyew egpakita te lungag diyè te seeg.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegpangguhud te minsan nekey diyè te me etew; 2 pegpakita wey pegpasabut 3 pegpakita

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that someone tells you, that you didn't know (make_a_revelation).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She made some interesting revelations about her life when we talked.

entries.summary: egsulì; egbales
seleppì te urganisasyun ne ingkuwa puun te me etew

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: seleppì te urganisasyun ne ingkuwa puun te me etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: money that an organization gets from people (especially the money that the government gets from tax).

entries.summary: dasag
gusuk
ribun
hemey
meyaman; due dakel wey eleg ne tahu te minsan nekey (iling te kalambuan, mentika, asukal, wey duma pad)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A rich person has a lot of money.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due dakel wey eleg ne tahu te minsan nekey (iling te kalambuan, mentika, asukal, wey duma pad)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Rich food contains a lot of fat, oil, sugar, eggs, or other things like that.

entries.summary: eg-untud; egpanguddè; egpangalabew; egmumutur; egbebayik; peg-untud; pegpanguddè; pegpangalabew; pegmumutur; pegbebayik

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you ride something, you sit on it or in it while it is moving.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Do you know how to ride a bike?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I rode the bus to Davao.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action of riding something such as a horse, bike or bus.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She went for a ride on her friend's bike.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He offered me a ride on his motorbike.

entries.summary: meupiya (meyitenged te himu); eleg; meupiya; katenged

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Parents need to teach their children to do what is right.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me ginikanan dapat egpanulù te me anak dan ke nekey ka meupiya ne himu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something right is true or correct, or fits the particular place or situation (e.g., the right key for the door).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He got twenty-eight answers right on the exam.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: No, you're not singing that right! Try again.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She thought he might have a boil, and she was right.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: No, that's not the right key; try the other one.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Nursing is the right job for me.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The box is upside down; you need to turn it over so that it will be right-side up.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Your T-shirt is inside out; you need to change it so that it is right-side out.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you have a right to do something, you should be able to do it (maybe because the law allows you to do it).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Parents have a right to advise their children.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you right a problem, you fix it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I went to the dentist to try to right the problems with my teeth.

entries.summary: igkakawanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The right side of something is the side to the east, if the thing is facing north.

entries.summary: pabulus; sahuhunè; eleg; iya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you go right to a place, you go there directly, without stopping.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She walked right into the manager's office.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggipanew sikandin duritsu te upisina te ahalen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I threw the ball to him, and he threw it right back to me.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migdegpak ku ka bula diyè te kandin, wey sahuhunè ne inlibed din iregpak kayi te keddì.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'll get the glass right now.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkuwa a te basu kunteen e iya.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He sat right in the middle of the room.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpinnuu sikandin te taliwarè te sinabeng.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use right to show that something goes as far as a certain time or place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He threw the ball right over the top of the house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migdegpak din iya ka bula pabulus-bulus ne inpalampey te atep te baley.

entries.summary: matareng; pegkamatareng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A righteous person does good, according to God's law.

entries.summary: egdahing; egparahing; eg-umew (meyitenged te tilipunu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something rings, it makes a sound like a bell or cellphone.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you ring something such as a bell, you cause it to make a sound.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you ring someone, you call them on their phone.

entries.summary: malibusen ne inpangimu puun te minsan nekey ne butang; sising; nateil ne lugar ne ka baksing diyè eggimuwa

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: malibusen ne inpangimu puun te minsan nekey ne butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a round shape made of things which are in a circle (e.g., a ring of people, a ring of trees)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a round thing (usually made of metal), which you wear around your finger.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nateil ne lugar ne ka baksing diyè eggimuwa

entries.summary: meyinug

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If food such as fruit is ripe, it it ready to eat, and not still hard and green.

entries.summary: peyinuhan
egpamatikang; egtulin; egdakel; pegtulin

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something rises, it moves higher.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The smoke from the fire rose slowly.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The sound of water rose from the valley far below them.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a level or amount rises, it becomes higher or larger.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The river rose quickly in the flood.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The cost of living is rising.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an increase in a level or amount

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There has been a rise in the number of students this year.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is happy because she received a payrise last month.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If the sun or moon rises, it appears from behind the earth.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The sun rises in the east.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you rise, you stand up.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They all rose from their chairs when she entered.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you rise, you get out of bed.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: When we say that Jesus rose from the dead, we mean that he became alive again.

entries.summary: himu
kunterè
pahamayan ne weyig; dakel ne weyig

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pahamayan ne weyig; dakel ne weyig

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large, long line of fresh water which is moving.

entries.summary: kelesadda; bayaanan te terak

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a way for cars and other vehicles to travel on. It may be in a town or between towns.

entries.summary: egtuug
takew
pegpanakew
makehal ne tanè ne egpuunan ne egkeyimu ka batu; batu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: makehal ne tanè ne egpuunan ne egkeyimu ka batu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the hard material which is under the ground, and which stones are made of.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is hard to make a well, because the rock is very hard.

entries.summary: egkaanluwag; egkatali; egkaantuwal; egkabiyal; eg-antuwal; eg-anluwag; egbiyal

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or thing rocks, they move from side to side, or backwards and forwards.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The table rocks because one leg is too short.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkaantuwal ka lamisa su malepet ka sabeka ne paa.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The small boat rocked when I got into it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you rock something, you cause it to move from side to side, or backwards and forwards.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She rocked the baby in her arms to make him sleep.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: In-anluwag din ka malalab pad ne batè diyè te belad eyew egpakalipereng.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We rocked the car to try to move it.

entries.summary: katungdanan; katenged; neyimu ne himu; pepil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your role in a group or place is the thing or things that you regularly do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My role at home is to look after the garden.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your role in something that happened is the thing or things that you did.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He played a major role in planning the fiesta.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a character in a movie or play

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That actor usually plays the role of the bad guy in movies.

entries.summary: egkalilid; egkabalikid; egbalikid; eglilid; eglulun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something rolls, they move by turning over one or more times.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The ball rolled along the ground

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka bula nalilid diyè te tanè.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The baby rolled over onto his back.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you roll something, you cause it to move by turning over one or more times.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He rolled the ball along the ground.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miglilid din ka bula diyè te tanè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you roll or roll_up something flat, you turn it over and over until it is in a round shape like a tube.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He rolled up his sleeping mat.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which is made of a flat thing made into a round shape like a tube.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a sleeping roll in the room.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due linulun ne ikam diyè te sinabeng.

entries.summary: atep; dibabew wey ke ampew te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the top part of a house.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: dibabew wey ke ampew te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the top part of something (e.g., the roof of your mouth).

entries.summary: sinabeng; natahahè; bakanti

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a section of a house or building which usually has four walls and a door.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: space where there is nothing or nobody

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is no more room on this jeepney, so you'll need to wait for the next one.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warad bakanti kayi te dyip, sika ka keilangan kad ne egtahad te seup.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Sit here. There is room for you on this seat.

entries.summary: dalid; ka kinareisekan, malemu wey kinewun-aan [kinewun-a:n] ne ula-ula te lalag, ne warè pad igmanumpul.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the part of a plant which is in the ground, and which gets water and other things from the soil.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka kinareisekan, malemu wey kinewun-aan [kinewun-a:n] ne ula-ula te lalag, ne warè pad igmanumpul.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the smallest, basic form of a word, with no affixes.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: 'Galè' iyan ka malemu wey kinewun-aan [kinewun-a:n] ne lalag te ' kahalaan', nahalè' wey 'warè nahalè'.

entries.summary: lubid
kalasiyan te bulak ne due keemutan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kalasiyan te bulak ne due keemutan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a kind of flower, which often has a good smell.

entries.summary: kaddat-kaddat; gelled-gelled; sibuen; baluren; mareet ne lalag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a surface is rough, it is not very even, so you can't move your fingers across it easily (e.g., a cat's tongue).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If water is rough, there are many small waves, maybe because of wind or a storm.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If words or actions are rough, they are not kind and soft, and maybe can hurt someone.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He gave me a rough push, and I fell down.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne warè neupiani te eggimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is rough, it is not done very carefully or very well.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This is just a rough copy of my story, but I need to write it again before I give it to the teacher.

entries.summary: malibusen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something round is in the shape of a circle.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The moon is round because it's a full moon tonight.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka bulan malibusen su timman kuntee ne karusileman.

entries.summary: lingya
egpamegsey
ka kahalangden.
igpeglakulas
gumà
rabis
umbeg
trapu
egdereet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you ruin something, you break it or do something to it so that it becomes bad.

entries.summary: kukuman; balaud; eg-uyan wey egbeye-beyè te nasud; peg-uyan wey pegbeye-beyè te nasud

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: words which say what people are allowed or not allowed to do

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a rule in the library that we are not allowed to speak loudly.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a leader or group rules a country, they control that country.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The country has been ruled by a dictator for the past 20 years.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The rule of a leader or group is their action of controlling the country, or the time that they control it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It happened during the rule of Julius Ceasar.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbehey te maheteng ne puhawang wey ke disisyun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone such as a judge rules something, they decide it formally.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The judge ruled that the criminal should spend 10 years in prison.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka talaggukum migbehey te patamanan ne puhawang ne ka nakapatey egkaprisu te sapulù ne tuig.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is the_rule, or if it happens as_a_rule, it's the way that things usually happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: As a rule, I take my lunch to school.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka layun egkeyitabù, eg-uyan a te bewu ku diyè te iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an].

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I bought my lunch today, but that's the exception rather than the rule.

entries.summary: egpallahuy; pegpallahuy; egtulayas

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or animal runs, they move quickly using their legs.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We were late for school, so we ran fast.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He goes for a run along the highway every evening.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a liquid runs, it moves.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The water ran down her face.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a machine is running, it is on and is working.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Don't put your hand in the machine when it is running.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggipanew layun ne unturanan eyew te peggated

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If public transport runs, it travels regularly.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Buses from Cagayan to Davao run all night, every hour.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka terak ne bas ne egpuun te Kagayan peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] Davao eggipanew layun te langun ne karukileman, tagsè uras.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you run something such as a business or a shop, you are the one who controls it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sikandin ka egdumalè te dakel ne tindaan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you run for a position in government, you try to win that position in an election.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is running for president in the election.

entries.summary: kebig
egsakripisyu te minsan nekey; peglasey-lasey; sakripisyu; egpanubad ne eggimatey te mananap

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you sacrifice something that is important to you, you give it, or live without it in order to help someone, or to get another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He sacrificed his free time to help me with my work.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Insakripisyu rin ka bakanti rin ne uras te pegbulig te trabahu ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you give or live without in order to help someone or get another thing. (make_a_sacrifice).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My parents made a lot of sacrifices to pay for my schooling.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ginikanan ku miggimu te dakel ne peglasey-lasey eyew te peg-iskuyla ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone sacrifices an animal, they kill the animal for a god or spirit.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegpanubad ne eggimatey te mananap, wey ke egbehey te minsan nekey diyè te diyus-diyus wey panisingan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a ceremony in which an animal is killed, or something is given to a god or spirit.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the animal which is killed, or the thing which is given for a god or spirit.

entries.summary: langè
diyè te nateil ne lugar ne mariyù te karereetan; kenè egpakarereet kuna; luwas (meyitenged te lugar wey ke sitwasyun)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: diyè te nateil ne lugar ne mariyù te karereetan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something is safe, they are in a place where they will not be hurt.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Don't worry, your children are safe at home.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is safe, it will not hurt you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This dog is safe; he will not bite you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That bike is not safe because it is broken.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: luwas (meyitenged te lugar wey ke sitwasyun)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a place or situation is safe, you will not be hurt there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That street is not safe at night.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kaban wey ke kehun ne putew ne due paggul ne egpanahuan te me kasangkapan eyew kenè egkatakew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a strong, heavy metal box with a lock. You put things in it so that nobody can steal them.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of say

entries.summary: etew te Manama; Kristuwanen; Te Katuliku ne simbaan [simba͡an], migpatey seini ne etew, piru egpakarawat te ispisyal ne pegtahud su ka me etew migpalintutuu te seini ne me etew mig-ugpe ne due balaanen ne umul.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Te Katuliku ne simbaan [simba͡an], migpatey seini ne etew, piru egpakarawat te ispisyal ne pegtahud su ka me etew migpalintutuu te seini ne me etew mig-ugpe ne due balaanen ne umul.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In the Catholic church, a saint is a person who has died, but receives special respect because people believe they lived a very holy life.

entries.summary: pegbelegyè; timpu te pegpamalepet te bali te me beliyenen; egbelegyè

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She was very sad about the sale of her horse.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The sale of alcohol to people under 18 is illegal.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: timpu te pegpamalepet te bali te me beliyenen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an event where a shop sells things at a lower price than usual.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That shop is having a sale next week, and everything will be half-price.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is for_sale, the owner wants to sell it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Sorry, this horse is not for sale.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Pasaylu a key rè, seini ne kuddè kenè ne belegyè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If things are on_sale, they are in shops and ready to buy.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That book is on sale in all large bookstores now.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpareisekan te bali ka me belegyè puun te nateil ne bali

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is on_sale, you can buy it for less than its usual price.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Only the things on this shelf are on sale; everything else is full-price.

entries.summary: pameligyè ne etew
asin; mapeit (meyitenged te due asin)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something salty has salt in it.

entries.summary: nekeg-iling; warè naalin [na͡alin]; warè nabalbalawi; iyan ded; sikan ded

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two things are the_same as each other, they are exactly like each other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You have the same T-shirt as me.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is the_same as it was before, it hasn't changed.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I haven't seen her for years, but she still looks the same.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egtuihan e ne warè ku nakita sikandin, piru iling te warè naalin [na͡alin] sikandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She always wears the same hat.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Layun egsaluub sikandin te iyan ded ne kalù.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use the_same to talk about something which you talked about just before.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She sat down and he did the same.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpinnuu sikandin wey miggimu te iling ded.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her bike had a broken wheel, and his bike had the same problem.

entries.summary: deisek ne baad te minsan nekey ne egpakita ke nekey a ka egkeilingan te kinatibuk-an.; eggeram te deisek te minsan nekey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: deisek ne baad te minsan nekey ne egpakita ke nekey a ka egkeilingan te kinatibuk-an.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a small amount of something which shows what the whole thing is like.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He took a sample of each cake, so that he could choose the best one.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggeram te deisek te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you sample something, you try a little of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I would like to sample some of that biku.

entries.summary: egpamatulusen; egbalaanen; pegpamatulus; pegbalaan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If God sanctifies you, he makes you clean from your sin, and causes you to become holy.

entries.summary: pantad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of sit

entries.summary: Meibulan; Satanas; due kalabetan te Satanas

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the leader of all evil spirits and the enemy of God.

entries.summary: katagbawan
egpakatagbew
sewug
pansewug
egluwas; egsamè; egpakahamit te deisek; egkasamaan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you save a person or animal that is in a dangerous situation, you take them away from that situation, or do something so that they are not hurt.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He ran into the house and saved the child from the fire.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you save something, you keep it so that it can be used later.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Please save some food for me, because I will be home late.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you save something such as time or money, you use less of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you take the short way, you will save 30 minutes.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke egpamantek ka, egkasamaan ke pad te me trayinta ne minutus.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Turn off the light to save power.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you save something (e.g., money), you slowly collect it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm saving for a horse, so I put a little money in a box every week.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eglilimud a te seleppì eyew te kuddè, sika ka egtahù a te deisek ne seleppì diyè te kehun te tagsè simana.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakabulig eyew kenad keilangan ne eggimu te iling ded ne eggimuwen.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something saves you doing something, it helps you so that you don't need to do that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She gave me some eggs, and that saved me going to the shop to buy eggs.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbehayan a nikandin te atelug, wey kena ad keilangan ne eggendiyè te tindaan [tinda͡an] ka egbebeli te atelug.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggeles wey ke egtahù te me kanengnengan diyè te kumpyutir

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: On a computer, if you save information, you cause the computer or a disk to keep that information.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I didn't save my work before I switched off the computer, so I lost it.

entries.summary: gabas; eggabas

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A sharp-edged tool which you move backwards and forwards on something such as wood, to cut it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you saw, you move a saw backwards and forwards to cut something.

entries.summary: eglalag; egkahi; egpangguhud; egpangasak; egpanugtul te katahaan [kataha͡an]; timpu te pegbehey te puhawang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you say that something is the case, you speak.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She said that she was tired.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something that you read says that something is the case, you can see the information there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My watch says that it is 11 o'clock.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka urasan ku egpanugtul te alas unsi e.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A say is the chance to give your ideas and help to decide something (have_a_say).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: One of the jobs of a chairman is to make sure that everyone in the meeting has their say.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sabeka ne trabahu te prisidinti ne ka tagsè sabeka due timpu te pegbehey te kandan ne puhawang.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use say to show that you are not giving an exact number.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are, say, 40 people in my sitio.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due me hep-at ne pulù ne etew diyè te sityu ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use say to show that you are giving an example.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you go to an Asian country, say, Japan, you will need to take off your shoes in the house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke eggendiyè ka te Asya ne me inged, panunggilingan, Dyapan, keilangan ne eg-aween nu ka sepatus nu ke diyè ka te lasud te baley.

entries.summary: paneked
tulak
talagtag
ka minsan nekey ne egkakita nu; inged ke hendei neyitabù ka hitabù; baad te salida

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka minsan nekey ne egkakita nu

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I watched them say goodbye, and it was a sad scene.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: inged ke hendei neyitabù ka hitabù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The scene of an event is the place where it happened.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The police came to the scene of the accident.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a part of a drama, such as a play or movie.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: makeseg ne pegpataha eyew ka me etew egpakatengteng kandin

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a situation where someone is very loud about their feelings in a public place, so that many people look at them (make_a_scene).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The bad child made a scene at the shop when his mother didn't buy candy for him.

entries.summary: dakel ne neyimu ne planu wey ke sistima te gubirnu wey ke grupu.; hineles ne planu (ne layun mareet) te peg-angey te minsan nekey ne igkeupii; eggimu te hineles ne planu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: dakel ne neyimu ne planu wey ke sistima te gubirnu wey ke grupu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large, organized plan or system by a government or organization.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The government introduced a new loan scheme to help businesses.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka gubirnu migpanengneng te iyam ne planu te pegpeutang eyew te pegtabang te me mamelegyeay.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: hineles ne planu (ne layun mareet) te peg-angey te minsan nekey ne igkeupii

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a secret plan (usually bad) to achieve something that you want.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't want to be part of your scheme to get their field.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you scheme, you make a secret plan to achieve something that you want.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Hi is scheming to get his neighbor's land.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pamaahi ne ka grupu te me butang egkatapid wey ke egkateil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the way that a group of things (e.g. colors) are organized together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They have a blue color scheme in their office: the walls and chairs are blue.

entries.summary: panuluanan; iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an]; nateil ne grupu te me etew ne due katuenan (iling te mateu ne eggimu te minsan nekey wey ke talagsulat) ne nenekeg-iling se pamaahi wey suman-suman.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a place where people go to learn from teachers.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nateil ne grupu te me etew ne due katuenan (iling te mateu ne eggimu te minsan nekey wey ke talagsulat) ne nenekeg-iling se pamaahi wey suman-suman.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a particular group of people (e.g., artists, or writers) who have similar styles or thinking.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Monet belonged to the impressionist school of artists.

entries.summary: ka pegnengneng te minsan nekey kayi te kalibutan; ka mapaayad-ayad ne pegnengneng te minsan nekey ne katuenan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka pegnengneng te minsan nekey kayi te kalibutan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the study of the physical world (e.g., animals, plants, rocks, disease).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka mapaayad-ayad ne pegnengneng te minsan nekey ne katuenan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the careful study of any area of knowledge (e.g. political science, social science).

entries.summary: gunting

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a tool for cutting which has two sharp edges crossing each other.

entries.summary: kaluahan ne katamanan.; timpu wey kaligwangan te peggimu te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The scope of something such as an activity or topic is all the things which are included in it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The scope of my job is very wide, and I do many different kinds of things.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kaluahan ne katamanan te trabahu ku su luluahi, wey masalig ka himuwenen ku ne me butang.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: timpu wey kaligwangan te peggimu te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the chance or freedom to do something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our project topic gives us scope to write about anything that we want to.

entries.summary: Bibliya; egpekegtupu ke nekey ka nasulat te Bibliya; me sinulat te nateil ne me rilihiyun ne ka me etew egnengneng wey eg-ikul kayi; kasulatan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The Bible is sometimes called Scripture

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpekegtupu ke nekey ka nasulat te Bibliya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is scriptural, it fits with what is written in Scripture.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me sinulat te nateil ne me rilihiyun ne ka me etew egnengneng wey eg-ikul kayi; kasulatan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the scriptures of a particular religion are the written things that people of that religion study and follow.

entries.summary: dahat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the area of salt water which covers a large area of the earth.

entries.summary: egpamitew; pegpamitew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you search for something, you look in many places to try to find it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action of trying to find something.

entries.summary: sengetimpuwan te sengetuig ne due nateil ne keugpè; sengetimpuwan te sengetuig ne due nateil ne himuwen; egtahù te pananam

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sengetimpuwan te sengetuig ne due nateil ne keugpè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one of the periods in a year with a particular kind of weather and temperature (e.g., summer, the wet season).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sengetimpuwan te sengetuig ne due nateil ne himuwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a period in a year when a particular activity happens (e.g., the volleyball season).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you season food, you add things such as spices to it to make it taste good.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He seasoned the chicken with salt and pepper.

entries.summary: pinnuuwan; bangkù; nakapinnuu; egkatahuan (meyitenged te egpakatahù wey egpakapinnuu ne me etew)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that is made for people to sit on.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are_seated, you sit down.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Please be seated, and open your books.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkatahuan (meyitenged te egpakatahù wey egpakapinnuu ne me etew)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a building seats a certain number of people, that is the number of people who can sit in it.

entries.summary: sigundu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a very short period of time (a minute is made up of 60 seconds).

entries.summary: ikarangeb; ikaruwa; duma; dangeb; lein; minsan nekey ne deisek dè ka bali tenged su due deisek ne prublima.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is second, it is number two in time or space.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Jun came first in the race, and Jin came second.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This is the second time that you've broken that chair.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A second thing is one more thing that is similar.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He finished his cup of coffee, so his friend brought him a second one.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Neimpusan din e ka sabeka ne basu ne keppi, purisu imbehayan e man-e sikandin te alukuy rin te ikarangeb ne basu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne deisek dè ka bali tenged su due deisek ne prublima.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a product which is cheaper because it has some small problem.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In a formal meeting, if you second an idea, you are the one who formally agrees with it, so that people can then talk or vote on it.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: tagsè seup te seup ne aldew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use phrases such as every_second month or every_other day to say that something happens one month or day, and not the next, and happens again the next day or month, and not the next, and so on.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I wash my hair every second day (meaning Monday, Wednesday, Friday...)

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eggugasan ku ka bulbul ku te tagsè seup te seup ne aldew.

entries.summary: hineles

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which only certain people know about, and don't tell other people.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a secret door behind the picture.

entries.summary: talagsulat wey talagtines diyè te punduk; pangulu te dipartamintu te gubirnu wey ke talagbulig te pangulu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: talagsulat wey talagtines diyè te punduk

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person whose job is to care for the paperwork and office work in an organization

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pangulu te dipartamintu te gubirnu wey ke talagbulig te pangulu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the leader of a government department, or an assistant of the leader

entries.summary: baad

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The body of an insect generally has three separate sections.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka lawa te me uled-uled due tatelu ne baad.

entries.summary: nateil ne baad te me etew; lugar ne due me sundalu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nateil ne baad te me etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a particular part of a society or economy in a country (e.g., the private sector, the education sector).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a large working class sector in that city.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: People who have government jobs work in the public sector, while people who have jobs in businesses work in the private sector.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an area where the military is working.

entries.summary: luwas; kasiguruwan; egsusiyen; egnengnengen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is secure, it is safe, and you can feel sure that you will not lose it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her children are safe and secure at home.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me anak din luwas diyè te baley.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This building is very secure, because it is made of blocks, and has locks on the doors and windows.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Keep your money in a secure place if you can.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a job is secure, you feel sure that it will continue.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She has a secure job at the Barangay.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sikandin due kasiguruwan ne himu diyè te Barangay.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you secure something, you make sure that it is safe.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Please secure your things before you leave the building.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Susiya niyu pa ubag ka me kasangkapan niyu wey kew panggipanew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you secure a place, you lock it so that it is safe.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He secured the office with a lock on the door.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miglekeban din e ka upisina wey inpaggulan din e ka lekeb.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you secure something, you get it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our team secured a place in the final.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka grupu ney nakaangey te kapanaluwan te katammanan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you secure something, you attach it to another thing so that it will not move easily.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They secured the roof with extra nails.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impakepkep dan ka atep te nasamè ne lansang.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He secured his raft to the riverbank so that it would not float away.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is secure, it is attached to another thing so that it will not move easily.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If your roof isn't secure, it might come off in the storm.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Emun ke ka atep nu warè nakakepkep, kema ke eglayap seini te kalamag.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due kasiguruwan (meyitenged te pegkeupii wey pegtanggu te duma)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person is secure, they feel sure that other people like them and care about them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His parents are kind and loving, so he is a very secure child.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ginikanan din buutan wey mapalanggeen, sika ka due kasiguruwan din ne batè.

entries.summary: kasiguruwan; minsan nekey ne igtaleu wey ke igpasalig

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm not sure about the security of your horse if you leave it near the highway at night.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Security in that area is not good, because there are a lot of criminals.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They bought a large dog for security.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne igtaleu wey ke igpasalig

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you borrow money from a person or organization, security is something that you will give them if you can't pay back the money.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He put up his motorbike as security for the loan.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Intaleu rin ka mutur din eyew gerentiya iya te insambayan din ne seleppì.

entries.summary: egpakakita; egpakanengneng, egpakasabut (meyitenged te pegpakataha); egleuy

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you see something, your eyes get a picture of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I saw the cat as it ran past.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakakita a te iiyali ne miyew ne migpallahuy.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Do you see what I mean?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakanengneng ka ke nekey ka igpasabut ku?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you see someone (e.g., a doctor), you visit them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The midwife told me to see a doctor.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpaleuyen a te manguyamu diyè te duktur.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you see that something happens, you do something to make sure that it happens.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mothers always sees that I don't forget my umbrella.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpaniguru ka iney ku ne kenè ku egkalingawan ka payung ku.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egtengtengan pad; egpatpateen pad (meyitenged te pegbehey te puhawang)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you say that you will see, you mean that you will decide later.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'll see if I can visit you tomorrow; it depends on my work.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egtengtengan ku pad ke egpakaleuy a kuna kaaselem; iyan ku egkataharan ka himu ku.

entries.summary: behas

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a small thing which grows into a plant when you put it in the ground.

entries.summary: egpamitew; eggeraman eggimuwa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you seek something, you try to find and get it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He went to the city to seek work.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggendiyè sikandin te siyudad eyew te pegpamitew te trabahu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We are seeking a solution to our problem.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you seek to do something, you try to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm seeking to finish this project tonight.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eggeraman ku te eg-impus seini ne himuwen kunteen karusileman.

entries.summary: iling te; hendue te

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something seems to be true, you think that it is true because of what you can see. It may or may not be really true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He seems like a friendly boy.

entries.summary: marelag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something seldom happens, it does not happen many times.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My cousins live far away, so they are seldom able to visit us.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me suled ku nangugpè te maddiyù, sika ka marelag dè egpakapanumbaley sikandan kanami.

entries.summary: eg-alam; egpilì; tineil ne in-alam ne grupu te etew wey ke minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you select something, you choose it from a group of things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She selected the biggest mango from the bag.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: tineil ne in-alam ne grupu te etew wey ke minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A select group is a special group of people or things who have been chosen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Only a select few were invited to the meeting.

entries.summary: peg-alam; pegpilì; grupu te me butang ne egkaalam nu

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The selection of a baby's name is hard for some people, because they have many ideas.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: grupu te me butang ne egkaalam nu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of things which you can choose something from.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The shop had a wide selection of rices: more than ten different varieties.

entries.summary: keugalingen
makeddi-keddien
egbelegyè; egpameligyè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you sell something, someone gives you money for it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I sold some vegetables from my field.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbelegya a te me gulay puun te kamet ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a shop sells something, it has that thing for people to buy.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini ne tindaan [tinda͡an] kenè egpameligyè te egpekewubug ne me inumen.

entries.summary: egpeuyan; egpekeyimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you send someone something, or send something to someone, you cause it to go to them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her brother was going to Davao, so she sent the gift with him.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She sent a text message to me.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The teacher sent the student to the principal's office.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something sends you ADJECTIVE, or sends you to a particular state, it causes you to be in that state.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That movie is so boring that it always sends me to sleep.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sika ne salida su makapepela sika naa ka egpakapalipereng keddì.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She had a bad temper, and even small things could send her into a terrible mood.

entries.summary: me katuenan ne egpakabulig ne egkanengnengan ka inged; geramen (meyitenged te minsan nekey); egkaheram; egkatahaan [egkataha͡an]

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me katuenan ne egpakabulig ne egkanengnengan ka inged

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one of the abilities which help us to experience the world (sight, hearing, touch, taste and smell).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling about something (e.g., a sense of fear).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you sense something, you feel it or know it in some way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She sensed that the child felt nervous.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: katuenan te pegkahalè wey ke pegpakasabut

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the ability to enjoy or understand something (e.g. a sense of fun, a sense of rhythm, a sense of style).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: katuenan te pegnengneng ke nekey ka meupiya ne eggimuwen te sitwasyun.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the ability to know what is the good or wise thing to do in a situation.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She's just a young teenager, but I trust her to look after my baby, because he has a lot of sense.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I didn't understand everything she said, but I got the sense of it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Wara a nakasabut te langun ne miglalag din, piru nakuwa ku ka igpasabut te langun-langun.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use sense to talk about one way of thinking about something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In one sense, I want to go, but in another sense, I just don't feel like it.

entries.summary: matelas

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of send

entries.summary: punduk te me lalag ne due igpasabut

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: punduk te me lalag ne due igpasabut

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of words which have a meaning together. There is always a verb and usually a subject.

entries.summary: eggukuman te nateil ne igbennal; hukum ne egkarawat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a judge sentences you to a particular punishment, they say that you will have that punishment.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The judge sentenced them to 5 years in prison.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka talaggukum miggukum kandan te lalimma ne tuig ne pegkaprisu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the punishment that a judge says you must receive.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is serving a five-year sentence in prison.

entries.summary: egpasuwayey; egpeengkerey; egpegsuwey; egpeg-engked; egpakapataliwarè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people or things separate from each other, they move away from each other so that they are not together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The group separated because each person needed to go to a different place.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka grupu migpasus-suwayey su ka tagsè sabeka ne etew keilangan ne eggendiyè te lein-lein ne lugar.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His parents separated last year, and he lives with his mother now.
