fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ginikanan din migpeg-engkerey seeyè se miglihad ne tuig, wey mig-ugpè sikandin diyè te iney rin kuntee.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you separate people or things from each other, you cause them to not be together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Separate the white part of the egg from the yellow part.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Pegsuwaya nu ka maangkag te atelug wey ka makalawag.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The teacher separated the fighting children.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something separates two things, it is between them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The river separates my land and his land.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pahamayan ne weyig ka nakapataliwarè te tanè din wey te tanè ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is separate from another thing, it is not part of that other thing, and is not together with it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The CR is not part of the house, it is separate from the house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka indesanan kenè ne baad te baley, nakasuwey seini te baley.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini ke eglalag ka te daruwa wey ke masulug ne lein-lein ne kasangkapan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use separate to talk about two or more different things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The children sleep in two separate rooms.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me batè miglipereng te nekegsuwey ne daruwa ne sinabeng.

entries.summary: pegkasunud-sunud; pegkateil; sunud-sunud ne egkeyitabù; egpegsunud-sunud

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an arrangement of things in a particular order (with one thing first, another thing second, and so on...).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What is the sequence of songs on the CD?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekey ka pegkasunud-sunud te me ulahingen due te plaka?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of things which happen in a particular order.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She told me about the sequence of events which had happened.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migkahiyan a nikandin te sunud-sunud ne neyitabù.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you sequence things, you put them in a particular order.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She sequenced the words in alphabetical order.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Sequential things happen in a particular order.

entries.summary: pegsinsinundul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of things which are one after the other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She tried a series of medicines before she found one which helped.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggeraman din pegsinsinundula te eg-inum ka bawì ne wey rin pad nataheyi ne duen bes sabeka ne klasi ne egpakabawì iya.

entries.summary: maheteng; keilangan ne egsumsumanen; mapahetpet ne eglalag ke nekey ka nasuman-suman

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A serious person thinks a lot, and doesn't joke or laugh much. If a mood is serious, there is not much joking or laughing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is very serious, so you should be careful if you try to joke with him.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is more serious than most young people his age.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is serious, it is important and you need to think about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She asked me some very serious questions about life.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mapahetpet ne eglalag ke nekey ka nasuman-suman

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are serious, you are saying what you really think, and are not joking about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She was serious when she said she wanted to become a pilot.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mapahetpet ne migkahi sikandin te egkeupian din ne egkeyimu ne pilutu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something bad is serious, it is large or very bad (e.g., an accident, a problem).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He fell off his bike, but he didn't get any serious injuries, just a few cuts.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: leleti ne keilangan ka minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are serious about something, it is truly important to you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a good student who is very serious about his study.

entries.summary: suluhuanen
egsendad; eg-alu; egpangeun; egbehey te egkeinum; egbehey wey ke egtanggu te egmambebeli; egbulig egtanggu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egsendad; eg-alu; egpangeun; egbehey te egkeinum

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you serve food or drink to someone, or serve someone food or drink, you give it to them to eat or drink.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother served our guests coffee.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Imbehayan te iney ku te keppi ka mahaliyug ney.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother served the rice onto our plates.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impangaluwan te iney ku ka me platu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That restaurant does not serve alcohol

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè egsendad te inumen ka sika ne keenanan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbehey wey ke egtanggu te egmambebeli

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone such as a shop assistant serves you, they receive your money and give you the things that you need.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A shop assistant's job is to serve customers.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka himu te talagbulig diyè te tindaan ka egbehey te egbeliyen te talagbeli.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you serve someone, you do things to help them and care for them.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpamakey (meyitenged te peggimu te igkeupii te Manama)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you serve God, you do things that he wants you to do.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggimu te pepil ne isip (ke nekey ka trabahu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you serve as a role, you work in that role.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He served as treasurer for six months.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggimu sikandin te pepil isip trisurir seled te hen-em ne bulan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you serve a period of time in a place such as prison, you spend the time there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She served six months in prison.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekeugpè sikandin te hen-em ne bulan diyè te prisuwan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something serves as something, it is used for that purpose.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The fallen tree serves as a bridge over the river.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkahamit ne tulay ka kayu ne napeled diyè te weyig.

entries.summary: pegbehey; pegtanggu (meyitenged te egmambebeli); pegbulig pegtanggu; peggimu te pepil ne isip (ke nekey ka trabahu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the help which a customer receives in a shop.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That shop has excellent service; the staff are very helpful.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne meupiya ka sirbisyu te sika ne tindaan; amana ne mabulig ka me trabahanti.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of doing something to help people.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He received an award for his service to the community.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakarawat sikandin te unag tenged te pegbulig rin diyè te kumunidad.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peggimu te pepil ne isip (ke nekey ka trabahu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of working in a particular job or role.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The director thanked him for his many years of service in the company.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impasalamatan sikandin te diriktur din tenged te masalig ne leg-un ne peggimu rin diyè te kumpanya.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkahamit wey egpakabulig te masalig (meyitenged te peglelawa wey ke unturanan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that many people can use or which helps many people (e.g., a health service, a bus service).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The midwife goes to the village every week to provide a health service for mothers.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eggendiyè ka midwayp te me sityu tagsè simana eyew te pegpamawi te me iney.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is no jeepney service to my town.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ware terak ne egpamasahiru diyè te ugpaan ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: After the storm there were no water or electricity services for a week.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Pegkapenga te baggiyu kenad e egpakabehey te weyig wey sulù te senge simana.

entries.summary: punduk te senge klasiyan ne kasangkapan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: punduk te senge klasiyan ne kasangkapan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of things which belong together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I bought a set of cups.

entries.summary: egtahù; egtahù te etew wey ke butang te nateil ne sitwasyun; egteil iling te uras wey ke pitsa te eggimuwen wey ke bali te minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you set something somewhere, you put it there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She set the cup on the table.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egtahù te etew wey ke butang te nateil ne sitwasyun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you set someone or something in a particular state, you cause them to be in that state.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He set the wood on fire.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Intemeg din ka kayu diyè te hapuy.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The bird was in a trap but he set it free.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka bayaku nalit-ag din e piru miglekaan din ded.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egteil iling te uras wey ke pitsa te eggimuwen wey ke bali te minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you set something such as the time or date of an event, or the price of something, you decide what the time, date or price will be.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We haven't set a date for the wedding yet.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè ki rè due pad migteil te pitsa te kasal.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is set, someone has already decided it, and you can't change it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a set price for that thing, so the shop assistant will not change it if you ask.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Eggimu te tamanan ne keilangan ne eg-umeen [eg-ume͡en] te minsan hentew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you set something such as a standard or a record, you make a level that other people need to reach.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She sets high standards for her students.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggimu sikandin te malayat ne tamanan para te istudyanti rin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The runner set a new world record.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egtahù te igbeye-beyè diyè te nateil ne egkatahuan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you set a machine, you put the controls in a particular position.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She set the volume on the radio to level 8.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you set a job for someone, you say that they need to do that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our teacher sets a lot of homework.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something soft sets, it becomes harder.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When candle wax is hot, it becomes liquid. When it cools it sets again.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The doctor put wet plaster bandages on my arm, and they set so that they were hard.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If the sun or moon sets, it moves below the horizon.

entries.summary: egpeeneng-eneng; eggimeley; egsanggel; eggendiyè te inged wey diyad e eg-ugpè; eggusey eyew egkasanggel ka apulaney wey ke ehetayey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as dust or a bird settles somewhere, it stops moving and rests in a place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A bird settled on the fence.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: After the truck passed by, the dust from the road slowly settled.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggendiyè te inged wey diyad e eg-ugpè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people settle in a place, they move there to live.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We are going to leave our town and settle in another area.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eg-awè key e te lungsud ney wey diyè key e eg-ugpè te lein ne lugar.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggusey eyew egkasanggel ka apulaney wey ke ehetayey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people settle an argument, they fix the problem so that they stop fighting.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The two men settled their disagreement and are now working together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The teacher settled the fight between the two students.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egsulbad te prublima wey ke egtabaken ka insè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something settles a problem or question, they fix the problem or answer the question.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His good answer settled my question.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka meupiya ne tabak din nakapeimpus te insè ku.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbayad te utang ne keilangan ne egbayaran

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you settle a bill or debt, you pay the money that you need to pay.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He settled all his debts before he went home.

entries.summary: masulug; kasuluhan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use several with a countable noun to talk about a number of things.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbebeli sikandin te masulug ne tebesal.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Several of my friends visited me when I was sick.

entries.summary: amana
egpaneyì
lukes wey ke malitan; peg-abirey; peggilabetey; peg-iyutey; due kalabetan te peg-paabirey, pegpeyilabetey, wey pegpei-yutey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The sex of a person or animal is the fact that they are either male or female.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekey-a ka batè, lukes wey ke malitan?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We don't care which sex our baby is.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action between a male and a female which can produce children (have_sex).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due kalabetan te peg-paabirey, pegpeyilabetey, wey pegpei-yutey

entries.summary: suman-suman te etew ne ka malitan kenè ne meupiya te lukes wey ke kenè egpekeyimu ka malitan te egkeyimu te lukes.; suman-suman ne kenè egpekeg-iling ka keupiya te lukes wey malitan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: suman-suman te etew ne ka malitan kenè ne meupiya te lukes wey ke kenè egpekeyimu ka malitan te egkeyimu te lukes.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A sexist person thinks that one sex (usually females) is not as good as the other sex, or that they shouldn't be able to do something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is sexist because he believes that women are not intelligent.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ne mapalintutuu sikandin su egsuman-suman sikandin ne ka me malitan kenè ne matagseb.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: suman-suman ne kenè egpekeg-iling ka keupiya te lukes wey malitan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the thinking that one sex is not as good as the other sex.

entries.summary: meelung [me͡elung]
alung

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an area of darkness behind something that is stopping the light.

entries.summary: egwelwel; pegwelwel; egkawelwel

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you shake something, you hold it in your hands and move it quickly from side to side, or up and down.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She shook the tree to make the fruit fall down.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migwelwel rin ka kayu eyew egkengeulug ka behas.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She gave the tree a shake.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something shakes, it makes very small, quick movements from side to side or up and down.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The walls shake when a very big truck passes our house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nawelwel ka me alabat te miglihad ka dakdakel ne terak te baley ney.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you shake, your body moves makes many small, quick movements, maybe because you are cold or weak.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You are shaking, so you need to wear a jacket.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkelkelen ka, sika ka keilangan ne egsaluub ka te diyakit.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something shakes you, it causes you to feel very surprised and upset.

entries.summary: nakamaan-maan; nakamanu-manu; napalpalanan; naalimukawan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are shaken, you are very surprised and upset about something.

entries.summary: Egkahamit seini ke eglalag ka te egginguma pad ne timpu.; Egkahamit seini ke due igpeyimu nu te senge etew; Eggamit ka kayi ke eg-insè ka diyè te duma te igkeupii nu ne eggimuwen.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini ke eglalag ka te egginguma pad ne timpu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If I say that I shall or we shall do something, I am talking about the future (but will is more common).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I shall tell you the answer tomorrow.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egnangenan ku sikeykew te tabak kaaselem.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini ke due igpeyimu nu te senge etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use shall to say what people must do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: All students shall wear the uniform.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka langun ne istudyanti egsaluub te unipurmi.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Eggamit ka kayi ke eg-insè ka diyè te duma te igkeupii nu ne eggimuwen.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use shall to ask what your hearer wants.

entries.summary: makeung; mababew
hilew
pegkeyimu; klasiyan te me ula-ula te minsan nekey; eggimuwen te nateil ne ula-ula

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The shape of something is the line that you could draw around it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her face is a pretty shape.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Meupiya ne pegkeyimu ka ula-ula rin.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: klasiyan te me ula-ula te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an area with a line around it (e.g., triangle, circle, square).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The child is drawing different shapes on the paper.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you shape something, you cause it to be a particular shape.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He shaped the wood with a bolo.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Inggimu rin ka kayu ne iling te ugpit.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something shapes a person or thing, they affect what that person or thing becomes.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ginikanan egpakabehey te kabalbalawan te umul te me anak dan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His experiences abroad shaped his ideas.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is_shaped like something, that is its shape.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her face is shaped like a heart.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Hendue te pusung ka ula-ula rin.

entries.summary: egtalad; egpasaamuley; egpekeg-iling

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you share something with someone, you give part of it to them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He shared his lunch with me, because I didn't have any.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtalaran a nikandin te paniudtu rin, su warad iya keddì.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two or more people share something, they both/all use it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My sisters and I share a bedroom.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpalemungey key rè te atebey ku te hibatanan ney ne sinabeng.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My sisters and I share a bike.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sikeddì wey ka atebey ku ka kamuney te bayik.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two or more people share a characteristic, they are similar in that way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother and father share a love of singing.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka iney wey amey ku nekeg-iling ne due geyinawa te pegkanta.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A share of something is a part of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She gave me a share of the rice.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Imbehayan a nikandin te baad te hemey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you share something with someone, or share about something, you speak about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He shared his story with me.

entries.summary: mahalang; liliddusi; dakel wey sahuhunè ne egkabalbalawan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something with an edge (such as a knife) is sharp, the edge of it is very thin, and cuts easily

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something pointed (such as a needle) is sharp, the point is very thin, and can go into things easily.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a change of direction (up, down, left or right) is sharp, it is a big and sudden change.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The road is dangerous because there are many sharp corners.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Dilikadu ka kelesedda su due masalig ne dakel wey sahuhunè ne pegbalewbalew te me nasiku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was a sharp increase in the number of crimes last year.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due dakel wey sahuhunè ne pegbalew-balew kasulug te me krimin seeyè se miglihad ne tuig.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an image is sharp, it is very clear and easy to see.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That photo is very sharp, so I can see everything clearly.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sika ne litratu su amana ne mating-ew, sika ka egkita ku ka langun egkaay-ayari.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: palinneu te musika egpasabut te keilangan ne egparibabew ka te kasabeka

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a symbol in music which means that you should play a note one step higher. Symbol: #

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: matikang pad te keilangan ne dahing ne egkuen (meyinged te musika)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a musical sound is sharp, it sounds higher than it should be.

entries.summary: gihalangan
panumpè
sikandin; nikandin; din; rin (igsubal te ngaran te malitan)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sikandin; nikandin; din; rin (igsubal te ngaran te malitan)

entries.summary: karniru

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a kind of animal with thick, heavy hair (wool).

entries.summary: tapiranan te me libru.
eg-aput; ugpaan; baley; sulung; nakapangabang ne minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you shelter in a place, you go there so that the weather or danger will not reach you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When the storm started, we sheltered in a cave.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something (natural or man-made) which covers you, so that the weather or danger will not reach you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A puruk is a kind of shelter.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the protection which something gives you so that the weather or danger will not reach you (take_shelter)

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Your roof gives you shelter from rain.

entries.summary: talagtameng te karniru

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who cares for sheep.

entries.summary: kalasag
eggalin; eggalinen ka minsan nekey; peggalin

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something shifts, they move from one place to another.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The wind has shifted, so now it's coming from the west.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My sister shifted to a new house last month, because the old house was burned.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you shift something, you move it from one place to another.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He shifted the books to the other table.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggalin din ka me libru diyè te lein ne lamisa.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action of moving or changing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There has been a shift in people's thinking, so now many people agree with him.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a place of work is open for many hours each day, a shift is the time when a particular group of people work (e.g., morning shift, night shift).

entries.summary: lulud
layag
unturanan (ne eggampung wey diyè egbayè te dahat); barku; egpapeendiyè [egpape͡endiyè]; egpeuyan; egparulung

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: unturanan (ne eggampung wey diyè egbayè te dahat); barku

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a very large boat which travels on the sea, and carries people or things.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you ship something to a place, you send it there by some kind of transport, such as ship or truck.

entries.summary: kumbalè
natingkemed te naaldek.
sapatus

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you wear on your foot to protect your foot when you walk.

entries.summary: egtimbak wey ke egpanè; egpanè; egpangimu te salida wey litratu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you shoot an animal or person, you send a bullet from a gun, or an arrow from a bow into their body.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He shot the pig with his gun.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtimbak din ka babuy te sinapang din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you shoot photographs or a film, you use a camera or video camera to record things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They are shooting a movie in our town.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggendiyè te nateil ne eggendiyaan te meiyal

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something shoots to a certain place or position, they move to that place or position very quickly.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The hungry dog shot to the kitchen when I called him.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka eggutasan ne asu iiyali ne miggendiye te kusina te peg-umew ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a new part growing out of a plant.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This plant has many new shoots.

entries.summary: baley ne due me belegyè; tindaan [tinda͡an]; egpameli; egbebeli

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: baley ne due me belegyè; tindaan [tinda͡an]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a place where you buy things.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you shop, you buy things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I am shopping for a birthday gift for my brother.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpameli a te dasag te aldew ne neetawan te suled ku.

entries.summary: ilis te weyig

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the place where the water meets the land.

entries.summary: malibutut; malepet; deisek wey ke malepet (meyitenged te timpu); dagdahew rè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is short, then they are not very tall.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is short, then it is not very long from one end to the other (e.g., a short piece of string, short hair).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: deisek wey ke malepet (meyitenged te timpu); dagdahew rè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If time is short, then there is not much time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We have only lived here for a short time; just a few months.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are short of something, you don't have enough of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: So many people came to the lunch that they ran short of food.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are ten of us, but only 8 cups, so we are two cups short.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè eglalag te malayat su due igkeepes din

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is short with you, they don't say many words, and speak in an unfriendly way, because they are angry about something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our aunt was very short with us when we arrived home, because we were late.

entries.summary: betu; panè; litratu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of shoot

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action of shooting with a gun or arrow

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I heard a shot from the other side of the mountain.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakarineg a te betu puun diyè limang te bubungan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That's a nice shot of your house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Meupiya sika ne litratu te baley nu.

entries.summary: eleg iya; Egkahamit seini ke eglalag ka te pangitabù ne egkeyitabù ke warè prublima.; ke

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you should do something, it is right and good for you to do that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You should brush your teeth after meals.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eleg ne eglinisan nu ka ngipen nu pegke-impus nu te egkeen.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini ke eglalag ka te pangitabù ne egkeyitabù ke warè prublima.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you say that something should happen, it will probably happen, if there are no problems. If you say that something should be the case now, it is probably the case, if there are no problems.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They should arrive at about 5pm, if the traffic is not bad.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpekeyinguma sikandan te me alas singku, ke ka trapiku kenè ne subla.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She should be at the house now

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Diyad e kuntee sikandin te baley.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use should to talk about something that may happen. Similar to if.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Should you arrive early, just sit in the waiting room [= If you arrive early...]

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke egpekeyinguma ka te seselemi, pinpinnuu ke pa diyè te egtetaharan ne sinabeng.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: perem (meyitenged te keilangan ne eggimuwen piru nanlihad e)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you say that something should_have happened, you are unhappy because it didn't happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's raining. I should have brought an umbrella!

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eg-uran e seini. Mig-uyan ku la perem ka payung ku!

entries.summary: pamanayen; eg-angken; malig-et ne tanè ne diyè te ilis te kelesadda

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the part of your body where your arm meets the top of your body.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you shoulder something such as a responsibility, you say that you are the one who did something, or will do something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She shouldered the blame for the accident.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-angken din ka me pegbasul te aksidinti.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He shouldered the responsibility for finishing the job.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: malig-et ne tanè ne diyè te ilis te kelesadda

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the narrow area of land at the side of a road.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When the truck passed, the tricycle moved onto the road shoulder.

entries.summary: egkuleyì; egbalukan; egderekul; kuleyì; balukan; dekul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you shout, you use your voice very loudly, maybe because you are speaking to someone far away, or because you are angry.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You don't need to shout at me, I can hear you.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè keilangan ne egkuleyian a nikeykew, egpakarineg a kuna.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I heard shouts from the people as they watched the horse fighting.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakarineg a te kuleyì puun te me etew te pegtengteng te egpegbuteng te kuddè.

entries.summary: egpakita; egkakita; egpakakita; egpakanengneng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you show something to someone, or show someone something, you cause them to look at it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She showed me her new T-shirt.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something shows (e.g., your feeling, or a part of your body), people can see it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She was very sad, and it showed in her eyes.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her toes show when she wears those shoes.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something shows something, people can see or know that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She showed no emotion when I told her the news.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her open shoes showed her toes.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Research shows that too much salt is bad for blood pressure.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a time of entertainment which you watch or listen to (e.g. a variety concert, a TV or radio program).

entries.summary: taligsik

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past participle of show. You can also use showed.

entries.summary: eglekeban, egsupaan; egkalekeban, egkasupaan; nalekeban, nasupaan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you close something, you move part of it so that you can't go into it, see into it, or take something out of it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something closes, part of it moves so that you can't go into it, see into it, or take something out of it (e.g., a door).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is shut, you can't go into it, see into it, or take anything out of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The box is shut. Don't try to open it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The windows are all shut, so there is not much fresh air in the room.

entries.summary: due dalu; dalu; pegpandaralu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are sick, your health is bad because you have a problem inside your body

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a problem which causes a person to have bad health

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a lot of sickness in my village at the moment [It means that many people are sick].

entries.summary: kilid; lenged; ilis

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an area between the top and bottom of something such as a house or a door. Or the part of the body under the arm, between the shoulder and legs.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a part of something which is not in the middle (e.g., the right side, the north side).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She lives on the south side of the village.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-ugpè sikandin te lenged te balabahan diyè te bariyu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the area which is next to something (e.g., the side of the road)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sabeka ne punduk te daruwa ne manggalaway wey ke egpeehetey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one of the two groups playing a game or fighting.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My son was on the winning side in the basketball game today.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka anak ku ne lukes diyè kuntee sikandin te egdeeg ne punduk te egpambubula.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one of the parts of a person or situation that is different from other parts

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is good to live near water, but there is also a bad side: floods can damage your house and garden.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Meupiya ne eg-ugpè diyè te marani te weyig, piru due degma lein ne baad ne mareet: ke egbaggiyu egkareetan degma ka baley wey me pinamula ne gulay.

entries.summary: pegpakakita; egpakakita; pegkakita; egkiteen ne minsan nekey

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My grandmother has lost her sight, so she is blind.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenad egpakakita ka apu ku, su nabutud e sikandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: At the sight of her father, she started crying.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te pegkakita rin te amey rin, migbunsud e migsinehew sikandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The playing children are a lovely sight.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka egmanggehalew ne me batè meupiya ne egpitawen.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you sight something, you see it, often by coming closer to it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The searchers finally sighted the lost child.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakite e te egmamitew ka batè ne nalaag.

entries.summary: palinneu; manipis wey mapatag ne insulatan te me lalag ne me kanengnengan; palinneu ne due nateil ne igpasabut

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is a sign of another thing, it shows that the other thing is there or is coming.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Very hot weather is a sign that a storm is coming.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka iiniti ne timpu iyan palinneu te eggingume e ka bagyu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: manipis wey mapatag ne insulatan te me lalag ne me kanengnengan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a flat thing with words or numbers on it for people to read.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The school has a large sign at the front.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an] due dakel wey maluag ne insulatan te me kanengnengan diyè te katangkaan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: palinneu ne due nateil ne igpasabut

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action or mark which has a special meaning (e.g., a dollar sign: $).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She made a sign with her hand to tell me to stop.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbehey te palinneu pinaahi te belad; egsingyas te belad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you sign to someone, you communicate something to them using your hands.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She signed to me to stop.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbehey sikandin te palinneu ne egpasanggelen a.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egsulat te ngaran diyè te sinulat wey ke dukumintu; egpirma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you sign a letter or document, or sign your name, you write your name on the letter or document.

entries.summary: tingyas; singyas; egtingyas; egsingyas; signal

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a sound or action which communicates a particular message.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When I wave my hand, that will be the signal for you to stand up.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you signal to someone, you do an action to communicate a message.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She signalled to me with her hand to tell me to stop.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: waves by which electrical information is sent (e.g. a cellphone signal).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can't use my cellphone here, because there is no signal.

entries.summary: pirma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the special way that you write your name.

entries.summary: impurtanti; due nateil ne igpasabut; pegkaimputanti

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In the Philippines, a man's twenty-first birthday is a significant birthday.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kayi te Pilipinas ka igka daruwan pulù wey sabekan tuig te lukes su amanan impurtanti.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something significant has a particular meaning.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The decorations on a soldier's clothes are significant, because they show his position in the army.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What is the significance of the flags there: what do they mean?

entries.summary: egpataha; egpakita; egpasabut

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something signifies another thing, it shows that the other thing is true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The fact that he is eating something signifies that he is feeling better.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegkeen din su egpakita ne meupiya ka peggeram-geram din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something signifies another thing, it is a symbol of that other thing, so that you understand it to mean the same as the other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In my picture, these green circles signify trees.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te seini ne litratu, ka me seini se meilem egpasabut te me kayu.

entries.summary: warè gulug

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the state of having no noise.

entries.summary: warè gulug
egpekeg-iling; pegpekeg-iling; pegsupu; pegpekeg-iling-iling

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing is similar to another, they have at least one feature the same about them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My son is very similar to my husband.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka anak ku amana nekeg-iling te asawa ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was surprised at the similarity between the two children.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a lot of similarity between my son and my husband.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a thing that is similar about two things or people.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are many similarities between my son and my husband.

entries.summary: me lalag ne egkahi te ka sabeka ne butang nekeg-iling ded te sabeka ne butang

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me lalag ne egkahi te ka sabeka ne butang nekeg-iling ded te sabeka ne butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of words which say that one thing is the same as another thing. You use like or as.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Your hands are as cold as ice.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me belad nu iling kaagsil [ka͡agsil] te ayis.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her tears fell like rain when she heard the news. [she cried a lot].

entries.summary: malemu; masayun; kenè ne masalig se baad; 1 pegkamalemu; 2 kenè ne masalig se baad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is simple, it is easy to understand or do

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That's a simple problem to fix.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Malemu rè sika ne prublima ne egsulbaren.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something simple does not have many or complex parts.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was a very simple pattern on the cloth

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's a very simple machine, with just three main parts.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegkamalemu; 2 kenè ne masalig se baad

entries.summary: salè; mareet ne batasan peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te Manama, wey ka mareet ne eg-ul-uleen [eg-ul-ule͡en]; egpakasalè; mareet (meyitenged te himu wey batasan te etew)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: salè; mareet ne batasan peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te Manama, wey ka mareet ne eg-ul-uleen [eg-ul-ule͡en]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a bad attitude towards God, and the bad actions which come from this (commit_sin).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you sin, you think, say or do something bad.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mareet (meyitenged te himu wey batasan te etew)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A sinful action or attitude is bad. A sinful person is someone who sins.

entries.summary: ligkat pad; puun pad (meyitenged te sasangan pad ne egkeyitabù); ligkat...pad; puun pad (meyitenged te miglihad ne neyitabù ne sasangan pad); su; tenged te

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ligkat pad; puun pad (meyitenged te sasangan pad ne egkeyitabù)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use since when you give the starting time of an action that continues to now.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Alas sayis pad ne migbunsud ad ka miggipanew ne taman e kuntee.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We haven't liked them ever since.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè key neupiì kandan ligkat pad dengan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ligkat...pad; puun pad (meyitenged te miglihad ne neyitabù ne sasangan pad)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use not_since when you talk about the last time before now that something happened.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I haven't seen her since yesterday.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Wara a nakakita kandin puun pad gabii.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use since to talk about the reason for something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Since you don't want to know, I'm not going to tell you.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Tenged te kenè ke ma egkeupian ne egpakataha, kena a egpanugtul kuna.

entries.summary: eg-ulahing

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you sing, you make music with your voice.

entries.summary: sabeka rè; para rè te sabeka ne etew; warè pad nakaasawa; mengebay wey ke kanakan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use single to say that there is only one.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The house has a single window, which is next to the front door.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: para rè te sabeka ne etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a room or a bed is single, it is made for one person.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He had a single room in the hospital.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: warè pad nakaasawa; mengebay wey ke kanakan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are single, you are not married.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use not_a_single to say strongly that there are none.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I didn't see a single bird in the forest.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Wara ad iya nakakita te minsan sabeka rè ne bayaku diyè te katalunan.

entries.summary: Eggamit ka kayi ke eglalag ka te sabeka rè ne etew wey ke kasangkapan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Eggamit ka kayi ke eglalag ka te sabeka rè ne etew wey ke kasangkapan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A singular word is about just one person or thing.

entries.summary: tanled
sir
atebey ne malitan.; madri; malitan ne nars ne egdumalè te nateil ne lugar wey ke sinabeng diyè te uspital.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your sister is a female with the same mother and father as you.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a Catholic nun (a single woman who is part of a particular group).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: malitan ne nars ne egdumalè te nateil ne lugar wey ke sinabeng diyè te uspital.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a female nurse who is the manager of a particular area or room in a hospital.

entries.summary: egpinnuu; nakapinnuu; nekeuugpè; nakatatahù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you sit, or sit_down, you move from standing to sitting. If you sit_up, you move from lying to sitting.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or animal is_sitting, their legs are bent, and their buttocks are resting on something (e.g., a seat).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something sits somewhere, it is there in that place, and is not moving or doing anything.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We have a radio, but it is broken, so it just sits on the table.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due radyu ney, piru nareetan, sika ka nakatatahù dè seini diyè te lamisa.

entries.summary: lugar; lukib diyè te Intirnit ne eglukatan pinaahi te nateil ne igmanahù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a place where something (e.g., a building) is, was or will be.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We found the perfect site for the new building.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakakita key e te eleg ne lugar para te iyam ne dakel ne baley.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: lukib diyè te Intirnit ne eglukatan pinaahi te nateil ne igmanahù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A site (or website) is a page or group of pages on the Internet which you open by typing a particular web address.

entries.summary: sitwasyun; keugpè; keyimtang (meyitenged te pangitabù te nateil ne timpu); natahuan; neugpaan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sitwasyun; keugpè; keyimtang (meyitenged te pangitabù te nateil ne timpu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: what is happening somewhere at a particular time.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The situation of a place or building is the place where it is and the things that are around it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That house has a beautiful situation near the river.

entries.summary: karakelan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the size of something is how big it is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What size tsinillas do you wear?

entries.summary: katuenan te peggimu te minsan nekey; nateil ne pamaahi ne natuenan ke egmenuwen te egpangimu ka minsan nekey.; mateu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: katuenan te peggimu te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the ability to do something well.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She plays the salurey with great skill.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nateil ne pamaahi ne natuenan ke egmenuwen te egpangimu ka minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a particular thing that you can learn how to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother has taught me a lot of skills, such as sorting rice, preparing meat and growing vegetables.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person is skillful, they do something very well. If an action is skillful, it is done very well.

entries.summary: laplap
saya
langit; hawhawanan; aw-awangan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the area above the surface of the earth, where you can see clouds.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The sky is very blue today.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka langit amana ne meilem kuntee.

entries.summary: uripen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: someone who is owned by another person, and has to work for them.

entries.summary: lipereng; eglipereng; peglipereng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a state in which a person or animal is resting, with their eyes closed and their mind not thinking.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He likes to have 8 hours of sleep every night.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian sikandin te due walu ne uras ne lipereng tagsè marusiem.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or animal sleeps, they rest with their eyes closed and mind not thinking.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I had a good sleep last night.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due meupiya ne peglipereng ku gabii.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm tired this afternoon, so I need to have a sleep.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a place sleeps a certain number of people, that many people can stay there.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini ne sinabeng egkaliperengan te walu ne etawan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the material in the corner of your eyes after you sleep.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You have sleep in your eyes.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of sleep

entries.summary: eglulurey
deisek; kenè dè amana; deisek wey mahasè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something slight is small (e.g., a slight difference).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was only a slight change.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A slight person is small and thin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother is very slight, but her sons are big.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka iney ku amana ne deisek, piru ka me anak din ne me lukes derakel.

entries.summary: egpakalurek
malurek
masandig
malambened; meyimulung; meyinay; egmeyimulung; due kalambeneran (puun te kenè ne masalig ka egkeyitabù)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something is slow, they take a long time to do something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a very slow worker

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something slows, or slows down, it becomes more slow.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Suddenly the bus slowed as it passed the group of people.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due kalambeneran (puun te kenè ne masalig ka egkeyitabù)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a place or activity is slow, not many things happen, so it is not very busy or interesting.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He finds the small town a little slow.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Diyè te kandin due kalambeneran te deisek ne lungsud.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Business was very slow at the shop this morning. There were only three customers.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A slow person is not very intelligent.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a clock is slow, it shows a time later than the real time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My watch is about 10 minutes slow. It says 10:50, but it's really 11 o'clock.

entries.summary: deisek; malintek
ngareg; egngareg te nateil ne ngareg; eggarek (meyitenged te ngareg); egpakaharek

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the smell of something is what it is like for your nose.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I love the smell of fresh bread.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian a te ngareg te iyam ne paan [pa͡an].

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something smells a certain way, that is what it is like for your nose.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you can_smell something, you know that it is there because your nose tells you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can smell smoke. Is there a fire nearby?

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggarekan (eyew te pegnengneng te ngareg te minsan nekey)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you smell something, you put your nose near it and breathe in.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She picked the flower and smelled it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of smell. You can also use smelled.

entries.summary: eggimun-gimun; peggimun-gimun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you smile, you move the corners of your mouth up, usually because you have good feelings, or because you want to be friendly (smile_at someone).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an expression on your face where the corners of your mouth are turned up.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She had a big smile on her face.

entries.summary: ebel; egpanihupan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the material in the air which fire produces.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you smoke, you use cigarettes.

entries.summary: marampal; masinaw; egpasinaw; egparampal; warè prublima (meyitenged te minsan nekey)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a surface is smooth, it is very even, so that your fingers can move easily and quickly across it (e.g., glass).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you smooth something, you cause it to be smooth (sense 1).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She smoothed her hair with her hands before she went into the house.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is smooth, there are no problems.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The sports day went very smoothly, with no accidents.

entries.summary: uled
migkehal ne inuwang te weyig ne neneulug puun diyè te aw-awangan ne dereisek wey memewumel.; eg-uran te ingkehal ne inuwang te weyig ne memewumel

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: migkehal ne inuwang te weyig ne neneulug puun diyè te aw-awangan ne dereisek wey memewumel.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: frozen water vapor that falls from the sky in small, soft pieces.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-uran te ingkehal ne inuwang te weyig ne memewumel

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: When soft pieces of frozen water vapor are falling from the sky, it is snowing.

entries.summary: sika naa; amana; wey...degma; wey minsan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use so to say that something happens or is true because of another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I didn't have breakfast, so I'm hungry.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Wara a miglem-ag, sika naa ka eggutasan a.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use so to say that something is the same as another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She can write and so can I.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkahamit seini ke kenad egliberen ka nalalag e ne lalag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use so to say something again, but another way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She told me to go home, and I did so.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migkahi sikandin te egpeulien a, wey miggimu ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Q: Did she get the job? A: I think so.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A: Maybe it will be sunny tomorrow. B: I hope so.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use so_that to talk about the reason why someone does something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She fed the baby so that it would stop crying.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impakeen din ka batè su eyew eg-engked e ka egsinehew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use so...that to show how strong, big or important something is, because you can see the result.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was so tired that I fell asleep very quickly.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana a nabeley sikan naa ka mahaan e rè nakalipereng.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use so_on if there are more things to say about something, but you don't want to say them all.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: To make biku, you prepare the coconut, cut up the ginger, cook the rice and so on.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te peggimu te biku, eg-andamen nu ka niyug, egkalaren ka luya, eggilutuen ka behas wey duma pad.

entries.summary: sebun

due kalabetan te pegbehey te uras eyew te peg-alukuy wey te pegpalallalahey te duma ne me etew.; keilangan ne eg-ugpè wey ke egbehey te panahun te peg-alukuy te duma (meyitenged te etew wey mananap).; due kalabetan te kumunidad te me keet-etawan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due kalabetan te pegbehey te uras eyew te peg-alukuy wey te pegpalallalahey te duma ne me etew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something social is related to people spending time together and talking.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There were many social times during the holidays, because people were free.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That child doesn't have very good social skills, as he always fights with other children.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: keilangan ne eg-ugpè wey ke egbehey te panahun te peg-alukuy te duma (meyitenged te etew wey mananap).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A social person or animal needs to live or spend time with others.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Bees are social animals who live in large communities.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due kalabetan te kumunidad te me keet-etawan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something social is related to communities of people (e.g., social problems, social structure).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Drugs are a big social problem in some communities.

entries.summary: keet-etawan; me etew ne mig-ugpè te nateil ne timpu te guhuren wey inged; me etew ne mabagget te sabeka ne himuwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: all humans in general, as a group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Violent criminals are a danger to society.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me etew ne mig-ugpè te nateil ne timpu te guhuren wey inged

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the people who live in an area at a particular time in history, and the way that they live (e.g., modern Matigsalug society, ancient Egyptian society).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me etew ne mabagget te sabeka ne himuwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an organized group of people who are all interested in a particular thing (e.g., a musical society, a dance society).

entries.summary: midyas
mewumel; mahebù; malurung-lurung wey malurek-lurek; kenè ne marahing

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is soft, it changes shape easily when you touch it (e.g., a soft pillow, a ripe mango).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as skin or hair is soft, it is good to touch because it smooth and moves easily.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A soft sound is not loud

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A soft light is not strong and bright.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: amana ne buutan, wey kenè egkeupian ne egpakapasakit te lein ne etew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A soft person is very kind, and doesn't like to hurt people.

entries.summary: tanè; eglinditan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the material which the ground is made of. Plants can grow in it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you soil something, you cause it to become dirty.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of sell

entries.summary: sundalu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who fights in an army.

entries.summary: igdiek
makehal; minsan nekey ne due ula-ula ne kenè egkabalbalawan egkaha-gaani; ware lungag diyè te taliwarè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something solid is not like a liquid or gas, because it has a shape which does not change easily.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: New babies can't eat solid food, only milk.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne due ula-ula ne kenè egkabalbalawan egkaha-gaani

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which has a shape that does not change easily.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something solid has no space in the middle of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Hollow blocks are not solid, because they are empty in the middle.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something solid doesn't have other things mixed in with it (e.g., solid gold).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That ring is made of solid gold.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something solid is strong and heavy, and will not break easily.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The bench is very solid, so many people can sit on it.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegkamakehal wey ke pegkarue ula-ula; 5 pegkamakehal wey pegkamabehat

entries.summary: kasulbaran; sinuweg te daruwa wey ke masalig ne sabstansis

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the solution to a problem is the thing that can fix the problem.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sinuweg te daruwa wey ke masalig ne sabstansis

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a mixture of two or more substances.

entries.summary: egsulbad
Egkahamit seini ke egguhud ka meyitenged te karakelan ne warè nataheyi ke kamenu.; ka duma; due (meyitenged te warè nataheyi wey ke neileyi)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini ke egguhud ka meyitenged te karakelan ne warè nataheyi ke kamenu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a general number or amount (not specific).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is some water in my glass.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Duen pad weyig te basu ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: part of a group or amount (not all).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Some of my friends don't like corn.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka duma ne alukuy ku kenè egkeupian te aheley.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due (meyitenged te warè nataheyi wey ke neileyi)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use some about a person or thing if you don't know exactly who or what.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Some man came to the house selling fruit.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due etew ne nekeyinguma diyè te baley ne egbebelegyè te prutas.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There were some seventy people at the wedding.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due me pitun pulù ne me etew ne migtambung te kasal.

entries.summary: senge etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use somebody about a person if you don't know or don't say exactly who they are.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I met somebody yesterday, but I can't remember her name.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakalambag a te senge etew gabii, piru kenè kud egkasuman-suman ka ngaran din.

entries.summary: migmemenu buwa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use somehow to say that you do not know the exact way that something happens.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our pig escaped from our place somehow.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migmemenu buwa ka babuy ne nakaligwang te lugar ney.

entries.summary: senge etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use someone about a person if you don't know or don't say exactly who they are.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Someone is going to take me on their bike, but I don't know who.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due senge etew ne egpeuntud keddì te bayik dan, piru wara a nakeila ke me hentew.

entries.summary: minsan nekey (meyitenged te kasangkapan ne kenè egngaranan); hendue te; iling te

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey (meyitenged te kasangkapan ne kenè egngaranan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use something about a thing if you don't say exactly what it is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I need to take something to eat for lunch.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan a ne egkuwa te minsan nekey eyew due egkeenen ku te paniudtu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use something_like to say that you are not giving an exact description or number

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I look something like my mother, but I am much bigger than her.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egtengtengan a ne henduen a te iney ku, piru dakel-dakel a kandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She has something like twelve cats.

entries.summary: minsan ken-u

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use sometime to talk about a time in the future or past which is not exact.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kaayun a ne egpanumbaley minsan ken-u diyè te kuna?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was born sometime in the 1960s.

entries.summary: sengekakuwa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something sometimes happens, it happens, but not always.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our dog sometimes chases our chickens, but not every week.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sengekakuwa ne ka asu ney eglupuhen ka me manuk ney, piru kenen tagsè simana.

entries.summary: minsan hendei; hendei buwa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use somewhere about a place if you don't know or don't say exactly where it is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Please put your bag somewhere and come and sit down.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Palihug itahù nu ka baag [ba͡ag] nu minsan hendei wey hendini ka wey pinnuu ka kayi.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Where is my coffee? I put it down somewhere.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Hendei ka kepi ku? Hendei ku buwa ikatahù gana sika.

entries.summary: anak ne lukes
ulahingen; kanteen [kante͡en]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a piece of music with words, which you sing.

entries.summary: mahaan e; hapit; pegkeimpus kuntee

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something will happen soon, it will happen a short time from now in the future.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I think it will rain soon, so I must go home now.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Hendue te mahaan e eg-uran, sika ka keilangan ne eg-uli ad e.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happens soon after another thing, it happens a short time after that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She said that she felt sick, and went home soon after that.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migkahi sikandin te hendue te egderalu rin, wey eg-uli din e pegkeimpus kuntee due.

entries.summary: mammulingan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: someone who uses evil spiritual power to do miracles.

entries.summary: peggamit te geem [ge͡em] te mareet ne panisingan eyew te peggimu te me kein-inuwan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peggamit te geem [ge͡em] te mareet ne panisingan eyew te peggimu te me kein-inuwan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of using evil spiritual power to do miracles.

entries.summary: kammuhè
kalangaan
pegbuyù te pasaylu.
sabeka ne karumaan [karuma͡an] te punduk ne due pegpekeg-iling; klasiyan; egteilen; egtapiren; bayew

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sabeka ne karumaan [karuma͡an] te punduk ne due pegpekeg-iling; klasiyan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one of the members of a group of similar people or things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There were many different sorts of birds in the forest.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Wheat is a sort of grain.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you sort things into groups, or into a particular order, you organize them like that.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Please sort the clothes into piles, one for each person.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He sorted the words into alphabetical order.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use sort_of to say that something is not exactly the case.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She has sort of finished, but there are still a few things to do.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Bayew e nekeimpus sikandin, piru duen pad deisek naan dè ne eggimuwen din.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can sort of play the piano, but only a few easy songs.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can't easily describe the colour, but it's sort of pink.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of seek

entries.summary: gimukud

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the part of a person which can't be seen. It is the part that thinks and feels.

entries.summary: dahing; egdahing; egparahing

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something (e.g., a bell) sounds, it produces a sound.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When a siren sounds, either police or ambulance, all traffic should move out of the way.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you sound something, you cause it to make a noise.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nateil ne klasiyan wey ke pamaahi te dahing

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something sounds a certain way, that is the kind of sound that it is.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne manekal ka laheng din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something sounds a certain way, you think it is like that because of what you hear.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You sound tired. Are you OK?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Iling te nabeley ka. Nekey kad naan e?

entries.summary: warè nareeti; warè prublima; maheteng wey matagseb; eleg iya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is sound, it is not broken or damaged, and it has no problems.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They checked the building after the landslide, and it was still sound.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My horse had a sore leg, but now the leg is sound.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is very old, but her mind is still sound.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If thinking is sound, it is good and wise.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her reasons for her decision were sound.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is sound, it is very complete (e.g., sound sleep)

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our team was much stronger than the other team, so we won a sound victory.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka grupu ney amana ne makeseg du te duma ne grupu, sika ka migdeeg key iya te eleg ne pegdeeg.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She was very tired, so she fell into a sound sleep.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 nareetan; due prublima; 2 kenè ne maheteng wey kenè ne matagseb

entries.summary: sabew
maperes
puunanan; ligkatanan; eg-angayan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the place, person or thing that something comes from.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The source of this river is up in the mountains.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka egpuunan te seini ne weyig diyè te dibabew te bubungan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you source something from somewhere, you get it from that place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We source our coffee from small farms in the mountains.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka eg-angayan ney te keppi iyan ka deisek ne kamet ney diyè te bubungan.

entries.summary: balabahan ne igkakawanan ke egtangkè ki te igsilè

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
