fields.text: balabahan ne igkakawanan ke egtangkè ki te igsilè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the direction which is opposite north. If you face the rising sun, south is the direction on your right.

entries.summary: egtuwil
mulug
warè tahù; warè nekeugpè; lihawangan te kalibutan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a place which doesn't have anything there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was a space next to her at the table, so I sat there.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due warè migpinnuu diyè te kasinundulan din ne lamisa, sika ka diya a migpinnuu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the very big area outside the earth, which contains stars, other planets, etc.

entries.summary: eglalag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you speak, you say something.

entries.summary: indakelan te geyinawa; sengekuan te layun eggamita wey egkakita ne me kasangkapan; minsan nekey ne nateil dè se eggamitan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something is special to you, you love them or think they're important

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My sister is very special to me.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne ispisyal kayi te keddiey ka suled ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Christmas is a special day for my family.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ispisyal ne aldew para te pamilya ku ka Kristmas.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sengekuan te layun eggamita wey egkakita ne me kasangkapan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something special is different from usual things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This is a special dress; I only wear it on special occasions.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne nateil dè se eggamitan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something special is used for a particular purpose.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I write stories in a special book just for my stories.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Diyè ku egsulata ka guhuren te ispisyal ne libru ne sulatanan ku te guhuren ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something at a shop which is cheaper than usual.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I always look for specials when I need to buy things.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Iyan ku layun egpamitawen te egbeli ka ispisyal iya.

entries.summary: egkamelmelehi; nateil ne minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If words are specific, they talk about something very clearly and exactly.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father gave me very specific instructions about how to fix it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka amey ku migbehey te amana egkamelmelehan ne panulù ke egmenuwen te eg-upiya seini.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you talk about a specific thing, you are talking about that thing, and not other things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: On which specific day do you want to go there?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekey ka nateil ne aldew ne egkeupian ka ne eggendiyè.

entries.summary: peglalag te eleg ke nekey-a ka minsan nekey; eleg ne balaud meyitenged peggimu te minsan nekey ne himuwen

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peglalag te eleg ke nekey-a ka minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of saying exactly what something is.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eleg ne balaud meyitenged peggimu te minsan nekey ne himuwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an exact rule about how something should be made or done.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The specifications say that the new building should be 20m long.

entries.summary: eglalahen te amana egkamelmelehan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you specify something, you say exactly what it is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He said that there was a problem, but he didn't specify what it was.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migkahi sikandin te due prublima, piru warè din klaruwa ke nekey.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My boss didn't specify what I should do with the extra paper.

entries.summary: pangasak
kanekal; kakeseg

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The speed of something is how fast it is moving, or how fast it happens.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What speed was the motorbike travelling at?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekey ne kanekal te mutur te peggipanew?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was surprised at the speed with which he finished his dinner.

entries.summary: eggamiten ne seleppì eyew te pegbayad te minsan nekey; egpakahamit te timpu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggamiten ne seleppì eyew te pegbayad te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you spend money on something, you use it to pay for that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She spends a lot of money on bus travel.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you spend time doing something, you use time to do that thing.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-uugpè siakandan te daruwa ne simana kayi.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I spend a lot of time cleaning and cooking.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakahamit a te dakel ne uras te pegpanlinis wey pegsusubba.

entries.summary: nagastu; nahamit

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of spend

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is spent, there is nothing remaining because it has all been used.

entries.summary: Panisingan te Manama
panisingan; panisingan; geyinawa; due kalabetan te Manama wey me panisingan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a being without a physical body. For example, a busew is a bad spirit.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the spirit of a person is the part of them that is not physical. It is the part of them which makes them alive.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due kalabetan te Manama wey me panisingan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: related to things such as God and spirits, not to the physical world.

entries.summary: eg-ileb; ileb
minsan pad...piru

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use in_spite_of to say that one fact is not changed or affected by another fact.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In spite of loving sport, she doesn't play much now.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Minsan pad indakelan din te geyinawa ka peggehalew, piru kenad amana eggalew sikandin.

entries.summary: eggusien
silut
galew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: games with rules in which you use your body

entries.summary: tinduk; puntik; lugar; egpakakita

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her dress is blue with white spots.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kumbalè din ne meilem due maangkag ne me puntik.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The Overview is a great spot to see the mountains from.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you spot something, you see it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I spotted her running into the house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakakita a te pegpallahuy rin peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te baley.

entries.summary: egdakel wey eg-empet; egdalapdap (te hapuy); egdalanag (te weyig); pegdakel wey peg-empet; egtalagtag (meyitenged te egtahù te minsan nekey)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egdakel wey eg-empet; egdalapdap (te hapuy); egdalanag (te weyig)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: if something spreads, it becomes bigger so that it fills a larger area.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The cup fell on the ground and the coffee quickly spread over the floor.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The action of something becoming bigger and filling a larger area.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They tried to stop the spread of oil from the broken boat.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egtalagtag (meyitenged te egtahù te minsan nekey)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you spread something on another thing, you put a layer of it on the other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She spread margarine on the bread with a knife.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as news or an illness spreads, more and more people know about it or experience it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The news about the accident spread quickly.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka balita meyitenged te aksidinti mahaan nekeempet.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Illnesses can spread quickly in schools.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpangguhud wey ke egbehey diyè te masalig ne etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you spread something such as news or an illness, you tell it or give it to many people.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of something moving to many people or areas.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Hand-washing helps to stop the spread of disease.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegpanggugaas egpakabulig te pegpasanggel te pegkatag te dalu.

entries.summary: eg-umbetut; egpakalibed (amana ne iiyali ne weil); egkabekas

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or animal springs, they jump forwards or upwards.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The cat sprang at the mouse and caught it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as grass or a curl of hair springs back into a position, it very quickly returns to that position.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The child pulled her curly hair to make it straight, but it immediately sprang back into curls.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a trap springs into a position, it quickly moves into that position.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The trap sprang shut when the animal entered.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sika ne igpanggingutel te leew ne mananap egkabekas ke egkabayaan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kasangkapan ne egkanat ne malayat wey miglibusen ne butang ne eggamiten diyè te minsan nekey iling te duma ne igpanggingutel te me mananap

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a thing made of a long, thin piece of metal shaped into many circles. It is used, for example, in some traps. If you stretch it, it will return quickly into its shape.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a place where water flows out of the ground.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: timpu taliwarè te tingkalamag wey gulabung

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the season between winter and summer.

entries.summary: ula-ula ne hep-at se pikungan ne nenekeg-iling-iling se kalayat; lugar ne diyè te siyudad ne due me darakel ne baley wey ka me dalan nakalingut kayi ne ka ula-ula due hep-at ne pikungan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ula-ula ne hep-at se pikungan ne nenekeg-iling-iling se kalayat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a shape which has four straight sides which are all the same length.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: lugar ne diyè te siyudad ne due me darakel ne baley wey ka me dalan nakalingut kayi ne ka ula-ula due hep-at ne pikungan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an area in a town which has four sides, with buildings or streets around it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are seats in the square where you can sit and rest.

entries.summary: warè egweilan; warè egbalbalawan wey ke egpasanggelan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that something will not move or fall over easily.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that something will not change or stop quickly or easily.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Job stability is something which many people want to have.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè katamanan ne trabuhu ka igkeupii te masulug ne me etew.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: People who travel a lot miss the stability of staying in their own home.

entries.summary: maresen; kenè ne mahaan egkabalbalawan wey egkapeengked wey ke egkeiyam; maheteng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is stable, it will not move or fall over easily.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That table is not stable, because one leg is shorter than the others.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sika ne lamisa kenè ne maresen, su ka sabeka ne paa malepet te duma.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That small boat is very stable, so you can stand up in it easily, and it won't turn over.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is very weak after her illness, so she is not very stable when she walks.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè ne mahaan egkabalbalawan wey egkapeengked wey ke egkeiyam

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a job is stable, it will not change or stop quickly or easily. This is a good characteristic.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has had a stable job with the government for many years.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due trabahu rin te gubirnu ne kenad egkabalbalawan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The sick man's condition is now stable, so we think that he is out of danger.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A stable person has good control of their mind and emotions, and doesn't change their mood a lot.

entries.summary: baley ne kulungan te kuddè; punduk ne egpanguuyag wey egbasbas te me kuddè

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: punduk ne egpanguuyag wey egbasbas te me kuddè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an organization which raises and trains racehorses

entries.summary: me punduk te me etew ne eggimu te senge inged; eggimuwan wey egtrabahuwan te nateil ne me etew

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me punduk te me etew ne eggimu te senge inged

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The group of people who work in a place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The hospital has a large staff.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The staff are all very good.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggimuwan wey egtrabahuwan te nateil ne me etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a place is_staffed by certain people, they are the people who work there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The hospital is staffed by Filipino workers.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka uspital migtrabahuwan te me Pilipinu ne me trabaanti [traba͡anti].

entries.summary: malayat wey makehal ne kayu ne due nateil ne eggamitan iling te tuked.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: malayat wey makehal ne kayu ne due nateil ne eggamitan iling te tuked.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a long, strong stick with some special use (e.g., a walking stick)

entries.summary: senge-baad te pegkasinsinundul te weil wey pegbalewbalew; hun-aan [hun-a͡an]; tangkaan; kewun-aan (ka egsasindehan te grupu wey ke sabeka rè ne egkanta); eggimu te kalibulungan te katangenan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: senge-baad te pegkasinsinundul te weil wey pegbalewbalew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one of the steps of a series of actions or changes.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The frogs are only at the tadpole stage at the moment.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me bakbak butiti pad te kuntee ne baad.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: hun-aan [hun-a͡an]; tangkaan; kewun-aan (ka egsasindehan te grupu wey ke sabeka rè ne egkanta)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the raised part at the front of an area, where people such as singers perform for a group.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you stage a public event such as a fiesta, you cause it to happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: MLCA staged a talent night at Fiesta.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka MLCA miggimu te kalibulungan ne pegpapitawey te katuenan te pista.

entries.summary: bilu
haheran
egsasindeg; nakasasindeg (meyitenged te etew wey ke mananap); nakatahù; nakasasindeg (meyitenged te minsan nekey)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or animal stands, or stands_up, they move from a sitting or lying position to an upright position.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He stood up when I called him.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nakasasindeg (meyitenged te etew wey ke mananap)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or animal is_standing, they are upright, and their legs are straight.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are no chairs, so he is standing.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something stands somewhere, it is in that place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The house stands near the river.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka baley nakasasindeg te ilis te pahamayan ne weyig.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you stand something somewhere, you put it in that place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He stood the chair near the window.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you stand somewhere on a particular topic, that is what you think about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't agree with that idea. Where do you stand on it?

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mapahetpet ne peglalag te nasuman-suman wey warè pegbalewbalew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action of saying strongly what you think, and not changing your idea (take_a_stand, make_a_stand).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I took a stand and told him that I would not tell lies for him.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you can_stand something difficult or painful, you can continue to live with it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can't stand that noise! Please stop it!

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena a egpakahaha te kahulub! Palihug sanggela niyu!

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a small stall where you can buy something (e.g. food)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which you can put things on (e.g., a TV stand).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: maluag ne egkeugpaan diyè te galawanan ne egpaminuuwan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the place at a large sports ground where people can sit.

entries.summary: seked te keupiya te minsan nekey; minsan nekey ne egpakita ke nekey ka keilangan ne eggimuwen wey egkahamit eyew te pegtengteng te keupiya te trabahu nu.; pegtuu meyitenged te eleg wey kenè

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: seked te keupiya te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a level of quality; how good something is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The standard of his work is very high.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seked te trabahu rin amana rè ne titikangi.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Since he got a job, his family's standard of living has improved.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ligkat te nakatrabahu sikandin, ka keugpè te pamilya rin migmeupiye e.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne egpakita ke nekey ka keilangan ne eggimuwen wey egkahamit eyew te pegtengteng te keupiya te trabahu nu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which shows you what you need to do, and which is used to check the quality of your work.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This document is the standard that you need to follow when you write your project. It will tell you what you need to include, and we will use it when we check your work.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegtuu meyitenged te eleg wey kenè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an idea about what is right and wrong.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has very high moral standards, so I trust him not to steal from me.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is standard, it is usual and normal.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That is the standard price for rice at the moment.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sika ka malasi ne bali te behas te kuntee ne panahun.

entries.summary: bituen; mabantug ne etew diyè te galew wey ke diyè te kaalayan; eg-uyan te salida wey ke diyè te prugrama te tibi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a ball of very hot gases in space. The sun is a star.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mabantug ne etew diyè te galew wey ke diyè te kaalayan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a famous person in sport or entertainment

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-uyan te salida wey ke diyè te prugrama te tibi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an actor stars in a movie, play or TV program, they act in that movie, play or program.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka salida, prugrama te tibi ka seini se nateil ne etew ka eg-uyan kayi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a movie, play or TV program stars a particular actor, that person acts in it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sika ne salida si Will Smith ka mig-uyan.

entries.summary: egbunsud; egsugud; egpabunsud; egpasugud; egparahing

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something starts to do something, or starts doing something, they do something that they were not doing before. If something starts, it happens or exists, when it didn't happen or exist before.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbunsud ka miting te alas siyiti te marusilem.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbunsud ka seini ne urganisasyun te 1993.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you start something, you cause it to start to happen or exist.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you start a machine, you cause it to begin working.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was late, so he missed the start of the meeting.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Namewuri sikandin, purisu warad sikandin nekeuma te bunsuranan te miting.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you start, you suddenly jump or move your body, because you are surprised by something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She started when the firecracker exploded.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a sudden jump or movement of your body because you are surprised by something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She turned around with a start when the firecracker exploded.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakabalikid sikandin te pegkakignat te migbetu ka bintedur.

entries.summary: sitwasyun; egkahi; lalahen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The state of someone or something is what they are like at a particular time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What state was the house in after the fire?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekey ka sitwasyun te baley pegkeimpus ne nasilaban.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She was in a state of shock after the fire.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you state something, or state that something is true, you say it (often clearly or in a formal way).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She stated that she didn't like the plan.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migkahi sikandin te warè din ikeupii ka planu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This letter states that I have passed my exam.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you say, often clearly or in a formal way (make_a_statement).

entries.summary: inged ne due kandin ne peg-uyan wey ke pegdumalè; panggubirnu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: inged ne due kandin ne peg-uyan wey ke pegdumalè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an area which has its own independent government. It may be a country, or a part of a country such as the United States.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The state is the government of a country.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In some countries, the state requires all males to join the army for some time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I attend a state high school, not a private school.

entries.summary: lugar ne due nateil ne katuyuan (iling te gasulinaan [gasulina͡an]); upisina te grupu (iling te pulis wey ke talag-ebuk te hapuy); lugar ne sanggelanan te me unturanan (iling te batsilur, trin)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: lugar ne due nateil ne katuyuan (iling te gasulinaan [gasulina͡an])

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a place with a special purpose (e.g., a gasoline station).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: upisina te grupu (iling te pulis wey ke talag-ebuk te hapuy)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the office of a group such as the police or firefighters.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The police took the criminals to the police station.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: lugar ne sanggelanan te me unturanan (iling te batsilur, trin)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a large place where public transport stops (e.g., bus station, train station).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sengebaad ne paminehanan te radyu wey tengtenganan te tibi.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We didn't like the program, so we changed to a different station.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egsuhù te pegpasasindeg diyè te nateil ne lugar

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you station someone somewhere, you tell them that they must stand there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The officer stationed police all around the building.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka due katenged ne pulis migsuhù te pegpasasindeg te me pulis palibut te baley.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the place where someone stands because someone told them to stand there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The soldier stayed at his station, even though it was raining.

entries.summary: me numiru ne egpakita te kanengnengan impus te peglibulung; ka peg-iskuyla te pegsuman-suman te me numiru ne egpakita te kanengnengan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me numiru ne egpakita te kanengnengan impus te peglibulung

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: numbers which show information that has been collected.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The statistics show that 80% of people eat too much salt.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impus te peglibulung te me kanengnengan nakita ne walu ne pulù ne pursintu ka me etew ne egkeen te asinen ne pegkeen.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka peg-iskuyla te pegsuman-suman te me numiru ne egpakita te kanengnengan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the science of analyzing numbers which show information.

entries.summary: katenged; keyimtang; keugpè wey keyimtang te nateil ne timpu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your status is how important you are in a group or in society, and the way that people in the group think about you.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seleppì egpakaapiktu te tawhanen ne keyimtang.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: keugpè wey keyimtang te nateil ne timpu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The status of something is the state that it is in at a particular time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What is the status of the new road? Is it finished yet?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekey ka keimtang te iyam ne kelesadda? Neimpusan naan e seini?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What is your marital status: married or single?

entries.summary: egpalunggahaat [egpalunggaha͡at]; egpabulus diyè te nateil ne sitwasyun; eg-aran

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you stay in a place, you don't move away from that place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He sat down in the chair and stayed there for a few hours.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Stay inside and don't go out.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpabulus diyè te nateil ne sitwasyun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you stay ADJECTIVE (e.g., quiet) , you continue to be in that state, and do not change.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was happy when he woke up and he stayed happy all day.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nahalè sikandin te peggimata rin wey nahalè sikandin te naapunan [na͡apunan].

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you stay in a place, you spend one or more nights there when you visit.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We stayed with a relative for a few days when we visited Davao.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your stay in a place is the time that you spend there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We hope you enjoy your stay in Davao.

entries.summary: putew; asiru
masandig

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a hill is steep, it moves from a low point to a high point in a short distance. This means that it is hard to walk or drive up.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We were tired after we climbed the steep hill.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nenabbeley key pegkeimpus te pegpatakereg ney te masandig ne labuntud.

entries.summary: lawa
egsikal; sikal; katutenen wey legsarenen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you step, you move your foot to another place on the ground.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They stepped over the fallen tree on the ground.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one action of moving your foot to another place on the ground (take_a_step).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He took a few steps towards the door.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a flat surface which you walk on to go up or down (e.g., on a ladder, or stairs)

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our house is high, so you need to go up four steps to enter.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sabeka ne weil te grupu ne eggimuwen nu te nateil ne pegkasinsinundul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one of a group of actions that you do in a particular order.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When you cook rice, the first step is to wash the rice.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke egsusubba ka te hemey, ka hun-a ne eggimuwen egkilisan ka hemey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one of the actions in a dance

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother taught me that dance, but I can't remember all the steps.

entries.summary: deisek wey ke manipis ne sugpang te kayu; kayu ne due nateil ne eggamitan iling te tuked, guad wey ke kali

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: deisek wey ke manipis ne sugpang te kayu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a thin branch from a tree.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kayu ne due nateil ne eggamitan iling te tuked, guad wey ke kali

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a long, thin piece of wood with a special purpose (e.g., a walking stick).

entries.summary: egdekket; egparekket; egtahù; egsalugkip; egtalisek; egsuksuk; egtiyuk; egpaligwang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing sticks to another thing, it becomes attached to that thing because there is something like glue on it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The chewing gum stuck to my shoe.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you stick one thing to another thing, you attach it to the other thing using something like glue.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She stuck her chewing gum under the chair.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egtahù; egsalugkip; egtalisek; egsuksuk; egtiyuk; egpaligwang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you stick something somewhere, you move it so that it is in that place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The nurse stuck a needle in my arm.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka nars migtiyuk te simat te bakelawan ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She stuck her tongue out at me.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpaligwang din ka dilè kayi te keddì.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She stuck the pen through the paper.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impasipit din ka bulpin diyè te pepil.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpanukalag (te bulbul); egpamulikangkang; kenè ne mapatag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something sticks up or out, it is not flat, in line with other things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His hair is sticking up because he hasn't combed it yet.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something sticky causes other things to stick to it (e.g., honey, glue).

entries.summary: kehal
egmakehal
layun pad; duen pad; pad iya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use still to talk about something that continues now the same as in the past.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I learned that when I was a child, and I still remember it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nateu ad due te batè e pad, wey layun ku pad egkasuman-suman seini.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use still to talk about something that remains.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's not time to finish yet. We still have 5 minutes.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè pad ne uras te peggipenga. Duen pad lalimma ne minutus.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use still if one thing is more than another thing, and the other thing is already a lot.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My sister is tall, and my brother is still taller.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Malangkew ka atebey ku, wey lelangkawi pad iya ka maama ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I watched amazed as he added still more sugar to his coffee.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Neinu-inu a ka migtengteng te in-abayan din pad iya te asukar ka keppi rin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use still to say one fact does not change another fact.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I know the dog is ugly, but I still love it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakataha a ne mareet ka asu, piru indakelan ku red seini te geyinawa.

entries.summary: kenè egweil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is still, it is not moving

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The air is still: there is no wind at all.

entries.summary: lalas
egkulibul
in-uyag ne me mananap; kasangkapan ne me belegyè diyè te belegyaanan; egbebelegyè

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kasangkapan ne me belegyè diyè te belegyaanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: all of the things which are for sale in a shop.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The truck delivered new stock to the shop.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a shop stocks something, they have it in their shop for sale.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Sorry, we don't stock that kind of coffee.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nakuwa ne seleppì puun te nabelegyè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the money that a company gets from selling shares. This money is for the people who own the shares.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is stock, it is usual and normal.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The visitors asked all the stock questions that people always ask.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me bisita mig-insè te langun ne me insè ne layun eg-insaa te me etew.

entries.summary: weyig ne migkale-kalè puun te minsan nekey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: weyig ne migkale-kalè puun te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a liquid which comes from slowly boiling something such as meat or fish. You can use stock to make soup.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: After she boiled the chicken, she used the stock to make soup.

entries.summary: getek
batu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a small, hard thing in the ground, or the material which is it made of.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She threw a stone into the water.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migdegpak sikandin te batu diyè te weyig.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This seat is made of stone.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini ne pinnuwan hinimu puun te batu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of stand

entries.summary: egpeeneng-eneng; egsanggel; pegpeeneng-eneng; pegsanggel; egpapeeneng-eneng; egpepasanggel

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something stops doing something, they don't continue to do that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Suddenly, the music stopped, because there was a brownout.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We stopped at my friend's house to say hello.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you stop something, you cause it to not continue happening or moving.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The rain stopped the basketball game.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The police stopped all the cars that were driving past.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He stopped his motorbike at the traffic lights.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We must put a stop the sale of drugs in this area.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone stops you (from) doing something, they don't allow you to do it. If something stops you (from) doing something, it causes you to not be able to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father stopped me from going to the gym, because he was worried about the storm.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His health problems stopped him joining the sports team.

entries.summary: baley ne due me belegyè; tindaan [tinda͡an]; eggeles wey egtahù te minsan nekey te egkaluhey ne timpu eyew egkahamit keuremè.; karakelan te iggeles ne igtahù ne minsan nekey eyew egkahamit keuremè.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: baley ne due me belegyè; tindaan [tinda͡an]

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggeles wey egtahù te minsan nekey te egkaluhey ne timpu eyew egkahamit keuremè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you store something, you keep it in a place for a long time because you are going to use it in the future.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We store our rice in a plastic box.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Iggeles ta igtahù ka behas sika te plastikk

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: karakelan te iggeles ne igtahù ne minsan nekey eyew egkahamit keuremè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A store of something is an amount of it which you are keeping to use in the future.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We keep a store of rice for planting.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkuwa ki te egbenien ta ne paley eyew igpamula.

entries.summary: bagyu; ayew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: very bad weather, with wind, rain, thunder and lightning.

entries.summary: ted-emen; guhuren

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: words about something that happened, or something which is imagined.

entries.summary: matul-id; nekeg-iling katul-id ka tagsè ilis; eggendiyè duritsu te warè pegpanulan-tulan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is straight, it has no bends in it (e.g., straight hair, a straight line, a straight road).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a picture is straight, both sides are at the same level.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The picture is not straight, because the left side is lower than the right.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka litratu warè nekeg-iling ka katul-id, su ka igkahibang ne ilis nariralem du te igkakawanan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you go straight to a place, you go there directly, without going to any other places on the way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can't play basketball after school, because I need to go straight home.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena ad eggalew te baskitbul pegkeimpus te klasi, su keilangan a eg-uli duritsu te baley.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini ke eglalag ka te minsan nekey ne egpabulus-bulus te nateil ne timpu, wey kenè egsanggel.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use straight to say that something continues for a period of time, and does not stop.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was very tired, and I slept for 12 hours straight.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana a nabeley, wey nakalipereng a te dusi ne uras te narahayun

entries.summary: egpatul-iren
lein te nalayaman; iyam wey lein

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A strange person or thing is different from usual, often in a bad way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is a very strange man, and I think he has a problem.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Lein sikandin ne etew, wey hendue te due prublima.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I feel strange, so I will rest.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is strange to you, it is new and different.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was in a strange city, and didn't know anybody.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Diya a te iyam ne siyudad, wey ware neilaan [neila͡an] ku minsan hentew.

entries.summary: amana egkahamit te pegkuwa te duma ne kapangkusan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: amana egkahamit te pegkuwa te duma ne kapangkusan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something strategic is very useful for getting some result.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The crossing is a strategic place to have a shop, because many people pass by.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka bebalakan amana ne egkahamit ne egtahuan te tindaan [tinda͡an], su masalig ne me etew ne egpanlihad.

entries.summary: pamaahi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a plan about how to get some result.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When he goes fishing, my father's strategy is to go to a different place every time.

entries.summary: beuhan
kelesadda (meyitenged te bayew deisek ne bayaanan te terak ne nasahiliran te me baley)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kelesadda (meyitenged te bayew deisek ne bayaanan te terak ne nasahiliran te me baley)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an area in a town along which cars drive, and which usually has buildings on each side.

entries.summary: kanekal; meupiya ne katuenan wey ke batasan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the strength of someone or something is how strong they are.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He used all his strength to carry the sack.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Inggamit din ka langun ne kanekal din te pegtiang te saku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was surprised by the strength of the wind.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: meupiya ne katuenan wey ke batasan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a good quality that you have, or something that you are good at.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His ability to learn fast is a strength.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka se katuenan din ne mahaan egkateu meupiya.

entries.summary: egpakesehen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you strengthen something, you cause it to become more strong.

entries.summary: pegkalaggew; egkabehatan; eglalahen te mapahetpet su amana ne keilangan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling of being worried about things, or of being too busy.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She has a lot of stress at the moment, because there are problems in her job.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due dakel ne pegkalaggew rin kuntee, su due me prublima te trabahu rin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a strong physical force, such as a heavy weight.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The bridge broke because it was under a lot of stress from the heavy trucks.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nareetan ka tulay su egkabehatan te me derakel ne terak.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eglalahen te mapahetpet su amana ne keilangan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you stress something, you say it carefully or strongly because it is important.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother stressed that I should never allow my baby sister near hot water.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka iney ku miglalag keddì te mapahetpet ne kenè iya igparulug ka atebey ku ne deisek pad te linala ne weyig.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eglalahen te makeseg ka baad te lalag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you stress a word or part of a word, you say it more loudly.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When you say the word 'believe', stress the second part of the word.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke eglalahen nu seini egmakesehen nu te eglalag ka ikaruwa ne baad te lalag.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the stronger sound which you use for a word or part of a word.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In the word 'believe', the stress is on the second part of the word.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te lalag ne 'believe', ka makeseg diyè te ikaruwa ne baad te lalag.

entries.summary: nagulam-asan; natamtamanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past participle for strike (sense 3). You can also use struck.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is stricken by something (e.g., panic or disease), they are very badly affected by that thing. And if something is stricken by something (e.g., a flood), it is very badly affected by that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I feel sad when I look at the typhoon-stricken town.

entries.summary: egkabundul; eglampes; egbundul; egpakasungkul; egsalerep; egsaharal

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you strike someone or something, you hit them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was struck by a car when he was crossing the road.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nabundul sikandin te terak te peglapas din te kelesadda.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He struck the animal on the back.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miglampesan din ka ayam diyè te peka.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you strike one thing on another thing, you hit it on that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He struck his head on the shelf when he stood up.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakasungkul ka ulu rin te marku te pegsasindeg din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something bad (e.g. a typhoon) strikes a group or area, it happens to that group or in that area.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A typhoon struck our town last week.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Insalerep ka lungsud ney te baggiyu seeyè se miglihad ne simana.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If it strikes you that something is the case, you suddenly think of that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It suddenly struck her that she should go home.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sahuhunè ne nasuman-suman din ne keilangan ne eg-uli din te baley.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkatahaan nu su egpakabagget wey egpakatekew keykew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something strikes you, you notice it because it is interesting or surprising.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was struck by how clean the street was.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Natekkew a amana te kalinis te kelesadda.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egsanggel te himu te nateil ne timpu su warè nahalè te minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If workers strike, they stop work for a certain period of time because they are not happy about something such as their pay.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a period when workers stop working because they are not happy about something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I couldn't travel that day because there was a bus drivers' strike.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena a egpekeyipanew te sika ne aldew su due pegpasanggel te himu te me drayibir.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-awè te lalag ne nasulat diyè te sinulat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you strike or strike_out words from a piece of writing, you remove them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The list of guests was too long, so she struck some names off it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka listaan [lista͡an] te me bisita amana ne lalayati, sika ka impangawè din ka duma te listaan [lista͡an].

entries.summary: kuwirdas
makeseg; manekal (ne etew wey ke mananap); makeseg; manekal; mabeheng (ne minsan nekey iling te kalamag wey ke weyig); mabasag; makehal

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: makeseg; manekal (ne etew wey ke mananap)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or animal is strong, their body is good, so they can do heavy or hard work.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father is so strong that he can carry two sacks of rice.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: makeseg; manekal; mabeheng (ne minsan nekey iling te kalamag wey ke weyig)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a force (e.g., water) is strong, it can move or change things easily.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The strong wind removed the roof from our house.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When I was washing in the river, the strong current carried away my shirt.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This plastic bag is strong, so it won't break if you carry the rice in it.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: amana egkakita, egkaneem-neem, egkaarek [egka͡arek], wey ke egkaheram

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something that you can see, taste, smell or feel is strong, it is very clear and easy to see, taste, smell or feel. (e.g., strong sunlight, a strong garlic taste, a strong smell of fish, a strong shaking of the ground, a strong feeling).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mapahetpet (meyitenged te aliddanan wey ke apulanan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A strong reason or argument is a very good one, which can cause people to agree with it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are very strong reasons for not smoking.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of strike.

entries.summary: kateilan; ula-ula; neyimu; hinimu; egteilen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the special way that the parts of something are organized and joined together (e.g., a building, a piece of writing, a company).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The structure of our house is unusual, because the kitchen is at the front.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ula-ula te baley ta amana ne nakasuwey-suwey, su diyè ka keenanan te tangkaan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The structure of your sentence is incorrect. You need to check the grammar.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that people have built, such as a house or bridge

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a large wooden structure near the crossing.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due amana dakel ne hinimu ne puun te kayu dutu te dulug te bebalakan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you structure something, you organize the different parts of it in a special way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He structured his song so that it had three main parts.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migteil din ka ulahingen din eyew egkeyimu ne due tatelu ne baad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: relating to the structure of something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That building has structural problems because it wasn't built well.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka baley due prublima te meyitenged te pegkateil su warè naay-ayari te eggimu.

entries.summary: nakarekket; nakatalu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of stick

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is stuck to another thing (e.g. with glue), it is attached strongly to that other thing.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is stuck in a place, it is very difficult to move it from that place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can't open the door, because it is stuck.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ku egkalukatan ka gemawan, su nakatalu.

entries.summary: ka me batè wey buyag ne layun eggendiyè te panuluanan; egmangiskuyla; etew ne egnengneng te nateil ne egnengnengen

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka me batè wey buyag ne layun eggendiyè te panuluanan; egmangiskuyla

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who studies at school or college.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: etew ne egnengneng te nateil ne egnengnengen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A student of something is a person who studies that particular thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is good to be a student of history, so that you can understand more about your country.

entries.summary: eg-iskuyla; egbasa eyew te pegbebasbas; 1 peg-iskuyla; 2 pegbasa eyew te pegbebasbas

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you study, you are a student, and learn about a particular subject or subjects

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is studying at college this year.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you study, you read the things that you need to learn so that you will know or remember them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have to study, because I have exams next week.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of learning things as a student (do_study).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I need to do some study, as I have exams next week.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you study a particular topic, you research it to learn more.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is studying herbal medicines of this area.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: himuwen ne egnengneng ka te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a project in which you research something (do_a_study).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is doing a study on herbal medicines of this area.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you study something, you look at it very carefully.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The doctor studied my foot carefully and said that it was broken.

entries.summary: pamaahi; pamaahi te pegkeyimu; pegkameupiya ne egtengtengan

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has a strange running style, but he is fast.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due lein ne pamaahi rin te pegpallahuy, piru meiyal sikandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I like that author's style of writing.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The style of something such as clothes or a building is the way that it looks and the way that it is made.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I like the style of that shoe.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian a te pegkeyimu te sika ne sepatus.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Style is the fact that someone or something looks good and smart.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you style something such as hair or clothes, you make it into a particular shape.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He uses wax to style his hair.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggamit sikandin te malamiket ne me butang eyew te pegteil te ula-ula te bulbul din.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: meupiya ne egtengtengan ka kumbalè wey bulbul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person is stylish, their clothes and hair look very good and modern.

entries.summary: ka etew wey ke kasangkapan ne eglalahen; ka nateil ne egpangguhuren diyè te iskuylaan; sabdyik; ka etew wey ke ka mananap ne iyan egnengnengen

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka etew wey ke kasangkapan ne eglalahen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the person or thing that you are talking about.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He didn't want to talk about his problem, so he quickly changed the subject.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Rizal is the subject of her recent book.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka nateil ne egpangguhuren diyè te iskuylaan; sabdyik

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a particular topic of study at school or college (e.g., history, physics).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In fourth year high school, I had to do 8 subjects.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: History is my favorite subject at school.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka etew wey ke ka mananap ne iyan egnengnengen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are doing research (e.g., in science), a subject is a person or animal that you are studying or doing tests on.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In the experiment, subjects had to answer 40 questions.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Iyan ka me lalag te kenè pad ka lalag ne weil ne iyan egpangasaken (meyitenged te Inglis ne pegkalalag).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In English grammar, the subject of a verb is the word or phrase that is before the verb.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My brother hates bread ['my brother' is the subject].

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka suled ku egkeepes te paan ['ka suled ku' ka egpangasaken].

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: keilangan ne eg-ikul ke nekey ka inlalag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are subject to a rule, you need to do what it says.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you visit another country, you are subject to the laws of that country.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: wey rè egkeyitabù ke egkeyitabù e ka sabeka

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is subject to another thing, it can only happen if the other thing happens.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We will leave early tomorrow morning, subject to the weather.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egselem-selem ki kaaselem eggipanew te maselem, ke meupiya ka timpu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka malasi wey ke mahaan egkeyitabù diyè te sabeka ne etew wey ke kasangkapan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or thing is subject to something (e.g., illness), that thing happens to them easily or often.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is subject to travel sickness, so she doesn't like taking the bus.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Malasi iya egderalu sikandin ke eggipanew, sika ka kenè egkeupian sikandin ne eg-untud te bas ne terak.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you subject someone to a bad experience, you cause them to have that bad experience.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The greedy manager subjected his workers to bad conditions and long hours.

entries.summary: egkeyitabù pegkeimpus te duma ne pangitabù

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkeyitabù pegkeimpus te duma ne pangitabù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A subsequent event happens after another event.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His accident and subsequent death were very sad.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka neyitabù wey pegkapatey rin amana ne makalelangè.

entries.summary: de-deisek ne keilangan.; baad te dakel ne kumpanya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is subsidiary to something else, it is less important than it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a company is a subsidiary of a larger company, it is part of that larger company.

entries.summary: egbulig egbayad te baad te minsan nekey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbulig egbayad te baad te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or government subsidizes something, they help by paying for part for it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The government subsidizes some medicines so that they are cheaper.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka gubirnu egbulig egbayad te tambal eyew baratu naan dè.

entries.summary: seleppì te gubirnu ne tabang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: money which the government pays to help a business, or to make something cheaper for people.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a governement subsidy on hospital treatment for poor people.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due seleppì te gubirnu ne tabang te pegpabawì diyè te uspital para te me pubri.

entries.summary: kasangkapan; kinewun-aan [kinewun-a͡an] ne igpasabut

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: any particular kind of matter (e.g., milk, ash and biku are three different substances).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The substance of words or writing is the basic meaning.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He spoke for a long time, but the substance of his message was that he was not happy.

entries.summary: igpakasubal; egsaliyuwan; subal

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you substitute for someone, you are there in their place, and do their things, because they are not there. If something substitutes for another thing, it is in the place of the other thing, because the other thing is not there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Money can never substitute for love.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seleppì kenè igpakasubal te geyinawa.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our teacher was sick yesterday, so another teacher substituted for him.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you substitute one thing for another thing, you use the first thing and not the second thing, so that the first thing is in the place of the second thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When you cook that food, substitute water for milk if you don't have milk.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke egsusubba ka te sika ne pegkeen, saliyui nu te weyig ke warad gatas nu ne igweyig.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The coach substituted me for the goalshooter, because the goalshooter was injured.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person or thing which is there in the place of another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The teacher yesterday was a substitute, because our real teacher was sick.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka talagpanulù gabii iyan subal, su ka malehet ne talagpanulù ney migderalu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Some people use spices as a substitute for salt.

entries.summary: egpakakaya; egpakakuwa te meupiya ne kapabulusan; egpekeimpus; egkamewuri; egpakasinundul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you succeed in doing something, you do it, even if it is difficult.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She succeeded in finishing her work before dark.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakakaya sikandin ne eg-impus te trabahu rin te warè pad migmarusilem.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakakuwa te meupiya ne kapabulusan; egpekeimpus

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone succeeds, they achieve good results in what they do. If something succeeds, it has a good result.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She succeeded as a student because she worked hard.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakakuwa te meupiya ne kapabulusan sikandin ne istudyanti su amana rin miglasey-lasey ka migtrabahu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Their garden succeeded, and so they had many vegetables.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one person or thing succeeds another, they come after the other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Cory Aquino succeeded Ferdinand Marcos as president.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Si Cory Aquino nakasinundul ne prisidinti ki Ferdinand Marcos.

entries.summary: pegpakakuwa te meupiya ne kapabulusan; nakaangey te meupiya ne kapangkusan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that someone or something achieves a good result.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I congratulated the winner on his success.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something is successful, they achieve good results.

entries.summary: amana; iling (te lalag ne newun-a); iling te

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use such to describe something more strongly.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This room is such a mess.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne nahuseng ka seini ne sinabeng.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I had such a bad day.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne mareet ka aldew ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was surprised when I saw it, because I had never seen such a thing before.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Neinu-inu a te nakita ku seeyè, su warè e pad nakakita te iling dutu ne kasangkapan ligkat pad dengan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I love yellow vegetables such as corn.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian a te makalawag ne me gulay iling te aheley.

entries.summary: sahuhunè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A sudden action happens quickly, and there is no warning about it before it happens, so people are surprised.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We were all surprised by the sudden rainshower, and got wet.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Langun ney ne natekkew te sahuhunè ne taligsik, wey nasubid key.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use suddenly to say that something happens quickly and with no warning before.

entries.summary: egkalasey (meyitenged te masakit wey ke mareet ne eggeramen); egkalasey te minsan nekey ne mareet ne egkeyitabù diyè te kuna; due eggeramen (meyitenged te dalu wey ke masakit te lawa)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkalasey (meyitenged te masakit wey ke mareet ne eggeramen)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or animal suffers, they experience pain or bad feelings.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The sick horse is suffering a lot.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka egderalu ne kuddè egkalasey amana.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkalasey te minsan nekey ne mareet ne egkeyitabù diyè te kuna

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you suffer something bad, that bad thing happens to you.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-antus sikandin te ataki te pusung ne dalu rin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The town suffered a lot of damage in the flood.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due eggeramen (meyitenged te dalu wey ke masakit te lawa)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you suffer_from a problem with your body, you have that problem.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is suffering from a headache.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due eggeramen din ne masakit te ulu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something suffers, it becomes not very good because of another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When he was sick, his work suffered.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te migderalu sikandin, naang-anggaan din e ka trabahu rin.

entries.summary: eleg; pegkeeleg te karakel wey kasalig

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is sufficient, it is enough.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: 100 pesos is not sufficient to buy food for all those people.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka mahatus kenè ne eleg ne igbeli te pegkeen te langun ne etew.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm not sure about the sufficiency of the food for all those people.

entries.summary: litra ne igsumpul diyè te keepusan te me lalag.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: litra ne igsumpul diyè te keepusan te me lalag.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a letter or group of letters which are added to the end of a word (e.g. '-ness' in 'sadness', '-an' in 'puunan').

entries.summary: sukal
egbehey te puhawang; egpakabehey te suman-suman; puhawang ne nasuman-suman nu ne igbehey diyè te duma eyew iyan igpeyimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you suggest doing something or suggest that someone do something, you tell them your idea so that they can think about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I had nothing to do, so my mother suggested that I visit my cousins.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I suggest a picnic for this afternoon. What do you think?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I suggest that he is not the best person for the job.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing suggests another thing, it causes you to think the other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The rain clouds suggest that it will rain later.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kibel egpakabehey te suman-suman ne eg-uran kangkuwa.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her sleepy eyes suggested that she had just woken up.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka egtuyungen ne mata rin egpakabehey te suman-suman ne iyam pad miggimata sikandin.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: puhawang ne nasuman-suman nu ne igbehey diyè te duma eyew iyan igpeyimu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: words which tell someone what you think they should do (make_a_suggestion).

entries.summary: egpakameupiya; eggayul; punduk te me igpanaluub eyew te me maleman ne me himuwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a plan suits you, it is good for you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It suits me if you come to my house tomorrow, because I don't have any plans.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpakameupiya keddì kaaselem ke eggendiyè ka te baley, su warè me planu ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If clothes or colors suit you, they look good on you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You look good, because that color really suits you.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Meupiya ka ne egpitawen, su ka sika ne batek amana eggayul kuna.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: punduk te me igpanaluub eyew te me maleman ne me himuwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a set of formal clothes, made of a jacket and pants or a jacket and skirt. Businesspeople often wear this.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: punduk te me igpanaluub eyew nateil ne eggamitan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a set of clothes which have a special purpose (e.g., a swimsuit).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peggamit te kukuman eyew te pegpeyimu wey pegpabayad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In a law court, a suit is an action of using the law courts to make someone pay or do something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He brought a lawsuit against the company.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sabeka te hep-at ne klasi te galawanan ne kartun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: One of the four kinds of cards in a pack of playing cards. There are four suits: hearts, diamonds, clubs and spades.

entries.summary: karakelan te seleppì; seel te langun puun te pinegtimul; prublima te egpegtimul, eg-awè, egpamasalig wey egbaad

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sapulù ne libu ne pisus-dakel e ne seleppì.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: seel te langun puun te pinegtimul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the sum of a group of numbers is the total when you add them together.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seel ke egpegtimulen ka hen-em wey hep-at su sapulù

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: prublima te egpegtimul, eg-awè, egpamasalig wey egbaad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a mathematical problem in which you need to add or subtract, multiply or divide numbers.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We had to do ten sums for maths homework.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegbehey te minalepet ne pangasak te impanlalag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you sum_up, you give a summary of all the things that you have said before.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: To sum up, I have made three points today. The first is that...

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te egmalepeten dè, nekeyimu a te tatelu ne puntu. Ka hun-a seeyè....".

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini ke egbehey ka te malepet ne behas te nalalag; te pantek (meyitenged te pegkalalag)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: you use in_sum to give a short, general message about the things you have said before.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have given many reasons why I don't agree with the plan. In sum, I just don't think it will work.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due deisek ne aliddanan ku mania te kena a eg-uyun te puhawang nu. Te pantek, kena a egpalintutuu ne seini egpekeyimu.

entries.summary: egmalepeten

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you summarize something, you say or write a summary of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She didn't add any new ideas, she just summarized what she had read.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè migtimul sikandin te iyam ne puhawang, immalepet din dè ka migbasa rin.

entries.summary: minalepet ne lalahen wey ke sinulat; malabundus wey warad labet te duma

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minalepet ne lalahen wey ke sinulat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a short piece of speaking or writing, which gives the main ideas from what was said or written before it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He gave a summary of the things that they had decided in the meeting.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbehey sikandin te minalepet ne me puhawang te miglihad ne kalibulungan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Don't copy the whole piece of writing. Just make a summary of it so that you don't forget the main points.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The last paragraph of your writing should be a summary of the main part of your essay.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: malabundus wey warad labet te duma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A summary action is done immediately, and doesn't include all the things which should be done with it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The mechanic did a summary check of the car, but didn't check it carefully.

entries.summary: iiniti ne timpu impus te tingkalamag wey te kenè pad ka tingtahak te dewun

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: iiniti ne timpu impus te tingkalamag wey te kenè pad ka tingtahak te dewun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the hottest season, after spring and before autumn (fall).

entries.summary: aldew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the bright light in the sky during the day.

entries.summary: kina-; pinaka- (egkahamit seini ne lalag ke egpeg-iling ka te minsan nekey ne iyan 'kinewun-aan [kinewun-a:n]')

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kina-; pinaka- (egkahamit seini ne lalag ke egpeg-iling ka te minsan nekey ne iyan 'kinewun-aan [kinewun-a:n]')

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Adjectives and some adverbs have a superlative form. You use the superlative form to talk about the 'number one' thing when you compare things. For short words, you add '-est' to the adjective. For long words, you put 'most' before the adjective. You use 'the' before superlative forms.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is the tallest girl in our family.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sikandin ka kinamalangkawan ne malitan te pamilya ney.

fields.label: English example
