fields.text: This tree is the most beautiful tree in the garden.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini ne kayu ka kinameupiyaan diyè te pamulaan.

entries.summary: egbehey te minsan nekey; karakelan te minsan nekey ne egkaayun ne egkakuwa; minsan nekey ne me keilangan (iling te pegkeen)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something supplies you with something, they give you that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The spring supplies us with water.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My brother supplies our family with rice.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: karakelan te minsan nekey ne egkaayun ne egkakuwa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an amount of something which you can get.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a large supply of bananas at the moment, because the weather is good.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne me keilangan (iling te pegkeen)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Supplies are the things that you need, such as food.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We have enough supplies to last for three days.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due eleg ne egkeilangan ta taman te tatelu ne aldew.

entries.summary: eggen-gen wey eg-uyan (te kabehat te minsan nekey); peggen-gen wey peg-uyan (te kabehat te minsan nekey); tukeg

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggen-gen wey eg-uyan (te kabehat te minsan nekey)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something supports another thing, it carries the weight of that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The man with the broken leg couldn't walk well, so his friend walked beside him and supported him.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you hold a young baby, you should support its head with your hand or arm.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The shelf is supporting a lot of books, so be careful that it doesn't break.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peggen-gen wey peg-uyan (te kabehat te minsan nekey)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of helping to carry the weight of something

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The support of his friend's arm stopped him from falling.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which helps to carry the weight of something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He felt weak, so he used the table as a support when he stood up.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you support someone, you regularly give them the money or things that they need to live.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has many children, so he needs to work hard to support all of them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His uncle supported him through college.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: seleppì wey butang ne keilangan ne igbehey eyew egkeuyag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the money or things which someone needs to live, and which you give to them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His uncle's support allowed him to finish college.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His sister works in the city, and sends home support for the family.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you support someone, you help them when they have some trouble in their life.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His friends supported him a lot when he was depressed.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me alukuy rin amana migpangabang kandin te nalangè sikandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the help that people give you when you have some trouble in your life.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was very thankful for the support of my friends when my grandmother died.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: someone who helps you when you have some trouble in your life

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My friend was a great support to me when my grandmother died.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me alukuy ku amana dakel ne bulig keddiey te pegpatey te apu ku ne buyag e.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you support an idea, you agree with it and like it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I support the Barangay's plan to build a clinic.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your support for an idea is the fact that you agree with it and like it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Public support for the Barangay plan is growing.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpasabut te malehet iya ka puhawang wey lalag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something supports an idea or words, it helps to show that the idea or words are true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I believe them, because his story supports her story.

entries.summary: egsumsumanen ne egkeyitabù; egkeilangan te nateil ne sitwasyun; Egkahamit seini ke egsumsuman ka te minsan nekey ne hendue te egkeyitabù.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you suppose that something is the case or will happen, you think that it is probably the case or will probably happen, but you are not sure.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We're a stronger team, so I suppose we'll win, but you can never be sure.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sikanta ka kinamanekalan ne grupu, sika ka egsuman-suman a ne egdeeg ki, piru kenè ta egkasiguru.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an idea or plan supposes something, it needs that thing to be the case.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Your plan supposes that it will not rain.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka planu nu egkeilangan te kenè eg-uran.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini ke egsumsuman ka te minsan nekey ne hendue te egkeyitabù.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use suppose or supposing when you imagine something that may happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Suppose there was an earthquake, what would you do?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Iling ke due linug, nekey ka eggimuwen nu?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He said he would come, but suppose he doesn't come. What will we do then?

entries.summary: minsan nekey ne keilangan ne egkeyitabù wey ke neyitabù; egkarineg ne iyan iya ne kasu piru warè nu pad isalerep; Egkahamit seini ke egpanunggiling ka te minsan nekey ne insuman-suman wey ke inlalag te me etew, minsan pad ke seini kenè ne malehet.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne keilangan ne egkeyitabù wey ke neyitabù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is_supposed_to happen, it should happen (maybe because there is a rule, or because people expect it). If something was_supposed_to happen, it should have happened (in the past), but it didn't.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He isn't supposed to know about that! Who told him?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè perem egkaayun ne egpakataha sikandin due! Hentew a ka impanudtul kandin?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is supposed to clean the kitchen, because that is his job.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miglinisan din perem ka kusina, su trabahu rin ma iya sika.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He was supposed to be here an hour ago. Where is he?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ganna rè perem sikandin ne uras kayi. Hendeid naa sikandin?

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkarineg ne iyan iya ne kasu piru warè nu pad isalerep

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you say that something is_supposed_to be the case, you have heard that it is the case, but you haven't experienced it yet.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I want to see that movie, because it's supposed to be really good.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian a ne egpitew te seika ne salida, su narineg ku ne uupiyei kun sika.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini ke egpanunggiling ka te minsan nekey ne insuman-suman wey ke inlalag te me etew, minsan pad ke seini kenè ne malehet.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use supposed to describe something that people think or say, even though it may not be true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is the supposed writer of that song, but nobody knows if he actually wrote it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sikandin ka nakahi ne migsulat te sika ne ulahingen, piru warè minsan hentew ne nakataha ke sikandin naa iya ka migsulat.

entries.summary: egpakanengneng; egpakasiguru; iya (meyitenged te leleheti ne egkeyitabù)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are sure that something is the case or will happen, you feel that you know that it is the case or that it will happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I am sure that he will come, because he always does.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakanengneng a ne egginguma sikandin, su layun din eggimuwa.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is sure to happen, it really will happen

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is sure to help us.

entries.summary: dibabew; ampew; baad te sitwasyun wey ke umul te duma ne egkakita nu; egpalunggahampung

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the outside or top of something (e.g., water, or a table).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The hot cup left a mark on the surface of the table.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka meinit ne pakawan nakahaat [nakaha͡at] te marka diyè te dibabew te lamisa.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The dead fish was floating on the surface of the water.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka migpatey ne ngalap te weyig miggampung te weyig.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The road surface is no longer very good, and there are a lot of potholes.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kelesadda kenad ne meupiya, wey due masalig ne lungag.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: baad te sitwasyun wey ke umul te duma ne egkakita nu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the part of a situation or someone's life that you can see.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: On the surface, he looks happy, but I think he is worried about many things.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te egkakita, nahalè sikandin, piru suman-suman ku ne masalig ka igkalaggew din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something in the water surfaces, it comes up from under the water to the top of the water.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The swimmer surfaced after a minute underwater.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka talaglumbuk migpalinggaampung [migpalingga͡ampung] pegkeimpus te senge-minutu puun diyè te diralem te weyig.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a piece of information surfaces, people learn about it, when they didn't know about it before.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Some interesting facts about him have surfaced during the past week.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka duma ne egpakabagget ne kamalehetan meyitenged kandin natuenan e te miglihad ne simana.

entries.summary: pegkabenga-benga; pegkeinu-inu; pegkatekkew; egpakatekkew; egpakabenga-benga; egpekeinu-inu; egpakapatekkew; egpakapabenga-benga; egpakapeinu-inu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling that you have when you see something strange, or when something happens that you are not ready for.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka lein ne me lalag din egpakapabenga-benga.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: To my surprise, the baby suddenly stood up and walked.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakapeinu-inu keddì, ka batè kalit dè ne migsasindeg wey miggipanew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something surprises you, it causes you to feel surprised.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It surprises me that you want to go to Davao, because I thought you didn't like big cities.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpakatekkew keddì seini se egkeupian ka ne eggendiyè te Dabaw su kenè ka egkeupian te derakel ne siyudad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that causes you to feel surprised.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It was a surprise to see her, because I though she was still in Davao.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakapatekkew keddì ka pegkakita ku kandin, su migsuman-suman a ne diyè pad sikandin te Dabaw.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Close your eyes and hold out your hand, because I have a surprise for you.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Pilenga nu ka mata nu wey kenè ka panggen-gen su due igtekkew ku keykew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use surprise to describe something which someone is not ready for and does not know about (e.g., a surprise birthday party).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You feel surprised when you see something strange, or when something happens that you are not ready for.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She was very surprised to see me, because she thought I was still in Valencia.

entries.summary: palibut
egpanginsè eyew te kanengnengan; pegpanginsè te nateil ne me insè; egtengteng te langun-langun; egpanlangu-langu te langun-langun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you survey a group of people, you ask each of them questions to find out information.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We surveyed ninety families to find out how many people lived in each house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpanginsè key e te siyam ne pulù ne pamiliya eyew te pegnengneng ke pilaa ne etawan ka eg-ugpè te sabeka ne baley.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegpanginsè te nateil ne me insè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of asking a set of questions to people (conduct_a_survey).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The Barangay is conducting a survey to find the number of people living in each house.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egtengteng te langun-langun; egpanlangu-langu te langun-langun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you survey something, you look at all of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She stood at the top of the mountain and surveyed the beautiful view below her.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migsasindeg sikandin diyè te puntul te bubungan wey migpanlangu-langu te meupiya ne egtengtengan diyè te diralem din.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egsukud te lugar eyew egkeyimuwan te mapa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you survey an area, you carefully measure it so that you can make a map.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegsukud te lugar eyew egkeyimuwan te mapa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of measuring an area to make a map.

entries.summary: pegtigkel

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that someone continues to live or exist after something bad has happened to them.

entries.summary: egtigkel; nakatigkel

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or thing survives, they continue to live or exist after something bad has happened to them.

entries.summary: egkabayungan
egpakabulig wey egpakabehey te kanekal te pegpabulus; egpabulus; egpekeula-ula

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakabulig wey egpakabehey te kanekal te pegpabulus

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something (e.g., food, hope) sustains you, it gives you the ability to continue.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our breakfast was not enough to sustain us through the morning, and we were hungry again by 9am.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka inlem-ag ney kenè ne eleg ne egpakabehey te kanekal te langun ne maselem, wey te me alas nuwibi inggutasan key e man-e.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We have enough money to sustain us for one month.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The hope of winning the race sustained me, so I kept running even though I was very tired.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you sustain something, you cause it to continue for some time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is very shy, so it is difficult to sustain a conversation with him.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana sikandin ne hiilawen [hi͡ilawen], sika ka malised ne egpabulus egpakiglalag kandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He ran very fast at the beginning of the long race, but he couldn't sustain that speed because he got tired.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you sustain something bad such as an injury or loss, you experience that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He sustained a broken leg in the accident.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekeula-ula sikandin te pegkahepù te paa rin te aksidinti.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They sustained a lot of damage to their house in the flood.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè egpakarereet ka mapabulusen ne pegderereet te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an action of using something is sustainable, it does not hurt that thing, so it can continue for some time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is not sustainable to destroy old forests to make paper.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpakarereet ka mapabulus ne pegdereet te daan e ne katalunan ne eggimuwen ne pepil.

entries.summary: eg-abeleng
eglalew; egsaad; egpangulibet; eggamit te mareet wey ke bastus ne lalag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you swear, you make a very serious promise.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggamit te mareet wey ke bastus ne lalag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you swear, you use a bad or rude word.

entries.summary: limuseng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Ifi you sweat, your body produces sweat (sense 1 above).

entries.summary: eglimas; egpanlimas
meemis; meupiya; mateles; buutan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something sweet tastes like sugar or honey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something sweet is nice or beautiful (e.g., sweet music).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A sweet person is very kind and gentle, and people love them.

entries.summary: eglumbuk
sambiyug
baad te lalag ne sabeka rè ka 'dahing'

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: baad te lalag ne sabeka rè ka 'dahing'

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a part of a word (e.g., 'dog' has one syllable, 'kitten' has two, and 'carabao' has three).

entries.summary: palinneu; palinneu ne due natahahè ne igpasabut

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is a symbol of a real thing, it is a kind of picture of that real thing. When you see the symbol, you think of the real thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The cross is a symbol of Christianity.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The kangaroo is a symbol of Australia.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: palinneu ne due natahahè ne igpasabut

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a letter or sign which you understand to have a special meaning (e.g., %, @).

entries.summary: pamaahi; punduk te me baad ne nenekegsumpul-sumpul wey eggimu langun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an organized way of doing something

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We have a good system for organizing the books in the library.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due meupiya ne pamaahi ta te peglibulung te libru diyè te tahuanan te me libru.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We have a good system in my family: I cook and my children wash the dishes.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: punduk te me baad ne nenekegsumpul-sumpul wey eggimu langun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of parts which are connected together and work together (e.g., a system of roads, a system of electrical wires).

entries.summary: migsulat ne kanengnengan ne natapid diyè te me lingya diyè te dibabew wey diralem; eglalahen eg-ay-ayari diyè te me etew te timpu te eglibulung; egtahù pad seup e eglalaha

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a flat board with one or more legs. People often sit at a table to do various activities such as eating.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: migsulat ne kanengnengan ne natapid diyè te me lingya diyè te dibabew wey diralem

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: written information which is arranged in lines across and down.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The pronouns are listed in a table.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eglalahen eg-ay-ayari diyè te me etew te timpu te eglibulung

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you table an idea, you say formally that you want people to talk about it at a meeting.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They tabled a proposal to build a new road.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you table an idea, you decide to talk about it another time, not now.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Let's table that for the next meeting.

entries.summary: ikug
maneneyi
egkuwa; egsipit; egkuwa te minsan nekey, minsan kenè ne keykew; egkuen wey ke egdawaten ka minsan nekey ne igbehey te senge etew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you take something, you get it in your hands.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She took the pencil and started to write.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migkuwa rin ka lapis wey migbunsud ne egsulat.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkuwa te minsan nekey, minsan kenè ne keykew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you take something, you cause it to become yours, even though it belongs to someone else.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I didn't give her the rice, she just came in and took it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè ku ibehey kandin ka behas, ingkuwa rin dè due kayi.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has been taking money from the office safe.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkuen wey ke egdawaten ka minsan nekey ne igbehey te senge etew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you take something that someone gives you, you accept it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I tried to give her money, but she wouldn't take it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Iyas e rè ka egbehey kandin te seleppì, piru warè din kua.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you take something to a person or place, you go there carrying it with you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We took our bolos when we went to the mountain.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-uyan ney ka me ugpit te miggendiyè key te bubungan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you take someone to a place, you cause them to go with you to that place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father took me to the hospital when I was sick.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Inhated a te amey ku diyè te uspital te migderalu a.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a thing takes time, it uses time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It usually takes me an hour to wash the clothes.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Malasi ne egpakaamin te uras ku ka pegpami-pì ku te me kasangkapan ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a thing takes something (e.g., effort), it needs and uses that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It takes a lot of work to build a house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeilangan te dakel ne himu ka egbebaley.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It takes patience to be a good teacher.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-inum wey ke egkeen te bawì

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you take medicine, you eat or drink it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I need to take two tablets per day.

entries.summary: eglalag; egpeglalahey; pegpalallalahey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you talk, you say something.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two people talk with each other or talk to each other, they say things to each other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I need to talk with my boss before I decide that.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan key pad ne egpeglalahey te ahalen ku wey a egbehey te puhawang due.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a situation where people say things to each other (have_a_talk with someone).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is talk that he will move to Davao.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due guhuren ne eggendiyè sikandin te Dabaw.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a speech; something that you say about a particular topic when you stand in front of a group of people (give_a_talk).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have to give a talk about frogs tomorrow in class.

entries.summary: malayat wey ke malangkew (meyitenged te etew); malayat (meyitenged te minsan nekey)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: malayat wey ke malangkew (meyitenged te etew)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A tall person is more than average height.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A tall thing (such as a tree or building) is more than average height.

entries.summary: egpaanad; egpaamuk
egkelit
manipis ne silupin ne egdekket ka limang; parekket; egtahuan te parekket; tip

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: manipis ne silupin ne egdekket ka limang; parekket

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a thin strip of plastic which is sticky on one side (e.g., scotch tape).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you tape something, you put tape on it to stick it somewhere.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He taped the box so that it would not open.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtahuan din te parekket ka kaban eyew kenè egkalukatan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a plastic case which has a roll of thin magnetic tape inside it, and which is used for recording something such as sounds or pictures (e.g., cassette tape, video tape).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: People listen to music on tapes or CDs.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egtahù te ulahingen wey ke salida diyè te tip

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you tape something, you record the sounds or pictures onto a video or cassette tape.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He taped a TV program so that he could watch it again.

entries.summary: eggisuhaten; nateil ne igkeupii ne egkuen; egtulagseb; egpanulegsab

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: someone or something that you shoot at or throw something at.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can never hit the target when I play darts.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè kud iya egkasuhat ka eggisuhaten ke eggalew a te dart.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The children used a can as a target for throwing stones.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a particular result or level that you want and plan to achieve.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My target is to sell 100 fish per day.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka igkeupii ku ne egkuen ku ne egpakabelegyè te mahatus ne buuk ne ngalap te weyig tagsè aldew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people target someone or something, they focus their actions or words on that person or thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The criminals targeted houses which didn't have dogs.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me manggimatey egpanulagsab te me baley ne warè me asu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The presidential candidate is targeting younger voters in his campaign.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person or group that certain people focus their actions or words on.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Young children are the target of that advertisement.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Me batè ka egpapeendiyaan te seyeè ne me pahinumdum.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Unfortunately, my son is the target of a lot of unkind words from other students at school.

entries.summary: minsan nekey ne keilangan ne eggimuwen

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne keilangan ne eggimuwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you need to do.

entries.summary: nanam; egnenanam te nateil ne nanam; egpakaneem-neem; egpakaheram

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The taste of something is what it is like when you put it in your mouth.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something tastes a certain way (e.g., good, sweet, salty), that is what it is like in your mouth.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egnenanam ka seini ne pegkeen te amana ne meupiya.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you can_taste something, you know that it is there because your mouth tells you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can taste salt; did you put salt in this food?

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Eggeram te deisek iling te egkakeen wey ke egkeinum eyew egkatuenan ke mamenu ka nanam.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you taste something, you eat or drink a little so that you will know what it is like.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She tasted the soup to check if it had enough salt.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ke nekey ka igkeupii wey ka kenè nu igkeupii iling te manggad wey ke musika.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your taste in something such as clothes or music, is what you like and don't like.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My sister and I have different taste in music, so we don't listen to the same music.

entries.summary: pangeteb; egpangeteb

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of teach

entries.summary: seleppì ne ingkulikta te gubirnu puun diyè te me etew puun te imbayad dan degma seini diyè te gubirnu.; egpabayad (meyitenged te bayarenen diyè te gubirnu); egpakaalas [egpaka͡alas]; egpakaamin

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: seleppì ne ingkulikta te gubirnu puun diyè te me etew puun te imbayad dan degma seini diyè te gubirnu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: money which the government collects from people. The amount of tax you pay usually depends on how much you earn from working.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpabayad (meyitenged te bayarenen diyè te gubirnu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a government taxes people, it makes them pay tax.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something taxes a supply of something, it uses a lot of it, so that there is not very much remaining.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The marathon really taxed his strength.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our visit to the hospital taxed our supply of money.

entries.summary: terak ne deisek, tatelu wey daruwa rè ka egpekeuntud

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: terak ne deisek, tatelu wey daruwa rè ka egpekeuntud

entries.summary: egpanulù; egpakapanulù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you teach someone something, you tell them about it or show them so that they can understand it or do it

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Could you teach me how to make biku?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something teaches you something, it causes you to know that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My bad experience taught me that I should always be careful when travelling alone.

entries.summary: meistru; meistru
eggisì; gisì

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you tear something such as paper or cloth, you pull the two sides away from each other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She tore the paper in two and give me half.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a space where two parts of something have been pulled away from each other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a tear in my shirt.

entries.summary: luwè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a drop of water from the eye.

entries.summary: eggamit te nateil ne kanengnenganan diyè te nateil dè ne puunanan te katuenan.; due kalabetan kayi meyitenged te mekinariyas; katuenan meyitenged te eleg ne pamaahi te peggimu te nateil ne butang.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggamit te nateil ne kanengnenganan diyè te nateil dè ne puunanan te katuenan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is technical, it uses special information from a particular area of knowledge, such as art or science.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can't understand this science book because it is very technical.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: due kalabetan kayi meyitenged te mekinariyas

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Technical things relate to machines and equipment.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The concert started late because of technical problems.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: katuenan meyitenged te eleg ne pamaahi te peggimu te nateil ne butang.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Technical skills relate to the correct way of doing a particular thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A sports coach teaches his team the technical skills of their sport.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peggamit te nateil ne kanengnenganan diyè te nateil dè ne puunanan te katuenan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I didn't understand the book because of the technicality of the topic.

entries.summary: pamaahi te peggimu te nateil ne butang, labi en iya ke ka eggimuwen nu egkeilangan te katuenan; katuenan te peggimu te nateil ne butang ne meupiya, su due eleg ne pamaahi

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pamaahi te peggimu te nateil ne butang, labi en iya ke ka eggimuwen nu egkeilangan te katuenan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a way of doing a particular thing, especially a thing that needs some skill or knowledge.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He used a new technique to build the bridge.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: katuenan te peggimu te nateil ne butang ne meupiya, su due eleg ne pamaahi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the ability to do a particular thing well, because you have the correct method.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A great musician must have good technique as well as sensitivity to the music.

entries.summary: ka katuenan wey mekina ne due kalabetan te peggamit te sayans diyè te malehet ne umul.; due kalabetan te tiknuluhiya

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka katuenan wey mekina ne due kalabetan te peggamit te sayans diyè te malehet ne umul.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the information and machines which are related to using science in real life.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Cellphone technology is getting better all the time.

entries.summary: tilipunu; egpanawag ne eggamit te tilipunu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a piece of electrical equipment which you use to speak with a person in another place.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you telephone someone, you call them using a telephone.

entries.summary: egpanugtul; egnangen; egsuhù eyew te pegpeyimu te minsan nekey; egpakataha

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you tell someone something, or tell them that something is the case, you say it to them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He told me that he was hungry.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egsuhù eyew te pegpeyimu te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you tell someone to do something, you say that they must do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My mother told me to come home before dark.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you can_tell that something is true, you know that it is true because there is some evidence.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When I saw her, I could tell that she had been crying.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te pegkakita ku kandin, nakataha a ne ligkat pad sikandin te pegsinehew.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakabehey te mareet diyè te keykew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something tells_on you, it has a bad effect on you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The lack of sleep began to tell on the young mother, and she had dark circles under her eyes.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kakulangen te peglipereng ka egbunsuran te mareet ne egpangkusan te batè pad ne iney, wey due mallahem ne mallibusen ne egpakapalingut diyè te mata rin.

entries.summary: keinit wey ke kaagsil [ka͡agsil] te minsan nekey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: keinit wey ke kaagsil [ka͡agsil] te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: how hot or cold something is

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The temperature of the water was about 40 degrees.

entries.summary: panubaran; simbaan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a building where people worship a god by doing things such as praying and offering sacrifices.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the large house of God in Jerusalem. The priests offered sacrifices there. The temple is no longer there because it was destroyed.

entries.summary: egtintal; pegtintal; egpakatintal

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone tempts you to do something bad, they try to cause you to want to do it.

entries.summary: egtanggu te minsan hentew wey ke minsan nekey

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egtanggu te minsan hentew wey ke minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you tend someone, you care for them. If you tend something such as a garden, you care for it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is busy these days, because she is tending her sick mother.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His garden is good, because he tends it every day.

entries.summary: nalayaman wey ke nabatasan e ne gimuwen wey ke egkeyitabù; weil ne nabatasan wey nalayaman

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nalayaman wey ke nabatasan e ne gimuwen wey ke egkeyitabù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone tends to do something, that is the natural and common thing for them to. If something tends to happen, that is the natural and common thing that happens.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Turtles tend to put their head inside their shell when they are frightened.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a natural and common action for you

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My uncle has a tendency to forget things.

entries.summary: mewumel
ula-ula te me weil ne egpakita ke (miglihad e, sasangan pad, wey ke egginguma pad)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ula-ula te me weil ne egpakita ke (miglihad e, sasangan pad, wey ke egginguma pad)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the form of a verb which shows when it happened (in the past, present or future).

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: 'Nakita' ka neimpus e ne weil te 'egkakita'

entries.summary: newusud natamtamani; nakanat natamtamani; nalaggew wey ke nabeley; nahaha; naralusung; napehes

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a rope is tense, it is pulled tight.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The rope was so tense that it broke.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Newusud amana natamtamani ka lubid sikan naa ka nabugtus.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you feel tense, you feel a lot of stress.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He feels quite tense because he has a lot of exams at the moment.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a relationship or situation is tense, there is a lot of stress.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The two leaders did not like each other, so the meeting was very tense.

entries.summary: pegkeheet [pegkehe͡et] (te minsan nekey); pegkalaggew wey ke pegkabeley; prublima te rilasyun ne ka etew; kenè meupiya se peggeram-geram te tagsè sabeka.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: how tightly something such as a rope is pulled.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The sound of that kuglung is not good. Perhaps we should change the tension of the strings.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka dahing te kuglung su kenè ne meupiya. Egbalbalawan te buwa ka pegkeheet [pegkehe͡et] te me kuwirdas.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: prublima te rilasyun ne ka etew; kenè meupiya se peggeram-geram te tagsè sabeka.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: problems in a relationship, so that people do not feel comfortable together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a lot of tension between the two leaders.

entries.summary: igngaran; egngaranan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a word or group of words for a particular thing, especially in a special area of knowledge (e.g., science).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What is the scientific term for that plant?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you term something, you give it a name or say what you think it is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Experts have termed it the worst flood for 100 years.

entries.summary: katammanan ne timpu (meyitenged te aldew; uras; simana; bulan wey ke tuig); sabeka ne baad te leg-un diyè te iskuylaan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: katammanan ne timpu (meyitenged te aldew; uras; simana; bulan wey ke tuig)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a fixed period of time (e.g., a president's term of office, a prison term).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sabeka ne baad te leg-un diyè te iskuylaan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one part of a year at a school or college, between vacations or breaks.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our school year is divided into 2 terms.

entries.summary: klasiyan te rilasyun; nenakatahù ne kasabutan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If two people or groups are on particular terms, that is the kind of relationship that they have (e.g. on friendly terms, on bad terms).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I am on first-name terms with my boss, because we were classmates before.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: When people or groups have an agreement, the terms are the things that each one has to do or accept.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: According to the terms of his contract, he cannot work more than 40 hours per week.

entries.summary: mareet amana
eggeraman; eg-el-elehan; egpitawen; peg-eleg-eleg; peggeram

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you test something, you try it to see what it is like.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She tested the soup and decided that it needed more salt.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggeraman din ka sabew wey natuenan din ne keilangan pad te asin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He tested the water temperature with his foot before he jumped in.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you test someone or something, you do something to see if they are strong, or good or real.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This race is long and hard, and will really test your fitness.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seini ne lumba mariyù wey malised, wey kayi ta iya egkeel-elehi ke mamenu iya ka katuenan nu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that shows if a person or thing is strong, good or real.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This race will be a test of your fitness.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggeraman ka minsan hentew wey ke minsan nekey te nateil ne kasangkapan eyew egkatahaan ke due ka sika ne butang diyè te kandan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you test someone or something for a particular thing (e.g., a chemical), you study them to see if they have that thing in them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They tested the sportsmen for drugs.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggeraman dan ka manggalaway ne me lukes para te druga.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They tested the food for insecticides.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegtengteng eyew te pegnengneng ke due nateil te kasangkapan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you do to a person or thing to find if they have a particular thing in them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The test for TB is quite reliable.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggeram eyew te pegnengneng te katuenan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you test someone, you ask them to do things or answer questions to check if they know something or can do something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our teacher tests us every Friday on the things we've studied during the week.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peggeram ne due igpeyimu wey ke due igpatabak ne me inse eyew te pegnengneng ke due natuenan dan wey ke egpekeyimu naa sikandan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a set of questions or activities which you do to check if you can do something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We have a spelling test every morning.

entries.summary: egtistigus; egpamalehet; egpakapamalehet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you testify in court, you promise to tell the truth, and you speak about what you have seen or what you know.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I saw the crime, so I needed to testify in court.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something testifies_to another thing, it shows that the other thing is true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her good results testified to her hard work.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka meupiya ne risulta migpamalehet te migtrabahu sikandin te mangune-kunè.

entries.summary: ka eglalahen nu diyè te kurti ke egtistigus ka; ka igkalalag nu ne butang meyitenged ke nekey ka nakita nu wey neula-ula.; egpakapamalehet; egpamalehet

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka eglalahen nu diyè te kurti ke egtistigus ka

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the things that you say when you testify in court.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka igkalalag nu ne butang meyitenged ke nekey ka nakita nu wey neula-ula.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the things you say about what you have seen and experienced.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing is a testimony to another thing, it shows that the other thing is true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her good results are a testimony to her hard work.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka meupiya ne risulta egpakapamalehet kandin ne meupiya ka pegtrabahu rin.

entries.summary: sinulat; deisek ne sinulat ne puun te silpun; tiks; egpeuyan te sinulat ne lalag puun te silpun

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Look at the text below the picture.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Pitew ka te sinulat sika te diralem te litratu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: deisek ne sinulat ne puun te silpun; tiks

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a short written message that you send from a cellphone.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpeuyan te sinulat ne lalag puun te silpun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you text someone, you send them a written message from a cellphone.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She texted me to say that she couldn't come.

entries.summary: kunterè; du te

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use than to compare things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My brother is taller than me.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka suled ku malmalangkew kunterè keddì.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The table is more expensive than I can afford.

entries.summary: egpasalamat; pegpasalamat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you thank someone, you say 'thank you' to them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We should give him our thanks for his help.

entries.summary: sika; seeyè; due (meyitenged te sabeka ne kasangkapan ne mariyù keykew); seeyè (meyitenged te minsan nekey ne neimpusan e); seika (meyitenged te peglalag te miglalag te duma)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sika; seeyè; due (meyitenged te sabeka ne kasangkapan ne mariyù keykew)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use that to talk about something which is not close to you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That seat over there is for you.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seeyè se diyè dapit ne pinuuwan su para keykew.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A: That is my sister, Sarah; she is the one wearing a red shirt.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: seeyè (meyitenged te minsan nekey ne neimpusan e)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use that to talk about something which is finished.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: seika (meyitenged te peglalag te miglalag te duma)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use that to say more about something which someone has just talked about.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A: There is a typhoon in Luzon. B: Oh, that's not good.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: A: Due bagiyu diyè te Lusun. B:Tuwey, kenè ne meupiya seika.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: seeyè dè (meyitenged te miglihad ne timpu te nekeg-iling ne aldew)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use that to talk about a past time that was in the same day, week, or year as another time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I finished the book in the morning, and that afternoon I went for a walk.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-impusan ku rè ka libru te maselem, wey te seeyè dè ne maapun [ma͡apun] migleug-leug ad.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ne (egkahamit seini te peglalag pad meyitenged te etew, lugar wey ke butang).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use that to say something more about a person, place or thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'll tell you about the movie that I saw.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpangguhud a kuna te salida ne nakita ku.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: te (egkahamit seini te kenè pad ke deisek dè ne pangasaken ne baad te kinarakelan ne pangasak)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use that before a smaller sentence which is part of a bigger sentence.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I know that you heard me ['you heard me' is the smaller sentence].

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakataha a te nakarineg ka keddiey.

entries.summary: ka; te (egkahamit seini ke eglalag ka te amana nu egkamelmelehi ne butang wey ke me butang. Egkeyimu ne kasabeka rè wey ke nalalag nud seini dengan).; ka; te (egkahamit seini te kenè pad ka sabeka rè ne ngaran eyew te peglalag te langun ne grupu te seeyè ne me butang); ka; te (egkahamit nu seini te kenè pad ka me lalag eyew te pegpanengneng meyitenged te grupu te me etew wey ke me butang ne iyan iya ka igpasabut te me lalag).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka; te (egkahamit seini ke eglalag ka te amana nu egkamelmelehi ne butang wey ke me butang. Egkeyimu ne kasabeka rè wey ke nalalag nud seini dengan).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use the when it is clear exactly which thing or things you are talking about. This can be because there is only one, or because you talked about it before.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Manila is the capital of the Philippines [there is only one capital].

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka Manila ka kepital ne siyudad te Pilipinas [sabeka rè ka kepital].

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a tree beside my house. The tree is dead. [Note the first time you use a].

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Are you going to watch the basketball game on Saturday?

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka; te (egkahamit seini te kenè pad ka sabeka rè ne ngaran eyew te peglalag te langun ne grupu te seeyè ne me butang)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use the before a singular noun to talk about the whole group of those things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The cellphone is a very useful thing.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka silpun amana ne egpakabulig ne butang.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka; te (egkahamit nu seini te kenè pad ka me lalag eyew te pegpanengneng meyitenged te grupu te me etew wey ke me butang ne iyan iya ka igpasabut te me lalag).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use the before some adjectives to talk about the group of people or things which the adjective describes.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She promises to help the poor.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migsaaad sikandin ne egbulig te pubri.

entries.summary: Egkahamit seini ke eglalag ki te timpu ne miglihad e wey egginguma pad.; pegkeimpus; pegkapenga; nataman; nè; na

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini ke eglalag ki te timpu ne miglihad e wey egginguma pad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use then to talk about a time in the past or future.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm going to Quezon next Monday, so I'll buy some fruit then.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eggendiya a te Kisun te seup ne Lunis, purisu egbebeli ad en iya te prutas.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I didn't know her then, but now we are good friends.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Wara a nekeila dengan kandin, piru kuntee amana key e ne alukuy.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use then to talk about the thing that happens next.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I ate dinner and then I relaxed.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miglabung a wey pegkeimpus miggimeley ad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use then to connect something to another thing said before.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We know that we need to do something to fix the problem. What, then, is the best thing to do?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakataha ki ne keilangan ne due eggimuwen ta eyew te peg-ayad-ayad te prublima. Na, nekey naa ka meupiya ne eggimuwen ta?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A: I just lost my bag. B: Then why are you smiling?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nalaag ka baag ku. B:Nè mania te eggimun-gimun ka?

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: emun ke...ne henduen pad (egkahamit seini ke eglalag ka meyitenged egpangkusan te minsan nekey ne egkeyitabù pad).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use if_..._then to talk about the result of something that may happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If she forgets, then I will need to call her.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Emun ke egkalingew sikandin, ne henduen pad ne keilangan ne eg-umew a kandin.

entries.summary: puhawang; suman-suman; pamaahi wey katuenan; mapuhawang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an idea or group of ideas about how something works or why it happens. People are not 100% sure that it is true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are different theories about how the pyramids in Egypt were built.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due nalein-lein ne me puhawang meyitenged ke immenu te pegbebaley ka batu diyè te Ihiptu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I know the theory of how to make a raft, but I've never done it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakataha a te pamaahi wey katuenan te peggimu te gakit, piru warè e pad nekeyimu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: related to theory (ideas), not to practice (actually doing something).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My course is very theoretical; we don't have much chance to use what we learn.

entries.summary: due; seeyè te (meyitenged te lugar); duen te pad; kayi te pad (meyitenged te nateil ne uras te himuwen)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use there is or there are to say that something exists.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a mango tree near my house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due lawa te mangga diyè te dulug te baley ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use there to talk about another place, not where you you now.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Is that your bike there near the house?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Bayik nu ka seeyè te dulug te baley?

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: duen te pad; kayi te pad (meyitenged te nateil ne uras te himuwen)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use there to to talk about a certain time in an activity.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Let's stop the lesson there, and we'll continue tomorrow.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Duen te pad egtamana ka egpangasaken ta, wey kaaselem kid egpabulus.

entries.summary: sika naa; kan naa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use therefore to say that something happens or is true because of another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The Philippines has many islands. Therefore travel is sometimes difficult.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due masalig ne Isla te Pilipinas. Sika naa ka pegleug-leug diyè sengekakuwa malised.

entries.summary: seini (meyitenged te daruwa wey ke masulug ne kasangkapan ne marani rè keykew); seini; seika (meyitenged te peglalag te minsan nekey ne miglalag e wey ke eglalahen pad)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: seini (meyitenged te daruwa wey ke masulug ne kasangkapan ne marani rè keykew)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use these to talk about two or more things which are close to you.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini red, kua nu seini se me beyabas.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: seini; seika (meyitenged te peglalag te minsan nekey ne miglalag e wey ke eglalahen pad)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use these to talk about something which you've just said, or something which you are going to say.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's too expensive, and it will take too much time. These are the reasons why I disagree with the plan.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana sika ne mahal, wey egkaluhey pad sika. Seini ka egpuunan ne kena a egkabennalan te planu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: These are the reasons why I disagree with the plan: first, it's too expensive, and second, it will take too much time.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ka egpuunan ne kena a egkabennalan te planu: an-anayan, amana sika ne mahal, igkarangeb, aman pad sika egkaluhey.

entries.summary: sikandan; nikandan; dan; ran
makepal; kakepal; mabehat wey kenè ne malemu ne egtulayas

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something thick has a large measurement between the two opposite sides (e.g., a thick book).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use thick to give the measurement of something from one side to the opposite side.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The piece of wood was 5cm thick.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Lalimma ne sintimitru ka kakepal te sengebuuk ne kayu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mabehat wey kenè ne malemu ne egtulayas

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A thick liquid does not flow easily, because it is heavy (e.g., honey).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something thick has many things close together (e.g., thick hair).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It was difficult to walk in the thick forest, because the trees were very close together.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Amana ne malised ka eggipanew diyè te katalunan puun te nasahensek wey mabenes ka me kayu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as smoke or cloud is thick, it is difficult to see through it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was thick smoke from the fire, so I couldn't see anything.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due makepal ne ebel puun te hapuy, sikak warè egkakita ku minsan nekey.

entries.summary: takawen
bubun
mahasè; manipis; marelag; salsalimbeka

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A thin person does not have much fat on their body.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something thin has a small measurement between the two opposite sides (e.g., a thin book).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as hair is thin, there are not many things and they are not close together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father is losing his hair, so his hair is thin.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka amey ku egkeupew e, sika ka bulbul rin salsalimbeka naan dè.

entries.summary: kasangkapan; butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: anything, physical (e.g., a ball) or non-physical (e.g., a fact, or a problem)

entries.summary: egsumsumanen; egkasuman-suman; sahuhunè ne egkasuman-suman; egpakalambag te suman-suman

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you think, you use your brain to understand or decide something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can't answer you yet because I need to think.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè e pad egpakatabak keykew su egsumsumanen ku pad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you think_about something, that thing is in your mind for some time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I think about you a lot.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sahuhunè ne egkasuman-suman; egpakalambag te suman-suman

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you think_of something, it suddenly comes into your mind.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I suddenly thought of his name.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sahuhunè ne nakalambag te suman-suman ku ka ngaran din.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can't think of an answer to your question.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena a egpakasuman-suman te igtabak ku te insè nu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you think that something is the case, it is your opinion.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I think that it's important to work hard.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you think that something is a fact, you believe it is a fact, but you are not sure if you are correct.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can't remember exactly, but I think he said that he was going there tomorrow.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ku egkasuman-suman egkaay-ayari, piru hendue te migkahi sikandin te eggendue kaaselem.

entries.summary: mara

seini (meyitenged te sabeka ne kasangkapan ne marani rè keykew); seini (meyitenged te minsan nekey ne sasangan pad ne egkeyitabù); seini; seika (meyitenged te peglalag te minsan nekey ne miglalag e wey ke eglalahen pad)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: seini (meyitenged te sabeka ne kasangkapan ne marani rè keykew)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use this to talk about something which is close to you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This seat here is for you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A: This is my sister, Sarah. B: Pleased to meet you, Sarah.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: seini (meyitenged te minsan nekey ne sasangan pad ne egkeyitabù)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use this to talk about something which is happening now.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mateles amana ka seini ne kunsirtu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: seini; seika (meyitenged te peglalag te minsan nekey ne miglalag e wey ke eglalahen pad)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use this to talk about something which you've just said, or something which you are going to say.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a typhoon in Luzon, and this is the reason for the rainy weather here.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due bagyu diyè te Lusun, wey seika ka aliddanan mania te eg-uran-uran degma kayi.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This is my idea: let's go to the river to swim.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ka sumamsuman ku: kuwa kid egpamanihus ki diyè te dakel ne weyig.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use this to talk about a time (before or after now) that is in the same day, or week, or year as now.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I finished the book this morning [part of today].

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Neimpusan kud ka libru te seini ne kaseleman.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I will go there this August [part of the same year as now].

entries.summary: duhi
sika; seeyè; due (meyitenged te daruwa wey ke masulug ne kasangkapan ne mariyù keykew); seeyè (meyitenged te nateil ne grupu te me etew)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sika; seeyè; due (meyitenged te daruwa wey ke masulug ne kasangkapan ne mariyù keykew)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use those to talk about two or more things which are not close to you

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Those guavas on the table over there are for you.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seeyè ne me beyabas te dibabew te lamisa su para kuna.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: seeyè (meyitenged te nateil ne grupu te me etew)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use those to talk about a particular group of people.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Those who arrived late could not find a seat.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seeyè se migginguma ne namewuri kenad egpakapinnuu.

entries.summary: pegsuman-suman; puhawang; sumansuman

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of think

entries.summary: tanud
abelengan; lieg

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the part of the body inside the neck.

entries.summary: egbayè; eg-usug; egselag; taman te; tenged te

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you move through something, you enter it on one side of it, and leave from the other side.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The rain came through the wall of the house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka uran migselag te alabat te baley.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: At the candy store, I pointed through the window at the one which I wanted.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Instead of going around the city, he went straight through the middle of town.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happens through a period of time, it continues for the whole time, or happens more than once in that time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It rained all through the night, without stopping.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-uran taman te marusilem, wey warad iya migsanggel.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She woke up a few times through the night.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She fell asleep through total exhaustion.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpakalipereng sikandin tenged te amana nabeley.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use through to talk about the way or method by which something happens.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I heard about the job through my friend.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakarineg a meyitenged te trabahu pinaahi te alukuy ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She passed her exams through working hard.

entries.summary: egdegpak; pegdegpak; egpakaparegpak

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you throw something, you use your hand and arm to make it fly through the air.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He threw the ball to his friend.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migdegpak din ka bula diyè te alukuy rin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That was a good throw, because the ball went very far.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Meupiya seeyè ne pegdegpak, su ka bula mariyù ka nabayaan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something throws another thing, it causes that thing to fly through the air.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When the motorbike hit the tree, it threw the rider into the air.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te ka mutur nakabangga te kayu, nakaparegpak seini te nanguntud.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something throws a light or shadow on something, it causes that light or shadow to be on something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The sun threw a warm light on the mountains.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka aldew nakapalayag te iiniti diyè te bubungan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The candles threw long shadows on the walls of our house.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egweil te baad ne lawa te sisiyapati eyew te nateil ne pegkatahù

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you throw a part of your body into a position, you move it very quickly into that position.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She threw her head back to look at the airplane.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miglingi sikandin te sisiyapati eyew te pegtengteng te eriplanu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: iiyali wey ke sisiyapati ne egpekepeyimu te nateil ne sitwasyun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a situation or action throws people or places into a particular state, it quickly causes them to be in that state.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The news threw everyone into panic.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka balita iiyali ne nakapasasew te tagsè sabeka ne etew.

entries.summary: timbebakal
luhung
sika ka; iling due; sasangan pad kuntee

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use thus to say that one thing happens or is true because of another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I woke up late and thus was also late for work.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mananey a nekeyimata, sika ka namewuri ad e degma te himu ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: like that, in that way (the way that you just talked about). (used in formal language).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She lay down on the concrete floor, and she lay thus for two hours.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Diyè sikandin miggibat te seeg ne simintu, wey migbahed sikandin iling due te daruwa ne uras.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: in the time up to now.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We haven't had any problems thus far.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sasangan pad kuntee ne warè prublima ku.

entries.summary: hiket
hehet
eggeheten
timpu; uras; panahun

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the thing which is made of the past, present and future. We measure it with seconds, minutes, hours, etc.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Time passes quickly when you are enjoying yourself.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka timpu amana ne iiyali ne eglihad labi en iya ke egkahalè ka.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a specific point in a day or night (e.g., 7pm).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a period of minutes, hours, weeks, etc.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Last month was a hard time for us, because there was no rain.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka miglihad ne bulan su amana ne malised kanta ne panahun, tenged su warè uran.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Do you remember the time when the carabao chased you?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakasuman-suman ka te timpu ne inglupug ka te kalabew?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you time someone or something, you measure how long their action takes.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our sports teacher timed us when we ran the 100m race.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka talagpanulù te galew ney mig-uras kanami te pegpallahuy ney te sabeka ne gatus ne mitrus.

entries.summary: lata
pupul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the pointed end of something long.

entries.summary: gumà diyè te diralem te ligid

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: gumà diyè te diralem te ligid

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the round rubber thing which you put on a wheel on a vehicle.

entries.summary: egpakahuyè; egpakabeley; egmahuyè; egkabeley; egkaawaan te keseg; nabeley; mahuyè; warad keseg

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something tires you, it causes you to have no more energy, so you need to rest.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you tire, you lose your energy.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are tired, you have no more energy.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something tiring causes you to feel tired.

entries.summary: uluwan ne ngaran te minsan nekey iling te libru; ka igngaran te etew te kenè pad ka ngaran dan ne egpataha ke hentew-a sikandan (iling ke lukes naa, malitan naa, duktur naa, wey duma pad); katenged te pegpangamuney te minsan nekey (iling te tanè)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: uluwan ne ngaran te minsan nekey iling te libru

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the name of something like a book

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka igngaran te etew te kenè pad ka ngaran dan ne egpataha ke hentew-a sikandan (iling ke lukes naa, malitan naa, duktur naa, wey duma pad)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The title of a person is the word that goes before their name to show their status (e.g., Mr, Mrs, Doctor).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: katenged te pegpangamuney te minsan nekey (iling te tanè)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: your title to something such as land is your right to own it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Matigsalugs have title to their land.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the fact that you are the winner in a sports competition.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our team won the title in the competition last year.

entries.summary: peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te; diyè te (meyitenged te egpeuyanan wey ke eggendiyaan); taman te; peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te; ligkat te; naan dè ne (te kenè pad)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te; diyè te (meyitenged te egpeuyanan wey ke eggendiyaan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something goes to a place, that is the place where they finish.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She sent an email to me.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: taman te; peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te; ligkat te

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you do something to a particular time, you do it until that time.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-iskuyla a ligkat te alas utsu te maselem taman te alas kwatru te maapun [ma͡apun].

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: When telling the time, to means 'before'

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Beyinti naan dè ne minutus ne eg-alas siti.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: te (egpanengneng te rilasyun te daruwa ne seked wey ke karakelan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use to to show the relationship between two measurements or amounts.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Combine one part milk powder to four parts water.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ipegsewug nu ka sabekan baad ne gatas te hep-at ne baad te weyig.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This car does 20km to the liter.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ne (egkahamit seini impus te lein ne weil)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: After some verbs (e.g. want and forget), you use to before another verb. This is a verb pattern.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian ad ne eg-uli diyè te baley.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use to before a verb to explain why someone does something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They worked hard to finish the field.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpangune-kunè sikandan migtrabahu eyew te peg-impus te kamet.
