entries.summary: tabaku
kuntee (meyitenged te sasangan ne timpu); kuntee (meyitenged te keugpè)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the time around now in history

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Life today is very different from life fifty years ago.

entries.summary: tinurù
egparumdumeey [egparumdume͡ey]; egpabulbulihey; egkasabeka; egkapunpun; egkalibulung; egkalimud; egpekeg-iling-iling (meyitenged te nenekegdengan-dengan ne peggimu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people do something together, they work as a group to do it, or do it with each other.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people or things are together, they are close to each other or are joined.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My clothes are all together in the box.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka langun ne me kumbalè ku nasabeka diyè te kehun.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He tied the two ropes together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The frightened children stood close together.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people do something together, they do it at the same time.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use together to talk about a group of things as one group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: the value of all his animals together is more than 10,000P.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kentidad langun te me mananap din su subla te sapulù ne libu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of tell

entries.summary: kaaselem
dilè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the large, soft, moving part in the middle of the mouth. It is used for eating and speaking.

entries.summary: te seini ne karukileman
ded maa; red maa; red degma; red man-e; degma; egkasublaan [egkasubla͡an] sika ka due prublima

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ded maa; red maa; red degma; red man-e

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use too to add something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I lost my keys, and I lost my cell phone, too.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nalaag ku ka yabi ku, wey nalaag ku red maa ka silpun ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use too to say that something is true of another person or thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She likes cooking and her brother likes it too.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian sikandin ne egsusubba wey ka suled din degma.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use too to say that something is more than it should be, so there is a problem.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This coffee is too hot, so I can't drink it yet.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Iiniti pad seini se keppi, sika ka ke ku pad egkeinum.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She put in too much coffee, so I don't like it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nasublaan [nasubla͡an] ka keppi ne intahù din, sika ka kena a egkeupian.

entries.summary: ka butang ne eggamiten te nateil ne himu, iling te bilding wey ke gamit diyè te kamet.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka butang ne eggamiten te nateil ne himu, iling te bilding wey ke gamit diyè te kamet.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a thing that you use to do a particular task, such as building or working in the field.

entries.summary: ngipen; ngipen te sugkad wey ke minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a hard, white bony thing in the mouth of a person or animal, used to bite.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ngipen te sugkad wey ke minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: One of the pointed things on something such as a comb or zip.

entries.summary: ampew; puntul; pinakamatikang; uluwan; egdumaan; egtingareen; kinewun-aan; kinaribabawan; insaluub ne minsan nekey te me etew diyè te lawa ran

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the highest part of something (e.g., the top of a hill).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pinakamatikang; uluwan; egdumaan; egtingareen; kinewun-aan; kinaribabawan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the top person or thing is the best or most important one.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Being the president is the top job in this country.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is the top runner in the competition.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: insaluub ne minsan nekey te me etew diyè te lawa ran

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that a man or woman wears on the upper part of their body (e.g., a T-shirt)

entries.summary: ulayan ne egtilengen; kasing; terumpu
ka etew wey ke kasangkapan ne eglalahen

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka etew wey ke kasangkapan ne eglalahen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the person or thing that you are talking about.

entries.summary: nahisi; nabindas; nawatak

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as paper or cloth is torn, it is damaged because the parts of it have been pulled apart.

entries.summary: seel te langun puun te pinegtimul; egpekeuma (meyitenged te seel te langun); egpegtimul

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: seel te langun puun te pinegtimul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the result when you add numbers together, or count how many things there are in a group.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka seel te hen-em wey hep-at su sapulù langun.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has a total of 12 chickens.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The total number of people there was 24.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an amount totals a certain number, that is how much it is after you add things together, or count how many there are.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka punduk ney nekeuma te daruwan pulù wey hep-at, labet e ka me batè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you total amounts, you add them together to find how many there are altogether.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She totalled the cost using a calculator.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpegtimul sikandin te kentidad gamit te kalkyulitur.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: leleheti (egkahamit seini ke leleheti ka eglalahen)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is total, it is 100% the case.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I've never met him, so he is a total stranger to me.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè e pad nakalambag kandin, sika ka leleheti ne iyam sikandin kayi te keddì.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: iya (egkahamit sika ke leleheti ka eglalahen)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is totally the case, it is 100% the case.

entries.summary: egsamsam; egpakaragket; 1 pegsamsam; 2 pegpakaragket

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you touch something, you put your finger or hand on it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Don't touch the pot because it is hot.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ka egsamsam te kendiru su meinit.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He touched the carabao on the head.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If one thing touches another thing, part of the two things are together for some time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The table is touching the wall.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The baby stopped crying at the touch of his mother's hand.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migsanggel ka batè te pegsinehew te pegsamsam te iney rin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the ability to feel things with your hands.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The sense of touch is one of the five senses.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka egpakaheram te pegsamsam sabeka te lalimma ne katuenan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakaheram te nateil ne eggeramen puun te minsan nekey iling te keyid-u wey ke geyinawa.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something touches you, it causes you to feel an emotion such as compassion or love.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka dasag din amana nakapatandug keddì.

entries.summary: hipanew
egpeendiyè [egpe͡endiyè] te; marani; te (meyitenged te egpekewun-a te kenè pad ka nateil ne timpu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you move or look towards a place, that place is the direction that you move or look.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: To get to Buda from Quezon, go towards Davao.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka eggendiyè te Buda puun te Kisun, egpeendiyè [egpe͡endiyè] te Dabaw.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is towards a place, it is near that place, but just before it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I usually sit towards the front of the bus.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Layun a egpinnuu diyè te marani tangkaan te batsilur.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: te (meyitenged te egpekewun-a te kenè pad ka nateil ne timpu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happens towards a certain time, it happens a short time before then.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I always get busier towards the end of the year.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Layun a egkabita-bita te pegpalundaniyan te keepusan te tuig.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: People start preparing their traditional clothes towards Fiesta time.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eyew te pegbulig (meyitenged te baad te kentidad)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you put money towards something, you give the money to pay part of the cost of that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She gave me some money towards my school fees.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbehayan a nikandin te seleppì eyew te pegbulig te bayaranen ku te iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an].

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your behavior towards someone is the things that you do and say to them. Your feelings towards someone are the way that you feel about them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His behavior towards me is always respectful.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegbebatasan din peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te keddì su layun maaddat.

entries.summary: labakara
pamantawanan
lugar ne bayew deisek te siyudad; lungsud

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: lugar ne bayew deisek te siyudad; lungsud

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of buildings and houses larger than a village but smaller than a city

entries.summary: galawan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that is made of a child to play with.

entries.summary: kinareisekan ne karakelan te minsan nekey; minsan nekey ne nahaat [naha͡at] wey ke neengkeran; egpamitew te aliddanan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kinareisekan ne karakelan te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a very small amount of something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There were traces of fat in the meat, but not very much.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due deisek amana ne kalambuan te ngalap, piru kenè dè amana ne dakel.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: minsan nekey ne nahaat [naha͡at] wey ke neengkeran

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which remains which shows that someone or something was in a place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There were a few pieces of wood on the ground, which were traces of a house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due memallintek ne tempug te kayu diyè te tanè, ne nahaat [naha͡at] te baley.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The police couldn't find any trace of the lost man.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you trace something, you find the cause of it, or the place where it comes from.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He traced the water problem to a broken pipe.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impamitew rin ka aliddanan te prublima te weyig wey nakita rin ne nareetan bes ka tubu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you trace someone or something, you find them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Police can't trace the lost man.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè egkakita te me pulis ka natarin ne etew.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpeilahen ka alung eyew eg-ilingan diyè te pepil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you trace a picture, you put a very thin piece of paper on it, and use a pencil to mark the lines of the picture on the paper.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He traced the map out of the book onto the paper.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impeilag din ka mapa diyè te libru wey mig-ilingan din diyè te pepil.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you trace a line, you follow it with your finger.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He traced the river on the map.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpeik-ikulan din tinurua ka pahamayan ne weyig diyè te mapa.

entries.summary: malig-et ne dalan
egpegsaliyuwey; egpabelbelegyeey; egpasalsaliyuwey; pegpabelbelegyeey wey pegpasalsaliyuwey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you trade something with someone, you give something to them, and they give something to you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I would like to trade my motorbike for a smaller one, because mine uses a lot of fuel.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I traded lunch with my friend because I liked his better.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people, companies or countries trade with each other, they buy things from and sell things to each other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The farmers in our area have traded with that company for years.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the work of buying, selling and exchanging things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The Philippines does a lot of trade with that country.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a shop trades, it sells things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The trading hours of that shop are 7am to 7pm.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka uras te pegpameligyè te tindaan [tinda͡an] su alas siti te maselem peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te alas siti te marusilem.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That shop has been trading there for many years.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a particular kind of business (e.g., the tourist trade, the rice trade).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: klasiyan te himu seini ne egkeilangan te pinasahi ne pegbebasbas (iling te iliktrikal, plastiring, mikaniku).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a kind of practical job that needs special training (e.g., electrical work, plastering, mechanics).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He is very good at fixing things, so he should learn a trade such as mechanics.

entries.summary: menà; batasan; pegbebatasan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that a group of people have believed or done for a long time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our family's tradition is to make biku on birthdays.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Many young people don't know old Matigsalug traditions.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is traditional, people have believed or done it for a long time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We always wear traditional Matigsalug dress for the parade at Fiesta.

entries.summary: egbebasbas wey egnengnengen eyew egkeyimu ne minsan nekey; egbebasbas; egbebasbas eyew te galew

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbebasbas wey egnengnengen eyew egkeyimu ne minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you train to be something, or train as something, you study and learn so that you can be that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is training to be a nurse.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you train for something such as a sports event, you do exercise so that you will be ready for it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We've been training for the marathon for three months.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you train a person to do something, you teach them how to do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: At the moment, my boss is training the new workers in how to use the machines.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you train an animal to do something, you teach them how to do it by practising many times with them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We trained the dog to sit when we tell it to.

entries.summary: unturanan (malayat ne terak ne nateil dè ka egbayaan); punduk te me puhawang wey pangitabù ne nekesinsinundul

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: unturanan (malayat ne terak ne nateil dè ka egbayaan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a line of cars joined together and pulled along tracks by an engine.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: punduk te me puhawang wey pangitabù ne nekesinsinundul

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of ideas or events which happen in order, one after the other (e.g., a train of thought, a train of events).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He spoke to me while I was thinking, and so I lost my train of thought.

entries.summary: eggalinen; eggalin te eg-ugpaan; peggalin

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you transfer something, you move it from one place to another.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She transferred the rice from the pot to the plate.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggalin din ka keenen puun te kendiru diyè te platu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you transfer somewhere, you move from one place to that other place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When his family moved to a different town, he transferred to another school.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te peggalin te taltalaanak diyè te lein ne lungsud, miggalin e sikandin te lein ne iskuylaan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of moving something from one place to another.

entries.summary: egbalbalawan e iya; egpakabalew-balew; 1 pegbalew-balew; 2 pegpakabalew-balew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you transform something, you change it a lot so that it is very different from before.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They transformed their yard into a beautiful garden.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbalbalawan dan en iya ka lama ran: miggimu ran ne meupiyan gulayan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something transforms a person or thing, it changes them so that they are very different.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakabalew-balew kandin ka kandin ne me nabaybayaan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The rain transformed the dry field into a beautiful, green field.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We watched the caterpillar's transformation into a butterfly.

entries.summary: pegpanguntud; pegpanggated; tetemuwanan te etew te pegtetahad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of carrying people or things in vehicles. If people or things are in_transit, they are travelling somewhere in vehicles.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His bags were lost in transit.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka baag [ba͡ag] din nalaag te pegpanguntud.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use transit to talk about a place where people or things wait between different parts of their travel.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The bus terminal is a kind of transit area for people who are waiting for their next bus.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka tetaharanan te terak sabeka ne klasiyan te temuwanan te me etew eyew te pegtetahad te terak.

entries.summary: pegbalew-balew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the process of changing from one state or situation to another (make_a_transition).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When we moved to a different town, the transition was difficult for our children.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te peggalin ney te lein ne lungsud, ka pegbalew-balew te me anak ney amana ne malised.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We made a transition from eating white rice to eating red rice.

entries.summary: weil ne due elin eglalahen wey egpakarawat te lalag. Due etew wey ke butang eggimu te weil, wey due degma etew wey ke butang ne egpakarawat te weil.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: weil ne due elin eglalahen wey egpakarawat te lalag. Due etew wey ke butang eggimu te weil, wey due degma etew wey ke butang ne egpakarawat te weil.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a verb which has both a subject and an object. There is a person or thing which does the action, and also a person or thing which receives the action.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He kicked the ball ['He' is the subject, and 'the ball' is the object].

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Insipè din ka bula ['din' ka eglalahen, ne 'ka bula' ka butang ne egdawat te weil].

entries.summary: egluwas
talagluwas
me unturan; egmeuntud eyew te pegpanggated

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Motorbikes, jeepneys and vans are all kinds of transport.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you transport people or things, you move them from one place to another using vehicles.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They transported us to the city in a bus.

entries.summary: eggendiyè; egpakapeendiyè [egpekape͡endiyè] (meyitenged te kalamag wey ke egkarineg)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you travel to a place (usually a far away place), you go there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They traveled a long way to visit us.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakapeendiyè [egpekape͡endiyè] (meyitenged te kalamag wey ke egkarineg)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If light or sound travels, it moves through the air so that people can see or hear it in another place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The sound of the loud music traveled far.

entries.summary: tahuanan te platu
eggamit ka kayi ke eglalag ka meyitenged te pamaahi te pegtanggu wey ke pegtumpis.; egtuganul; egbawì

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggamit ka kayi ke eglalag ka meyitenged te pamaahi te pegtanggu wey ke pegtumpis.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you treat someone a certain way (e.g., badly, kindly, like a son), that is the way that you behave towards them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He treats his animals very well, so they are healthy and happy.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Intumpisan din ka me mananap din upiani, sika ka mallambeg sikandan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I like our teacher because he treats us as adults.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you treat something a certain way, that is the way that you use it or behave towards it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Treat this book with care, because it was very expensive.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Tuganula nu seini se libru ne due pegtumpis, su amana seini ne mahal.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you treat someone who is sick, you give medical care.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The burned child was treated at the clinic.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggamit te kimikals eyew te pegbalew-balew te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you treat something, you use a chemical to change it in some way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In cities they treat the water to make it safer to drink.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakeen wey ke egpalewuk-lewuk te senge-etew wey sikandin ka balahad ne eggastu wey te pegbayad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you treat someone to food or to some good experience, you pay for them.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kasangkapan wey ke keyimtang ne amana ne meupiya wey kenè amana ne malasi.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a special, good thing or experience which doesn't happen often.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We only have biku on birthdays, so it is a special treat.

entries.summary: pegtanggu; pegtuganul; peg-uyan; pegtambal; pegbawì; peggamit te kimikals eyew te pegbalew-balew te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the way that you behave towards a person or use a thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I am angry because of his bad treatment of his children.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nalangetan a tenged te mareet ne peg-uyan din te me anak din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: medical care for a sick person

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is receiving treatment for TB.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peggamit te kimikals eyew te pegbalew-balew te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a process in which you use a chemical to change something in some way.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This building is for the treatment of water for the city.

entries.summary: kayu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a plant with a woody section growing out of the ground, and leaves at the top.

entries.summary: egkawelwel
nabantug ne kapandayan; kinatibuk-an ne pegkaalin [pegka͡alin]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something which is popular with a lot of people.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's a trend at the moment to wear your hair like that.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nabantug kuntee ne kapandayan ka eg-ilingen due ka bulbul.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She liked to keep up with the trends in fashion.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a trend towards buying brown sugar rather than white sugar.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due kinatibuk-an ne pegkaalin [pegka͡alin] te pegbebeli te makalawag ne sukal du te maangkag ne sukal.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a downward trend in the price of gas.

entries.summary: kalised; peg-eleg-eleg; Minsan hentew ne nakasalè, eggendiyè sikandan te kurti eyew egkanengnengan ke nakasalè naa wey ke warè; eggeraman eyew egkatahaan [egkataha͡an] ke mamenu ne eggimu ka minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that is very difficult, which tests you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Losing my job was a real trial.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Dakel ne kalised te pegkatarin te trabahu ku.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Minsan hentew ne nakasalè, eggendiyè sikandan te kurti eyew egkanengnengan ke nakasalè naa wey ke warè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people say that someone committed a crime, they go to a court for a trial, where people decide if the person is innocent or guilty.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: All of the newspapers had stories about the trial of the robbers.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eggeraman eyew egkatahaan [egkataha͡an] ke mamenu ne eggimu ka minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you trial something, you use it so that you can see how it works.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The company is trialling a new TB drug. If the results are good, the drug will be used in hospitals from next year.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action of using something to test how it works.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The motorbike company ran trials to test the safety of it's vehicles.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peggeram eyew te pegbehey te puhawang ke nekey ka egpakaluyud.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: In sport, trials are the games which happen before the main competition, to decide who can join.

entries.summary: tribu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a number of families or other groups with a similar culture and the same ancestor.

entries.summary: hipanew; egpakasipè; egkasaligkat; egpeled (pinaahi te pegsaligkat te paa); egpakapeled; egsaligkat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action of traveling to a place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My trip to Cagayan was good, because the bus was not crowded.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Meupiya ka hipanew ku diyè te Kagayan, su ka terak warè napenù.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you trip, or trip_over something, you catch your foot on that thing, and fall down.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She tripped over the rock and fell over.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakasipè sikandin te batu wey napeled.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpeled (pinaahi te pegsaligkat te paa); egpakapeled; egsaligkat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something trips you, they cause you to fall over by catching your foot.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The naughty boy put his foot out to trip me when I was running.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ungel ne lukes ne batè migsaligkat keddì te paa rin te pegpalahuy ku.

entries.summary: wangal; hukag; prublima; mareet ne sitwasyun; dilikadu ne sitwasyun; pegpeehetey; pegpeusihey; samuk

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We had a lot of trouble with our motorbike when we drove to Davao.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have a lot of eye trouble, because my eyes are weak.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Life is hard for him because he has many troubles.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: mareet ne sitwasyun; dilikadu ne sitwasyun

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She got into trouble swimming in the deep water, and someone needed to save her.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Diyè sikandin te dilikadu ne sitwasyun te pegpamanihus din diyè te maralem ne weyig, wey keilangan ne egluwasen sikandin te duma.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The police arrested the men who were causing trouble in the shopping mall.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something troubles you, you feel worried about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father's bad health really troubles me.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: himu ne malised diyè te keykew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: work that is not easy for you to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's no trouble at all for me to help you.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ne malised kayi te keddì ka pegbulig keykew.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She went to a lot of trouble to make a delicious meal.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you trouble someone, you ask them to do something which they may not want to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm sorry to trouble you, but could you help me to carry this?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Pasaylua a ne egbanggew kuna, piru egkaayun ded ubag ne egbulihan a ni keykey ne eg-uyan kayi?

entries.summary: eleg; malehet; telek; malehet; matareng; matulanged; matalengteng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is true, it fits the reality (e.g., a true story).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The story she told us wasn't true, she just made it up.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is true, it is real (e.g., a true diamond).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It looks like a pearl, but it's not a true pearl.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person is true, they are faithful, and always do the good or right thing for their friend or family member.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is a true friend; she visited me almost every day when I was sick.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He remained true to his wife throughout their marriage, and never cheated with other women.

entries.summary: egsalig; pegsalig

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you trust someone, you believe that they will do the right thing, or will do what they say.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling of believing that someone will do the right thing.

entries.summary: pegkamalehet; kenè ne ubaten; maheteng

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The truth about something is the real facts about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He always tries to tell the truth.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Layun egpanugtul sikandin te malehet ne sitwasyun.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A truthful person tells the truth.

entries.summary: eggeram; Eggamit te kanekal wey keseg eyew egkakuwa piru kenè egkahaha.; Eggeraman egkeena, eggamiten wey ke eggimuwen eyew te pegnengneng ke meupiya naa.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you try, you use energy and effort to do something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She is a good student who always tries hard.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Eggamit te kanekal wey keseg eyew egkakuwa piru kenè egkahaha.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you try to do something, you use energy or effort, but you can't do that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She tried to reach the top of the hill, but it was too hard.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eggendiyè din perem eggeram te puntul te bubungan, piru warè din nahaha.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Eggeraman egkeena, eggamiten wey ke eggimuwen eyew te pegnengneng ke meupiya naa.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you try something, or try doing something, you eat it, use it or do it because you want to experience it or see if it is good.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Try some of this soup. Do you like it?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Gerami nu seini se sabew. Igkeupii nu red?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Maybe your hair will be better if you try using a different shampoo.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kema ke ka bulbul nu egmeupiya ke eggeraman nu eggamiti te lein-lein ne siyampu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: peggeram te pegkeen, peggamit wey ke peggimu eyew te pegnengneng ke meupiya naa.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Don't be afraid of swimming! Give it a try!

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ka egkaaldek [egka͡aldek] ne eglumbuk! Gerami nu!

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is_tried, they go to court and it is decided if they are innocent or guilty.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something difficult tries you, it causes you stress or other bad feelings.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My naughty brother really tries my mother's patience.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka umbeg ne suled ku amana egtameneng te iney ku.

entries.summary: tubu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a long, round thing which you can put things in (e.g., a tube of toothpaste).

entries.summary: tunu
egtileng; egtileng-tileng; egpatileng; egpatileng-tileng; egbekad; egbalikid

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something turns, they move so that they face in another direction, or move in a circle one or more times.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She turned around to see what the noise was.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The CD was turning quickly in the player.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you turn someone or something, you cause them to face in another direction or to move in circle.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He turned the handle of the door.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you turn something such as a page, you cause the other side of it to be on the top.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When you make banana-cue, you need to turn the bananas so that they don't burn.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you turn, you change the direction that you're moving in.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We turned left at the corner.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something turns ADJECTIVE, or turns into something, it changes to become that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The leaves of the dying tree turned yellow.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me dewun te egpatey ne kayu egmemakalawag e.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The caterpillar turned into a beautiful butterfly.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka uled neyimu ne meupiyan kalibangbang.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I turned 17 on my last birthday.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migsabeka ad ne pulù wey pitu te iyam ne miglihad ne aldew ne neetawa.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your turn is your chance or obligation to do something after others have done it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My friend has finished using the computer, and now it's my turn.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekeimpus e ka alukuy ku ne miggamit te kumpyutir, ne kuntee keddiey e degma ne turnu.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit nu seini te peglalag meyitenged te sabeka ne butang ne neyitabù pegkeimpus te sabeka, wey due kalabetan ne newun-a ne neyitabù.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use in_turn to talk about one thing which happens after another, and is connected to the first action

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I explained the problem to her, and she in turn explained it to the others.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Impangguhud ku ka prublima, pegkeimpus sikandin e degma ka migpangguhud diyè te duma.

entries.summary: eggulipis
sabeka ne karumaan [karuma͡an] te punduk ne due pegpekeg-iling; klasiyan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sabeka ne karumaan [karuma͡an] te punduk ne due pegpekeg-iling; klasiyan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: one of the members of a group of similar people or things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What type of music do you like?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekey ne klasiyan te me ulahingen ka igkeupii nu?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A van is a type of vehicle.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sabeka ne klasiyan te terak ka ban.

entries.summary: egpamesel-pesel (meyitenged te pegsulat te kumpyutir wey ke tayipraytir); egtayip

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpamesel-pesel (meyitenged te pegsulat te kumpyutir wey ke tayipraytir); egtayip

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you type, you use a keyboard (e.g., on a computer) to produce writing.

entries.summary: mareet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something is ugly, they are not good to look at.

entries.summary: payung
anggam

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: your mother's brother, mother's sister's husband, father's brother or father's sister's husband.

entries.summary: ngaran te minsan nekey ne kenè nu egkaseel, su malised ne egkakita ka minsan sabeka kayi (iling te weyig, kahalaan).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ngaran te minsan nekey ne kenè nu egkaseel, su malised ne egkakita ka minsan sabeka kayi (iling te weyig, kahalaan).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the name of something that you can't count, because it is difficult to see one of it (e.g., water, happiness). Uncount nouns are always singular.

entries.summary: egselib; te diralem; te selib; nabunbunan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something moves under something else, it moves below it from one side of it to the other

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The dog ran under the fence.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migselib migpallahuy ka asu te alad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is under something else it is directly below it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I keep my clothes under my bed.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Inggeles ku ka me kumbalè ku diyè te selib te hibatanan ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is under something else, that other thing is covering it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The baby is under the blanket.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is under someone else, that other person has responsibility and authority to tell them what to do.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My supervisor is always respectful to the workers under him.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka ahalen ku amana egtahud te me trabaanti [traba͡anti] ne diddiralem kandin se katenged.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: de-deisek dè te nakahi ne seel

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a certain number is under another number, it is less than that other number.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are under 50 people in my village.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: De-deisek dè te singkuwinta ne etawan ka kayi te bariyu.

entries.summary: egkabunbunan; eg-ayatan; nenakaanig [nenaka͡anig]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something underlies a second thing, it is under that second thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Hard rock underlies the soil here.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka makehal ne me batu nabunbunan kayi te tanè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something underlies another thing, it causes or produces that other thing, and maybe is not easy to see.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A lack of vitamins underlies his sickness.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegkakulang te bitamina iyan eg-ayatan te dalu rin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something underlying is covered or hidden by another thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't know the underlying reason for his sickness.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Wara a nakataha te nenakaanig ne aliddanan te dalu rin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is hard to make a well because of the underlying rock.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Malised ne iggimu te belun tenged te nenakaanig ne batu.

entries.summary: egpakanengneng; egpakasabut; egkanengnengan ka etew wey ke geramen; egkasabut

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you understand something, you are able to know what it is, or what it means, or how it works.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't understand what you mean.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I understand what the problems are.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkanengnengan ka etew wey ke geramen; egkasabut

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you understand a person or feeling, you know that person and their feeling, and believe that it is OK for them to be or feel like that.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My best friend really understands me.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can understand why you are so upset; I know that you loved your dog that died.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A: I'm sorry that I have to leave early, but my sister is sick. B: No problems, I understand.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: A: Pasaylu-a a te mahaan e rè eg-awè, su ka atebey ku egderalu. B: Nakasabut a, warè prublima.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of understand

entries.summary: pegkasabeka; pegpalemungey; pegpasaamuley; nekeg-amul; migsabeka; punduk ne eggimu te pegtabang te me mimbru eyew due meupiya ne sitwasyun te trabahu wey bayad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of two or more things joining together to become one thing

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The union of the two clubs created a larger, stronger club.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pegpaamuley te daruwa ne grupu nekeyimu te dakel, wey nenekali ne grupu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group of two or more things that have joined together (e.g., the European Union, which includes many European countries).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: punduk ne eggimu te pegtabang te me mimbru eyew due meupiya ne sitwasyun te trabahu wey bayad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A union, or trade_union, is a group that works to help the members to have good work conditions and pay.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He became a member of the teacher's union.

entries.summary: sengebuuk ne kasangkapan; grupu te me etew ne eggimu te nateil ne himuwen, wey ke nateil ne lugar ne egtrabahuwan dan.; baad te mekina ne due nateil ne himu

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are 20 family units in our sitio.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: grupu te me etew ne eggimu te nateil ne himuwen, wey ke nateil ne lugar ne egtrabahuwan dan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a group who do a particular job together, or the place where they work.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She works in the emergency unit of the hospital.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: baad te mekina ne due nateil ne himu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a machine or part of a machine which does a particular thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The cooling unit in the van is broken.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A unit of measurement is a particular measurement (e.g., centimeters, liters) which you use to say the size of something.

entries.summary: egkasabeka; egpakasabeka; egpakalibulung

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people or things unite, they join together to become one group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The people of the village united to save the houses from the fire.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me etew te bariyu nasabeka te pegbantey ne kenè egkasilaban ka me baley.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The two teams united to make one stronger team.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something unites people or things, it causes them to join to become one group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The emergency united the people in the town.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sahuhunè ne hitabù nakalibulung te me etew diyè te lungsud.

entries.summary: pegsabeka
pangkinatibuk-an
Ka minsan nekey ne nakatahù kayi te kalibutan wey diyè te ligwang te kalibutan, apil e ka me butang, inirhiya, aw-awangan, me bituen wey me inged.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Ka minsan nekey ne nakatahù kayi te kalibutan wey diyè te ligwang te kalibutan, apil e ka me butang, inirhiya, aw-awangan, me bituen wey me inged.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The universe is everything that exists on Earth and outside Earth, including things, energy, space, stars and planets.

entries.summary: seup te hayiskul ne iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a place for education after high school, where students can study to receive a degree (e.g., Bachelors, Masters). It is also a place for research.

entries.summary: Egkahamit seini ke eglalag ka te minsan nekey ne kenè egkeyitabù ke ka duma ne butang malehet.; Egkahamit seini ke eglalag ka te minsan nekey ne egkeyitabù dè ke ka duma ne butang malehet.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini ke eglalag ka te minsan nekey ne kenè egkeyitabù ke ka duma ne butang malehet.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use unless to say that something will not happen if another thing is true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'll sell my bike, unless you want it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Igbelegyè ku ka bayik ku, ke kenè ka egkeupian kayi.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini ke eglalag ka te minsan nekey ne egkeyitabù dè ke ka duma ne butang malehet.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use unless to say that something will only happen if another thing is true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I won't sell it to him unless he pays more than 200 for it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ku igbelegyè seini kandin ke kena a egbayaran nikandin te subla te daruwa ne gatus.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I won't buy anything unless I see something very cheap.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena a egbebeli te minsan nekey ke kenè ku pad egkakita ka minsan nekey ne amana ne baratu.

entries.summary: taman te (meyitenged te pegpabulus te weil); taman te (meyitenged te pegtahad)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: taman te (meyitenged te pegpabulus te weil)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happens until a certain time, it continues and then stops at that time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She stayed here until Fiesta finished.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-ugpè sikandin kayi taman te neimpusan ka pista.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something doesn't happen until a certain time, it does not happen before that time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She didn't leave until Fiesta finished.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè miggipanew sikandin taman te neimpusan ka pista.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She didn't stop working until dark until the middle of July.

entries.summary: egpatakereg; egpamaneyik; egkatut; patakereg; paribabew; egparibabew; egpeureyik

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you move up something such as a ladder, you move to a higher position on that thing.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is located up something such as a ladder, it is located at a higher position on that thing

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Their house is about 2km up the mountain.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka baley ran su me daruwa ne kilumitru pad patakereg te bubungan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you move up something such as a road, you move to a higher or further place along that thing.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is located up something such as a road, it is located at a further position on that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Their house is about 2km up the road.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka baley ran su me daruwa ne kilumitru pabulus diyè te kewun-aan [kewun-a͡an] te kelesadda.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a number or level goes up, it becomes higher or larger.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My grades went up at college because I studied more.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migderakel ka gradu ku te kulihiyu ad su migpakanekal a mig-istadi.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The water level in the river is going up.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a period of time is up, it is finished.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Your time for the test is up, so please stop writing.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Neimpusan e ka uras te tis nu, sika ka palihug sanggel kad ka egsulat.

entries.summary: te (nekeuntud te; nakaampew te); te (meyitenged te nekeglegsè wey ke nekegsinundul ne weil)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is upon something else, it is on that thing. (used in formal language)

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She had a hat upon her head.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: te (meyitenged te nekeglegsè wey ke nekegsinundul ne weil)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use upon if one thing happens immediately after another thing, or at the same time. (used in formal language).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Upon standing up, he forgot his speech.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te pegsasindeg din, nalingawan din e ka eglalahen din.

entries.summary: dibabew
igkeupii
eggamit; eg-amin; egpakaamin; peggamit

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you use something, it is a tool or method for you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I know how to use a dictionary.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something uses something, it consumes it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That motorbike uses a lot of gas.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sika ne mutur amana egpakaamin te dakel ne gasulina.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the action of using something (make_use_of something).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The use of fertilizers in farming is increasing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you have a carabao, you should make use of it in your field.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the purpose that something is used for.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Bamboo has many uses, such as carrying water and building houses.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kawayan due masalig ne egkahamitan, iling te sakeruwanan te weyig, wey te pegbebeley.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you have the use of something, you can use it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I have the use of his carabao when he is out of town.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakahamit a te kalabew rin te warè sikandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something that is useful can help you somehow.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Bamboo is a very useful plant.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is useless, it can't help you at all.

entries.summary: ngaran te eggamit
naanaran; nalayaman; meyilut

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is usual, it is the same as what often happens.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I just had my usual breakfast: rice with sardines.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miglem-ag a te nalayaman ku: hemey wey tinapa.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Not smoking inside is a usual regulation in the church.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Meyilut ne kukuman te simbaan ka kenè egpanihupan diyè te seled.

entries.summary: pegpakabulig; me himu diyè te inged ne egbayaran te me etew (iling te kurinti)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The utility of something is the fact that it is useful.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm not sure about the utility of that small table, even though it is very pretty.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kena an siguradu ne egpakabulig kas deisek ne lamisa, minsan ke seini amanan meupiya.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: me himu diyè te inged ne egbayaran te me etew (iling te kurinti)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a public service such as electricity, which people pay to have in their house.

entries.summary: eggamit; peggamit

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you utilize something, you find a way to use it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We utilize the space behind our house for growing vegetables.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggamit ney ka tanè diyè te liyu te baley ney eyew egpamulaan te me gulay.

entries.summary: warè pulus; warè karuan

eleg su due meupiya ne aliddanan; egkahamit wey ke egkaayun su ka organisasyun wey ke gubirnu egdawat wey warè pad degma neimpus ka aldew te tammanan te lisinsya.; 1 pegkeeleg; 2 pegkahamit wey ke pegkaayun

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eleg su due meupiya ne aliddanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something that you think, say or do is valid, it is okay because there is a good reason for it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She didn't give any valid reason for what she did.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè migbehey sikandin te eleg ne aliddanan ke nekey ka inggimu rin.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkahamit wey ke egkaayun su ka organisasyun wey ke gubirnu egdawat wey warè pad degma neimpus ka aldew te tammanan te lisinsya.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a document such as a licence is valid, you can use it because organizations or the government will accept it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His licence is not valid because it is old.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka lisinsya rin kenad egkaayun su neimpus e ka katammanan.

entries.summary: miglabiung

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the low place between two hills

entries.summary: due karuan
egdakelan; eggeyinawaan; kamenu karakel ka eleg ne igbayad; egbaliyan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you value someone or something, you believe that they are very important.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I really value my dog, because he is a companion as well as a guard.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kamenu karakel ka eleg ne igbayad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The value of something is how much money is the correct amount to pay for it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What's the value of his horse.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you value something, you look at it carefully to decide how much money is the correct amount to pay for it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They valued my motorbike at 10,000 pesos.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbaliyan dan ka mutur ku te sapulù ne libu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The value of something is how useful or helpful it is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There's not much value in brushing your teeth before a meal.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has high values: he is very honest and faithful.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due meupiya ne batasan din: kenè ne taluen sikandin wey mapalintutuu.

entries.summary: egkatarin; egkaawè; egkatebas

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something vanishes, people suddenly can't see it or can't find it any more.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Suddenly, the sun vanished as the clouds moved over it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sahuhunè, ne natarin ka siha te aldew te migtagmaan te gapun.

entries.summary: uwang; inuwang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: tiny drops of water or other liquid floating together in the air.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a solid or liquid becomes a gas, it is called vapor.

entries.summary: egkaalin-halin [egka͡alin-halin]; masalsaliyu; kaalin-halin [ka͡alin-halin]

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something variable is not the same all the time; it changes.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The weather in our area is variable. Sometimes it is very dry, and sometimes it is rainy.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka timpu diyè te kanami egkaalin-halin. Due meinit ne timpu wey due ting-uran.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that does not always stay the same; often something else changes because the variable changes.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The price of gas is an important variable in the cost of having a motorbike.

entries.summary: lein-lein; sabeka ne karumaan [karuma͡an] te punduk ne due pegpekeg-iling; klasiyan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A variety of things is a number of different things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I eat a variety of vegetables so that I will be healthy.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeen a te lein-lein ne klasiyan te gulay eyew meupiya ka peglelawa ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is important to have variety in your diet.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sabeka ne karumaan [karuma͡an] te punduk ne due pegpekeg-iling; klasiyan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A variety of something such as a plant or animal is a kind or type of that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This variety of banana has a very thin skin.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ne karumaan te sahing due amana ninipisi ne luwit.

entries.summary: masalig ne nalein-lein

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use various to say that there are a number of different things or people.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Various people visited my house at the weekend.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Masalig ne nalein-lein ne me etew ne migmanumbaley diyè te baley ku te seeyè se Sebadu.

entries.summary: egpalin; eggalin; egsaliyu; lein; egpapalin; egpahalin; egpasaliyu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something varies, it is not always the same; it changes sometimes.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The length of the dry season varies; some years it is short, and other years it is quite long.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something varies, it is not the same for everyone; it is different for different people or things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The color of cats' eyes varies from cat to cat.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka batek te mata te miyew lein du te batek te mata te duma ne miyew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you vary something, you cause it to not be the same all the time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I vary my diet by eating different kinds of vegetables.

entries.summary: me lalag ne due weil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a word which talks about an action (e.g., eat) or state (e.g., believe). You can change verbs to make them talk about the past, present or future.

fields.label: Compare
fields.text: transitive verb, intransitive verb, auxiliary verb, reciprocal verb.

entries.summary: birsikulu
lein ne klasi te nateil ne butang, ne senge lein te duma ne klasi; lein ne pegkapangasak

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: lein ne klasi te nateil ne butang, ne senge lein te duma ne klasi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A version of something (e.g., a movie) is one of the forms of that thing, which is different from the other forms.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are two versions of that movie. The old version was made in 1980, and the new version was made last year.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due daruwa ne pegkalein te sika ne salida. Ka hun-a ne neyimu te 1980 pad, wey ka iyam ne klasi neyimu te miglihad pad leg-un

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the story of a particular event as one person or group tells it (the story may be different for different people and groups).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My version of the accident is quite different from his.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka keddì ne pegkapangasak te mareet ne neyitabù su bayew lein te kandin.

entries.summary: amana; subla
uhat ne usuhanan te me langesa

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: uhat ne usuhanan te me langesa

entries.summary: eglihad te; egbayè te

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you go via a place, you travel through that place to get to where you want to go.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They went to Davao via Cotabato.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggendiyè sikandan te Dabaw ne eglihad te Kutabatu.

entries.summary: kareehan; kapanaluwan
ka langun ne egkakita nu ne ula-ula diyè te nateil ne lugar; suman-suman wey pegtuu (meyitenged te nateil ne eglalahen); egsuman-suman wey egtuu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka langun ne egkakita nu ne ula-ula diyè te nateil ne lugar

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: everything that you can see when you are in a particular place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There is a beautiful view of the mountains from that hill.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: suman-suman wey pegtuu (meyitenged te nateil ne eglalahen)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your view on a particular topic is what you think and believe about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has very strong views on alcohol: he hates it, because his mother was a heavy drinker.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you view someone or something as a particular thing, that is what you think and believe about them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Many people view Rizal as one of the greatest national heroes.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Masalig ne me etew ne egsuman-suman ne si Rizal sabeka ne mabantug ne bayani.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you view something such as a TV program, you watch it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your view of something is the general way that you think about it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A child's view of fun may be very different from an adult's view.

entries.summary: maagsik-agsik (meyitenged te etew); nenekali; kekesehi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A vigorous action or person is strong or has a lot of energy.

entries.summary: bariyu; sityu
peglapas
egsuwey
malalab
kamenu kariyù ka egkakita nu; pegkakita; pegkamating-ew

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There was a lot of fog on the road, so visibility was very poor.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due dakel ne gapun te kelesadda, sika ka kenè ne mariyù ka egkakita.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The fact that something can be seen.

entries.summary: mating-ew; egkakita

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is visible, it can be seen.

entries.summary: egleuy; eggendiyè te deisek dè ne timpu; pegleuy te etew wey ke lugar

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egleuy; eggendiyè te deisek dè ne timpu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you visit a person or place, you go to that person or place for a short time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We visited my grandmother in the hospital.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migleuy key te Apu ney diyè te uspital.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We visited Davao for three days.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggendiyè key te Dabaw seled te tatelu ne aldew.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegleuy te etew wey ke lugar

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action of visiting a person or place (pay_someone_a_visit).

entries.summary: mahaliyug
laheng; due kanekal egpakalalag te igkeupii; eglalag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the sound that you make when you speak or sing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She has a beautiful voice, so I love to hear her sing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I could hear voices in the room, but I wasn't sure who it was.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If people have a voice, they are able to say what they think and want.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The Femmatrics helps to give tribal people a voice in decisions about land.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you voice a feeling or idea, you say it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: After the meeting she voiced to me her unhappiness with the decision.

entries.summary: karakelan te minsan nekey, wey ke kamenu karakel ka kaluahan ne egkahamit; kamenu keemen [ke͡emmen] ka dahing; libru

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: karakelan te minsan nekey, wey ke kamenu karakel ka kaluahan ne egkahamit

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the amount of something, or how much space it uses.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A large volume of traffic travels along this road.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka masulug ne karakelan te trapik ne nekeusug te kelesadda.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What is the volume of water in that bucket?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kamenu karakel ka weyig sika te baldi?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Could you please turn down the volume of the music? It's too loud.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kaayun ubag ne peyimulungi nu rè ka dahing te musika nu. Amana ne meemen [me͡emen].

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a book, often one in a series of books.

entries.summary: eg-alam (igkalalag te tagsè sabeka ke hendei ka igkeupii ran ne etew wey ke puhawang. Wey ka grupu eg-alam te pinakameupiya ne etew wey ke puhawang naa).; peg-alam

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-alam (igkalalag te tagsè sabeka ke hendei ka igkeupii ran ne etew wey ke puhawang. Wey ka grupu eg-alam te pinakameupiya ne etew wey ke puhawang naa).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a group of people vote, they each say which person or idea they want. Then the group chooses the most popular person or idea.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Which candidate are you going to vote for in the election.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Hendei ka kendidatu ne igkeupii nu ne eg-alamen?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The committee voted to change the name of the group.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kumiti mig-alam te pegbalew-balew te ngaran te grupu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We couldn't decide what to do, so we had a vote.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè ki egpekewukum ke nekey ka eggimuwen ta, sika ka due peg-alam te eyew te pegbutar.

entries.summary: laheng te peglalag ne kenè egsanggel ka kalamag te be-bè nu ne egligwang.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: laheng te peglalag ne kenè egsanggel ka kalamag te be-bè nu ne egligwang.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a speaking sound that you make when you don't restrict air coming out of your mouth. In the English alphabet, there are five vowel letters: a, e, i, o and u.

entries.summary: bayad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the money that you regularly receive for working.

entries.summary: hawak
egtahad; kaluhayen te pegtetahad; egbehey wey egpanggated te pegkeen wey ke egkeinum

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you wait_for someone or something, you don't start until that person or thing is ready.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Don't wait for me, just start eating.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a period of waiting for something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The supermarket was crowded, so there was a long wait at the counter.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egbehey wey egpanggated te pegkeen wey ke egkeinum

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you wait_on someone, you bring them the things that they need (especially food and drink).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The girl who waited on us at the restaurant was very helpful.

entries.summary: suluhuanen
suluhuanen ne malitan
eggimata; egpekew; pegdamag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you wake, or wake_up, you open your eyes after you have finished sleeping.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you wake someone, you cause them to stop sleeping.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a gathering of people when a dead person is buried.

entries.summary: eggipanew; peggipanew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you walk, you move on foot, not too fast, and you roll your foot forward from your heel to your toe.

entries.summary: alabat

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A flat structure made of something such as blocks or wood, which stands up and separates one area from another (e.g., in a house).

entries.summary: egleug-leug
egkeupian; kulang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you want something, or want to do something, you wish to have it or do it.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A want of something is the fact that there is none of that thing, or not enough of it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My garden died for want of rain.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pamulaan ku migpamatey su kulang te uran.

entries.summary: ehetayey; gubut

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a period of fighting between two or more groups or countries.

entries.summary: bayew meinit; egmeinit; eg-init; eg-iinit; egpameinit; eg-dalap; egderalap

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is warm, it is a bit hot, but not very hot.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something warms_up, it becomes warmer.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The weather was cold this morning, but the day is warming up now.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you warm something, or warm something up, you cause it to become warmer.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She sat close to the fire and warmed her hands.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone is warm, they are friendly.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She said hello to me with a warm smile.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They gave me a warm welcome.

entries.summary: egpataha

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you warn someone, you tell them about something bad or dangerous that might happen, so that they will stay away from that bad thing.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past of be (first person singular and third person singular)

entries.summary: eglu-lù (te belad wey ke platu); egpami-pì (te manggad); egdihus (te batè); egkulisung (te platu); egdep-ug (te ula-ula); eggugas (te belad, paa, wey ke platu); eg-anlas

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eglu-lù (te belad wey ke platu); egpami-pì (te manggad); egdihus (te batè); egkulisung (te platu); egdep-ug (te ula-ula); eggugas (te belad, paa, wey ke platu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you wash something (e.g., clothes, plates, a motorbike, a baby, your face), you use water to make it clean.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If water washes something somewhere, it moves the thing to that place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My tsinillas fell into the river, and the river washed them down to the bridge.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka sinilas ku neuleg diyè te pahamayan ne weyig, wey ka weyig mig-anlas peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te tulay.
