fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you watch someone or something, you focus your eyes and mind on them. Usually they are moving.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you watch something, you check and control it carefully.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She has some health problems, so she needs to watch her diet carefully.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Due me prublima rin te peglelawa, sika ka egbantayan din kas kandin ne egpangeenen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She kept a careful watch on the child.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a small clock which you wear on your arm

entries.summary: weyig; egweyihan; egbisbisan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the clear liquid that makes rain, rivers and oceans.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you water plants, you pour water on them so that they will live.

entries.summary: sebseb
egwelewes te belad; pegwelewes te belad; egwelewes te minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you wave, you put your hand in the air and move it, often to say hello or goodbye to someone, or to cause them to look at you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: They waved to us as they walked past our house.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action of moving your hand in the air.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He said goodbye with a wave.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you wave something, you hold it in the air and move it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He waved the paper in the air.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as grass waves, it moves from side to side in the air.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The tall grass waved in the wind.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a moving line of water in the sea or a river.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is very windy, so there are waves on the water.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a soft curl in the hair.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Her hair isn't very curly, but it has waves in it.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ula-ula te minsan nekey iling te dahing wey ke signal te radyu te pegweil diyè te kalamag.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the shape of something such as sound or radio signals as they move through the air.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We hear things because our ears catch sound waves.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: sahuhunè ne pegtulin te minsan nekey (iling te eggeramen, eggimuwen wey ke karakelan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a sudden increase in something such as a feeling or activity.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A wave of people moved to our town last year.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sahuhunè ne peggalin te me etew diyè te lungsud ney te seeyè se miglihad ne tuig.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She felt a wave of happiness in her heart.

entries.summary: tuli
dalan; peggipanew; pamaahi

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a path or direction to a place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Can you tell me the way to your sitio?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kaayun ne egpanuluen a nikeykew te dalan peendiyè [pe͡endiyè] te sityu niyu?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the travelling of a person or animal (on_the_way)

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I lost my hat on my way to school.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Natarin ka kalù ku te peggipanew ku peendiyè te iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an].

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a way to do something or a way of doing something is a style or method of doing it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That's the wrong way to fix a roof.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seyyup sika ne pamaahi te peg-upiya te atep.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit te peglalag te nateil ne weil, eggeramen wey ke sitwasyun.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use the_way to talk about a particular action, feeling or situation.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I'm telling the truth. That's the way that it happened.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpanugtul a te malehet. Neiling iya due te pegkeyitabù.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I can't explain the way I feel.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you live in another country, it takes time to learn about the ways of the people there.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In many ways, Sinuda is more comfortable than Davao.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te masalig ne baad, ka Simud malmaluwan te Davao.

fields.text: ki; key; sikanta; sikanami; ta; ney

entries.summary: mahuyè; mahaan egkasuhù; kenè mahaan egpakaweil wey ke egpabalew-balew te me butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or animal is weak, they are not able to do difficult things with their body.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person is weak, it is easy for other people to make them do things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The boy is quite weak, and always follows his friends, even when they do bad things.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka batè bayew mahaan egkasuhù, wey layun eg-ikul te me alukuy rin, minsan eggimu sikandan te mareet ne himuwen.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kenè mahaan egpakaweil wey ke egpabalew-balew te me butang

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If an action or thing is weak, it can't move or change things easily (e.g., a weak push).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is weak, it can break easily.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The weak rope broke when I pulled it hard.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: dakel se weyig, wey ka nanam kenè ne manekal iling te keppi wey duma pad

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a liquid is weak, it contains a lot of water, and the taste is not strong (e.g., weak coffee).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: 1 pegkamahuyè; 2 pegkamahaan egkasuhù; 3 kenè ne pegkamahaan pegpakaweil wey ke pegpakabalew-balew te me butang; 4 pegkamahaan egkapesè; 5 pegkarakel se weyig, wey ka nanam kenè ne manekal

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something bad in a person's character.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His hot temper is his weakness.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka meinit se ulu rin ka mareet ne batasan din.

entries.summary: karatuan
panganiban

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something that you use to fight with (e.g., a gun, a spear, a bomb).

entries.summary: egsaluub te minsan nekey diyè te me baad te lawa; nateil ne klasiyan te me manggad ne igpanaluub; egkareetan e su nahamit e te malayat ne timpu

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egsaluub te minsan nekey diyè te me baad te lawa

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you wear something such as clothing, jewelry, or make-up, you put it on your body to cover or decorate yourself.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nateil ne klasiyan te me manggad ne igpanaluub

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a particular type of clothing (e.g., casual wear).

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkareetan e su nahamit e te malayat ne timpu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something wears, it becomes damaged because it is used a lot or used for a long time.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migmanipis e seini ne me sinilas su nasaluub e.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something wears another thing, it causes that other thing to become damaged over a period of time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The river wore the stones until they became smooth.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pahamayan ne weyig nakapeiyam te me batu taman te neyimu seini ne mallurung.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Wear is the damage that happens to something because it is used a lot.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This chair is old, but it doesn't show any sign of wear, because it is very good quality.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: There are no big problems with the motorbike, just general wear from everyday driving.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Wear is the amount of time that you can use something before it becomes damaged or too old.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Those shoes are good quality, so you will get a lot of wear out of them.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Meupiya seeyè ne klasiyan te sepatus, sika ka due kaluhayan nu te egpanggamit due.

entries.summary: timpu; egpekapabuyag; egpakapalepuk; egbunsud e egkabuyag ne egtengtengan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: what is happening with the air and clouds in a particular place.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If things such as sun and rain weather something, they cause it to look older.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This chair is always outside, so it has been weathered a lot by the rain.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ne bangku diyè layun te ligwang, sika ka nalepuk e seini te dakel ne uran.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something weathers, it starts to look older because of things such as sun and wind.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This chair has weathered, so it's a lighter colour now.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ne bangku egkaraan e, sika ka naa kuntee ka eglubad e ka batek kayi.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakaantus (te etew wey mananap); egkeuyag (te etew, mananap, wey pinamula); warè namenu (te warè umul)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a person or thing weathers a difficult situation, it is able to survive.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The house was strong, so it weathered the storm.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka baley su makehal, sika ka warè namenu te bagiyu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has had a hard life, but has weathered it well.

entries.summary: pegpangimu
hilamunen
simana

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a period of seven days, usually counted from Sunday to Saturday, or Monday to Sunday.

entries.summary: impus te simana
kabehat; pabehat; kamenu ka keimpurtanti ka minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the weight of something is how heavy it is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The weight of the bananas is 800 grams.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kabehat te sahing su me walu ne gatus ne gramu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a heavy thing which is used to hold something down, or which people practice lifting in order to become strong.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He lifts weights at the gym because he wants his muscles to become big.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggenat din ka pabehat diyè te bebasbasanan su egkeupian sikandin ne ka me bakelawan din egderakel.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: kamenu ka keimpurtanti ka minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the weight of something is how important it is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I really respect him, so his advice holds a lot of weight for me.

entries.summary: meupiya ne pegginguma
peglelawa; bulig puun te gubirnu ne igpamehey te me etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: your welfare is how you are: your health, safety and comfort.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I am worried about the welfare of my friend, because I haven't heard from him for more than two weeks.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkalaggew a te peglelawa te alukuy ku, su warè kud narineg sikandin te suble e te daruwa ne simana.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He cares for the welfare of his animals, so he always makes sure that they have food and shelter.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: bulig puun te gubirnu ne igpamehey te me etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: help which the government gives to people who are in need (e.g., sick, or very poor).

entries.summary: eg-ay-ayaran; egpaay-ayaran; tetelesi; meupiya amana; eg-ay-ayaran; meupiya (meyitenged te peglelawa)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you do something well, you do it skilfully, and the quality of the action is good.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-ulahing sikandin ne amana ne tetelesi.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you do something well, you do it very completely.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You must wash it well so that there is absolutely no dirt remaining.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eg-ay-ayaran nu seini te egpi-pì eyew warad iya bilu ne egkahaat [egkaha͡att].

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are well, your health is good.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Q: How are you? A: Well, thanks.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: duen pad malayat ne timpu wey ke dakel ne kaleinan te daruwa ne numiru.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use well with words like before and under to say that there is a large difference between two numbers or times.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We will arrive well before dark, so don't worry.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpekeyinguma key te kenè pad egkarusilem, sika ka kenè ka kalaggew.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We paid well over 100 pesos for it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakabayad key te subla pad te mahatus te para kayi.

entries.summary: belun; lungag ne maralem ne eg-angayan te gesulina wey ke gas; egsuwak; egpanihis

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a hole in the ground from which you get water

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: lungag ne maralem ne eg-angayan te gesulina wey ke gas

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a deep hole in the ground from which you get oil or gas.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a liquid wells up, it flows up or out from a place (e.g., tears from your eyes, or water from a well).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If you dig a hole in the ground near a spring, water will well up.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past of be (first person plural, third person plural, second person singular and plural)

entries.summary: iglineb

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the direction which is opposite of east. The sun goes down in this direction.

entries.summary: puun te iglineb ne inged; Eggamit eyew te peglalag te me menà diyè te Iyurupa wey Nurt Amirika.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: something western is in or from the west part of a place.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-ugpè sikandin diyè te iglineb ne baad te Mindanaw.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Eggamit eyew te peglalag te me menà diyè te Iyurupa wey Nurt Amirika.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use Western to describe things that are connected to the culture of Europe and North America (e.g., Western art, Western thinking).

entries.summary: egsubid; nasubid

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you wet something, you put water or another liquid on it.

entries.summary: nekey; nekaa; langun; Egkahamit seini te pegpanunggiling te amana ka minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use what to ask or talk about a thing or action.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekey ne me mananap ka nakita niyu?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't remember what I said.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè kud egkasuman-suman ke nekey ka inlalag ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What we need to do is wait.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka keilangan kuntee ne eggimuwen ta su ka egtetahad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use what to mean 'everything' or 'all'.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She gave me what money she had.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbehayan a nikandin te seleppì ka langun ne diyè te kandin.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She gave me what she had.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: Egkahamit seini te pegpanunggiling te amana ka minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use what with a noun to describe something strongly.

entries.summary: minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use whatever to say that it is not important exactly what something is, or how much it is.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My children do whatever jobs I ask them.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me anak ku egmaruma-ruma te minsan nekey ne igpeyimu ku kandan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Whatever I said yesterday, I'm sorry.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Minsan nekey ne nalalag ku gabii, pasaylua a.

entries.summary: trigu
ligid

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a round thing that moves around and around.

entries.summary: ken-u; te (meyitenged te timpu te neyitabù); ne; ke

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use when to ask or talk about a time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When are you going to visit them?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keen-u ka a eggendiyè ka egleuy kandin?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't know when he will come.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: te (meyitenged te timpu te neyitabù); ne

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use when to talk about the time that something happens.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Evening is the time when I rest.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Marusilem ka timpu te peggimeley ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Do you remember the day when I lost my cellphone?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakasuman-suman ke pad te aldew ne nalaag ka silpun ku?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I met her when I was at school.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nalambag kud sikandin te diyè e pad te iskuylaan [iskuyla͡an].

fields.label: English example
fields.text: 1977, when I was born, was a good year.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: 1977, te peglesut ku, su amana ne meupiya ne tuig.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use when to say a reason.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: How can I call him when I don't know his number?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Menuwen ku naa te eg-umew kandin ke wara a nakataha te numiru rin?

entries.summary: tagsè; minsan ken-u

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use whenever to say that something happens every time that another thing happens

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It always rains whenever I want to visit my friend.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Layun eg-uran tagsè egkeupian a ne egleuy te alukuy ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Whenever I take the dog for a walk, he barks a lot.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Tagsè eg-alapen ku ka asu te eggipanew, amana eggebu sikandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use whenever to say that it is not important exactly when something happens.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Whenever you arrive, just text me and I'll come and meet you.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Minsan ken-u ka egginguma, tiks ke rè wey egtemuwen ku si keykew.

entries.summary: hendei; ke hendei; ne

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use where to ask or talk about a place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We don't know where he is.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ware key nakataha ke hendei sikandin.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use where to say something about a place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This is the town where I was born.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ka lungsud ke hendei a ilesut / Seini ka lungsud ne inlesutan ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Manila, where I was born, is a big city.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Dakel ne siyudad ka Menila ne inlesutan ku.

entries.summary: ne...mulè (meyitenged te daruwa ne kasangkapan ne nekeglein); piru

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ne...mulè (meyitenged te daruwa ne kasangkapan ne nekeglein); piru

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use whereas to talk about two things that are different.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I prefer chicken, whereas my sister prefers pork.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian a te manuk, ne ka atebey ku mulè egkeupian te karni te babuy.

entries.summary: tagsè; minsan hendei

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use wherever to say that something happens in every place that another thing happens.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Wherever you see kittens, you will probably find a mother cat nearby.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Tagsè egpakakita ka te me dereisek ne miyew, egkakita nu iya diyè te marani ka Iney kayi.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use wherever to say that the exact place is not important.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Sit wherever you want, it doesn't matter.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Pinnuu ka minsan hendei ne igkeupii nu, warè prublima.

entries.summary: ke (eyew te insè ne uya wey kenè se tabak); minsan ke

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ke (eyew te insè ne uya wey kenè se tabak)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use whether to talk about questions which have a yes-or-no answer.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She asked me whether I wanted to stay.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-insè sikandin ke egkeupian e naa ne egpalunggehaat [egpalunggeha͡at].

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't know whether anyone told him.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use whether when you talk about two or more options.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It doesn't matter whether they go to their own house, or their aunt's house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè prublima minsan ke eggendiyè sikandin te baley ran, wey ke diyè te baley te ayè dan.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I will go whether or not it rains.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eggipanew a minsan ke kenè eg-uran wey ke eg-uran.

entries.summary: hendei (ke due eg-alamen); ne (eyew te peglalag te duma ne kanengnengan te butang)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use which to ask about something that you can choose from a small group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Which do you want: the red passionfruit or the yellow one?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Hendei ka igkeupii nu: ka malalab ne prutas ne pasyun wey ke ka makalawag?

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Which passionfruit do you want: the red one or the yellow one.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ne (eyew te peglalag te duma ne kanengnengan te butang)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use which to say more about a thing or situation.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My house, which has two rooms, is near the highway.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka baley ku, ne due daruwa rè se sinabeng, su marani rè te kelesadda.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I want to buy the one which is cheaper.

entries.summary: minsan hendei; minsan nekey

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use whichever to say that it is not important which thing happens or which thing you choose.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Whichever seat you choose, you will not be comfortable.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Minsan hendei ne pinnuuwan ka eg-alamen nu, kenè ka iya egkaluwan.

entries.summary: taheed; te (meyitenged te sasangan ne gimuwen); nè...mulè; piru

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She stayed with her aunt for a while.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-ugpè sikandin taheed diyè te ayè din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something happens while another thing is happening, it happens in the same period of time.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She watched me while I cooked.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migtengtengan a nikandin te migsusubba a.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I met my best friend while I was living in Bukidnon.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nalambag ku ka telek ne alukuy ku te peg-ugpè ku pad te Bukidnon.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use while to talk about two things that are different.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She likes playing sport, while her brother prefers reading.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian sikandin ne eggalew, ne ka suled din mulè egkeupian ne egbasa.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use while to say that one fact is not changed or affected by another fact.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: While there are many milk products in the stores, the best milk for babies is their mother's milk.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Minsan pad due masalig ne gatas diyè te tindaan [tinda͡an], ka gatas ded iya te iney ka meupiya para te me batè.

entries.summary: egnaas-naas
egpanlagkuy; egpammiyung; bansuwit
maangkag

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the colour of teeth or bones

entries.summary: egpamaangkahen
hentew-a; ne

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use who to ask or talk about somebody.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Who wants to come with me?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Hentew a ka egkeupian ne egduma keddì.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use who to say something more about a person.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I met a girl who knew my cousin.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakalambag a te malitan ne nekeila te suled ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father, who is a teacher, works in the next town.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka amey ku ne meistru diyè migtrabahu te egpakasinundul ne lungsud.

entries.summary: minsan hentew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use whoever to talk about a person or people when it doesn't matter or you don't know who they are.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Whoever wins the contest will receive a cash prize.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Minsan hentew ne egdeeg te kuntis egpakarawat te seleppì ne dasag.

entries.summary: langun (meyitenged te minsan nekey); intiru; kinatibuk-an; timman

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I've lived here my whole life.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-ugpa a kayi te intiru ne umul ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a whole is something made of parts joined together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The body is a whole: all the parts are connected and work together.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka lawa iyan kinatibuk-an: ka langun ne baad nakasumpul wey eggimu sikandan langun.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is whole, all the parts of it are together, and it is not broken.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Take a photo of the cake while it is still whole, before we cut it up.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Litratuwi nu ka kik taheed te senge timman pad, te kenè te pad egpedperiyen seini.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The hungry dog swallowed the large bread roll whole, in just one bite.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: In-abeleng te eggutgutasan ne asu ka senge timman ne dakel ne paan [pa͡an], te sabeka rè ne kahat.

entries.summary: hendei, hentew-a; hentew; ne

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use whom to ask or talk about the person that is the object of the verb. Whom is formal, and some people just use who.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use whom to say something more about the person who is the object of the verb. Some people just use who.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The girl to whom I spoke was a friend of my cousin.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka malitan ne migpakiglalahan ku su alukuy te suled ku.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I met a girl whom my cousin knew.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakalambag a te malitan ne ka suled ku nekeila kandin.

entries.summary: mania; ke mania

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use why to ask or talk about the reason for something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I don't know why he left early.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He asked me why I was crying.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use why to talk about the reason for something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That's the reason why he left early.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sika ka aliddanan ke mania te seselemi mig-awè sikandin.

entries.summary: maluag; kaluag; naseled ka masalig ne klasiyan te me kasangkapan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something wide has a large measurement from one side to the other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: His field is very wide, so he can grow a lot of vegetables.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kamet din amana ne maluag, sika ka egpakapamula sikandin te dakel ne gulayan.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use wide to give the measurement of something from one side to the other.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka kamet din su singkuwinta ne mitrus ka kaluag.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: naseled ka masalig ne klasiyan te me kasangkapan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If a range of things is wide, it includes many different things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That shop sells a wide range of vegetables.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eglabet te masalig ne etew wey dakel ne lugar

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is wide, it includes many people in a large area.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka pulitiku ne etew due dakel ne supurta.

entries.summary: balu ne malitan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a woman whose husband is dead

entries.summary: balu ne lukes

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a man whose wife is dead.

entries.summary: kakepal; kaluag; kaluahan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The width of something is the measurement from one side to the other.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What is the width of that field?

entries.summary: asawa ne malitan; igmalitan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the woman to whom a man is married.

entries.summary: mahintalunan
eglalag te egginguma pad; egpaka-, egpeke- (meyitenged te egpekeyimu)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you say that something will happen, you are talking about the future.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I think it will rain tomorrow.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you say that something will do something, you mean that it can do that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This shampoo will help to take away dandruff.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Seini ne siyampu egpakabulig te peg-awè te kaspa.

entries.summary: katuenan te peg-alam te igkeupii wey pegbeye-beyè te me weil; igkeupii; dukumintu te impangamuney ne kasangkapan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: katuenan te peg-alam te igkeupii wey pegbeye-beyè te me weil

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your will is your ability to choose what you want to do, and to control your actions.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He has a very strong will, and so I can't make him change his mind.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Your will is the thing that you want to happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Excellent sportsmen have the will to win.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: In a democracy, there are elections to find out the will of the people.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the document that you leave when you die, to say who will receive your money and things.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's important to write a will, so that your family knows how to divide your property.

entries.summary: egdeeg; egpakaangey te unag; pegdeeg

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you win a race, competition or argument, you get the best result.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you win a prize, you receive a prize in some kind of competition.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an action of getting the best result in a competition.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Our team had seven wins during the season.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpakaalig wey ke egpakapeupian te me etew

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you win people, you cause them to like you.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The politician won a lot of support when he visited the town.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She won a lot of sympathy when she told people her sad story.

entries.summary: pegpangalamag; egpakahutus; egpekeetut; butud; kalamahen

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We are going to fly our kites because the wind is strong.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egpalayang ki te tambanug ta su makeseg ka pegpangalamag.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an uncomfortable problem in which you have gas in your stomach.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Some foods such as raw foods can cause you to have wind.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka duma ne pegkeen iling te memeyilew ne pegkeen egpakahutus.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If weather is windy, there is a lot of wind.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Windy weather makes my hair untidy.

entries.summary: egtiku-tikù; egbelebed; egtilengen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a river or road winds, it has curves and bends in it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I feel sick when I catch the bus down the mountain, because the road winds a lot.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migderalu a te mig-untud a te terak peendiyad [pe͡endiyad] e te bubungan, su ka kelesadda egtiku-tikù.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you wind something long around another thing, you put it around that thing many times.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She wound the string around the pencil.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbelebed din ka kuwirdas diyè te lapis.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you wind a machine such as a watch, you turn a part of it around and around, so that it will work.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My alarm clock doesn't have a battery, you need to wind it.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka urasan ku warè batiri, keilangan ne egtilengen seini.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something such as a road is windy, it has a lot of bends and curves in it.

entries.summary: sulawanan; bintanà

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an opening in a wall to allow air and light into a building.

entries.summary: inumen ne due alkuhul ne egpekewubug ne puun te ubas

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: inumen ne due alkuhul ne egpekewubug ne puun te ubas

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: an alcoholic drink which is made from grapes.

entries.summary: pakpak
tingkalamag
egpunas
wayr

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a long, thin piece of metal.

entries.summary: nakataha wey mateu; katuenan
egkeupian perem; igkeupii

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use wish to talk about something now or in the past that you are not happy with, and would like to change.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I wish I could fly, but I can't.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian a ne egpakalayang perem piru kenè ku egkeyimu.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I wish I hadn't said that (but I did say it).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use wish to say that you want something good for someone.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I wish you a happy birthday.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Igkeupii ku ne due kahalè nu te aldew ne neetawan nu.

entries.summary: duma te; ne; ne due; gamit ka

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If someone or something is with someone or something else, they are together.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I like gabi tops with rice.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egkeupian a te tubed duma te hemey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: A person or thing with something has that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Look at the man with a broken leg.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Pitawa nu ka etew ne nahepuan te paa.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Look at the man with a red shirt.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Pitawa nu ka etew ne nakamalalab te kumabalè.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you do something with a tool or instrument, you use that tool or instrument to do that action.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I ate my meal with a fork.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Miggamit a te tinidur te pegkeen ku.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: meyitenged te; tenged te; puun te (meyitenged te aliddanan)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are doing something with a particular feeling, you are doing it because of the feeling.

entries.summary: seled te; seled dè te seeyè ne katamanan (ne timpu, kariyuan, wey ke karakelan).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is within a place, it is in the place.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She heard singing from within the house.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakarineg sikandin te eg-ulahing seled dè te baley.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You must stay within the goal circle.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: seled dè te seeyè ne katamanan (ne timpu, kariyuan, wey ke karakelan).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you do something within a certain range (e.g., time, distance), you do not go past the limits of that range.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He finished the work within 12 hours.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mig-impusan din ka himu te seled dè te sapulù wey daruwa ne uras.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We live within 2km of the school.

entries.summary: ne warè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is without another thing, it does not have or include that other thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Today I saw a tree without leaves.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kuntee nakakita a te kayu ne warè derewunen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He washed his hair without conditioner.

entries.summary: nakakita te neyitabù; nakakita ne minsan hentew te neyitabù; talagpamalehet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you witness something, you see it happen.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I witnessed a car accident yesterday.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nakakita a te aksidinti te terak gabii.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: nakakita ne minsan hentew te neyitabù

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I was the only witness to the accident.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Sikeddì dè iya ka nakakita te aksidinti te terak.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: someone who speaks in a criminal court about what they saw or what they know.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpamalehet pinaahi te pegpirma te ngaran

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you witness something for another person (e.g., a document or signature), you write your signature to say that the thing is real and true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I witnessed my friend's signature when she applied for a passport.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ka etew ne egpirma te ngaran eyew te pegpamalehet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a person who writes their signature to show that something is real and true.

entries.summary: malitan (buyag-buyag e)
kamalmalitanan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: past and past participle of win

entries.summary: egkatekkew wey egkeinu-inu amana te minsan nekey; nawangalan; pegkeinu-inu te amana ne tetelesi wey ke makabebagget ne minsan nekey; pegkawangali; kein-inuwan

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkatekkew wey egkeinu-inu amana te minsan nekey; nawangalan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you wonder at something, you feel very surprised or amazed.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She wondered at the beautiful sunset.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Neinu-inu amana sikandin te uupiyei ne peglineb te aldew.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: pegkeinu-inu te amana ne tetelesi wey ke makabebagget ne minsan nekey; pegkawangali

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a feeling of being surprised and amazed because something is very good or very interesting.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The child was full of wonder when he saw the tiny kittens.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When I look at the stars, I have a feeling of wonder, because they are so amazing.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is a wonder, it causes people to feel surprised and amazed.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The Great Barrier Reef in Australia is one of the wonders of the world.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He always forgets everything, so it's a wonder that he remembered his wife's birthday.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: ware nakataha wey egkeupian ne egpakataha

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you wonder, you don't know something and you want to know it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I wonder where my children are.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nangendei buwa ka me anak ku mulè.

entries.summary: kenè
kayu

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the hard material trees are made of

entries.summary: hinimu puun te kayu
bul-bul te me karniru

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the hair of sheep. Used in making warm clothes.

entries.summary: hinimu puun te me bul-bul te karniru

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: hinimu puun te me bul-bul te karniru

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: made from the wool of a sheep.

entries.summary: lalag; pangulibet; saad; lalew; guhuren

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a piece of language which can stand alone and has a meaning.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A dictionary gives the meanings of many words.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Egbehey ka diksyunari te masalig ne kaluwasan te me lalag.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I gave my word that I would tell nobody.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpangulibet a ne kenè ku igguhud te minsan hentew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: word of someone or something is news about them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We got word of the accident the next day.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nahuhuran key meyitenged te aksidinti te seup e ne aldew.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: eg-alam te me lalag ne eglalahen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you word something a particular way, you choose certain words to say that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She worded the email carefully so that he would not be angry.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: In-alam dè ay-ayari te malitan ka eglalahen din diyè te imil su eyew kenè egkabelu ka lukes.

entries.summary: eggimu; egtrabahu; himu; trabahu; neyimu; himuwen

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you work, you use your body or mind to do something.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: We worked hard at school this morning.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migpataman-taman key migtrabahu diyè te iskuylaan [iskuyala͡an] te maselem.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the thing that you do with your body or mind (do_work).

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You should check your work before you give it to the teacher.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Keilangan ne egtengtengan nu pad ka neyimu nu te kenè nu pad igbehey te meistara nu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something works, you can use it, because it is not broken.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: This machine doesn't work; maybe it's broken.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Kenè eg-andar seini ne mekina; nareetan buwad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something that you do works, it achieves the goal that you want to achieve.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: You are trying to trick me, but it won't work.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Eggeraman a nikeykew egsahiluta, piru kenè egsilbi.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you work something such as a machine, you control it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My friends worked the lights at the concert.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka me alukuy ku ka migpalayag te sulù te kunsirt.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: all of the things that are related to a particular area, activity, group of people, or group of things (e.g., the Western world, the entertainment world, the insect world, the world of work).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the evil system here on earth which does not love or obey God.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: The world is sometimes very attractive, but it is never good for us.

entries.summary: egkalaggew; egkalangè; egpakalaggew; egpakalangè; pegkalaggew; pegkalangè

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you worry about something, you feel bad and do not have peace, because you feel that there is trouble.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something worries you, it causes you to feel bad and have no peace.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: a bad feeling of having no peace.

entries.summary: mareet-deet

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is worse than another thing, it is more bad than that thing.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I sing worse than she does, because I have no ability.

entries.summary: egsimba; peggimu te me himu ne egpakita te pegtahud wey peggeyinawa te Manama (iling te, eg-ulahing, eg-ampu, wey egtahud ke nekey ka igkeupii rin ne igpeyimu kanta); pegsimba

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egsimba; peggimu te me himu ne egpakita te pegtahud wey peggeyinawa te Manama (iling te, eg-ulahing, eg-ampu, wey egtahud ke nekey ka igkeupii rin ne igpeyimu kanta)

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you worship God, you do activites to show that you respect and love him (for example, singing, praying, obeying what he says).

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: the things that you do to show God that you respect and love him.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The_worst thing is the number one bad thing in a group.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: That is the worst movie that I've ever seen, and I never want to see it again.

entries.summary: eleg ne bali ne igbayad; eleg ne bali; pegkakeilangan

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is worth a certain amount, that is the amount that people should pay for it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I paid 6,000 for that horse, but it is worth 8,000.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migbayad a te hen-em ne libu te kuddè, piru ka eleg ne bali kayi walu ne libu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The worth of something is how much money is the correct amount to pay for it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: What is the worth of that house?

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekey a ka kentidad te sika ne baley?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: The worth of someone or something is how important or necessary they are.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: A kind attitude is of great worth.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka meupiya ne batasan su dakel ne keilangan.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: meupiya ne eggimuwen su eyew kenè egkaraat ka uras nu.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something is worth doing, it is good to do, so you will not waste your time if you do it.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It's worth getting up early to watch the sunrise, even if the weather is cold.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Meupiya ne eg-enew te maselem-selem ne egtengteng te pegsilè te aldew, minsan pad ke ka timpu maagsil [ma͡agsil].

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use would to talk about an action that is not real.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If I saw a snake, I'd [I would] run (just imagining).

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke egpakakita a te uled, egpallahuy a.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: If he knew the answer, he'd [he would] tell you (but he doesn't know the answer).

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ke natahaan [nataha͡an] din ka tabak, egkahiyan ka perem nikandin (piru warè din nataheyi ka tabak)

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egkahamit seini te pegbehey te minsan nekey wey ke pegkahi te senge etew te maaddat ne pegpeyimu te minsan nekey.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use would to offer something or tell someone to do something politely.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you say that someone would do something, you mean that it was their habit in the past.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: When I was a child, my father would carry me on his shoulders.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Te batè e pad, egti-ti-angen a te amey ku.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you wound someone, you hurt their body so that the skin is broken.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you wound someone, you hurt their feelings badly.

entries.summary: mareet (ne himu); seyyup; sayep; kenè ne eleg ka suman-suman

fields.label: English example
fields.text: It is wrong to hurt people.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Mareet ne himu ka egpasakit ka te me etew.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: Something wrong is not true or not correct.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He got two answers wrong on the exam.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Daruwa ka seyyup ne tabak din te iksam din.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you are wrong about something, your thinking is not correct.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She thought it was a snake, but she was wrong.

fields.label: Matigsalug meaning
fields.text: egpekeyimu te mareet ne egpakapasakit te duma

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If you wrong someone, you do something bad that hurts them.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: He wronged his wife by leaving her.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Nekeyimu sikandin te pegpasakit te asawa rin pinaahi te peg-engked din.

entries.summary: gabii
pad; pad (kaluhey te pegpabulus); pad iya

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: If something hasn't happened yet, it hasn't happened in the time up to now, but you think that it will happen in the future.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She hasn't finished high school yet.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Warè pad nekeimpus sikandin te hayiskul.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: Has she finished high school yet?

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use yet to talk about an action that will continue into the future.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: I think that the road repairs will continue for a few weeks yet.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Migsuman-suman a ne ka peg-upiya te kelesadda egpabulus te me pilan simana pad.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use yet if one thing is more than another thing, and the other thing is already a lot.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: My father is tall, but my brother is yet taller.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Ka amey ku malangkew, piru ka suled ku lelangkawi pad iya degma.

fields.label: English explanation
fields.text: You use yet when it is surprising that two facts are both true.

fields.label: English example
fields.text: She's a Filipina, yet she doesn't like rice.

fields.label: Matigsalug translation
fields.text: Pilipina sikandin, piru kenè egkeupian sikandin te hemey.
